We validate the electromagnetic solver against multiple benchmark problems: wave propagation in a rectangular waveguide, a cavity problem with a singular solution, and a microwave-heated obstacle problem, comparing our results against numerical and experimental data from the literature. The results confirm the validity of the implementation and demonstrate its ability to perform adaptive mesh refinement using the DPG method's built-in error estimator. The final part of the study showcases the capabilities of the multiphysics framework through simulations of microwave-heated flow around obstacles with singular geometric features. These results highlight the potential of the proposed framework for the simulation and optimization of microwave-assisted chemical processes. Finally, the developed high-order multiphysics solver has a low memory footprint, since the electromagnetic solver relies on a Conjugate Gradient (CG) iterative solver and the fluid solver is implemented in a matrix-free fashion, making the overall approach scalable and well-suited for large-scale parallel simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出用于模拟微波加热流动的高阶多物理场求解器，将时间谐波 Maxwell 方程的 DPG 有限元方法与热方程和不可压 Navier-Stokes 方程的连续 Galerkin 有限元方法耦合。作者通过多个电磁基准问题验证求解器，并展示其利用 DPG 内置误差估计器进行自适应网格加密的能力。最终模拟表明，该框架适用于具有奇异几何特征障碍物周围的微波加热流动，并具备可扩展、低内存占用的大规模并行潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种用于模拟微波加热流动的高阶多物理场求解器。该求解器将用于时间谐波 Maxwell 方程的间断 Petrov-Galerkin（DPG）有限元方法，与用于热方程和不可压 Navier-Stokes 方程的连续 Galerkin 有限元方法相耦合。我们通过多个基准问题验证电磁求解器：矩形波导中的波传播、具有奇异解的腔体问题以及微波加热障碍物问题，并将我们的结果与文献中的数值和实验数据进行比较。结果证实了实现的有效性，并展示了其利用 DPG 方法内置误差估计器进行自适应网格加密的能力。研究的最后部分通过对具有奇异几何特征的障碍物周围微波加热流动进行模拟，展示了该多物理场框架的能力。这些结果凸显了所提出框架在微波辅助化学过程模拟与优化方面的潜力。最后，所开发的高阶多物理场求解器具有较低内存占用，因为电磁求解器依赖共轭梯度（CG）迭代求解器，而流体求解器以无矩阵方式实现，使整体方法具有可扩展性并非常适合大规模并行模拟。

articles.title: Bifurcations in the Heliosphere: Global-scale Coronal Pseudostreamer Evolution and the Creation of Secondary Heliospheric Current Sheets
articles.title_zh: 日球层中的分岔：全球尺度日冕伪流光演化与次级日球电流片的形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03298v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The heliospheric current sheet (HCS) is the boundary between open magnetic fields of opposite polarity in the solar wind that connect back to their respective open flux regions in the corona. The HCS is often described as a disc-like sheet warped by the combined effects of the inclination of the magnetic equator on the Sun, solar rotation, and solar wind expansion. The HCS is an extension of the helmet streamer belt-the closed-flux region resulting from the global dipole component of the observed photospheric magnetic field. In the absence of a strong dipole, a dominant quadrupole can result in two separate HCSs. Here we report on a set of idealized, axisymmetric solar wind simulations designed to study the transition of the single-HCS corona and inner heliosphere into a multiple-HCS configuration, run with the WindPredict-AW PLUTO MHD code. We systematically vary the relative strengths of the dipole/quadrupole contributions to the global field and show this results in the formation of a large-scale, closed-flux pseudostreamer that interacts with the ambient solar wind. We find that when the dipole and quadrupole magnitudes are approximately equal, our model corona can oscillate between a one- and two-HCS configuration on the timescale of days-to-weeks. We characterize the plasma dynamics of the transition of a global-scale pseudostreamer into a localized, secondary helmet-streamer belt with its own HCS surrounding a newly-opened, opposite-polarity coronal hole. We discuss the implications of our results for solar cycle evolution and the dynamic coupling of the highly structured corona and inner heliosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究用理想化轴对称太阳风模拟考察单一日球电流片的日冕和内日球层如何转变为多电流片构型。作者系统改变全球磁场中偶极与四极贡献的相对强度，发现可形成与背景太阳风相互作用的大尺度闭合磁通伪流光。模型表明，当偶极和四极强度近似相等时，日冕可在数日至数周时间尺度上于单电流片和双电流片构型之间振荡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 日球电流片（HCS）是太阳风中相反极性开放磁场之间的边界，这些磁场向回连接到日冕中各自的开放磁通区域。HCS 通常被描述为一种盘状片结构，受到太阳上磁赤道倾角、太阳自转和太阳风膨胀的共同作用而发生弯曲。HCS 是盔状流光带的延伸，后者是由观测到的光球磁场的全球偶极分量产生的闭合磁通区域。在不存在强偶极的情况下，占主导的四极可能导致两个分离的 HCS。在这里，我们报告一组理想化轴对称太阳风模拟，旨在研究单 HCS 日冕和内日球层向多 HCS 构型的转变，这些模拟使用 WindPredict-AW PLUTO MHD 代码运行。我们系统改变全球磁场中偶极和四极贡献的相对强度，并表明这会导致形成一个与背景太阳风相互作用的大尺度闭合磁通伪流光。我们发现，当偶极和四极的大小近似相等时，我们的模型日冕可以在数日至数周的时间尺度上在单 HCS 和双 HCS 构型之间振荡。我们表征了全球尺度伪流光转变为局地次级盔状流光带时的等离子体动力学，该次级盔状流光带具有自身的 HCS，并环绕一个新近打开的相反极性日冕洞。我们讨论了这些结果对于太阳周期演化以及高度结构化日冕与内日球层动态耦合的意义。

articles.title: The Role of Preceding CMEs and SIRs in Enhancing Shock Acceleration of Electrons
articles.title_zh: 前导日冕物质抛射与流相互作用区在增强电子激波加速中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03709v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The role of large-scale pre-existing interplanetary structures, including preceding coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and stream interaction regions (SIRs), in shaping the shock acceleration environment for energetic electrons remains not fully understood. In this study, we investigate nine interplanetary shocks observed by the Solar Terrestrial Relations Observatory (STEREO) that are associated with significant MeV electron enhancements, as such enhancements are rarely observed at interplanetary shocks. We combine remote-sensing observations, drag-based modeling, and in-situ measurements to analyze the shock propagation through pre-existing interplanetary structures. Eight of the nine events are associated with a preceding slow or intermediate-speed CME, while six shocks are in-situ observed propagating within preceding ICMEs, indicating that large-scale upstream trapping structures are a common feature of these events. Further analysis identifies three distinct scenarios associated with enhanced electron acceleration: shocks propagating through preceding ICMEs, shock-SIR interactions, and direct injection of flare-accelerated electrons into SIRs. As a representative shock-in-ICME event, the 2012 January 29 low-β, quasi-perpendicular shock (θBₙsim87^circ) is further investigated using observations together with one-dimensional Monte Carlo test-particle simulations of a shock propagating into a large-scale upstream magnetic loop. The simulation suggests that the upstream loop prolongs electron residence near the shock and substantially enhances acceleration efficiency. These results demonstrate that large-scale interplanetary structures can precondition the upstream magnetic environment, providing favorable conditions for prolonged electron residence and efficient shock acceleration.
articles.abstract_zh: 大尺度预先存在的行星际结构可能通过改变激波上游磁环境，增强高能电子的激波加速。对九个与显著MeV电子增强相关的行星际激波进行研究发现，前导CME、前导ICME和激波-SIR相互作用是三种主要情形。模拟表明，上游大尺度磁环能够延长电子在激波附近的停留时间，从而显著提高加速效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 包括前导日冕物质抛射（CME）和流相互作用区（SIR）在内的大尺度预先存在的行星际结构，如何塑造高能电子的激波加速环境，仍未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们考察了由太阳—地球关系天文台（STEREO）观测到的九个行星际激波，这些激波均与显著的MeV电子增强相关，因为在行星际激波处很少观测到此类增强。我们结合遥感观测、基于阻力的模型和原位测量，分析激波穿过预先存在的行星际结构时的传播过程。九个事件中的八个与先前出现的慢速或中速CME相关，其中六个激波被原位观测到正在前导ICME内部传播，这表明大尺度上游俘获结构是这些事件的共同特征。进一步分析确定了与增强电子加速相关的三种不同情形：激波在前导ICME内部传播、激波与SIR相互作用，以及耀斑加速电子直接注入SIR。作为一个具有代表性的ICME内激波事件，我们进一步研究了2012年1月29日的低β准垂直激波（θBn约为87°），所采用的方法结合了观测数据与一维蒙特卡罗测试粒子模拟，模拟对象是一个向大尺度上游磁环传播的激波。模拟表明，上游磁环能够延长电子在激波附近的停留时间，并显著提高加速效率。这些结果表明，大尺度行星际结构能够预先调节上游磁环境，为电子长时间停留和高效激波加速提供有利条件。

articles.title: FPGA Implementation of a CNN-based Topological Trigger for HL-LHC
articles.title_zh: 面向高亮度大型强子对撞机的基于卷积神经网络拓扑触发器的FPGA实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.09428v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The implementation of convolutional neural networks in programmable logic, for applications in fast online event selection at hadron colliders, is studied. In particular, an approach based on full event images for classification is studied, including hardware-aware optimisation of the network architecture, and evaluation of physics performance using simulated data. A range of network models are identified that can be implemented within resources of current FPGAs, as well as the stringent latency requirements of HL-LHC trigger systems. A candidate model that can be implemented in the CMS L1 trigger for HL-LHC is shown to be capable of excellent signal/background discrimination for a key HL-LHC channel, HH(bbbb), although the performance depends strongly on the degree of pile-up mitigation prior to image generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在可编程逻辑中实现卷积神经网络，以用于强子对撞机的快速在线事例选择。研究重点是基于完整事例图像的分类方法，并结合硬件感知的网络架构优化和模拟数据上的物理性能评估。结果表明，某一候选模型可部署于CMS高亮度大型强子对撞机一级触发器，并能在HH→bbbb道中实现出色的信号与背景判别，但其性能高度依赖图像生成前对堆积效应的抑制程度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了在可编程逻辑中实现卷积神经网络，以应用于强子对撞机中的快速在线事例选择。具体而言，研究了一种基于完整事例图像进行分类的方法，其中包括网络架构的硬件感知优化，以及利用模拟数据对物理性能进行评估。研究确定了一系列网络模型，它们既能够在当前FPGA的资源范围内实现，也能够满足高亮度大型强子对撞机（HL-LHC）触发系统严格的延迟要求。研究显示，一个可部署于CMS高亮度大型强子对撞机一级触发器的候选模型，能够在一个关键的高亮度大型强子对撞机物理道HH（bbbb）中实现出色的信号与背景判别能力，不过其性能强烈依赖于图像生成之前对堆积效应的抑制程度。

articles.title: CARDIO-Affect: A Hamiltonian-Variability Framework for Spatio-Temporal Emotional Pattern Recognition with Manifold-Based Individual and Group Profiling
articles.title_zh: CARDIO-Affect：用于时空情感模式识别及流形个体与群体刻画的哈密顿量变异性框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.16046v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present CARDIO-Affect, a complex-systems theoretical framework for long-term emotional dynamics in bounded social groups, with explicit uncertainty quantification at every layer. Long-period naturalistic emotion in stable small groups exhibits hallmarks of complex systems -- multi-stable attractors, weak chaos, long-range memory, and sparse heterogeneous coupling -- invisible to conventional short-clip facial-emotion analysis. CARDIO-Affect treats individual emotion as a multi-stable nonlinear stochastic dynamical system and group emotion as a sparsely-coupled network with emergent macrostates, formalised through six propositions and four pillars: (i) statistical mechanics with neural-parameterised Hamiltonian SDE over asymmetric potentials; (ii) information geometry on a 45-dimensional Fisher-Rao manifold; (iii) topological data analysis for invariant trajectory signatures; (iv) HRV-inspired Emotional Variability Analytics (EVA) decomposing each person-day into multi-scale time/frequency/nonlinear measures. We validate on the first 30.1-month longitudinal in-the-wild facial-emotion corpus (companion: arXiv:2510.15221) by discovering three falsifiable paradoxes: Sparse-Contagion (R₀=0.36, density 2.7%, 8 BH-FDR edges), Asymmetric-Persistence (negative dwell 5.85x positive, 1.77D potential gap), and Crisis-Inversion (Shanghai 2022 lockdown naive d=-0.40 collapses to permutation-p=0.94 under BSTS + synthetic-control). On synthetic benchmarks, CARDIO-EBM v2 matches asymptotically optimal Granger on linear VAR data (Class A AUROC 0.984+/-0.012 vs Granger 0.997+/-0.001, 5 seeds) but fails on tanh-coupled nonlinear data (Class B AUROC 0.490 vs Granger 0.796), a documented limitation of the linear mask-self estimator. We release framework code and the full reproduction pipeline.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出CARDIO-Affect，用于描述受限社会群体中的长期情感动力学，并在各层级显式量化不确定性。该框架结合神经参数化哈密顿随机微分方程、Fisher-Rao信息几何、拓扑数据分析和多尺度情感变异性分析。基于纵向自然场景面部情感数据，研究发现了稀疏传染、不对称持续性和危机反转三个可证伪现象，同时报告了模型在非线性耦合数据上的局限性，并公开了代码与复现实验流程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出CARDIO-Affect，这是一个用于描述受限社会群体中长期情感动力学的复杂系统理论框架，并在每一层显式进行不确定性量化。稳定小群体中的长周期自然情境情感表现出复杂系统的特征，包括多稳态吸引子、弱混沌、长程记忆和稀疏异质耦合，而这些特征在传统的短片段面部情绪分析中是不可见的。CARDIO-Affect将个体情感视为多稳态非线性随机动力系统，并将群体情感视为具有涌现宏观状态的稀疏耦合网络，具体通过六个命题和四个支柱加以形式化：（i）采用具有非对称势的神经参数化哈密顿随机微分方程的统计力学；（ii）45维Fisher-Rao流形上的信息几何；（iii）用于不变轨迹特征分析的拓扑数据分析；（iv）受心率变异性启发的情感变异性分析（EVA），将每个人每天的情感分解为多尺度的时间域、频率域和非线性指标。我们在首个为期30.1个月的真实场景纵向面部情感语料库上进行了验证，该语料库的配套研究见arXiv:2510.15221，并发现了三个可证伪的悖论：稀疏传染（R0=0.36、密度为2.7%、8条经BH-FDR校正的边）、不对称持续性（负面情感的停留时间是正面情感的5.85倍，势差为1.77D），以及危机反转（2022年上海封控期间，朴素估计的d=-0.40在BSTS加合成控制方法下坍缩为置换检验p=0.94）。在合成基准测试中，CARDIO-EBM v2在合成线性VAR数据上达到了与渐近最优格兰杰方法相近的表现（5个随机种子下，A类AUROC为0.984±0.012，而格兰杰方法为0.997±0.001），但在双曲正切耦合的非线性数据上表现失败（B类AUROC为0.490，而格兰杰方法为0.796），这表明线性掩码自估计器存在已记录的局限性。我们公开了框架代码和完整的复现实验流程。

articles.title: On large-scale wind-drift ocean currents: An asymptotic approach in spherical coordinates
articles.title_zh: 大尺度风生海洋漂移洋流：球坐标下的渐近方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06473v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Starting from the Navier--Stokes equations in rotating spherical coordinates with depth-varying density and eddy viscosity, we derive an asymptotic model describing non-equatorial wind-generated ocean drift currents. Our approach allows for large-scale flows that cannot be captured by classical tangent-plane approximations. The strategy is to perform a careful scaling and to perform a double asymptotic expansion with respect to two small parameters arising from the scaling: the Rossby number and the ratio between the Ekman depth and the Earth's radius. We obtain a system of linear ordinary differential equations with nonlinear boundary conditions governing the leading-order dynamics, highlighting that the dynamics is governed by the linear terms, whereas the nonlinear ones, related to the injection and dissipation of kinetic energy, appear only at higher order. We use the leading-order equations to compare our model with the simplest theory of ocean circulation due to Sverdrup and note that, even at this level of simplification, our equations have the potential to provide deeper insight. Subsequently, focusing on Ekman flows, we prove existence and uniqueness of the leading-order solution, which retains the classical Ekman spiral structure for arbitrary eddy viscosity profiles. Finally, we compute the surface deflection angle of the wind-driven current for three explicit eddy viscosity profiles, obtaining results consistent with observations. In addition, we derive the governing equations for the first-order correction with respect to the Rossby number and provide a priori bounds for its solution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从具有随深度变化的密度和涡黏性的旋转球坐标Navier–Stokes方程出发，推导描述非赤道风生海洋漂移洋流的渐近模型。通过对罗斯贝数和厄克曼深度与地球半径之比进行双重渐近展开，得到由线性常微分方程和非线性边界条件构成的领先阶模型。该模型保留了任意涡黏性剖面下的经典厄克曼螺旋结构，并给出了表面偏转角及罗斯贝数一阶修正的结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从旋转球坐标下、具有随深度变化的密度和涡黏性的Navier–Stokes方程出发，推导出一个描述非赤道风生海洋漂移洋流的渐近模型。我们的方法能够处理经典切平面近似无法描述的大尺度流动。具体策略是进行仔细的尺度分析，并针对由该尺度分析产生的两个小参数进行双重渐近展开，这两个参数分别是罗斯贝数以及厄克曼深度与地球半径之比。我们得到一个由线性常微分方程和非线性边界条件构成的系统，用以控制领先阶动力学，并揭示动力学由线性项主导，而与动能注入和耗散有关的非线性项只在更高阶出现。我们利用领先阶方程将该模型与Sverdrup提出的最简单海洋环流理论进行比较，并指出，即使在这一简化层次上，我们的方程也有望提供更深入的认识。随后，我们聚焦于厄克曼流，证明了领先阶解的存在性和唯一性，并表明该解在任意涡黏性剖面下仍保留经典的厄克曼螺旋结构。最后，我们针对三种显式涡黏性剖面计算了风驱动洋流的表面偏转角，所得结果与观测一致。此外，我们推导了关于罗斯贝数的一阶修正所满足的控制方程，并为其解给出了先验界。

articles.title: Revealing Magnon-Photon Coupling in Ultrathin Magnetic Films Using the Derivative-Divide Method
articles.title_zh: 利用导数-相除法揭示超薄磁性薄膜中的磁振子-光子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.10770v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnon-photon coupling in planar cavities provides a promising platform for integrated cavity magnonics devices. However, its characterization becomes challenging in ultrathin magnetic films because their weak magnetic response can be obscured by the much stronger microwave background. Here, we employ the derivative-divide method to extract the field-dependent magnetic response from transmission measurements of split-ring resonators. The method reveals clear magn-photon anticrossings that are hardly discernible in conventional transmission spectra and enables quantitative extraction of the coupling strength. We resolve coupling in yttrium iron garnet films down to 60 nm and extend the approach to conductive CoFeB films down to 5 nm. Our results demonstrate a practical method for characterizing magno-photon coupling in ultrathin magnetic films, providing an experimental route toward cavity magnonics systems based on ultrathin magnetic films.
articles.abstract_zh: 平面腔中的磁振子-光子耦合为集成腔磁学器件提供了平台，但超薄磁性薄膜的微弱磁响应容易被强微波背景掩盖。本文采用导数-相除法，从裂环谐振器的透射测量中提取随磁场变化的磁响应，并清晰解析出常规透射谱中难以辨认的反交叉现象。该方法在厚度低至60纳米的钇铁石榴石薄膜和厚度低至5纳米的导电CoFeB薄膜中均实现了耦合强度的定量提取。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平面腔中的磁振子-光子耦合为集成腔磁学器件提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，在超薄磁性薄膜中，由于磁响应较弱，耦合特性的表征可能具有挑战性，因为磁响应会被强得多的微波背景所掩盖。在这里，我们采用导数-相除法，从裂环谐振器的透射测量中提取随磁场变化的磁响应。该方法揭示了清晰的磁振子-光子反交叉，而这些反交叉在传统透射谱中几乎难以辨认，并能够定量提取耦合强度。我们在厚度低至60纳米的钇铁石榴石薄膜中分辨出耦合，并将该方法扩展到厚度低至5纳米的导电CoFeB薄膜。我们的结果展示了一种表征超薄磁性薄膜中磁振子-光子耦合的实用方法，为构建基于超薄磁性薄膜的腔磁学系统提供了实验途径。

articles.title: Learning shadows to predict quantum ground state correlations
articles.title_zh: 学习量子阴影以预测量子基态关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.00052v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a variational scheme inspired by classical shadow tomography to compute ground state correlations of quantum spin Hamiltonians. Shadow tomography allows for efficient reconstruction of expectation values of arbitrary observables from a bag of repeated, randomized measurements, called snapshots, on copies of the state ρ. The prescription allows one to infer expectation values of M k-local observables to accuracy ϵ using just N sim 3^k logM /ϵ² snapshots when measurements are performed in locally random bases. Turning this around, a bag of snapshots can be considered an efficient representation of the state ρ, particularly for estimating low-weight observables, such as terms in a local Hamiltonian needed to estimate the energy. Inspired by this, we consider a variational scheme wherein a bag of N parametrized snapshots is used to represent the putative ground state of a desired local spin Hamiltonian and optimized to lower the energy with respect to it. Additional constraints in the form of positivity of reduced density matrices, motivated by work in quantum chemistry, are employed to ensure compatibility of the predicted correlations with the underlying Hilbert space. Despite the limited set of imposed constraints, we show that the optimized ensemble of snapshots yields fairly accurate estimates of the ground state energy and other correlations, including those that do not appear in the set of constraints used in optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种受经典阴影层析启发的变分方案，用于计算量子自旋哈密顿量的基态关联。该方法以一组参数化测量快照表示候选基态，并通过降低局域哈密顿量能量进行优化，同时利用约化密度矩阵的正定性约束保证预测关联与底层希尔伯特空间相容。尽管施加的约束有限，优化后的快照集合仍能较准确地估计基态能量及未直接用于优化约束的其他关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种受经典阴影层析启发的变分方案，用于计算量子自旋哈密顿量的基态关联。阴影层析允许人们从对量子态ρ的多个副本进行重复随机测量所获得的一组快照中，高效重构任意可观测量的期望值。该方法表明，当测量在局域随机基底中进行时，只需N约为3的k次方乘以log M再除以ε的平方个快照，就能够以精度ε推断M个k-局域可观测量的期望值。反过来看，一组快照可以被视为量子态ρ的一种高效表示，尤其适用于估计低权重可观测量，例如用于估计能量的局域哈密顿量项。受此启发，我们考虑一种变分方案，其中使用由N个参数化快照组成的集合来表示目标局域自旋哈密顿量的候选基态，并通过针对该哈密顿量降低能量对其进行优化。我们进一步施加了约化密度矩阵正定性形式的约束，这些约束受到量子化学相关工作的启发，用于确保预测得到的关联与底层希尔伯特空间相容。尽管施加的约束集合有限，我们仍然表明，优化后的快照集合能够较准确地估计基态能量和其他关联，包括那些未出现在优化所用约束集合中的关联。

articles.title: Quantum Skyrmions in Mixed States of Light and Their Nested Topology
articles.title_zh: 光的混合态中的量子斯格明子及其嵌套拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.23571v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Topological quasiparticles of light, such as classical and quantum optical skyrmions, have so far relied on fully coherent or pure quantum states whose topology is encoded in the entanglement between polarization and two-dimensional spatial modes. Here we show that skyrmionic topology can emerge directly within the density matrix of a mixed quantum state. We introduce a framework in which a coherence-Stokes vector defines a topological texture over the density matrix, enabling the realization of quantum skyrmions using only a pseudospin and a real or synthetic one-dimensional space of modes. For a single photon, the density matrix is analogous to the coherence matrix of classical light, and can be encoded using partially coherent electromagnetic fields. We further analyze the topological texture encoded in a bipartite entangled photon pair, showing how skyrmions arise not only in the full bi-photon system, but also in its reduced subspaces with any pseudospin-mode combination simultaneously. We then explore the robustness of such skyrmions to environmental noise, and discover their persistence in mixed-quantum states of multiple photons. Finally, we propose a feasible experimental route to generate and measure such skyrmions using integrated photonic networks, and suggest avenues for similar implementations in other quantum systems. Our work paves the way for robustly encoding classical information on partially coherent light or on mixed quantum states and for encoding topological charges on many-body quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 以往的经典和量子光学斯格明子通常依赖完全相干或纯量子态，其拓扑编码在偏振与二维空间模式之间的纠缠中。本文表明，斯格明子拓扑也可以直接存在于混合量子态的密度矩阵中，并通过相干性-斯托克斯矢量在密度矩阵上构造拓扑纹理。研究进一步展示了双光子纠缠态及其约化子空间中的嵌套斯格明子，分析了环境噪声下的稳定性，并提出利用集成光子网络进行生成和测量的实验方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 迄今为止，光的拓扑准粒子，例如经典和量子光学斯格明子，通常依赖完全相干态或纯量子态，其拓扑编码在偏振与二维空间模式之间的纠缠中。在这里，我们表明，斯格明子拓扑能够直接在混合量子态的密度矩阵内部产生。我们提出一个框架，其中相干性-斯托克斯矢量在密度矩阵上定义拓扑纹理，从而只利用一个赝自旋和一个真实或合成的一维模式空间即可实现量子斯格明子。对于单光子而言，密度矩阵类似于经典光的相干矩阵，并且可以利用部分相干电磁场进行编码。我们进一步分析了双分纠缠光子对中编码的拓扑纹理，展示出斯格明子不仅存在于完整的双光子系统中，也能同时存在于任意赝自旋-模式组合所对应的约化子空间中。随后，我们研究了此类斯格明子对环境噪声的鲁棒性，并发现它们能够在多光子混合量子态中持续存在。最后，我们提出一种利用集成光子网络生成和测量此类斯格明子的可行实验路径，并建议在其他量子系统中开展类似实现。我们的工作为在部分相干光或混合量子态上稳健编码经典信息，以及在多体量子系统上编码拓扑荷，开辟了道路。

articles.title: SU3HOB-ladder: a Fortran package for harmonic-oscillator brackets in the SU(3) basis from pseudo-spin ladder operators
articles.title_zh: SU3HOB-ladder：基于伪自旋阶梯算符在 SU(3) 基中计算谐振子括号的 Fortran 程序包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02640v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present SU3HOB-ladder, a Fortran 2008 package computing the general Talmi-Moshinsky harmonic-oscillator transformation brackets for an arbitrary mass-ratio parameter d in the SU(3) basis. The bracket reduces to a single sum over Wigner d-functions of the reflection-containing Talmi-Moshinsky matrix, weighted by products of SU(3) > SO(3) isofactors of the chain U(6) > U(3)xU(2); the isofactors are d-independent, so they are built once per block (E,L) and reused for every d. We obtain them from the U(2) pseudo-spin generators of that same chain: because the U(3) and U(2) labels inside [E] of U(6) are complementary, the highest-weight states are the null space of the raising operator J₊ = a^dag(1).a(2) and the remaining members of each multiplet follow by lowering, so that no SU(3) recoupling machinery, K-matrix or outer-multiplicity resolution is required at any point. We compare this construction with two alternatives that produce the same brackets - the same scheme with isofactors taken from the vector-coherent-state library Su3cgvcs, and the classical Talmi-Moshinsky sum of Kamuntavicius et al. - over every block up to E=50. Evaluating the classical sum with its factorials in logarithmic form rather than as tabulated binomials removes the range limit that otherwise caps it near E ~ 12, and makes it an absolute check on the bracket values over the whole range where its cost is bearable. Against that check the two routes agree to within a factor of a few at every shell, while the ladder construction is faster by three orders of magnitude; it is also the only one of the three usable over the whole range, retaining max|HOB.HOB^T - I| <~ 2x10⁻⁶ at E=50, where the library route has become unusable and the classical route is prohibitively slow.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍 Fortran 2008 程序包 SU3HOB-ladder，用于在 SU(3) 基中计算任意质量比参数 d 下的一般 Talmi-Moshinsky 谐振子变换括号。方法利用 U(2) 伪自旋生成元构造同位因子，避免 SU(3) 再耦合机制、K 矩阵或外重数分辨。与两种替代方案在 E≤50 的全部区块上比较后，阶梯构造在保持较好正交性的同时速度快约三个数量级，并且是三种方法中唯一可覆盖全范围的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍 SU3HOB-ladder，这是一个 Fortran 2008 程序包，用于在 SU(3) 基中计算任意质量比参数 d 的一般 Talmi-Moshinsky 谐振子变换括号。该括号可化为含反射的 Talmi-Moshinsky 矩阵的 Wigner d 函数单重求和，并由链 U(6) > U(3)xU(2) 的 SU(3) > SO(3) 同位因子乘积加权；这些同位因子与 d 无关，因此它们在每个区块 (E,L) 中构建一次，并对每个 d 重复使用。我们从同一链的 U(2) 伪自旋生成元获得这些同位因子：由于 U(6) 的 [E] 内部的 U(3) 和 U(2) 标号是互补的，最高权态是升算符 J₊ = a^dag(1).a(2) 的零空间，而每个多重态的其余成员通过降算符得到，因此在任何阶段都不需要 SU(3) 再耦合机制、K 矩阵或外重数分辨。我们将这一构造与另外两种产生相同括号的方法进行比较，即同一方案但同位因子取自矢量相干态库 Su3cgvcs，以及 Kamuntavicius 等人的经典 Talmi-Moshinsky 求和，比较覆盖了最高到 E=50 的每个区块。用对数形式的阶乘而非制表二项式来计算经典求和，消除了原本将其限制在约 E ~ 12 附近的范围限制，并使其成为在成本尚可承受的整个范围内对括号值的绝对检验。相对于该检验，两条路线在每个壳层上均在几倍因子范围内一致，而阶梯构造快了三个数量级；它也是三者中唯一能在整个范围内使用的方法，在 E=50 时仍保持 max|HOB.HOB^T - I| <~ 2x10⁻⁶，而此时库路线已不可用，经典路线则慢到难以承受。

articles.title: Mesh-Native Physics-Informed Graph Surrogates for TCAD-in-the-Loop Design Space Exploration
articles.title_zh: 用于 TCAD 闭环设计空间探索的网格原生物理信息图代理模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-fidelity TCAD simulation of drift-diffusion transport remains the workhorse of emerging FinFET device design, but it is computationally expensive, especially for 3D structures where runtime escalates steeply with mesh complexity. This sharply limits multi-objective design space exploration. Existing machine-learning surrogates map a fixed set of design parameters to a few scalar device metrics, discarding the underlying physics and losing transferability across device geometries and families. A physics-informed graph attention network (GAT) surrogate is proposed. It operates directly on the tetrahedral TCAD mesh and predicts, at every mesh node, the electrostatic potential together with the electron and hole quasi-Fermi levels, the fundamental unknowns of the drift-diffusion system. Training combines a data loss with finite-volume current-continuity residuals, embedding carrier-transport physics into the objective. Operating on the mesh as a graph, the surrogate inherits size generalization: a model trained on few-fin meshes applies unchanged to substantially larger arrays, bounded at inference only by GPU memory. Per-node uncertainty from a deep ensemble drives an active-learning loop that screens large candidate pools in seconds and forwards only the most informative designs for full simulation. Benchmarked against Sentaurus Device on multi-fin tri-gate FinFETs, the surrogate reproduces the three drift-diffusion fields with sub-volt per-field RMSE and reaches a per-design throughput orders of magnitude higher than the full simulator. The advantage grows with device size: on large multi-fin arrays that are prohibitively slow to simulate directly, inference still completes in under a second per device, enabling Pareto-front exploration across device scales infeasible for direct TCAD sweeps.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理信息图注意力网络代理模型，直接作用于四面体 TCAD 网格，并在每个网格节点预测静电势以及电子和空穴准 Fermi 能级。训练将数据损失与有限体积电流连续性残差结合，以嵌入载流子输运物理。相较 Sentaurus Device，该代理模型在多鳍三栅 FinFET 上以亚伏级每场 RMSE 复现漂移-扩散场，并显著提高单设计吞吐量，支持更大尺度器件的 Pareto 前沿探索。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 漂移-扩散输运的高保真 TCAD 模拟仍是新兴 FinFET 器件设计的主力工具，但它计算成本高昂，尤其对于三维结构而言，运行时间会随网格复杂度急剧上升。这严重限制了多目标设计空间探索。现有机器学习代理模型将一组固定设计参数映射到少数标量器件指标，丢弃了底层物理，并失去了跨器件几何和族类的可迁移性。本文提出一种物理信息图注意力网络（GAT）代理模型。它直接作用于四面体 TCAD 网格，并在每个网格节点预测静电势以及电子和空穴准 Fermi 能级，这些是漂移-扩散系统的基本未知量。训练将数据损失与有限体积电流连续性残差相结合，将载流子输运物理嵌入目标函数。由于将网格作为图来处理，该代理模型继承了尺寸泛化能力：在少鳍网格上训练的模型可不经改变地应用于显著更大的阵列，推理时仅受 GPU 内存限制。来自深度集成的逐节点不确定性驱动主动学习循环，该循环可在数秒内筛选大型候选池，并仅将信息量最大的设计转交给完整模拟。以 Sentaurus Device 在多鳍三栅 FinFET 上作为基准，该代理模型以每个场亚伏级 RMSE 复现三个漂移-扩散场，并实现比完整模拟器高数个数量级的单设计吞吐量。该优势随器件尺寸增大而增长：在直接模拟极其缓慢的大型多鳍阵列上，推理仍可在每个器件不到一秒内完成，从而使跨器件尺度的 Pareto 前沿探索成为可能，而这是直接 TCAD 扫描难以实现的。

articles.title: Gradients Know What Outcomes Don't: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning with Gradient-Aligned Rewards
articles.title_zh: 梯度知道结果不知道的内容：用梯度对齐奖励释放大语言模型推理中的强化学习能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models, yet its binary outcome reward cannot distinguish among correct trajectories. Existing dense reward alternatives, from surface heuristics to process reward models, either ignore the expert solutions already present in training corpora or require expensive offline annotation. We propose Gradient-Aligned Reward (GAR), which operates in the policy's own gradient space: truncated backpropagation through the output projection layer extracts a compact gradient vector for each rollout, and cosine similarity with an expert-anchor gradient yields a dense, reasoning-aware reward with less than 9% wall-clock overhead. We prove that this cosine admits a multiplicative decomposition into prediction-error and activation-pattern factors, providing a concrete characterization of what the alignment signal measures. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, GAR consistently improves over GRPO and other baselines on competition-level math benchmarks and transfers to GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro without domain-specific data. Code and data are available at https://github.com/LQgdwind/GAR.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出梯度对齐奖励 GAR，用于弥补可验证奖励强化学习中二元结果奖励无法区分正确推理轨迹的问题。GAR 在策略自身的梯度空间中工作，通过输出投影层的截断反向传播提取 rollout 梯度向量，并与专家锚点梯度的余弦相似度形成稠密推理感知奖励。实验显示 GAR 在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上优于 GRPO 等基线，并能迁移到 GPQA Diamond 和 MMLU-Pro。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 来自可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）推动了大语言模型中的思维链推理，但其二元结果奖励无法区分正确轨迹之间的差异。现有稠密奖励替代方案，从表面启发式到过程奖励模型，要么忽略训练语料中已经存在的专家解答，要么需要昂贵的离线标注。我们提出梯度对齐奖励（GAR），它在策略自身的梯度空间中运行：通过输出投影层的截断反向传播为每个 rollout 提取一个紧凑的梯度向量，并与专家锚点梯度的余弦相似度产生一个稠密的、推理感知的奖励，墙钟时间开销低于 9%。我们证明该余弦可分解为预测误差因子和激活模式因子的乘法形式，从而对该对齐信号所测量的内容给出具体表征。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，GAR 在竞赛级数学基准上持续优于 GRPO 和其他基线，并且无需领域特定数据即可迁移到 GPQA Diamond 和 MMLU-Pro。代码和数据可用。

articles.title: Resolution-Aware Experimental Design under Partial Identifiability
articles.title_zh: 部分可识别性下的分辨率感知实验设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimental design is commonly framed as choosing the experiment expected to provide the most information. Under partial identifiability however, persistent nuisance uncertainty can make the same observation carry different structural meanings. We introduce Resolution-Aware Experimental Design (RAED), which selects an experiment by the smallest expected nonempty structural candidate set achievable subject to false-exclusion control. We prove an exact cross-nuisance aliasing separation: an experiment can be preferred by structural and full-latent information gain, average classification, and nuisance-marginalized informativeness while having arbitrarily poorer valid structural resolution. RAED nevertheless preserves the expected ordering under a genuine composite Blackwell comparison. To make this criterion operational, we develop a learned score-based implementation with finite-sample nuisance-average and positive-tail calibration, and characterize a rare-tail sample-complexity obstruction. Under constrained sensing, two subsurface-flow benchmarks exhibit genuine RAED--expected-information-gain (EIG) experiment-selection disagreements, with the clearest and largest held-out resolution differences in WCA. In a fluvial benchmark, tail protection changes the selected physical experiment and replaces hard-region false exclusions primarily with explicit ambiguity. In a mechanistic methane-oxidation benchmark, a prospectively specified 5% false-exclusion tolerance also yields a nontrivial finite-sample population guarantee for tail-sensitive nuisance risk, with 95% joint confidence across all three structural families.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出分辨率感知实验设计 RAED，用于在部分可识别性下按照受误排除控制约束的最小期望非空结构候选集来选择实验。作者证明了精确的跨扰动别名分离，说明若干常见信息增益或分类准则偏好的实验可能具有任意更差的有效结构分辨率。论文还给出基于学习评分的有限样本实现与校准方法，并在多个基准中展示 RAED 与期望信息增益选择之间的真实分歧及其分辨率优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实验设计通常被表述为选择预期能够提供最多信息的实验。然而，在部分可识别性下，持续存在的扰动不确定性可能使同一观测承载不同的结构含义。我们引入分辨率感知实验设计（RAED），它通过在控制错误排除的约束下可实现的最小期望非空结构候选集来选择实验。我们证明了一个精确的跨扰动别名分离：一个实验可能受到结构信息增益和全潜变量信息增益、平均分类以及扰动边缘化信息性的偏好，同时却具有任意更差的有效结构分辨率。尽管如此，RAED 在真正的复合 Blackwell 比较下仍保持期望排序。为使该准则可操作，我们开发了一种基于学习评分的实现，具有有限样本扰动平均校准和正尾校准，并刻画了一个罕见尾部样本复杂度障碍。在受限感知条件下，两个地下流基准表现出真实的 RAED 与期望信息增益（EIG）实验选择分歧，其中 WCA 中的留出分辨率差异最清晰且最大。在一个河流基准中，尾部保护改变了所选择的物理实验，并主要以显式歧义替代了困难区域的错误排除。在一个机理性甲烷氧化基准中，一个前瞻性指定的 5% 错误排除容忍度也为尾部敏感扰动风险产生了非平凡的有限样本总体保证，并在全部三个结构族上具有 95% 联合置信度。

articles.title: Projected Riemannian Gradient Descent for the Bures-Wasserstein Barycenter: Dimension-Independent Linear Convergence at Unit Step Size
articles.title_zh: 用于 Bures-Wasserstein 重心的投影 Riemann 梯度下降：单位步长下与维度无关的线性收敛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The computation of the Bures-Wasserstein (BW) barycenter of an ensemble of positive definite matrices arises throughout machine learning, optimal transport, and quantum information. Riemannian gradient descent (RGD) at unit step size -- the fixed-point iteration used in practice -- converges rapidly, yet existing analyses present a dichotomy: unit-step guarantees carry worst-case exponential dependence on the dimension, while dimension-independent guarantees require small step sizes that forfeit the empirical speed. We resolve this dichotomy, not by improving the guarantees for unit-step RGD, but by proposing a Projected RGD algorithm that achieves dimension-independent linear convergence at unit step size. The achieved rate, (1 - κ⁻³/²), where κ is the condition number of the ensemble, also polynomially improves on the best small-step guarantee (κ³/² versus κ⁵/² iteration complexity). The crux is a novel Projection Lemma: clipping the eigenvalues of a positive matrix to an interval [α, β] is the closed-form, non-expansive (1-Lipschitz) BW-metric projection onto the set S : α I ≤ S ≤ β I -- a statement which, unlike its known one-sided counterpart, does not follow from convexity. The projection is moreover free: it reuses an eigendecomposition the next iteration must perform in any case, so the projected and unprojected iterations cost the same per step. The same analysis covers the invariant matrix projection problem of Brahmachari et al. (2025), whose fixed-point algorithm we identify as unit-step RGD on a totally geodesic submanifold, thereby extending the dimension-independent guarantee to that setting verbatim.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对正定矩阵集合的 Bures-Wasserstein 重心计算，提出投影 Riemann 梯度下降算法，在单位步长下实现与维度无关的线性收敛。其收敛率为 (1 - κ⁻³/²)，并相较最佳小步长保证在迭代复杂度上实现多项式改进。核心是新的投影引理：将正矩阵特征值裁剪到区间 [α, β] 是 BW 度量下到集合 αI≤S≤βI 的闭式非扩张投影，且每步计算成本与未投影迭代相同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 正定矩阵集合的 Bures-Wasserstein（BW）重心计算广泛出现于机器学习、最优传输和量子信息中。单位步长下的 Riemann 梯度下降（RGD），即实践中使用的固定点迭代，收敛迅速；然而现有分析呈现出一种二分局面：单位步长保证具有对维度的最坏情形指数依赖，而与维度无关的保证需要小步长，从而放弃了经验上的速度。我们解决了这一二分局面，但不是通过改进单位步长 RGD 的保证，而是提出一种投影 RGD 算法，在单位步长下实现与维度无关的线性收敛。所得收敛率为 (1 - κ⁻³/²)，其中 κ 是集合的条件数；该结果还在多项式意义上改进了最佳小步长保证的迭代复杂度（κ³/² 相对于 κ⁵/²）。关键是一个新的投影引理：将正矩阵的特征值裁剪到区间 [α, β]，是在 BW 度量下投影到集合 S : α I ≤ S ≤ β I 的闭式、非扩张（1-Lipschitz）投影；这一陈述不同于已知的单侧对应结论，不能从凸性推出。此外，该投影是免费的：它复用了下一次迭代无论如何都必须执行的特征分解，因此投影迭代和未投影迭代每步成本相同。同一分析涵盖了 Brahmachari 等人（2025）的不变矩阵投影问题，我们将其固定点算法识别为全测地子流形上的单位步长 RGD，从而将与维度无关的保证原样扩展到该设置。

articles.title: Privacy, Robustness, and Fairness Trade-offs in Federated Intrusion Detection: Geometric Indistinguishability at the Aggregation Interface
articles.title_zh: 联邦入侵检测中的隐私、鲁棒性与公平性权衡：聚合接口处的几何不可区分性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03420v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated learning enables privacy-conscious collaboration for network intrusion detection without centralizing sensitive traffic data, yet its deployment in operational environments must simultaneously satisfy three competing requirements: formal differential privacy guaranties, tolerance to Byzantine-adversarial participants, and reliable detection coverage across severely imbalanced attack categories. Existing literature treats these properties as independently composable, an assumption that this paper challenges both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we study how these requirements interact in class-imbalanced federated NIDS and introduce geometric indistinguishability as a conceptual lens for a regime in which privacy-induced dispersion in client updates can make minority-class signals harder for robust aggregation to preserve. Using UNSW-NB15 as a case study, we evaluate DP-SGD combined with coordinate-wise median under label-flip and model-poisoning attacks, with threat coverage assessed across attack categories. Our results provide initial evidence that the joint use of privacy noise and robust aggregation can disproportionately degrade detection of rare attacks relative to majority classes. We also show that part of the observed collapse under strong privacy can arise from training miscalibration, while a residual performance floor may remain for ultra-rare categories even after epsilon-dependent tuning. These findings motivate studying privacy, robustness, and rare-attack coverage jointly rather than as independently composable properties, and suggest that aggregation-aware modeling and sample-aware evaluation are promising directions for trustworthy federated NIDS.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究类别不平衡的联邦网络入侵检测中，差分隐私、拜占庭鲁棒聚合与少数攻击类别覆盖之间的相互作用。作者以 UNSW-NB15 为案例，评估 DP-SGD 与逐坐标中位数聚合在标签翻转和模型投毒攻击下的表现。结果初步表明，隐私噪声与鲁棒聚合的联合使用会相对多数类更严重地削弱稀有攻击检测，并提示可信联邦 NIDS 需要联合评估隐私、鲁棒性与稀有攻击覆盖。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 联邦学习使网络入侵检测能够在不集中敏感流量数据的情况下进行具有隐私意识的协作，但其在运行环境中的部署必须同时满足三个相互竞争的要求：形式化差分隐私保证、对拜占庭式对抗参与者的容忍，以及在严重不平衡攻击类别上的可靠检测覆盖。现有文献将这些性质视为可以独立组合，本文从理论和经验两个方面挑战了这一假设。在本文中，我们研究这些要求如何在类别不平衡的联邦 NIDS 中相互作用，并引入几何不可区分性作为一种概念视角，用于描述这样一种情形：隐私引入的客户端更新离散性可能使鲁棒聚合更难保留少数类信号。我们以 UNSW-NB15 为案例，评估 DP-SGD 与逐坐标中位数聚合在标签翻转和模型投毒攻击下的组合，并按攻击类别评估威胁覆盖。我们的结果提供了初步证据，表明隐私噪声和鲁棒聚合的联合使用可能相对于多数类别不成比例地降低稀有攻击的检测效果。我们还表明，在强隐私条件下观察到的部分崩塌可能源于训练校准不当，而即使经过依赖 epsilon 的调优，超稀有类别仍可能存在残余性能下限。这些发现促使人们将隐私、鲁棒性和稀有攻击覆盖作为联合问题来研究，而不是视为可独立组合的性质，并表明面向聚合的建模和样本感知评估是可信联邦 NIDS 的有前景方向。

articles.title: Influence of Extruded Filament Shape on Buildability in 3D Concrete Printing: A Geometry-Informed Deep Learning-FEM Approach
articles.title_zh: 挤出丝材形状对 3D 混凝土打印可建造性的影响：一种几何信息驱动的深度学习-FEM 方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04028v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The geometric morphology of deposited filaments can significantly influence the structural performance and stability of 3D concrete-printed (3DCP) structures. However, most finite element (FEM)-based approaches for buildability assessment represent printed layers as simplified rectangles, potentially limiting predictive accuracy. This study proposes a geometry-informed modelling framework that integrates the deep-learning-based filament shape prediction tool ShapeGen3DCP with a layer-activation FEM approach to investigate the effect of realistic filament geometries on buildability. The framework generates geometry-aware numerical models directly from material and process parameters, eliminating the need for experimental filament characterization or computationally intensive fluid-flow simulations. Validation against experimental data and a parametric study of rectilinear walls demonstrate that extrusion parameters and the resulting filament geometry can significantly influence buildability predictions. Realistic filament representations are particularly important for free-flow deposition, whereas layer-pressing strategies are less sensitive to geometric simplifications. Among the investigated representations, an elliptical approximation provides an effective balance between geometric fidelity and modelling simplicity. When rectangular representations are preferred to enable regular computational meshes for faster simulations, defining their dimensions based on volume conservation improves prediction reliability compared with calibrating them using either the maximum filament width or the interlayer contact width. Overall, the proposed methodology demonstrates the importance of incorporating filament geometry into 3DCP simulations and provides practical guidance for selecting efficient and accurate geometric representations for buildability assessment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种几何信息建模框架，将基于深度学习的丝材形状预测工具 ShapeGen3DCP 与层激活有限元方法结合，用于评估真实丝材几何对 3D 混凝土打印可建造性的影响。实验验证和参数研究表明，挤出参数及其导致的丝材几何会显著影响可建造性预测，尤其是在自由流动沉积中。研究还指出椭圆近似在几何保真度和建模简洁性之间较为均衡，而基于体积守恒定义矩形表示可提升快速仿真的可靠性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沉积丝材的几何形态会显著影响 3D 混凝土打印（3DCP）结构的结构性能和稳定性。然而，大多数基于有限元（FEM）的可建造性评估方法将打印层表示为简化矩形，这可能限制预测精度。本研究提出一种几何信息建模框架，将基于深度学习的丝材形状预测工具 ShapeGen3DCP 与层激活 FEM 方法相结合，以研究真实丝材几何对可建造性的影响。该框架直接根据材料和工艺参数生成具有几何感知能力的数值模型，无需实验性丝材表征或计算量巨大的流体流动模拟。与实验数据的验证以及对直线墙体的参数研究表明，挤出参数及由此产生的丝材几何会显著影响可建造性预测。真实丝材表示对于自由流动沉积尤为重要，而层压策略对几何简化不那么敏感。在所研究的表示方法中，椭圆近似在几何保真度和建模简洁性之间提供了有效平衡。当为了支持规则计算网格和更快仿真而偏好矩形表示时，基于体积守恒定义其尺寸相比使用最大丝材宽度或层间接触宽度进行校准，能够提高预测可靠性。总体而言，所提出的方法证明了将丝材几何纳入 3DCP 仿真的重要性，并为可建造性评估中选择高效且准确的几何表示提供了实用指导。

articles.title: Linearized subspace refinement framework to expose hidden accuracy in trained neural networks
articles.title_zh: 用于揭示已训练神经网络中隐藏精度的线性化子空间精炼框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13989v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods often exhibit optimization-induced accuracy plateaus in scientific machine learning tasks. We present Linearized Subspace Refinement (LSR), an architecture-agnostic post-training framework that exploits the local linearized model at a fixed trained state. By solving a reduced direct least-squares problem in a Jacobian-defined low-dimensional space, LSR computes a subspace-optimal linearized correction and yields a refined predictor with markedly improved accuracy. Across function approximation, data-driven operator learning, physics-informed operator fine-tuning, and noisy inverse problems, LSR shows that standard nonlinear training can remain far above this subspace-attainable error level. Similar accuracy plateaus persist even for the convex quadratic problem from local linearization when solved with standard iterative optimizers, identifying numerical ill-conditioning as a primary bottleneck. LSR frequently delivers order-of-magnitude error reductions, while the subspace rank provides an explicit capacity-control mechanism that balances correction strength, numerical stability, and noise sensitivity. Together, LSR exposes conditioning-limited attainable accuracy in trained-state linearized models and provides direct access to it.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出线性化子空间精炼（LSR），一种与架构无关的后训练框架，用于利用固定训练状态附近的局部线性化模型提升精度。LSR 在由雅可比矩阵定义的低维空间中求解约化直接最小二乘问题，从而得到子空间最优修正。跨多类科学机器学习任务的结果显示，标准非线性训练可能远高于该子空间可达到的误差水平，而数值病态性是主要瓶颈。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由基于梯度的方法训练的神经网络，在科学机器学习任务中常常表现出由优化导致的精度平台。我们提出线性化子空间精炼（Linearized Subspace Refinement, LSR），这是一种与架构无关的后训练框架，利用固定训练状态下的局部线性化模型。通过在由雅可比矩阵定义的低维空间中求解约化的直接最小二乘问题，LSR 计算出子空间最优的线性化修正，并产生精度显著提高的精炼预测器。在函数逼近、数据驱动的算子学习、物理信息算子微调以及含噪逆问题中，LSR 表明标准非线性训练可能仍远高于该子空间可达到的误差水平。即使对于由局部线性化得到的凸二次问题，在使用标准迭代优化器求解时，类似的精度平台仍然存在，这表明数值病态性是主要瓶颈。LSR 经常带来数量级级别的误差降低，同时子空间秩提供了一种显式的容量控制机制，用于平衡修正强度、数值稳定性和噪声敏感性。总体而言，LSR 揭示了训练状态线性化模型中受条件性限制的可达到精度，并提供了直接访问该精度的方法。

articles.title: Observation-Aligned Two-Stage Domain Decomposition for Physics-Informed Traffic State Estimation with Sparse Fixed Sensors
articles.title_zh: 面向稀疏固定传感器物理信息交通状态估计的观测对齐两阶段域分解方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.08028v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traffic state estimation from sparse fixed sensors is challenging because physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) tend to over-smooth sharp transitions admitted by the Lighthill-Whitham--Richards (LWR) model. This study proposes Two-Stage Domain Decomposition Physics-Informed Neural Networks (TSDD-PINN), an observation-aligned framework for LWR-based offline speed-field reconstruction. The framework supports spatial, temporal, and space--time refinement. Matched direction analysis shows that spatial refinement has the lowest mean error and less than half the training time of space--time refinement in the tested setting, while temporal refinement is faster. A global parent PINN is first trained. In the controlled spatial implementation, its residual profile guides a deterministic partition for warm-started child networks. An optional operational safeguard retains Stage~1 when the prespecified screen does not activate. The primary I-24 MOTION evaluation spans five days, five sensor configurations, and ten seeds per configuration, yielding 1,500 runs. Controlled TSDD-PINN attains the lowest relative L₂ error in 18 of 25 configurations and 14 of 15 sparse-sensing cases, while training 2.4 times faster than the extended PINN (XPINN) baseline under the evaluated implementations and training budgets. Non-neural comparisons show that the advantage over interpolation is concentrated under sparse sensing, whereas dense sensing often favors interpolation. A separate 250-run operational evaluation finds infrequent activation and motivates the Stage-1-preserving safeguard. The residual is treated as an indicator of model difficulty rather than a validated shock detector. The evidence supports a sensing-density-dependent operating range rather than uniform improvement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出两阶段域分解物理信息神经网络（TSDD-PINN），用于基于 LWR 模型的离线速度场重建，旨在缓解稀疏固定传感器条件下 PINN 对尖锐交通状态转变的过度平滑。研究支持空间、时间和时空细化，并在 I-24 MOTION 数据上的大规模评估中显示，受控 TSDD-PINN 在多数配置特别是稀疏感知场景下达到最低相对 L2 误差，同时比 XPINN 基线训练更快。结果表明其优势依赖传感密度，而非在所有场景中一致优于替代方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从稀疏固定传感器估计交通状态具有挑战性，因为物理信息神经网络（PINN）倾向于过度平滑 Lighthill-Whitham--Richards（LWR）模型所允许的尖锐转变。本研究提出两阶段域分解物理信息神经网络（TSDD-PINN），这是一种面向基于 LWR 的离线速度场重建的观测对齐框架。该框架支持空间、时间以及时空细化。匹配方向分析表明，在测试设置中，空间细化具有最低的平均误差，并且训练时间不到时空细化的一半，而时间细化速度更快。首先训练一个全局父 PINN。在受控空间实现中，其残差剖面引导确定性划分，以用于经暖启动的子网络。一个可选的运行保障机制会在预先指定的筛查未被激活时保留第一阶段。主要的 I-24 MOTION 评估覆盖五天、五种传感器配置以及每种配置十个随机种子，共产生 1,500 次运行。在所评估的实现和训练预算下，受控 TSDD-PINN 在 25 种配置中的 18 种以及 15 种稀疏感知情形中的 14 种取得最低相对 L2 误差，同时训练速度比扩展 PINN（XPINN）基线快 2.4 倍。与非神经方法的比较表明，相对于插值的优势主要集中在稀疏感知条件下，而密集感知通常更有利于插值。另一项 250 次运行的运行评估发现激活并不频繁，并支持保留第一阶段的保障机制。残差被视为模型困难程度的指标，而不是经过验证的激波检测器。证据支持一种依赖传感密度的适用范围，而不是一致性的全面改进。

articles.title: Markov Chain Monte Carlo with Diffusion Paths
articles.title_zh: 基于扩散路径的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11631v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sampling from multimodal distributions is a longstanding challenge for classical local Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods. A popular remedy is to introduce a sequence of intermediate distributions that interpolate between the target and a simpler reference. The classical choice, tempering, raises the density to a power, but distorts the relative weights of asymmetric modes and can lead to poor mixing. We instead propose interpolating along the diffusion path, the marginals of a noising diffusion process that carries the target toward a Gaussian. This path preserves the relative weights of the modes and enjoys favorable mixing properties, which we make precise through a spectral-gap analysis of the corresponding ideal transition kernel. Sampling along the path requires its intermediate scores, which can be estimated from the unnormalized target through variational approaches, yielding only an approximate sampler. To remove the resulting bias, we introduce the Metropolis-adjusted diffusion path (MAD-Path) sampler, which corrects the diffusion-path proposal in an augmented path space and leaves the target invariant regardless of the accuracy of the learned score or the discretization error. We further quantify how these two errors affect the acceptance probability, providing guidance for practical tuning. Experiments on a range of Bayesian posteriors show that MAD-Path improves global exploration and mode-weight estimation relative to tempering-based MCMC methods and unadjusted diffusion samplers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出沿扩散路径构造 MCMC 中间分布，以改善多峰分布采样中的全局探索和模式权重估计。与传统温度化相比，扩散路径可保持模式相对权重，并具有有利的混合性质。作者进一步提出 Metropolis 调整扩散路径（MAD-Path）采样器，在增广路径空间中校正近似得分和离散化误差带来的偏差，并在贝叶斯后验实验中优于温度化 MCMC 和未调整扩散采样器。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从多峰分布中采样是经典局部马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）方法长期面临的挑战。一种流行的补救方法是引入一系列在目标分布和更简单参考分布之间插值的中间分布。经典选择是温度化，即将密度提升到某个幂次，但这会扭曲非对称模式的相对权重，并可能导致混合较差。我们改为提出沿扩散路径进行插值，该路径是一个加噪扩散过程的边缘分布，该过程将目标分布推向高斯分布。这一路径保持模式的相对权重，并具有有利的混合性质，我们通过相应理想转移核的谱隙分析对其进行了精确刻画。沿该路径采样需要其中间得分，这些得分可以通过变分方法从未归一化目标中估计得到，从而产生的只是一个近似采样器。为消除由此产生的偏差，我们引入 Metropolis 调整扩散路径（MAD-Path）采样器，它在增广路径空间中校正扩散路径提议，并且无论学习得分的准确性或离散化误差如何，都保持目标分布不变。我们进一步量化这两类误差如何影响接受概率，为实际调参提供指导。在一系列贝叶斯后验上的实验表明，相对于基于温度化的 MCMC 方法和未调整的扩散采样器，MAD-Path 改善了全局探索和模式权重估计。

articles.title: A computable representation of the physical laboratory enables verifiable workflows
articles.title_zh: 物理实验室的可计算表示支持可验证工作流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Making science computable requires representations of both scientific knowledge and the physical world in which scientific claims are tested. A computable representation of the physical laboratory is established through typed research objects, capability-bound operations and a compositional workflow algebra. It provides the physical-world counterpart to machine-readable knowledge, expressing workflows as programs over evolving laboratory states with explicit dependencies, decisions, iteration and concurrency. The representation was implemented in a modular agentic robotic laboratory by binding formal operations to executable Function Skills. For diverse scientific intents, capability-relative workflows were generated, while stateful simulation propagated object transformations and verified operation preconditions and laboratory constraints before dispatch. The proposed representation and its engineering framework jointly establish a general computational interface between agent reasoning and capability-bound physical transformations, providing a foundation for end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理实验室的可计算表示，使用类型化研究对象、能力绑定操作和可组合工作流代数，将实验工作流表达为随实验室状态演化的程序。该表示在模块化智能体机器人实验室中实现，并将形式化操作绑定到可执行功能技能。结果表明，该框架可在执行前传播对象转换、验证操作前置条件和实验室约束，为自主科学发现提供智能体推理与物理转换之间的通用计算接口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使科学可计算需要同时表示科学知识以及检验科学主张的物理世界。本文通过类型化研究对象、能力绑定操作和可组合工作流代数建立了物理实验室的可计算表示。它为机器可读知识提供了物理世界对应物，将工作流表达为作用于不断演化的实验室状态之上的程序，并具有显式依赖、决策、迭代和并发。该表示在一个模块化智能体机器人实验室中实现，方法是将形式化操作绑定到可执行的功能技能。对于多样化的科学意图，系统生成了与能力相关的工作流，同时有状态仿真在调度前传播对象转换，并验证操作前置条件和实验室约束。所提出的表示及其工程框架共同建立了智能体推理与能力绑定物理转换之间的通用计算接口，为端到端自主科学发现提供了基础。

articles.title: Spurious Advantage Hidden in GRPO
articles.title_zh: GRPO 中隐藏的虚假优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely studied for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where its advantage estimator assigns each rollout a magnitude from within-group reward statistics. In the common case, this magnitude rewards rollouts that reach the correct answer through reasoning. Yet, an overlooked case shares the same surface: a rollout may land on it by guessing, and the formula still assigns a high magnitude, which we identify as the spurious advantage. This arises in three cases: bounded-answer tasks with a small candidate set; open-answer sets hosting bounded sub-cases; and search agents whose budget opens many paths to the same answer. In all three, this misleads the policy toward guess-like behaviors. We propose SIGNBALANCE, whose magnitude is composition-free: it keeps the verifier sign, uses a global scale, and restores zero-mean balance via a stop-gradient per-class rescaling. Across math and search agent benchmarks at different scales, SIGNBALANCE matches GRPO on open-answer math and improves on bounded-answer math and search agents. Code will be released.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，群组相对策略优化（GRPO）的优势估计在某些情况下会把靠猜测得到正确答案的 rollout 赋予高幅度奖励，形成“虚假优势”。这种问题出现在小候选集的有界答案任务、开放答案集合中的有界子情形，以及搜索预算允许多路径到达同一答案的搜索智能体中。作者提出 SIGNBALANCE，通过保留验证器符号、使用全局尺度并进行停止梯度的按类重缩放来恢复零均值平衡，在有界答案数学和搜索智能体基准上优于 GRPO。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 群组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）被广泛研究用于具有可验证奖励的强化学习，其中其优势估计器根据组内奖励统计为每个 rollout 分配一个幅度。在常见情况下，这一幅度会奖励通过推理得到正确答案的 rollout。然而，一个被忽视的情形具有相同的表面形式：某个 rollout 可能通过猜测得到正确答案，而公式仍然为其分配高幅度，我们将其识别为虚假优势。这出现在三种情况下：候选集较小的有界答案任务；包含有界子情形的开放答案集合；以及预算允许打开许多通向同一答案路径的搜索智能体。在这三种情况下，它都会误导策略转向类似猜测的行为。我们提出 SIGNBALANCE，其幅度与组成无关：它保留验证器符号，使用全局尺度，并通过每类停止梯度重缩放恢复零均值平衡。在不同规模的数学和搜索智能体基准上，SIGNBALANCE 在开放答案数学上与 GRPO 持平，并在有界答案数学和搜索智能体上取得改进。代码将发布。

articles.title: The Natural Language Interaction Protocol and Standard for AI Agents
articles.title_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的自然语言交互协议与标准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are increasingly being developed and deployed across organizations using heterogeneous agent-development frameworks, AI models, tool interfaces, protocols, and execution environments. To realize their potential social and business impact, these agents must be able to interoperate through a common communication protocol. The Natural Language Interaction Protocol (NLIP), developed by researchers and practitioners across companies and universities and standardized by Ecma International, addresses this need by defining a standards-based application-layer protocol for AI-agent interaction. NLIP provides a lightweight semantic message envelope that can be carried over existing transports such as HTTP/HTTPS, WebSocket, and AMQP, while allowing NLIP-aware agents and gateways to adapt between clients, agents, local context stores, ontologies, tools, enterprise services, and heterogeneous underlying protocols. This paper presents the motivation and design rationale of NLIP, its message model and transport bindings, security-by-design considerations, reference implementation, representative applications, adoption signals, and relationship to emerging agent protocols such as MCP and A2A.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍自然语言交互协议（NLIP），一种由产业界和学术界共同开发并由 Ecma International 标准化的 AI 智能体应用层交互协议。NLIP 提供轻量级语义消息封装，可承载于 HTTP/HTTPS、WebSocket 和 AMQP 等现有传输之上，并支持智能体、网关、工具、企业服务和异构底层协议之间的适配。论文阐述其动机、设计依据、消息模型、传输绑定、安全设计、参考实现、应用案例、采用信号及其与 MCP 和 A2A 等新兴协议的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AI 智能体正越来越多地在各组织中使用异构的智能体开发框架、AI 模型、工具接口、协议和执行环境进行开发和部署。为了实现其潜在的社会和商业影响，这些智能体必须能够通过共同的通信协议互操作。由来自公司和大学的研究人员及实践者开发、并由 Ecma International 标准化的自然语言交互协议（Natural Language Interaction Protocol, NLIP）通过定义一种基于标准的 AI 智能体交互应用层协议来满足这一需求。NLIP 提供轻量级语义消息封装，可承载在 HTTP/HTTPS、WebSocket 和 AMQP 等现有传输之上，同时允许感知 NLIP 的智能体和网关在客户端、智能体、本地上下文存储、 ontology、工具、企业服务以及异构底层协议之间进行适配。本文介绍 NLIP 的动机和设计依据、其消息模型和传输绑定、安全内建设计考虑、参考实现、代表性应用、采用信号，以及它与 MCP 和 A2A 等新兴智能体协议的关系。

articles.title: A Computationally Feasible Framework for Causal Probabilistic Explanation
articles.title_zh: 一种计算可行的因果概率解释框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Explaining why a specific outcome occurred, and which inputs deserve the blame or credit, is central to philosophical, scientific, and policy analysis. Existing tools split into two camps. The theory of actual causality (AC) gives principled verdicts, but only for toy-sized models, because computing them requires enumerating counterfactual scenarios. Scalable attribution methods like SHAP (or even causal SHAP) at least partially ignore the causal structure that generated the data, and can give answers that conflict with a careful causal analysis. We close this gap with Probabilistic Causal Impact (PCI). PCI builds on actual causality and on Pearl's notions of probability of necessity and sufficiency, but recasts the question of explainability as an estimation problem on a probabilistic causal model that is easily approximated via Monte Carlo. By specifying a distribution over "candidate explanations," a distribution over counterfactual values, and a scoring function, PCI provides tractable, causally grounded, graded explanations, generalizing AC and Pearl's probability of causation as degenerate cases. We evaluate PCI in synthetic and real-world examples, spanning consistency checks with AC, scaling experiments, complex continuous-valued dynamical systems, and a real-world deployed causal machine learning model trained on millions of datapoints.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出概率因果影响（PCI），用于在可扩展条件下解释特定结果为何发生以及哪些输入应被归因。PCI 基于实际因果性和 Pearl 的必要性与充分性概率概念，将可解释性问题重构为概率因果模型上的估计问题，可通过蒙特卡罗近似。该框架通过指定候选解释分布、反事实值分布和评分函数，提供可处理且有因果依据的分级解释，并在合成和真实案例中进行评估。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 解释某一特定结果为何发生，以及哪些输入应承担责任或获得功劳，是哲学、科学和政策分析的核心。现有工具分为两类。实际因果性（AC）理论给出原则性判断，但只适用于玩具规模模型，因为计算它们需要枚举反事实情景。像 SHAP（甚至因果 SHAP）这样的可扩展归因方法至少部分忽略了生成数据的因果结构，并可能给出与细致因果分析相冲突的答案。我们用概率因果影响（Probabilistic Causal Impact, PCI）弥合这一差距。PCI 建立在实际因果性以及 Pearl 的必要性概率和充分性概率概念之上，但将可解释性问题重新表述为概率因果模型上的估计问题，该问题易于通过蒙特卡罗方法近似。通过指定“候选解释”分布、反事实值分布和评分函数，PCI 提供可处理、具有因果基础的分级解释，并将 AC 和 Pearl 的因果概率作为退化情形加以推广。我们在合成和真实世界示例中评估 PCI，涵盖与 AC 的一致性检查、扩展性实验、复杂连续值动力系统，以及一个在数百万数据点上训练并已部署的真实世界因果机器学习模型。

articles.title: Exploring the Potential of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Data
articles.title_zh: 探索对比语言-图像预训练在多源遥感数据中的潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03391v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Contrastive language-image learning (CLIP) has become a key paradigm for remote sensing vision-language understanding. However, existing remote sensing contrastive learning methods are mostly built on RGB-oriented CLIP architectures, making it difficult to exploit heterogeneous sensors such as SAR, multi-spectral imaging (MSI), and hyperspectral imaging (HSI). To address this limitation, we propose OmniRSCLIP, an end-to-end contrastive learning framework that supports multi-source sensor inputs for remote sensing vision-language modeling. The key idea is to extend CLIP beyond its fixed RGB input interface without breaking the pretrained visual knowledge. To this end, OmniRSCLIP introduces Spectral-Spatial Basis Decomposition (SSBD), which formulates arbitrary-channel adaptation as a basis recomposition problem: pretrained CLIP patch embeddings provide transferable spatial bases, while wavelength-conditioned coefficients span sensor-specific embedding kernels within a constrained visual prior space. This design avoids forcing heterogeneous sensors into a fixed-channel input space, while aligning them in a unified image-text semantic space. We further introduce a spectral-context-aware mask-based contrastive learning scheme to suppress modality-specific redundant features and enhance fine-grained image-text alignment. Finally, to support multi-modal training, we construct OmniRS5M, the first large-scale remote sensing image-text corpus covering RGB, SAR, MSI, and HSI. Experiments on retrieval, zero-shot classification, and semantic localization show that OmniRSCLIP preserves strong RGB-domain performance while effectively extending CLIP to heterogeneous remote sensing modalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 OmniRSCLIP，一种支持 RGB、SAR、多光谱和高光谱等多源传感器输入的端到端遥感视觉语言对比学习框架。其核心是通过光谱-空间基分解将任意通道适配表述为基重组问题，在不破坏预训练 CLIP 视觉知识的前提下扩展输入接口。作者还构建 OmniRS5M 多模态遥感图文语料，并在检索、零样本分类和语义定位实验中表明该方法能保持 RGB 性能并扩展到异构遥感模态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对比语言-图像学习（CLIP）已成为遥感视觉语言理解的关键范式。然而，现有遥感对比学习方法大多建立在面向 RGB 的 CLIP 架构之上，难以利用 SAR、多光谱成像（MSI）和高光谱成像（HSI）等异构传感器。为解决这一限制，我们提出 OmniRSCLIP，这是一种端到端对比学习框架，支持遥感视觉语言建模中的多源传感器输入。核心思想是在不破坏预训练视觉知识的前提下，将 CLIP 扩展到其固定 RGB 输入接口之外。为此，OmniRSCLIP 引入光谱-空间基分解（Spectral-Spatial Basis Decomposition, SSBD），将任意通道适配表述为基重组问题：预训练 CLIP patch 嵌入提供可迁移的空间基，而由波长条件化的系数在受约束的视觉先验空间内张成特定传感器的嵌入核。这一设计避免了将异构传感器强行放入固定通道输入空间，同时将它们对齐到统一的图像-文本语义空间中。我们进一步引入一种光谱上下文感知的基于掩码的对比学习方案，以抑制模态特定冗余特征并增强细粒度图像-文本对齐。最后，为支持多模态训练，我们构建 OmniRS5M，这是首个覆盖 RGB、SAR、MSI 和 HSI 的大规模遥感图像-文本语料库。在检索、零样本分类和语义定位方面的实验表明，OmniRSCLIP 在保持强 RGB 域性能的同时，有效地将 CLIP 扩展到异构遥感模态。

articles.title: From Prior-Guided Heuristics to Deployable Agents: Accelerating Demonstration-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Deadline-Constrained Network Control
articles.title_zh: 从先验引导启发式到可部署智能体：加速面向期限约束网络控制的示范驱动强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03590v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Timely delivery of delay-sensitive information over dynamic, heterogeneous networks is essential for NextG interactive applications, yet providing strict End-to-End (E2E) peak latency guarantees remains an open challenge. Two obstacles limit the adoption of learning-based network control in this setting: traditional volume-based routing metrics, while highly effective for general traffic management, are not designed to capture traffic urgency; and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) controllers trained from scratch suffer from sample inefficiency, long training times, and early-stage exploration volatility. This paper introduces a deployment-focused network control framework that addresses both obstacles. First, we present Effective Congestion (EC), a deadline-aware metric family that quantifies interface congestion by packet urgency and proactively filters non-viable traffic, coupled with a Uniform Path Grouping (UPG) distribution heuristic promoting robust load-balancing; the resulting policies are embedded into Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Effective Congestion (p^*) (MADRL EC (p^*)), a hybrid architecture combining a distributed scheduler with a centralized RL-based router. Second, we introduce a unified training objective that generalizes existing policy-learning paradigms---behavioral cloning, offline Reinforcement Learning (RL), online RL, and offline-to-online schemes---as special cases, combining a live-reward term, a pre-collected-reward term, and a policy-imitation term. From this objective, we derive the Model-Guided Annealed Reinforcement Learning (MGA-RL) protocol, instantiated on a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) backbone: a deployment-oriented, demonstration-driven training approach that generalizes conventional Offline-to-Online (O2O) schemes, in which trajectories from a lightweight [...]
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向部署的网络控制框架，用于在动态异构网络中支持延迟敏感信息的及时传递和端到端峰值时延约束。框架引入期限感知的有效拥塞（EC）指标和统一路径分组启发式，并将其嵌入结合分布式调度器与集中式强化学习路由器的 MADRL EC 架构。作者还提出统一训练目标和基于 DDPG 的模型引导退火强化学习（MGA-RL）协议，用示范轨迹加速从离线到在线的训练；原摘要在给定文本中截断，具体实验结论需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在动态、异构网络中及时传递延迟敏感信息，对于 NextG 交互式应用至关重要，但提供严格的端到端（E2E）峰值时延保证仍然是一个开放挑战。在这一场景中，两个障碍限制了基于学习的网络控制的采用：传统的基于流量体积的路由指标虽然对一般流量管理非常有效，但并非为刻画流量紧迫性而设计；从零开始训练的深度强化学习（DRL）控制器存在样本效率低、训练时间长和早期探索波动大的问题。本文提出一种面向部署的网络控制框架，以解决这两个障碍。首先，我们提出有效拥塞（Effective Congestion, EC），这是一族期限感知指标，通过数据包紧迫性量化接口拥塞，并主动过滤不可行流量；同时结合统一路径分组（Uniform Path Grouping, UPG）分布启发式以促进稳健负载均衡；由此得到的策略被嵌入到多智能体深度强化学习有效拥塞（p^*）（MADRL EC（p^*））中，这是一种混合架构，结合了分布式调度器和基于集中式强化学习的路由器。其次，我们引入一个统一训练目标，将现有策略学习范式——行为克隆、离线强化学习（RL）、在线 RL 和离线到在线方案——概括为特例，该目标结合了实时奖励项、预收集奖励项和策略模仿项。基于这一目标，我们推导出模型引导退火强化学习（Model-Guided Annealed Reinforcement Learning, MGA-RL）协议，并在深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）骨干上实例化：这是一种面向部署、由示范驱动的训练方法，推广了传统离线到在线（O2O）方案，其中来自轻量级方法的轨迹在原摘要给定文本中被截断。

articles.title: Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 通过可组合基础先验与可泛化抓取合成实现自适应视觉-语言抓取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.04096v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp (VLG) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing VLG methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AdaRoboVLG，一种任务自适应视觉-语言-抓取框架，支持跨不同机器人手的可泛化抓取合成。该方法将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦，由基础策略生成和评估物理可行抓取候选，并由专门的基础模型模块提供空间、认知和时间等可组合先验。仿真和真实实验表明，该框架学习高效、跨手泛化强，并能在杂乱和动态环境中实现功能性抓取。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出 AdaRoboVLG，这是一种任务自适应视觉-语言-抓取（Vision-Language-Grasp, VLG）框架，支持跨不同机器人手的可泛化抓取合成。不同于现有将基础模型与端到端抓取策略紧密耦合的 VLG 方法，AdaRoboVLG 学习一种高效的可泛化基础策略，通过显式运动学映射和基于力闭合的稳定性估计来生成并评估物理可行的抓取候选，同时将任务相关理解卸载到专门的基础模型模块。这些模块提供可组合先验，并被整合到抓取合成过程中，从而无需重新训练底层抓取策略即可实现上下文自适应的抓取合成。通过广泛的仿真和真实世界实验，我们证明：（i）基础策略表现出高效学习和强跨手泛化能力；（ii）该框架能够有效纳入空间、认知和时间先验，以应对三类代表性抓取挑战，同时与最先进方法相比不损害抓取合成性能；（iii）这些先验可以联合发挥作用，以在杂乱和动态环境中实现功能性抓取。这些结果表明，将物理抓取合成与任务相关理解解耦，为机器人抓取提供了一种可扩展范式，使未来基础模型的进展能够直接转化为改进的抓取能力，而无需重新设计或重新训练底层抓取策略。补充视频可在项目页面获取。

articles.title: Beyond DFT: Quantum Chaos and Neural Networks for 2D Material Device Design
articles.title_zh: 超越 DFT：用于二维材料器件设计的量子混沌与神经网络
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of quantum stability in Selenium-doped MoS 2 field-effect transistors (FETs) remains challenging due to the computational cost of ab initio methods. Here, we combine quantum chaos theory with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network to predict the Brody parameter (β) and current-voltage characteristics without relying on density functional theory. Our MLP model achieves R 2 > 0.93 on test data, accurately capturing the dependence of quantum chaos on bias voltage, impurity concentration, and lattice size. We demonstrate that quantum stability is tunable, not intrinsic, and uncover a universal scaling law where system size governs the transition from integrable to chaotic behavior. This framework bridges atomistic theory and device engineering, enabling rapid design of stable MoS 2-based electronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对硒掺杂 MoS₂ 场效应晶体管中量子稳定性预测成本高的问题，提出将量子混沌理论与多层感知机神经网络结合的方法。模型在测试数据上取得 R² > 0.93，可预测 Brody 参数和电流—电压特性，并揭示系统尺寸主导从可积到混沌行为的转变。该框架有助于在不依赖密度泛函理论的情况下快速设计稳定的 MoS₂ 电子器件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于从头算方法的计算成本较高，准确预测硒掺杂 MoS₂ 场效应晶体管（FET）中的量子稳定性仍然具有挑战性。本文将量子混沌理论与多层感知机（MLP）神经网络相结合，在不依赖密度泛函理论的情况下预测 Brody 参数（β）以及电流—电压特性。我们的 MLP 模型在测试数据上达到 R² > 0.93，能够准确捕捉量子混沌对偏置电压、杂质浓度和晶格尺寸的依赖关系。我们证明，量子稳定性是可调控的，而非材料固有不变的，并揭示了一条普适标度律，即系统尺寸支配从可积行为向混沌行为的转变。该框架连接了原子尺度理论与器件工程，可用于快速设计稳定的 MoS₂ 基电子器件。

articles.title: Predicting the process parameters for torque and thrust force in wood plastic composite drilling using machine learning algorithms
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习算法预测木塑复合材料钻削中扭矩与轴向力的工艺参数
articles.abstract: Wood Plastic Composite has become increasingly notable in domestic and industrial applications. The excessive thrust force and torque generated during drilling lead to poor surface finish and potential damage to the work materials. The drilling experiments were performed using Taguchi's L27 orthogonal array, with drilling parameters (N, f, and d) as inputs and thrust force and torque as output responses. The ANOVA analysis reveals that feed rate contributes (65.16% for thrust force and 64.41% for torque), followed by drill diameter (27.33% for thrust force and 20.39% for torque), and spindle speed (4.90% for thrust force and 12.84% for torque). Furthermore, machine learning models such as the extra-trees regressor, bagging with decision trees, and the random forest regressor were built to predict the output responses of WPC composite panels. To evaluate the performance of the predicted outcomes, six error metrics were used: mean absolute percentage error, mean absolute difference, Root mean square error, Standard error, mean square error, and coefficient of determination. Compared with other models, random forest produces more accurate predictions for thrust force and torque. This study provides a novel approach for evaluating and identifying suitable process parameters to minimize thrust force and torque induced during drilling of WPC composites.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 Taguchi L27 正交试验分析木塑复合材料钻削中的轴向力和扭矩，并将主轴转速、进给量和钻头直径作为输入参数。ANOVA 结果显示进给量对两项响应贡献最大，其次为钻头直径和主轴转速。研究比较了多种机器学习模型，发现随机森林回归器对轴向力和扭矩的预测最准确，可为优化钻削工艺参数提供依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 木塑复合材料在民用和工业应用中日益受到关注。钻削过程中产生的过大轴向力和扭矩会导致较差的表面质量，并可能损伤工件材料。钻削实验采用 Taguchi 的 L27 正交阵列进行，以钻削参数（N、f 和 d）作为输入，以轴向力和扭矩作为输出响应。ANOVA 分析表明，进给量的贡献最大（对轴向力为 65.16%，对扭矩为 64.41%），其次是钻头直径（对轴向力为 27.33%，对扭矩为 20.39%）和主轴转速（对轴向力为 4.90%，对扭矩为 12.84%）。此外，构建了极端随机树回归器、基于决策树的装袋模型以及随机森林回归器等机器学习模型，用于预测 WPC 复合板的输出响应。为评估预测结果的性能，使用了六种误差指标：平均绝对百分比误差、平均绝对差、均方根误差、标准误差、均方误差和决定系数。与其他模型相比，随机森林对轴向力和扭矩产生了更准确的预测。该研究为评估并确定合适工艺参数提供了一种新方法，以尽量降低 WPC 复合材料钻削过程中产生的轴向力和扭矩。

articles.title: Conglomerate-Financed Entry, Predatory Pricing and Regulatory Interfaces in BRICS Telecommunications Markets: Lessons from the Indian Jio Decisions
articles.title_zh: 金字塔集团融资进入、掠夺性定价与 BRICS 电信市场中的监管衔接：来自印度 Jio 裁决的启示
articles.abstract: This paper examines whether dominance-first predatory pricing rules adequately address conglomerate-financed entry into high-fixed-cost network industries across the BRICS jurisdictions. Taking the Indian Reliance Jio episode as the central case, it analyses how sustained below-cost strategies financed by diversified parent groups can trigger rapid, network-effect-driven reconcentration even when the entrant lacks contemporaneous dominance. Drawing on the frameworks of India (Competition Act, 2002 and the 2025 Cost of Production Regulations), South Africa, China, Brazil and Russia, it shows that static market-share snapshots systematically under-weight the competitive significance of externally financed entrants. The Competition Commission of India’s 2017 closures of the Jio informations, the Supreme Court’s 2019 TRAI–CCI demarcation, and the 2025 Kerala High Court refinement illustrate both the protective function and the limits of a sequential dominance gateway. Parallel challenges appear elsewhere in the BRICS group, including South Africa’s average-avoidable-cost standard, China’s treatment of platform cross-subsidisation, and Brazil’s attention to losses financed by external capital. The paper argues that a residual gap concerning sustained cross-subsidisation from unrelated businesses is common to the bloc. It proposes four operational reforms: dynamic application of market-power factors; treatment of credible conglomerate cross-subsidisation as an intensifying factor; formal inter-agency protocols; and reasoned departures from average-variable-cost benchmarks. These measures preserve dominance-based architecture while equipping BRICS authorities to respond to capital-intensive network markets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考察 BRICS 司法辖区中以“先支配地位”为门槛的掠夺性定价规则，是否足以应对高固定成本网络行业中由企业集团融资支持的市场进入。以印度 Reliance Jio 事件为核心案例，文章指出多元化母公司资助的持续低于成本策略可能在进入者尚未具备当期支配地位时，引发由网络效应驱动的快速再集中。作者提出四项改革建议，旨在保留支配地位框架的同时增强监管机构应对资本密集型网络市场的能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文考察在 BRICS 各司法辖区中，以先确立支配地位为前提的掠夺性定价规则是否足以应对由企业集团融资支持的市场进入，尤其是在高固定成本的网络行业中。文章以印度 Reliance Jio 事件为核心案例，分析了由多元化母公司资助的持续低于成本定价策略，如何即使在进入者当时尚不具备支配地位的情况下，也可能触发由网络效应驱动的快速市场再集中。文章借鉴印度（《2002 年竞争法》和 2025 年《生产成本规章》）、南非、中国、巴西和俄罗斯的制度框架，表明静态的市场份额快照会系统性地低估外部融资进入者的竞争意义。印度竞争委员会 2017 年对 Jio 举报事项的结案、印度最高法院 2019 年关于 TRAI 与 CCI 权限划分的裁定，以及 2025 年喀拉拉邦高等法院的进一步细化，既说明了顺序性支配地位门槛的保护功能，也说明了其局限性。BRICS 集团其他国家也出现了类似挑战，包括南非的平均可避免成本标准、中国对平台交叉补贴的处理，以及巴西对外部资本融资亏损的关注。文章认为，关于来自无关业务的持续交叉补贴，各成员经济体普遍存在一个剩余监管缺口。文章提出四项可操作改革：动态适用市场力量因素；将可信的企业集团交叉补贴视为强化因素；建立正式的机构间协议；以及对平均可变成本基准作出有理由的偏离。这些措施在保留以支配地位为基础的制度架构的同时，使 BRICS 竞争主管机关能够更好地应对资本密集型网络市场。

articles.title: Red Light Induces Metabolic Reprogramming and Enhances Secondary Metabolite Accumulation in Tea Leaves (Camellia sinensis)
articles.title_zh: 红光诱导茶叶代谢重编程并增强次生代谢物积累（Camellia sinensis）
articles.abstract: Light quality serves as a critical environmental cue for metabolic reprogramming in tea plants (Camellia sinensis), yet the systematic regulatory mechanisms of red light (RL) on quality-related metabolites remain poorly understood. This study demonstrates that RL irradiation significantly triggers systematic metabolic shifts, redirecting carbon and energy resources from vegetative growth toward secondary metabolism and quality formation. Using untargeted LC-QTOF-MS metabolomics, we identified 4261 metabolites, of which 2469 were differentially accumulated under RL compared to white light (WL). Our results reveal that RL selectively activates core hub pathways including phenylpropanoid biosynthesis (ko00940) and flavonoid biosynthesis (ko00941), while simultaneously suppressing primary metabolic routes such as purine and pyrimidine metabolism. Specifically, RL significantly up-regulates key flavor-contributing volatiles (e.g., methyleugenol and thymol) and remodels the plant hormone signaling network by up-regulating ABA, JA, and SA pathways to mediate the trade-off between growth and defense. Furthermore, network topological analysis identified ABC transporters (ko02010) as a pivotal regulatory hub facilitating the transport and accumulation of specialized metabolites. These findings provide a theoretical framework for precise light-quality management to enhance tea flavor and stress resilience in high-quality tea cultivation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨红光对茶树品质相关代谢物的系统调控机制。基于非靶向 LC-QTOF-MS 代谢组学，研究识别出 4261 种代谢物，其中 2469 种在红光与白光处理之间存在差异积累。结果显示红光激活苯丙烷和黄酮生物合成等核心通路，同时抑制部分初级代谢并调节激素信号，有助于提升茶叶风味和抗逆性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光质是茶树（Camellia sinensis）代谢重编程的关键环境信号，但红光（RL）对品质相关代谢物的系统调控机制仍了解不足。本研究表明，红光照射会显著触发系统性代谢转变，将碳和能量资源从营养生长重新导向次生代谢和品质形成。利用非靶向 LC-QTOF-MS 代谢组学，我们鉴定出 4261 种代谢物，其中 2469 种在红光处理下相对白光（WL）处理呈差异积累。我们的结果显示，红光选择性激活了包括苯丙烷生物合成（ko00940）和黄酮生物合成（ko00941）在内的核心枢纽通路，同时抑制嘌呤和嘧啶代谢等初级代谢路线。具体而言，红光显著上调了关键的风味贡献挥发物（例如甲基丁香酚和百里香酚），并通过上调 ABA、JA 和 SA 通路重塑植物激素信号网络，以介导生长与防御之间的权衡。此外，网络拓扑分析将 ABC 转运蛋白（ko02010）识别为促进专门代谢物运输与积累的关键调控枢纽。这些发现为精准光质管理提供了理论框架，可用于在高品质茶叶栽培中增强茶叶风味和抗逆性。

articles.title: Parameter-performance scaling of hybrid quantum-classical policies for demand-charge-aware battery control
articles.title_zh: 面向需量电费感知电池控制的混合量子—经典策略参数—性能标度关系
articles.abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical models are often proposed as compact alternatives to classical neural networks; however, the claim that they require fewer parameters has rarely been tested across full model size ranges against strong classical baselines. In this study, this claim was tested on a realistic energy-control task: 15-min, full-month control of behind-the-meter batteries that must minimize commercial electricity demand charges using 549 simulated office buildings under a standardized utility tariff. Three policy families—a classical neural network and two hybrid quantum-circuit variants sharing the same inputs and control head—were trained by behavioral cloning from a perfect-foresight optimizer and compared at four parameter budgets on a locked held-out test set. One compact hybrid design (~ 1,400 parameters) provided the best control performance among all tested model and modestly outperformed the size-matched classical network. However, the advantage is small, does not hold for other sizes, and depends on a task-specific control head rather than on the quantum circuit itself. The classical network remains a strong baseline and runs faster. Therefore, this study reports a narrow, bounded parameter-efficiency benefit rather than a general quantum advantage and outlines which hardware-level validation would still be required. All quantum circuits were evaluated using exact simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在真实感较强的楼宇电池控制任务中，检验混合量子—经典模型是否比经典神经网络更具参数效率。研究比较了经典神经网络和两类混合量子电路策略在不同参数预算下的表现，发现一个约 1400 参数的紧凑混合设计表现最佳并略优于同规模经典网络。总体结论是该优势狭窄且有边界，并不能支持一般性的量子优势主张，且经典网络仍是速度更快的强基线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合量子—经典模型常被提出作为经典神经网络的紧凑替代方案；然而，关于其需要更少参数的说法，很少在完整模型规模范围内并与强经典基线进行对比测试。本研究在一个现实的能源控制任务上检验了这一说法：对表后电池进行 15 分钟粒度、整月尺度控制，使其在标准化公用事业电价下尽量降低商业电力需量电费，该任务使用了 549 栋模拟办公楼。三类策略族——一个经典神经网络和两个共享相同输入与控制头的混合量子电路变体——通过从完美前瞻优化器进行行为克隆来训练，并在四种参数预算下于锁定的留出测试集上进行比较。一个紧凑的混合设计（约 1400 个参数）在所有测试模型中提供了最佳控制性能，并小幅优于参数规模匹配的经典网络。然而，这种优势很小，并未在其他规模下保持，而且依赖于特定任务的控制头，而不是量子电路本身。经典网络仍然是一个强基线，并且运行速度更快。因此，本研究报告的是一种狭窄且有边界的参数效率收益，而不是一般性的量子优势，并概述了仍需进行哪些硬件层面的验证。所有量子电路均使用精确模拟进行评估。

articles.title: Bimetallic Cu-Fe 3 O 4 nanocomposite-loaded nanocellulose: a magnetic catalyst for reductive elimination of toxic nitroarenes from water; Optimization using response surface methodology
articles.title_zh: 负载双金属 Cu–Fe₃O₄ 纳米复合物的纳米纤维素：一种用于水中有毒硝基芳烃还原消除的磁性催化剂；基于响应面法的优化
articles.abstract: Hydrogenation-based detoxification of nitroaromatics is frequently impeded by costly, non-recyclable precious metal catalysts. Herein, the design, synthesis, and characterization of a magnetically recoverable biomass-based catalyst (Cu@Mag-CNC) in its Cu–Fe3O4 nanocomposite supported on cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) derived from rice straw for the green NaBH4-mediated aqueous/protic phase reduction of nitroarenes is reported. A structural and surface characterization revealed metallic Cu0 domains uniformly anchored on Fe3O4 spinel framework with integrity of cellulose crystallinity and superparamagnetism, which ensured fast magnetic separation. Under optimized conditions (10 mg catalyst, NaBH4/NB = 2.0, EtOH/H₂O 1:1, 75°C), nitrobenzene was reduced to aniline with excellent yield (98.5% conversion) following pseudo-first-order kinetics with kapp ≈ 0.59 min− 1 and providing turnover frequencies as high as 627 mol g− 1 h− 1 over an extensive range of nitroarenes while retaining high chemoselectivity for the nitro group. Response-surface optimization (R2 ≈ 0.98) continuously identifies temperature as the leading factor, revealing an ultra-low resource operating window of 10 mg Cu@Mag-CNC, 2.0 equivalents NaBH4 and 75°C, and regarding activity/reagent economy/addressable lifetime/sustainability in terms of biomass-derived support, Cu@Mag-CNC was rated among the best performing active/durable/supportable Cu-based nanocatalysts with > 95% conversion obtained over seven cycles (84% for the eighth cycle).
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究设计并制备了以稻草来源纤维素纳米晶为载体的可磁回收 Cu–Fe₃O₄ 纳米复合催化剂，用于 NaBH₄ 介导的水相/质子相硝基芳烃还原。表征结果显示金属 Cu⁰ 均匀锚定于 Fe₃O₄ 尖晶石框架并保持纤维素结晶性和超顺磁性。优化条件下硝基苯可高效转化为苯胺，催化剂在多种硝基芳烃中表现出高选择性、较高转化率和良好循环稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于加氢的硝基芳香化合物解毒过程常受到昂贵且不可回收的贵金属催化剂限制。本文报道了一种可磁回收的生物质基催化剂（Cu@Mag-CNC）的设计、合成与表征，该催化剂为负载在由稻草来源纤维素纳米晶（CNCs）上的 Cu–Fe₃O₄ 纳米复合物，用于绿色 NaBH₄ 介导的水相/质子相硝基芳烃还原。结构与表面表征显示，金属 Cu⁰ 结构域均匀锚定在 Fe₃O₄ 尖晶石框架上，同时保持了纤维素结晶完整性和超顺磁性，从而确保快速磁分离。在优化条件下（10 mg 催化剂、NaBH₄/NB = 2.0、EtOH/H₂O 1:1、75°C），硝基苯以优异产率还原为苯胺（98.5% 转化率），反应遵循准一级动力学，kapp ≈ 0.59 min⁻¹，并在广泛的硝基芳烃范围内提供高达 627 mol g⁻¹ h⁻¹ 的转换频率，同时对硝基保持高化学选择性。响应面优化（R² ≈ 0.98）持续识别出温度是主导因素，揭示了一个超低资源操作窗口，即 10 mg Cu@Mag-CNC、2.0 当量 NaBH₄ 和 75°C；并且从活性、试剂经济性、可用寿命和可持续性等方面看，由于其生物质来源载体，Cu@Mag-CNC 被评为表现最佳且兼具活性、耐久性和可负载性的铜基纳米催化剂之一，其在七次循环中保持 >95% 转化率，第八次循环仍为 84%。

articles.title: Enhancing Property Prediction of OLED Materials under Data Scarcity via Cognitive Eye-Tracking-Informed Attention Mechanism Models
articles.title_zh: 通过认知眼动追踪启发的注意力机制模型提升数据稀缺条件下 OLED 材料性质预测
articles.abstract: The inductive bias derived from human cognitive patterns plays a pivotal role in developing high-performance AI systems. However, the full potential of this principle remains underutilized in materials science. Deep learning models for materials property prediction often struggle to accurately map complex structure-property relationships in low-data regimes, limiting their accuracy and efficiency in critical areas such as frontier electro-optical materials. Here, we utilize eye-tracking technology to record human attention patterns during molecular analysis and employ standard network modules to emulate these cognitive processes. This approach successfully replicates multi-stage feature processing strategies of experts into a hierarchical deep learning architecture designed for geometric-to-electronic structure inference. Trained on thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF) molecules, a representative class of organic light emitting diode (OLED) emitters, the model predicts frontier molecular orbital distributions with near-DFT accuracy (mean squared error < 1%). By aligning the model’s internal multi-stage attention maps with human fixation distributions, we demonstrate that the network learns to prioritize task-relevant functional group interactions emulating human-like reasoning. Furthermore, the human-mimicking attention mechanism provides quantitative correlations to serve as references for expert-driven molecular design. These results establish a robust framework for embedding domain knowledge into AI via structured attention mechanisms. By adopting an inherently interpretable approach, this method shifts away from the prevailing trend of merely scaling up model parameter counts, offering a promising pathway to assist in cutting-edge materials design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将人类专家在分子分析中的眼动注意模式嵌入深度学习模型，以提升低数据条件下 OLED 材料性质预测能力。模型在热激活延迟荧光分子上训练，可近似 DFT 精度预测前线分子轨道分布，并通过多阶段注意力图模拟人类推理。该方法强调可解释的结构化注意机制，为将领域知识注入材料 AI 提供了框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 源自人类认知模式的归纳偏置在开发高性能 AI 系统中发挥关键作用。然而，这一原则的全部潜力在材料科学中仍未得到充分利用。用于材料性质预测的深度学习模型在低数据条件下往往难以准确映射复杂的结构—性质关系，从而限制了其在前沿电光材料等关键领域中的准确性和效率。本文利用眼动追踪技术记录人类在分子分析过程中的注意模式，并采用标准网络模块来模拟这些认知过程。该方法成功地将专家的多阶段特征处理策略复制到一种层级式深度学习架构中，该架构面向从几何结构到电子结构的推断。在热激活延迟荧光（TADF）分子这一有机发光二极管（OLED）发光体的代表性类别上训练后，该模型以前接近 DFT 的精度预测前线分子轨道分布（均方误差 < 1%）。通过将模型内部的多阶段注意力图与人类注视分布对齐，我们证明该网络学会了优先关注与任务相关的官能团相互作用，从而模拟类人的推理。此外，这种模仿人类的注意力机制提供了定量相关性，可作为专家驱动分子设计的参考。这些结果建立了一个通过结构化注意机制将领域知识嵌入 AI 的稳健框架。通过采用一种内在可解释的方法，该方法摆脱了单纯扩大模型参数数量的主流趋势，为辅助前沿材料设计提供了一条有前景的路径。
