articles.title: Assessment of a Confined Dynamic Energy Shell in Terms of Quantum Teleportation and Quantum Tunneling: A Theoretical and Pre-Experimental Analysis of a Dual-Capsule Apparatus
articles.title_zh: 从量子隐形传态与量子隧穿角度评估受限动态能量壳：一种双舱装置的理论与预实验分析
articles.abstract: This work quantitatively assesses a multilayer, dual-capsule experimental apparatus, designed to be sited inside a mountain gallery, with respect to quantum teleportation and quantum tunneling. The apparatus is intended to create a confined, dynamic energy shell around an inner capsule by means of a 25 MV electron arc that sheathes the capsule from top to bottom, a coaxial 20 kV laser current, and rotating superconducting magnets. A three-tier epistemic distinction is used. At the first tier (established physics), the high-energy photon field can generate polarization-entangled pairs via Bethe–Heitler pair production, and these can be used for single-qubit state teleportation, with attainable fidelity F=(2F_ent+1)/3 exceeding the classical bound of 2/3. At the second tier, teleportation of a macroscopic object is shown to be impossible owing to the required ~10²⁹ qubits, the near-instantaneous decoherence of macroscopic superpositions, and the no-communication theorem. At the third tier, macroscopic tunneling is proven effectively impossible, since the WKB transmission probability is of order 10⁽−¹⁰^²⁵⁾. The work delineates the apparatus's genuine quantum capacity while honestly rejecting two popular misconceptions through closed-form calculations, and provides an upper bound on the gravitational self-potential of the energy shell.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从量子隐形传态和量子隧穿角度，对拟设置于山体廊道内的多层双舱实验装置进行定量评估。文章区分了已确立物理、宏观物体传送不可行性和宏观隧穿有效不可能性三个层次。结论认为装置在产生纠缠对并用于单量子比特态传送方面具有真实量子能力，但宏观物体传送和宏观隧穿在物理上不可行。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作对一种多层双舱实验装置进行了定量评估，该装置设计为安置在山体廊道内部，评估角度包括量子隐形传态和量子隧穿。该装置旨在通过一个自上而下包覆内舱的 25 MV 电子弧、一个同轴 20 kV 激光电流以及旋转超导磁体，在内舱周围形成受限的动态能量壳。文章采用三层认识论区分。第一层为已确立的物理学：高能光子场可通过 Bethe–Heitler 对产生机制生成偏振纠缠对，而这些纠缠对可用于单量子比特态隐形传态，其可达到的保真度 F = (2F_ent + 1)/3 超过 2/3 的经典界限。第二层表明，宏观物体的隐形传态是不可能的，原因在于其需要约 10²⁹ 个量子比特、宏观叠加态几乎瞬时退相干，以及无通信定理的限制。第三层证明宏观隧穿在实际上是不可能的，因为 WKB 透射概率约为 10⁽⁻¹⁰^²⁵⁾ 的量级。该工作通过闭式计算界定了该装置真实的量子能力，同时坦率否定了两种流行误解，并给出了能量壳引力自势的上界。

articles.title: DDAN: A Dense Dual-Attention Network with Physics-Informed Loss for Robust Multi-Type Optical Image Denoising
articles.title_zh: DDAN：一种带物理约束损失的密集双注意力网络，用于鲁棒多类型光学图像去噪
articles.abstract: Image degradation caused by additive Gaussian noise, multiplicative speckle, and their hybrid combination is a fundamental challenge in optical imaging. Existing methods predominantly specialise for a single noise type, leaving a critical performance gap when multiple noise sources co-exist. This paper proposes the Dense Dual-Attention Network (DDAN), an end-to-end encoder-decoder framework for robust multi-type image denoising. DDAN incorporates Residual Dense Blocks with Dual Attention (RDBA) at every encoder and decoder stage, combining progressive dense feature concatenation maximising gradient flow and feature reuse with a sequential Dual Attention Module (DAM) that performs channel recalibration via global average pooling and spatial gating via a 7((×))7 depthwise convolution. Training is governed by a physics-informed composite loss integrating ((L₁)) pixel fidelity, structural similarity (SSIM), and a log-ratio speckle constraint (((α=0.7)), ((β=0.2)), ((γ=0.1))). Evaluated on Classic5, Kodak24, McMaster, and Set12 against seven competing methods, DDAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in all 96 evaluated conditions without exception surpassing DATNet by 7.94-12.51 dB PSNR under additive noise, by 0.58-1.44 dB across all multiplicative look counts including single-look (L=1), and by 0.90-7.41 dB under hybrid noise, establishing a new universal benchmark for multi-type optical image denoising.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 DDAN 端到端编码器—解码器框架，用于同时处理加性高斯噪声、乘性散斑噪声及其混合噪声造成的光学图像退化。该网络在各编码器和解码器阶段引入带双注意力的残差密集块，并采用结合 L₁、SSIM 和对数比散斑约束的物理启发复合损失。多个数据集和 96 种评估条件下，DDAN 均取得领先性能，建立了多类型光学图像去噪的新基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由加性高斯噪声、乘性散斑噪声及其混合组合造成的图像退化，是光学成像中的一个基本挑战。现有方法主要专门针对单一噪声类型，当多种噪声源共存时留下了关键性能缺口。本文提出密集双注意力网络（DDAN），这是一种端到端编码器—解码器框架，用于鲁棒的多类型图像去噪。DDAN 在每个编码器和解码器阶段都引入带双注意力的残差密集块（RDBA），将最大化梯度流和特征复用的渐进式密集特征拼接，与一个顺序式双注意力模块（DAM）相结合；该模块通过全局平均池化进行通道重校准，并通过 7×7 深度卷积进行空间门控。训练由一种物理启发的复合损失控制，该损失整合了 L₁ 像素保真度、结构相似性（SSIM）以及对数比散斑约束（α = 0.7，β = 0.2，γ = 0.1）。在 Classic5、Kodak24、McMaster 和 Set12 数据集上与七种竞争方法比较评估时，DDAN 在所有 96 种评估条件下无一例外地取得最先进性能：在加性噪声下 PSNR 超过 DATNet 7.94–12.51 dB，在包括单视（L = 1）在内的所有乘性视数条件下高出 0.58–1.44 dB，并在混合噪声下高出 0.90–7.41 dB，从而建立了多类型光学图像去噪的新型通用基准。

articles.title: A Physics-Guided Transfer Learning Framework for Cloud, Dust and Clear-Sky Detection over Bright Surfaces in Passive Satellite Remote Sensing
articles.title_zh: 面向被动卫星遥感中亮表面云、沙尘与晴空检测的物理引导迁移学习框架
articles.abstract: Accurate discrimination among clouds, dust aerosols, and bright surfaces remains challenging because these targets exhibit substantial spectral overlap. Fixed-threshold algorithms often lack regional transferability, whereas data-driven models are constrained by sparse and potentially biased reference labels. This study presents a physics-guided transfer-learning framework based on a stochastic differential equation network (SDE-Net) for joint cloud and dust aerosol identification from MODIS multispectral observations. Radiative transfer simulations spanning a broad range of atmospheric, surface, and viewing conditions were used for model pretraining, and collocated MODIS-CALIPSO observations were used for regional fine-tuning. The proposed method achieved overall accuracies of 93.81% and 85.68% for daytime and nighttime classification, respectively. For dust aerosol identification, the overall accuracy was 91.96%, and the daytime and nighttime F1 scores were 87.80% and 77.04%, respectively, exceeding those of the evaluated benchmark methods by 3.22% to 27.01%. Cloud recall reached 95.09% during daytime and 92.61% at night. Case studies showed that the retrieved spatial patterns were more consistent with MODIS imagery and CALIPSO vertical feature observations than the comparison products. The stochastic formulation further enabled uncertainty quantification. Mean epistemic uncertainty remained low at 1.71% during daytime and 5.69% at night, whereas mean aleatoric uncertainty increased from 14.96% to 31.40%. The proposed framework provides an effective approach for cloud-dust discrimination over bright surfaces and supports subsequent environmental and climate analyses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于随机微分方程网络的物理引导迁移学习框架，用于从 MODIS 多光谱观测中联合识别云和沙尘气溶胶。模型先利用辐射传输模拟进行预训练，再用配准的 MODIS-CALIPSO 观测进行区域微调。结果显示该方法在昼夜分类、沙尘识别和云召回方面优于基准方法，并可提供不确定性量化，支持亮表面上的云尘区分与环境气候分析。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于云、沙尘气溶胶和明亮地表之间存在显著光谱重叠，准确区分三者仍然具有挑战性。固定阈值算法通常缺乏区域可迁移性，而数据驱动模型则受到稀疏且可能存在偏差的参考标签限制。本研究提出一种基于随机微分方程网络（SDE-Net）的物理引导迁移学习框架，用于从 MODIS 多光谱观测中联合识别云和沙尘气溶胶。覆盖广泛大气、地表和观测条件的辐射传输模拟被用于模型预训练，配准的 MODIS-CALIPSO 观测被用于区域微调。所提出的方法在白天和夜间分类中分别达到 93.81% 和 85.68% 的总体准确率。对于沙尘气溶胶识别，总体准确率为 91.96%，白天和夜间 F1 分数分别为 87.80% 和 77.04%，超过所评估基准方法 3.22% 至 27.01%。云召回率白天达到 95.09%，夜间达到 92.61%。案例研究表明，与对比产品相比，反演得到的空间分布格局与 MODIS 影像和 CALIPSO 垂直特征观测更加一致。随机建模形式还进一步实现了不确定性量化。平均认知不确定性在白天和夜间分别保持在较低的 1.71% 和 5.69%，而平均偶然不确定性则从 14.96% 增加到 31.40%。所提出的框架为亮表面上的云—尘区分提供了一种有效方法，并支持后续环境和气候分析。

articles.title: Viscoelasticity and Interface Properties of Multi-Component Condensates Govern Protein Sequestration and Suppression of Amyloid Formation
articles.title_zh: 多组分凝聚体的黏弹性与界面性质调控蛋白质隔离并抑制淀粉样蛋白形成
articles.abstract: Stress granules (SGs) are multi-component biomolecular condensates widely implicated as sites of protein aggregation by virtue of the high concentrations of amyloidogenic RNA-binding proteins they contain. This model, in which SGs are viewed as crucibles for amyloid formation, has not been rigorously tested. Here, we employed twelve multi-component protein–nucleic acid condensate systems as SG-mimics with diverse physicochemical features. Utilizing three fibril-forming proteins, hnRNPA1, Tau, and FUS, which are concentrated more than 50-fold in condensates, we report that multi-component biomolecular condensates robustly suppress, rather than promote, amyloid formation. Multiscale experimental analyses, including quantitative kinetic measurements, rheology, and microscopy, combined with computational modelling, reveal that condensates serve as sinks for soluble protein, and fibrils form in the dilute phase, although interfaces can promote nucleation. Three key physicochemical properties of condensates govern suppression of fibril formation: First, condensate-mediated sequestration lowers the concentration of fibril-forming proteins in the dilute phase. Second, condensate viscoelasticity constrains efflux-driven fibril growth in the dilute phase. And third, dilution of fibril-forming proteins at condensate interfaces mitigates fibril nucleation. The sink potential of SG-mimics is recapitulated in G3BP1–RNA condensates and SGs reconstituted in mammalian cell lysate, suggesting that SGs may have evolved to suppress stress-induced protein aggregation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究检验了压力颗粒是否会因富集淀粉样 RNA 结合蛋白而促进蛋白聚集这一常见模型。作者使用十二种多组分蛋白—核酸凝聚体系统作为压力颗粒模拟物，发现它们稳健地抑制而非促进 hnRNPA1、Tau 和 FUS 的淀粉样形成。研究指出蛋白隔离、凝聚体黏弹性和界面稀释共同调控抑制效应，并提示压力颗粒可能演化出抑制应激诱导蛋白聚集的功能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 压力颗粒（SGs）是多组分生物分子凝聚体，由于其含有高浓度的淀粉样生成倾向 RNA 结合蛋白，因而被广泛认为是蛋白聚集位点。将 SGs 视为淀粉样形成熔炉的这一模型尚未得到严格检验。本文采用十二种具有不同物理化学特征的多组分蛋白—核酸凝聚体系统作为 SG 模拟物。利用三种成纤维蛋白 hnRNPA1、Tau 和 FUS，它们在凝聚体中的浓度可超过 50 倍，我们报告多组分生物分子凝聚体能够稳健地抑制而不是促进淀粉样形成。包括定量动力学测量、流变学和显微成像在内的多尺度实验分析，结合计算建模，揭示凝聚体作为可溶性蛋白的汇，而纤维在稀相中形成，尽管界面可促进成核。凝聚体的三个关键物理化学性质支配纤维形成的抑制作用：首先，凝聚体介导的隔离降低了稀相中成纤维蛋白的浓度。其次，凝聚体黏弹性限制了由外流驱动的稀相纤维生长。第三，成纤维蛋白在凝聚体界面的稀释减弱了纤维成核。SG 模拟物的汇集潜力在 G3BP1–RNA 凝聚体以及哺乳动物细胞裂解液中重构的 SGs 中得到再现，提示 SGs 可能已经演化为抑制应激诱导蛋白聚集的结构。

articles.title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model-Assisted Title­­ and Abstract Screening for Systematic Reviews: Method Evaluation and Validation
articles.title_zh: 用于系统综述的成本高效大语言模型辅助题名与摘要筛选：方法评估与验证
articles.abstract: Background The yearly number of publications in many fields, including research on potential health effects of electromagnetic fields (EMF), has steadily risen, making systematic reviews (SRs) increasingly laborious. Automating the title and abstract screening phase using large language models (LLMs) is a promising solution. However, prior studies have underexplored structured LLM workflows, including explicit reasoning outputs, few-shot prompting, and task-decomposition.Methods We systematically devised and evaluated multiple LLM-based workflows using both open-source and proprietary models. The most promising workflows were validated on eight independent SR datasets, focusing on EMF and non-EMF research domains. Workflows were designed to elicit PECOS-wise decisions with explicit reasoning, and record-level verdicts were derived using deterministic decision rules.Results Three workflows, one based on an open-source (llama3.3:70b) and two based on proprietary LLMs, achieved high sensitivity while substantially reducing manual screening effort. The proprietary LLM gpt-4.1-mini embedded in a few-shot workflow with PECOS-wise reasoning, reached a pooled sensitivity of 96.4% (95% CI: 94.8%–97.6%) with a workload reduction of 80.4% (95% CI: 63.7%–90.5%) at an approximate batch API cost of 1.0 per 1,000 records. Overall, small “mini” models performed competitively, demonstrating cost-efficient and resource-friendly applicability.Conclusions Carefully selected LLM workflows implementing few-shot prompting and explicit PECOS-wise reasoning can achieve near-human sensitivity while substantially reducing manual screening effort. These findings provide a transparent and versatile framework for AI-assisted literature screening in systematic reviews, although further optimisation is needed to improve specificity, with executable code for the best workflows available at https://github.com/openbfs/ai-sr-litscreen.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了多种大语言模型工作流程在系统综述题名和摘要筛选自动化中的表现，重点关注显式推理、少样本提示和任务分解。多个开放源和专有模型工作流程在八个独立系统综述数据集上验证，其中包含电磁场与非电磁场研究领域。结果显示，经过精心设计的少样本和 PECOS 分项推理流程可在保持较高敏感性的同时显著降低人工筛选工作量，但仍需进一步提升特异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景：包括电磁场（EMF）潜在健康影响研究在内的许多领域，每年发表的文献数量持续上升，使系统综述（SRs）越来越耗费人力。使用大语言模型（LLMs）自动化题名和摘要筛选阶段是一种有前景的解决方案。然而，以往研究对结构化 LLM 工作流程探索不足，包括显式推理输出、少样本提示和任务分解。方法：我们系统设计并评估了多个基于 LLM 的工作流程，使用开放源模型和专有模型。最有前景的工作流程在八个独立的 SR 数据集上得到验证，重点涵盖 EMF 和非 EMF 研究领域。工作流程被设计为引出按 PECOS 维度作出的决策及其显式推理，并使用确定性决策规则得出记录层面的判定。结果：三个工作流程，其中一个基于开放源模型（llama3.3:70b），两个基于专有 LLM，在显著减少人工筛选工作量的同时实现了高敏感性。嵌入少样本工作流程并具有 PECOS 分项推理的专有 LLM gpt-4.1-mini 达到 96.4% 的合并敏感性（95% CI：94.8%–97.6%），工作量减少 80.4%（95% CI：63.7%–90.5%），批量 API 成本约为每 1000 条记录 1.0。总体而言，小型“mini”模型表现具有竞争力，显示出成本高效且资源友好的适用性。结论：经过精心选择、实施少样本提示和显式 PECOS 分项推理的 LLM 工作流程，可以在大幅减少人工筛选工作量的同时达到接近人工的敏感性。这些发现为系统综述中 AI 辅助文献筛选提供了一个透明且通用的框架，尽管仍需进一步优化以提高特异性，最佳工作流程的可执行代码已公开提供。

articles.title: Stacked Intelligent Metasurface Enabled Integrated Sensing and Communications for 6G: Joint Optimization and Performance Analysis
articles.title_zh: 面向6G的堆叠智能超表面赋能通感一体化：联合优化与性能分析
articles.abstract: This paper proposes a stacked intelligent metasurface (SIM)-empowered integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) framework for next-generation 6G smart radio environments, with the objective of jointly enhancing communication efficiency and sensing accuracy through multi-layer electromagnetic wave manipulation. Unlike conventional single-layer reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) architectures, the proposed SIM model employs cascaded programmable metasurface layers to provide additional spatial and electromagnetic degrees of freedom for improved beam control, signal focusing, and dual-functional optimization. A unified mathematical framework is developed by integrating metasurface response modeling, joint communication-sensing signal formulation, and alternating optimization of beamforming and metasurface parameters. Simulation results confirm that the proposed SIM-assisted ISAC system consistently outperforms the conventional RIS baseline. In communication performance, the achievable rate increases from approximately 15.2-bit/s/Hz for RIS to about 16.4-bit/s/Hz for SIM. In sensing performance, the sensing signal-to-noise ratio improves from nearly 27.2 dB to around 29.6 dB, while the Cramér–Rao bound decreases from about 2.0×10⁻⁴ to approximately 1.1×10⁻⁴, indicating substantially enhanced estimation precision. The results further reveal that a three-layer SIM configuration provides the most favourable trade-off between communication and sensing objectives. These findings establish SIM-enabled ISAC as a promising paradigm for high-performance, environment-aware 6G wireless networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种由堆叠智能超表面（SIM）赋能的6G通感一体化框架，通过多层电磁波操控同时提升通信效率与感知精度。研究建立了涵盖超表面响应、通感信号建模以及波束成形与超表面参数交替优化的统一数学框架。仿真表明，SIM系统在可达速率、感知信噪比和克拉美–罗下界方面均优于传统RIS基线，且三层SIM在通信与感知目标之间实现较优折中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出一种由堆叠智能超表面（SIM）赋能的通感一体化（ISAC）框架，用于下一代6G智能无线电环境，其目标是通过多层电磁波操控联合提升通信效率和感知精度。不同于传统单层可重构智能表面（RIS）架构，所提出的SIM模型采用级联的可编程超表面层，为改进波束控制、信号聚焦和双功能优化提供额外的空间与电磁自由度。本文通过整合超表面响应建模、通感联合信号表述以及波束成形和超表面参数的交替优化，建立了一个统一的数学框架。仿真结果证实，所提出的SIM辅助ISAC系统始终优于传统RIS基线。在通信性能方面，可达速率从RIS的约15.2 bit/s/Hz提高到SIM的约16.4 bit/s/Hz。在感知性能方面，感知信噪比从接近27.2 dB提高到约29.6 dB，而克拉美–罗下界从约2.0×10⁻⁴降低到约1.1×10⁻⁴，表明估计精度得到显著增强。结果还显示，三层SIM配置在通信和感知目标之间提供了最有利的折中。这些发现确立了SIM赋能ISAC作为高性能、环境感知型6G无线网络的一种有前景范式。

articles.title: Design and Fabrication of Bio-Inspired Bouligand-Structured Scaffold for Bone Tissue Engineering Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向骨组织工程应用的仿生Bouligand结构支架设计与制造
articles.abstract: Bone scaffolds used for bone tissue regeneration require a three-dimensional framework with interconnected porosity, adequate mechanical strength, permeability, and bioelectrical functionality. Achieving an optimal balance among these properties remains a significant challenge. In this work, we developed scaffold architectures inspired by the bouligand structure to enhance the mechanical, piezoelectric, and permeability properties for bone tissue engineering (BTE) applications. The representative volume element (RVE) method was adopted to predict the elastic modulus and piezoelectric coefficient of hybrid composites comprising various wt% of hydroxyapatite (HAp), barium titanate (BT), and graphene (Gr). Subsequently, these material properties were used to evaluate scaffold designs at different porosities using numerical techniques. The finite element method (FEM) is used to predict the elastic modulus and piezoelectric coefficient, and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is used to analyse the permeability properties of different scaffold designs. The technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) was used to identify the optimal scaffold design with material properties to highly dense cancellous bone. The results showed that the scaffold design with 70% infill, comprising 90% HAp, 9.9% BT, and 0.1% Gr, is a promising approach for multifunctional design. The optimized scaffold was subsequently fabricated by robocasting using optimized printing parameters.The results demonstrate the potential of combining bioinspired architecture and multifunctional composite materials to develop scaffolds with improved performance for bone tissue regeneration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了受Bouligand结构启发的骨组织工程支架，以平衡互连孔隙、力学强度、渗透性和生物电功能。研究采用RVE、FEM、CFD和TOPSIS方法，评估不同复合材料组成与孔隙/填充设计下的弹性模量、压电系数和渗透性能。结果显示，70%填充、由90%羟基磷灰石、9.9%钛酸钡和0.1%石墨烯组成的支架较为优选，并通过直写成型制造验证了该多功能设计思路。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于骨组织再生的骨支架需要具有相互连通孔隙的三维框架、足够的机械强度、渗透性以及生物电功能。在这些性能之间实现最佳平衡仍然是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们开发了受Bouligand结构启发的支架架构，以增强其用于骨组织工程（BTE）应用的机械、压电和渗透性能。本文采用代表性体积单元（RVE）方法来预测由不同重量百分比的羟基磷灰石（HAp）、钛酸钡（BT）和石墨烯（Gr）组成的杂化复合材料的弹性模量和压电系数。随后，这些材料性能被用于通过数值技术评估不同孔隙率下的支架设计。有限元方法（FEM）用于预测弹性模量和压电系数，计算流体动力学（CFD）用于分析不同支架设计的渗透性能。采用逼近理想解排序法（TOPSIS）来确定材料性能接近高密度松质骨的最优支架设计。结果表明，具有70%填充率、由90% HAp、9.9% BT和0.1% Gr组成的支架设计，是一种有前景的多功能设计方法。随后，采用优化的打印参数，通过机器人直写成型制备了优化支架。结果表明，将仿生结构与多功能复合材料相结合，有望开发出用于骨组织再生且性能改进的支架。

articles.title: Performance Analysis of a Solar-Hybrid System for Sustainable Hydrogen Production via Biomass Reforming
articles.title_zh: 通过生物质重整可持续制氢的太阳能混合系统性能分析
articles.abstract: This study investigates the thermochemical conversion of carbonaceous materials and biomass via solar-driven gasification for the production of high-calorific gaseous fuels. Particular emphasis is placed on intensifying hydrogen generation through the application of concentrated solar radiation. Thermodynamic assessments reveal that while steam gasification of biomass is energetically unfavorable at low temperatures, the process facilitates complex parallel reaction pathways within the 700–900 °C range, significantly enhancing syngas quality. By integrating concentrated solar energy as an external thermal source, the system achieves autothermal operation, eliminating reliance on fossil fuels for reaction maintenance or steam superheating. This integration enhances overall process efficiency and demonstrates a potential reduction in energy consumption by up to 40%. Furthermore, the study elucidates the reaction mechanisms governing the interactions between coal, biomass-derived carbon, and oxidizing agents under high-temperature solar conditions. Design and operational principles of helioreactors, along with the kinetics and pathways of hydrogen formation, are critically analyzed. Utilizing a solar furnace system, the reforming of CO2–CH4 mixtures into hydrogen-rich gas streams is facilitated. Additionally, the incorporation of thermal energy storage in molten salts ensures process stability and continuity, thereby advancing the overall sustainability and reliability of the solar-biomass gasification system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了利用太阳能驱动气化对含碳材料和生物质进行热化学转化以生产高热值气体燃料，重点关注集中太阳辐射对制氢的强化作用。热力学分析表明，尽管低温下生物质蒸汽气化在能量上不利，但在700–900°C范围内可促进复杂并行反应并提升合成气质量。通过引入集中太阳能、熔盐储热和太阳炉/日光反应器设计，系统可减少对化石燃料的依赖、提高效率并改善连续运行能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究考察了通过太阳能驱动气化对含碳材料和生物质进行热化学转化，以生产高热值气体燃料。研究特别强调通过应用集中太阳辐射来强化氢气生成。热力学评估表明，虽然生物质蒸汽气化在低温下从能量角度看是不利的，但该过程在700–900°C范围内促进了复杂的并行反应路径，从而显著提高了合成气质量。通过将集中太阳能作为外部热源集成到系统中，该系统实现了自热运行，消除了对化石燃料来维持反应或进行蒸汽过热的依赖。这种集成提高了整体过程效率，并显示出最高可降低40%能耗的潜力。此外，本研究阐明了在高温太阳能条件下煤、生物质衍生碳和氧化剂之间相互作用的反应机制。本文对日光反应器的设计和运行原则，以及氢形成的动力学和路径进行了批判性分析。利用太阳炉系统，可以促进CO2–CH4混合物重整为富氢气流。此外，将熔盐热能储存纳入系统可确保过程稳定性和连续性，从而提升太阳能—生物质气化系统的整体可持续性和可靠性。

articles.title: BESIII sets world's most stringent direct limit on Lambda hyperon electric dipole moment
articles.title_zh: BESIII给出世界上最严格的Λ超子电偶极矩直接限制
articles.abstract: The BESIII Collaboration, led by the Institute of High Energy Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, has achieved the world's most precise measurement of the electric dipole moment (EDM) of the Lambda (Λ) hyperon using quantum-entangled Λ–anti-Λ pairs produced in J/ψ decays. The result improves the experimental sensitivity by about three orders of magnitude compared with the previous measurement, providing a new way to probe charge-parity (CP) violation in particles containing strange quarks.
articles.abstract_zh: 中国科学院高能物理研究所牵头的BESIII合作组利用J/ψ衰变产生的量子纠缠Λ–反Λ对，对Λ超子的电偶极矩进行了迄今最精确的测量。该结果相比既有测量将实验灵敏度提高约三个数量级，为研究含奇异夸克粒子中的电荷-宇称（CP）破坏提供了新途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由中国科学院高能物理研究所牵头的BESIII合作组，利用J/ψ衰变中产生的量子纠缠Λ–反Λ对，实现了对Λ（Lambda）超子电偶极矩（EDM）的世界最高精度测量。与此前测量相比，该结果将实验灵敏度提高了约三个数量级，为探测含有奇异夸克的粒子中的电荷-宇称（CP）破坏提供了一种新方法。

articles.title_zh: 石墨烯实现偶极-偶极耦合的动态H-J切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Environmental modification of dipole interactions has long been explored in energy transport. Here we consider the effects of a tunable graphene monolayer upon nearly H-type or J-type molecular aggregates, concentrating on the inversion of one type of coupling to the other. Modelling the graphene as being deposited on a metallic substrate, we find that as the surface conductivity of the graphene is varied, there is a corresponding change in the parameter region over which coupling inversion is predicted. This provides a route towards observing the predicted coupling inversion in a real system by dynamically changing the surface conductivity during a single run of an experiment.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究可调石墨烯单层对近H型或J型分子聚集体中偶极相互作用的影响，重点关注两类耦合之间的反转。模型将石墨烯置于金属衬底上，发现改变石墨烯表面电导率会改变预测发生耦合反转的参数区域。这为在单次实验过程中动态调控表面电导率、从而观测耦合反转提供了途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在能量传输研究中，人们长期探索通过环境修饰来调控偶极相互作用。本文考察可调石墨烯单层对近H型或J型分子聚集体的影响，重点关注一种耦合类型向另一种耦合类型的反转。我们将石墨烯建模为沉积在金属衬底上，并发现随着石墨烯表面电导率的变化，预测会发生耦合反转的参数区域也相应改变。这提供了一条在真实体系中观测所预测耦合反转的途径，即在一次实验运行期间动态改变表面电导率。

articles.title: A Unified Description of Dirac-Cone Anisotropies in Two Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维体系中狄拉克锥各向异性的统一描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anisotropies in two-dimensional materials are responsible for a variety of effects that significantly modify their physical properties. In this paper, we present a covariant modification of the Dirac equation that incorporates anisotropies into the effective low-energy description around the Dirac point. The model is constructed by analogy with a Lorentz-violating extension of the Standard Model of elementary particles and yields a (2+1)-dimensional framework describing physical effects such as shifted, tilted, and distorted Dirac cones through its free parameters. The proposed model thus provides a general and unified framework in which distinct anisotropy-induced modifications of the Dirac spectrum and their combinations can be systematically characterized. We further apply the model to strained graphene and show that its effective parameters can be quantitatively extracted from first-principles electronic band structures while retaining a direct geometrical interpretation. These results establish a connection between the microscopic electronic structure and a material-independent effective description of anisotropic two-dimensional Dirac systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种协变修正的狄拉克方程，将各向异性纳入狄拉克点附近的低能有效描述。该模型借鉴标准模型洛伦兹破缺扩展，可统一描述狄拉克锥的位移、倾斜和畸变等效应。作者还将其应用于应变石墨烯，从第一性原理能带结构中定量提取有效参数，并建立微观电子结构与材料无关有效理论之间的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维材料中的各向异性会导致多种效应，并显著改变其物理性质。本文提出一种狄拉克方程的协变修正形式，用以将各向异性纳入狄拉克点附近的有效低能描述。该模型类比于基本粒子标准模型的洛伦兹破缺扩展而构建，并给出一个（2+1）维框架，可通过其自由参数描述诸如位移、倾斜和畸变的狄拉克锥等物理效应。因此，所提出的模型提供了一个一般且统一的框架，可在其中系统表征由各向异性引起的狄拉克谱不同修正及其组合。我们进一步将该模型应用于应变石墨烯，并表明其有效参数可从第一性原理电子能带结构中定量提取，同时保留直接的几何解释。这些结果在微观电子结构与各向异性二维狄拉克体系的材料无关有效描述之间建立了联系。

articles.title: Decoherence-controlled collective criticality in a two-dimensional quantum Stag Hunt
articles.title_zh: 二维量子猎鹿博弈中由退相干控制的集体临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physical decoherence can preserve the microscopic strategic neutrality condition of a quantum game while changing the thermodynamic regime of the corresponding interacting population. We demonstrate this for an Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein (EWL) Stag Hunt embedded as independent nearest neighbor encounters on a square lattice. For the restricted strategies mathsfQ=iZ and mathsfD=iY, noisy two-player payoff matrices are determined for phase damping, depolarization, and amplitude damping and mapped exactly to channel dependent Ising parameters mathfrakJ(Γ,p) and mathfrakH(Γ,p). Phase damping and depolarization show the clearest contrast: they share the same microscopic neutrality branch mathfrakH=0, while only depolarization suppresses the interaction as (1-p)². At β=1, this produces an exact depolarization-driven square-lattice critical point at p*approx 0.233460ldots, whereas phase damping remains in the ordered coexistence regime along the same neutrality branch. Monte Carlo finite size scaling is consistent with two-dimensional Ising criticality and distinguishes field driven coexistence below p* from a smooth crossover above it. Amplitude damping additionally reveals a strong dependence on channel placement: the post-strategy neutrality branch reaches Γ=0 at p=1/3 and then disappears. Resource negativity further shows that microscopic two-qubit entanglement and collective interaction strength are distinct quantities. The resulting extended lattice remains an ordinary classical Ising system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，物理退相干可以保持量子博弈的微观策略中性条件，同时改变相应相互作用群体的热力学状态。作者将EWL猎鹿博弈嵌入平方晶格最近邻相互作用，并把不同噪声信道下的收益矩阵精确映射到Ising参数。结果显示，退极化可驱动精确的二维平方晶格临界点，而相位阻尼沿同一中性分支仍保持有序共存；振幅阻尼还表现出对信道位置的强依赖。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理退相干可以保持量子博弈的微观策略中性条件，同时改变相应相互作用群体的热力学区域。我们针对一个Eisert--Wilkens--Lewenstein（EWL）猎鹿博弈证明了这一点，该博弈作为平方晶格上的独立最近邻遭遇而嵌入。对于受限策略mathsfQ=iZ和mathsfD=iY，我们确定了相位阻尼、退极化和振幅阻尼下的含噪双人收益矩阵，并将其精确映射到依赖信道的Ising参数mathfrakJ(Γ,p)和mathfrakH(Γ,p)。相位阻尼和退极化显示出最清晰的对比：它们共享相同的微观中性分支mathfrakH=0，而只有退极化会按(1-p)²抑制相互作用。在β=1时，这产生了一个由退极化驱动的精确平方晶格临界点p*约等于0.233460……，而相位阻尼沿同一中性分支仍处于有序共存区域。蒙特卡罗有限尺寸标度与二维Ising临界性一致，并区分了p*以下由场驱动的共存与p*以上的平滑交叉。振幅阻尼还揭示出对信道放置位置的强依赖：策略后中性分支在p=1/3时到达Γ=0，随后消失。资源负性进一步表明，微观双量子比特纠缠与集体相互作用强度是不同的量。所得扩展晶格仍然是一个普通的经典Ising系统。

articles.title: Valley polarization dependence of candidate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in monolayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 单层石墨烯中候选偶分母分数量子霍尔态的谷极化依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (EDFQH) states in monolayer graphene, focusing on the experimentally observed filling fractions ν = 1/2 and ν = 1/4. Owing to the approximate SU(4) symmetry arising from spin and valley degrees of freedom, graphene hosts a rich variety of multi-component fractional quantum Hall states with different polarization configurations. Using the Chern-Simons composite fermion framework for SU(4) systems, we construct candidate variational wave functions corresponding to distinct spin, valley, and mixed polarization states. The ground-state energies of these states are evaluated numerically using the Coulomb interaction in spherical geometry. By comparing energies across different polarization sectors, we identify the energetically favored configurations at ν = 1/2 and ν = 1/4. Our variational energy comparison suggests that the energetically favored candidate states correspond to multi-component correlated quantum Hall liquids. Within the restricted family of trial states considered here, these states differ from a simple composite-fermion Fermi-sea description. These findings provide insight into the role of valley polarization and SU(4) symmetry in stabilizing even-denominator fractional quantum Hall states in graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究单层石墨烯中实验观测到的ν=1/2和ν=1/4偶分母分数量子霍尔态，重点分析谷极化的作用。利用SU(4)体系的Chern-Simons复合费米子框架，他们构造不同自旋、谷和混合极化态的候选变分波函数，并在球几何中数值比较库仑能量。结果表明，在所考虑的试探态范围内，能量最有利的候选态是多分量关联量子霍尔液体，并不同于简单的复合费米子费米海图像。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究单层石墨烯中的偶分母分数量子霍尔（EDFQH）态，重点关注实验观测到的填充分数ν=1/2和ν=1/4。由于自旋和谷自由度产生近似SU(4)对称性，石墨烯能够承载具有不同极化构型的丰富多样的多分量分数量子霍尔态。利用SU(4)体系的Chern-Simons复合费米子框架，我们构造了对应于不同自旋、谷以及混合极化态的候选变分波函数。我们在球几何中使用库仑相互作用对这些态的基态能量进行数值评估。通过比较不同极化扇区中的能量，我们确定了ν=1/2和ν=1/4处能量上有利的构型。我们的变分能量比较表明，能量上有利的候选态对应于多分量关联量子霍尔液体。在本文所考虑的受限试探态族内，这些态不同于简单的复合费米子费米海描述。这些发现为理解谷极化和SU(4)对称性在稳定石墨烯偶分母分数量子霍尔态中的作用提供了见解。

articles.title: Microscopically exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model
articles.title_zh: 量子Calogero模型的微观精确输运方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive an exact transport equation for the quantum Calogero model, i.e. inverse-square interacting bosons on a line, from microscopic first principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从微观第一性原理出发，推导了量子Calogero模型的精确输运方程。该模型描述一维直线上具有反平方相互作用的玻色子。摘要较短，具体方程形式、推导步骤和适用条件需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从微观第一性原理出发，为量子Calogero模型，即一条直线上具有反平方相互作用的玻色子，推导出一个精确的输运方程。

articles.title: Interplay between Isomerization and Spin Crossover in 1D Fe-Indigo Coordination Polymers on Ag substrates
articles.title_zh: Ag衬底上一维Fe-靛蓝配位聚合物中异构化与自旋交叉的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-crossover (SCO) compounds offer a route to switchable molecular functionality in reduced dimensions. However, one-dimensional (1D) SCO chains, which offer the possibility to study ligand fields other than the paradigmatic octahedral field, remain comparatively little studied. Here, we use first-principles density functional theory (DFT+U) to investigate Fe-indigo coordination-polymer chains synthesized experimentally on Ag(111) and Ag(100) substrates. These display a rich interplay between changes in ligand field (isomerization) and spin crossover. On-surface isomerization on Ag(111) interconverts (N,O)-chelated trans configuration and (N,N)-/(O,O)-chelated cis configurations at the Fe centers. The lowest-energy trans and cis solutions on Ag(111) have different spin configurations over the interval 0.66 <3.00~eV. At the reference value U=1~eV, the preferred trans solution is the mixed LS--LS--HS configuration, whereas the preferred cis solution is LS--LS--LS. The experimentally observed preference for cis chains on Ag(111) and trans chains on Ag(100) is reproduced for the range 0.88 <3.75~eV. To interpret these results, toy models and spin-resolved Fe 3d projected densities of states are used, while freestanding-chain calculations reveal a strain-sensitive LS--HS competition. These results provide a microscopic explanation for isomerization-controlled spin-state switching in a 1D coordination polymer.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用第一性原理DFT+U研究了在Ag(111)和Ag(100)衬底上实验合成的Fe-靛蓝配位聚合物链。结果揭示配体场变化（异构化）与自旋交叉之间存在丰富耦合：Ag(111)表面上的异构化可在Fe中心的反式与顺式螯合构型间转换，并伴随不同自旋态偏好。作者还通过模型、Fe 3d投影态密度和自由链计算解释这些结果，为一维配位聚合物中由异构化控制的自旋态开关提供了微观说明。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋交叉（SCO）化合物为低维度中的可切换分子功能提供了一条途径。然而，一维（1D）SCO链可用于研究不同于典型八面体场的配体场，但目前相关研究仍相对较少。本文使用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT+U）研究了在Ag(111)和Ag(100)衬底上实验合成的Fe-靛蓝配位聚合物链。这些体系展现出配体场变化（异构化）与自旋交叉之间丰富的相互作用。在Ag(111)表面上的异构化会使Fe中心处的（N,O）螯合反式构型与（N,N）/（O,O）螯合顺式构型相互转化。在Ag(111)上能量最低的反式和顺式解在0.66<U<3.00 eV区间内具有不同的自旋构型。在参考值U=1 eV时，优选的反式解为混合LS--LS--HS构型，而优选的顺式解为LS--LS--LS构型。在0.88<U<3.75 eV范围内，计算再现了实验中观察到的Ag(111)上偏好顺式链而Ag(100)上偏好反式链的现象。为解释这些结果，作者使用了简化模型和自旋分辨的Fe 3d投影态密度，而自由链计算揭示了对形变敏感的LS--HS竞争。这些结果为一维配位聚合物中由异构化控制的自旋态切换提供了微观解释。

articles.title: Deterministic nanofabrication for engineering nanowire quantum dot devices
articles.title_zh: 用于工程化纳米线量子点器件的确定性纳米制造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are a leading platform for realising bright, wavelength-tunable sources of single and entangled photon pairs for photonic quantum technologies. Site-selected nanowire quantum dots (NWQDs) are a promising platform for fabricating such photonic devices in a scalable manner. However, implementing additional structures around the photonic nanowire while maintaining its vertical growth geometry has remained a challenge. In this work, we develop a deterministic pick-and-place technique to conduct a vertical-to-vertical transfer of NWQDs from the growth substrate to arbitrary templates. Using this transfer technique, we enhance the photon extraction efficiency to 75% by implementing a bottom gold mirror and tune the emission wavelength by 3.6 GHz via implementing electrostatic gates around the QD. Importantly, we measure low-multiphoton probability (g⁽²⁾(0) = 0.002) and high indistinguishability (>80% for +/-100 ps) of the QD emission after the transfer process, yielding high-quality devices. These results demonstrate the repeatability and versatility of the developed transfer technique, which is an enabling step towards scalable single and entangled photon sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体量子点是实现明亮、波长可调单光子和纠缠光子对源的重要平台，而位置选择性纳米线量子点有望实现可扩展光子器件。作者开发了一种确定性拾取-放置技术，可将纳米线量子点从生长衬底垂直到垂直转移至任意模板。借助底部金镜和静电栅，他们实现了75%的光子提取效率和3.6 GHz的发射波长调谐，同时保持低多光子概率和高不可区分性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半导体量子点（QDs）是实现明亮、波长可调的单光子和纠缠光子对光源的领先平台，可用于光子量子技术。位置选择性纳米线量子点（NWQDs）是以可扩展方式制造此类光子器件的有前景平台。然而，在保持光子纳米线垂直生长几何形状的同时，在其周围实现附加结构仍然是一项挑战。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种确定性的拾取-放置技术，用于将NWQDs从生长衬底以垂直到垂直的方式转移到任意模板。利用这种转移技术，我们通过实现底部金镜将光子提取效率提高到75%，并通过在量子点周围实现静电栅将发射波长调谐了3.6 GHz。重要的是，在转移过程之后，我们测得量子点发射具有低多光子概率（g⁽²⁾(0)=0.002）和高不可区分性（在+/-100 ps内>80%），从而获得高质量器件。这些结果展示了所开发转移技术的可重复性和通用性，是迈向可扩展单光子和纠缠光子源的关键一步。

articles.title: Grain boundary evolution in nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 纳米颗粒中的晶界演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundary evolution is a key dynamical process that enables structural rearrangements in nanoparticles and drives them towards low energy configurations. Grain boundaries can also enhance catalytic properties, making it important to understand the elementary processes underlying their evolution for grain boundary engineering in nanoparticles. Compared with bulk materials, nanoparticles have additional rotational and translational degrees of freedom, can accommodate structural changes through shape relaxation, and grain boundaries terminate at free surfaces. However, the atomic-scale mechanisms of GB evolution under these less constrained conditions remain comparatively less understood than in bulk materials. Here, using atomistic simulations, we focus on low energy Σ3 (coherent twin boundary) and Σ11 grain boundaries, which are among the persistent compact GB structures that emerge during nanoparticle structural evolution. We identify two fundamental atomic displacements, column shift (C) and screw shift (S), that recur during the evolution of these grain boundaries and their junctions. These displacements occur through different atomic pathways and combine in different ways to generate grain boundary migration, structural transformations, and junction evolution. In particular, the same initial and final grain boundary configurations can be connected through different atomic pathways, and a column shift can occur either as a full shift or through disconnection kinks. C and S remain identifiable even when the grain boundary character changes, for example during a Σ11 to Σ3 transformation. An understanding of these elementary GB processes can help identify strategies to control grain boundary evolution and thereby engineer GB structures in nanoparticles.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者通过原子模拟研究纳米颗粒中晶界演化的基本机制，重点关注结构演化中常见的低能Σ3相干孪晶界和Σ11晶界。研究识别出两类反复出现的基本原子位移：柱移（C）和螺旋移（S），它们通过不同路径组合产生晶界迁移、结构转变和结点演化。理解这些基本过程有助于控制纳米颗粒晶界演化并工程化设计晶界结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶界演化是一个关键的动力学过程，它使纳米颗粒中的结构重排成为可能，并驱动其趋向低能构型。晶界还可以增强催化性质，因此理解其演化背后的基本过程对于纳米颗粒中的晶界工程十分重要。与块体材料相比，纳米颗粒具有额外的转动和平动自由度，可以通过形状弛豫来容纳结构变化，并且晶界终止于自由表面。然而，在这些约束较少的条件下，晶界演化的原子尺度机制相较于块体材料仍了解较少。本文利用原子模拟，聚焦于低能Σ3（相干孪晶界）和Σ11晶界，它们是纳米颗粒结构演化过程中出现的持久紧凑晶界结构之一。我们识别出两种基本原子位移，即柱移（C）和螺旋移（S），它们在这些晶界及其结点的演化过程中反复出现。这些位移通过不同的原子路径发生，并以不同方式组合，从而产生晶界迁移、结构转变和结点演化。特别是，相同的初始和最终晶界构型可以通过不同的原子路径相连接，而柱移既可以作为完整位移发生，也可以通过位错台阶弯结发生。即使当晶界性质发生变化时，例如在Σ11到Σ3的转变过程中，C和S仍然可以被识别出来。对这些基本晶界过程的理解有助于确定控制晶界演化的策略，从而在纳米颗粒中工程化设计晶界结构。

articles.title: Polaron Self-Trapping Rates from First Principles
articles.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的极化子自陷速率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polaron formation, also known as self-trapping, is a process akin to nonradiative carrier capture at point defects or impurities. In this work, we develop the formalism to determine how long it takes to form a small hole or electron polaron from first principles. We employ an accurate, fully first-principles approach based on a Koopmans compliant hybrid functional. The self-trapping rate is the product of two components: the nonradiative capture coefficient, which we evaluate using a one-dimensional approximation, and the maximum density of polaron sites, whose physics we elucidate based on finite-size interactions present in supercells. We apply our methodology to several technologically relevant materials known to host hole polarons, Ga₂O₃, Al₂O₃, BeO, KBr, MgO, NaCl, SiO₂, SnO₂, TiO₂, and ZnO, and to an electron polaron in rutile TiO₂. We also study an emerging semiconductor, rutile GeO₂, where we find that polaron formation could hamper p-type conductivity. The calculated self-trapping lifetimes span 7 orders of magnitude, from 10⁻¹ to 10⁶~ps, in agreement with experiments where available, and providing detailed insight into the dynamics of carrier localization and relaxation in solids.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一套从第一性原理确定小空穴或电子极化子形成所需时间的形式体系。自陷速率被表示为非辐射俘获系数与最大极化子位点密度的乘积，前者用一维近似计算，后者通过超胞有限尺寸相互作用加以阐明。作者将方法应用于多种技术相关材料，计算得到的自陷寿命跨越7个数量级，并在可获得实验数据时与实验相符。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极化子形成，也称为自陷，是一种类似于点缺陷或杂质处非辐射载流子俘获的过程。在这项工作中，我们发展了用于从第一性原理确定形成小空穴或电子极化子需要多长时间的形式体系。我们采用一种精确的、完全第一性原理的方法，该方法基于符合Koopmans条件的杂化泛函。自陷速率是两个组成部分的乘积：非辐射俘获系数，我们使用一维近似对其进行评估；以及最大极化子位点密度，其物理含义我们基于超胞中存在的有限尺寸相互作用加以阐明。我们将该方法应用于若干已知承载空穴极化子的技术相关材料，包括Ga₂O₃、Al₂O₃、BeO、KBr、MgO、NaCl、SiO₂、SnO₂、TiO₂和ZnO，以及金红石TiO₂中的电子极化子。我们还研究了一种新兴半导体金红石GeO₂，在其中发现极化子形成可能会阻碍p型导电性。计算得到的自陷寿命跨越7个数量级，从10⁻¹到10⁶ ps；在有实验数据可用的情况下与实验一致，并为固体中载流子局域化和弛豫动力学提供了详细见解。

articles.title: Universal scaling of fluctuations and correlations across the superfluid transition
articles.title_zh: 超流相变中涨落与关联的普适标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03433v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The critical behavior of a system near a continuous phase transition is commonly characterized by power laws and a set of universal critical exponents. Yet universality at phase transitions has even more fundamental manifestations. It dictates that all observables follow universal scaling functions, which may extend beyond simple power laws. Furthermore, microscopic details are captured entirely by only two system-specific scale factors, that rescale any measured quantity onto its universal form. In this work, we report the experimental validation of this prediction in ultracold lattice Bose gases undergoing the superfluid transition. We extract the scale factors by collapsing the order-parameter cumulants measured at varying entropies. We show that these factors specify scaling functions governing both the order-parameter distribution and two-point correlations. By measuring these scaling functions, we also determine three critical exponents β, γ and ν. Our results provide an experimental demonstration that universal scaling is simultaneously obeyed by multiple observables in a quantum many-body system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在发生超流相变的超冷晶格玻色气体中实验验证了相变普适标度函数的预测。作者通过塌缩不同熵下测得的序参量累积量提取体系特定的两个尺度因子，并表明这些因子同时决定序参量分布和两点关联的标度函数。测量这些标度函数还使他们确定了β、γ和ν三个临界指数，展示了量子多体系统中多个观测量同时服从普适标度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 连续相变附近系统的临界行为通常由幂律和一组普适临界指数来表征。然而，相变中的普适性还有更为基本的表现形式。它规定所有可观测量都遵循普适标度函数，而这些函数可以超越简单的幂律。此外，微观细节完全由仅有的两个体系特定尺度因子捕获，这两个因子可将任何测量量重新标度到其普适形式。在这项工作中，我们报告了在经历超流相变的超冷晶格玻色气体中对这一预测的实验验证。我们通过塌缩在不同熵下测量的序参量累积量来提取这些尺度因子。我们表明，这些因子规定了同时支配序参量分布和两点关联的标度函数。通过测量这些标度函数，我们还确定了三个临界指数β、γ和ν。我们的结果实验证明，在量子多体系统中，多个可观测量同时遵守普适标度。

articles.title: Studying line defect at Deconfined Quantum Criticality via fuzzy sphere regularization
articles.title_zh: 通过模糊球正则化研究去禁闭量子临界中的线缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between bulk critical fluctuations and nontrivial topology can enrich defect physics and give rise to novel defect universality classes. Understanding the fate of such defects therefore constitutes an important open problem. In this work, we studied a particularly simple setting: a (0+1)-dimensional pinning-field defect coupled to a (2+1)-dimensional deconfined quantum critical bulk. Using the fuzzy-sphere regularization, we numerically investigated the defect operator spectrum and extracted several universal quantities characterizing the defect conformal fixed point, including the scaling dimensions of defect-changing(creating) operators and the defect (g)-function. These results establish the first numerical characterization of line-defect conformal data at deconfined quantum criticality and may stimulate further investigations of defect critical phenomena in topological quantum critical matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 体相临界涨落与非平凡拓扑的相互作用会丰富缺陷物理，并可能产生新的缺陷普适类。本文研究了一个简单而具体的情形：一个与二维加一维去禁闭量子临界体相耦合的零维钉扎场缺陷。作者使用模糊球正则化数值研究了缺陷算符谱，并提取了若干表征缺陷共形固定点的 सार्व用量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 体相临界涨落与非平凡拓扑的相互作用会丰富缺陷物理，并可能产生新的缺陷普适类。因此，理解这类缺陷的命运是一个重要的开放问题。在这项工作中，我们研究了一个特别简单的设定：一个与（2+1）维去禁闭量子临界体相耦合的（0+1）维钉扎场缺陷。利用模糊球正则化，我们数值研究了缺陷算符谱，并提取了若干表征缺陷共形固定点的普适量，包括缺陷变换（生成）算符的标度维数以及缺陷（g）函数。这些结果建立了去禁闭量子临界中线缺陷共形数据的首次数值表征，并可能激发对拓扑量子临界物质中缺陷临界现象的进一步研究。

articles.title: Competing lattice structures induced by Sn substitution in CsV₃Sb₅
articles.title_zh: Sn 替位诱导的 CsV₃Sb₅ 中竞争晶格结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the effect of chemical substitution on competing phases of kagome metals is crucial for disentangling the interplay between local structural distortions and electronic instabilities. In cvs, Sn substitution strongly modifies the electronic phase diagram, yet the microscopic mechanism driving this remains unclear. Here, we combine ¹²¹Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements and density functional theory calculations to investigate the atomic-scale effects of Sn substitution in CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ. At low Sn concentrations, the observed satellite NQR peaks exhibit signatures of local structural distortion induced by Sn substitution, qualitatively consistent with our computational analysis. These impurity-induced features persist across the entire experimentally investigated doping range, up to x = 0.65, and remain observable up to room temperature. For x=1, the fully doped idealized case, the estimated dynamical instabilities of the kagome lattice suggest the stabilization of two nearly energy-degenerate equilibrium structures characterized by V-trimers, distinguished by a zero- or π-phase shift between adjacent layers along the c-axis. Together, these results show that Sn substitution drives a complex interplay between local impurity-induced distortions and competing structural instabilities in vanadium-based kagome compounds.
articles.abstract_zh: Sn 替位会显著改变 kagome 金属的电子相图，但其微观机制仍不清楚。作者结合 ¹²¹Sb 核四极共振与密度泛函理论，研究了 CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ 中 Sn 替位对原子尺度结构的影响。结果表明，低掺杂下存在由杂质诱导的局域结构畸变，而在更高掺杂乃至理想化满掺杂极限下，还会出现彼此竞争的近简并平衡结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解化学替位对 kagome 金属竞争相的影响，对于厘清局域结构畸变与电子不稳定性之间的相互作用至关重要。在 CsV₃Sb₅ 中，Sn 替位会强烈改变电子相图，但驱动这一变化的微观机制仍不明确。本文结合 ¹²¹Sb 核四极共振（NQR）测量与密度泛函理论计算，研究了 CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ 中 Sn 替位在原子尺度上的影响。在低 Sn 浓度下，观测到的卫星 NQR 峰表现出由 Sn 替位诱导的局域结构畸变特征，并与我们的计算分析在定性上相一致。这些由杂质诱导的特征在整个实验研究的掺杂范围内都持续存在，最高可达 x = 0.65，并且在室温下仍可观测到。对于 x = 1 的完全掺杂理想化情形，估算得到的 kagome 晶格动力学不稳定性表明，体系可稳定两种能量几乎简并的平衡结构，它们都以 V 三聚体为特征，但沿 c 轴相邻层之间分别具有零相位移或 π 相位移。综合来看，这些结果表明，Sn 替位在钒基 kagome 化合物中驱动了局域杂质诱导畸变与竞争结构不稳定性之间的复杂相互作用。

articles.title: Electron-phonon coupled hydrodynamics in semimetal TaAs₂
articles.title_zh: 半金属 TaAs₂ 中电子-声子耦合流体力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrodynamic corrections to diffusive transport can arise when momentum-conserving collisions between quasiparticles become prominent, and they have been documented for both electrons and phonons. An emerging frontier topic is coupled electron-phonon (e-ph) hydrodynamics. Here, through electrical and thermal transport measurements on TaAs2 crystals with different impurity levels, we document the emergence of an e-ph bifluid in the temperature window of 5 to 15 K. Within this range, the lattice thermal conductivity exhibits a faster-than-T³ temperature dependence, as a consequence of non-monotonic and purity-dependent phonon mean free paths, a signature of phonon Poiseuille flow. However, strong e-ph coupling impedes the emergence of a ballistic regime. This is corroborated by the observation of quantum oscillations in the lattice thermal conductivity. Prominent phonon-mediated momentum exchange between electrons amplifies the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law and yields a two-order-of-magnitude discrepancy between quantum and transport lifetimes, a signature of electron hydrodynamics in semimetals. Our results imply that in semimetals with optimized e-ph coupling, thanks to matching between the cryogenic phonon wave?length and the Fermi wavelength, momentum and energy flow between the electron and phonon reservoirs as frequently as within each reservoir.
articles.abstract_zh: 当准粒子之间的动量守恒碰撞变得显著时，扩散输运会出现流体力学修正，这一现象已在电子和声子体系中分别被观察到。更前沿的课题是耦合的电子-声子流体力学。作者通过对不同杂质水平 TaAs₂ 晶体的电学与热输运测量，观测到 5 到 15 K 温区内电子-声子双流体的出现，并发现晶格热导呈现快于 T³ 的温度依赖，体现了声子 Poiseuille 流。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当准粒子之间的动量守恒碰撞变得显著时，扩散输运中会出现流体力学修正，这一点已分别在电子和声子体系中得到报道。一个正在兴起的前沿主题是耦合的电子-声子（e-ph）流体力学。本文通过对不同杂质水平的 TaAs₂ 晶体进行电输运与热输运测量，记录了在 5 到 15 K 的温区内电子-声子双流体的出现。在这一范围内，晶格热导率呈现快于 T³ 的温度依赖，这是非单调且依赖纯度的声子平均自由程所导致的结果，也是声子 Poiseuille 流的特征信号。然而，强电子-声子耦合阻碍了弹道输运区的形成。晶格热导中的量子振荡观测进一步佐证了这一点。显著的声子介导的电子间动量交换放大了 Wiedemann-Franz 定律的偏离，并导致量子寿命与输运寿命之间相差两个数量级，这是半金属中电子流体力学的特征。我们的结果表明，在具有优化电子-声子耦合的半金属中，由于低温声子波长与费米波长相匹配，动量和能量在电子与声子库之间的流动频率可与各自库内的流动频率相当。

articles.title: Non-Resonant Impulsively Stimulated Raman Scattering by a Terahertz Field: a Case Study of 1T-TaS2
articles.title_zh: 太赫兹场驱动的非共振脉冲激发拉曼散射：以 1T-TaS2 为例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-domain ultrafast and nonlinear terahertz spectroscopy techniques are recently applied to many condensed matter systems for investigating their collective excitations. In centrosymmetric systems, these collective modes are typically Raman-active and therefore do not couple directly to the terahertz electric field. The mechanism by which light-matter interaction realizes in these studies has not been explicitly discussed in detail. In this work, we perform terahertz pump - optical probe and terahertz third harmonic generation investigations on 1T-TaS2, a material exhibiting a rich charge-density-wave (CDW) phase diagram including the commensurate, nearly-commensurate and incommensurate CDW phases. The transition between these distinct states leaves a clear signature on the dynamical Raman response. We investigate how the Raman-active phonons couple to a broadband monocycle terahertz field as well as a narrowband multicycle terahertz field. Our results indicate that a modified impulsively stimulated Raman scattering mechanism involving two-photon absorption, also known as non-resonant Raman scattering, underlies the coherent excitation and observation of the lattice modes. These results are relevant for future spectroscopy investigation and coherent control of collective modes using low-energy terahertz field as well as cavity electrodynamical dressing of solids.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，时域超快与非线性太赫兹光谱被用于研究多种凝聚态体系中的集体激发。在中心对称体系中，这些模通常具有拉曼活性，因此不会直接与太赫兹电场耦合。本文以具有丰富电荷密度波相图的 1T-TaS2 为对象，通过太赫兹泵浦-光学探测和太赫兹三次谐波实验研究其拉曼活性声子的激发机制。结果表明，所见相干晶格模的激发来自一种包含双光子吸收的改进型脉冲激发拉曼散射，即非共振拉曼散射机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，时域超快与非线性太赫兹光谱技术已被应用于多种凝聚态体系，以研究其中的集体激发。在中心对称体系中，这些集体模通常具有拉曼活性，因此不会直接与太赫兹电场耦合。然而，在这些研究中光与物质相互作用如何实现，尚未被明确详细讨论。本文以 1T-TaS₂ 为研究对象，开展了太赫兹泵浦-光学探测和太赫兹三次谐波产生研究。该材料具有丰富的电荷密度波（CDW）相图，包括整合、近整合和非整合 CDW 相。这些不同状态之间的转变会在动力学拉曼响应中留下清晰特征。我们研究了拉曼活性声子如何耦合到宽带单周期太赫兹场以及窄带多周期太赫兹场。结果表明，相干激发并观测这些晶格模的机制，是一种经过修正的脉冲激发拉曼散射机制，其中涉及双光子吸收，也称为非共振拉曼散射。这些结果对未来利用低能太赫兹场开展集体模光谱研究与相干操控，以及固体的腔量子电动力学调控，都具有相关意义。

articles.title: Near-surface colloidal dynamics in jammed and slipping microgel suspensions
articles.title_zh: 凝胶团簇悬浮液中近表面胶体动力学：堵塞与滑移状态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Jammed suspensions of soft microgel particles may exhibit slippage along smooth boundaries. Owing to their expected sub-micrometric dimensions, direct observations of dynamics within the near-surface layers supposed to be responsible for this slippage have been difficult to achieve. Here, we use total internal reflection fluorescence microscopy (TIRFM) to observe nanoparticle dynamics near glass/microgel-suspension interfaces. Indicating near-wall dynamic heterogeneity, velocity profiles for suspensions are nonlinear. These profiles tend to a constant slippage velocity at submicrometric distances from the wall, consistent with macroscopic wall slip measurements. Furthermore, nanoscale particle altitude distributions are strongly dependent on the slip velocity, revealing a dynamically-mediated and nanoscale particle-organisation effect. The collected observations give support for the existence of near-wall heterogeneity as a dominant mechanism contributing to microgel wall slip. Our work also opens new perspectives for the study of particle dynamics and organisation in complex interfacial environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 软微凝胶颗粒的堵塞悬浮液在光滑边界上可能出现滑移，但近表面层的直接观测一直较困难。作者利用全内反射荧光显微镜观察了玻璃/微凝胶悬浮液界面附近的纳米颗粒动力学，发现近壁速度剖面具有非线性，并在亚微米距离处趋于恒定滑移速度。结果还显示，纳米尺度颗粒高度分布与滑移速度强相关，支持近壁异质性是微凝胶壁面滑移的主导机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 软微凝胶颗粒的堵塞悬浮液在光滑边界上可能表现出滑移。由于负责这种滑移的近表面层预计只有亚微米尺度，直接观察其中的动力学一直十分困难。在这里，我们使用全内反射荧光显微镜（TIRFM）观察玻璃/微凝胶悬浮液界面附近的纳米颗粒动力学。悬浮液的速度剖面呈非线性，表明近壁存在动力学异质性。这些速度剖面在距壁面亚微米的距离处趋于恒定的滑移速度，与宏观壁面滑移测量一致。此外，纳米尺度颗粒的高度分布强烈依赖于滑移速度，揭示出一种由动力学介导的、纳米尺度的颗粒组织效应。所收集到的观测结果支持这样一种观点：近壁异质性是导致微凝胶壁面滑移的主导机制。我们的工作也为研究复杂界面环境中的颗粒动力学与组织方式提供了新的视角。

articles.title: Charge Regulated conformational properties of polyelectrolyte near an oppositely charged nanoparticle
articles.title_zh: 带电调控下聚电解质靠近异号带电纳米颗粒时的构象性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03587v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Customizing the surface characteristics and stimuli-responsive behavior of nanoparticles with polyelectrolytes ushers in a new era across many aspects of our lives, ranging from advanced diagnostics to practical applications. Here, using hybrid CR Monte Carlo/ molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate how charge regulation can play a crucial role in shaping the adsorption dynamics of polyelectrolyte (PE) on oppositely charged nanoparticle (NP). We systematically investigate the influence of salt density, and polymer chain length on the PE-NP interaction. To complement CR results, we also perform molecular simulations under constant charge conditions. At high salt concentrations, CR enhances the adsorption of PE onto the NP surface, leading to a rapid decrease in the radius of gyration of PE; conversely, CC promotes the extended conformation of PE. No clear effect of PE length is observed at either low or high salt concentrations, whereas in CC simulations, the PE relaxes faster on the NP in the case of short chains. Furthermore, By comparing these results, we demonstrate that the MSD of PE follows a more direct path during adsorption implying a ballistic motion, whereas in the CC case, it exhibits subdiffusive behavior and delayed adsorption in both low and high salt density. Our findings indicates that 'tunable CR' is a robust strategy for controlling nanoparticle stability and interaction within a complex biochemical cues.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者采用杂化的电荷调控蒙特卡罗/分子动力学模拟，研究了聚电解质在异号带电纳米颗粒附近的吸附动力学。结果表明，电荷调控在塑造聚电解质-纳米颗粒相互作用中起关键作用，且盐浓度会显著影响吸附过程。在高盐条件下，电荷调控促进聚电解质快速吸附并使其回转半径迅速减小；而恒定电荷条件则更倾向于使聚电解质保持伸展构象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用聚电解质定制纳米颗粒的表面特性和刺激响应行为，正为从先进诊断到实际应用的许多领域带来新机遇。在这里，我们采用杂化的电荷调控（CR）蒙特卡罗/分子动力学模拟，研究电荷调控在塑造聚电解质（PE）于异号带电纳米颗粒（NP）上的吸附动力学中的关键作用。我们系统考察了盐浓度与聚合物链长对 PE-NP 相互作用的影响。为补充 CR 结果，我们还在恒电荷条件下进行了分子模拟。在高盐浓度下，CR 会增强 PE 向 NP 表面的吸附，导致 PE 的回转半径快速减小；相反，恒电荷（CC）会促使 PE 采取更伸展的构象。在低盐和高盐条件下，都未观察到 PE 链长的明显影响，而在 CC 模拟中，短链情况下 PE 在 NP 上的松弛更快。进一步比较这些结果可以看出，在吸附过程中，PE 的均方位移沿着一条更直接的路径演化，表明其具有弹道式运动；而在 CC 情况下，无论低盐还是高盐浓度，它都表现出次扩散行为和延迟吸附。我们的发现表明，可调电荷调控是一种稳健策略，可用于在复杂生化环境线索中控制纳米颗粒的稳定性与相互作用。

articles.title: Patterned Substrates Unlock Self-Electrophoretic Phenomenon in Active Janus Microswimmers
articles.title_zh: 图案化基底揭示活性Janus微游动器中的自电泳现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inert colloids half-coated with platinum (Pt) are a standard model of chemically powered active particles, yet the microscopic origins of their propulsion in hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) remain difficult to dissect experimentally. Whereas self-diffusiophoresis was the prevailing theory, self-electrophoresis has been more recently suggested as the main mechanism of propulsion. According to the latter mechanism, the pole-to-equator Pt-thickness gradient produced by directional metal deposition is sufficient to create anodic and cathodic regions on the metal cap and thereby generate an electric field sustained by H2O2 decomposition. Enhancing self-propulsion performance of such particles thus requires precise control over the Pt thickness distribution, which is currently not achievable with standard methods (e.g. evaporation or sputtering). Here, we propose a method to fabricate Janus active particles by assembling silica microspheres on patterned substrates containing spherical grooves whose depth and spacing set the degree of particle coating while simultaneously suppressing proximity-led defects (Pt bridges). The resulting particles exhibit a tunable platinum-thickness contrast, as verified by Focused-Ion-Beam cross-sections. In 2.5% H2O2, our results suggest that this control can significantly increase propulsion efficiency, while providing evidence indirectly supporting the hypothesis that self-electrophoresis is the dominant mechanism. These results demonstrate that our patterned-substrate route can enhance control over the catalyst deposition and enable novel Janus morphologies, allowing for more precise engineering of active colloids.
articles.abstract_zh: 半覆铂二氧化硅胶体是化学驱动活性粒子的标准模型，但其在过氧化氢中的推进机制仍存在争议。本文利用带有球形凹槽的图案化基底制备Janus活性颗粒，实现对铂层厚度分布和覆盖程度的调控，并抑制铂桥等缺陷。实验表明，这种厚度对比度控制能够提高推进效率，并间接支持自电泳是主要推进机制的观点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半覆铂（Pt）的惰性胶体是化学驱动活性粒子的标准模型，但其在过氧化氢（H₂O₂）中的推进机制的微观起源仍难以通过实验加以解析。尽管自扩散泳曾是主流理论，但近来有研究提出，自电泳可能是推进的主要机制。根据这一机制，由定向金属沉积产生的从极点到赤道的铂厚度梯度，足以在金属帽上形成阳极区和阴极区，并由H₂O₂分解产生的电场维持推进。因此，要提高这类颗粒的自推进性能，就需要精确控制铂厚度的分布，而标准方法（例如蒸发或溅射）目前无法实现这一点。在本文中，我们提出了一种制备Janus活性颗粒的方法：将二氧化硅微球组装在图案化基底上，该基底包含球形凹槽，其深度和间距决定颗粒的覆盖程度，同时抑制由邻近效应引起的缺陷（铂桥）。所得颗粒表现出可调控的铂厚度对比度，这一点通过聚焦离子束截面分析得到了验证。在2.5%的H₂O₂中，我们的结果表明，这种控制能够显著提高推进效率，同时提供间接证据支持自电泳是主导机制的假设。这些结果表明，图案化基底路线能够增强对催化剂沉积的控制，并实现新型Janus形貌，从而更精确地设计活性胶体。

articles.title: Frenkel line of Yukawa fluids within the self-consistent relaxation theory
articles.title_zh: 自洽弛豫理论框架下Yukawa流体的Frenkel线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For a simple model fluid, the Yukawa fluid, the condition for dynamic crossover, known as the Frenkel line, is defined. The condition is related to the fact that the roton minimum in the dispersion relation of longitudinal acoustic-like excitations exists only when the collective vibrational dynamics of particles dominates in the liquid. Based on the self-consistent relaxation theory for the Yukawa fluid, thermodynamic states are determined in which the roton minimum disappears. The obtained values of the state parameters for the Frenkel line are consistent with the results of studies in which the position of this line on the phase diagram of the Yukawa fluid was determined using molecular dynamics simulations. It is shown that the Frenkel line in this system can be determined directly from the structural characteristic -- the static structure factor. A physical interpretation of the roton minimum frequency for the simple liquids near the Frenkel line is proposed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了简单模型流体Yukawa流体中的动力学交叉条件，即Frenkel线。该条件与纵向类声激发色散关系中的旋子最低点有关，后者仅在粒子集体振动动力学占主导时存在。基于自洽弛豫理论，作者确定了旋子最低点消失的热力学状态，并表明Frenkel线还可由静态结构因子直接确定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于一种简单模型流体，即Yukawa流体，本文定义了被称为Frenkel线的动力学交叉条件。该条件与这样一个事实有关：纵向类声激发的色散关系中只有在粒子的集体振动动力学占据主导地位时才存在旋子最低点。基于Yukawa流体的自洽弛豫理论，本文确定了旋子最低点消失时所对应的热力学状态。所得Frenkel线状态参数与分子动力学模拟研究的结果一致，后者曾用于确定Yukawa流体相图中该线的位置。研究表明，在这一体系中，可以直接根据结构特征，即静态结构因子，确定Frenkel线。本文还对Frenkel线附近简单液体中的旋子最低点频率提出了物理解释。

articles.title: Low-Frequency Charge Noise in Bilayer Graphene Quantum Dots
articles.title_zh: 双层石墨烯量子点中的低频电荷噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03650v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bilayer graphene (BLG) quantum dots (QDs) are a promising platform for semiconductor qubits. However, the low-frequency charge noise that may ultimately limit coherence has remained largely unexplored. Here, we systematically characterize charge noise in gate-defined BLG QDs using transport-based noise spectroscopy. We extract a median amplitude of  S_μ¹/² (1~Hz) = 1.16~mueV/sqrtHz, placing BLG well within the range reported for established semiconductor quantum-dot platforms. Across variations in charge occupation, confinement, source-drain bias, and charge-sensor operating conditions, neither the noise amplitude nor the spectral dependence shows a reproducible trend in electrostatic tuning, indicating that we extracted the intrinsic semiconductor noise. Consistent noise levels are further observed in double QDs and confirmed using an independent superconducting resonator-based dispersive readout. Extending the study to BLG devices incorporating transition metal dichalcogenide layers reveals no measurable charge noise increase in weakly proximitized QDs. These results validate BLG as a viable platform for coherent quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统表征了栅极定义双层石墨烯量子点中的低频电荷噪声，并测得其中位噪声幅度为S_μ¹/²(1 Hz)=1.16 μeV/√Hz，处于成熟半导体量子点平台的已报道范围内。改变电荷占据数、约束条件、源漏偏压和电荷传感器工作条件后，噪声幅度及谱依赖性均未呈现可重复的静电调控趋势，表明所测噪声主要源于半导体本征特性。双量子点、独立的超导谐振器色散读出以及弱近邻耦合器件中的结果进一步验证了双层石墨烯用于相干量子信息处理的可行性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双层石墨烯（BLG）量子点（QDs）是半导体量子比特的一个有前景平台。然而，可能最终限制相干性的低频电荷噪声一直未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们利用基于输运的噪声谱学，系统表征了栅极定义的BLG量子点中的电荷噪声。我们提取出的中位噪声幅度为S_μ¹/²（1 Hz）=1.16 μeV/√Hz，这使BLG处于已有半导体量子点平台所报道的范围之内。在改变电荷占据数、约束条件、源漏偏压以及电荷传感器工作条件时，噪声幅度和谱依赖性均未显示出可重复的静电调控趋势，这表明我们提取到的是半导体本征噪声。在双量子点中也观察到一致的噪声水平，并通过独立的基于超导谐振器的色散读出得到确认。进一步研究包含过渡金属二硫族化物层的BLG器件发现，在弱近邻耦合的量子点中，电荷噪声没有可测量的增加。这些结果验证了BLG作为相干量子信息处理可行平台的潜力。

articles.title: Finite-temperature mass gap and quench dynamics of mobile impurities in a Fermi gas
articles.title_zh: 费米气体中可移动杂质的有限温度质量隙与淬火动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03656v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently, a mass-gap description of mobile impurities in a Fermi gas was introduced, which connects Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe for static impurities to the quasiparticle picture of Fermi polarons through a recoil-induced energy gap in the fermionic dispersion. That description, however, was restricted to zero temperature and did not address dynamics. Here we generalize the mass-gap model to finite temperature by combining the Lee--Low--Pines transformation with a self-consistent Hartree--Fock decoupling of the recoil-induced interaction, and we study the quench dynamics within this framework using the functional-determinant approach. At finite temperature the effective mass gap obeys the self-consistency equation Δ(T)=2U_Ftanh[Δ(T)/4k_B T], with U_F=k_F²/2M and M the impurity mass. This equation admits a nonzero solution below the characteristic temperature T^*=U_F/(2k_B) and closes as (T^*-T)¹/². We identify this closing as the mean-field signature of the thermal melting of the polaron and molecule quasiparticles. Computing the Ramsey response S(t) after a sudden quench of the impurity--fermion interaction, we find that its long-time oscillations---quantum beats between the bound and in-gap states---disappear precisely above T^*. Our work ties the thermodynamic and dynamical fingerprints of polaron formation to a single temperature-dependent mean-field parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将描述费米气体中可移动杂质的质量隙模型推广到有限温度，并研究其淬火动力学。通过Lee–Low–Pines变换和自洽Hartree–Fock解耦，作者得到温度依赖的有效质量隙方程，并发现质量隙在特征温度T*=U_F/(2k_B)以上消失。Ramsey响应表明，束缚态与隙内态之间的长时间量子拍振荡也在该温度以上消失，揭示了极化子和分子准粒子热熔化的动力学特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期提出了一种用于描述费米气体中可移动杂质的质量隙模型，该模型通过费米子色散中的反冲诱导能隙，将Anderson静态杂质正交灾变与费米极化子准粒子图像联系起来。然而，这一描述仅限于零温度，且没有涉及动力学问题。在本文中，我们结合Lee–Low–Pines变换与反冲诱导相互作用的自洽Hartree–Fock解耦，将质量隙模型推广到有限温度，并在这一框架内利用泛函行列式方法研究淬火动力学。在有限温度下，有效质量隙满足自洽方程Δ(T)=2U_F tanh[Δ(T)/(4k_B T)]，其中U_F=k_F²/(2M)，M为杂质质量。该方程在特征温度T*=U_F/(2k_B)以下存在非零解，并且质量隙按照（T*−T）¹/²的规律闭合。我们将这一闭合认定为极化子和分子准粒子热熔化的平均场特征。通过计算杂质—费米子相互作用突然淬火后的Ramsey响应S(t)，我们发现，其长时间振荡，即束缚态与隙内态之间的量子拍，在T*以上恰好消失。本文将极化子形成的热力学和动力学指纹与一个统一的温度依赖平均场参数联系起来。

articles.title: Multimodal and Multiscale Interrogation of a Mechanically Tough Glass Forming Copper-Based Metal-Organic Framework
articles.title_zh: 机械韧性玻璃形成铜基金属有机框架的多模态多尺度表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A copper-based metal-organic framework, Cu(Im)2, was synthesized using a sol-gel process and subsequently melt-quenched into glass upon heating above 240 degC. In this paper, we present a multimodal, multiscale interrogation of the MOF nanocrystals and the resulting glasses. Structural characterization using X-ray diffraction, atomic force microscopy, and electron microscopy was performed to understand the morphology and size of the synthesized nanocrystals and glasses. Thermogravimetric analysis and differential scanning calorimetry were employed to understand the melting process of the crystals to form the glass. Synchrotron pair distribution function analysis was performed to verify that the framework structure is maintained upon melting, and nearfield infrared nanospectroscopy provided insight into the local chemical structure of the materials. The mechanical characterization via nanoindentation revealed that the resulting glasses exhibit an appreciably high elastic modulus (~10 GPa) and the highest fracture toughness (K₁c ~ 0.5 MPa m¹/2) yet reported for MOF glasses. This development is central to the emerging field of MOF-based materials processing and shaping, while upholding mechanical robustness and resistance to cracking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用溶胶–凝胶工艺合成铜基金属有机框架Cu(Im)₂，并在高于240°C时加热熔融淬冷形成玻璃。研究结合X射线衍射、原子力显微镜、电子显微镜、热分析、同步辐射对分布函数分析和近场红外纳米光谱，对纳米晶及玻璃进行了多模态、多尺度表征。纳米压痕结果显示，所得玻璃具有约10 GPa的较高弹性模量和约0.5 MPa·m¹/²的断裂韧度，后者为目前MOF玻璃中报道的最高值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一种铜基金属有机框架Cu(Im)₂通过溶胶–凝胶工艺合成，随后在高于240°C的温度下加热并熔融淬冷形成玻璃。在本文中，我们对MOF纳米晶及所得玻璃开展了多模态、多尺度表征。我们利用X射线衍射、原子力显微镜和电子显微镜进行结构表征，以了解所合成纳米晶和玻璃的形貌与尺寸。通过热重分析和差示扫描量热法，研究晶体熔融形成玻璃的过程。同步辐射对分布函数分析用于验证框架结构在熔融过程中得以保持，近场红外纳米光谱则揭示了材料的局域化学结构。纳米压痕机械表征显示，所得玻璃具有相当高的弹性模量（约10 GPa）以及迄今MOF玻璃中报道的最高断裂韧度（K₁c约为0.5 MPa·m¹/²）。这一进展对于新兴的基于MOF的材料加工与成形领域具有重要意义，同时保持了材料的机械稳健性和抗开裂能力。

articles.title: Real-space Floquet topology written by the orbital angular momentum of light
articles.title_zh: 由光的轨道角动量写入实空间Floquet拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Floquet engineering usually treats light as a uniform control field that changes the topology of an entire driven material. Here we show that structured light carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) enables a different regime, in which topology is written directly in real space. For ultrathin topological insulator films, circularly polarized Laguerre--Gaussian beams generate a radial Floquet mass whose sign changes define a topological annulus bounded by two concentric chiral ring modes. The transition is helicity selective: below a thickness-dependent critical frequency, left-circularly polarized light drives mass inversion, whereas right-circularly polarized light increases the gap and leaves the film trivial. Independently, the OAM quantum number shifts and reshapes the annulus without changing the frequency, intensity, or helicity. In the decoupled-surfaces limit, the same mechanism produces a purely Floquet-induced topological mass and a vortex-core zero mode. These results identify photon OAM as a control parameter for nonequilibrium topology and provide a route to programmable topological landscapes in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: Floquet工程通常将光视为改变整个受驱材料拓扑性质的均匀控制场，而本文展示了携带轨道角动量的结构光能够将拓扑直接写入实空间。在超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜中，圆偏振Laguerre–Gaussian光束产生径向Floquet质量，其符号变化界定出由两个同心手性环模包围的拓扑环带。光的螺旋性决定质量反转，轨道角动量量子数则可在不改变频率、强度和螺旋性的情况下移动并重塑环带，为可编程拓扑景观提供了途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Floquet工程通常将光视为一种均匀控制场，用于改变整个受驱材料的拓扑性质。在本文中，我们表明，携带轨道角动量（OAM）的结构光能够实现一种不同的机制，即将拓扑直接写入实空间。对于超薄拓扑绝缘体薄膜，圆偏振Laguerre–Gaussian光束会产生径向Floquet质量，其符号变化定义出一个拓扑环带，该环带由两个同心的手性环模界定。该转变具有螺旋性选择性：在低于与厚度有关的临界频率时，左旋圆偏振光驱动质量反转，而右旋圆偏振光增大能隙并使薄膜保持平庸拓扑。另一方面，OAM量子数能够在不改变频率、强度或螺旋性的情况下移动并重塑环带。在表面解耦极限下，同一机制还会产生纯粹由Floquet诱导的拓扑质量以及涡旋核心零模。这些结果表明，光子OAM可以作为控制非平衡拓扑的参数，并为量子材料中的可编程拓扑景观提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Ion-Engineered Insulator-to-Semiconductor Transition in Natural 2D Biotite
articles.title_zh: 离子工程诱导天然二维黑云母中的绝缘体–半导体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03757v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Naturally occurring layered silicates offer an abundant yet unexplored class of 2D materials, but their insulating nature limits their functional utility. Here, we demonstrate a chemical strategy that transforms liquid-phase-exfoliated biotite nanosheets into a tunable 2D semiconductor through controlled NaOH treatment. The resulting insulator-to-semiconductor transition originates from Na incorporation, defect generation, and local structural reconstruction while largely preserving the layered framework. Structural and chemical analyses reveal lattice distortion, interlayer reorganization, hydroxylation, and partial Na+-K+ exchange, establishing the origin of the electronic restructuring. This transformation broadens the optical response, shifting the approximately 221 nm absorption toward approximately 280 and 975 nm, reducing the optical bandgap from approximately 5.2 to 3.2-3.5 eV, and introducing low-energy transitions at approximately 1.12-1.17 eV. Electrical measurements reveal nonlinear transport with currents reaching close to 10 microA, demonstrating activated carrier conduction. Ultrafast transient absorption reveals pronounced excited-state absorption, with carrier cooling (0.16-0.38 ps) followed by fast (35-60 ps) and long-lived (336-491 ps) relaxation associated with trap-mediated recombination. Fluence-dependent dynamics reveal a hot-phonon bottleneck at elevated carrier densities. Together with density functional theory calculations, these results establish chemical defect and ion engineering as a powerful route for converting naturally abundant layered minerals into electronically tunable 2D materials for emerging optoelectronic and ultrafast photonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种化学策略，通过可控NaOH处理将液相剥离的黑云母纳米片转变为可调控的二维半导体。该绝缘体–半导体转变源于Na引入、缺陷生成和局域结构重构，同时层状骨架基本保持不变。处理后光学带隙由约5.2 eV降至3.2–3.5 eV，并出现约1.12–1.17 eV的低能跃迁；电学和超快瞬态吸收测量进一步显示出激活载流子输运、陷阱介导复合及高载流子密度下的热声子瓶颈。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 天然存在的层状硅酸盐提供了一类丰富但尚未得到充分探索的二维材料，然而其绝缘性质限制了功能应用。在本文中，我们证明，通过可控的NaOH处理，可以将液相剥离的黑云母纳米片转变为一种可调控的二维半导体。由此产生的绝缘体–半导体转变源于Na的引入、缺陷生成和局域结构重构，同时层状骨架在很大程度上得以保持。结构和化学分析揭示了晶格畸变、层间重组、羟基化以及部分Na⁺–K⁺交换，从而确立了电子结构重构的起源。这一转变拓宽了光学响应范围，使约221 nm处的吸收移向约280 nm和975 nm，将光学带隙从约5.2 eV降低至3.2–3.5 eV，并引入约1.12–1.17 eV的低能跃迁。电学测量揭示出非线性输运，电流最高接近10 μA，证明存在激活的载流子传导。超快瞬态吸收测量显示出显著的激发态吸收，其中载流子冷却时间为0.16–0.38 ps，随后发生快速弛豫（35–60 ps）和长寿命弛豫（336–491 ps），二者与陷阱介导的复合有关。依赖于激发通量的动力学表明，在较高载流子密度下存在热声子瓶颈。结合密度泛函理论计算，这些结果确立了化学缺陷和离子工程是一种强有力的途径，可将天然丰富的层状矿物转化为电子性质可调的二维材料，用于新兴光电和超快光子技术。

articles.title: Coherent interaction of WS₂ and quasi-2D perovskite excitons over micrometer distances via a cavity field
articles.title_zh: 借助腔场实现WS₂与准二维钙钛矿激子在微米距离上的相干相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coherent coupling of cavity-confined photons and excitonic matter resonances leads to the formation of cavity polaritons, hybrid light-matter quasi-particles. If multiple exciton resonances couple to the same photonic mode, the resulting polariton constitutes a coherent interaction between matter resonances that can be spatially separated without any direct electronic coupling. In this work, we demonstrate the formation of such a coherent coupling at room temperature using an open optical cavity containing two distinct van der Waals materials - monolayer WS2 and layered quasi-2D halide perovskites (HaPs) - separated by 1.5 μrm m. The system forms three polariton branches, with the middle branch possessing nearly equal fractions of both excitons and the photonic mode. White-light reflectivity and luminescence measurements are in good agreement with simulations using a coupled harmonic oscillator and a microscopic Wannier-Hopfield framework. Our results lay the foundation to combine highly complementary degrees of freedom in 2D materials in an in-situ tunable fashion to enable new polaritonic functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔限制光子与激子物质共振的相干耦合会形成腔极化激元，而多个激子共振耦合到同一光学模式时，即使空间上相隔且没有直接电子耦合，也能产生物质共振之间的相干相互作用。本文在室温下利用开放光学腔，实现了单层WS₂与层状准二维卤化物钙钛矿之间的相干耦合，两者相距1.5微米。体系形成三个极化激元分支，其中间分支几乎均等地包含两种激子和光子成分，为可原位调控地结合二维材料的互补自由度奠定了基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 腔限制光子与激子物质共振之间的相干耦合会形成腔极化激元，即光与物质的混合准粒子。如果多个激子共振与同一光子模式耦合，所得极化激元就构成了物质共振之间的相干相互作用，即使这些物质共振在空间上彼此分离且不存在直接电子耦合。在本研究中，我们利用一个包含两种不同范德华材料的开放光学腔，在室温下实现了这种相干耦合：单层WS₂与层状准二维卤化物钙钛矿（HaP）相距1.5微米。该体系形成三个极化激元分支，其中间分支几乎等量地包含两种激子成分和光子模式成分。白光反射率和发光测量结果与耦合谐振子模型及微观Wannier–Hopfield框架的模拟结果吻合良好。我们的结果为以原位可调方式结合二维材料中高度互补的自由度奠定了基础，从而有望实现新的极化激元功能。

articles.title: Exciton multipolarity controls coherent and squeezed phonons in van der Waals heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 激子多极性控制范德华异质结构中的相干声子与压缩声子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photoexcitation-driven changes in the electronic distribution displace atoms, generating coherent phonons on ultrafast timescales. Two-dimensional (2D) materials and their heterostructures offer a powerful platform for engineering these phonons. Yet, despite the widespread observation of photoexcited coherent phonons, a design principle for controlling their character remains elusive. Here, using detailed atomistic simulations of multilayers of alternating MoSe₂ and WSe₂, we reveal exciton multipolarity as a design principle for tuning photoinduced phonons from coherent to squeezed. These phonons are interlayer breathing modes, with dipolar excitons coupling linearly to generate coherent states and quadrupolar excitons coupling quadratically to produce squeezed states. Moreover, an out-of-plane electric field enables switch-like control, converting quadrupolar excitons into dipolar excitons and switching the phonon state from squeezed to coherent. For example, in trilayer WSe₂/MoSe₂/WSe₂, the photoexcited 1.04-THz breathing mode switches from a squeezed state at zero field to a coherent state under an applied vertical field. Experimentally, these phonon states can be directly probed by ultrafast X-ray or electron diffraction and indirectly through transient reflectivity. Our results open new avenues for ultrafast control of lattice and electronic dynamics on picosecond timescales, with implications for THz quantum phononics, nanophotonic technologies, and quantum-noise-limited sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 光激发引起的电子分布变化会驱动原子位移，并在超快时间尺度上产生相干声子。本文通过对交替MoSe₂和WSe₂多层结构的原子级模拟，揭示激子多极性可以作为调控光诱导声子性质的设计原理：偶极激子线性耦合产生相干态，四极激子二次耦合产生压缩态。面外电场能够将四极激子转换为偶极激子，从而实现声子态由压缩态到相干态的开关式控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光激发驱动的电子分布变化会使原子发生位移，从而在超快时间尺度上产生相干声子。二维材料及其异质结构为设计这些声子提供了强有力的平台。然而，尽管光激发相干声子已被广泛观测，控制其性质的设计原理仍然缺失。在本文中，我们利用对交替排列的MoSe₂和WSe₂多层结构进行的详细原子级模拟，揭示了激子多极性是调节光诱导声子从相干态到压缩态的设计原理。这些声子是层间呼吸模，其中偶极激子与其线性耦合，从而产生相干态；四极激子与其二次耦合，从而产生压缩态。此外，面外电场能够实现开关式控制，将四极激子转换为偶极激子，并将声子态从压缩态切换为相干态。例如，在三层WSe₂/MoSe₂/WSe₂结构中，光激发的1.04 THz呼吸模在零场下处于压缩态，而在施加垂直电场后切换为相干态。在实验上，可以通过超快X射线或电子衍射直接探测这些声子态，也可以通过瞬态反射率进行间接探测。我们的结果为在皮秒时间尺度上超快控制晶格和电子动力学开辟了新途径，并对THz量子声子学、纳米光子技术以及量子噪声极限传感具有意义。

articles.title: Peeling threshold for removal of an adhered elastic sheet by a shear flow
articles.title_zh: 剪切流移除黏附弹性薄片的剥离阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fluid shear can induce detachment of a thin elastic sheet adhered to a flat substrate. This peeling process is important in a variety of environmental and technological systems. The condition for peeling depends on: the shear rate dotγ, the fluid viscosity η, the length of the detached portion of the sheet L, the bending rigidity B and the adhesion energy Γ. What are the laws governing the detachment? We address this question experimentally in the regime of intermediate adhesion, using macroscopic sheets bonded to a substrate and immersed in a shear cell containing a viscous fluid. The experiments indicate a critical shear rate for peeling of the order of dotγ sim B/(η L³). This threshold is, unexpectedly, independent of adhesion. We rationalise this result by applying Griffith's fracture theory to optical measurement data of the shape of the sheet, under conditions of freely moving peeling front or clamped boundary. The results indicate that the large curvature of the sheet for dotγ sim B/(η L³) yields a nearly diverging strain energy release rate at this threshold. This approximate divergence in turn yields a peeling threshold that depends at most weakly on Γ, confirming a theory that was proposed recently (Salussolia et al., J. Mech. Phys. Solids, 2020, 134). Among other applications, our work provides a quantitative formula that can aid the production at scale of 2D materials such as graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 流体剪切能够使黏附在平面基底上的薄弹性片发生脱附。本文通过黏附于基底并浸没在黏性流体剪切池中的宏观薄片开展实验，研究中等黏附条件下的剥离规律。实验表明，剥离临界剪切速率约为B/(ηL³)，并出乎意料地与黏附能无关；基于Griffith断裂理论和薄片形状测量，作者将其归因于临界条件附近大曲率导致的能量释放率近似发散，并给出了可辅助石墨烯等二维材料规模化生产的定量公式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 流体剪切能够诱导黏附在平面基底上的薄弹性片发生脱附。这一剥离过程对于各种环境和技术系统都很重要。剥离条件取决于剪切速率γ̇、薄片脱离部分的长度L、流体黏度η、弯曲刚度B以及黏附能Γ。控制脱附的规律是什么？我们在中等黏附条件下研究了这一问题，实验采用黏附在基底上并浸没于含有黏性流体的剪切池中的宏观薄片。实验表明，剥离的临界剪切速率约为γ̇∼B/(ηL³)。出乎意料的是，该阈值与黏附无关。我们通过将Griffith断裂理论应用于薄片形状的光学测量数据，对这一结果进行了阐释，研究条件包括剥离前沿自由移动或边界被夹持的情况。结果表明，当γ̇∼B/(ηL³)时，薄片的大曲率会使应变能释放率在该阈值处近似发散。这种近似发散反过来导致剥离阈值至多仅弱依赖于Γ，从而证实了Salussolia等人在近期提出的理论（《固体力学与物理学杂志》，2020年，第134卷）。除其他应用外，我们的工作还提供了一个定量公式，可辅助石墨烯等二维材料的规模化生产。

articles.title: Unravelling the Li-Haldane Conjecture with the Projected Ensemble
articles.title_zh: 利用投影系综揭示Li–Haldane猜想
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The entanglement spectra of fractional quantum Hall states contain universal fingerprints of their underlying topological order, as posited by the Li-Haldane conjecture. In this work, we uncover a finer universal structure within the entanglement spectra unravelled by projective measurements. Concretely, we study the projected ensemble of fractional quantum Hall states, defined as the collection of quantum states on a subsystem conditioned on measurement outcomes of its complement. We find that this ensemble exhibits a hidden hierarchy inside the Li-Haldane edge manifold: by conditioning on measurement outcomes, the entanglement spectrum's support is split into measurement-dependent sectors whose ranks we demonstrate are fixed by conformal field theory counting, an observation we dub the measurement-resolved Li-Haldane conjecture. For the non-Abelian Moore-Read state, this hierarchy is particularly rich: each parity-resolved edge manifold contains internal subspaces whose dimensions reproduce the conformal field theory counting of the opposite-parity sector. This structure persists even in realistic Coulomb-interacting ground states, establishing the projected ensemble as a sharp new probe of topological order beyond what the entanglement spectrum alone can detect.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数量子霍尔态的纠缠谱包含其拓扑序的普适指纹，而Li–Haldane猜想对这一联系进行了描述。本文研究通过对补集进行投影测量并按测量结果条件化得到的投影系综，发现测量能够将纠缠谱中的边缘流形划分为依赖测量结果的扇区，其秩由共形场论计数固定。对于非阿贝尔Moore–Read态，这一层级结构尤其丰富，并且在真实库仑相互作用基态中仍然存在，显示投影系综能够探测纠缠谱之外的拓扑序细节。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子霍尔态的纠缠谱包含其底层拓扑序的普适指纹，正如Li–Haldane猜想所提出的那样。在本文中，我们揭示了纠缠谱中一种更精细的普适结构，这一结构可通过投影测量得到解析。具体而言，我们研究了分数量子霍尔态的投影系综，其定义为：在对补集进行测量并以测量结果为条件的情况下，子系统上量子态的集合。我们发现，这一系综在Li–Haldane边缘流形内部呈现出隐藏的层级结构：通过以测量结果为条件，纠缠谱的支撑被划分为依赖测量结果的扇区；我们证明，这些扇区的秩由共形场论计数固定，并将这一现象称为测量分辨的Li–Haldane猜想。对于非阿贝尔Moore–Read态，这一层级结构尤其丰富：每个按宇称分辨的边缘流形都包含内部子空间，其维数重现了相反宇称扇区的共形场论计数。即使在具有真实库仑相互作用的基态中，这一结构仍然存在，从而确立了投影系综是一种超越单独纠缠谱所能探测范围、用于精确研究拓扑序的新工具。

articles.title: Universal Driven Critical Dynamics of Entanglement Entropy
articles.title_zh: 纠缠熵的普适驱动临界动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM) and finite-time scaling (FTS) provide a foundational framework for driven critical dynamics, yet their predictive power has been largely confined to local observables. Here, we establish a universal finite-time scaling theory for the nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum entanglement. Using unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we investigate the corner entanglement entropy of (2+1)-dimensional interacting Dirac fermions driven from ordered phases toward a quantum critical point. We find that the corner entanglement accurately obeys a universal driven scaling governed by the driving rate and system size, persisting whether the initial ordered state is fully gapped or hosts gapless Goldstone modes. Crucially, this dynamical entanglement exhibits a logarithmic dependence on the driving rate, from which the universal corner coefficient of the underlying conformal field theory can be robustly extracted far from equilibrium. These results generalize the KZM from local observables to the intrinsic nonlocal quantum information measures, offering a practical blueprint for characterizing quantum criticality and entanglement on programmable quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: Kibble–Zurek机制和有限时间标度理论为驱动临界动力学提供了基础框架，但其预测能力主要局限于局域观测量。本文利用无偏量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究从有序相向量子临界点驱动的二维相互作用Dirac费米子系统，发现角纠缠熵遵循由驱动速率和系统尺寸控制的普适标度。该动力学纠缠熵对驱动速率呈对数依赖，可用于远离平衡地提取底层共形场论的普适角系数，从而将Kibble–Zurek机制推广到非局域量子信息量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kibble–Zurek机制（KZM）和有限时间标度（FTS）为驱动临界动力学提供了基础框架，但它们的预测能力在很大程度上局限于局域观测量。在本文中，我们建立了一个关于量子纠缠非平衡动力学的普适有限时间标度理论。我们利用无偏量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了（2+1）维相互作用Dirac费米子从有序相向量子临界点驱动过程中的角纠缠熵。我们发现，角纠缠准确地遵循一种普适的驱动标度，该标度由驱动速率和系统尺寸共同决定；无论初始有序态是完全有隙的，还是包含无隙Goldstone模，这一标度关系都成立。至关重要的是，这种动力学纠缠对驱动速率呈对数依赖，由此可以在远离平衡的条件下稳健地提取底层共形场论的普适角系数。这些结果将KZM从局域观测量推广到本征的非局域量子信息测度，并为在可编程量子模拟器上表征量子临界性和纠缠提供了实用方案。

articles.title: Tunable Chern superconductivity of PtBi₂ in slab geometry
articles.title_zh: 板层几何中 PtBi₂ 的可调陈超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.03867v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments indicate that PtBi₂ is a Weyl semimetal whose surfaces become topological superconductors with i-wave gap symmetry at low temperature. The bulk hosts 12 Weyl cones while in the superconducting state each of the two surfaces hosts in addition 6 Majorana cones. We study a simplified model in a slab geometry, where the finite thickness gaps out the bulk Weyl cones and leaves the surface Majorana cones as the low-energy degrees of freedom. We identify two competing mechanisms that gap these cones: inter-cone hybridization opens a trivial gap, whereas a Zeeman field opens a nontrivial one. In the nontrivial regime, chiral Majorana edge modes connect the gapped cones. We determine their wavefunction profile and relate it to the momentum-space distribution of the cones. Mapping out the phase diagram, we find both trivial and nontrivial regions in the quasi-two-dimensional limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期实验表明，PtBi₂ 是一种 Weyl 半金属，其表面在低温下会形成具有 i 波能隙对称性的拓扑超导态。作者研究了板层几何中的简化模型，发现有限厚度会使体相 Weyl 锥开隙，并留下表面 Majorana 锥作为低能自由度。相图显示，准二维极限下既存在平庸相，也存在具有手性 Majorana 边缘模的非平庸相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期实验表明，PtBi₂ 是一种 Weyl 半金属，其表面在低温下会成为具有 i 波能隙对称性的拓扑超导体。体相中包含 12 个 Weyl 锥，而在超导态中，两个表面中的每一个还额外包含 6 个 Majorana 锥。我们研究了板层几何中的一个简化模型，其中有限厚度使体相 Weyl 锥开隙，并将表面 Majorana 锥作为低能自由度保留下来。我们识别出两种相互竞争的使这些锥开隙的机制：锥间杂化会打开一个平庸能隙，而 Zeeman 场会打开一个非平庸能隙。在非平庸区域中，手性 Majorana 边缘模连接这些已开隙的锥。我们确定了它们的波函数轮廓，并将其与动量空间中这些锥的分布联系起来。通过绘制相图，我们发现准二维极限下同时存在平庸区域和非平庸区域。
