articles.abstract_zh_full: 石墨烯衍生物被广泛用作改善金属卤化物钙钛矿器件体相性质和界面性质的材料。然而，它们的片层化学以及与钙钛矿前驱体之间相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明，原始石墨烯片层（GF）与更为常用的氧化石墨烯片层（GOF）并不可互换。密度泛函理论计算显示，GOF与钙钛矿晶格的相互作用更强，但会诱导更大的结构畸变、更强的界面极化以及局域化的带隙态。相比之下，GF形成的接触具有相对较小的扰动，并且在很宽的组分范围内都能保持这一响应。机器学习原子模拟进一步表明，GF会接触溶剂化钙钛矿纳米晶中含Pb和含I的区域，而且这种接触强烈依赖于溶剂。溶液光谱表征表明，GF添加剂可以作为预先组织的含Pb/I前驱体的支架，从而有利于薄膜结晶。从这一意义上说，GF能够提升不同钙钛矿组分的太阳能电池性能，尤其适用于面临更大结晶挑战的组分。在混合Sn-Pb钙钛矿太阳能电池中，GF将最高功率转换效率从21.5%提高到23.7%，并改善了储存稳定性。这些结果确立了原始GF作为一种化学组成明确的添加剂的地位，并将其原子尺度相互作用与前驱体组织、结晶、器件性能和稳定性联系起来。
articles.focus_summary: 本文研究石墨烯及氧化石墨烯片层与金属卤化物钙钛矿之间的相互作用，结合密度泛函理论、机器学习原子模拟和实验表征分析其对结构、界面极化、局域能隙态及结晶过程的影响。结果表明，氧化石墨烯相互作用更强但引起更大结构畸变，而原始石墨烯接触扰动较小，并可促进钙钛矿薄膜结晶和太阳能电池性能提升。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、二维材料、异质结构界面、机器学习原子模拟、界面电荷转移和太阳能电池方向高度相关。其关于石墨烯化学性质、溶剂依赖界面作用和结晶调控的结果，可为钙钛矿界面工程及缺陷钝化设计提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算不同石墨烯官能团、缺陷和应变条件下的界面电荷转移、缺陷形成能及载流子复合过程。结合非绝热分子动力学或GW-BSE方法，可研究石墨烯调控下的热载流子弛豫、激子解离和非辐射复合。

articles.title: Magnetoelectric Phase Transition and Axion Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 磁电相变与轴子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelectric phase transitions have been experimentally studied, but no macroscopic theory has been proposed to explain their dynamical origin. In this work, we assume that the axion quasiparticle with frequency undergoes a condensation like process. We show that these magnetoelectric phase transitions can be described within a Ginzbur Landau framework by introducing a coupled dynamic parameter, the axion angle, which is proportional to the magnetoelectric coeffcient. We derive relations between the static axion angle, the axion frequency, and the phase transition temperature for different magnetoelectric materials, respectively, and compare these calculations with existing experimental results. We also connect the artificially designed Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction with the axion condensate like process, so that the relation between the static axion angle and the experimentally measured frequency shift can be obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁电相变虽然已得到实验研究，但其动力学起源尚缺乏宏观理论解释。本文假设轴子准粒子经历类似凝聚的过程，并在引入与磁电系数成正比的耦合动力学参数轴子角后，利用金兹堡-朗道框架描述磁电相变。作者推导了不同磁电材料中静态轴子角、轴子频率和相变温度之间的关系，并将计算结果与已有实验结果进行比较，同时讨论了人工设计的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与类轴子凝聚过程之间的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁电相变已经得到实验研究，但尚未提出解释其动力学起源的宏观理论。在这项工作中，我们假设频率为某值的轴子准粒子经历类似凝聚的过程。我们表明，通过引入一个耦合的动力学参数，即与磁电系数成正比的轴子角，可以在金兹堡-朗道框架内描述这些磁电相变。对于不同的磁电材料，我们分别推导出静态轴子角、轴子频率和相变温度之间的关系，并将这些计算结果与已有实验结果进行比较。我们还将人工设计的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与类轴子凝聚过程联系起来，从而可以得到静态轴子角与实验测得的频移之间的关系。

articles.title: Systematic display of the spin splitting in band structures of representative altermagnetic crystals
articles.title_zh: 系统展示代表性交错磁晶体能带结构中的自旋劈裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we demonstrate a novel approach to exhibit the unique spin splitting that is typical of collinear altermagnets. This approach is to plot band structures on Brillouin zone paths that sample general k-points to show a representative picture that corresponds to Brillouin zone averages. This is in contrast to conventional band structure plotting which plots band structures on the highest-symmetry points and lines, and thus in many cases can fail to show any altermagnetic spin splitting at all. Our investigation compares the new approach with the band structures of collinear altermagnets using conventional band structure plotting. We report the band structure and symmetry analysis for MnTe, CrSb, SmFeO3, ScCrO3, LaMnO3, TlCrO3, HoFeO3, InCrO3 and DyFeO3. This result clearly demonstrates the advantage of this novel method for displaying the spin splitting of collinear altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种展示共线交错磁体特有自旋劈裂的新方法：在能够采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，以获得代表布里渊区平均特征的图像。该方法区别于只经过高对称点和高对称线的传统能带绘制方式，后者在许多情况下会完全隐藏交错磁自旋劈裂。通过对MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3等材料进行能带和对称性分析，本文明确展示了新方法的优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们展示了一种呈现共线交错磁体所特有自旋劈裂的新方法。该方法是在能够采样一般k点的布里渊区路径上绘制能带结构，从而展示与布里渊区平均相对应的代表性图像。这不同于传统的能带绘制方式，后者沿高对称点和高对称线绘制能带，因此在许多情况下可能完全无法显示任何交错磁自旋劈裂。我们的研究将这种新方法与采用传统能带绘制方式得到的共线交错磁体能带结构进行了比较。我们报告了MnTe、CrSb、SmFeO3、ScCrO3、LaMnO3、TlCrO3、HoFeO3、InCrO3和DyFeO3的能带结构及对称性分析。结果清楚地展示了这种用于显示共线交错磁体自旋劈裂的新方法的优势。

articles.title: Emergence of the magnetic octupole Rashba-Edelstein effect from spin-orbit entanglement
articles.title_zh: 自旋-轨道纠缠诱导的磁八极Rashba-Edelstein效应的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic multipoles have attracted growing interest as order parameters and dynamical degrees of freedom in unconventional magnets, yet it remains unclear how broadly they can emerge as active electronic degrees of freedom. Here, we show that spin-orbit-entangled multiorbital states can host magnetic octupole (MO) degrees of freedom. In Rashba systems, this gives rise to an MO Rashba texture accompanying the J-Rashba texture. Remarkably, spin-orbital entanglement can realize a pure-MO limit in which the spin and orbital-angular-momentum textures vanish while the MO texture remains finite. An applied electric field converts this texture into a nonequilibrium MO polarization through an MO Rashba-Edelstein effect. Around the pure-MO regime, the MO Edelstein response dominates over the conventional spin response, showing that multipolar responses need not be small corrections to dipolar spin physics. Our results establish an interface-based route for electrically generating nonequilibrium multipolar magnetic polarization in spin-orbit-coupled systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁多极矩作为非常规磁体中的序参量和动力学自由度日益受到关注，但其作为活性电子自由度的普适性仍不清楚。本文表明，自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态能够承载磁八极矩自由度，并在Rashba体系中形成伴随J-Rashba纹理的磁八极Rashba纹理。电场可将该纹理转换为非平衡磁八极极化；在纯磁八极区域附近，其Edelstein响应可超过传统自旋响应，为电生成非平衡多极磁极化提供了界面途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁多极矩作为非常规磁体中的序参量和动力学自由度，已经引起越来越多的关注，但目前仍不清楚它们能否广泛地作为活性电子自由度出现。在这里，我们表明，自旋-轨道纠缠的多轨道态能够承载磁八极矩（MO）自由度。在Rashba体系中，这会产生一种MO Rashba纹理，并伴随J-Rashba纹理。值得注意的是，自旋-轨道纠缠可以实现纯MO极限，在这一极限下，自旋纹理和轨道角动量纹理均消失，而MO纹理仍保持有限。施加电场可以通过MO Rashba-Edelstein效应将这一纹理转化为非平衡MO极化。在纯MO区域附近，MO Edelstein响应超过传统自旋响应，这表明多极响应不一定只是偶极自旋物理的小修正。我们的结果确立了一条基于界面的途径，可在自旋-轨道耦合体系中电学生成非平衡多极磁极化。

articles.title: AlterSeeK-Path: Systematic construction of generalized band-structure paths for displaying altermagnetic spin splitting
articles.title_zh: AlterSeeK-Path：用于展示交错磁自旋劈裂的广义能带结构路径的系统构建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetic materials exhibit spin splitting in their electronic band structures while maintaining zero net magnetization. However, conventional high-symmetry k-paths generally hide this splitting because they follow symmetry lines that in most cases enforce spin degeneracy. We present AlterSeeK-Path, an open-source Python tool that systematically constructs generalized band-structure paths for collinear altermagnets. The method selects the centroid of the conventional irreducible wedge used in routine band-structure calculations as the representative general k-point, maps it to a spin-flip-related partner, and inserts paired segments through these points into the standard high-symmetry path; these segments systematically sample the interior of the irreducible wedge. We demonstrate the construction for all 54 three-dimensional combinations of extended Bravais lattice type and spin Laue group across the six crystal systems that support collinear altermagnetism, and for the 12 two-dimensional cases spanning the four compatible two-dimensional Bravais lattices. Representative band structures are shown for the distinct lattice/path cases. With AlterSeeK-Path, these band structures can be constructed with essentially the same effort as conventional band structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 交错磁材料在保持零净磁化强度的同时，其电子能带结构中存在自旋劈裂，但传统高对称性k路径通常会将这种劈裂隐藏。本文提出开源Python工具AlterSeeK-Path，用于系统构建共线交错磁体的广义能带路径。该方法选取常规能带计算所用不可约楔形区的质心作为代表性一般k点，将其映射到自旋翻转相关的伙伴点，并把成对线段插入标准高对称路径。作者展示了其对三维和二维所有支持共线交错磁性的晶格与自旋劳厄群组合的适用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交错磁材料在保持零净磁化强度的同时，其电子能带结构表现出自旋劈裂。然而，传统的高对称性k路径通常会隐藏这种劈裂，因为这些路径沿着在多数情况下强制自旋简并的对称线。我们提出AlterSeeK-Path，这是一种开源Python工具，用于系统构建共线交错磁体的广义能带结构路径。该方法选取常规能带结构计算中使用的不可约楔形区的质心作为代表性一般k点，将其映射到一个与自旋翻转相关的伙伴点，并将经过这些点的成对线段插入标准高对称路径；这些线段能够系统地采样不可约楔形区的内部。我们针对支持共线交错磁性的六种晶系，展示了扩展布拉菲晶格类型与自旋劳厄群的全部54种三维组合的路径构建；同时也展示了覆盖四种兼容二维布拉菲晶格的12种二维情形。我们给出了不同晶格和路径情形的代表性能带结构。利用AlterSeeK-Path，可以用与构建传统能带结构基本相同的工作量构建这些能带结构。

articles.title: First Principle Analysis of the Magnetism and Electronic Structure of Fe2XSi (X=Ti, V)
articles.title_zh: Fe2XSi（X=Ti、V）的磁性与电子结构的第一性原理分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic, magnetic, and mechanical properties of Fe2XSi, where X is titanium (Ti) and vanadium (V), are investigated using computational methods. Volume optimization reveals that the ground state of Fe2TiSi is a nonmagnetic narrow-band gap semiconductor, and that of Fe2VSi is a ferrimagnetic metal. The negative formation energies of both materials confirm the stability of their crystal structures. Mechanical properties confirm the static stability of the crystal structure and suggest that the titanium compound is ductile; however, the vanadium material is brittle. Density of states and band structure studies confirm the nonmagnetic semiconducting nature with an indirect band gap at Γ and X for the titanium material and the ferrimagnetic-metallic nature of the vanadium material. Electronic and magnetic properties of the materials were investigated with applied tension (negative pressure) and compression (positive pressure) to the crystal structure. The pressure study on Fe2TiSi shows a tunable band gap and a possible semiconductor-metal transition, and Fe2VSi shows a tunable magnetic moment and a possible low-spin/high-spin magnetic transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用计算方法研究Fe2XSi（X为钛或钒）的电子、磁学和力学性质。体积优化表明，Fe2TiSi的基态是非磁性窄带隙半导体，而Fe2VSi是亚铁磁金属；两种材料的负形成能证实了其晶体结构稳定性。力学性质表明钛化合物具有延展性，而钒化合物较为脆性。压力研究显示，Fe2TiSi的带隙可调并可能发生半导体-金属转变，Fe2VSi的磁矩可调并可能发生低自旋-高自旋磁性转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用计算方法研究了Fe2XSi的电子、磁学和力学性质，其中X为钛（Ti）和钒（V）。体积优化表明，Fe2TiSi的基态是非磁性窄带隙半导体，而Fe2VSi的基态是亚铁磁金属。两种材料的负形成能证实了其晶体结构的稳定性。力学性质证实了晶体结构的静态稳定性，并表明钛化合物具有延展性；然而，钒化合物是脆性的。态密度和能带结构研究证实，钛化合物具有非磁性半导体性质，在Γ点和X点之间存在间接带隙；同时也证实了钒化合物具有亚铁磁金属性质。在对晶体结构施加拉伸应力（负压力）和压缩应力（正压力）时，我们研究了这些材料的电子和磁学性质。对Fe2TiSi的压力研究表明，其带隙可调，并可能发生半导体-金属转变；对Fe2VSi的研究表明，其磁矩可调，并可能发生低自旋-高自旋磁性转变。

articles.title: Relaxation effects on Hartree-Fock ground states in twisted bilayer graphene at even integer fillings
articles.title_zh: 偶数整数填充下扭曲双层石墨烯Hartree-Fock基态的弛豫效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A standard approach for studying magic angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG)'s correlated electronic phase diagram is to project the Coulomb interaction down to effective models only involving electrons in single-particle flat bands and some nearby remote bands. We provide a novel systematic derivation of a single-particle continuum model of MATBG's single-particle properties which incorporates structural relaxation while remaining in the Lagrangian frame. We project the Coulomb interactions down to electrons occupying the flat bands of this model and compute the Hartree-Fock many-body ground states at fillings ν = ± 2. We find that incorporating relaxation effects drives the model into a semi-metallic phase at - 2 because of particle-hole asymmetry in the relaxed model's single-particle dispersion and because the flat band wavefunctions become more concentrated leading to an enhanced Hartree potential. Our results corroborate recent ab initio density functional theory studies which also found semi-metallic phases at -2. We discuss potential explanations for why such phases have not been seen in experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究魔角扭曲双层石墨烯关联电子相图的一种标准方法，是将库仑相互作用投影到仅包含单粒子平带及其附近远程能带的有效模型中。本文系统推导了一个在拉格朗日坐标系中、同时纳入结构弛豫的单粒子连续模型，并将库仑相互作用投影到该模型的平带电子上，计算填充数ν=±2时的Hartree-Fock多体基态。结果表明，结构弛豫使ν=-2处的模型进入半金属相，这源于弛豫模型单粒子色散的粒子-空穴不对称以及平带波函数集中化导致的Hartree势增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）关联电子相图的一种标准方法，是将库仑相互作用投影到只涉及单粒子平带和一些邻近远程能带的有效模型中。我们系统地推导了一个用于描述MATBG单粒子性质的单粒子连续模型，该模型纳入了结构弛豫，同时仍保持在拉格朗日坐标系中。我们将库仑相互作用投影到占据该模型平带的电子上，并计算了填充数ν=±2时的Hartree-Fock多体基态。我们发现，纳入弛豫效应会使该模型在ν=-2处进入半金属相，其原因在于弛豫模型单粒子色散中的粒子-空穴不对称，以及平带波函数变得更加集中，从而导致Hartree势增强。我们的结果与近期从头算密度泛函理论研究相一致，后者同样在ν=-2处发现了半金属相。我们还讨论了为何实验中尚未观测到这类相的潜在解释。

articles.title: Repairing PBE-Spurious Metallicity for HSE06-Level Screening of 2D Photocatalysts for Green Hydrogen Production
articles.title_zh: 修复 PBE 伪金属性，以实现 HSE06 水平的二维光催化剂绿色制氢筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semilocal PBE calculations can remove viable photocatalysts before screening by labeling narrow-gap semiconductors as metals. We address this failure mode in the Computational 2D Materials Database (C2DB) by combining leakage-aware repair of PBE-spurious metallicity with HSE06--PBE Δ-learning. Stage~I classifies HSE06-unknown PBE metals using structural, chemical, magnetic, and stability descriptors, while excluding HSE06/GW quantities and PBE electronic shortcuts. Stage~II learns E_gHSE - E_gPBE for the corrected insulating population. The curated XGBoost regressor reconstructs HSE06 gaps with a mean absolute error of 0.108~eV (R²=0.989), compared with 1.036~eV for raw PBE. The Stage~I classifier is used only for triage because the labeled true-metal class contains 29 materials; its best holdout performance gives 87.5% accuracy, 0.286 true-metal recall, and 0.643 balanced accuracy. The corrected pH~0 electronic screen yields 10 strict and 29 initial relaxed green-hydrogen photocatalyst candidates. Four strict and 18 relaxed candidates would fail the same 1.6--2.8~eV gap window at the PBE level. Targeted VASP HSE06 calculations for six ML-predicted compounds give material-level MAEs of 0.417, 0.182, and 0.110~eV for the C2DB-native, Magpie+structural, and curated models, respectively; feat1AgBr-1 shifts above the upper gap cutoff, leaving 28 retained relaxed candidates. The workflow shows that high-fidelity correction must be evaluated by candidate membership, not only by global regression error.
articles.abstract_zh: 半局域 PBE 计算可能把窄带隙半导体误判为金属，从而在筛选阶段过早淘汰可行的光催化剂。本文针对 C2DB 数据库，结合对 PBE 伪金属性的泄漏感知修复与 HSE06--PBE 的 Δ 学习，建立两阶段筛选流程。修正后的模型显著提升了带隙预测精度，并给出了更可靠的绿色制氢候选材料集合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半局域 PBE 计算可能将窄带隙半导体标记为金属，从而在筛选过程中提前排除可行的光催化剂。我们通过将对 PBE 伪金属性的泄漏感知修复与 HSE06--PBE Δ 学习相结合，解决了计算二维材料数据库（C2DB）中的这一失效模式。第一阶段利用结构、化学、磁性和稳定性描述符，对 HSE06 未知的 PBE 金属进行分类，同时排除 HSE06/GW 量和 PBE 电子学捷径。第二阶段针对修正后的绝缘体群体，学习 Eg_HSE - Eg_PBE。经过整理的 XGBoost 回归器重建 HSE06 带隙的平均绝对误差为 0.108 eV（R²=0.989），而原始 PBE 的误差为 1.036 eV。由于标记为真实金属的样本仅有 29 个材料，第一阶段分类器只用于初筛；其最佳留出集性能为 87.5% 准确率、0.286 的真实金属召回率和 0.643 的平衡准确率。修正后的 pH~0 电子筛选给出了 10 个严格候选和 29 个初步放宽的绿色制氢光催化剂候选材料。若采用 PBE 水平，在相同的 1.6--2.8 eV 带隙窗口下，其中 4 个严格候选和 18 个放宽候选本会被淘汰。对 6 个机器学习预测化合物进行有针对性的 VASP HSE06 计算后，C2DB 原生、Magpie+结构和整理后模型的材料层面 MAE 分别为 0.417、0.182 和 0.110 eV；feat1AgBr-1 上移至上限带隙截断之上，使保留的放宽候选减少为 28 个。该流程表明，高保真修正必须通过候选成员资格来评估，而不仅仅依赖全局回归误差。

articles.title: When Literature Data Mislead Artificial Intelligence in Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: 文学数据如何误导材料发现中的人工智能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01621v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly treats scientific literature as a data source for building databases, training predictive models, and guiding discovery. Yet literature-derived datasets often assume that reported experimental values are internally consistent and directly reusable. Here, we analyze this assumption using solid electrolyte (SE) conductivity data as a representative materials-science case. By tracing values from source articles to curated datasets, we identify recurrent text-figure mismatches, ambiguous axis annotations, unit inconsistencies, and missing measurement context. These discrepancies are often numerically plausible and therefore difficult to detect through routine preprocessing, but they can propagate as structured label noise during database construction and machine-learning reuse. A cross-database example shows how ambiguous reporting can create a 100-fold conductivity error. Our analysis reframes data accuracy as an infrastructure requirement for artificial-intelligence-driven discovery and motivates traceable reporting, curation, and validation practices for reusable scientific data. Keywords: AI for science; Data reliability; Scientific databases; Structured label noise; Literature-derived data; Materials informatics; Solid electrolytes
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能越来越多地将科学文献视为数据库构建、预测模型训练和发现引导的数据来源，但文献转化的数据并不总是可以直接复用。本文以固体电解质电导率数据为例，分析了文本与图示不一致、坐标标注含糊、单位不统一和测量背景缺失等问题。作者指出，这些看似合理的差异会在数据库构建与机器学习复用中演化为结构化标签噪声，因此数据可靠性应被视为人工智能驱动发现的基础设施要求。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能（AI）越来越多地将科学文献视为用于构建数据库、训练预测模型和指导发现的数据来源。然而，基于文献的数据集往往默认所报告的实验值在内部是一致的，并且可以直接复用。这里，我们以固体电解质（SE）电导率数据作为材料科学中的代表性案例，对这一假设进行了分析。通过追踪从原始论文到整理数据库的数值，我们识别出反复出现的文本与图表不匹配、坐标轴标注含糊、单位不一致以及测量背景信息缺失等问题。这些差异在数值上往往看似合理，因此很难通过常规预处理发现，但它们在数据库构建和机器学习复用过程中会作为结构化标签噪声传播。一个跨数据库的例子表明，含糊的报告方式可能造成 100 倍的电导率误差。我们的分析将数据准确性重新界定为人工智能驱动发现所必需的基础设施条件，并促使人们采取可追踪的报告、整理与验证实践，以便生产可复用的科学数据。关键词：科学人工智能；数据可靠性；科学数据库；结构化标签噪声；文献来源数据；材料信息学；固体电解质

articles.title: Numerical simulation of D-Wave's quantum advantage experiment with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 利用时变变分蒙特卡洛对 D-Wave 量子优越性实验进行数值模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01719v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Programmable quantum annealers can realize real-time dynamics of frustrated transverse-field Ising models on large, nontrivial graphs. Recent work by King et al. argued that the classical simulation of such experiments would require exponential computational resources for classical methods such as tensor networks and neural quantum states. Here, we numerically simulate the D-Wave spin-glass annealing protocol with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo (t-VMC) using a correlator state tailored to spin-glass dynamics. For the two-dimensional cylinder, three-dimensional dimer, diamond, and biclique instances considered, at annealing times of 7 and 20 ns, we show that systematically increasing the variational ansatz size enables t-VMC to approximate the final two-spin correlation errors of the quantum processing unit (QPU). We also perform an accurate large-scale simulation of a challenging biclique instance for which no other variational method is known to work, and we find close agreement with the quantum annealer. Through ablation studies, we identify poor Markov-chain mixing, high-variance local-energy estimators, and stochastic Runge-Kutta error estimates as the principal numerical failure modes. We address these numerical issues by using parallel tempering, blurred sampling and an importance-weighted differential equation solver, thereby clarifying the numerical requirements for stable, large-scale t-VMC simulations. Our results extend the frontier of classical simulation while providing a realistic assessment of the computational costs of simulating quantum dynamics at this scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用时变变分蒙特卡洛（t-VMC）对 D-Wave 自旋玻璃退火协议进行经典数值模拟。通过针对自旋玻璃动力学设计的相关器态，作者在多个实例上展示了随着变分 ansatz 规模增大，t-VMC 可逼近量子处理器的最终两自旋相关误差。文中还分析了数值失效的主要来源，并给出相应的稳定化策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可编程量子退火器能够在大规模、非平凡图结构上实现受挫横场 Ising 模型的实时动力学。King 等人的近期工作认为，使用张量网络和神经量子态等经典方法对这类实验进行模拟将需要指数级计算资源。在这里，我们采用针对自旋玻璃动力学定制的相关器态，使用时变变分蒙特卡洛（t-VMC）对 D-Wave 自旋玻璃退火协议进行数值模拟。对于所考虑的二维柱面、三维二聚体、金刚石和双部图实例，在 7 ns 和 20 ns 的退火时间下，我们表明系统性地增大变分 ansatz 的规模能够使 t-VMC 逼近量子处理单元（QPU）的最终两自旋相关误差。我们还对一个复杂的双部图实例进行了准确的大规模模拟；据我们所知，没有其他变分方法能够成功处理该实例，而我们发现其结果与量子退火器高度一致。通过消融研究，我们将马尔可夫链混合不良、本地能量估计器方差过高以及随机 Runge-Kutta 误差估计等识别为主要的数值失效模式。我们通过使用平行温度交换、模糊采样以及加权重要性的一阶微分方程求解器来解决这些数值问题，从而阐明了稳定的大规模 t-VMC 模拟所需的数值条件。我们的结果拓展了经典模拟的前沿，同时也对在这一尺度上模拟量子动力学的计算成本给出了现实评估。

articles.title: Bilinear correlations in Fluctuating Gaussian States with anti-unitary symmetries
articles.title_zh: 具有反幺正对称性的涨落高斯态中的双线性关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01724v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study bilinear order-parameter correlations in a general class of sign problem-free systems that are described by what we call Fluctuating Gaussian States (FGS) with anti-unitary symmetries, where the weight of each Gaussian measurement in the space-time path integral is positive-definite. Supported by Monte Carlo simulations on fluctuating Gaussian fermionic and bosonic examples, we argue that such systems generally exhibit two types of broken-symmetry phases: a emphsaddle point phase and a emphnon-local contraction phase, with the competition between the two determined by the stability of the fluctuation saddle point of FGS. Due to the Fermi liquid instability in fermionic FGS with anti-unitary symmetries, we also discuss the possibility of representing fermionic FGS with a particular Projected Entangled-Pair State (PEPS) ansatz, which we argue a certain construction provides an efficient description for the saddle point phase, but not for the non-local contraction phase. Finally, we discuss the potential implication of our result in non-equilibrium systems and stabilizing a target bilinear order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由涨落高斯态（FGS）描述的一类无符号问题系统中的双线性序参量关联。作者结合对费米子与玻色子示例的蒙特卡洛模拟，指出这类系统通常会呈现两种破缺对称相：鞍点相与非局域收缩相，其竞争由 FGS 波动鞍点的稳定性决定。文章还讨论了在反幺正对称下用 PEPS 近似表示某些费米子 FGS 的可能性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一类无符号问题系统中的双线性序参量关联，这些系统可由我们称之为具有反幺正对称性的涨落高斯态（Fluctuating Gaussian States, FGS）来描述，其中空间-时间路径积分中每个高斯测量的权重都是正定的。基于对涨落高斯费米子和玻色子示例的蒙特卡洛模拟，我们认为这类系统通常表现出两种对称性破缺相：一种是鞍点相，另一种是非局域收缩相，而二者之间的竞争由 FGS 波动鞍点的稳定性所决定。由于具有反幺正对称性的费米子 FGS 存在费米液体不稳定性，我们还讨论了用某种特定的投影纠缠对态（PEPS）ansatz 来表示费米子 FGS 的可能性；我们认为某种构造能够为鞍点相提供有效描述，但不能有效描述非局域收缩相。最后，我们讨论了这一结果在非平衡系统以及稳定目标双线性序方面的潜在意义。

articles.title: Asymmetric optical transmission from broken interface-orientation symmetry in self-shadowed grating metallizations
articles.title_zh: 由自阴影光栅金属化中破缺的界面取向对称性引发的非互易光传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01755v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reciprocal optical structures can transmit finite-angle illumination asymmetrically when the two illumination directions couple differently to the available diffraction channels. We realize this in a single overlay-free step: oblique metallization of a conventional diffraction grating, where ballistic self-shadowing grows a one-sided, louver-like silver profile. Electron microscopy and Ag mapping show the one-sided silver redistribution on oblique-coated films and its absence on a normal-incidence control. Full-wave Maxwell calculations on the ballistic-growth geometry predict broadband substrate-favored transmission, carried by the transverse-magnetic (TM) polarization in the diffraction regime (contrast up to 2.1) and polarization-independent and spectrally flat (1.5-1.9) deep in the geometric regime; the rejected power is redirected predominantly into specular reflection, and the deposition angle selects the magnitude and sign of the effect (optimum near 45^circ). Calibrated three-color sample-reversal measurements yield dark-corrected substrate-favored ratios that persist in both output-analyzer projections on a 45^circ-coated 1-μm-period film (up to 1.8) and lie within the computed geometric-regime band on a 30-μm-period film (1.5-1.8, with reference-normalized absolute transmittances).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实现了一种可使有限角入射呈现非对称透射的互易光学结构。其核心是在传统衍射光栅上进行斜向金属化，利用弹道自阴影生长出单侧百叶窗式银层结构。实验与全波计算表明，该结构可在衍射区和几何光学区分别产生偏向基底一侧的宽带透射，并且效果随沉积角改变而变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 互易光学结构在有限角入射下也可能表现出非对称透射，这是因为两个入射方向与可用衍射通道的耦合方式不同。我们通过一种单步、无需额外叠层的方法实现了这一点：对传统衍射光栅进行斜向金属化，其中弹道自阴影生长出单侧、百叶窗式的银轮廓。电子显微镜和 Ag 映射显示了在斜向镀膜样品上单侧银再分布的现象，而在正入射对照样品中则没有出现。基于该弹道生长几何的全波 Maxwell 计算预测了偏向基底一侧的宽带透射：在衍射区由横磁（TM）偏振主导，反差可达 2.1；而在几何光学区深处则表现为与偏振无关、光谱平坦的 1.5--1.9。被拒绝的功率主要被重新导向镜面反射；沉积角决定该效应的幅度与符号，最佳值接近 45°。经校准的三色样品翻转测量得到，经暗场修正后、偏向基底一侧的比值在 45° 镀膜、1 μm 周期薄膜的两个输出分析器投影下均保持存在（最高达 1.8），并在 30 μm 周期薄膜上落入计算得到的几何区间范围（1.5--1.8，以参考归一化的绝对透射率表示）。

articles.title: Quantum Circuit and Tensor Network Implementation of the 2D Acoustic Wave Equation
articles.title_zh: 二维声波方程的量子电路与张量网络实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01904v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a cohesive framework for simulating seismic wave propagation utilizing quantum computing paradigms and their classical tensor network equivalents. We detail a quantum circuit-based formulation for the explicit finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solution of the two-dimensional acoustic wave equation and map this quantum architecture onto a tensor train representation, namely for Matrix Product State (MPS). The MPS solver enables deterministic simulation of large-scale wavefield dynamics on classical high-performance computing systems. We demonstrate the MPS representation by computing 2D seismic wavefields on the Marmousi model. Our results indicate that the MPS representation is a viable direction for computing and scaling wavefield propagation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个统一框架，用于借助量子计算范式及其经典张量网络对应形式来模拟地震波传播。作者给出了二维声波方程显式有限差分时域（FDTD）求解的量子电路表述，并将其映射为矩阵乘积态（MPS）张量训练表示。基于 Marmousi 模型的数值示例表明，该方法有望用于大尺度波场传播计算与扩展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个统一框架，用于借助量子计算范式及其经典张量网络对应形式来模拟地震波传播。我们详细给出了二维声波方程显式有限差分时域（FDTD）求解的量子电路表述，并将该量子体系结构映射到张量训练表示，即矩阵乘积态（MPS）。MPS 求解器使得在经典高性能计算系统上能够对大规模波场动力学进行确定性模拟。我们通过在 Marmousi 模型上计算二维地震波场来展示 MPS 表示。我们的结果表明，MPS 表示是实现波场传播计算与扩展的一个可行方向。

articles.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization of Composite Functions for Image-Based Inverse Problems in Materials Characterization
articles.title_zh: 用于材料表征图像型反问题的复合函数可扩展贝叶斯优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02126v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Estimating physical parameters from scientific images is a common inverse problem in materials characterization that often relies on expensive physics-based simulations. In electron microscopy, specimen thickness and crystal mistilt are critical parameters that govern how electrons scatter through the sample, and therefore the accuracy of any atomic-scale structure recovered from it. They are commonly inferred by matching experimental position-averaged convergent-beam electron diffraction (PACBED) patterns to simulated ones, but grid searches scale poorly and neural-network methods require extensive pretraining that may not transfer to new conditions. Here, we propose scalable Bayesian optimization of composite functions (SBOCF), a simulation-efficient method that exploits the known composite structure of the image-matching objective and the intermediate information contained in simulated images. By representing PACBED images with patch-level summaries and two correction terms, SBOCF preserves the original pixel-wise objective while reducing the number of modeled outputs from 24,649 to 11. Under a budget of 50 simulator evaluations, SBOCF outperformed standard Bayesian optimization with expected improvement on synthetic SrTiO3 benchmarks with thick and thin specimens, reducing the median final SSE by up to 290x in the thick-sample case. On experimental data, SBOCF produced parameter estimates consistent with previously reported values without task-specific pretraining. For a simulated mistilted specimen, using the SBOCF estimates in a downstream ptychographic reconstruction recovered sharp atoms that were otherwise blurred. These results establish SBOCF as a promising approach for inverse problems involving expensive simulators and high-dimensional structured outputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 图像型反问题在材料表征中十分常见，通常需要代价高昂的物理模拟。本文提出一种利用已知复合结构和中间模拟图像信息的可扩展贝叶斯优化方法 SBOCF，用于从 PACBED 图像中高效估计样品厚度和晶体倾斜等参数。实验表明，该方法在较少模拟预算下优于标准贝叶斯优化，并可在实验与下游重建任务中给出有竞争力的结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从科学图像中估计物理参数是材料表征中的常见反问题，往往依赖代价高昂的基于物理的模拟。在电子显微学中，样品厚度和晶体微倾斜是决定电子如何在样品中散射的关键参数，因此也决定了从样品中恢复原子尺度结构的准确性。通常通过将实验的 position-averaged convergent-beam electron diffraction（PACBED）图样与模拟图样进行匹配来推断这些参数，但网格搜索扩展性很差，而神经网络方法又需要大量预训练，且可能无法迁移到新的条件。这里，我们提出了用于复合函数的可扩展贝叶斯优化（SBOCF），这是一种模拟高效的方法，它利用图像匹配目标的已知复合结构以及模拟图像中包含的中间信息。通过用块级汇总和两个修正项表示 PACBED 图像，SBOCF 在保持原始像素级目标的同时，将建模输出数从 24,649 个降至 11 个。在 50 次模拟评估的预算下，SBOCF 在具有厚样品和薄样品的合成 SrTiO3 基准上优于采用期望改进的标准贝叶斯优化，并在厚样品情形下将最终 SSE 的中位数最多降低了 290 倍。在实验数据上，SBOCF 给出的参数估计与先前报道的数值一致，而且无需任务特定预训练。对于一个模拟的微倾斜样品，将 SBOCF 的估计值用于下游 ptychographic 重建后，可恢复出原本模糊的清晰原子结构。这些结果表明，SBOCF 是处理涉及昂贵模拟器和高维结构化输出的反问题的一种很有前景的方法。

articles.title: Multidimensional Light Detection with Symmetry-engineered Heterojunctions
articles.title_zh: 基于对称工程异质结的多维光探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02161v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Miniaturised multidimensional light detection, encompassing full-Stokes polarimetry and spectroscopy in ultracompact footprints, is attracting growing interest for its potential to capture a comprehensive set of light properties in portable platforms. Although significant progress has been made in miniaturised schemes for independent polarisation and spectral detection, achieving simultaneous high-dimensional light detection remains an outstanding challenge that limits their development toward full integration. We overcome this limitation by breaking the rotational and inversion symmetries in a symmetry-engineered van der Waals heterojunction to realise an ultracompact multidimensional photodetector. The dual symmetry breaking gives rise to non-trivial quantum geometric and topological features, enabling simultaneous broadband polarisation- and spectrum-resolved light detection, in contrast to previous van der Waals material-based devices, which could detect only one of these modalities. Our device, with an effective area of only 10 micron x 10 micron, reconstructs full-Stokes polarisation with overall root-mean-square errors below 0.05 and resolves spectral peaks separated by 0.4 nm, capabilities not previously achieved in single-pixel detectors. By unifying high-fidelity polarimetry and sub-nanometre spectroscopy in a single electrically tunable junction, our work eliminates the need for cascaded detection architectures and establishes a foundation for multidimensional detector arrays for integrated photonics, quantum information processing, and precision imaging.
articles.abstract_zh: 面向全斯托克斯偏振和光谱一体化的微型多维光探测正受到越来越多关注。作者通过在范德华异质结中打破旋转与反演对称性，构建了一种超紧凑多维光电探测器，可同时实现宽带偏振分辨与光谱分辨探测。器件面积仅 10 微米见方，却能实现高精度全斯托克斯重建和亚纳米级光谱分辨。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微型化多维光探测，包括全斯托克斯偏振测量和超紧凑器件中的光谱探测，因其在便携式平台上捕获全面光学信息的潜力而日益受到关注。尽管在实现微型化独立偏振探测和光谱探测方面已取得显著进展，但同时实现高维光探测仍然是一个未解决的挑战，限制了其向全集成方向的发展。我们通过在一种经对称性工程设计的范德华异质结中打破旋转与反演对称性，克服了这一限制，从而实现了一种超紧凑多维光电探测器。双重对称性破缺产生了非平庸的量子几何与拓扑特征，使其能够同时进行宽带偏振分辨和光谱分辨光探测，这与此前只能检测其中一种模态的基于范德华材料的器件形成对比。我们的器件有效面积仅为 10 微米 × 10 微米，却能够重建总体均方根误差低于 0.05 的全斯托克斯偏振，并分辨出间隔 0.4 nm 的光谱峰，这些能力在单像素探测器中前所未有。通过将高保真偏振测量与亚纳米光谱学统一到单个电可调结中，我们的工作消除了级联探测架构的需要，并为集成光子学、量子信息处理和精密成像中的多维探测器阵列奠定了基础。

articles.title: Memory as an Energy Landscape---Hopfield
articles.title_zh: 记忆作为一种能量景观——Hopfield
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02195v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This chapter reconstructs the Hopfield network as a physical theory of memory rather than merely an early neural-network algorithm. It begins with the problem as it stood before 1982-threshold logic, Hebbian association, correlation memories, and recurrent binary networks-and isolates what Hopfield's synthesis added: a dynamical definition of content-addressable memory, a symmetric recurrent architecture with a Lyapunov function, a Hebbian embedding of patterns in its couplings, and a physical account of basins, robustness, and graceful degradation. The binary and graded-response energy functions are derived in full, together with the signal-crosstalk decomposition governing pattern stability, the mean-field theory of retrieval at extensive load, and the zero-temperature retrieval spinodal at (alpha 0.138) established by Amit, Gutfreund, and Sompolinsky. The energy-based program is then followed through analog optimization networks, polynomial dense associative memories, exponential interactions, and modern continuous Hopfield updates, including the precise conditions under which the update becomes scaled dot-product attention. Throughout, capacity claims are tied to their disorder ensemble, scaling limit, and success criterion, showing why numerically different storage limits need not conflict. A closing assessment distinguishes established results from surviving principles, assumption-bound limitations, and open problems, treating the Hopfield network as an effective theory whose symmetry, locality, and point-neuron assumptions delimit its biological reach. Fixed-seed numerical experiments expose the mechanisms discussed but do not substitute for analytical results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本章将 Hopfield 网络重构为一种关于记忆的物理理论，而不仅仅是早期神经网络算法。作者从 1982 年之前的阈值逻辑、Hebb 联想、相关记忆与递归二元网络出发，系统梳理 Hopfield 综合所引入的内容寻址记忆、具有 Lyapunov 函数的对称递归结构、模式在耦合中的 Hebb 嵌入，以及吸引域、鲁棒性和渐进退化的物理图像。文中进一步给出了二元与分级响应能量函数、模式稳定性的信号-串扰分解、极大负载下检索的平均场理论，以及 Amit 等人建立的零温检索自旋odal 等结果，并讨论了其与现代注意力机制的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本章将 Hopfield 网络重构为一种关于记忆的物理理论，而不仅仅是一个早期神经网络算法。它从 1982 年之前的相关问题出发——阈值逻辑、Hebb 联想、相关记忆以及递归二元网络——并提炼出 Hopfield 的综合贡献：内容寻址记忆的动力学定义、带有 Lyapunov 函数的对称递归结构、模式在其耦合中的 Hebb 嵌入，以及关于吸引域、鲁棒性和渐进退化的物理描述。二元和分级响应能量函数都被完整推导出来，同时还给出了支配模式稳定性的信号-串扰分解、在广延负载下检索的平均场理论，以及由 Amit、Gutfreund 和 Sompolinsky 建立的零温检索自旋odal（alpha 0.138）。随后，能量基程序被延伸到模拟优化网络、多项式稠密联想记忆、指数相互作用以及现代连续 Hopfield 更新，包括该更新何时精确等同于缩放点积注意力的条件。贯穿全文，容量宣称都与其无序系综、缩放极限和成功判据相联系，说明为何数值上不同的存储极限并不必然矛盾。最后的评述区分了已确立的结果、仍然有效的原则、受假设限制的局限以及开放问题，并将 Hopfield 网络视为一个有效理论，其中对称性、局域性和点神经元假设共同限定了其生物学适用范围。固定随机种子的数值实验展示了所讨论的机制，但不能替代解析结果。

articles.title: Low-Temperature Transport in Li-Ion Battery EC/EMC/FEC Electrolytes: Molecular Dynamics and Machine-Learning Modeling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02824v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-temperature operation imposes severe limitations on lithium-ion transport in battery electrolytes, yet the coupled effects of solvent composition and fluorinated additives in the cold-temperature regime remain insufficiently resolved. Here, we combine classical molecular dynamics (MD) and machine learning (ML) to investigate 1 M LiPF₆ electrolytes containing ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), and EC/EMC (3:7), with 0-10 mol% fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), from 298 to 233 K. MD simulations quantify Li⁺ self-diffusion, Nernst-Einstein (NE) and Green-Kubo (GK) conductivities and local coordination, while Gaussian-process surrogates model conductivity across composition and temperature. Cooling produces a pronounced transport penalty, particularly in EMC-containing electrolytes, whose GK conductivity decreases by more than 98% at 233 K, compared with approximately 90% in EC-rich systems. Li⁺ self-diffusion activation energies are 0.49-0.54 eV for EMC-containing systems and 0.27-0.29 eV for EC-based systems. Within the EC family, 0-2 mol% FEC gives comparable cold-temperature transport, whereas 5-10 mol% FEC shows lower conductivity retention at the coldest simulated temperature. The analyzed coordination channels remain solvent dominated, while direct Li⁺-FEC coordination is not quantified in the present RDF set.The Gaussian-process surrogates achieve composition-disjoint cross-validated RMSE values of 0.56 and 0.57 mS cm⁻¹ for NE and GK conductivity. Within the simulated liquid-state trajectories, temperature and host-solvent composition dominate the bulk-transport response, with FEC acting as a secondary modifier.

articles.title: d⁰-d half-Heusler alloys: A potential class of advanced spintronic materials
articles.abstract: arXiv:1701.08397v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The possibility of ferromagnetic half-metallicity in lithium-based half-Heusler alloys, such as MnPLi, has been theoretically explored before [Damewood et al., Phys. Rev. B 91, 064409 (2015)], although at optimized lattice constants such lithiated manganese pnictides are predicted to be ordinary ferromagnets and therefore not suitable for spintronic applications. In the following, however, it is shown by first principles density functional calculations that half-Heusler alloys formed by 3d transition metals and d⁰ alkali or alkaline-earth metals, which are defined by the valence electronic configuration ns¹,²,(n-1)d⁰, can produce all kinds of half-metallic behavior at optimized lattice constants including the elusive Dirac half-metallicity that is theoretically predicted for the first time in a three-dimensional prototype MnPK. Together with the predicted magnetic and mechanical stability, this could pave the way for massless and dissipationless spintronics of the future. Among other technologically important features of the prototype Dirac half-metal MnPK, are the maximal moment d-shell ferromagnetism, high Fermi velocity of Dirac fermions that is comparable with that in graphene, and a wide half-metallic gap. Furthermore, by considering the prototype conventional half-metal VSbSr, the introduction of d⁰ metals is shown to substantially reduce the hull distance and produce true metastability in the otherwise instable chemical structure of zinc-blende transition metal pnictides--in this case zinc-blende VSb--without altering the `p-d exchange' that is mainly responsible for their half-metallicity, thus bringing their realization and potential applications in spintronics a step closer to reality.

articles.title: Anomalous vortex shape in a frustrated superconductor hosting chiral multicomponent order parameters
articles.abstract: arXiv:2306.06711v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multicomponent chiral superconductors can host spatially separated superconducting components within a single Abrikosov vortex, leading to unconventional, anisotropic vortex shapes forbidden in conventional single-component superconductors. Here, using spectroscopic scanning tunneling microscopy at 0.3 K, we investigate the mixed state of the spinel superconductor LiTi2O4 (Tc = 13 K). In the low-field regime, where vortex-vortex interactions are minimized and the intrinsic single-vortex shape is preserved, reasonably isolated triangular Abrikosov vortices are directly visualized with high statistical significance. Remarkably, the vortex orientation is locked to crystallographic domains rather than the magnetic-field direction, revealing a hidden chirality selectivity embedded in the zero-field electronic state.

articles.title: Global fermionic mode optimization via swap gates
articles.title_zh: 通过交换门实现全局费米子模优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.03449v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An optimal choice of single-particle modes leads to an optimal tensor network-based compression of the many-body wave function for systems of indistinguishable particles, which compression can be essential for large, close-to-critical systems. The proposed mode optimization relies on the minimization of the block entropy area, a global quantity that measures entanglement of the wave function along the one-dimensional chain of modes. Extension of the two-site DMRG algorithm by nearest-neighbor mode optimizations is straightforward, but it performs poorly without systematic reordering of modes. Moreover, finding a stationary optimal point in the combination of the fixed-rank MPS manifold and the unitary group of mode rotations requires optimization for every generator, i.e., for every two-mode pair. Here, a systematic joint optimization protocol over the MPS manifold and the full unitary group is presented in which every two-mode pair is accessed by a carefully constructed sequence of two-qubit operations, including swap-gate controlled permutations. Large-scale DMRG simulations of strongly correlated two-dimensional fermionic lattice models and the multireference Fe₄S₄ transition metal cluster demonstrate rapid convergence towards the optimum, achieving low energy and low entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对不可区分粒子体系，最优单粒子模的选择能够优化基于张量网络的多体波函数压缩。本文提出一种在矩阵乘积态流形与完整模旋转幺正群之间进行联合优化的系统方案，并通过交换门控制的排列访问任意两模。大规模DMRG模拟表明，该方法可快速收敛到低能量、低纠缠的优化状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 选择最优的单粒子模，可以实现对不可区分粒子体系多体波函数的最优张量网络压缩；对于规模大且接近临界的体系，这种压缩可能至关重要。所提出的模优化依赖于最小化块熵面积这一目标，该全局量度量波函数沿一维模链的纠缠。将最近邻模优化扩展到双位点DMRG算法是直接的，但如果不对模进行系统重排，其性能会很差。此外，要在固定秩MPS流形与模旋转的幺正群组合中寻找一个驻定的最优点，就需要针对每个生成元进行优化，也就是针对每一对模进行优化。本文提出了一种在MPS流形与完整幺正群之间进行系统联合优化的方案，其中每一对模都通过精心构造的双量子比特操作序列来访问，该序列包括由交换门控制的排列操作。对强关联二维费米子晶格模型和多参考态Fe₄S₄过渡金属团簇开展的大规模DMRG模拟表明，该方法能够快速收敛到最优解，同时实现低能量和低纠缠。

articles.title: Empirical approaches to Fröhlich excitonic polarons in polar semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 极性半导体中弗勒里希激子极化子的经验研究方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.07406v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The excitonic correlation between electron and hole and these carriers' interactions with underlying crystal lattice govern the opto-electronic response of semiconductors. The latter is dominated in ionic crystals by the Fröhlich interaction corresponding to the long-range electric field generated by polar phonons. Theoretical description of complex interplay of these two effects, excitonic and polaronic, has been a formidable challenge. The present paper reviews the physics of Fröhlich excitonic polarons from the point of view of empirical approaches and supplements it with a few original developments. At first, we review the models for excitonic polarons in ionic semiconductors built analogously to Lee-Low-Pines (LLP) model for free polarons, and later extended by Pollman and Büttner (PB). These models have been applied in past to the case of weakly interacting polarons (e.g. GaAs). We consider their applicability to ionic solids such as TlCl or 3D lead halide perovskites, where electron-hole correlations are relatively stronger. In these compounds, electrons and holes have almost equal effective masses, which allows us to derive a new analytical expressions of PB effective interaction potential. The refined Kane approach to PB's model is shown to (i) bridge the regime between weakly interacting polarons and excitonic polarons with strong electron-hole correlations and (ii) recover the LLP model for free polarons in the limit of vanishing correlation. Various developments carried out in this paper also include extension of Kane and PB's semi-empirical models to incorporate Fröhlich-like interaction with multiple polar phonons, essential for reconciliation of experimental observations in multi-atom systems. In the end, we discuss the relation of the empirical approaches with ab initio methods and provide an outlook of their application to lower-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子与空穴之间的激子关联，以及它们与晶格的相互作用，共同决定半导体的光电响应，其中离子晶体中的弗勒里希相互作用尤为重要。本文综述基于经验模型描述弗勒里希激子极化子的理论，并发展适用于强电子-空穴关联和多极性声子体系的新表达式与模型。文章还讨论这些经验方法与从头算方法的关系，以及其向低维体系的拓展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子与空穴之间的激子关联，以及这些载流子与 underlying 晶格之间的相互作用，共同支配半导体的光电响应。对于离子晶体，后者主要由弗勒里希相互作用决定，该相互作用对应于极性声子产生的长程电场。对这两种效应，即激子效应与极化子效应之间复杂相互作用的理论描述，一直是一个极具挑战的问题。本文从经验方法的角度综述弗勒里希激子极化子的物理，并补充若干原创性发展。首先，本文回顾了离子半导体中激子极化子的模型，这些模型仿照自由极化子的Lee-Low-Pines（LLP）模型建立，随后又由Pollmann和Büttner（PB）加以扩展。这些模型过去曾应用于弱相互作用极化子的情形，例如GaAs。本文考察其对于TlCl或三维铅卤钙钛矿等离子固体的适用性，在这些材料中电子-空穴关联相对更强。在这些化合物中，电子和空穴的有效质量几乎相等，这使我们能够推导出PB有效相互作用势的新解析表达式。我们表明，改进的Kane方法应用于PB模型时，可以做到两点：（i）连接弱相互作用极化子与电子-空穴强关联的激子极化子区域；（ii）在关联趋于消失的极限下恢复自由极化子的LLP模型。本文还开展了其他若干发展，包括将Kane模型和PB半经验模型扩展到包含多个极性声子的弗勒里希型相互作用；对于多原子体系而言，这对于协调实验观测结果是必不可少的。最后，我们讨论经验方法与从头算方法之间的关系，并展望其在低维体系中的应用。
articles.focus_summary: 本文综述极性半导体中弗洛里希激子极化子的经验理论，讨论电子空穴关联与极性声子晶格耦合共同作用下的光电响应。文章重点评估适用于GaAs、TlCl及三维铅卤钙钛矿等体系的模型，并分析强电子空穴关联条件下的理论适用性。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的卤化物钙钛矿、电子-声子耦合、极化子、载流子动力学、热载流子弛豫和光电性质研究直接相关。虽然主要是经验模型综述，但其中对激子极化子和长程库仑相互作用的处理可补充第一性原理和非绝热动力学研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可将弗洛里希耦合与第一性原理声子、介电响应及载流子有效质量结合，建立适用于具体钙钛矿材料的激子极化子模型。进一步研究缺陷、界面和温度对极化子形成、载流子复合及迁移率的影响。

articles.title: Evidence for spontaneous breaking of a continuous symmetry at a non-conformal quantum critical point in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维非共形量子临界点连续对称性自发破缺的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.09097v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we present numerical evidence for the spontaneous breaking of a continuous U(1) symmetry in a nearest-neighbor interacting spin-1 chain at a quantum critical point separating two XY quasi-long-range ordered phases distinguished by a spontaneously broken Z₂ symmetry. Remarkably, the continuous symmetry breaking emerges precisely at the critical point of the discrete order parameter, suggesting a novel mechanism beyond currently established scenarios. At criticality, the XY correlations develop true long-range order, accompanied by a finite perpendicular magnetization, a zero-frequency Bragg peak in the transverse dynamical structure factor, and sharp gapless collective excitations. From complementary static and dynamical observables, we quantitatively determine the critical exponents, obtaining a dynamical exponent z=1.50±0.04 and an anomalous dimension η=1.04±0.03. Remarkably, the value of z coincides with the one-dimensional Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) exponent despite the system being an equilibrium quantum many-body system. We further show that the non-interacting continuum limit is equivalent to the recently introduced transverse quantum fluid, displaying their off-diagonal long-ranged order in one dimension. Complementing the numerical study, we derive the renormalization-group flow equations of the continuum theory to second order in the ε expansion. We identify an interacting fixed point whose critical behavior differs from the Ising universality class already at two-loop order, although the perturbative exponents remain far from the numerical values.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在最近邻相互作用的自旋1链中，给出量子临界点处连续U(1)对称性自发破缺的数值证据，该临界点分隔两个具有自发Z₂对称性破缺的XY准长程有序相。临界点处出现真正的XY长程有序、有限的垂直磁化、横向动力学结构因子中的零频布拉格峰以及清晰的无能隙集体激发。数值结果得到动力学指数z=1.50±0.04和反常维数η=1.04±0.03，且还发现了不同于伊辛普适类的相互作用固定点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文给出了数值证据，表明在一条具有最近邻相互作用的自旋1链中，存在连续U(1)对称性的自发破缺。该现象发生在一个量子临界点处，该临界点分隔两个XY准长程有序相，而这两个相由自发破缺的Z₂对称性区分。值得注意的是，连续对称性的破缺恰好出现在离散序参量的临界点处，这暗示了一种超越当前已确立情形的新机制。在临界点处，XY关联发展为真正的长程有序，并伴随着有限的垂直磁化、横向动力学结构因子中的零频布拉格峰，以及尖锐的无能隙集体激发。通过互补的静态和动力学观测量，我们定量确定了临界指数，得到动力学指数z=1.50±0.04和反常维数η=1.04±0.03。值得注意的是，z的数值与一维Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）指数相同，尽管这里的体系是一个平衡量子多体体系。我们进一步表明，非相互作用连续极限等价于近期提出的横向量子流体，并展示了它们在一维中的非对角长程有序。作为对数值研究的补充，我们推导了连续理论在ε展开中二阶精度下的重整化群流方程。我们确定了一个相互作用固定点，其临界行为在二圈阶上就已经不同于伊辛普适类，尽管微扰得到的临界指数仍然明显偏离数值结果。

articles.title: Revealing quantum geometry of solids through vacuum fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 通过真空涨落揭示固体的量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.07116v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that quantum fluctuations of electromagnetic fields induce an extensive zero-point energy in insulators. The zero-point energy density is proportional to the quantum fluctuation of electric polarization in the many-body ground state, a fundamental quantum geometric property of solids known as the quantum weight. For fields produced by a superconducting LC circuit, the zero-point energy results in a repulsive force between the circuit and the material and an attractive force on the capacitor plates, which we call quantum geometric force. The force on the capacitor plates is proportional to the quantum weight, inversely proportional to the plate area, and independent of the plate distance. The proposed effects provide direct experimental access to the many-body quantum geometry and reveal a new quantum geometric effect in macroscopic solids induced by vacuum fluctuation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，电磁场的量子涨落能够在绝缘体中诱导广延的零点能，而零点能密度正比于多体基态中电极化的量子涨落，即量子权重。对于由超导LC电路产生的场，这种零点能会导致电路与材料之间的排斥力以及电容器极板之间的吸引力。相关力学效应为直接探测固体多体量子几何提供了实验途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，电磁场的量子涨落会在绝缘体中诱导广延的零点能。零点能密度正比于多体基态中电极化的量子涨落，而后者是固体的一种基本量子几何性质，称为量子权重。对于由超导LC电路产生的场，零点能会在电路与材料之间产生排斥力，并在电容器极板上产生吸引力；我们将后者称为量子几何力。电容器极板所受的力正比于量子权重，与极板面积成反比，并且与极板间距无关。所提出的效应为直接实验探测多体量子几何提供了途径，同时揭示了一种由真空涨落在宏观固体中诱导的新型量子几何效应。

articles.title: Composition-dependent bulk properties of intercalated transition metal dichalcogenides Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂
articles.title_zh: 插层过渡金属二硫属化物Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂的成分依赖体性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26069v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a systematic study of the composition-dependent bulk properties in Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂ single crystals across a series of precisely controlled cobalt compositions with -4%<δ<8%. By tuning the cobalt stoichiometry, we find that the topological Hall effect is critically sensitive to the intercalant cobalt composition and is completely suppressed when the cobalt composition exceeds δ=+4%. We observe that the longitudinal conductivity is also strongly influenced by the cobalt composition, reaching its maximum value just before the disappearance of the topological Hall effect. Furthermore, heat capacity measurements reveal distinct Sommerfeld coefficients (γ) across different compositions, which exhibit a clear linear scaling with the inverse of the ordinary Hall coefficient (R_H⁻¹). These results demonstrate that composition tuning in Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂ systematically modifies the low-energy electronic degree of freedom, moving beyond a simple dilute impurity picture. Finally, we use the microscopic spin Hamiltonian to explain the stability of experimentally observed M-point modulation vector and the corresponding triple-Q magnetic order. Our findings highlight that the topological properties of this system are highly tunable through precise control of the intercalant concentration, offering a new perspective on the competition between electronic and magnetic orders in intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenides.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂单晶在精确调控钴含量下的成分依赖体性质，覆盖−4%<δ<8%的范围。拓扑霍尔效应对插层钴含量极为敏感，并在δ超过+4%时完全消失；纵向电导率则在该效应消失前达到最大值。热容和霍尔测量表明，成分调控会系统改变低能电子自由度，并影响实验观察到的M点调制矢量及相应的三重Q磁序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂单晶开展了成分依赖体性质的系统研究，研究对象覆盖一系列精确控制的钴含量，其中−4%<δ<8%。通过调节钴的化学计量比，我们发现拓扑霍尔效应对插层钴的成分极其敏感，并且当钴含量超过δ=+4%时完全受到抑制。我们还观察到，纵向电导率同样受到钴含量的强烈影响，并在拓扑霍尔效应消失之前达到最大值。此外，热容测量揭示了不同成分对应不同的Sommerfeld系数γ，而且该系数与普通霍尔系数R_H⁻¹呈现清晰的线性标度关系。这些结果表明，Co₁/₃₍₁±δ₎NbS₂中的成分调控会系统改变低能电子自由度，超越了简单稀释杂质图像的解释。最后，我们利用微观自旋哈密顿量解释了实验观察到的M点调制矢量及相应三重Q磁序的稳定性。我们的研究突出表明，通过精确控制插层浓度，可以高度调节该体系的拓扑性质，并为理解插层过渡金属二硫属化物中电子序与磁序之间的竞争提供了新的视角。

articles.title: Unconventional entanglement scaling and quantum criticality in the long-range spin-one Heisenberg chain with single-ion anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 具有单离子各向异性的长程自旋一海森堡链中的非常规纠缠标度与量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12754v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Long-range interactions can fundamentally reshape the low-energy properties of low-dimensional quantum matter, altering both continuous symmetry breaking and topological phenomena. However, their impact on the quantum criticality separating these regimes remains poorly understood. We determine the ground-state phase diagram and critical properties of the spin-one Heisenberg chain with single-ion anisotropy and staggered antiferromagnetic power-law interactions, using matrix-product state (MPS) calculations complemented by high-order series expansions (pCUT+MC). Such long-range, non-frustrated interactions circumvent the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner theorem, thereby stabilizing continuous symmetry breaking (CSB) phases in direct competition with the Haldane phase. We map out the resulting phase diagram and analyze the entanglement entropy scaling behavior in the U(1) and SU(2) CSB phases, finding logarithmic corrections beyond the short-range, universal contributions expected from linearly dispersed Goldstone modes. We further characterize all critical boundaries through finite-size scaling of either the entanglement entropy or the staggered magnetization. In particular, the large-D-to-U(1)-CSB transition exhibits unconventional, continuously varying critical exponents as a function of the long-range decay exponent with a strong dependence on the imposed boundary conditions leading to distinct finite-size scalings for sufficiently long-range potentials. Remarkably, the Haldane-to-U(1)-CSB transition likewise displays unconventional quantum criticality with distinct continuously varying critical exponents. Our work positions this model as a target for near-term atomic platforms with tunable long-range couplings and exhibiting natural single-ion anisotropy, offering a minimal playground for exploring the interplay between long-range interactions, continuous symmetry breaking, and topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用矩阵乘积态计算和高阶级数展开，研究了带单离子各向异性并具有交错反铁米幂律相互作用的自旋1海森堡链的基态相图与临界性质。长程非受挫相互作用能够绕开Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner定理，从而稳定与Haldane相竞争的连续对称性破缺相。研究发现，纠缠熵存在超出短程普适贡献的对数修正，且多个相变边界表现出随长程衰减指数连续变化的非常规临界指数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长程相互作用能够从根本上重塑低维量子物质的低能性质，改变连续对称性破缺现象和拓扑现象。然而，它们对分隔这些区域的量子临界性的影响仍然缺乏充分理解。我们利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）计算，并结合高阶级数展开（pCUT+MC），确定了具有单离子各向异性和交错反铁米幂律相互作用的自旋1海森堡链的基态相图与临界性质。这种长程且不受挫的相互作用能够绕开Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner定理，从而稳定连续对称性破缺（CSB）相，使其直接与Haldane相竞争。我们绘制了相应的相图，并分析了U(1)和SU(2)连续对称性破缺相中的纠缠熵标度行为，发现除了线性色散Goldstone模所预期的短程普适贡献之外，还存在对数修正。我们还通过纠缠熵或交错磁化的有限尺寸标度，对所有临界边界进行了表征。特别是，大-D相到U(1)-CSB相的转变表现出非常规的临界行为，其临界指数随长程衰减指数连续变化；当势足够长程时，所施加的边界条件会产生强烈影响，并导致不同的有限尺寸标度。值得注意的是，Haldane相到U(1)-CSB相的转变同样表现出非常规量子临界性，并具有不同的连续变化临界指数。我们的工作将该模型确定为近期原子平台的研究目标；这些平台具有可调长程耦合和天然的单离子各向异性，为探索长程相互作用、连续对称性破缺与拓扑之间的相互作用提供了一个最简实验场。

articles.title: Nearly Complete Charge--Spin Conversion via Strain-Eliminated Fermi Pockets in d-Wave Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 通过应变消除d波交替磁体中的费米口袋，实现近乎完全的电荷-自旋转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.21779v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ideal d-wave altermagnets with nearly orthogonal flat Fermi surfaces enable complete spin-channel separation and 100% theoretical charge--spin conversion efficiency (CSE). The metallic altermagnet KV₂Se₂O exemplifies this, but realistic samples host residual elliptical Fermi pockets that enhance charge conductivity while suppressing spin conductivity, drastically reducing CSE. Here we show that in-plane equibiaxial tensile strain systematically eliminates these parasitic pockets, restoring the flat-band geometry. Our first-principles calculations reveal that CSE increases monotonically with strain, reaching a record sim96% at 4% strain. An effective tight-binding model confirms that pocket suppression, governed by reduced next-nearest-neighbor hoppings, is the dominant mechanism. We further identify an unconventional out-of-plane spin current component with CSE sim55% at optimal orientations, enabling field-free perpendicular magnetization switching. Moreover, the same strain-driven removal of parasitic pockets yields giant TMR enhancement in KV₂Se₂O-based magnetic tunnel junctions, from 10⁵% to 10⁹%, and the giant TMR persists over a wide energy window near the Fermi level. These findings establish strain engineering as a clean, widely applicable strategy to maximize CSE and magnetoresistance in d-wave altermagnets, and provide predictive descriptors for screening high-efficiency spintronic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 理想的d波交替磁体具有近乎正交的平坦费米面，可实现自旋通道完全分离和理论上100%的电荷-自旋转换效率。本文表明，面内等双轴拉伸应变能够系统消除KV₂Se₂O中的残余椭圆费米口袋，使转换效率在4%应变下达到约96%。同一机制还可产生约55%的面外自旋流转换效率，并将基于KV₂Se₂O的磁性隧道结隧穿磁阻从10⁵%提高至10⁹%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有近乎正交平坦费米面的理想d波交替磁体能够实现自旋通道完全分离，并达到理论上的100%电荷-自旋转换效率（CSE）。金属交替磁体KV₂Se₂O是这一情形的典型代表，但实际样品中存在残余的椭圆费米口袋；这些费米口袋会增强电荷电导、抑制自旋电导，从而大幅降低CSE。在本文中，我们表明，面内等双轴拉伸应变能够系统地消除这些寄生费米口袋，恢复平坦能带几何。我们的第一性原理计算显示，CSE随应变单调增加，并在4%应变下达到约96%的创纪录数值。有效紧束缚模型证实，费米口袋的抑制由次近邻跃迁减小所控制，这是其主导机制。我们还发现了一种非常规的面外自旋流分量，在最佳取向下其CSE可达到约55%，从而能够实现无外场的垂直磁化翻转。此外，由应变驱动的寄生费米口袋去除还会使基于KV₂Se₂O的磁性隧道结中的巨大隧穿磁阻（TMR）从10⁵%增强到10⁹%，并且在费米能级附近较宽的能量窗口内保持巨大TMR。上述结果表明，应变工程是最大化d波交替磁体中CSE和磁阻的一种清洁且具有广泛适用性的策略，同时为筛选高效率自旋电子材料提供了可预测的描述符。

articles.title: Symmetry-Selective Topological Magnon Engineering by Phonon Angular Momentum
articles.title_zh: 通过声子角动量实现对称性选择性的拓扑磁振子工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28425v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamical control of Berry curvature remains an outstanding challenge in the engineering of topological phases. Here, we demonstrate control of magnon band structures via coherently driven phonons, based on ab initio spin-lattice coupling and Floquet theory. We show that this control is symmetry selective: linearly polarized phonons leave the spectrum unchanged, whereas circular and elliptical phonons carrying finite phonon angular momentum (PAM) induce chiral interactions that open and tune gaps at Dirac points, generating and reversing topological magnon phases. The gap magnitude and Chern numbers are directly governed by the PAM, enabling handedness-selective topology control. Applied to monolayer CrI₃, and supported by symmetry analysis, our results establish driven lattice dynamics as a general route to engineering topological bosonic excitations and a versatile platform for Floquet control of magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理自旋-晶格耦合与Floquet理论，展示了利用相干驱动声子控制磁振子能带结构的方法。线偏振声子不改变能谱，而携带有限声子角动量的圆偏振和椭圆偏振声子会诱导手性相互作用，在Dirac点打开并调节能隙，从而产生或反转拓扑磁振子相。能隙大小和Chern数由声子角动量直接控制，并以单层CrI₃为例说明了这种对称性选择性的拓扑调控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动态控制Berry曲率仍然是拓扑相工程中的一个重要挑战。在这里，我们基于从头算自旋-晶格耦合和Floquet理论，展示了通过相干驱动声子控制磁振子能带结构。我们表明，这种控制具有对称性选择性：线偏振声子不会改变能谱，而携带有限声子角动量（PAM）的圆偏振和椭圆偏振声子会诱导手性相互作用，在Dirac点打开并调节能隙，从而产生和反转拓扑磁振子相。能隙大小和Chern数由PAM直接决定，因此可以根据偏振手性选择性地控制拓扑。将该方法应用于单层CrI₃，并结合对称性分析，我们的结果表明，驱动晶格动力学是工程化拓扑玻色激发的一条普适路径，也是Floquet磁性控制的多功能平台。

articles.title: Athermality of generalized Gibbs ensembles
articles.title_zh: 广义吉布斯系综的非热性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30762v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Integrable quantum systems evolving from non-equilibrium initial states do not thermalize to conventional Gibbs ensembles (GE). Instead, at long times they relax to generalized Gibbs ensembles (GGEs), which incorporate the full set of local and quasi-local conserved quantities. While GGEs have been extensively studied in the literature, a quantitative analytic characterization of how different they are from ordinary GEs is still lacking. In this work, we address this question by employing the concept of athermality, which we define within quantum resource theory as the relative entropy between a given state and the closest thermal state. By means of integrability techniques we compute the athermality for several quantum quenches in paradigmatic integrable models, including the free XY spin chain, the interacting Lieb-Liniger model, the XXZ spin chain, and the harmonic chain. We find that often the athermality becomes anomalously small when the post-quench Hamiltonian is critical in its ground state, despite probing physics at a finite energy density. We also prove that it systematically develops a singularity at criticality, which is inherited from the entropy of the GGE.
articles.abstract_zh: 从非平衡初态出发演化的可积量子系统通常不会热化到普通吉布斯系综，而会弛豫到包含全部局域和准局域守恒量的广义吉布斯系综。本文借助量子资源理论中的非热性概念，以给定状态与最近热态之间的相对熵定量刻画广义吉布斯系综与普通热系综的差异。对多个典型可积模型的量子淬火计算表明，当淬火后的哈密顿量在基态处于临界状态时，非热性常会异常变小，并在临界点出现继承自广义系综熵的奇异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从非平衡初态出发演化的可积量子系统不会热化到传统的吉布斯系综（GE）。相反，在长时间极限下，它们会弛豫到广义吉布斯系综（GGE），后者纳入了全部局域和准局域守恒量。尽管广义吉布斯系综已经在文献中得到广泛研究，但对于它们与普通吉布斯系综究竟有多大差异，仍缺乏定量的解析刻画。在本文中，我们采用非热性这一概念来处理该问题；在量子资源理论中，非热性被定义为给定状态与距离其最近的热态之间的相对熵。借助可积性技术，我们计算了多个典型可积模型中若干量子淬火过程的非热性，包括自由XY自旋链、相互作用的Lieb-Liniger模型、XXZ自旋链和谐振子链。我们发现，当淬火后的哈密顿量在其基态处于临界状态时，非热性通常会异常变小，尽管此时探测的是有限能量密度下的物理。我们还证明，非热性会系统地在临界点发展出奇异性，而这种奇异性继承自广义吉布斯系综的熵。

articles.title: Stability-threshold control of helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance
articles.title_zh: 通过稳定性阈值控制手性选择性反铁磁共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07488v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance in an antiferromagnetic-insulator/nonmagnetic-metal junction with sublattice-dependent damping and spin-orbit torque. By formulating the linearized Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation as a 2x2 non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem, we analyze the complex resonance frequencies and the stability threshold, using MnF₂ parameters as a representative example of a uniaxial antiferromagnet. We show that the absorption is strongly enhanced near the stability threshold, where one helicity mode becomes weakly damped, leading to linewidth narrowing and pronounced helicity selectivity in the sub-THz regime. The selected helicity can be switched by reversing the current direction, which reverses the spin-orbit torque acting on the interfacial sublattice. These results identify stability-threshold control as a design principle for electrically tunable helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance in uniaxial antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了反铁磁绝缘体/非磁金属结中具有亚晶格依赖阻尼和自旋轨道力矩的手性选择性反铁磁共振。通过将线性化Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程表述为2×2非厄米特征值问题，研究者分析了复共振频率和稳定性阈值，并以MnF₂参数作为单轴反铁磁体的代表。结果表明，在稳定性阈值附近，某一手性模的阻尼减弱，从而产生增强吸收、线宽变窄以及亚太赫兹频段显著的手性选择性；反转电流方向即可切换所选择的手性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了反铁磁绝缘体/非磁金属结中的手性选择性反铁磁共振，其中阻尼和自旋轨道力矩依赖于亚晶格。通过将线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程表述为一个2×2非厄米特征值问题，我们分析了复共振频率和稳定性阈值，并以MnF₂参数作为单轴反铁磁体的代表性示例。我们表明，在稳定性阈值附近，某一手性模式会变得弱阻尼，从而导致吸收显著增强、线宽变窄，并在亚太赫兹频段产生明显的手性选择性。反转电流方向可以切换所选择的手性，因为这会反转作用于界面亚晶格的自旋轨道力矩。这些结果确定了稳定性阈值控制这一设计原则，可用于在单轴反铁磁体中实现电可调的手性选择性反铁磁共振。

articles.title: Hybrid-parity sliding multiferroics
articles.title_zh: 混合宇称滑移多铁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24337v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we introduce a class of hybrid-parity sliding multiferroics in which the spontaneous ferroelectric polarization is coupled to certain nonrelativistic spin splitting components through interlayer sliding, allowing these components to be reversibly switched in an electrical way. Symmetry analysis identifies coplanar magnets as natural platforms for realizing this form of sliding multiferroicity. First-principles calculations establish bilayer VBr₂ as a representative example, demonstrating the coupled reversal of the out-of-plane ferroelectric polarization and the signs of both even- and odd-parity nonrelativistic spin splitting components via an interlayer-sliding pathway. The signs of these nonrelativistic spin splitting components are locked to the sliding-switchable ferroelectric polarization and encoded in the spin-current responses, providing a signature of the coupled ferroic switching. Our findings expand the scope of sliding multiferroics and the functionality of sliding ferroelectrics for low-energy, nonvolatile logic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一类混合宇称滑移多铁体，其中自发铁电极化通过层间滑移与某些非相对论自旋劈裂分量耦合，使这些分量能够以电方式可逆切换。对称性分析表明，共面磁体是实现该类滑移多铁性的天然平台；第一性原理计算则以双层VBr₂为代表，展示了面外铁电极化以及偶宇称和奇宇称非相对论自旋劈裂分量符号的协同反转。该耦合切换可通过自旋流响应加以识别，并有望用于低能耗非易失逻辑器件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们引入了一类混合宇称滑移多铁体，其中自发铁电极化通过层间滑移与某些非相对论自旋劈裂分量耦合，从而使这些分量能够以电学方式可逆切换。对称性分析确定，共面磁体是实现这种滑移多铁性的天然平台。第一性原理计算以双层VBr₂为代表性实例，表明沿层间滑移路径，面外铁电极化以及偶宇称和奇宇称非相对论自旋劈裂分量的符号可以协同反转。这些非相对论自旋劈裂分量的符号与可由滑移切换的铁电极化锁定，并编码在自旋流响应中，从而提供了铁电与磁性耦合切换的特征信号。我们的发现拓展了滑移多铁体和滑移铁电体的研究范围及功能，为低能耗、非易失逻辑器件提供了可能。
articles.focus_summary: 本文提出混合宇称滑移多铁材料概念，研究铁电极化与非相对论自旋劈裂分量之间的耦合。通过对称性分析和第一性原理计算，以双层VBr₂为例，展示了滑移驱动的极化及自旋劈裂符号可逆翻转，并产生相应的自旋流响应。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的滑移铁电、二维范德华磁体、多铁性、对称性分析、自旋输运和磁电耦合方向高度直接相关。其将滑移铁电与非共线或非相对论自旋响应结合的思路，可用于拓展二维多铁和低功耗自旋逻辑材料设计。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究缺陷、应变、层数和莫尔超晶格对滑移路径、磁电耦合及自旋流响应的影响。建议结合自旋哈密顿量、分子动力学或机器学习势评估有限温度下的切换动力学与稳定性。

articles.title: Shortcomings and capacities of real-constrained neural networks in complex spaces
articles.title_zh: 复数空间中实约束神经网络的局限与容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04390v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We find the asymptotic ratio between the storage capacities when enforcing real pre-activations in a complex hypothesis class as opposed to complex ones in the same class. We use weights drawn from the complex Gaussian, which converge asymptotically in norm to the square root of dimension almost surely. Our methods depend on Gardner volume-type comparisons at critical capacity. Our proof relies on an application of the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) formula, nonstandard in literature. With the HCIZ formula, we may obtain a more robust approximation for the final asymptotic ratio. This strategy is applicable to our work specifically since we integrate over the unitary and orthogonal compact manifolds, facilitated via the Weyl integration formula and the Haar measure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在复数假设类中施加实值预激活约束时，其存储容量与同一假设类允许复值预激活时存储容量的渐近比值。研究采用复高斯分布抽取权重，并利用临界容量处的Gardner体积型比较方法。证明中使用了文献中较少采用的Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber公式，并结合Weyl积分公式与Haar测度，对酉群和正交群上的积分得到更稳健的渐近近似。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们求得了在复数假设类中施加实值预激活约束时的存储容量，与同一假设类中允许复值预激活时的存储容量之间的渐近比值。我们采用从复高斯分布中抽取的权重；这些权重的范数几乎必然地在渐近意义下收敛到维数的平方根。我们的方法依赖于临界容量处Gardner体积型的比较。我们的证明依赖于对Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber（HCIZ）公式的一种应用，而这种用法在相关文献中并不常见。借助HCIZ公式，我们能够获得对最终渐近比值更稳健的近似。由于我们需要在酉紧流形和正交紧流形上进行积分，而这可以通过Weyl积分公式和Haar测度实现，因此该策略特别适用于本文的研究。

articles.title: Symmetric mass generation of interacting chiral fermions on a one-dimensional lattice without fermion doubling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24713v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Symmetric mass generation is the interaction-induced opening of a fermion gap without spontaneous symmetry breaking. The anomaly-free 3-4-5-0 model of Wang and Wen provides a minimal one-dimensional setting for this phenomenon, but a direct lattice realization faces two obstacles: fermion doubling for local chiral discretizations and perturbative irrelevance of the six-fermion gapping interaction. We address both obstacles. First, we formulate the model on a strictly one-dimensional tangent-fermion lattice, where a nonlocal hopping produces a single chiral branch without a mirror partner while retaining an efficient tensor-network representation. Second, we add a Hubbard-type density-density interaction (Luttinger parameter K) that reduces the scaling dimension of the 3-4-5-0 interaction from 5 to 5K, making it relevant for K<2/5. Density-matrix renormalization group calculations show the opening of an excitation gap in this regime without the appearance of a degenerate ground state, the hallmark of symmetric mass generation.

articles.title: Geometry-native machine learning reconstruction of DSMC moment fields with support monitoring
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) resolves rarefied-gas dynamics without a constitutive closure, but finite-sample estimates of macroscopic moments converge at markedly different rates. We develop a non-intrusive, geometry-native machine learning reconstruction of the retained two-dimensional moment hierarchy: number density, two velocity components, translational temperature, three pressure-tensor components, and two heat-flux components. From three sampling blocks, the estimator corrects a structured prior learned from development data with a bounded term computed from the current observation, while preserving additive-moment consistency and the measured zero-frequency content. In cavity development tests, the final observation-conditioned estimator, whose prior is a trained MambaIR restoration network, reduces transverse-heat-flux error to 0.658 and 0.672 times that of a ten-block direct average at two rarefied conditions. For a hypersonic cylinder, a cylinder-centred estimator is fixed before evaluation on six new observation/reference pairs. It improves both global transverse heat flux and near-wall normal heat flux in every pair; the ratios of arithmetic-mean normalised root-mean-square errors (NRMSEs) are 0.846 and 0.793, and the Holm-adjusted one-sided exact probabilities are 0.03125.

articles.title: A Probability Model for Pentagonal Prism Dice Rolls
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the realm of probability theory and game design, the study of dice probabilities plays a crucial role. The featured dice are usually fair, so their probabilities can be predicted without rolling the dice. Pentagonal prismatic dice are not fair. Hence, the probabilities are more complicated. Our mathematical model is naturally derived from both the geometric properties of the dice and empirical evidence. Dice of varying sizes but with constant volume were designed. Using a 3D printer with 100 percent infill, the dice were printed and prepared. A machine that simulates dropping dice through a dice tower onto a hard surface was used to obtain about 41,000 results. From these data, a statistical model was constructed that gives probabilities of dice with varying height-to-radius ratios. The formula for the model is based on the centroid solid angle, but with two adjustment parameters due to varying energy and other requirements to transition between different resting aspects. Within the range of height-to-radius ratios tested, the data are within reasonable statistical error of the model.

articles.title: Baseline Climatology of Tornadoes and Waterspouts in the Philippine Archipelago
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tornadoes are documented on every inhabited continent, yet the environmental condition used to anticipate them was developed and validated overwhelmingly on mid-latitude records, leaving tropical regimes largely unexamined. Here, we collected 1,186 tornado and waterspout reports combined in the Philippines spanning the early 1900s to 2025 and paired each with an ERA5 proximity sounding to construct the first baseline climatology and environmental characterization of these severe weather events in the archipelago. Activity concentrates in three corridors, mostly flanked by mountain ranges, one in each major island group, and is sharply phased within a May-October window that closely tracks the annual cycle of thunderstorm frequency. The environments are thermodynamically permissive but kinematically shallow as mean convective available potential energy exceeds typical Great Plains values, while bulk wind difference between the 0-6 km layer stays below 10 kt, diverging from the mid-latitude covariance in which instability and wind shear increase together. Nearly all of the discriminating variance instead resides in the lowest kilometer, where 68-79% of the near-surface horizontal vorticity is streamwise, reaching 96% in the most organized profiles, and the hodographs retain low-level curvature. Consequently, composite indices underestimate even as tornadoes recur, and locally rescaled thresholds are required. Therefore, mid-latitude calibrated convective parameters can misdiagnose tropical-maritime regimes.

articles.title: A monolithic segmented 3D ion trap fabricated from fused silica by selective laser-induced etching
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the design, fabrication, and characterization of a monolithic, segmented, three-dimensional linear Paul ion trap for quantum science applications. The trap is fabricated from a single fused-silica block using selective laser-induced etching (SLE) and is subsequently metallized, forming electrodes isolated by self-shadowing trench structures without the need for layer alignment or external shadow masks. The segmented electrodes allow for shaping of the axial potential, enabling the creation of anharmonic potential wells, such as those required for equidistant ion strings. In addition, they enable shuttling and splitting of ion chains. We discuss key design choices and SLE-imposed constraints on achievable feature sizes, and evaluate electron-beam evaporation and magnetron sputtering as metallization approaches. Across two independent experimental setups, we demonstrate stable trapping and control of linear chains of up to 33 ⁴⁰Ca⁺ ions, including approximately equally spaced configurations. The measured secular frequencies in both traps agree with boundary-element simulations at the percent level, with residual deviations attributed to stray electric fields in the presence of anharmonic axial potentials, rather than fabrication imperfections. We measure axial micromotion field strengths on the order of 100 V/m along the trap axis, in approximate agreement with simulations. For radial mode frequencies near 2 MHz and an ion-electrode distance of 300 um, we measure heating rates of the order of 10 quanta/s in all but one motional mode, which is elevated by a technical noise source. The presented trap design is thus suitable for a wide range of quantum science applications and demonstrates the viability of SLE for the fabrication of finely segmented, monolithic, three-dimensional ion traps.

articles.title: Revisiting the MRX Electron Current Sheet Width with Semi-Collisional Kinetic Simulations at Hydrogen Mass Ratio
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For over eighteen years, the electron current sheet measured in the Magnetic Reconnection Experiment (MRX) has stood a factor of 2--5 wider than predicted by MRX-like kinetic simulations, and the measured electron force balance has not closed with the classical terms alone. As a consequence, the dominant nonideal terms responsible for breaking the frozen-in condition have remained unexplained. Here, two-dimensional kinetic simulations with binary Coulomb collisions are performed in a cylindrical geometry representative of MRX, at the realistic hydrogen mass ratio mᵢ/mₑ = 1836 and at MRX-relevant collisionality. For the first time, these simulations reproduce the measured electron current sheet half-width. The simulated value, δBT = 0.744 ± 0.054~cm or 6.26 ± 0.45 electron skin depths (dₑ), lies within the experimental range of 5.5--7.5~dₑ. The electron force balance closes through the classical channels alone: the pressure-tensor divergence supports 76% of the nonideal electric field and collisional friction the remainder. The historical force-balance deficit reappears only when the simulated layer is sampled at the experimental 3~cm outflow resolution, suggesting that the deficit reflects probe resolution rather than anomalous dissipation. Beyond this reproduction, an analytic model of the layer width is developed that orders the meandering electrons by the coherence of their orbits against collisions. In this model, the Dreicer ratio E_D/|E_y| selects the electrons whose current-carrying motion survives, and the resulting width prediction brackets the measured values across a wide collisionality scan. A discrepancy remains in the width normalized to the local electron gyroradius (ρₑ), whose measured value lies a factor of 3--6 above both the model and the simulations.

articles.title: Learning a general class of admissible multi-species collision operators from molecular dynamics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a structure-preserving, data-driven collision operator for spatially homogeneous multi-species kinetic systems from molecular dynamics (MD). The operator consists of diagonal self-collision blocks and ordered off-diagonal cross-species blocks to describe intra- and inter-species momentum and energy exchange. Within a local and point-wise identifiable kernel class, we develop the necessary and sufficient condition for the admissible kernel class satisfying the conservation laws, the H-theorem, and the frame indifference. Unlike the classical Landau operator, the off-diagonal kernels are not restricted to be symmetric under permutation of the two velocity variables. This unique structural freedom captures the distinct responses of different species to unresolved correlations and many-body effects arising from micro-scale particle interactions. The equivalent parameterizable kernel formalization enables us to learn a generalized data-driven collision operator directly from MD, where the low-rank tensor representations and random sampling are used to achieve efficient kernel training and numerical simulation. Numerical experiments show that the learned operator accurately predicts transport coefficients and the non-equilibrium relaxation, while retaining discrete conservation and entropy production. In particular, it captures plasma kinetics in the moderately coupled regime, where the predictions of both the Landau and the data-driven model restricted to velocity-permutation symmetry show significant discrepancies.

articles.title: Dodecahydrogen uranium: an icosahedral f-electron superatom with 26-electron shell structure
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new icosahedral superatom UH₁₂ is reported and analyzed using post-Hartree-Fock multiconfigurational methods. A RASSCF/CASPT2/RASSI/SINGLE_ANISO workflow is employed to determine the electronic energy levels and magnetic properties. Superatomic characteristics, such as orbital topologies and shell filling order, are discussed. The high hydrogen-to-uranium ratio and potential for optically stimulated decomposition make UH₁₂ worth investigation in the context of hydrogen storage. The electric-dipole transition oscillator strengths of the molecule vanish, while its lowest electronic transitions fall in the THz and infrared ranges. The lowest septet manifold exhibits crystal-field splitting into a 1+3+3 pattern, as expected from icosahedral symmetry. In turn, the interlevel gaps within these crystal-field triplets are 30-150 GHz (1-5 cm⁻¹). The molecule is magnetically isotropic at low fields, while its levels exhibit higher-order Zeeman anisotropy that becomes significant around 2 Tesla. These properties suggest potential relevance for quantum computing, quantum communication, and quantum memory, including qubit- and qudit-based architectures.

articles.title: Latent unified smooth Hamiltonians for excited state chemistry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe a neural network architecture and training procedure designed to model electronic ground and excited states of arbitrary molecular systems. By indirectly learning a latent, implicit basis representation of the electronic-state Hamiltonian, the model offers a unified treatment of multiple electronic states, conical intersections, and non-adiabatic couplings. The formalism can be further extended to learn consistent latent representations of additional operators such as transition dipole moments, for example. To demonstrate the general capabilities of our architecture, we train and evaluate networks on two realistic photochemical systems, thymine and azobenzene. The resulting models accurately reproduce energies and oscillator strengths for the ground- and low-lying excited states relevant to the photochemistry of these systems. We highlight the performance of the trained networks by studying critical molecular geometries, including conical intersections and excited state minima. By construction, the proposed framework also recovers the emergence of Berry phase accumulation around conical intersections. By pairing key mathematical structure from quantum chemistry with the representation learning power of transformers, the presented architecture offers a qualitatively new path toward fast and accurate ground- and excited-state simulations.

articles.title: Physics-informed Learning for Orbital Uncertainty Propagation with Error Bounds
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Fokker-Planck partial differential equation (FP-PDE) governs uncertainty evolution in stochastic dynamical systems. In orbital dynamics, solving the FP-PDE is challenging because of nonlinear motion, high-dimensional states, and large space-time domains. We develop a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach that approximates the FP-PDE solution as a single space-time probability density, while also quantifying its worst-case approximation error. This approach is, in principle, independent of the choice of state coordinates and neural network architecture. Specifically, to enforce probability density function (PDF) properties into the neural network, we design a Physics-informed Gaussian mixture model (PINN-GMM). Then a companion error PINN learns the dynamics of the approximation error and yields time-dependent bounds that define an ambiguity set of PDFs. This ambiguity set enables rigorous computation of upper and lower bounds on event probabilities through tractable linear programs. Numerical studies on illustrative 1D examples and several 4D--6D orbital test cases demonstrate accurate uncertainty propagation, correct and informative error bounds, and improved reliability over common uncertainty-propagation baseline methods (Gaussian approximation, unscented transform, and Gaussian mixture model). Constructing the PINN-GMM requires offline training, making it costlier than the baseline approximations; once trained, however, a single forward pass returns the density at any time in sub-millisecond time (0.16~ms in our implementation).

articles.title: A novel objective function minimizes resonant trapped energetic particle losses in stellarators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near-omnigenous stellarators are susceptible to energetic particle (EP) losses due to resonances between trapped EPs and non-omnigenous perturbations to the magnetic field.
