We observe a strong suppression of diffuse transmission, providing direct experimental evidence for a breakdown of conventional diffuse transport associated with a strongly reduced photonic density of states. Together with large-scale numerical simulations, our results establish the presence of a deep photonic pseudogap in an amorphous three-dimensional dielectric material and open new opportunities for observing disorder-induced localization phenomena, including Anderson localization of light.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子带隙不仅能够在晶态介电材料中形成，也可以出现在非晶结构中。本文利用直接激光写入光刻和先进材料加工技术，以高折射率硅制备自均匀非晶陀螺网络，并在中红外波段观察到显著的透射极小值。偏振分辨透射光谱将弹道透射与多重散射贡献分离，结果显示漫射透射被强烈抑制，证明非晶三维介电材料中存在深度光子赝带隙，并为研究安德森光局域等无序诱导局域化现象提供了可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子带隙不仅能够在晶态介电材料中打开，也可以在非晶结构中形成。自均匀非晶陀螺网络已被提出作为有前景的无序光子结构。受数值研究启发，我们结合直接激光写入光刻与先进材料加工技术，利用高折射率硅制备了这些结构。光谱测量在中红外波长范围内揭示出明显的透射极小值。为了研究非晶结构中光子带隙的形成，我们开发了偏振分辨透射光谱技术，将弹道透射贡献与多重散射贡献分离，从而能够直接识别其背后的输运机制。我们观察到漫射透射受到强烈抑制，这为与光子态密度显著降低相关的传统漫射输运失效提供了直接实验证据。结合大规模数值模拟，我们的结果确立了非晶三维介电材料中深度光子赝带隙的存在，并为观察无序诱导的局域化现象，包括光的安德森局域化，开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Spatio-temporal coherent molding and retrieval of pulsed signals in optical waveguides
articles.title_zh: 光波导中脉冲信号的时空相干整形与恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optical waveguides are key elements for high fidelity, long distance optical communications. Coupled waveguide arrays allow for higher information density, steerting the propagation direction, and for encoding information. However, due to the mixing of relative phases for short pulses containing multiple waveguide-mode frequencies, a process for retrieving an encoded input state once these signals undergo coherent propagation remains elusive. A concept is presented to extract with high fidelity the phase-encrypted input signal from spatio-temporal propagated states. As a realization, an array of coupled waveguides is suggested with the retrieval mechanism being realized by local phase shifts that comply with the identified retrieval concept. Three dimensional full-wave electromagnetic simulations for broadband optical signals in coupled dielectric waveguides confirm the validity of the scheme and the high fidelity of information retrieval pointing to potential applications, for instance in ultrafast coherent coding and decoding of information imprinted on pulse sequences.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种从时空传播态中高保真提取相位加密输入信号的方法，以解决多波导模频率短脉冲在相干传播过程中相对相位混合导致的恢复困难。该方案通过局域相位移实现，并以耦合波导阵列为具体实现平台。三维全波电磁模拟表明，该方法能够高保真恢复宽带光信号中的信息，具有用于超快相干编码与解码的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光波导是实现高保真、长距离光通信的关键元件。耦合波导阵列能够提高信息密度、引导传播方向并实现信息编码。然而，对于包含多个波导模频率的短脉冲而言，由于相对相位发生混合，一旦这些信号经历相干传播，如何恢复编码后的输入态仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。本文提出了一种概念，用于从时空传播态中高保真地提取经过相位加密的输入信号。作为一种实现方案，我们提出采用耦合波导阵列，并通过满足所确定恢复概念的局域相位移来实现恢复机制。针对耦合介质波导中宽带光信号开展的三维全波电磁模拟证实了该方案的有效性以及信息恢复的高保真度，表明其可能应用于脉冲序列所承载信息的超快相干编码和解码等领域。

articles.title: Information geometry of non-equilibrium quantum states: Mixed metric structures on an extended information manifold
articles.title_zh: 非平衡量子态的信息几何：扩展信息流形上的混合度量结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We discuss an information-geometric framework for characterizing quantum states in non-equilibrium dynamics. Using the transverse-field Ising chain model as a laboratory, we investigate the quantum Fisher information metric with particular emphasis on the mixed metric component gₕₜ and related geometric observables, where h is a controllable post-quench Hamiltonian parameter and t is real time. The framework treats h and t as coordinates of an extended information manifold (h,t). The geometric observables characterize the speed of evolution on the manifold and the alignment between the temporal and parameter-deformation directions. Correlations between these geometric quantities and two widely used measures of non-equilibrium dynamics, the entanglement entropy and the Loschmidt echo, are analyzed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个用于刻画非平衡动力学中量子态的信息几何框架，并以横场伊辛链为研究模型。研究重点是量子费舍尔信息度量中的混合度量分量g_ht及相关几何观测量，其中h为淬火后哈密顿量的可控参数，t为实时间。通过将h和t视为扩展信息流形的坐标，文章分析了几何量与纠缠熵、Loschmidt回波等非平衡动力学指标之间的关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了一个用于刻画非平衡动力学中量子态的信息几何框架。我们以横场伊辛链模型为研究对象，重点考察量子费舍尔信息度量，尤其关注混合度量分量gₕₜ及相关几何观测量，其中h是一个可控的淬火后哈密顿量参数，t是真实时间。该框架将h和t视为扩展信息流形（h,t）的坐标。几何观测量刻画了流形上的演化速度，以及时间方向与参数形变方向之间的对齐程度。我们分析了这些几何量与两种广泛使用的非平衡动力学度量，即纠缠熵和Loschmidt回波之间的关联。

articles.title: Tangent fermions can restore vacuum stability of discrete-time Dirac models
articles.title_zh: 切线费米子能够恢复离散时间狄拉克模型的真空稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01029v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Dirac quantum walk (a 1+1 dimensional space-time discretization of the Dirac equation) has a 2μ mass gap both at the center and at the corner of the quasi-energy-momentum Brillouin zone. Gupta and Short recently noted [Quantum 9, 1845 (2025)] that the Dirac vacuum can create a particle-hole pair at the zone corner with the release of an energy 2μ to the environment. They removed this vacuum instability at the expense of fermion doubling, the appearance of a second low-energy Dirac cone. Here we show that an alternative discretization scheme, with a tangent rather than a sine dispersion relation, offers stability while retaining a single Dirac cone. The key step is the Cayley transformation from the unit circle of Floquet eigenvalues e⁻ⁱε to the real line of unbounded energies E=2tan(ε/2). We compute the Schwinger effect (particle-hole pair creation in a uniform electric field) for tangent fermions and show that the pair-production rate agrees with the continuum result for a single Dirac cone. The zone corner is exactly decoupled if the scalar potential is coupled through the Hermitian generator of the quantum map. If it is coupled as a split operator, in order to preserve exact gauge invariance on the lattice, the corner does contribute - with a weight that vanishes quadratically with the lattice constants, in contrast to the Dirac quantum walk where the zone-corner instability survives the continuum limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了离散时间狄拉克模型中的真空不稳定问题，并提出采用切线色散关系的离散化方案，在保留单一低能狄拉克锥的同时恢复稳定性。关键步骤是利用Cayley变换，将Floquet本征值所在的单位圆映射到无界能量所在的实轴。对均匀电场中的切线费米子计算表明，粒子-空穴对产生率与单一狄拉克锥的连续极限结果一致；具体耦合方式决定了布里渊区角点是否参与该过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 狄拉克量子行走，即狄拉克方程在1+1维时空中的离散化，在准能量-动量布里渊区的中心和角点都具有2μ的质量隙。Gupta和Short近期指出[Quantum 9, 1845（2025）]，狄拉克真空可以在布里渊区角点产生一对粒子-空穴对，并向环境释放2μ的能量。他们以出现第二个低能狄拉克锥、即费米子倍增为代价消除了这种真空不稳定性。本文表明，另一种采用切线而非正弦色散关系的离散化方案，能够在保留单一狄拉克锥的同时实现稳定性。关键步骤是使用Cayley变换，将Floquet本征值e⁻ⁱε所在的单位圆映射到无界能量E=2tan(ε/2)所在的实轴。我们计算了切线费米子中的Schwinger效应，即均匀电场中的粒子-空穴对产生，并表明其成对产生率与单一狄拉克锥的连续理论结果一致。如果通过量子映射的厄米生成元耦合标量势，则布里渊区角点会被完全解耦。如果采用分裂算符方式耦合标量势，以便在晶格上保持严格的规范不变性，那么角点仍会作出贡献；但其权重会随晶格常数的减小而按二次方趋于零，这与狄拉克量子行走不同，后者的布里渊区角点不稳定性在连续极限中仍然存在。

articles.title: Exceptional Points in Photonics: From Non-Hermitian Physics to Applications
articles.title_zh: 光子学中的例外点：从非厄米物理到应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01239v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open photonic systems provide a versatile platform for non-Hermitian physics, enabling control over complex spectra, transport, and light-matter interactions. Exceptional points (EPs), at which eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce and the governing operator becomes defective, play a central role because they combine branch-point spectral topology, nonanalytic perturbative response, and controllable eigenstate conversion. This Review provides a unified framework for EP photonics by systematically distinguishing exceptional degeneracies according to the underlying operator, spectral variable, boundary conditions, and experimentally accessible observables. We discuss Hamiltonian EPs, absorbing EPs associated with scattering zeros, real-frequency scattering-matrix and Jones-matrix EPs, Bloch and Floquet EPs, and Liouvillian EPs in open quantum systems. We review their spectral topology, static and dynamical encircling, higher-order exceptional structures, and coexistence with bound states in the continuum, together with applications in sensing, lasing, coherent absorption, directional scattering, polarization and wavefront control, nonlinear optics, optical storage, nonreciprocal photonics, and quantum photonics. We also critically assess the current limitations, practical challenges, and future perspectives of EP-based photonic technologies, with particular attention to robustness, noise, scalability, and experimentally measurable performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述开放光子系统中的例外点及其物理与应用，并根据算符、谱变量、边界条件和可实验观测量对不同类型的例外简并进行系统区分。文章涵盖哈密顿量例外点、与散射零点相关的吸收例外点、实频散射矩阵和Jones矩阵例外点、Bloch与Floquet例外点，以及开放量子系统中的Liouvillian例外点。综述还讨论了谱拓扑、静态与动态环绕、高阶结构、连续谱中的束缚态及其在传感、激光、相干吸收、方向性散射和量子光子学等方面的应用，同时评估实际鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性和可测性能等挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开放光子系统为非厄米物理提供了一个多功能平台，能够实现对复谱、输运以及光-物质相互作用的调控。例外点（EP）是本领域的核心，因为在例外点处本征值和本征矢发生合并，且所对应的算符变为缺陷算符；它们同时具有分支点谱拓扑、非解析微扰响应以及可控本征态转换等特征。本综述通过根据所涉及的算符、谱变量、边界条件和实验可观测量对例外简并进行系统区分，为EP光子学提供了统一框架。我们讨论了哈密顿量EP、与散射零点相关的吸收EP、实频散射矩阵和Jones矩阵EP、Bloch和Floquet EP，以及开放量子系统中的Liouvillian EP。我们综述了它们的谱拓扑、静态和动态环绕、高阶例外结构，以及它们与连续谱中的束缚态的共存；同时还讨论了其在传感、激光、相干吸收、方向性散射、偏振与波前控制、非线性光学、光存储、非互易光子学和量子光子学中的应用。我们还批判性地评估了基于EP的光子技术当前的局限、实际挑战和未来展望，尤其关注鲁棒性、噪声、可扩展性以及实验可测的性能。

articles.title: Depth-1 expanders on the unitary group and applications
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01605v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a constant-degree and constant-gap quantum expander on n qubits where each unitary can be implemented by a depth-1 and 1D circuit of Pauli or CNOT gates. We provide two applications of this expander. First, we use it to construct a family of frustration-free 1D Hamiltonians whose ground states obey the entanglement-gap relation S = Θ(Δ⁻¹/²); this is believed to be optimal, but achieving it had been open. Second, we use it to provide a streaming protocol that tests for closeness to a class of 1D volume-law entangled states. Moreover, we extend our quantum expander to a constant-degree and constant-gap expander on the unitary group where each unitary is a single T gate, a single Tdagger gate, or a depth-1 Clifford circuit. This implies that a random sequence of unitaries from the expander yields a gapped walk on a dense subgroup of the unitary group. This improves upon previous work by Bourgain and Gamburd which did not control the dependence of the gap on the dimension.

articles.title: Observable- and state-selective prethermalization and bounds on prethermal lifetimes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01606v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Prethermalization describes long-lived intermediate regimes that precede equilibrium and can dominate experimentally accessible dynamics. Here, we show that a separation of spectral energy scales, despite giving rise to a hierarchy of dynamical timescales, does not by itself guarantee the appearance of a prethermal plateau. Under the same Hamiltonian, some observables may exhibit prethermal behavior, while others relax directly toward equilibrium. We uncover the mechanism governing this selectivity, showing that the emergence of a prethermal plateau depends not only on the Hamiltonian, but also on the observable and the initial state. Our results apply broadly to systems close to a fully permutation-symmetric limit and are illustrated with a long-range interacting spin model. We further prove that the Loschmidt echo provides a lower bound on the prethermal lifetime of any bounded observable whenever the prethermal and exact dynamics are unitary.

articles.title: Investigation into thorium sulfate as a spinless crystal for a high-performance solid-state ²²⁹Th nuclear clock
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.11374v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The ²²⁹Th isotope has a laser-accessible nuclear transition allowing the construction of a solid-state nuclear clock. Solid-state ²²⁹Th nuclear clock development has focused on ²²⁹Th-doped CaF₂ and other metal fluorides as the solid material. However, the accuracy of any fluoride-based clock will be reduced by nuclear magnetic dipole coupling to ¹⁹F and by inhomogeneities in the thorium defect environments. Here we explore thorium sulfate, Th(SO₄)₂, as a solution to both problems. Strong bonding and charge delocalization in the SO₄²⁻ anion may give Th(SO₄)₂ the wide band gap needed for a good clock. In this work we synthesize Th(SO₄)₂ and probe it as a nuclear clock material spectroscopically, finding that it is opaque to the 148 nm radiation that excites the ²²⁹Th nucleus. Theoretical analysis of the optical spectra shows that charge transfer excitons are responsible for the absorption. We give guidelines for future material development and assess the prospects for Th(SO₄)₂ as a clock material.

articles.title: Local spectroscopy of loop current order with individual magnetic atoms
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.19032v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hidden ordered states--characterized by order parameters that elude conventional probes--pose a fundamental challenge for their identification in quantum materials. Recent experiments report evidence for time-reversal symmetry breaking orbital magnetic order and anomalous transport signatures in the 2a×2a charge density wave state of the kagome metal CsV₃Sb₅ at a temperature T<30,K. Theoretical analyses propose that a time-reversal symmetry breaking loop-current order could exist as the ground state of this charge density wave. However, this microscopic interpretation remains debated and experimentally unverified. In this work, we employ individual magnetic atoms as local quantum sensors to examine the quasiparticle excitations of the charge density wave in CsV₃Sb₅ with the scanning tunneling microscope. Our spectroscopic measurements show that the magnetic moment of Co induces a spatially localized dI/dV peak inside the spectral gap of the charge density wave near the Fermi energy. Conducting temperature-dependent spectroscopy, we find that this spectral feature emerges at T<30,K. By comparing our experimental observations with results of quantum many-body simulations and realistic tight-binding model calculations, we show that this spectroscopic signature can be naturally interpreted as a local flux defect in a loop current ordered state, arising from the Kondo coupling of the magnetic moment of Co with the loop current electrons. The excellent agreement between our experimental and theoretical results suggests the presence of loop-current order in the 2a×2a charge density wave of CsV₃Sb₅ at T<30,K. Our results provide a microscopic picture to the observation of time-reversal symmetry breaking orbital magnetism and anomalous transport signatures detected in measurements of the macroscopic material properties.

articles.title: Super natural orbital representation of many-body operators: structured non-Gaussianity and matrix product operator compression
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.10690v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce super natural orbitals (SNOs) for many-body operators, defined as the eigenvectors of the one-body super-density matrix associated with an operator (OBDMO). These objects provide a natural measure of the complexity of operators in terms of non-Gaussianity. We first establish analytical properties of SNOs for time-evolution operators generated by non-interacting Hamiltonians and for Haar-random unitaries. We then perform numerical tensor network simulations to compute the SNOs for both the time-evolution operator and local operators in the Heisenberg picture in two many-body systems: the fermionic t-V chain and a quantum impurity model. While the t-V model exhibits no preferred super-orbital basis, the operators in the impurity model display exponentially decaying SNO occupations at all times, indicating that only a few SNOs contribute significantly to quantum correlations. For local Heisenberg-picture operators in the impurity model, we find that the complexity in the SNO basis saturates at long times. Finally, we show that rotating operators into the SNO basis with an appropriate ordering leads to substantial matrix product operator compression by exposing the factorized structure of a large number of SNOs.

articles.title: Data-Driven Thiele Equation Approach for State-Dependent Coefficients in the Nonlinear Dynamics of Vortex-based Nano-Oscillators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.14829v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin-torque vortex oscillators provide a model system for the nonlinear dynamics of a confined magnetic texture. Their motion is commonly described by the Thiele equation, but its standard constant-coefficient form relies on a rigid-texture approximation and becomes inaccurate at large gyration amplitudes. We introduce a data-driven Thiele equation approach (DD-TEA) that extracts effective, position-dependent Thiele coefficients from a single current-ramp micromagnetic simulation by interpolating the magnetization in vortex-core-position space. The extracted maps reveal a weak increase of the gyrovector magnitude and a pronounced separation of the radial and azimuthal dissipation as the orbit expands, providing quantitative signatures of confinement- and motion-induced vortex deformation. Because the gyrotropic, dissipative, conservative, and spin-transfer contributions retain their usual Thiele structure, the resulting description remains physically interpretable rather than acting as a black-box surrogate. Incorporating these state-dependent coefficients into the equation reproduces the nonlinear stable-orbit dynamics and accurately predicts the response to time-varying currents, whereas a conventional constant-coefficient description predicts vortex expulsion. The framework therefore provides a systematic route for deriving effective collective-coordinate dynamics from full micromagnetic states with high computational efficiency
authors: Tristan da Câmara Santa Clara Gomes

articles.title: Frustration-enhanced quantum annealing correction models with additional inter-replica interactions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11217v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum annealing correction (QAC) models provide a promising approach for mitigating errors in quantum annealers. Previous studies have established that QAC models are crucial for ensuring the robustness of the ground state of the Ising model on hardware. In this work, the effects of QAC models incorporating replicas with additional interactions, specifically, the penalty spin model and the stacked model, are investigated for problems characterized by a small energy gap between the ground and first excited states during quantum annealing, a well-known bottleneck to reaching the ground state. The results demonstrate that these QAC models can obtain the optimal solution within short annealing times by exploiting diabatic transitions, even for problems with a small energy gap. These findings highlight the potential of QAC models as practical near-term algorithms for hardware subject to runtime limitations and control noise.

articles.title: Exploring confinement transitions in Z₂ lattice gauge theories with dipolar atoms beyond one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维以上具有偶极原子的Z₂晶格规范理论中的禁闭转变探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.16200v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Confinement of particles into bound states is a phenomenon spanning from high-energy to condensed matter physics, which can be studied in the framework of lattice gauge theories (LGTs). Achieving a comprehensive understanding of confinement continues to pose a major challenge, in particular at finite matter density and in the presence of strong quantum fluctuations. State-of-the-art quantum simulators constitute a promising platform to address this problem. Here we study confinement in coupled chains of Z₂ LGTs coupled to matter fields, that can be mapped to a mixed-dimensional (mixD) XXZ model. We perform large-scale numerical matrix-product state calculations to obtain the phase diagram of this model, in which we uncover striped phases formed by the Z₂ charges that can be melted at finite temperature or by increasing the tunneling rate. To explore this setting experimentally, we use our quantum simulator constituted by erbium atoms with dipolar interactions in a quantum gas microscope, and observe the predicted melting of a stripe phase by increasing the particle tunneling rate. Our explorative experimental studies of thermal deconfinement of Z₂ charges motivate our further theoretical study of the mixD Z₂ LGT, in which we predict a confined meson gas at finite temperature and low magnetization where thermal fluctuations destroy stripes but enable spontaneous commensurate spin order. Overall, we demonstrate that our platform can be used to study confinement in Z₂ LGTs coupled to matter fields, including long-range interactions and beyond one dimension, paving the way for future research of confinement in the quantum many-body regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究与物质场耦合的Z₂晶格规范理论中粒子禁闭现象，重点考察有限物质密度、强量子涨落及超越一维的情形。作者将耦合链模型映射为混合维度XXZ模型，通过大规模矩阵乘积态计算和镱原子量子气体显微镜实验，发现了可由升温或增强隧穿熔化的条纹相。理论进一步预言，在有限温度和低磁化率下，条纹被热涨落破坏，但会形成受限介子气体和自发的整比自旋序，为量子多体体系中的禁闭研究提供了实验平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将粒子禁闭于束缚态之中，是一种横跨高能物理和凝聚态物理的现象，可以在晶格规范理论（LGT）的框架下加以研究。要全面理解禁闭现象仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在有限物质密度和强量子涨落存在的情况下。先进的量子模拟器为研究这一问题提供了很有前景的平台。在这里，我们研究了与物质场耦合的Z₂晶格规范理论耦合链系统，该系统可以映射为一个混合维度（mixD）XXZ模型。我们开展大规模矩阵乘积态数值计算，获得了该模型的相图，并发现由Z₂电荷形成的条纹相；这种条纹相可以在有限温度下或通过增大隧穿速率而熔化。为了在实验上探索这一体系，我们使用了由具有偶极相互作用的铒原子构成的量子气体显微镜量子模拟器，并观察到随着粒子隧穿速率增大，条纹相按照理论预言发生熔化。我们关于Z₂电荷热去禁闭的探索性实验研究，促使我们进一步研究混合维度Z₂晶格规范理论；在该理论中，我们预言，在有限温度和低磁化率下，会形成受限介子气体：热涨落破坏条纹结构，但能够促成自发的整比自旋序。总体而言，我们证明了这一平台可用于研究与物质场耦合的Z₂晶格规范理论中的禁闭现象，包括长程相互作用和超越一维的情形，从而为未来研究量子多体区域中的禁闭现象铺平道路。

articles.title: Dynamics of CPN⁻¹ skyrmions
articles.title_zh: CPN⁻¹斯格明子的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.17403v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We derive several exact results for the dynamics of CPN⁻¹ skyrmions with arbitrary N. Fractonic continuity equation is shown to hold for arbitrary CPN⁻¹ fluid implying the conservation of the topological charge and the dipole moment. Inclusion of the Gilbert damping modifies the continuity equation, resulting in the violation of the dipole moment conservation but not of the topological charge. Thiele's equation for the CPN⁻¹ skyrmion follows from the modified continuity equation. The Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman (GMP) algebra in the long-wavelength limit is derived for arbitrary CPN⁻¹ fluid. In the case of CP² skyrmions, we identify stable skyrmions in which the ferromagnetic moments are dominant. One can associate a nonzero CP¹ charge equal to half the CP² skyrmion charge and argue that the topological Hall effect of electrons should exist due to their coupling to the ferromagnetic part of the CP² texture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了任意N下CPN⁻¹斯格明子动力学的若干精确结果。任意CPN⁻¹流体均满足分形子连续性方程，从而守恒拓扑荷和偶极矩；吉尔伯特阻尼会破坏偶极矩守恒，但不破坏拓扑荷守恒。作者还推导了长波极限下的GMP代数，并指出CP²斯格明子中的铁磁部分可产生非零CP¹荷及相应的拓扑霍尔效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导了任意N下CPN⁻¹斯格明子动力学的若干精确结果。我们证明，任意CPN⁻¹流体都满足分形子连续性方程，这意味着拓扑荷和偶极矩均受到守恒。引入吉尔伯特阻尼会修改连续性方程，导致偶极矩守恒被破坏，但拓扑荷守恒不受影响。CPN⁻¹斯格明子的Thiele方程可以由修正后的连续性方程得到。我们还为任意CPN⁻¹流体推导了长波极限下的Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman（GMP）代数。对于CP²斯格明子，我们确定了铁磁矩占主导的稳定斯格明子。在这种情况下，可以将一个非零的CP¹荷与CP²斯格明子荷的一半联系起来，并据此论证，电子由于耦合到CP²纹理的铁磁部分，应当产生拓扑霍尔效应。

articles.title: Single-Q and Double-Q magnetic orders: A Theoretical Analysis of Inelastic Neutron Scattering in a Centrosymmetric Structure
articles.title_zh: 单Q与双Q磁序：中心对称结构中非弹性中子散射的理论分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07428v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent discoveries of multi-Q magnetic structures in centrosymmetric compounds have stimulated growing interest in their microscopic origin and observable properties. Here, we calculate the dynamical magnetic structure factor for a double-Q magnetic structure and compare it with that of a single-Q configuration. Our results demonstrate how inelastic neutron scattering can distinguish the double-Q state from competing single-Q states in this square-lattice setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来中心对称化合物中多Q磁结构的发现，推动了对其微观起源和可观测性质的研究。本文计算了双Q磁结构的动态磁结构因子，并将其与单Q构型进行比较。结果表明，在方格子体系中，非弹性中子散射能够区分双Q态及与之竞争的单Q态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，在中心对称化合物中发现的多Q磁结构激发了人们对其微观起源和可观测性质日益增长的兴趣。在这里，我们计算了双Q磁结构的动态磁结构因子，并将其与单Q构型的动态磁结构因子进行比较。我们的结果展示了在这一方格子体系中，非弹性中子散射如何区分双Q态和与之竞争的单Q态。

articles.title: Emergent spin-resolved electronic density waves from strong d-wave altermagnetism and pseudogap phenomena from phason fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 强d波交错磁性诱导的自发自旋分辨电子密度波，以及相位子涨落产生的赝能隙现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11694v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Metallic d-wave altermagnets provide a unique setting in which strong spin-momentum locking can qualitatively reshape electronic instabilities. Here we develop a self-consistent microscopic theory beyond the mean-field approximation for density-wave order in d-wave altermagnetic metals. The altermagnetic band structure with strong spin-momentum locking reconstructs the Fermi surface into mutually orthogonal spin-selective quasi-1D sectors, whose strong nesting drives density-wave instabilities in the respective spin sectors. The resulting spin-resolved density-wave orders nevertheless share a common ordering wave vector and give rise to a distinct class of stripe states, accompanied by pronounced gap openings on the nested Fermi sheets. The relative phase between the two spin sectors controls the character of the collective order, allowing charge density wave, spin density wave, and mixed density-wave orders to emerge within the same ordered manifold. As temperature increases from zero, thermal excitation of the emergent phason mode induces strong phase fluctuations that destroy long-range density-wave order at T_c, while the single-particle gap remains finite, giving rise to a robust pseudogap regime that persists up to a higher temperature T_g. The theory reveals a density-wave mechanism unique to metallic d-wave altermagnets, rooted in strong spin-selective Fermi-surface reconstruction, and establishes a fluctuation-driven route to pseudogap phenomena governed by phason dynamics. Applied to the metallic d-wave altermagnet KV₂Se₂O, our simulations quantitatively reproduce the key spectroscopic features reported in recent experiments, providing a unified microscopic understanding of the underlying phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了超越平均场近似的自洽微观理论，研究金属d波交错磁体中的密度波序。强自旋-动量锁定将费米面重构为彼此正交且具有自旋选择性的准一维区域，其嵌套驱动相应自旋扇区中的密度波不稳定性，并形成具有共同波矢的条纹态。相对相位决定电荷密度波、自旋密度波或混合密度波的性质；升温激发的相位子涨落会先摧毁长程密度波序，但保留单粒子能隙，从而产生赝能隙区。对金属d波交错磁体KV₂Se₂O的模拟再现了实验中的主要光谱特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属d波交错磁体提供了一个独特平台，其中强自旋-动量锁定能够定性地重塑电子不稳定性。在这里，我们建立了一个超越平均场近似的、自洽的金属d波交错磁体中密度波序微观理论。具有强自旋-动量锁定的交错磁性能带结构，会将费米面重构为彼此正交且具有自旋选择性的准一维区域；这些区域的强嵌套驱动了相应自旋扇区中的密度波不稳定性。由此产生的自旋分辨密度波序仍然共享一个共同的有序波矢，并形成一类独特的条纹态，同时在嵌套的费米面片上伴随显著的能隙打开。两个自旋扇区之间的相对相位控制着集体有序的性质，使电荷密度波、自旋密度波和混合密度波序能够在同一个有序流形中出现。当温度从零升高时，新出现的相位子模的热激发会诱发强烈的相位涨落，并在临界温度T_c处破坏长程密度波序；与此同时，单粒子能隙仍保持有限，从而产生一种稳健的赝能隙区域，并持续到更高的温度T_g。该理论揭示了金属d波交错磁体所特有的一种密度波机制，其根源在于强烈的自旋选择性费米面重构；同时建立了一条由相位子动力学支配的、由涨落驱动的赝能隙现象产生路径。将该理论应用于金属d波交错磁体KV₂Se₂O时，我们的模拟定量再现了近期实验中报道的关键光谱特征，为相关现象的微观起源提供了统一理解。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文建立了超越平均场的自洽微观理论，研究强 d 波交替磁性金属中的自旋分辨电荷密度波和自旋密度波。研究表明，交替磁性引起的自旋-动量锁定和准一维费米面嵌套可诱导自旋选择性的密度波序，并通过相对相位产生电荷、 自旋或混合密度波态；热激发的相位模涨落则可能破坏长程有序。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的交替磁性、磁性结构、电子结构、拓扑磁性和电荷序研究高度相关。其关于自旋分辨密度波、费米面嵌套及相位涨落的理论框架，可补充团队现有的第一性原理和有效哈密顿量研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可利用第一性原理计算和 Wannier 哈密顿量检验候选 d 波交替磁性材料中的费米面嵌套与密度波不稳定性。进一步结合自旋哈密顿量、蒙特卡洛或含涨落的有效模型，研究温度、应变和载流子掺杂对密度波及磁序的调控。

articles.title: Tractable model for a fractionalized Fermi liquid (FL^*) on a square lattice
articles.title_zh: 方格子上分数化费米液体（FL*）的可解析模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.06157v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by the continued interest in Fermi-surface reconstruction without symmetry breaking, we present an analytically tractable microscopic model of a fractionalized Fermi liquid (FL^*) on a square lattice and discuss its potential relevance to the cuprates. As in ancilla-qubit constructions, the model is related to Kondo lattice systems, but in this case, the conduction electrons interact with a Z₂ spin liquid of the Yao--Lee type, with a Majorana Fermi surface. The associated mathbb Z₂ gauge theory is static so that the model can be analytically solved to leading-logarithic accuracy. There are two phases: one in which the fractionalized fermions of the spin liquid hybridize with conduction electrons to form a common Fermi surface violating the naive Luttinger count, and one in which they remain decoupled. We discuss the salient features of the small Fermi-surface phase, including analytically derived momentum dependent coherence factors responsible for the appearance of Fermi arcs à la Yang-Rice-Zhang. We further discuss the impact of quantum and thermal fluctuations, including a strong diamagnetic response and a logarithmically divergent Sommerfeld coefficient at the onset of the pseudogap.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对无对称性破缺的费米面重构问题，本文提出了一个位于方格子上的、解析上可处理的分数化费米液体微观模型。模型中的传导电子与具有马约拉纳费米面的Yao--Lee型Z₂自旋液体相互作用，并存在一个违反朴素Luttinger计数的分数化费米子-传导电子混合相，以及一个二者解耦的相。作者进一步解析了小费米面相中的动量依赖相干因子，说明其可产生类似Yang-Rice-Zhang机制的费米弧，并讨论了赝能隙起始处的强抗磁响应和对数发散的Sommerfeld系数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受无对称性破缺情况下费米面重构问题持续受到关注的启发，我们提出了一个位于方格子上的、解析上可处理的分数化费米液体（FL*）微观模型，并讨论其与铜氧化物超导体的潜在关联。与辅助量子比特构造一样，该模型与Kondo晶格系统有关；但在本模型中，传导电子与Yao--Lee型Z₂自旋液体相互作用，而该自旋液体具有马约拉纳费米面。与之相关的Z₂规范理论是静态的，因此该模型可以在主导对数精度下解析求解。模型存在两个相：一个相中，自旋液体的分数化费米子与传导电子杂化，形成一个共同的费米面，并违反朴素的Luttinger计数；另一个相中，二者保持解耦。我们讨论了小费米面相的主要特征，包括解析推导的动量依赖相干因子；这些因子导致类似Yang-Rice-Zhang机制的费米弧出现。我们还讨论了量子涨落和热涨落的影响，包括强抗磁响应，以及在赝能隙起始处Sommerfeld系数的对数发散。

articles.title: Coupled-channels method for the scattering hypervolume in ultracold atomic three-body collisions
articles.title_zh: 超冷原子三体碰撞中散射超体积的耦合通道方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15815v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a novel coupled-channels method for elastic three-body scattering in systems of identical bosonic alkali-metal atoms. The approach relies on the numerically exact two-body off-the-energy-shell transition matrix, constructed from realistic multichannel molecular interaction potentials that support many bound states. By rigorously accounting for this off-shell structure, the method captures both the short-range physics as well as multichannel couplings characteristic of alkali-metal potentials without resorting to model pseudopotentials. The central output is the complex three-body scattering hypervolume -- the three-body analogue of the two-body scattering length -- which we obtain with controlled and verifiable numerical accuracy. As a realistic benchmark, we apply our framework to spin-polarized potassium-39, performing full coupled-channels three-body scattering calculations and extracting the hypervolume over experimentally relevant conditions. The method is general and transferable to other atomic species and interaction models featuring deep molecular potentials with an arbitrarily large number of bound states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于相同玻色碱金属原子体系弹性三体散射的新型耦合通道方法。该方法以数值精确的二体非壳上跃迁矩阵为基础，该矩阵由支持大量束缚态的真实多通道分子相互作用势构造而成，因此能够在不使用模型赝势的情况下处理短程物理和多通道耦合。作者计算了复杂三体散射超体积，并以自旋极化的钾-39为基准体系，在实验相关条件下提取了该物理量。
authors: S. J. J. M. F. Kokkelmans
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍了一种用于相同玻色碱金属原子体系弹性三体散射的新型耦合通道方法。该方法依赖于数值上精确的二体非壳上跃迁矩阵；该跃迁矩阵由真实的多通道分子相互作用势构造，而这些相互作用势支持大量束缚态。通过严格地计及这种非壳上结构，该方法无需借助模型赝势，即可同时捕捉短程物理以及碱金属相互作用势所具有的多通道耦合。该方法的核心输出是复数三体散射超体积，即二体散射长度的三体对应物；我们以受控且可验证的数值精度获得了这一物理量。作为真实体系的基准，我们将该框架应用于自旋极化的钾-39，完成了全耦合通道三体散射计算，并在实验相关条件下提取了散射超体积。该方法具有普适性和可迁移性，也适用于其他原子种类以及具有深分子势、且束缚态数目任意多的相互作用模型。

articles.title: Using the slowest observable in one-dimensional Markov processes to construct quasi-exactly-solvable generators with two explicit levels
articles.title_zh: 利用一维马尔可夫过程中的最慢观测量构造具有两个显式能级的准精确可解生成元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15908v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The construction of Quasi-Exactly-Solvable quantum Hamiltonians where only the first two eigenstates Φ₀(x) and Φ₁(x) of energies E₀ and E₁ are explicit is revisited from the point of view of one-dimensional Markov processes satisfying detailed-balance, whose generators are related to quantum Hamiltonians via similarity transformations. Here, the lowest energy vanishes E₀=0 and is associated with the conservation of probability and with the steady state P_*(x), while E₁>0 is the rate that governs the exponential relaxation towards the steady-state, and is associated with the slowest observable L₁(x) that corresponds to the ratio  fracΦ₁(x) Φ₀(x) of the two quantum eigenstates. Our main conclusion is that the Markov perspective leads to interesting re-interpretations and that the construction of quasi-exactly-solvable models with N=2 explicit levels is more intuitive and technically simpler when one takes the slowest observable L₁(x) as the central object from which all the other properties can be reconstructed. This general approach is then applied to Fokker-Planck generators in continuous space and to Markov jump generators on the lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从满足细致平衡的一维马尔可夫过程视角，重新研究仅有前两个本征态显式可得的准精确可解量子哈密顿量构造。最低能量为零，对应概率守恒和稳态分布；第一激发能量则决定趋于稳态的指数弛豫速率，并对应于两个量子本征态之比所定义的最慢观测量。作者指出，以该最慢观测量为核心可以更直观、简便地重构所有其他性质，并将方法应用于连续空间中的福克-普朗克生成元和晶格上的马尔可夫跳跃生成元。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文从满足细致平衡的一维马尔可夫过程角度，重新考察准精确可解量子哈密顿量的构造问题，其中只有能量为E₀和E₁的前两个本征态Φ₀(x)和Φ₁(x)能够显式写出。这里，最低能量满足E₀=0，并与概率守恒和稳态分布P_*(x)相联系；而E₁>0是支配向稳态指数弛豫的速率，并与最慢观测量L₁(x)相联系，后者对应于两个量子本征态之比Φ₁(x)/Φ₀(x)。我们的主要结论是，马尔可夫过程视角带来了有意义的重新诠释；当以最慢观测量L₁(x)为核心对象、并由其重构所有其他性质时，构造具有N=2个显式能级的准精确可解模型会更加直观且技术上更简单。随后，我们将这一一般方法应用于连续空间中的福克-普朗克生成元以及晶格上的马尔可夫跳跃生成元。

articles.title: Unveiling the Superconducting Ground State of Heusler alloy Pd2ZrIn via muon spin relaxation and rotation measurement
articles.title_zh: 通过缪子自旋弛豫与旋转测量揭示Heusler合金Pd₂ZrIn的超导基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19283v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Full Heusler alloys XInPd2 (X= Zr, Hf and Ti) have recently attracted significant attention owing to their symmetry-driven electronic structure and also due to the interplay between disorder and emergent ground states. Within this family, Pd2ZrIn serves as a unique platform to study the effect of disorder on superconducting pairing. This alloy crystallizes in a cubic L21 structure with significant B2-type antisite disorder. Electrical resistivity and magnetic susceptibility studies confirm bulk type-II superconductivity with a transition temperature TC ~ 2.2 K. Zero-field μSR results reveal no evidence of spontaneous internal magnetic fields below TC, confirming the preservation of time-reversal symmetry. Transverse-field μSR spectra show the formation of a vortex lattice, consistent with type-II superconductivity, and the superfluid density is well described by a fully gapped, nodeless s-wave state with superconducting gap Δ (0) ~ 0.33 ± 0.01 meV. Furthermore, the estimated ratio of transition temperature and Fermi temperature (TC/TF) indicates that this alloy lies within the conventional superconducting regime on the Uemura plot. These results establish Pd2ZrIn as a weakly coupled, dirty-limit, type-II superconductor; with a fully gapped, nodeless order parameter and preserved time-reversal symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用缪子自旋弛豫和旋转测量研究Heusler合金Pd₂ZrIn的超导基态。电阻率和磁化率证实其为转变温度约2.2 K的块体Ⅱ型超导体；零场μSR未发现转变温度以下的自发内部磁场，表明时间反演对称性保持。横向场μSR显示涡旋晶格，超流密度符合完全开口、无节点的s波态，超导能隙约为0.33 meV；该合金属于弱耦合、脏极限、保持时间反演对称性的Ⅱ型超导体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全Heusler合金XInPd₂（X=Zr、Hf和Ti）由于其由对称性决定的电子结构，以及无序与涌现基态之间的相互作用，近年来受到了广泛关注。在这一合金家族中，Pd₂ZrIn为研究无序对超导配对影响提供了一个独特平台。该合金结晶为立方L2₁结构，并具有显著的B2型反位无序。电阻率和磁化率研究证实，该材料是块体Ⅱ型超导体，其转变温度T_C约为2.2 K。零场μSR结果显示，在T_C以下没有自发内部磁场的证据，证实时间反演对称性得以保持。横向场μSR谱显示涡旋晶格的形成，这与Ⅱ型超导性一致；超流密度可以由完全开口、无节点的s波态很好地描述，其超导能隙Δ(0)约为0.33±0.01 meV。此外，估算得到的转变温度与费米温度之比（T_C/T_F）表明，在Uemura图中该合金处于常规超导区域。这些结果确立了Pd₂ZrIn是一种弱耦合、脏极限的Ⅱ型超导体，具有完全开口、无节点的序参量，并保持时间反演对称性。

articles.title: Towards Application of Nanodiamonds for in-situ Monitoring of Radicals in Liquid Phase Chemical Reactions
articles.title_zh: 纳米金刚石用于液相化学反应中自由基原位监测的应用探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19433v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In many chemical reactions, short-lived radical intermediates play a crucial role, while detecting such short-lived species in-situ remains challenging. The optically readable electronic spin of nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond is a nanoscale sensor for such radical species: its longitudinal spin relaxation time (T₁) reacts to magnetic fluctuations from the unpaired electrons of radical species in its local environment. In this setting, we demonstrate the successful in-situ detection of the nitroxide radical 2,2,6,6-Tetramethylpiperidinyloxyl (TEMPO) using NV center-based T₁ relaxometry after depositing nanodiamonds onto the inner wall of a glass cuvette. A significant concentration-dependent shortening of the relaxation time was observed, from 197:textmu s ± 21:textmu s without radical to 66:textmu s ± 30:textmu s at a concentration of 1:M TEMPO. At the same time, the nanodiamonds remain firmly attached to the cuvette even after the solution under investigation has been exchanged. The detection is sensitive in the nanomolar (nM) range and the determined signal-to-noise ratio is between 1.6 and 3.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多化学反应依赖短寿命自由基中间体，但对其进行原位检测十分困难。本文利用金刚石氮-空位中心的纵向自旋弛豫时间T₁对局域自由基磁涨落的响应，将纳米金刚石沉积在玻璃比色皿内壁，实现了对TEMPO自由基的原位检测。无自由基时弛豫时间为197±21 μs，在1 M TEMPO下缩短至66±30 μs；纳米金刚石在更换待测溶液后仍牢固附着，检测灵敏度达到纳摩尔范围，信噪比为1.6至3。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在许多化学反应中，短寿命自由基中间体发挥着关键作用；然而，对这类短寿命物种进行原位检测仍然具有挑战性。金刚石中氮-空位（NV）中心的可光学读取电子自旋是一种用于检测此类自由基物种的纳米尺度传感器：其纵向自旋弛豫时间（T₁）会对局域环境中自由基物种未成对电子产生的磁涨落作出响应。在这一体系中，我们将纳米金刚石沉积到玻璃比色皿的内壁上，并利用基于NV中心的T₁弛豫测量，成功实现了对硝基氧自由基2,2,6,6-四甲基哌啶氧基（TEMPO）的原位检测。我们观察到弛豫时间随浓度显著缩短：无自由基时为197±21 μs，而在TEMPO浓度为1 M时缩短至66±30 μs。与此同时，即使更换了待测溶液，纳米金刚石仍牢固附着在比色皿上。该检测在纳摩尔（nM）范围内具有灵敏度，测得的信噪比介于1.6和3之间。

articles.title: Modeling of flopping-mode spin qubits: beyond the two-site model
articles.title_zh: 起扑模式自旋量子比特建模：超越双位点模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20510v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a flexible modeling framework for flopping-mode spin qubits that captures the spatial structure of the double-well confinement and magnetic-field-gradient profile going beyond conventional low-energy descriptions. By using this approach, we simulate electric dipole spin resonance-based single-qubit control and evaluate the frequency and spectral purity of the Rabi oscillations across different parameter regimes. Our analysis reveals a fundamental tradeoff between fast electrical driving and clean single-mode Rabi oscillations, and demonstrates that the standard two-site low-energy approximation can overestimate the Rabi frequency by up to sim 20% in certain parameter regimes. We also investigate two-qubit control by considering two capacitively coupled flopping-mode qubits and derive the corresponding exchange interaction with an appropriately restricted configuration interaction treatment. Our approach reveals the interplay between the spatial profile of the double-well confinement, magnetic field gradient, and Coulomb interaction, which together govern the effective exchange coupling strength. Our spatially resolved modelling framework enables efficient exploration of double-well confinement parameters and magnetic field gradient profiles, enabling a transparent mapping from spatial device properties to flopping-mode qubit parameters and quality metrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个灵活的起扑模式自旋量子比特建模框架，能够描述双势阱约束和磁场梯度的空间结构，并超越传统低能有效模型。模拟表明，快速电驱动与纯净单模拉比振荡之间存在基本权衡，标准双位点近似在某些参数区域会将拉比频率高估约20%。对于两个电容耦合的起扑模式量子比特，作者还采用受限组态相互作用方法推导了交换相互作用，揭示了约束、磁场梯度和库仑相互作用共同决定有效交换耦合强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个灵活的起扑模式自旋量子比特建模框架，该框架能够描述双势阱约束和磁场梯度分布的空间结构，从而超越传统的低能描述。利用这一方法，我们模拟了基于电偶极自旋共振的单量子比特控制，并评估了不同参数区域中拉比振荡的频率和谱纯度。我们的分析揭示，快速电驱动与纯净的单模拉比振荡之间存在基本权衡，并表明在某些参数区域，标准的双位点低能近似可能将拉比频率高估多达约20%。我们还通过考察两个电容耦合的起扑模式量子比特研究了双量子比特控制，并利用适当受限的组态相互作用方法推导了相应的交换相互作用。我们的方法揭示了双势阱约束的空间分布、磁场梯度和库仑相互作用之间的相互影响；这些因素共同决定有效交换耦合强度。我们的空间分辨建模框架能够高效探索双势阱约束参数和磁场梯度分布，从而透明地建立空间器件性质与起扑模式量子比特参数及质量指标之间的映射。

articles.title: Polarizable atomic multipoles for learning long-range electrostatics
articles.title_zh: 用于学习长程静电作用的可极化原子多极矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.05746v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Long-range electrostatics and polarization remain central obstacles to extending machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to ionic, polar, and interfacial systems. Here we introduce a semi-local framework for learning electrostatics from energies and forces using polarizable atomic multipoles. Local equivariant descriptors predict environment-dependent latent monopoles, dipoles, and quadrupoles, while residual non-local charge transfer and polarization are captured by non-self-consistent linear response in induced charges and dipoles. Across four diverse benchmarks and four short-range MLIP architectures, the multipole hierarchy and response terms systematically improve potential energy surface accuracy, with the largest gains in systems where long-range effects are essential. More importantly, physically meaningful electrical responses emerge without direct supervision. The learned latent multipoles yield accurate Born effective charge tensors and infrared spectra in close agreement with experiments. The induced-dipole extension introduces new capabilities: it predicts polarizabilities and thereby enables semi-quantitative Raman spectra for bulk water and hybrid MAPbI₃ perovskite, as well as the essential features of the surface-specific vibrational sum-frequency generation spectrum at the water-air interface. In ferroelectric HfO₂, the predicted electrical response also captures LO-TO splitting and polarization switching. This systematically improvable, physically transparent framework enables MLIPs trained on standard energy and force labels to predict polarization-sensitive observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个利用可极化原子多极矩从能量和力中学习静电作用的半局域框架，以解决机器学习原子间势在离子、极性和界面体系中的长程静电与极化问题。局域等变描述符预测环境依赖的隐变量单极矩、偶极矩和四极矩，非局域电荷转移与极化则由感应电荷和偶极矩的非自洽线性响应描述。该框架在多种基准体系中提高了势能面精度，并在无需直接监督的情况下准确预测Born有效电荷、红外光谱、极化率、拉曼光谱及其他极化相关观测量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长程静电作用和极化仍然是将机器学习原子间势（MLIP）扩展到离子体系、极性体系和界面体系时的核心障碍。在这里，我们提出了一个半局域框架，利用可极化原子多极矩从能量和力中学习静电作用。局域等变描述符预测依赖于环境的隐变量单极矩、偶极矩和四极矩，而剩余的非局域电荷转移和极化则通过感应电荷与感应偶极矩的非自洽线性响应进行描述。在四个不同的基准体系和四种短程MLIP架构中，多极矩层级结构和响应项系统性地提高了势能面精度；在长程效应至关重要的体系中，提升幅度最大。更重要的是，在没有直接监督的情况下，该方法产生了具有物理意义的电响应。学习得到的隐变量多极矩能够准确给出Born有效电荷张量和红外光谱，并且与实验结果高度一致。感应偶极矩扩展还带来了新的能力：它能够预测极化率，进而为体相水和混合型MAPbI₃钙钛矿提供半定量的拉曼光谱预测，并再现水-空气界面表面特异振动和频生成光谱的基本特征。在铁电HfO₂中，预测得到的电响应还捕捉到了纵光学-横光学（LO-TO）劈裂和极化翻转现象。这一可系统改进且具有物理透明性的框架，使得仅利用标准能量和力标签训练的MLIP能够预测对极化敏感的观测量。

articles.title: Hall effect in multi-leg bosonic ladders
articles.title_zh: 多腿玻色梯子中的霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28090v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use bosonization to analyze the ground state Hall response of interacting bosonic N-leg ladders threaded by a flux. We derive an explicit expression of the Hall imbalance in a perturbative expansion in the band curvature, retaining fully the interactions. For small magnetic field the Hall resistance is proportional to the derivative of the logarithm of the charge stiffness with respect to density, generalizing the result obtained in the two leg case. We also consider the effect of temperature, and establish that at low temperature, corrections to the Hall resistance are exponentially small in the Meissner phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用玻色化方法分析穿透磁通的相互作用玻色N腿梯子的基态霍尔响应。作者在保留完整相互作用的同时，对能带曲率进行微扰展开，得到霍尔不平衡的显式表达式。弱磁场下，霍尔电阻与电荷刚度对密度的对数导数成正比，这是对两腿情形结果的推广；在低温迈斯纳相中，霍尔电阻的温度修正呈指数小。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用玻色化方法分析穿透磁通的相互作用玻色N腿梯子的基态霍尔响应。我们在完全保留相互作用效应的同时，对能带曲率进行微扰展开，并推导出霍尔不平衡的显式表达式。在小磁场下，霍尔电阻与电荷刚度对密度的导数所对应的对数导数成正比，这是对两腿情形中所得结果的推广。我们还考察了温度的影响，并证明在低温下，迈斯纳相中的霍尔电阻修正相对于主要结果呈指数小量。

articles.title: Holographic duality between bulk topological order and boundary mixed-state order
articles.title_zh: 体拓扑序与边界混合态序之间的全息对偶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.19597v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a holographic framework for analyzing the steady states of repeated quantum channels with strong symmetries. Using channel-state duality, we show that the steady state of a d-dimensional quantum channel is holographically mapped to the boundary reduced density matrix of a (d+1)-dimensional wavefunction generated by a sequential unitary circuit. From this perspective, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the steady state arises from the anyon condensation on the boundary of a topological order in one higher dimension. The conditional mutual information (CMI) associated with SWSSB is then inherited from the bulk topological entanglement entropy. We make this duality explicit using isometric tensor network states (isoTNS) by identifying the channel's time evolution with the transfer matrix of a higher-dimensional isoTNS. Built on isoTNS, we further construct continuously tunable quantum channels that exhibit distinct mixed-state phases and transitions in the steady states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个用于分析具有强对称性的重复量子信道稳态的全息框架。借助信道-态对偶性，d 维量子信道的稳态可映射为由序贯幺正电路生成的高一维波函数的边界约化密度矩阵。研究表明，稳态中的强到弱自发对称性破缺可理解为高一维体拓扑序边界上的任意子凝聚，并可由体拓扑纠缠熵解释相应的条件互信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一个全息框架，用于分析具有强对称性的重复量子信道的稳态。利用信道-态对偶性，我们证明，d 维量子信道的稳态在全息意义下映射为一个（d+1）维波函数的边界约化密度矩阵，而该波函数由序贯幺正电路生成。从这一视角来看，稳态中的强到弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）源于高一维拓扑序边界上的任意子凝聚。与 SWSSB 相关的条件互信息（CMI）因此继承自体拓扑纠缠熵。我们利用等距张量网络态（isoTNS）明确展示了这种对偶性，将信道的时间演化识别为高维 isoTNS 的转移矩阵。在 isoTNS 的基础上，我们进一步构造了可连续调节的量子信道，并证明这些信道的稳态表现出不同的混合态相及相变。

articles.title: Influence of Generalized Ghost Dark Energy on Wormhole Geometry
articles.title_zh: 广义幽灵暗能量对虫洞几何的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article presents a wormhole solution constructed from a generalized ghost dark energy (GGDE) source in general relativity. At first, a brief review of GGDE is presented along with the necessary mathematical frameworks. We employed the Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) technique to constrain the free parameters of the model using the CC+BAO, Pantheon⁺, and their combined datasets. Furthermore, the Akaike Information Criterion (AIC) and Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) were used to statistically assess the model's performance and determine its level of acceptance. Next, the basics of wormhole geometries along with the thin-shell formalism are explained in detail. After that, three different wormhole solutions associated with three different choices of the redshift function are presented ,and their various geometric properties as well as energy conditions are studied graphically. Finally, the stability of these thin--shell structures is examined analytically as well as graphically by studying the associated effective potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在广义相对论框架下，以广义幽灵暗能量为源构造了虫洞解。作者利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法，结合 CC+BAO、Pantheon⁺ 及其联合数据集约束模型参数，并通过 AIC 和 BIC 评估模型表现。随后，文章研究了三种红移函数选择下的虫洞几何、能量条件及薄壳结构稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一个由广义幽灵暗能量（GGDE）源在广义相对论中构造的虫洞解。首先，文章简要回顾了 GGDE，并介绍了所需的数学框架。我们采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法，利用 CC+BAO、Pantheon⁺ 以及它们的联合数据集，对模型的自由参数进行约束。此外，还使用赤池信息准则（AIC）和贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）对模型表现进行统计评估，并确定其可接受程度。接下来，文章详细说明了虫洞几何的基础知识以及薄壳形式。之后，针对三种不同的红移函数选择，给出了三个不同的虫洞解，并以图形方式研究了它们的各种几何性质和能量条件。最后，通过研究相关的有效势，对这些薄壳结构的稳定性进行了解析和图形分析。

articles.title: How well is surface ocean carbon represented in observations and ocean models?
articles.title_zh: 观测和海洋模型对海洋表层碳的表征程度如何？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a general framework for quantifying the information content and representation quality of complex geophysical datasets based on the intrinsic dimension and differentiable information imbalance of data manifolds. We use it to derive and compare optimal representations of surface ocean carbon in the SOCAT database of observations and in global ocean biogeochemistry models (GOBMs) and to assess the robustness of the information we can extract from existing data. We find that within the most widely used feature set, the complexity of the data space of SOCAT observations is not fully captured by GOBMs, but the ranking and relative importance of variables learned through GOBMs are substantially correct. We observe that the learned representation of ocean carbon is less accurate in some regions, including the Southern Ocean, but doesn't appear to have evolved significantly over the last two decades. Finally, we show how the optimal representations can be used to improve the skill of distance-based machine learning models and demonstrate it for ocean carbon, and we propose two new metrics to compare models and observations that can be used to build more accurate weighted ensembles of estimates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于数据流形内禀维数和可微信息不平衡度的通用框架，用于量化复杂地球物理数据集的信息含量及其表征质量。该框架被用于比较 SOCAT 观测数据库与全球海洋生物地球化学模型对海洋表层碳的最优表征。结果显示，模型未完全捕捉观测数据空间的复杂性，但对变量排序及相对重要性的学习总体上是正确的；这些表征还可用于提升基于距离的机器学习模型，并构建更准确的加权集合估计。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个基于数据流形内禀维数和可微信息不平衡度的通用框架，用于量化复杂地球物理数据集的信息含量和表征质量。我们利用该框架，推导并比较 SOCAT 观测数据库和全球海洋生物地球化学模型（GOBMs）中海洋表层碳的最优表征，同时评估现有数据中可提取信息的稳健性。我们发现，在使用最广泛的特征集合时，SOCAT 观测数据空间的复杂性并未被 GOBMs 完全捕捉，但通过 GOBMs 学得的变量排序及其相对重要性总体上是正确的。我们观察到，在包括南大洋在内的一些区域，所学习的海洋碳表征准确性较低，但在过去二十年中似乎没有显著演化。最后，我们展示了如何利用最优表征提高基于距离的机器学习模型的性能，并以海洋碳为例进行了验证；同时提出了两个用于比较模型和观测的新指标，这些指标可用于构建更准确的估计结果加权集合。

articles.title: Collective dressed states for inelastic light scattering by atomic ensembles
articles.title_zh: 原子系综非弹性光散射的集体缀饰态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a general dressed-state framework for computing fluorescence spectra, probe absorption spectra, and photon-photon correlations of light scattered by ensembles of N_at two-level atoms with arbitrary J_g → Jₑ transitions driven by intense coherent fields. The approach employs a full vectorial treatment of the electromagnetic field, handles any atomic geometries, illumination directions, and polarizations, and yields optical observables as explicit sums of Lorentzian lines whose positions, widths, and weights are directly tied to the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the Lindbladian. The framework is implemented in an open-source Python package and benchmarked against exact single- and two-atom calculations. We identify geometries in which the full vectorial description is essential, and the scalar approximation fails qualitatively. Applying the method to pairs of atoms with a J_g=0→ Jₑ=1 transition, we show that elastic and inelastic scattered intensities collapse onto universal master curves controlled by a single collective saturation parameter built from the dominant superradiant mode, across several orders of magnitude in drive strength and interatomic distance. We identify collective phenomena that require a description beyond this single-mode picture. Extending the analysis to atoms with ground-state degeneracy, we find that most collective features carry over, while two qualitatively new effects emerge: an incoherent spontaneous Raman channel that modifies the scaling of inelastic emission, and a slow timescale in the time-delayed correlations g⁽²⁾(τ) governed by the competition between Raman scattering and subradiant decay, controlled by a single dimensionless parameter. These results provide both physical insight and practical computational tools for engineering collective optical responses in few-atom systems such as optical tweezer arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个集体缀饰态理论框架，用于计算强相干场驱动下、具有任意 Jg → Je 跃迁的 N_at 个二能级原子系综的荧光谱、探针吸收谱和光子-光子关联。该方法采用完整矢量电磁场描述，适用于任意原子几何结构、入射方向和偏振，并将光学观测量表示为与 Lindblad 超算符本征值和本征矢直接相关的洛伦兹线之和。针对原子对的研究揭示了由超辐射模主导的集体饱和参数控制的普适标度关系，以及简并基态引发的自发拉曼通道和慢关联时间尺度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发展了一个通用的缀饰态理论框架，用于计算强相干场驱动下、具有任意 Jg → Je 跃迁的 N_at 个二能级原子系综所散射光的荧光谱、探针吸收谱和光子-光子关联。该方法采用完整的矢量电磁场处理，能够处理任意原子几何结构、照明方向和偏振，并将光学观测量表示为洛伦兹线的显式求和形式，其中线的位置、宽度和权重直接对应于 Lindblad 超算符的本征值和本征矢。该框架已在一个开源 Python 软件包中实现，并通过精确的单原子和双原子计算进行了基准测试。我们确定了一些完整矢量描述不可或缺、而标量近似会定性失效的几何结构。将该方法应用于具有 Jg=0→Je=1 跃迁的原子对时，我们发现，在跨越多个驱动强度和原子间距离数量级的范围内，弹性和非弹性散射强度会塌缩到由单一集体饱和参数控制的普适主曲线上；该参数由主导超辐射模构成。我们还识别出一些需要超越单模图像才能描述的集体现象。进一步将分析扩展到具有基态简并的原子后，我们发现，大多数集体特征仍然存在，同时出现了两个定性上全新的效应：非相干自发拉曼通道会改变非弹性发射的标度关系；时间延迟关联 g⁽²⁾(τ) 中还出现了一个慢时间尺度，该时间尺度由拉曼散射与亚辐射衰减之间的竞争控制，并由一个无量纲参数决定。这些结果既为理解少原子体系中的集体光学响应提供了物理洞见，也提供了实用的计算工具，可用于设计光镊阵列等体系中的集体光学响应。

articles.title: A fully coupled electromagnetic-thermal-mechanical model for metal-insulated HTS high field magnets
articles.title_zh: 金属绝缘高温超导高场磁体的全耦合电磁-热-力学模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra high field REBCO magnets operate under strongly coupled electromagnetic, thermal and mechanical conditions, where screening currents, localized heating, thermal expansion and Lorentz forces can modify both the structural state and the critical current density of the conductor. In this work, a coupled electromagnetic, thermal and mechanical model is developed for a metal-insulated nested REBCO insert designed for a 40 T class SuperEMFL magnet. The existing electromagnetic formulation resolves the non-uniform screening currents in the REBCO tapes. The thermal model is extended from an explicit Finite Difference Method (FDM) to an implicit Backward Euler scheme with Picard iteration, while a new axisymmetric mechanical FDM solver based on BiCGSTAB is introduced to calculate displacements, strains and stresses in the coil windings and G10 spacer regions. Thermal expansion and Lorentz force contributions are included, and the calculated longitudinal mechanical strain is coupled back to the electromagnetic model through a strain dependent critical current density, which also depends on temperature, magnetic field, and its orientation. A literature-informed Parabolic-Weibull model is used to model reversible and irreversible strain degradation of the REBCO conductor. The numerical methods are benchmarked, and the resulting framework provides a computationally efficient approach for investigating temperature gradients, thermo-mechanical stresses, strain-dependent critical current degradation and quench behaviour in full scale nested high field REBCO magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对 40 T 级 SuperEMFL 磁体中的金属绝缘嵌套式 REBCO 插入磁体，本文建立了电磁、热和力学全耦合模型。模型描述了筛选电流、温度梯度、热膨胀和洛伦兹力，并将纵向机械应变通过应变相关的临界电流密度反馈至电磁模型。数值方法经过基准验证，可用于研究全尺寸嵌套式高场 REBCO 磁体中的热机械应力、临界电流退化及失超行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超高场 REBCO 磁体工作在强耦合的电磁、热和力学条件下，其中筛选电流、局部加热、热膨胀和洛伦兹力都可能改变导体的结构状态和临界电流密度。在本工作中，我们针对为 40 T 级 SuperEMFL 磁体设计的金属绝缘嵌套式 REBCO 插入磁体，建立了一个电磁、热和力学耦合模型。现有的电磁公式能够解析 REBCO 带材中的非均匀筛选电流。热模型从显式有限差分方法（FDM）扩展为带皮卡德迭代的隐式后向欧拉格式；同时，引入了一个新的基于 BiCGSTAB 的轴对称力学 FDM 求解器，用于计算线圈绕组和 G10 间隔区域中的位移、应变和应力。模型纳入了热膨胀和洛伦兹力的贡献，并将计算得到的纵向机械应变通过应变相关的临界电流密度反馈耦合到电磁模型中；该临界电流密度还取决于温度、磁场及其方向。我们采用基于文献的抛物线-威布尔模型，对 REBCO 导体的可逆和不可逆应变退化进行建模。数值方法经过基准测试，所得框架为研究全尺寸嵌套式高场 REBCO 磁体中的温度梯度、热机械应力、应变相关的临界电流退化和失超行为提供了一种计算效率较高的方法。

articles.title: Use of Cholesky decomposition in the CFOUR program package
articles.title_zh: Cholesky 分解在 CFOUR 程序包中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An overview is given about our efforts to speed up high-level computations of molec- ular energies and properties using Cholesky decomposition (CD). We describe the cor- responding developments in the CFOUR quantum-chemical package with a focus on (a) the use of CD in complete-active space self-consistent-field (CASSCF) and coupled- cluster (CC) computations, (b) the implementation of analytic CC gradients using CD, (c) the efficient calculation of magnetic properties (NMR shieldings and magnetizabili- ties) using CD when carried out with explicit magnetic-field dependent basis functions, i.e., the so-called gauge-including atomic orbitals (GIAOs), (d) the efficient computa- tion of CASSCF response properties using CD, (e) the use of CD in relativistic two- and four-component computations, as well as (f) computations for molecules in finite magnetic fields using GIAOs together with CD. An outlook on future developments concerning the CFOUR package is given.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了利用 Cholesky 分解加速高水平分子能量和性质计算的工作，并重点介绍其在 CFOUR 量子化学程序包中的实现。相关应用包括 CASSCF 和耦合簇计算、解析耦合簇梯度、采用 GIAO 基组的磁性质与响应性质计算，以及相对论二分量和四分量计算。文章还讨论了有限磁场下结合 GIAO 与 Cholesky 分解的分子计算及未来发展方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文概述了我们利用 Cholesky 分解（CD）加速高水平分子能量和性质计算所开展的工作。我们描述了 CD 在 CFOUR 量子化学程序包中的相关发展，重点包括：（a）在完备活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）和耦合簇（CC）计算中使用 CD；（b）利用 CD 实现解析 CC 梯度；（c）在使用显式磁场依赖基函数，即所谓规范包含原子轨道（GIAO）的情况下，利用 CD 高效计算磁性质（核磁共振屏蔽和磁化率）；（d）利用 CD 高效计算 CASSCF 响应性质；（e）在相对论二分量和四分量计算中使用 CD；以及（f）在有限磁场下，结合 GIAO 与 CD 进行分子计算。最后，文章展望了 CFOUR 程序包未来的发展。

articles.title: Spectral element lattice Boltzmann method for non-ideal gases with partial wetting boundary condition
articles.title_zh: 具有部分润湿边界条件的非理想气体谱元格子玻尔兹曼方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a spectral element lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) for partial wetting on curved geometries. A non-ideal gas phase-field model is incorporated into the LBM framework to enable phase separation with a constant interface thickness and the potential form of surface tension force is used. We adopt the force-splitting approach, yielding significantly improved stability and accuracy. Complex boundaries are naturally handled using a flux bounce-back scheme, which resolves inconsistencies in normal vectors across adjacent elements. Additionally, a general wetting boundary condition is implemented to capture static contact line in a thermodynamically consistent manner. The method is validated through simulations of droplets on flat surfaces, 2/3-dimensional curved surfaces, and equilibrium droplets without boundaries. Results demonstrate that parasitic currents are significantly reduced on unstructured meshes with complex geometries, reaching residual kinetic energy levels on the order of 10⁻²⁴ for wetting configurations and 10⁻³⁰ for isolated droplets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于曲面几何中部分润湿问题的谱元格子玻尔兹曼方法。该方法将非理想气体相场模型与格子玻尔兹曼方法结合，以实现相分离，并采用表面张力力的势形式和力分裂方法来提高稳定性与精度。通过通量反弹回方法处理复杂边界，并实现热力学一致的润湿边界条件；液滴测试表明，该方法在复杂非结构网格上的寄生流显著降低。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种用于曲面几何中部分润湿问题的谱元格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）。该方法将非理想气体相场模型纳入 LBM 框架，以实现具有恒定界面厚度的相分离，并采用表面张力力的势形式。我们采用力分裂方法，从而显著改善了稳定性和精度。复杂边界通过通量反弹回格式得到自然处理，该格式解决了相邻谱元之间法向量不一致的问题。此外，我们实现了一种通用润湿边界条件，以热力学一致的方式捕捉静态接触线。我们通过模拟平面表面上的液滴、二维和三维曲面上的液滴，以及无边界平衡液滴，对该方法进行了验证。结果表明，在具有复杂几何结构的非结构网格上，寄生流得到显著降低；对于润湿构型，残余动能可达到 10⁻²⁴ 量级，而对于孤立液滴则可达到 10⁻³⁰ 量级。

articles.title: Dual-polarized, mid-infrared nonreciprocal absorption
articles.title_zh: 双偏振中红外非互易吸收
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emission and absorption of thermal radiation are usually coupled via Kirchhoff's law or reciprocity, stated as the equality of spectral directional emissivity and absorptivity. Magneto-optical materials have recently been identified as a promising route to lifting the constraint of reciprocity, with multiple experimental demonstrations using doped InAs. However, these demonstrations have been limited to p-polarized light in the Voigt configuration, whereas thermal radiation from a blackbody is unpolarized. Therefore, to break reciprocity in both polarization channels, we design a nanophotonic, dual-polarized nonreciprocal absorber operating in the mid-infrared spectral range (11-20 unicodex03BCm), consisting of an a-Si photonic crystal slab on top of a doped InAs substrate described by an antisymmetric, nonreciprocal dielectric tensor under an applied magnetic field. The photonic crystal slab supports eigenmodes that couple to both s- and p-polarized light, resulting in absorption peaks that frequency shift in opposite directions for forward- and backward-propagating lightunicodex2014a signature of nonreciprocity in planar, subwavelength systems. We fabricate our design, then measure its room-temperature absorptance using magnetic-field-integrated absorptance spectroscopy, experimentally demonstrating nonreciprocal absorption for both polarizations. Our design is a step toward the complete control of light as heat, which could improve photonic energy conversion, thermal management, and mid-infrared optical isolation and circulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 热辐射的发射与吸收通常通过基尔霍夫定律或互易性相联系，而磁光材料为打破这一限制提供了途径。本文设计并制备了一种工作于 11 至 20 μm 中红外波段的双偏振非互易吸收器，由非晶硅光子晶体薄膜和掺杂 InAs 衬底组成。实验在室温下证明了 s 偏振和 p 偏振通道中的非互易吸收，为热光子能量转换、热管理及中红外光隔离和环行提供了新方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热辐射的发射和吸收通常通过基尔霍夫定律或互易性相耦合，基尔霍夫定律或互易性表述为光谱方向发射率与吸收率相等。磁光材料近来被认为是解除互易性约束的一条有前景途径，并且已有多项利用掺杂 InAs 的实验展示。然而，这些展示仅限于 Voigt 构型下的 p 偏振光，而黑体的热辐射是非偏振的。因此，为了在两种偏振通道中都打破互易性，我们设计了一种工作在中红外光谱范围（11-20 μm）的纳米光子双偏振非互易吸收器。该吸收器由位于掺杂 InAs 衬底上的非晶硅光子晶体薄膜组成，在外加磁场下，掺杂 InAs 由反对称的非互易介电张量描述。光子晶体薄膜支持能够与 s 偏振光和 p 偏振光耦合的本征模，从而产生吸收峰；对于正向和反向传播的光，这些吸收峰会沿相反方向发生频移，这是平面亚波长系统中非互易性的特征。我们制备了该设计，并通过结合磁场的吸收光谱测量，在室温下测量其吸收率，实验上证明了两种偏振下的非互易吸收。我们的设计朝着完全控制光作为热的方向迈出了一步，有望改善光子能量转换、热管理以及中红外光隔离和环行。

articles.title: Photonic magnetism and altermagnetism without magnetic materials
articles.title_zh: 无需磁性材料的光子磁性与交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetism, a fundamental property of solids arising from the collective alignment of electronic spins of magnetic atoms, has recently been expanded by the discovery of altermagnetism, a symmetry-driven phase distinct from both ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism. Initial efforts to emulate altermagnetism in photonic systems are also being pursued, primarily through the magneto-optic response of materials; however, their intrinsic frequency limitations pose challenges for extending photonic altermagnetism into the optical regime, thereby restricting their material choices and optical applications. Here, we establish a microscopic framework of photonic magnetism through group theory symmetry analysis, defining photonic counterparts of electron spin and magnetic atoms. This approach enables the realization of photonic ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, and altermagnetic phases within structured optical lattices constructed by purely dielectric, nonmagnetic materials, which not only broadens the photonic magnetism concept, but also lifts the material and frequency limitations. Analytical models, numerical simulations, and experimental measurements reveal spin-momentum locking directly corresponding to their electronic analogs, showing d-, g-, and i-wave circular dichroism (CD) splitting bands at telecom wavelengths (around 1550 nm). These results demonstrate that altermagnetic order, and magnetism more broadly, can be reconstructed in photonic systems through symmetry and mode coupling alone, opening a new route towards spin-dependent light control and bosonic analogs of quantum magnetic phenomena in dielectric photonic crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于群论对称性分析建立了光子磁性的微观理论框架，并定义了电子自旋和磁性原子的光子对应物。借助纯介电、非磁性材料构成的结构化光学晶格，研究实现了光子铁磁、反铁磁和交替磁相，并在约 1550 nm 的电信波段观察到与电子体系对应的自旋-动量锁定及 d 波、g 波和 i 波圆二色性分裂能带。结果表明，仅通过对称性和模式耦合即可重构交替磁序及更广义的磁性，为介电光子晶体中的自旋依赖光调控提供了新途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性是固体的一种基本性质，源于磁性原子电子自旋的集体排列；最近，随着交替磁性的发现，磁性的概念得到了扩展。交替磁性是一种由对称性驱动的相，与铁磁性和反铁磁性均不相同。在光子系统中模拟交替磁性的初步工作也正在开展，主要依赖材料的磁光响应；然而，磁光响应固有的频率限制，使得将光子交替磁性扩展到光学频段面临挑战，从而限制了可选材料和光学应用。本文通过群论对称性分析建立了光子磁性的微观理论框架，并定义了电子自旋和磁性原子的光子对应物。该方法使得人们能够在完全由纯介电、非磁性材料构成的结构化光学晶格中实现光子铁磁相、反铁磁相和交替磁相，同时拓展了光子磁性的概念，并解除材料和频率方面的限制。解析模型、数值模拟和实验测量揭示了与电子对应物直接相联系的自旋-动量锁定，并在电信波长（约 1550 nm）处显示出 d 波、g 波和 i 波圆二色性（CD）分裂能带。这些结果表明，仅通过对称性和模式耦合，即可在光子系统中重构交替磁序以及更广义的磁性，从而为自旋依赖的光控制和介电光子晶体中量子磁现象的玻色子类比提供了新途径。
articles.focus_summary: 论文建立了纯介电、非磁性光学晶格中的光子磁性微观框架，并通过群论定义光子自旋和光子磁性原子的对应概念。研究表明，结构化光学晶格可以实现光子铁磁、反铁磁和交替磁性相，从而突破传统磁光材料的频率限制。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队关注的交替磁性、磁性拓扑性质和对称性分析相关，但研究对象主要是光子系统而非真实磁性材料。其群论框架和交替磁性判据可借鉴到二维磁体、磁性超晶格及光-磁耦合体系的理论分析中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究光子交替磁性与真实二维范德华磁体之间的对应关系，或利用第一性原理和有效自旋哈密顿量分析具有类似对称性的材料。还可探索光子晶格中的非互易输运、拓扑态及磁电耦合类比现象。

articles.title: Direct Optimization of a 3D Finite-Source Reflector via Neural-Network Parameterization
articles.title_zh: 通过神经网络参数化直接优化三维有限源反射器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a direct optimization method for three-dimensional freeform reflectors that transform the light of a finite-étendue source into a prescribed far-field angular intensity distribution. The reflector profile is represented by a small neural network (a multilayer perceptron), which is trained end-to-end through a differentiable ray-tracing objective. We furthermore parameterize the emission directions in gnomonic coordinates, and show how we use this to ensure that every emitted ray intersects the reflector. At each iteration, the network is converted to a bicubic spline representation for ray-tracing efficiency, and intersections with this smooth surface are solved by a damped Newton solve, with gradients computed via the implicit function theorem. The traced output distribution is compared with the desired target on a 'soft' histogram, under an H⁻¹-type spectral weighting that emphasizes long-range transport of flux to improve convergence. Optimization is performed using a BFGS method with self-scaled Broyden updates and a plateau-perturbation rule to prevent stalling. The method converges reliably within seconds on a single GPU for all examples tested.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种三维自由曲面反射器的直接优化方法，用于将有限展度光源的光转换为指定的远场角强度分布。反射器轮廓由小型多层感知器表示，并通过可微分光线追迹目标进行端到端训练。方法采用本征函数坐标参数化出射方向，在保证光线与反射器相交的同时，通过光滑曲面求交、隐式函数梯度和带防停滞策略的 BFGS 优化实现了可靠且快速的收敛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种三维自由曲面反射器的直接优化方法，用于将有限展度光源的光转换为预先指定的远场角强度分布。反射器轮廓由一个小型神经网络（多层感知器）表示，并通过可微分的光线追迹目标进行端到端训练。此外，我们在本征函数坐标中对发射方向进行参数化，并展示了如何利用这种参数化确保每条发射光线都与反射器相交。在每次迭代中，神经网络都会被转换为双三次样条表示，以提高光线追迹效率；随后通过阻尼牛顿求解方法计算光线与光滑曲面的交点，并利用隐式函数定理计算梯度。将追迹得到的输出分布与目标分布在一种“软”直方图上进行比较，同时采用 H⁻¹ 型谱加权，以强调通量的长距离输运并改善收敛性。优化使用 BFGS 方法，并结合自缩放的 Broyden 更新和平台扰动规则来防止停滞。在所测试的所有示例中，该方法都能在单个 GPU 上于数秒内可靠收敛。

articles.title: Multiphase Reactive Transport in a Heterogeneous Flow Field: Channel Formation in Hydrocarbon-Bearing Carbonate Rock
articles.title_zh: 非均质流场中的多相反应输运：含烃碳酸盐岩中的通道形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01328v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) is a key approach for reducing anthropogenic CO2 emissions. Currently the vast majority of CO2 stored is injected into depleted hydrocarbon reservoirs. Reactive transport in hydrocarbon-bearing carbonate reservoirs is controlled not only by the balance between reactant delivery and surface reaction, but also by the heterogeneous pore-scale flow field created by pore structure and fluid distribution. Here, we used time-resolved micro-CT imaging, pore-network analysis, and direct numerical simulation to investigate channelized dissolution during injection of CO2-saturated brine into oil-bearing Ketton limestone at 0.5 mL/min. The system remained in a high Pe, low Da regime throughout the 180 min injection. Despite the advection-dominated flow regime, dissolution became strongly localized. Preferential flow pathways were already present originally because the heterogeneous pore structure and remaining-oil occupancy restricted brine flow to a subset of the connected pore space. Dissolution progressively amplified these pathways. The associated reduction in hydraulic resistance further focused flow, producing a continuous tortuous channel by 180 min. Meanwhile, the effective reaction rate was only 1.6*10⁵ mol/m2s,, approximately one order of magnitude lower than the batch reaction rate, showing that rapid advective transport did not translate directly into rapid overall dissolution under multiphase conditions. These results demonstrate that channel formation arose from the coupling between strong reactant delivery and pore-scale flow-field heterogeneity, rather than from the bulk Pe Da regime alone. Accounting for flow-field heterogeneity is therefore important for predicting reactive transport and pore-structure evolution during CO2 injection into hydrocarbon-bearing carbonate reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合时间分辨微型 CT 成像、孔隙网络分析和直接数值模拟，研究了 CO₂ 饱和盐水注入含油 Ketton 石灰岩时的通道化溶解过程。尽管体系始终处于高 Pe、低 Da 的平流主导状态，溶解仍因孔隙结构和残余油分布造成的非均质流场而高度局部化，并逐步放大已有的优先流路，最终形成连续的曲折通道。研究表明，通道形成源于反应物输运与孔隙尺度流场非均质性的耦合，而不能仅由宏观 Pe-Da 状态解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碳捕集、利用与封存（CCUS）是减少人为 CO₂ 排放的一项关键方法。目前，所封存的 CO₂ 绝大部分被注入已枯竭的含烃储层。含烃碳酸盐岩储层中的反应输运不仅受反应物输送与表面反应之间平衡的控制，还受到由孔隙结构和流体分布形成的非均质孔隙尺度流场的控制。在本研究中，我们采用时间分辨微型 CT 成像、孔隙网络分析和直接数值模拟，研究了以 0.5 mL/min 的速率向含油 Ketton 石灰岩中注入 CO₂ 饱和盐水时的通道化溶解过程。在 180 min 的注入过程中，该体系始终处于高 Pe、低 Da 状态。尽管流动状态由平流主导，溶解仍变得高度局部化。由于非均质孔隙结构和残余油的占据，盐水流动从一开始就被限制在连通孔隙空间的一个子集内，因此优先流动通道原本就已存在。溶解过程逐渐放大了这些通道。随之而来的水力阻力降低进一步集中流动，并在 180 min 时形成了一条连续的曲折通道。同时，有效反应速率仅为 1.6×10⁵ mol/m²s，约为批量反应速率的一个数量级以下，这表明在多相条件下，快速的平流输运并不会直接转化为快速的总体溶解。上述结果表明，通道形成源于强反应物输送与孔隙尺度流场非均质性之间的耦合，而不是仅由宏观 Pe-Da 状态决定。因此，在预测 CO₂ 注入含烃碳酸盐岩储层过程中的反应输运和孔隙结构演化时，考虑流场非均质性十分重要。

articles.title: The role of different nonlinearities and potential vorticity conservation in two-dimensional fluid ITG models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nature of turbulent energy cascade of simple two-dimensional fluid models of ion temperature gradient driven turbulence is studied in detail. Notably, it is observed that a minimal two-field model of toroidal ITG, behaves qualitatively differently with or without the diamagnetic nonlinearity. In its absence, the zonal flows always dominate and the system never reaches a high-transport state. In contrast, when this term is included, zonal flows dominate only near marginality, while away from it, an inverse cascade with high levels of transport is observed, requiring large-scale dissipation (hypoviscosity) to saturate and hyperviscosity to regularize small scale instability associated with this nonlinear term. However introducing such a term, together with the existence of the curvature term, breaks potential vorticity conservation, which is one of the key symmetries of drift-wave turbulence. This can be remedied by considering a more complete model that retains higher-order terms in the pressure equation. This form of the model, with four nonlinearities, conserves potential vorticity and behaves similarly to the original model, requiring hyperviscosity to saturate since the added nonlinearity generates small scale instability also for the pressure equation. To characterize the roles of potential vorticity conservation and higher-order terms in the pressure equation, the behavior of both the standard ITG system, and the potential vorticity conserving system, is studied by analyzing their spectra, turbulent cascades, and sensitivity to viscosity. Finally, the direction of turbulent cascade due to the different nonlinearities (i.e. the diamagnetic nonlinearity in particular) is investigated by examining their contributions to the spectral energy transfer and by considering the triadic instability assumption for each of these nonlinearities separately.

articles.title: Reference-Density Hartree Screening for Gausslet Hamiltonians
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gausslets are among the few electronic-structure bases that permit the four-index electron--electron interaction to be replaced by an accurate two-index integral diagonal approximation (IDA). Near a many-electron nucleus, however, the nuclear attraction and core-electron Hartree field are individually large and substantially cancel. Treating the first as a full finite-basis matrix while treating the second with IDA leaves an avoidable imbalance. We introduce reference-density Hartree screening: the Hartree field of a chosen reference density is represented accurately, and IDA is applied only to density fluctuations about it. Tests on He, Ne, atomic F, F₂, and Cr₂ show large reductions in direct Hartree errors, including transfer of fitted neutral-atom fields to molecules. For Cr₂, atomic-core screening prevents the spurious HF collapse found with the unscreened q=5 and q=7 Hamiltonians, whereas finite-reference matching without screening does not. Screening leaves exchange and residual correlation unchanged. We therefore also introduce a low-rank one-particle correction that uses an accurate conventional Gaussian-basis Hartree--Fock calculation to match either occupied-space exchange information or the complete occupied Fock vectors. In F₂ and Cr₂, Xᵣₘ HF reproduces the finite-reference energy and occupied Fock vectors to numerical precision and the selected states return after orbital perturbations. For Cr₂, the corrected q=5 basis uses one quarter as many functions as the q=7 control while retaining sub-mHa mean-field accuracy. Screening provides the physical improvement to the direct field; the state-specific correction then restores the remaining accuracy of the Gaussian-basis mean-field reference.

articles.title: A Magnetothermodynamic Theory of Energy Transport In Collisionless Plasmas
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Presented here is an exploratory conceptual framework with the aim of describing electromagnetic and thermal energy transport and transfer in collisionless plasmas in a coherent way, starting from an arrow-of-time perspective. That is, arguments about the transport of energy are fundamentally based on the idea that systems tend to fill the phase space available to them. First, we describe electric fields, magnetic fields, and plasma particles as interacting subsystems that are thermodynamically linked in specific ways. Second, we discuss the importance of the stochastic electric field in the transport of plasma particles down energy density gradients until the energy flux contributions from so-called electrothermodynamic (ETD) interactions become sufficiently uniform. Third, the logic of ETD transport is extended to a magnetized system invoking 2 types of magnetothermodyamic (MTD) transport: 1) transport of electromagnetic energy through stochastic Poynting flux and 2) plasma energy transport through stochastic drift energy fluxes associated with local ExB drift motion. The magnitudes of the ETD and MTD mechanisms are tied to local characteristic scales of the electric field fluctuations and critical scales are derived beyond which ETD mechanisms dominate MTD mechanisms. Finally, we discuss the interplay between electrothermodynamic and magnetothermodynamic equilibria (ETE and MTE), dynamics in the small critical scale (MTD) limit, and the potential relevance of this type of description to the problem of reconnection onset and scale coupling.

articles.title: A Sensor-Adaptive Incremental Learning Framework for Artifact Detection in Satellite Precipitation Data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.01514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Historically, retrieving rainfall data from satellite imagery has been the domain of space agencies. However, in recent years, the development of cheaper, more compact satellites (SmallSats) capable of detecting rainfall proxies has led to a significant increase in private-sector initiatives for satellite launch and surface precipitation products. This rapid growth has yet to be matched by data validation efforts. Consequently, the need for a robust tool to detect anomalies in near-real-time data before it is disseminated to the public has become critical. In this paper, we present the development of an anomaly-detection system to identify artifacts in global satellite-based rainfall products. The developed framework leverages pre-trained computer vision models and incorporates scarce human-labeled data to detect specific anomalies. Our proposed anomaly detection strategy is tested on data from the Special Sensor Microwave Imager (SSMI) and the Special Sensor Microwave Imager/Sounder (SSMIS). Results demonstrate the efficacy of our approach at separating regular orbits from artifact-containing orbits for each satellite, with performance comparable to state-of-the-art in-place methods. Additionally, the framework offers explainability and the capacity for iterative refinement following false-positive or false-negative classifications.

articles.title: Chern--Simons Fluctuations and Information Geometry in Discrete Electromagnetism
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00020v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct helicity-conditioned statistical states for a Whitney-discretized electromagnetic field on a closed oriented three-manifold. The simplicial de Rham complex provides exact discrete gauge symmetry, while the Whitney inner product separates exact, harmonic, and coexact sectors. The spatial Abelian Chern--Simons functional is gauge invariant and depends only on the coexact potential. After fixing harmonic modes, we introduce a helicity-biased Gaussian ensemble on the reduced electromagnetic phase space and derive explicit formulas for its admissible parameters, partition function, mean helicity, relative entropy, and Fisher information. The distribution uniquely minimizes relative entropy under a prescribed mean-helicity constraint. Its helicity susceptibility equals the variance of the discrete Chern--Simons functional and controls the local distinguishability of neighboring statistical states. Because magnetic helicity is generally not conserved under unconstrained Maxwell dynamics, these states represent conditioned inference rather than dynamical equilibrium.

articles.title: AdaptNTK: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification and Active Learning for Neural Network Potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00488v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials bridge the gap between quantum chemical precision and classical computational speed, enabling molecular dynamics simulations with first-principles accuracy. Their reliability is often improved through active learning, which iteratively expands the training set by identifying uncertain, out-of-distribution configurations. Existing uncertainty-quantification methods often involve a trade-off between computational cost and reliability, and generally cannot account for redundancy as an acquisition batch is assembled. Here, we introduce AdaptNTK, a single-model framework that measures uncertainty as a regularized Mahalanobis distance in empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) feature space. With the NTK features fixed during acquisition, the uncertainty depends on the acquired configurations but not their reference labels. This allows the uncertainty to be updated recursively after each selection without retraining, reducing redundancy within an acquisition batch. On held-out rMD17 data, AdaptNTK achieves the highest mean correlations with force errors (Spearman 0.68, Pearson 0.71) and matches a three-member ensemble in error retention. In active learning experiments, AdaptNTK achieves the lowest force errors across rMD17 and Transition-1X, with particularly strong performance on transition-state configurations in Transition-1X. AdaptNTK provides a 2.6-fold speedup per Transition-1X cycle relative to the ensemble, providing efficient single-model uncertainty estimation with sequential updates for data-efficient active learning.
articles.focus_summary: 论文提出了AdaptNTK方法，利用经验神经切线核特征空间中的正则化马氏距离进行单模型不确定性量化和主动学习。该方法能够递归更新候选构型的不确定性、减少批量采样中的冗余，并在分子动力学数据集上取得较好的误差相关性。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队发展的机器学习势、图神经网络、主动学习和材料分子动力学高度直接相关。其无需重新训练即可更新不确定性的策略，可用于提升铁电畴壁、缺陷迁移、离子扩散及复杂相变模拟的数据效率。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该方法在HfO2铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿、锂电池材料和含电荷缺陷体系中的表现，特别是长程库仑作用和多组分自旋体系。还可将其与等变神经网络、能量-力-应力联合训练及分布外检测结合。

articles.title: Why Multi-Layer Message Passing Works: Completeness Theory for Graph Neural Network Interatomic Potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00528v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that the Hypergraph Neural Network, an invariant architecture with 3-body message passing, is a universal approximator for potential energy surfaces. Our main contribution is a multi-layer completeness theory. We show that L layers of message passing on sparse, cutoff-based graphs achieve the same representational power as having access to the full L-hop neighborhood, provided the configurations are generic, satisfy an overlap condition and a connectivity condition. This provides the first rigorous justification for the common practice of using multi-layer message passing with a per-layer cutoff smaller than the physical interaction range, the setting used by virtually all practical graph neural network based machine-learned interatomic potentials. As immediate consequences, we show that both DPA3 and CHGNet architectures inherit universal approximation.
articles.focus_summary: 论文从理论上证明了带有三体消息传递的超图神经网络能够普适逼近势能面，并建立了多层消息传递的完备性理论。研究说明，在满足一定重叠性和连通性条件时，较小截断半径的多层消息传递可以获得完整多跳邻域的信息，并据此推导DPA3和CHGNet具有普适逼近能力。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队关注的图神经网络、等变神经网络和机器学习原子势直接相关。该理论可帮助判断多层消息传递、局域截断和三体表示在材料势能面建模中的表达能力与适用范围。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议检验完备性条件在缺陷、界面、低维材料和强非均匀应变结构中的适用性，并量化其对长程相互作用建模的限制。可进一步结合E(3)等变架构、显式库仑项和自适应截断策略，构建更适合铁电和离子导体的机器学习势。
