Kuo, K. Lasko, K. Lau, M. Lautzenhiser, T. Liu, S. C. Mackey, N. Maher, K. G. Megerian, L. Minutolo, L. Moncelsi, Y. Nakato, H. T. Nguyen, R. O'Brient, S. N. Paine, M. A. Petroff, A. R. Polish, T. Prouve, C. Pryke, C. D. Reintsema, T. Romand, M. Salatino, A. Schillaci, B. Schmitt, B. Singari, A. Soliman, T. St. Germaine, A. Steiger, B. Steinbach, R. Sudiwala, K. L. Thompson, C. Tucker, A. D. Turner, C. Vergès, A. G. Vieregg, A. Wandui, A. C. Weber, J. Willmert, W. L. K. Wu, H. Yang, C. Yu, L. Zeng, C. Zhang, S. Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: BA4-90/150是将部署在BICEP Array（BA）系列中的第四台接收机，是一台双色90/150 GHz仪器，目标频率空间是对宇宙微波背景（CMB）偏振灵敏度最大化的区域。该接收机将于2026-2027南半球夏季部署，并将使BA能够实现对宇宙微波背景（CMB）偏振的异常精确测量，并加强对暴胀模型的约束。现有BA接收机中的近期测量表明，钛（Ti）过渡边缘传感器（TES）中出乎意料的高环路增益会产生过量高频噪声，随后这些噪声通过时分复用读出被混叠下变到科学频带中。为了降低环路增益，我们制备并测试了原型Ti TES晶圆，其中包含16种改进的探测器架构，旨在拓宽超导转变并降低转变陡峭度（alpha）。我们给出探测器性能结果，这些结果将直接为目前正在设计、用于完整接收机调试的最终集成晶圆提供依据。

articles.title: Detuning-robust Rydberg entangling gates from echoed pulses
articles.title_zh: 由回波脉冲实现的抗失谐里德堡纠缠门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26446v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rydberg-based two-qubit gate fidelities in neutral atom arrays are limited chiefly by laser intensity inhomogeneity and by detuning errors from frequency miscalibration, background-field drift, intermediate state light shift and Doppler shifts. Quantum optimal control can suppress the former, but no pulse can render a controlled-Z gate first-order insensitive to detuning. Here we show that this obstruction can be circumvented by designing Rydberg gate pulses with every leading-order detuning error relegated to single-qubit Z-rotations, which an echoed sequence removes. The resulting maximally-entangling ZZ gate has no leading-order response to arbitrary detunings on either atom, maintaining an infidelity below 10⁻³ much wider range of single-atom detunings than previous gate designs. We further show that a large fraction of residual error is dominated by population outside the computational subspace, which can be converted into heralded erasures. Our results significantly reduce the requirements on laser frequency stability and intensity homogeneity, field calibration and atomic temperature toward practical fault-tolerant quantum computing with neutral atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 中性原子阵列中的里德堡双量子比特门保真度主要受激光强度不均匀性和失谐误差限制。作者指出，尽管无法让受控Z门对失谐一阶不敏感，但可将主导失谐误差转化为单量子比特Z旋转并由回波序列消除。得到的最大纠缠ZZ门对任一原子的任意失谐无一阶响应，并可将部分残余误差转化为可标记擦除，从而放宽实用容错中性原子量子计算的实验要求。
authors: Zhubing Jia, Yichao Yu, Xiye Hu, Lintao Li, Jacob Zheng, Christopher Monroe, Jacob P. Covey
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中性原子阵列中基于里德堡的双量子比特门保真度主要受限于激光强度不均匀性，以及由频率校准误差、背景场漂移、中间态光移和多普勒频移导致的失谐误差。量子最优控制可以抑制前者，但没有任何脉冲能够使受控Z门对失谐达到一阶不敏感。这里我们表明，可以通过设计里德堡门脉冲来绕过这一障碍，使每一个主导阶失谐误差都被归入单量子比特Z旋转，而这些旋转可由回波序列去除。由此得到的最大纠缠ZZ门对任一原子上的任意失谐都没有主导阶响应，并且在比以往门设计宽得多的单原子失谐范围内将不保真度维持在10⁻³以下。我们进一步表明，残余误差中的很大一部分由计算子空间之外的布居主导，而这可以被转化为带标记的擦除。我们的结果显著降低了在中性原子上实现实用容错量子计算所需的激光频率稳定性和强度均匀性、场校准以及原子温度要求。

articles.title: Demystifying Relativistic Quantum Collapse
articles.title_zh: 澄清相对论性量子坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26474v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-relativistic objective collapse theories have been remarkably successful in addressing the conceptual problems of standard quantum mechanics. Despite substantial efforts, the project of extending them to the relativistic domain remains burdened by significant conceptual objections and technical challenges, often taken to cast doubt on the viability of the program as a whole. On the conceptual side, relativistic collapse theories have been claimed to face challenges involving tension between instantaneous collapse and relativity, frame-dependence of property values and probabilities, the possibility of superluminal signaling and the failure of narratability. On the technical side, persistent infinities, difficulties in constructing fully covariant frameworks and the apparent need for non-standard fields have hindered the development of workable models. In this paper, we offer a systematic rebuttal of the conceptual objections and provide a structured account of the remaining technical challenges. We conclude that relativistic collapse theories do provide a promising route toward a fully relativistic quantum framework that overcomes the conceptual limitations of standard quantum theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 非相对论客观坍缩理论在处理标准量子力学概念问题方面取得了显著成功，但相对论推广仍面临概念质疑和技术难题。作者系统回应了关于瞬时坍缩与相对论张力、性质和概率的参考系依赖、超光速信号以及可叙述性失效等概念反对意见。论文同时梳理了仍然存在的技术挑战，并认为相对论性坍缩理论仍是通向完整相对论量子框架的有希望路径。
authors: R. Muciño, E. Okon, D. Sudarsky, M. Wiedemann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非相对论客观坍缩理论在处理标准量子力学的概念问题方面取得了显著成功。尽管付出了大量努力，将它们扩展到相对论领域的项目仍然受到重大概念反对和技术挑战的困扰，而这些问题常被认为会使整个纲领的可行性受到怀疑。在概念方面，有人声称相对论性坍缩理论面临若干挑战，包括瞬时坍缩与相对论之间的张力、性质值和概率的参考系依赖性、超光速信号的可能性以及可叙述性的失败。在技术方面，持续存在的无穷大、构造完全协变框架的困难以及对非标准场的表面需求，阻碍了可行模型的发展。在本文中，我们对这些概念反对意见给出系统反驳，并对剩余技术挑战提供结构化说明。我们得出结论，相对论性坍缩理论确实提供了一条有希望的路径，可通向一种完全相对论性的量子框架，并克服标准量子理论的概念局限。

articles.title: Evaluating Quantum Kernel Methods for Track-Based Classification in High-Energy Physics
articles.title_zh: 面向高能物理基于径迹分类的量子核方法评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27333v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a systematic design for large-scale quantum kernel classification, demonstrated through a quantum support vector classifier (QSVC) for particle-track classification using centroid-based CLAS12 drift-chamber features. Each event is encoded into a six-qubit state via a fully entangled ZZFeatureMap, whose fidelities define a quantum kernel within a standard SVM framework. By decoupling state preparation from kernel construction and distributing evaluation across a multi-node MPI-based HPC allocation, the approach scales to 1.0x10⁵ training and 4.0x10⁵ test events with an exactly constructed kernel matrix, to our knowledge more than an order of magnitude larger than prior high-energy-physics quantum-kernel studies. Benchmarked against linear, polynomial, RBF, and sigmoid SVM kernels and extremely randomized trees (ERT), the ideal QSVC achieves the highest recall (99.99%) among all models. Under a calibrated hardware noise model (FakeMumbaiV2, 500 training / 2,000 test events), AUC falls from 0.9985 to 0.9671 and peak significance improvement falls from 17.5 to ~3.5, yet recall remains at 99.51% -- indicating this signal-retention advantage is attenuated but not eliminated by circuit-level decoherence. Geometric analysis of the quantum embedding shows near-orthogonal inter-class states with coherent intra-class neighborhoods under ideal simulation; under noise this structure compresses toward the maximally mixed state while preserving its relative ordering. These results demonstrate a scalable, reproducible workflow for quantum kernel experimentation at HEP-relevant scale, quantifying the practical cost of realistic hardware noise on quantum-enhanced classification.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种大规模量子核分类的系统设计，并用基于CLAS12漂移室质心特征的粒子径迹分类量子支持向量分类器进行展示。该方法将事件编码为六量子比特态，通过完全纠缠ZZFeatureMap定义量子核，并借助MPI高性能计算扩展到10万训练和40万测试事件。理想QSVC取得最高召回率；在校准硬件噪声下性能下降但信号保留优势仍存在，量化了现实噪声对量子增强分类的代价。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种用于大规模量子核分类的系统设计，并通过一个量子支持向量分类器（QSVC）进行展示，该分类器使用基于质心的CLAS12漂移室特征进行粒子径迹分类。每个事件通过完全纠缠的ZZFeatureMap被编码为一个六量子比特态，其保真度在标准SVM框架内定义量子核。通过将态制备与核构造解耦，并在基于MPI的多节点HPC资源上分布式执行评估，该方法可扩展到1.0×10⁵个训练事件和4.0×10⁵个测试事件，并精确构造核矩阵，据我们所知，其规模比以往高能物理量子核研究大一个数量级以上。与线性、多项式、RBF和sigmoid SVM核以及极端随机树（ERT）进行基准比较后，理想QSVC在所有模型中取得最高召回率（99.99%）。在校准的硬件噪声模型（FakeMumbaiV2，500个训练事件/2,000个测试事件）下，AUC从0.9985降至0.9671，峰值显著性改进从17.5降至约3.5，但召回率仍保持在99.51%，表明这种信号保留优势被电路级退相干削弱但并未消除。对量子嵌入的几何分析显示，在理想模拟下，类间态近似正交，并具有相干的类内邻域；在噪声下，该结构向最大混合态压缩，同时保持其相对排序。这些结果展示了一个可扩展、可复现的量子核实验工作流程，其规模与高能物理相关，并量化了现实硬件噪声对量子增强分类的实际代价。

articles.title: Population Metrology of a Hidden Exciton Reservoir: Quasi-Thermalization versus Localization
articles.title_zh: 隐藏激子库的布居计量：准热化与局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Long-lived dark states can dominate the lowest-energy manifold of optically driven quantum materials, yet their occupation remains difficult to quantify, leaving it unclear whether it reflects thermal redistribution or kinetic trapping. We combine microsphere-enabled far-field access with quantitative optical-response calibration to retrieve dark-to-bright population ratios in monolayer WSe2. Temperature-dependent measurements and controlled defect enhancement separate mobile and localized contributions. Near room temperature, the mobile dark-to-bright ratio reaches approximately 65% of its Boltzmann limit, indicating substantial but incomplete quasi-thermalization, whereas the low-temperature excess is dominated by defect-assisted localization. Dark-state dominance alone therefore does not establish equilibration, a distinction essential for interpreting transport and collective phases in optically hidden quasiparticle reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 长寿命暗态可主导光驱动量子材料的最低能量流形，但其占据难以定量。作者结合微球辅助远场访问和定量光学响应校准，提取单层WSe2中的暗态与亮态布居比。结果显示近室温下移动暗态达到玻尔兹曼极限约65%，低温过量主要由缺陷辅助局域化主导，说明暗态主导并不等同于热平衡。
authors: Guangyu Dai, Xinyu Zhang, Jiaxin Yu, Zi'ang Xing, Miao Cai, Zhaoqi Gu, Junyuan Zhang, Lin Dou, Fuxing Gu, Yiming Zhu, Songlin Zhuang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长寿命暗态可以主导光驱动量子材料的最低能量流形，但其占据仍然难以量化，因此尚不清楚它反映的是热再分布还是动力学俘获。我们将微球支持的远场访问与定量光学响应校准相结合，以获得单层WSe2中的暗态与亮态布居比。温度依赖测量和受控缺陷增强将移动贡献和局域贡献区分开来。接近室温时，移动暗态与亮态之比达到其玻尔兹曼极限的约65%，表明存在显著但不完全的准热化；而低温过量则由缺陷辅助局域化主导。因此，仅有暗态占优并不能证明已达到平衡，这一区分对于解释光学隐藏准粒子库中的输运和集体相至关重要。

articles.title: A brief history of quantum vs classical computational advantage
articles.title_zh: 量子与经典计算优势简史
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.14703v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this review article we summarize all experiments claiming quantum computational advantage to date. Our review highlights challenges, loopholes, and refutations appearing in subsequent work to provide a complete picture of the current statuses of these experiments. In addition, we also discuss theoretical computational advantage in example problems such as approximate optimization and recommendation systems. Finally, we review recent experiments in quantum error correction -- the biggest frontier to reach experimental quantum advantage in Shor's algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述总结了迄今所有声称实现量子计算优势的实验。文章重点讨论后续工作中出现的挑战、漏洞和反驳，以呈现这些实验当前状态的完整图景。作者还讨论了近似优化、推荐系统等问题中的理论计算优势，并回顾了通向Shor算法实验量子优势的关键前沿：量子纠错实验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这篇综述文章中，我们总结了迄今所有声称实现量子计算优势的实验。我们的综述突出介绍了后续工作中出现的挑战、漏洞和反驳，以提供这些实验当前状态的完整图景。此外，我们还讨论了示例问题中的理论计算优势，例如近似优化和推荐系统。最后，我们回顾了量子纠错方面的近期实验，这是在Shor算法中实现实验量子优势的最大前沿。

articles.title: GHZ-State Ramsey Interferometry on PKTron and IBM Quantum Hardware: Toward Quantum-Enhanced GPS-Denied Navigation Sensors
articles.title_zh: PKTron与IBM量子硬件上的GHZ态拉姆齐干涉：迈向量子增强的拒止GPS导航传感器
articles.abstract: Quantum-enhanced positioning, navigation, and timing (Quantum PNT) has been proposed as a partial mitigation for Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) denial, jamming, and spoofing in contested operational environments. The physical mechanism underlying proposed quantum inertial sensors — cold-atom accelerometers and gyroscopes — is quantum-enhanced phase estimation using entangled Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) probe states, which in principle allows measurement precision to scale with probe size N as the Heisenberg limit (N² Fisher information) rather than the classical standard quantum limit (N). This study isolates that sensing primitive, implements it as a qubit circuit, and validates it in two stages: (1) a noiseless statevector simulation using the PKTron quantum computing framework across probe sizes N = 1, 2, 4, and 6, and (2) a single-point hardware validation of the N = 4 case on IBM Quantum's ibm_fez superconducting processor via Qiskit Runtime. The simulation reproduced exact Heisenberg scaling (measured Fisher information of 1.00, 4.00, 16.00, and 36.00 against theoretical N² values of 1, 4, 16, and 36). On real hardware, the circuit's zero-signal calibration point returned P(all-zero) = 0.981, and its maximum-sensitivity bias point returned P(all-zero) = 0.477 against a theoretical value of 0.500, a deviation of approximately 2.3 percentage points attributable to gate and readout noise. These results constitute a reproducible, hardware-validated demonstration of the quantum sensing primitive that underlies Quantum PNT proposals. This work explicitly does not constitute a demonstration, prototype, or validation of an operational navigation system; it validates the elementary phase-sensing building block only, under idealized and near-idealized conditions, and is offered as a ready-to-run circuit reference for groups with access to atomic or trapped-ion sensing hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将量子增强定位、导航与授时中的相位估计原语抽象为量子比特电路，并在PKTron模拟和IBM量子硬件上验证。无噪声模拟在N=1、2、4、6时复现实测费舍尔信息的海森堡标度，N=4硬件点也接近理论概率。作者明确指出，该工作只验证基础相位传感模块，并非可运行导航系统的演示或原型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子增强定位、导航与授时（Quantum PNT）被提出作为在对抗性作战环境中应对全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）拒止、干扰和欺骗的部分缓解手段。所提出量子惯性传感器，即冷原子加速度计和陀螺仪，背后的物理机制是使用纠缠Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger（GHZ）探针态进行量子增强相位估计，原则上可使测量精度随探针规模N按海森堡极限（N²费舍尔信息）标度，而不是按经典标准量子极限（N）标度。本研究隔离出这一传感原语，将其实现为量子比特电路，并分两阶段验证：（1）使用PKTron量子计算框架在探针规模N=1、2、4和6上进行无噪声态矢量模拟；（2）通过Qiskit Runtime在IBM Quantum的ibm_fez超导处理器上对N=4情形进行单点硬件验证。模拟复现了精确的海森堡标度，测得费舍尔信息为1.00、4.00、16.00和36.00，对应理论N²值1、4、16和36。在真实硬件上，电路的零信号校准点返回P(全零)=0.981，其最大灵敏度偏置点返回P(全零)=0.477，而理论值为0.500，偏差约为2.3个百分点，可归因于门噪声和读出噪声。这些结果构成了对量子PNT方案所依赖的量子传感原语的可复现、经硬件验证的演示。本工作明确不构成对运行导航系统的演示、原型或验证；它只在理想化和近理想化条件下验证基本相位传感构件，并作为可直接运行的电路参考，提供给可访问原子或俘获离子传感硬件的研究团队。

articles.title: SWCNTs thin film transistor circuits fabricated on flexible substrates with inkjet-printed silver electrodes for photodetectors
articles.title_zh: 用于光探测器的柔性基底喷墨印刷银电极SWCNT薄膜晶体管电路
articles.abstract: We demonstrate thin film transistors (TFTs) and PMOS inverter circuit using drop casted single-wall carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) as active semiconductor and spin-coated poly(4-vinylphenol) (PVP) dielectric on a flexible polyethylene naphthalate (PEN) substrate of 125-µm-thick. All the electrodes were inkjet-printed using silver ink. The fabricated TFTs exhibit a linear field-effect mobility of 2.43 cm2V−1s− 1, while the saturated-load PMOS inverter achieves a voltage gain of 1.5 at a supply voltage of -15 V. The optoelectronic characteristics of these TFTs are systematically investigated under white-light illumination by monitoring drain-current (ID) transients at different gate voltages (VGS). The transfer characteristics reveal a reversal in hysteresis direction between dark and illuminated conditions, indicating that photo-induced charge-carrier recombination governs the device response. Under positive gate bias, the TFTs exhibit a pronounced and fully reversible photoresponse, with the drain current recovering completely after the light is switched off. In contrast, under negative gate bias, illumination suppresses the drain current, and the stretched-exponential transient decay becomes progressively faster with increasing negative VGS, reflecting Fermi-level-dependent carrier dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在柔性PEN基底上制备了以滴涂单壁碳纳米管为有源半导体、旋涂PVP为介电层、喷墨印刷银为电极的TFT和PMOS反相器。器件表现出2.43 cm2 V⁻¹ s⁻¹的线性场效应迁移率，反相器在-15 V供电下电压增益为1.5。白光照射实验显示光致载流子复合控制器件响应，且不同栅压下呈现可逆光响应或电流抑制及费米能级相关动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了薄膜晶体管（TFT）和PMOS反相器电路，它们使用滴涂单壁碳纳米管（SWCNT）作为有源半导体，并使用旋涂聚（4-乙烯基苯酚）（PVP）介电层，制备在厚度为125微米的柔性聚萘二甲酸乙二醇酯（PEN）基底上。所有电极均使用银墨水喷墨印刷。制备的TFT表现出2.43 cm2 V⁻¹ s⁻¹的线性场效应迁移率，而饱和负载PMOS反相器在-15 V供电电压下实现1.5的电压增益。通过在不同栅电压（VGS）下监测漏电流（ID）瞬态，系统研究了这些TFT在白光照射下的光电子特性。转移特性显示暗态和照明条件之间的迟滞方向发生反转，表明光诱导电荷载流子复合支配器件响应。在正栅偏压下，TFT表现出显著且完全可逆的光响应，关灯后漏电流完全恢复。相比之下，在负栅偏压下，照明抑制漏电流，并且拉伸指数瞬态衰减随VGS负值增大而逐渐加快，反映出依赖费米能级的载流子动力学。

articles.title: Evolution and Analysis of Biomolecule Induced Gate-All-Around CNT FET for Nanoscale Biosensing
articles.title_zh: 用于纳米尺度生物传感的生物分子诱导环栅CNT FET的演化与分析
articles.abstract: Evolution and analysis of gate-all-around carbon-nanotube field-effect-transistors (GAA CNT FETs) on incorporating various functionalized biomolecules in (19,0) CNT channels form biosensors at nano regime employing non-equilibrium Green's function is the advent in today’s era. To investigate nanoscale biosensing, a 10 nm gate-all-around (GAA) CNT FET was employed, where glucose, biotin, cellulose, and a haemoglobin-derived peptide fragment (residues 64–76) were covalently functionalized onto the gated CNT channel, modulating NEGF-based quantum transport and producing distinct biomolecule-specific electrical signatures. Glucose- and biotin-based CNT FETs observe reduced OFF current ~ 97% and ~ 96%, respectively, in comparison to bare CNT FET, whereas the haemoglobin-fragment-functionalized device achieves the highest ON current of the simulated structures, 44.3 µA µm⁻¹, due to quantum-confined carrier transport enabling selective label-free biosensing. Enhanced sensitivity for glucose-based biosensor is acquired, with 15.7%, and 112.4% in ON-current, and threshold-voltage sensitivities, over existing graphene-based-glucose biosensor FET. Linearity and harmonic analyses reveals sensing stability, and reduced distortion supporting analog/RF operations in nano-quantum regime. The CNT biosensor thus offers high signal integrity, low-power operation and label-free analyte detection being highly sensitive, making itself a promising candidate for next-generation implantable biosensing device for possible real time applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用非平衡格林函数方法研究功能化生物分子引入(19,0)碳纳米管沟道后的环栅CNT FET纳米生物传感器。葡萄糖、 生物素、纤维素和血红蛋白片段在沟道上产生不同电学签名，其中葡萄糖和生物素显著降低关断电流，血红蛋白片段器件获得最高开态电流。作者还报告葡萄糖传感器相较既有石墨烯器件具有更高灵敏度，线性和谐波分析支持其稳定低功耗、无标记检测潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在当今时代，采用非平衡格林函数，将各种功能化生物分子引入（19,0）CNT沟道以形成纳米尺度生物传感器，并对环栅碳纳米管场效应晶体管（GAA CNT FET）进行演化和分析，是一项新进展。为研究纳米尺度生物传感，采用了一个10 nm环栅（GAA）CNT FET，其中葡萄糖、生物素、纤维素和血红蛋白衍生肽片段（残基64-76）被共价功能化到受栅控的CNT沟道上，从而调制基于NEGF的量子输运，并产生不同的生物分子特异性电学特征。与裸CNT FET相比，基于葡萄糖和生物素的CNT FET分别显示关断电流降低约97%和约96%；而血红蛋白片段功能化器件由于量子限域载流子输运，在模拟结构中实现最高开态电流44.3微安/微米，从而支持选择性无标记生物传感。基于葡萄糖的生物传感器获得增强灵敏度，在开态电流和阈值电压灵敏度方面相对于现有石墨烯基葡萄糖生物传感FET分别提高15.7%和112.4%。线性和谐波分析显示其具有传感稳定性和降低的失真，支持纳米量子区域中的模拟/RF操作。因此，该CNT生物传感器具有高信号完整性、低功耗运行和无标记分析物检测能力，并且高度灵敏，使其成为下一代可植入生物传感器件的有前景候选者，有望用于可能的实时应用。

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Atomic Clocks for Military PNT and Secure Communications
articles.title_zh: 用于军事PNT与安全通信的量子增强原子钟
articles.abstract: Precise timekeeping is a foundational, often overlooked dependency of both positioning/navigation/timing (PNT) systems and secure communications: satellite navigation requires nanosecond-level clock synchronization to compute position from signal time-of-flight, and time-synchronized cryptographic protocols (including key-exchange window validation and frequency-hopping schemes) depend on clock stability at the transmitting and receiving ends. Current-generation atomic clocks (cesium and rubidium standards) achieve their stability by averaging over many independent, unentangled atoms, a strategy fundamentally limited by the standard quantum limit (SQL), in which timing precision scales with the number of atoms N as N. Quantum-enhanced atomic clocks propose replacing independent-atom ensembles with entangled (GHZ-state) ensembles, whose Heisenberg-limited precision scales instead as N². This study validates the two components of that claim independently: (1) the entanglement-derived precision advantage, via GHZ Ramsey spectroscopy simulated on the PKTron quantum computing framework across probe sizes N = 1, 2, 4, and 6, and cross-checked on IBM Quantum's ibm_fez hardware at N = 4; and (2) accurate recovery of an atomic transition's phase signal, via PKTron's built-in Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) algorithm, tested against three independent reference phases. Simulation reproduced exact Heisenberg scaling (measured Fisher information of 1.00, 4.00, 16.00, and 36.00 against theoretical N² values of 1, 4, 16, and 36) and exact QPE phase recovery (zero measured error across all three test phases). On real IBM Quantum hardware at N = 4, the zero-drift calibration point returned P(all-zero) = 0.972, and the maximum-sensitivity bias point returned P(all-zero) = 0.500, exactly matching the theoretical prediction. These results constitute a reproducible, multi-method, hardware-validated confirmation of the sensing and phase-extraction primitives that underlie quantum-enhanced atomic clock proposals. This work does not simulate or validate a physical atomic clock, an optical lattice clock, or any oscillator hardware; it validates the underlying discrete-variable sensing and estimation mechanisms only, and should be read accordingly.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论量子增强原子钟对定位、导航、授时和安全通信的潜在意义，并验证两个基础机制：GHZ拉姆齐谱中的纠缠精度优势和量子相位估计中的相位恢复。PKTron模拟复现了N=1、2、4、6的海森堡标度并实现三种参考相位零误差恢复，IBM硬件N=4实验也匹配关键理论概率。作者强调这并非物理原子钟或振荡器硬件验证，而只是离散变量传感和估计机制验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 精密计时是定位/导航/授时（PNT）系统和安全通信的基础性、但常被忽视的依赖：卫星导航需要纳秒级时钟同步，以根据信号飞行时间计算位置；而时间同步的密码协议，包括密钥交换窗口验证和跳频方案，则依赖发送端和接收端的时钟稳定性。当前一代原子钟（铯和铷标准）通过对许多独立、非纠缠原子进行平均来实现稳定性，这一策略从根本上受标准量子极限（SQL）限制，其中计时精度随原子数N按N标度。量子增强原子钟提出用纠缠（GHZ态）原子系综替代独立原子系综，其海森堡极限精度改为按N²标度。本研究分别验证这一主张的两个组成部分：（1）通过在PKTron量子计算框架上对探针规模N=1、2、4和6进行GHZ拉姆齐谱模拟，并在IBM Quantum的ibm_fez硬件上对N=4进行交叉检查，验证由纠缠带来的精度优势；（2）通过PKTron内置的量子相位估计（QPE）算法，针对三个独立参考相位进行测试，验证原子跃迁相位信号的准确恢复。模拟复现了精确的海森堡标度，测得费舍尔信息为1.00、4.00、16.00和36.00，对应理论N²值1、4、16和36，并实现了精确QPE相位恢复，三个测试相位的测量误差均为零。在N=4的真实IBM Quantum硬件上，零漂移校准点返回P(全零)=0.972，最大灵敏度偏置点返回P(全零)=0.500，与理论预测完全一致。这些结果构成了对量子增强原子钟方案所依赖的传感和相位提取原语的可复现、多方法、经硬件验证的确认。本工作没有模拟或验证物理原子钟、光晶格钟或任何振荡器硬件；它只验证底层离散变量传感和估计机制，并应据此解读。

articles.title: BB84 Quantum Key Distribution on PKTron and IBM Quantum Hardware: Eavesdropper-Detection Validation for Secure Military Communications
articles.title_zh: PKTron与IBM量子硬件上的BB84量子密钥分发：面向安全军事通信的窃听者检测验证
articles.abstract: Secure military communications depend on the confidentiality of exchanged cryptographic keys across command centers, satellite links, and classified order transmission. Classical key-distribution protocols rely on computational hardness assumptions that provide no intrinsic mechanism for detecting interception; an adversary who copies transmitted ciphertext leaves no physical trace. Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), and specifically the BB84 protocol, replaces this assumption with a physical guarantee derived from quantum mechanics: any attempt to measure an unknown quantum state necessarily disturbs it, rendering interception statistically detectable. This study implements the BB84 protocol at the circuit level — qubit state preparation, basis selection, interception modeling, and measurement — and validates its central security property, the Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) signature of eavesdropping, in two stages: (1) a noiseless statevector simulation using the PKTron quantum computing framework over ten independent trials per condition, and (2) hardware execution on IBM Quantum's ibm_fez superconducting processor. In simulation, the average QBER without an eavesdropper was 0.000, and with a full intercept-resend attack was 0.248, closely matching the theoretical prediction of 0.25. On real hardware, the undisturbed channel returned QBER = 0.000 (19 sifted bits) and the eavesdropped channel returned QBER = 0.261 (23 sifted bits), in close agreement with both theory and the simulated baseline. These results provide a reproducible, two-platform validation of the eavesdropper-detection mechanism that underlies the security claims made for QKD-protected communications. This study validates the cryptographic detection primitive only; it does not constitute a deployed secure communications system, and extending these results to operational command, satellite, or classified-order channels requires physical single-photon transmission hardware, authenticated classical channels, and full key-management infrastructure outside the scope of this work.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在电路层面实现BB84量子密钥分发协议，并验证其核心安全性质，即窃听导致的量子比特误码率信号。PKTron无噪声模拟中，无窃听平均QBER为0，有完整截获重发攻击时约为0.248，接近理论0.25。IBM硬件实验同样显示无扰信道QBER为0、被窃听信道QBER约为0.261；作者强调该工作只验证检测原语，并非部署式安全通信系统。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 安全军事通信依赖于指挥中心、卫星链路和机密命令传输之间所交换密码密钥的保密性。经典密钥分发协议依赖计算困难性假设，而这种假设没有提供检测拦截的内在机制；复制所传输密文的对手不会留下物理痕迹。量子密钥分发（QKD），尤其是BB84协议，用源自量子力学的物理保证取代这一假设：任何测量未知量子态的尝试都必然扰动它，从而使拦截在统计上可检测。本研究在电路层面实现BB84协议，包括量子比特态制备、基选择、拦截建模和测量，并分两个阶段验证其核心安全性质，即窃听的量子比特误码率（QBER）特征：（1）使用PKTron量子计算框架在每种条件下进行十次独立试验的无噪声态矢量模拟；（2）在IBM Quantum的ibm_fez超导处理器上执行硬件实验。在模拟中，无窃听者时平均QBER为0.000，在完整截获-重发攻击下为0.248，与0.25的理论预测非常接近。在真实硬件上，未受扰信道返回QBER=0.000（19个筛选比特），被窃听信道返回QBER=0.261（23个筛选比特），与理论和模拟基线均高度一致。这些结果为QKD保护通信安全主张所依赖的窃听者检测机制提供了可复现、双平台验证。本研究只验证密码检测原语；它并不构成已部署的安全通信系统，而将这些结果扩展到实际指挥、卫星或机密命令信道，需要物理单光子传输硬件、认证经典信道以及完整密钥管理基础设施，这些均超出本工作的范围。

articles.title: Reliability-aware multimodal prioritization of natural-product candidates against Candida albicans using gray-zone MIC modeling and applicability-domain analysis
articles.title_zh: 利用灰区 MIC 建模与适用域分析对抗白色念珠菌天然产物候选物进行可靠性感知的多模态优先级排序
articles.abstract: The discovery of anti-Candida albicans candidates from natural-product libraries is challenged by heterogeneous MIC data, uncertain activity boundaries, and limited reliability of direct model-based ranking. Here, we developed a gray-zone augmented multimodal prioritization workflow for anti-C. albicans candidate screening. MIC records from ChEMBL, PubChem, and CO-ADD were standardized and divided into strict active/inactive samples and gray-zone samples using dual MIC thresholds. Three complementary molecular representations, including SMILES-based ChemBERTa, 2D fingerprints/descriptors, and 3D EGNN graphs, were trained under scaffold-isolated splits and integrated by an uncertainty-aware dynamic routing module using out-of-fold probabilities and entropy features. On the independent strict test set, the final UADR fusion model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.9181, PR-AUC of 0.7917, and Brier score of 0.0559, outperforming the strongest single-modality model while showing only marginal improvement over static mean fusion. Gray-zone ablation, source-held-out validation, entropy-stratified reliability analysis, and applicability-domain assessment were further used to evaluate deployment robustness. Among the top-ranked natural-product candidates, 86 analyzable candidate entries were stratified into experimental-priority, exploratory, and lower-priority groups according to model score, entropy, modality disagreement, and nearest-neighbor Tanimoto similarity. Docking and 100 ns molecular dynamics simulations provided structural plausibility for selected candidates. This study provides a reliability-aware chemoinformatics workflow for prioritizing anti-C. albicans natural-product candidates for experimental follow-up.
articles.abstract_zh: 从天然产物库中发现抗白色念珠菌候选物受到 MIC 数据异质性、活性边界不确定以及直接模型排序可靠性有限等因素制约。该研究构建了引入灰区建模的多模态优先级排序流程，整合 ChemBERTa、二维指纹/描述符和三维 EGNN 图表示，并用不确定性感知动态路由融合模型输出。最终模型在严格独立测试集上表现良好，并结合灰区消融、来源留出验证、可靠性分层和适用域评估筛选出不同实验优先级的天然产物候选物。分子对接和 100 ns 分子动力学模拟为部分候选物提供了结构合理性支持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从天然产物库中发现抗白色念珠菌候选物面临异质性 MIC 数据、活性边界不确定以及直接基于模型排序的可靠性有限等挑战。在此，我们开发了一种用于抗白色念珠菌候选物筛选的、增强灰区的多模态优先级排序工作流程。来自 ChEMBL、PubChem 和 CO-ADD 的 MIC 记录经过标准化，并使用双 MIC 阈值划分为严格活性/非活性样本和灰区样本。三种互补的分子表示，包括基于 SMILES 的 ChemBERTa、二维指纹/描述符以及三维 EGNN 图，在骨架隔离划分下进行训练，并通过一个使用折外概率和熵特征的不确定性感知动态路由模块进行整合。在独立严格测试集上，最终 UADR 融合模型取得了 0.9181 的 ROC-AUC、0.7917 的 PR-AUC 和 0.0559 的 Brier 分数，优于最强的单模态模型，同时相对于静态均值融合仅显示出边际提升。研究进一步采用灰区消融、来源留出验证、按熵分层的可靠性分析以及适用域评估来评价部署稳健性。在排名靠前的天然产物候选物中，86 个可分析候选条目根据模型得分、熵、模态分歧和最近邻 Tanimoto 相似度被分层为实验优先、探索性和较低优先级组。分子对接和 100 ns 分子动力学模拟为所选候选物提供了结构合理性。本研究提供了一种可靠性感知的化学信息学工作流程，用于为后续实验优先筛选抗白色念珠菌天然产物候选物。

articles.title: Permutationally symmetric molecular aggregates
articles.title_zh: 具有置换对称性的分子聚集体
articles.abstract: Linear optical spectra of molecular aggregates are often approximated by classical optics methods such as the discrete-dipole approximation (DDA), coherent exciton scattering (CES), and coherent potential approximation (CPA), where the only quantum-mechanical input to the calculation is the linear susceptibility of the monomers. However, the limits of validity of these classical optics methods remain opaque. Here, starting from a quantum mechanical Hamiltonian for the aggregate, we identify a limit where DDA/CPA/CES is exact: all-to-all coupled permutationally symmetric aggregates of N → ∞ monomers, starting from a totally symmetric initial state. The permutational symmetry of this molecular version of the Lipkin–Meshkov–Glick model, which is closely related to that of the molecular polariton problem of many identical molecules coupled to a single-cavity mode, allows us to borrow recent techniques developed for the latter. In particular, we identify a 1/ N expansion that corrects the classical optics limit with finite N corrections to the linear response of the aggregate. These corrections feature as Raman-like transitions of a single monomer. We illustrate these findings with calculations on the very physically relevant setup of a homodimer. Our findings clarify how quantum optical features that go beyond classical optics can already be present in simple arrays of quantum emitters such as molecular aggregates.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子聚集体的线性光学谱常用离散偶极近似、相干激子散射和相干势近似等经典光学方法描述，但这些方法的适用范围并不清晰。本文从聚集体的量子力学哈密顿量出发，确定了一个使这些方法严格成立的极限：由无限多个单体组成、任意两个单体均耦合且具有置换对称性的聚集体，并从完全对称初态出发。作者进一步建立了1/N展开，用于描述有限单体数对经典光学极限的修正，并以同型二聚体说明这些修正。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子聚集体的线性光学谱通常采用离散偶极近似（DDA）、相干激子散射（CES）和相干势近似（CPA）等经典光学方法进行近似，其中输入计算的唯一量子力学信息是单体的线性极化率。然而，这些经典光学方法的适用范围仍不明确。在本文中，我们从聚集体的量子力学哈密顿量出发，确定了一个使DDA、CPA和CES严格成立的极限：由N趋于无穷的单体组成、单体之间全连接耦合且具有置换对称性的聚集体，并且体系从完全对称的初态开始。该分子版Lipkin–Meshkov–Glick模型的置换对称性与许多相同分子耦合到单一腔模的分子极化激元问题中的对称性密切相关，因此我们可以借用近期针对后者发展的技术。特别地，我们确定了一个1/N展开，用于在经典光学极限的基础上加入有限N对聚集体线性响应的修正。这些修正表现为单个单体的类拉曼跃迁。我们通过对一个具有重要物理意义的同型二聚体体系进行计算来说明这些发现。我们的研究阐明了超越经典光学的量子光学特征，甚至可以存在于分子聚集体这类简单的量子发射体阵列中。

articles.title: How does intercalation reshape layered structures? A first-principles study of sodium insertion in layered potassium birnessite
articles.title_zh: 插层如何重塑层状结构？钠插入层状钾水钠锰矿的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: This work presents a first-principles study of the sodium intercalation process in a layered potassium birnessite (a layered manganese dioxide, δ -MnO 2 ) using hybrid-level density functional theory. Understanding the intercalation processes of δ -MnO 2 is a vital step in advancing its potential innovative applications. Using a formation energy formalism, we analyze the stability of the structure as sodium ions (Na + ) are intercalated between layers. Simulated Raman spectra allow us to find relationships between the vibrational and structural properties of the material, i.e., we identify the most important vibrational modes and relate them to the structural/geometrical change. The diffusion of Na + and K + ions in birnessite is studied by transition state theory, determining the energy barriers to ion displacement in the interlayer. The symmetry and planar density of the system are characterized by simulated X-ray diffraction and geometrical analysis of the optimized structures. Through binding energy analysis, we also find that the Na + ions are more loosely bound to the lattice as they reach the saturation limit. Finally, the electronic properties are studied via spin-polarized densities of states. As intercalants are added, the electronic properties are profoundly modified, resulting from modifications of Mn oxidation states, lattice distortions, and symmetry effects. Moreover, some of the intercalated structures behave as bipolar magnetic semiconductors with potential applications in spintronics devices. In other words, the bandgaps and magnetic behavior of the system can be controlled by intercalation. This work provides an overarching analysis of intercalated birnessite and describes the essential properties of potassium birnessite and co-intercalation with sodium as a next-generation energy, electronic, and spintronic material.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用混合精度密度泛函理论，从第一性原理研究钠离子插入层状钾水钠锰矿，即层状二氧化锰δ-MnO2的过程。研究通过形成能、模拟拉曼光谱、扩散势垒、X射线衍射和几何分析，系统考察了插层结构的稳定性、振动与结构变化以及离子迁移。结果表明，钠离子接近饱和插层极限时与晶格的结合减弱；插层还会通过改变锰氧化态、晶格畸变和对称性显著调控电子与磁性质。部分插层结构表现为具有潜在自旋电子学应用价值的双极磁性半导体。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作采用混合精度密度泛函理论，从第一性原理研究钠在层状钾水钠锰矿中的插层过程；钾水钠锰矿是一种层状二氧化锰（δ-MnO2）。理解δ-MnO2中的插层过程，是推动其潜在创新应用发展的重要一步。我们利用形成能形式，分析了钠离子（Na+）插入层间时结构的稳定性。模拟拉曼光谱使我们能够发现振动性质与结构性质之间的关系，即识别出最重要的振动模，并将其与结构和几何形状的变化联系起来。我们通过过渡态理论研究了水钠锰矿中Na+和K+离子的扩散，确定了离子在层间位移的能垒。我们通过模拟X射线衍射和对优化结构进行几何分析，表征了体系的对称性和平面密度。通过结合能分析，我们还发现，随着Na+离子插层达到饱和极限，它们与晶格的结合变得更加松散。最后，我们通过自旋极化态密度研究了电子性质。随着插层离子的加入，电子性质发生了深刻改变，这些变化源于锰氧化态的变化、晶格畸变和对称性效应。此外，部分插层结构表现为双极磁性半导体，具有在自旋电子学器件中的潜在应用。换言之，插层可以控制体系的带隙和磁性行为。本工作对插层水钠锰矿进行了综合分析，并描述了钾水钠锰矿以及钠共插层作为下一代能源、电子和自旋电子学材料所需的基本性质。

articles.title: Yoctosecond imaging of the 129Xe ground state at the Large Hadron Collider
articles.title_zh: 大型强子对撞机上对129Xe基态的约秒级成像
articles.abstract: Imaging a quantum many-body system requires probes that resolve the coordinates of its constituents in sufficiently large event samples, allowing measurements of correlation functions [1–4]. High-energy nuclear collisions provide this opportunity on the nuclear scale [5], enabling features of colliding ions, such as their deformation, to be probed through particle correlation observables [6, 7]. However, a quantitative extraction of the correlation properties of nuclei from these measurements is still lacking. Here we show that this is possible for the nucleus 129Xe using Bayesian inference methods. We combine a deformed-rotor description of the colliding nuclei, which encodes the many-body dynamics of constituent neutrons and protons, with hydrodynamic simulations of the ensuing collision evolution. From a combined global analysis of Large Hadron Collider data on Xe-Xe and Pb-Pb collisions, we then infer that the shape of 129Xe is nearly maximally triaxial, which aligns with mean-field results for xenon isotopes away from shell closure [8, 9]. From this we evaluate two- and three-particle correlations in the nuclear ground state to provide new constraints for ab initio methods in nuclear theory. We establish thus collider experiments as a means of quantifying correlations of protons and neutrons arising from residual forces of quantum chromodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用贝叶斯推断，从大型强子对撞机的氙—氙和铅—铅碰撞数据中提取129Xe原子核的关联性质。研究结合描述核子多体动力学的形变转子模型与碰撞后的流体动力学模拟，推断129Xe的形状接近最大三轴形。由此计算的基态二粒子和三粒子关联，为核理论第一性原理方法提供了新的约束，并表明对撞机实验能够量化由量子色动力学残余力产生的质子—中子关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对量子多体系统进行成像，需要探针在足够大的事件样本中分辨其组分的坐标，从而能够测量关联函数[1–4]。高能核碰撞在核尺度上提供了这种机会[5]，使得可以通过粒子关联观测量探测碰撞离子的形变等特征[6,7]。然而，目前仍缺乏从这些测量中定量提取原子核关联性质的方法。在此，我们利用贝叶斯推断表明，对于129Xe原子核，这是可以实现的。我们将描述碰撞原子核的形变转子模型与随后碰撞演化的流体动力学模拟相结合；其中，形变转子模型编码了中子和质子组分的多体动力学。随后，我们对大型强子对撞机上的氙—氙和铅—铅碰撞数据进行联合全局分析，推断129Xe的形状接近最大三轴形，这与闭壳层之外氙同位素的平均场结果一致[8,9]。基于这一结果，我们计算了核基态中的二粒子和三粒子关联，为核理论中的第一性原理方法提供了新的约束。由此，我们确立了对撞机实验作为量化质子和中子关联的一种手段，而这些关联源于量子色动力学的残余力。

articles.title: Even/Odd-parity STS spectra induced by quantum well mirror symmetry breaking in iron-based superconductors
articles.title_zh: 铁基超导体中量子阱镜面对称性破缺诱导的偶宇称/奇宇称扫描隧道谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining whether superconducting scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) is uniquely dictated by crystal structure constitutes a fundamental challenge in condensed matter physics. Here, we systematically investigate bulk FeSe single crystals, monolayer FeSe, and KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂. We resolve one-, two-, and three-order checkerboard quantum-well structures that perfectly match the experimentally observed one, two, and three pairs of superconducting coherence peaks. In bulk FeSe, quantum wells promote real-space Cooper pairing and form degenerate antiferromagnetic checkerboard sublattices, yielding bosonic even-parity STS responses. In monolayer FeSe, mirror symmetry breaking suppresses Cooper pairing and induces nondegenerate ferromagnetic sublattice dichotomy, producing fermionic odd-parity STS spectra. We establish a universal gap scaling law Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ², where η(T) is a temperature-dependent prefactor and ξ denotes quantum-well depth that governs the number and magnitude of superconducting gaps. For KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂, our predicted gap pairs of ±6.2 meV, ±5.6 meV, and ±4.2 meV are in excellent agreement with experimental results of ±6.2 meV, ±5.4 meV, and ±4.4 meV. This quantum-well mechanism unifies mirror symmetry breaking, checkerboard sublattice ordering, Cooper pairing, fermion-boson duality, and half-Bogoliubov states for STS interpretation, offering new insights toward a unified high-T_c superconductivity theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了块体 FeSe 单晶、单层 FeSe 和 KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂，发现一阶、二阶和三阶棋盘状量子阱结构分别对应实验观测到的一对、两对和三对超导相干峰。在块体 FeSe 中，量子阱促进实空间库珀配对并形成简并反铁磁棋盘状子晶格，产生玻色型偶宇称扫描隧道谱；在单层 FeSe 中，镜面对称性破缺抑制库珀配对并诱导非简并铁磁子晶格二分性，产生费米型奇宇称扫描隧道谱。作者进一步提出普适能隙标度律，并指出量子阱机制可统一多种现象，为理解高温超导提供新视角。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定超导扫描隧道谱是否完全由晶体结构唯一决定，是凝聚态物理中的一个基本挑战。在此，我们系统研究了块体 FeSe 单晶、单层 FeSe 以及 KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂。我们分辨出一阶、二阶和三阶棋盘状量子阱结构，它们与实验观测到的一对、两对和三对超导相干峰完全吻合。在块体 FeSe 中，量子阱促进实空间库珀配对，并形成简并的反铁磁棋盘状子晶格，从而产生玻色型偶宇称扫描隧道谱响应。在单层 FeSe 中，镜面对称性破缺抑制库珀配对，并诱导非简并的铁磁子晶格二分性，产生费米型奇宇称扫描隧道谱。我们建立了普适能隙标度律 Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ²，其中 η(T) 是与温度有关的前因子，ξ 表示量子阱深度；该深度决定超导能隙的数量及其大小。对于 KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂，我们预测的 ±6.2 meV、±5.6 meV 和 ±4.2 meV 能隙对，与实验得到的 ±6.2 meV、±5.4 meV 和 ±4.4 meV 高度一致。这一量子阱机制统一了镜面对称性破缺、棋盘状子晶格有序、库珀配对、费米子-玻色子二象性以及半玻戈留布夫态等现象，为扫描隧道谱的解释提供了统一框架，并为建立统一的高温超导理论带来了新的认识。

articles.title: Reply to Comment on: Microscopic signatures of an imaginary charge density wave in a kagome metal
articles.title_zh: 对《戈薯金属中虚电荷密度波的微观特征》评论的回复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We address a recent Comment [I. Nikolov it et al., arXiv:2608.13579 (2026)] proposing crystalline mosaicity as an alternative explanation for the asymmetric nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra reported in our study [S. Suetsugu it et al., Nat. Phys. bf 22, 1251--1256 (2026)]. We show that this scenario requires substantial temperature- and site-dependent distributions of crystallographic orientations and additional site-dependent distributions of the electric field gradient (EFG) asymmetry parameter, none of which follow from ordinary crystalline mosaicity. We therefore conclude that crystalline mosaicity cannot account for the observed site-selective spectral asymmetry and does not provide an alternative explanation for the central spectroscopic observation underlying our interpretation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回应了关于晶体马赛克结构能否解释此前研究中不对称核磁共振谱的评论。作者指出，该解释需要存在显著的、依赖温度和晶格位置的晶体取向分布，以及额外的、依赖位置的电场梯度不对称参数分布，而这些因素并非普通晶体马赛克结构自然产生的结果。因此，作者认为晶体马赛克结构不能解释所观测到的位置选择性谱不对称，也不能替代其原有的光谱学解释。
authors: S. Suetsugu, S. Kitagawa, K. Ishida, T. Shibauchi, Y. Matsuda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们回应了近期一篇评论 [I. Nikolov 等，arXiv:2608.13579 (2026)] 提出的观点。该评论认为，晶体马赛克结构可能是我们研究 [S. Suetsugu 等，《Nature Physics》22, 1251--1256 (2026)] 中所报道不对称核磁共振谱的一种替代解释。我们表明，这一情景要求存在显著的、依赖温度和晶格位置的晶体取向分布，以及额外的、依赖位置的电场梯度不对称参数分布；而这些分布都不是普通晶体马赛克结构所必然产生的。因此，我们得出结论：晶体马赛克结构无法解释所观测到的位置选择性谱不对称，也不能为支撑我们解释的核心光谱学观测提供替代说明。

articles.title: Heat Transfer and Torque in Enclosing Cylindrical Configurations with Nonreciprocal Materials
articles.title_zh: 非互易材料包围圆柱构型中的热传递与扭矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electromagnetic fluctuations can transfer not only energy but also angular momentum, leading to forces, torques, heat currents, and friction in out-of-equilibrium setups. In enclosing configurations, we show that if at least one of two objects is rotationally symmetric, the torque is bounded by heat transfer, since both arise from photon transfers with angular momentum hbar n and energy hbarω. With only one object assumed to be rotationally symmetric, it may be possible to obtain a nonzero torque with reciprocal media, but nonreciprocal media are required to break the symmetry between n and -n and produce a nonzero torque if both objects are rotationally symmetric. We then specialize to concentric cylinders with a nonreciprocal dielectric response and use Rytov fluctuational electrodynamics to express heat transfer and torque in terms of an angular-momentum-resolved flux density, Φₙ₍ω). We also analyze the conditions for stable levitation of the inner cylinder using the proximity force approximation, in the process obtaining a new analytic formula for the normal Casimir force between dilute plates at different temperatures. Finally, to find the extracted work in a contactless engine setup, we compute the fluctuation-induced friction for a slowly rotating inner cylinder, and we find a bound between torque, friction, and heat transfer. Due to this bound, the efficiency of the heat engine remains bounded by the Carnot limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究非平衡包围构型中电磁涨落引起的热传递、扭矩和摩擦。作者证明，只要两个物体中至少有一个具有旋转对称性，扭矩就受到热传递的约束；当两个物体都具有旋转对称性时，则需要非互易介质打破角动量量子数 n 与 -n 之间的对称性，才能产生非零扭矩。对于具有非互易介电响应的同心圆柱，作者利用里托夫涨落电动力学推导了角动量分辨的热流和扭矩表达式，并分析了稳定悬浮、摩擦及热机效率的限制。
authors: Dhruv Shah, Kiryl Asheichyk, David Gelbwaser-Klimovsky, Noah Graham, Mehran Kardar, Matthias Krüger
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电磁涨落不仅能够传递能量，也能够传递角动量，从而在非平衡构型中产生力、扭矩、热流和摩擦。在包围构型中，我们表明，如果两个物体中至少有一个具有旋转对称性，那么扭矩受到热传递的约束，因为二者都源于携带角动量 ℏn 和能量 ℏω 的光子传递。当只假设一个物体具有旋转对称性时，互易介质也可能产生非零扭矩；但是，如果两个物体都具有旋转对称性，则必须使用非互易介质打破 n 与 -n 之间的对称性，才能产生非零扭矩。随后，我们将研究具体化为具有非互易介电响应的同心圆柱，并利用里托夫涨落电动力学，将热传递和扭矩表示为按角动量分辨的通量密度 Φₙ(ω)。我们还利用近邻力近似分析了内圆柱稳定悬浮的条件，并由此获得了不同温度稀薄平板之间法向卡西米尔力的新解析公式。最后，为了确定无接触发动机构型中提取的功，我们计算了缓慢旋转内圆柱时由涨落诱导的摩擦，并得到了扭矩、摩擦和热传递之间的界限。由于这一界限，热机效率始终受到卡诺极限的约束。

articles.title: High-harmonic fingerprints of sharp spin twists in a chiral soliton lattice
articles.title_zh: 手性孤子晶格中尖锐自旋扭转的高次谐波指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A magnetic field applied perpendicular to the helical axis of a monoaxial chiral helimagnet compresses the spin helix into a coplanar chiral soliton lattice (CSL). We show that optically driven high-harmonic generation from itinerant electrons coupled to a frozen CSL resolves the lattice-scale structure of the localized twist, rather than the continuum soliton shape. High-order harmonics remain perturbative for the uniform helix. As the winding localizes at fixed magnetic period, they grow by many orders of magnitude and acquire a nonperturbative dependence on the drive amplitude. The growth originates from a spatially nonuniform effective hopping that turns each soliton into a localized dip in the hopping amplitude. When the degree of winding localization is held fixed, high-order intensities fall by many orders of magnitude as the magnetic period increases toward the continuum limit, where the hopping modulation is spatially smoothed. High-order harmonics thus resolve a real-space characteristic of the coplanar CSL, even in the absence of scalar chirality and an emergent magnetic field.
articles.abstract_zh: 垂直于螺旋轴施加磁场会将单轴手性螺旋磁体中的自旋螺旋压缩为共面手性孤子晶格。本文表明，受光驱动的高次谐波产生能够分辨局域扭转的晶格尺度结构，而非连续介质孤子形状。随着扭转在固定磁周期内局域化，高次谐波强度显著增强并呈现对驱动振幅的非微扰依赖；随着磁周期增大并趋向连续极限，空间平滑的跃迁调制又使高次谐波强度大幅下降。由此，高次谐波可以在不存在标量手性和涌现磁场的情况下，探测共面手性孤子晶格的实空间特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 施加一个垂直于螺旋轴的磁场，会将单轴手性螺旋磁体中的自旋螺旋压缩为共面的手性孤子晶格（CSL）。我们表明，与冻结的 CSL 耦合的巡游电子在光驱动下产生的高次谐波，能够分辨局域扭转的晶格尺度结构，而不是连续介质孤子的形状。对于均匀螺旋，高阶谐波始终处于微扰范围内。当绕转在磁周期固定的情况下发生局域化时，高阶谐波会增强许多个数量级，并对驱动振幅产生非微扰依赖。这种增强源于空间非均匀的有效跃迁，使每个孤子表现为跃迁振幅中的一个局域凹陷。当保持绕转局域化程度不变时，随着磁周期增大并趋向连续介质极限，高阶谐波强度会下降许多个数量级；在该极限下，跃迁调制在空间上被平滑化。因此，即使不存在标量手性和涌现磁场，高阶谐波仍能分辨共面 CSL 的一个实空间特征。

articles.title: Raman magnon spectroscopy of local interactions and ground state selection in Sr₂IrO₄
articles.title_zh: Sr₂IrO₄ 中局域相互作用与基态选择的拉曼磁振子光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing and coupled spin and charge interactions in quantum materials lead to a variety of ordered states where local configurations preferentially influence the long-range order. When these interactions are finely balanced in energy, disorder and fluctuations play an outsized role. Raman scattering is particularly well-suited to revealing the underlying physics in such situations because of its sensitivity to local environments and ability to reveal overall symmetries. We perform angle-resolved Raman polarization measurements on single crystals of the correlated, layered magnet, ȩSr2IrO4, where the Mott insulating ground state arises from strong spin-orbit coupling. We characterize the symmetries of both the phonon and magnon modes through comprehensive measurements in both the ab-plane and out-of-plane geometries from 10 to 700 cm⁻¹, and trace the evolution of these modes in both configurations to 12 GPa in a diamond anvil cell with perforated diamonds. Pressure does not significantly alter the lattice as the phonon modes shift linearly under compression, but at the same time the magnon modes become position dependent and spread over a range of wavenumbers. We attribute this magnetic heterogeneity to pressure-enhanced variations in the weak interlayer interactions, which may locally favor competing magnetic stacking configurations, and compare our experimental results to the predictions of linear spin wave calculations. Our results demonstrate that Raman-active magnons amplify μeV-scale interactions responsible for ground-state selection into easily measurable spectral changes.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料中相互竞争并相互耦合的自旋和电荷相互作用，会形成多种有序态，其中局域构型能够优先影响长程有序。本文对 Sr₂IrO₄ 单晶开展角分辨拉曼偏振测量，并在面内和面外几何构型下表征声子与磁振子模式。加压至 12 GPa 时，声子模式近似线性移动，而磁振子模式出现位置依赖性并在一段波数范围内展宽，作者将其归因于压力增强的层间相互作用差异。结果表明，拉曼活性磁振子能够将决定基态选择的微电子伏特尺度相互作用放大为可测量的光谱变化。
authors: Xiang Li, Scott E. Cooper, Ahmed E. Fahmy, Yuan-Ming Lu, A. de la Torre, R. S. Perry, D. Hsieh, T. F. Rosenbaum, Yejun Feng, D. M. Silevitch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料中相互竞争并相互耦合的自旋和电荷相互作用，会产生多种有序态，其中局域构型会优先影响长程有序。当这些相互作用在能量上达到精细平衡时，无序和涨落会发挥特别重要的作用。拉曼散射尤其适合揭示这类情形下的底层物理，因为它既对局域环境敏感，也能够揭示整体对称性。我们对具有强自旋-轨道耦合、其莫特绝缘基态由此产生的层状关联磁体 Sr₂IrO₄ 单晶，进行了角分辨拉曼偏振测量。我们在 10 至 700 cm⁻¹ 范围内，分别对 ab 面内和面外几何构型开展了全面测量，表征声子和磁振子模式的对称性；同时，利用带孔金刚石的金刚石对顶压砧，追踪了两种构型下这些模式演化至 12 GPa 的过程。压力并未显著改变晶格，因为声子模式在压缩下呈线性移动；与此同时，磁振子模式却表现出位置依赖性，并在一定波数范围内展宽。我们将这种磁性非均匀性归因于压力增强的弱层间相互作用差异，这些差异可能在局部区域偏 favor 竞争性的磁性堆垛构型，并将实验结果与线性自旋波计算的预测进行了比较。我们的结果表明，拉曼活性磁振子能够将负责基态选择的微电子伏特尺度相互作用放大为容易测量的光谱变化。

articles.title: High-pressure phase transitions in the quantum spin liquid candidate Na2Co2TeO6 probed by Raman spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 拉曼光谱探测候选量子自旋液体 Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 的高压相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quasi-2D magnet Na2Co2TeO6 (NCTO) is a candidate for a Kitaev Quantum Spin Liquid (KQSL) state. Pressure-tuning in such materials is of interest as a potential method to tune the Kitaev exchange interactions, which are strongly dependent on bond geometry. Here we report a Raman spectroscopic study of NCTO inside a diamond anvil cell (DAC) with pressure applied up to 16.3 GPa. Based on the changes in the Raman modes, this pressure range is divided into three regions. The appearance and disappearance of several modes and changes in the polarization dependence of the representative modes, most prominently above 13.8 GPa, point to pressure-induced phase transitions in this material.
articles.abstract_zh: 准二维磁体 Na₂Co₂TeO₆ 是候选 Kitaev 量子自旋液体材料，压力调控可用于改变对键几何高度敏感的 Kitaev 交换相互作用。本文在金刚石对顶压砧中对该材料开展最高 16.3 GPa 的拉曼光谱研究，并依据拉曼模式的变化将压力范围划分为三个区域。多个模式的出现与消失，以及代表性模式偏振依赖性的变化，尤其是在 13.8 GPa 以上的显著变化，表明该材料发生了压力诱导的相变。
authors: Ihsan Ahmed Kolasseri, Maria Mei Ravnebæk, Subhadip Das, Carl Jonas Linnemann, Haidong Zhou, Christian Frydendahl, Martin Bremholm, Yong P. Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准二维磁体 Na₂Co₂TeO₆（NCTO）是 Kitaev 量子自旋液体（KQSL）态的候选材料。在这类材料中，压力调控受到关注，因为它可能改变 Kitaev 交换相互作用，而后者强烈依赖于键的几何结构。在此，我们报告了在金刚石对顶压砧（DAC）中对 NCTO 进行的拉曼光谱研究，施加的压力最高达到 16.3 GPa。根据拉曼模式的变化，这一压力范围被划分为三个区域。多个模式的出现和消失，以及代表性模式偏振依赖性的变化，尤其是 13.8 GPa 以上最为显著的变化，指向该材料中由压力诱导的相变。

articles.title: Intercalation of Alkali Metal into WTe2, the Crystal Structure of A0.5WTe2 and Observation of a Metal-to-Semiconductor Transition
articles.title_zh: 碱金属插层进入 WTe₂：A₀.₅WTe₂ 的晶体结构及金属到半导体转变的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore the cationic intercalation of tungsten ditelluride (WTe2) with potassium (K), rubidium (Rb), and cesium (Cs), yielding intercalation compounds of the form A0.5WTe2 (A = K, Rb, Cs). Structural characterization was performed using powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), while diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform (DRIFT) spectroscopy and temperature-dependent conductivity measurements were employed to investigate the electronic properties. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were carried out to support the experimental findings and to provide insight into the intercalation mechanisms and the resulting material characteristics. All synthesized compounds display semiconducting behavior with narrow band gaps, emphasizing the influence of alkali metal intercalation on the electronic structure and transport properties of WTe2. These results advance the fundamental understanding of property modulation in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) and highlight their potential for electronic device applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了钾、铷和铯对二碲化钨 WTe₂ 的阳离子插层，制得了 A₀.₅WTe₂（A = K、Rb、Cs）插层化合物。作者利用粉末 X 射线衍射表征结构，并结合漫反射红外傅里叶变换光谱和变温电导率测量研究其电子性质，同时通过密度泛函理论计算分析插层机制。所有合成化合物均表现出具有窄带隙的半导体行为，说明碱金属插层能够显著调控 WTe₂ 的电子结构和输运性质。
authors: Patrick Schmidt, Fabian Strauß, Marcus Scheele, Carl P. Romao, Hans-Jürgen Meyer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了钾（K）、铷（Rb）和铯（Cs）对二碲化钨（WTe₂）的阳离子插层，得到化学式为 A₀.₅WTe₂（A = K、Rb、Cs）的插层化合物。我们使用粉末 X 射线衍射（PXRD）进行结构表征，并采用漫反射傅里叶变换红外（DRIFT）光谱和变温电导率测量来研究其电子性质。我们还开展了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，以支持实验结果，并深入分析插层机制及由此产生的材料特性。所有合成化合物都表现出具有窄带隙的半导体行为，凸显了碱金属插层对 WTe₂ 电子结构和输运性质的影响。这些结果增进了对过渡金属二硫属化物（TMDC）性质调控机制的基础理解，并突出了其在电子器件应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Probing bulk superconductivity in centrosymmetric Te-doped PtBi₂ single crystals
articles.title_zh: 探索中心对称 Te 掺杂 PtBi₂ 单晶中的体超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Weyl semimetal γ-PtBi₂ has been shown to be one of the most promising novel materials, recently proposed as a topological i-wave superconductor. A crucial requirement for observing this physics is the absence of inversion symmetry in its trigonal P31m crystal structure. Centrosymmetry has been reported to be readily restored in the Poverline3m1 structure upon electron doping, partially substituting Bi with as little as 2% Te. In this work, we synthesized Te-doped PtBi₂₋ₓTeₓ samples and thoroughly investigated the bulk superconductivity of selected single crystals with nominal composition PtBi₁.₉₆Te₀.₀₄, exhibiting the highest superconducting volume fraction of sim100%. Single crystal XRD measurements confirm the centrosymmetric Poverline3m1 structure in our samples, whereas bulk superconductivity with a critical temperature of T_c approx 2.4,K was observed in magnetization and specific heat measurements. The upper critical fields for two different orientations were determined as Hparallelc₂(0)approx 6.3,kOe for in-plane and Hperpc₂(0)approx 4.7,kOe for out-of-plane magnetic fields. Robust superconductivity was also found in resistance and point contact measurements, where the latter showed a slight enhancement of the critical temperature up to T_c sim 3,K. Finally, ARPES measurements corroborate the centrosymmetric structure of our samples, showing a single surface termination and the absence of Fermi arcs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文合成并研究了 Te 掺杂的 PtBi₂ 单晶，以检验中心对称结构中的体超导性。名义组成为 PtBi₁.₉₆Te₀.₀₄ 的样品具有接近 100% 的超导体积分数，单晶 X 射线衍射证实其为中心对称结构，并在磁化率和比热测量中观测到约 2.4 K 的超导转变温度。电阻、点接触和 ARPES 测量进一步支持其稳健超导性及中心对称结构，后者还显示单一表面终止并缺少费米弧。
authors: Kilian Srowik, Pablo Pedrazzini, Soumen Ash, Oksana Kvitnitskaya, Andrii Kuibarov, Susmita Changdar, Oleksandr Suvorov, Volodymyr Bezguba, Alexander Kordyuk, Rafał Kurleto, Dawid Wutke, Reza Firouzmandi, Robert Kluge, Swarnamayee Mishra, Alexander Mistonov, Saicharan Aswartham, Jochen Geck, Sergey Borisenko, Laura T. Corredor, Bernd Büchner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 已有研究表明，Weyl 半金属 γ-PtBi₂ 是最有前景的新型材料之一，近期有人提出它可能是拓扑 i 波超导体。观测到这种物理现象的一个关键要求，是其三方 P31m 晶体结构中不存在反演对称性。据报道，在电子掺杂后，结构会很容易在 P-3m1 中恢复中心对称性；即使仅以约 2% 的 Te 部分取代 Bi，也可能发生这种恢复。在本工作中，我们合成了 Te 掺杂的 PtBi₂₋ₓTeₓ 样品，并对选定的单晶进行了体超导性研究；其中名义组成为 PtBi₁.₉₆Te₀.₀₄ 的样品具有最高的超导体积分数，接近 100%。单晶 X 射线衍射测量证实，我们的样品具有中心对称的 P-3m1 结构；磁化率和比热测量则观察到体超导性，其临界温度 T_c 约为 2.4 K。对于两种不同的磁场取向，我们确定了上临界场：面内磁场对应的 Hc₂(0) 约为 6.3 kOe，面外磁场对应的 Hc₂(0) 约为 4.7 kOe。在电阻和点接触测量中也发现了稳健的超导性；后者显示临界温度略有升高，最高可达约 3 K。最后，ARPES 测量进一步印证了样品的中心对称结构，显示出单一表面终止以及费米弧的缺失。

articles.title: Tuning Dirac-Rashba and Double Dirac Cone Surface States of Topological Crystalline Insulator Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe by Transition Metal Adsorbate
articles.title_zh: 利用过渡金属吸附原子调控拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 的狄拉克-拉什巴与双狄拉克锥表面态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic structure of topological insulator/magnetic metal (TI/MM) interfaces is of great importance for understanding of exotic spin-dependent phenomena and realization of advanced spin-orbitronic devices. Here, we employ a model system of submonolayer transition metal (TM) deposited on the surface of a topological crystalline insulator (TCI) of Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe to systematically map out the modification of the surface electronic structure by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) as a function of coverage. For the polar (111) Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe surface, we observe the coexistence of the Dirac topological surface states (TSS) and Rashba-split surface states (RSS) induced by the combined effects of inversion-symmetry breaking, surface band bending and orbital angular momentum effects. In particular, we demonstrate very large Rashba splittings can be obtained and the Rashba parameter (α_R) can be tuned over a remarkably wide range from 0 to 3.5 eV · mathringA, depending on the type and coverage of the TM adatoms. Model-Hamiltonian calculations corroborate the experimental findings and reveal that this coexistence results from the filling of the TSS by the surface doping caused by the TM. In contrast, for the nonpolar (001) surface exhibiting a double Dirac cone topological surface state, the inversion symmetry is preserved and hence no Rashba-split surface states emerge. Instead, surface charge imbalance induces dephasing of the wave functions of the double Dirac cones that diminishes the momentum-space separation between them. These findings shed light on novel phenomena occurring at the topological insulator / transition metal interface, offering a versatile platform for future spintronic and quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用角分辨光电子能谱研究亚单层过渡金属沉积对拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 表面电子结构的调控，并考察其随覆盖度的变化。在极性（111）表面，狄拉克拓扑表面态与拉什巴劈裂表面态共存，拉什巴参数可通过吸附原子种类和覆盖度在 0 至 3.5 eV·Å 的范围内调节。在非极性（001）表面，反演对称性保持，不出现拉什巴劈裂表面态，而表面电荷不平衡会导致双狄拉克锥波函数退相干并减小其动量空间分离。
authors: Bartłomiej Turowski, Wojciech Brzezicki, Ondřej Caha, Rafał Rudniewski, Natalia Olszowska, Jacek Kołodziej, Marta Aleszkiewicz, Tomasz Wojciechowski, Tomasz Wojtowicz, Timo Hyart, Gunther Springholz, Valentine V. Volobuev
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑绝缘体/磁性金属（TI/MM）界面的电子结构，对于理解奇异的自旋依赖现象以及实现先进的自旋轨道电子学器件具有重要意义。在此，我们将亚单层过渡金属（TM）沉积在拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 表面，并利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），系统绘制了表面电子结构随覆盖度变化而发生的改变。对于极性的（111）Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 表面，我们观察到狄拉克拓扑表面态（TSS）和拉什巴劈裂表面态（RSS）共存；这种共存由反演对称性破缺、表面能带弯曲和轨道角动量效应共同诱导。特别是，我们证明，通过选择不同种类及覆盖度的过渡金属吸附原子，可以获得非常大的拉什巴劈裂，并将拉什巴参数 α_R 在 0 至 3.5 eV·Å 的极宽范围内调控。模型哈密顿量计算支持了实验结果，并揭示这种共存源于过渡金属造成的表面掺杂对 TSS 的填充。相比之下，对于具有双狄拉克锥拓扑表面态的非极性（001）表面，反演对称性得以保持，因此不会出现拉什巴劈裂表面态。相反，表面电荷不平衡会导致双狄拉克锥波函数退相干，从而减小它们在动量空间中的分离。这些发现揭示了拓扑绝缘体/过渡金属界面中出现的新奇现象，为未来自旋电子学和量子器件提供了一个多功能平台。

articles.title: Finite relaxation protocols with minimal dissipation
articles.title_zh: 耗散最小的有限步弛豫方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Work extraction from nonequilibrium systems is a major challenge across biological, chemical, physical, and engineering systems. Idealized protocols generally require a quasistatic relaxation stage in which the Hamiltonian is gradually adjusted through a continuum of intermediaries. Here, we consider protocols restricted to a finite number N of intermediary Hamiltonians, consisting of a sequence of quench-relax steps. We determine the sequence of quenches that minimizes the dissipated work, which can be expressed in terms of a recurrence involving the Lambert function. The optimal sequence converges to the Fisher-Rao geodesic, saturating known leading-order dissipation bounds at large N. We obtain lower bounds on work extraction from a nonequilibrium distribution as a function of its Fisher-Rao distance to equilibrium. We extend and apply the framework in two simple models: (i) an optical trap experiment, showing that the optimal intermediary distribution can be bimodal even for unimodal initial and final distributions, and (ii) an enzyme-catalyzed reaction, showing that that accounting for relaxation time in addition to dissipation can favor barrier-lowering.
articles.abstract_zh: 从非平衡系统中提取功，是生物、化学、物理和工程系统共同面临的挑战。本文研究仅允许使用有限个中间哈密顿量的淬火-弛豫序列，并确定使耗散功最小的淬火序列，其结果可用涉及 Lambert 函数的递推关系表示。最优序列在中间步骤数较大时收敛到 Fisher-Rao 测地线，并达到已知的主导阶耗散下界；作者还将该框架应用于光学陷阱实验和酶催化反应模型，说明中间分布可能呈双峰形状，且考虑弛豫时间后降低势垒可能更有利。
authors: Ben Ansbacher, Harrison Hartle, Abhishek Yadav, Jan Korbel, David H. Wolpert
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从非平衡系统中提取功，是生物、化学、物理和工程系统中的一个重大挑战。理想化方案通常要求经历一个准静态弛豫阶段，在此阶段中，哈密顿量通过一系列连续的中间状态逐渐调节。在这里，我们考虑受到限制的方案：只允许使用有限数量 N 个中间哈密顿量，并由一系列淬火-弛豫步骤组成。我们确定了使耗散功最小的淬火序列，该序列可以用一个涉及 Lambert 函数的递推关系表示。最优序列会收敛到 Fisher-Rao 测地线，并在 N 较大时达到已知的主导阶耗散界。我们得到了从非平衡分布中提取功的下界，该下界取决于该分布到平衡态的 Fisher-Rao 距离。我们将这一框架扩展并应用于两个简单模型：（i）一个光学陷阱实验，结果表明，即使初始分布和最终分布都是单峰的，最优中间分布也可能是双峰的；（ii）一个酶催化反应，结果表明，在耗散之外同时考虑弛豫时间后，降低势垒的方案可能更受青睐。

articles.title: Origin of High-Temperature Antiferromagnetic Order in a van der Waals Material
articles.title_zh: 范德瓦耳斯材料中高温反铁磁序的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While Van der Waals (vdW) itinerant antiferromagnets with high Neel temperatures (TN) are highly desirable for spintronics, they remain relatively scarce. Here, we unravel the physical origin of the unusually high TN (= 250 K) in the newly identified vdW compound (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2. The substitution of Co in Fe4GeTe2 induces layer-selective Fe-Co ordering and stabilizes a robust antiferromagnetic (AFM) state primarily driven by Co moments. The AFM order is further strengthened by enhanced electronic correlations of quasi-localized Co 3d-states at the Fermi level, giving rise to an itinerant-localized duality of the 3d electrons. This interplay generates strong magnetic correlations well above TN and stabilizes low-temperature spin canting with a possible nontrivial Berry curvature. Our results establish (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2 as a rare material bridging fundamental magnetic interactions with potential applications in AFM spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德瓦耳斯巡游型反铁磁体具有较高的奈尔温度，对自旋电子学十分重要，但这类材料仍较为稀少。本文揭示了新发现的范德瓦耳斯化合物(Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2具有异常高奈尔温度（TN = 250 K）的物理起源：Co取代诱导层选择性的Fe-Co有序，并主要由Co磁矩驱动稳定的反铁磁态。费米能级附近准局域化Co 3d态增强的电子关联进一步强化反铁磁序，形成3d电子的巡游-局域二重性；这种相互作用在TN以上产生强磁关联，并稳定低温自旋倾斜及可能的非平庸贝里曲率。
authors: Rabindra Basnet, Hari Paudyal, Gicela Saucedo Salas, Nicholas P. Butch, Durga Paudya, Ramesh C. Budhani
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管具有较高奈尔温度（TN）的范德瓦耳斯（vdW）巡游型反铁磁体对自旋电子学极具吸引力，但这类材料仍然相对稀少。在此，我们揭示了新近发现的范德瓦耳斯化合物(Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2具有异常高奈尔温度（TN = 250 K）的物理起源。在Fe4GeTe2中引入Co取代会诱导层选择性的Fe-Co有序，并稳定一种主要由Co磁矩驱动的稳健反铁磁态。费米能级处准局域化Co 3d态增强的电子关联进一步强化了反铁磁序，使3d电子呈现巡游-局域二重性。这种相互作用在远高于TN的温度范围内产生强磁关联，并稳定低温自旋倾斜，且可能形成非平庸贝里曲率。我们的结果表明，(Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2是一种罕见材料，连接了基本磁相互作用与反铁磁自旋电子学的潜在应用。

articles.title: Dynamical splitting and a nodal Bose liquid in 2d chiral XYZ model
articles.title_zh: 二维手性XYZ模型中的动力学分裂与节点玻色液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a class of Hamiltonians with a structure that we call "dynamical splitting": the Hamiltonian terms can be divided into two sets acting on the same degrees of freedom such that every term in one set commutes with every term in the other, although terms within either set do not all commute. This structure yields an algebraic duality to effective degrees of freedom on which the two parts of the Hamiltonian act disjointly, enabling exact diagonalization on lattices with approximately twice as many spins as usually accessible. We exploit it in the "chiral XYZ model", a geometrically frustrated spin-1/2 model on the triangular lattice which was previously introduced as a special limit of a Majorana-Hubbard model. This model also possesses anticommuting noncontractible line symmetries, which enforce an exact, topology-dependent degeneracy between locally indistinguishable states. We first study a Z_N clock generalization and find, at large N, a gapless ground state with three subsystem-symmetry-protected nodal lines. Exploiting dynamical splitting and the subsystem symmetries, we carry out exact diagonalization of the N=2 model on lattices up to 9×9 spins. The many-body gap and bipartite entanglement provide strong evidence for a gapless state consistent with the large-N nodal structure: the entanglement scales as Llog L and exhibits 1+1-dimensional CFT-like chord scaling on cylinders. Finally, we study instabilities and proximate phases. In particular, we find evidence that a subsystem-symmetry-preserving deformation drives a finite coupling transition to a gapped phase with mathbb Z₂ × mathbb Z₂ topological order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有“动力学分裂”结构的一类哈密顿量：两组作用于相同自由度的项彼此逐项对易，从而可通过代数对偶性转化为作用于相互独立有效自由度的两部分。作者将其应用于三角晶格上的手性XYZ自旋1/2模型，并发现大N极限下具有三个受子系统对称性保护的节点线的无能隙基态。针对N=2模型的精确对角化显示，纠缠熵按L log L增长，并支持与该节点结构一致的无能隙态；保持子系统对称性的形变则显示出通向具有Z2 × Z2拓扑序的有隙相的有限耦合相变迹象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究一类具有我们称为“动力学分裂”结构的哈密顿量：哈密顿量中的各项可以分成两组，这两组作用于相同的自由度，并且其中一组的每一项都与另一组的每一项对易，尽管任一组内部的各项并非全部对易。这种结构产生了一个关于有效自由度的代数对偶，在这些有效自由度上，哈密顿量的两部分彼此分开地作用，从而能够在通常可处理规模约两倍的自旋晶格上实现精确对角化。我们将这一方法用于三角晶格上的手性XYZ模型。这一几何受挫自旋1/2模型此前曾作为马约拉纳- Hubbard模型的一个特殊极限被提出。该模型还具有反对易的不可收缩非平凡线对称性，这些对称性在局域上不可区分的态之间强制产生依赖拓扑的精确简并。我们首先研究一个Z_N钟模型推广，并发现当N较大时，其基态是无能隙的，并具有三个由子系统对称性保护的节点线。利用动力学分裂和子系统对称性，我们对N=2模型在最大达到9×9个自旋的晶格上进行了精确对角化。多体能隙和二分纠缠为一种无能隙态提供了有力证据，该态与大N极限下的节点结构相一致：纠缠按L log L增长，并且在圆柱几何上呈现类似1+1维共形场论的弦函数标度。最后，我们研究了该模型的不稳定性及其邻近相。特别是，我们发现，保持子系统对称性的形变会在有限耦合处驱动系统发生相变，进入具有Z2 × Z2拓扑序的有隙相。

articles.title: Signatures of a ferro-Josephson effect in twisted graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭转石墨烯中铁约瑟夫森效应的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a spin-polarized current is driven across a magnetic domain wall, the resulting spin-transfer torque could, beyond a critical threshold, set the wall's moments into precession. This precession would modulate the Berry curvature experienced by electrons traversing the wall, producing an electromotive force that is topological in nature, proportional to the precession frequency, mapping precisely onto the DC Josephson effect and leading to the name ferro-Josephson effect. We report signatures consistent with this effect in a twisted graphene van der Waals heterostructure, where spin and valley textures are linked by exchange, Hund's coupling, and spin-orbit interactions. Tuned to fillings where the isospin degeneracy is spontaneously broken, the samples develop a sharp peak in the longitudinal resistance within a fraction of a millitesla of Bₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ₌₀₋₋₋ₐ peak that disappears as the current is reduced toward zero. In differential resistance the feature resolves into sharp resonances that disperse with Bₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ on microtesla and picoampere scales. We argue that these arise from the current-driven precession of spin-domain-wall moments, in competition with the in-plane anisotropy set by a minuscule applied field, and that they establish nonlinear transport as a sensitive probe of isospin domain-wall dynamics at energy scales far below k_BT.
articles.abstract_zh: 当自旋极化电流穿过磁畴壁时，自旋转移力矩可能在超过临界阈值后使畴壁磁矩发生进动。该进动会调制电子穿越畴壁时感受到的贝里曲率，产生与进动频率成正比的拓扑电动势，这一过程对应直流约瑟夫森效应，因而被称为铁约瑟夫森效应。作者在扭转石墨烯范德瓦耳斯异质结构中观测到与该效应一致的特征，包括随电流减小而消失的纵向电阻尖峰，以及在微特斯拉和皮安培尺度上随平行磁场色散的微分电阻共振，并将其归因于电流驱动的自旋畴壁磁矩进动。
authors: Ruiheng Su, Zhenxiang Gao, Christopher Coleman, Manabendra Kuiri, Dacen Waters, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Matthew Yankowitz, Nemin Wei, Chunli Huang, Allan H. MacDonald, Joshua Folk
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当自旋极化电流被驱动穿过磁畴壁时，由此产生的自旋转移力矩可能在超过某一临界阈值后使畴壁中的磁矩发生进动。这种进动会调制电子穿越畴壁时所感受到的贝里曲率，从而产生一种本质上具有拓扑性质、与进动频率成正比的电动势；这一过程恰好对应于直流约瑟夫森效应，因此被称为铁约瑟夫森效应。我们在一种扭转石墨烯范德瓦耳斯异质结构中报告了与该效应相符的特征，其中自旋和谷纹理由交换相互作用、洪特耦合和自旋轨道相互作用相互联系。当调节到同位旋简并性发生自发破缺的填充数时，样品会在平行磁场Bₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ接近零的不到一毫特斯拉范围内产生一个纵向电阻尖峰；随着电流减小并趋近于零，该尖峰会消失。在微分电阻中，这一特征分解为尖锐的共振，并且在微特斯拉和皮安培尺度上随Bₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ发生色散。我们认为，这些现象源于电流驱动的自旋畴壁磁矩进动，并与由极小外加磁场设定的面内各向异性相竞争；这些结果表明，非线性输运可以作为一种灵敏探针，用于研究远低于k_BT能标的同位旋畴壁动力学。

articles.title: Metastable magnetic domains and the anomalous Bₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ₌₀ resistance peak in twisted double bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭转双双层石墨烯中的亚稳磁畴与异常的零面内磁场电阻峰
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In graphene moirés, valley polarization gives rise to orbital magnetism, manifested as an anomalous Hall effect and resulting in Barkhausen jumps in longitudinal resistance when changing domain configurations modify quasiparticle scattering. Beyond a simple picture of polarized domains, however, spin and valley textures within and between the domains are less well understood, as is the effect of these textures on transport. In the valley-polarized quarter-metal state of twisted double bilayer graphene, a sharp and metastable peak in longitudinal resistance often appears at zero in-plane magnetic field, whose microscopic origin has yet to be identified. Here, we show that this peak depends on the configuration of domains of orbital magnetism, which is itself set by the gate-voltage trajectory used to enter the ordered state and by the magnetic field --- particularly the in-plane component --- present during that trajectory. The sensitivity of the effect to in-plane magnetic field components points to spin, linked to valley polarization through spin-orbit coupling, as the key degree of freedom in both the domain formation and the resistance peak.
articles.abstract_zh: 在石墨烯莫尔体系中，谷极化可产生轨道磁性，并通过反常霍尔效应与畴构型变化影响纵向电阻。本文研究扭转双双层石墨烯谷极化四分之一金属态中零面内磁场处尖锐且亚稳的纵向电阻峰，发现其取决于轨道磁畴构型、进入有序态的栅压路径以及该路径中的磁场，尤其是面内分量。结果表明，受自旋-轨道耦合与谷极化关联的自旋，是畴形成和电阻峰的关键自由度。
authors: Zhenxiang Gao, Christopher Coleman, Silvia Folk, Ruiheng Su, Manabendra Kuiri, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Nemin Wei, Chunli Huang, Joshua Folk
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在石墨烯莫尔体系中，谷极化会产生轨道磁性，其表现为反常霍尔效应，并且当畴构型变化改变准粒子散射时，会导致纵向电阻中的巴克豪森跳变。然而，超越极化畴的简单图像之后，畴内和畴间的自旋与谷织构仍不甚清楚，这些织构对输运的影响也同样尚未充分理解。在扭转双双层石墨烯的谷极化四分之一金属态中，纵向电阻在零面内磁场处常常出现一个尖锐且亚稳的峰，其微观起源尚未被确定。本文表明，该峰取决于轨道磁性畴的构型，而这种构型本身由进入有序态时所采用的栅电压轨迹以及该轨迹中存在的磁场，特别是面内分量，所设定。该效应对面内磁场分量的敏感性表明，自旋通过自旋-轨道耦合与谷极化相联系，是畴形成和电阻峰中的关键自由度。

articles.title: Grain Boundary Engineering Effect on Vortex Matter in Superconducting Films
articles.title_zh: 晶界工程对超导薄膜中涡旋物质的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline superconducting films act as a double-edged sword: they can pin vortices or degrade superconductivity through Josephson-like weak-link coupling. Here, we demonstrate that sputtering pressure tunes GB coupling in NbTiN films and visualize its consequences for vortex matter. The 5 mTorr film exhibits dispersed grain orientations and a two-step resistive transition under field, signaling intergranular weak-link behavior. In contrast, the 7 mTorr film develops a (111) texture, a single-step transition, higher critical current density, a second magnetization peak, and a δl-type pinning response consistent with improved GB coupling. Cryogenic magnetic force microscopy reveals a spatially heterogeneous, cluster-like vortex configuration in the 5 mTorr film, whereas the 7 mTorr film hosts a more uniform distribution with enhanced local order. These results establish a connection between deposition-controlled GB connectivity, macroscopic weak-link transport, and microscopic vortex organization, providing a practical route to tailor vortex pinning in polycrystalline superconducting films.
articles.abstract_zh: 多晶超导薄膜中的晶界既可钉扎涡旋，也可能通过约瑟夫森式弱连接削弱超导性。本文证明溅射压力可调控 NbTiN 薄膜中的晶界耦合，并显著影响宏观输运与微观涡旋组织。5 mTorr 薄膜表现出弱连接行为和团簇状非均匀涡旋构型，而 7 mTorr 薄膜具有更好的晶界耦合、更高临界电流密度和更均匀有序的涡旋分布。
authors: Qun Wang, Ting Chen, Ya-Xun He, Xing-Jian Liu, Jian-Wen Sun, Kang-Hong Yin, Fang-Ting Lin, Shi-Xun Cao, Jun-Yi Ge
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多晶超导薄膜中的晶界是一把双刃剑：它们可以钉扎涡旋，也可以通过类似约瑟夫森弱连接的耦合削弱超导性。本文证明，溅射压力能够调控 NbTiN 薄膜中的晶界耦合，并可视化其对涡旋物质的影响。5 mTorr 薄膜表现出分散的晶粒取向，并在磁场下出现两步电阻转变，表明存在晶间弱连接行为。相比之下，7 mTorr 薄膜形成了 (111) 织构，表现出单步转变、更高的临界电流密度、第二磁化峰，以及与改善的晶界耦合相一致的 δl 型钉扎响应。低温磁力显微镜显示，5 mTorr 薄膜中存在空间非均匀的团簇状涡旋构型，而 7 mTorr 薄膜则具有更均匀的分布并呈现增强的局域有序性。这些结果建立了沉积过程控制的晶界连通性、宏观弱连接输运和微观涡旋组织之间的联系，为调控多晶超导薄膜中的涡旋钉扎提供了一条实用途径。

articles.title: High-throughput Discovery of Magnetic Rare Earth Transition Metal Alloys
articles.title_zh: 磁性稀土-过渡金属合金的高通量发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an accelerated materials discovery framework that combines diffusion-based crystal structure generation with hierarchical screening to identify new rare-earth--transition-metal magnets simultaneously achieving high magnetization and thermodynamic stability. Using this workflow, we systematically explored over 3000 binary (R-T) and ternary (R-T-T') compositions spanning R~in Y, Sm, T~in Fe, Co, Ni, and T' in Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn, and filtered approximately 240,000 generated crystal structures through machine-learning interatomic potential prescreening and spin-polarized density functional theory validation. We identify 300+ low-energy magnetic candidates within 0.1~eV/atom above the convex hull at the DFT level, including 5 thermodynamically stable phases. The highest saturation magnetization reaches sim1.8~T in Fe-rich binary and ternary phases (SmFe₁₂, YFe₁₂, YFe₁₈Ti and Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn). Symmetry analysis reveals that the majority of ternary candidates are subgroup derivatives of known binary prototypes through Wyckoff site splitting that accommodates T' substitution. Site-resolved magnetic moment analysis further shows that Mn aligns ferromagnetically with the Fe sublattice with minimal magnetization loss, whereas Cr couples antiferromagnetically, providing systematic guidance for dopant selection. These findings demonstrate a generalizable strategy for targeted magnetic materials discovery and suggest that extending generative searches to larger unit cells (>20 atoms) with higher Fe fractions is a promising route toward stable phases with saturation magnetization exceeding 1.8~T.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种加速材料发现框架，将基于扩散模型的晶体结构生成与分层筛选结合，用于寻找同时具有高磁化强度和热力学稳定性的稀土-过渡金属磁体。研究筛选约 24 万个生成结构，在 DFT 水平发现 300 余个低能磁性候选物，其中包括 5 个热力学稳定相。结果还揭示了三元候选物与已知二元原型的对称性关系，并给出 Mn、Cr 等掺杂元素对磁化的不同影响，为高磁化稳定磁体搜索提供指导。
authors: Shuo Tao, Osman Goni Ridwan, Liqin Ke, Qiang Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种加速材料发现框架，该框架将基于扩散的晶体结构生成与分层筛选相结合，以识别同时实现高磁化强度和热力学稳定性的新型稀土-过渡金属磁体。利用这一工作流程，我们系统探索了 3000 多种二元 (R-T) 和三元 (R-T-T') 组成，其中 R 属于 Y、Sm，T 属于 Fe、Co、Ni，T' 属于 Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Cu、Zn，并通过机器学习原子间势预筛选和自旋极化密度泛函理论验证，对约 240000 个生成的晶体结构进行了过滤。我们在 DFT 水平识别出 300 多个处于凸包上方 0.1 eV/atom 以内的低能磁性候选物，其中包括 5 个热力学稳定相。最高饱和磁化强度在富 Fe 二元和三元相中达到约 1.8 T，包括 SmFe₁₂、YFe₁₂、YFe₁₈Ti 和 Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn。对称性分析表明，大多数三元候选物是已知二元原型通过 Wyckoff 位点分裂以容纳 T' 取代而形成的子群衍生结构。位点分辨磁矩分析进一步显示，Mn 与 Fe 子晶格铁磁排列且磁化损失很小，而 Cr 则发生反铁磁耦合，从而为掺杂元素选择提供系统性指导。这些发现展示了一种可推广的靶向磁性材料发现策略，并表明将生成式搜索扩展到更大晶胞（>20 个原子）和更高 Fe 含量，是通向饱和磁化强度超过 1.8 T 的稳定相的一条有前景路径。

articles.title: Distinct Surface and Bulk Superconductivity in the Kagome Superconductor SrSn₃
articles.title_zh: 笼目超导体 SrSn₃ 中不同的表面与体相超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface and bulk superconductivity may possess fundamentally different superconducting properties in quantum materials with nontrivial electronic structures, yet their superimposed spectroscopic signatures often prevent direct experimental access to each superconducting channel. Here we reveal, in epitaxial films of the kagome superconductor SrSn₃, distinct surface and bulk superconducting channels with markedly different superconducting gaps, upper critical fields, and vortex-core electronic states by tuning the tunneling junction resistance in scanning tunneling spectroscopy. The surface superconductivity is characterized by a thickness-independent superconducting gap and an enhanced upper critical field, whereas the bulk superconducting channel exhibits a larger superconducting gap that decreases with reducing film thickness and a much lower upper critical field. Within magnetic vortex cores, robust non-split zero-bias conductance peaks are observed exclusively in the surface superconducting channel, while pronounced zero-bias suppression is consistently associated with the bulk superconducting channel. These findings demonstrate that the vortex-core electronic structure depends sensitively on the underlying superconducting channel, providing new insight into vortex-bound states in topological quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在具有非平庸电子结构的量子材料中，表面与体相超导可能具有本质不同的性质，但其谱学信号常相互叠加。本文通过调节扫描隧道谱中的隧穿结电阻，在外延 SrSn₃ 薄膜中区分出表面和体相超导通道。研究发现二者在超导能隙、上临界场和涡旋芯电子态方面显著不同，表面通道中独有稳健的非劈裂零偏压电导峰。
authors: Qun Zhu, Yong-Wei Wang, Ji-Hai Zhang, Qiang-Jun Cheng, Chen-Yu Hu, Jun-Zhong Wang, Qi-Kun Xue, Xu-Cun Ma, Can-Li Song
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有非平庸电子结构的量子材料中，表面和体相超导性可能具有根本不同的超导性质，然而它们相互叠加的谱学特征常常阻碍对每个超导通道的直接实验探测。本文通过调节扫描隧道谱中的隧穿结电阻，在笼目超导体 SrSn₃ 的外延薄膜中揭示了彼此不同的表面和体相超导通道，它们具有显著不同的超导能隙、上临界场和涡旋芯电子态。表面超导性的特征是厚度无关的超导能隙和增强的上临界场，而体相超导通道表现出更大的超导能隙，该能隙随薄膜厚度减小而降低，并且具有低得多的上临界场。在磁涡旋芯内，稳健的非劈裂零偏压电导峰仅在表面超导通道中被观察到，而显著的零偏压抑制始终与体相超导通道相关联。这些发现表明，涡旋芯电子结构对其底层超导通道高度敏感，为拓扑量子材料中的涡旋束缚态提供了新的认识。

articles.title: Splay-induced charging of ferroelectric droplets in highly non-uniform electric fields
articles.title_zh: 高度非均匀电场中展曲诱导的铁电液滴带电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric sessile droplets on a superhydrophobic surface can be put into motion by highly non-uniform electric fields, in a direction that depends on the field sign. This indicates that droplets carry a non-vanishing electrostatic charge, which we interpret as acquired through contact electrification at the interface with the superhydrophobic substrate. This phenomenon is not observed in the presence of a uniform or quasi-uniform electric field, suggesting that droplets charging is favored in highly nonuniform fields able to induce localized distortions of the ferroelectric polarization, in turn producing localized charge accumulation sites. Electrostatic charging is thus understood as a splay-induced contact electrification and interpreted as a strategy to minimize the accumulated charge. Electrophoretic-like motion is observed in about 30% of the experiments, meaning that splay-induced charging requires the proper combination of conditions such as droplets size, distance from the field source, freshness of the substrate coating and other experimental details that are not easily quantified. When charging does not occur, effects related to droplet polarization such as dielectrophoresis, ejection of polarized fluid jets and electrostriction-like deformations are observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 超疏水表面上的铁电固着液滴可在高度非均匀电场驱动下运动，且方向依赖电场符号，说明液滴带有非零静电电荷。作者将其解释为与超疏水基底界面处的接触起电，并认为高度非均匀电场通过诱导局域极化畸变促进带电。该类电泳式运动约在 30% 实验中出现；未发生带电时则观察到介电泳、极化流体射流喷出和类电致伸缩形变等效应。
authors: Lorenzo Fiorentini, Elia Rocchetti, Raouf Barboza, Roberta Galeazzi, Liana Lucchetti
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超疏水表面上的铁电固着液滴可以在高度非均匀电场的作用下发生运动，其运动方向取决于电场符号。这表明液滴携带非零静电电荷，我们将其解释为通过与超疏水基底界面处的接触起电获得。该现象在均匀或准均匀电场存在时未被观察到，说明液滴带电受到高度非均匀电场的促进，这类电场能够诱导铁电极化的局域畸变，进而产生局域电荷积累位点。因此，静电带电被理解为一种展曲诱导的接触起电，并被解释为一种使积累电荷最小化的策略。约 30% 的实验中观察到类似电泳的运动，这意味着展曲诱导带电需要液滴尺寸、与场源距离、基底涂层新鲜程度以及其他不易量化的实验细节等条件的适当组合。当带电未发生时，则观察到与液滴极化相关的效应，如介电泳、极化流体射流喷出以及类似电致伸缩的形变。

articles.title: Interpretable physics-informed retrieval-augmented generation language model for end-to-end inorganic crystal synthesis planning
articles.title_zh: 用于端到端无机晶体合成规划的可解释物理信息检索增强生成语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthesis planning for inorganic materials requires predicting both synthesizability and viable routes by linking microscopic thermodynamic stability with macroscopic synthesis methods, precursors, and processing conditions. Here, we develop an interpretable Physics-Informed Retrieval-Augmented Generation Language Model (PIRAG-LM) for end-to-end inorganic crystal synthesis planning. We construct a material-centered Structured Synthesis Knowledge Base (SSKB) containing route-level records for 13,820 experimentally synthesized inorganic crystals. PIRAG-LM retrieves historical precedents using chemical, structural, and thermodynamic similarity, then employs a structured LLM reasoning module to propose routes, precursors, and processing conditions and assess thermodynamic feasibility, kinetics, and accessibility. It achieves 91.4% accuracy in synthesis-method prediction, compared with 72.1% for the LLM alone, and generalizes to materials reported after the knowledge cutoff. Because the framework relies on retrieval rather than parametric memorization, its performance can be improved by expanding the SSKB without retraining the language model. Guided by PIRAG-LM, we experimentally synthesize five new compounds: BaMo0.3In0.7O2.95, BaNb0.4In0.6O2.9, Hg[B(CN)4]2, CoCo(CN)6, and SrNb2Fe2(PO4)6, via solid-state and solution routes. These results demonstrate an interpretable machine-learning approach that helps bridge computational materials discovery and experimental realization.
articles.abstract_zh: 无机材料合成规划需要同时预测可合成性和可行路线，并连接微观热力学稳定性与宏观合成工艺。本文开发了可解释的物理信息检索增强生成语言模型 PIRAG-LM，并构建包含 13820 种实验合成无机晶体路线记录的结构化知识库。该方法在合成方法预测上达到 91.4% 准确率，并指导实验合成了五种新化合物，展示了连接计算材料发现与实验实现的机器学习路径。
authors: Wei-Jian Jiang, Ye-Nan Sha, Hui Guo, Jie Chen, Yu-Cai Liang, Ke Zhou, Qi-Long Gao, Dong-Lin Han, Xin-Gao Gong, Wan-Jian Yin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无机材料的合成规划需要通过连接微观热力学稳定性与宏观合成方法、前驱体和处理条件，来预测可合成性和可行路线。本文开发了一种可解释的物理信息检索增强生成语言模型（PIRAG-LM），用于端到端无机晶体合成规划。我们构建了一个以材料为中心的结构化合成知识库（SSKB），其中包含 13820 种经实验合成的无机晶体的路线级记录。PIRAG-LM 使用化学、结构和热力学相似性检索历史先例，然后采用结构化 LLM 推理模块来提出路线、前驱体和处理条件，并评估热力学可行性、动力学和可获得性。它在合成方法预测中达到 91.4% 的准确率，而单独使用 LLM 的准确率为 72.1%，并且能够泛化到知识截止时间之后报道的材料。由于该框架依赖检索而不是参数化记忆，因此其性能可以通过扩展 SSKB 来提高，而无需重新训练语言模型。在 PIRAG-LM 的指导下，我们通过固相和溶液路线实验合成了五种新化合物：BaMo0.3In0.7O2.95、BaNb0.4In0.6O2.9、Hg[B(CN)4]2、CoCo(CN)6 和 SrNb2Fe2(PO4)6。这些结果展示了一种可解释的机器学习方法，有助于弥合计算材料发现与实验实现之间的差距。

articles.title: Non-Hermitian topological Euler insulators
articles.title_zh: 非厄米拓扑欧拉绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological Euler insulators emerge in multiband systems with real Bloch Hamiltonians and wavefunctions. Their fragile topologies are characterized by the Euler class of degenerate bands and protected by the PT or C₂T symmetry in two dimensions, which go beyond the tenfold K-theory classification of topological matter. In this work, we extend the conception of topological Euler insulators to non-Hermitian systems and propose a theoretical framework to unlock their nontrivial Euler topology. Focusing on two-dimensional, three-band non-Hermitian lattice models with symmetric Hamiltonians, we formulate a comprehensive description of their topological Euler bands, entanglement spectrum and bulk-boundary correspondence. Three typical models of non-Hermitian Euler insulators are constructed and investigated explicitly to illustrate our theory. Unique topological phase transitions and anomalous edge-band overlaps with non-Hermitian origins are further identified. Our study establishes the presence of topological Euler bands in non-Hermitian systems and unveils their intriguing physical characteristics, thereby broadening the existing territory of topological matter in non-Hermitian open systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑欧拉绝缘体出现在具有实 Bloch 哈密顿量和波函数的多带体系中，其脆弱拓扑由简并能带的欧拉类表征。本文将拓扑欧拉绝缘体概念扩展到非厄米体系，并建立理论框架以刻画其非平庸欧拉拓扑。作者围绕二维三带非厄米对称晶格模型，讨论欧拉能带、纠缠谱和体边对应，并揭示具有非厄米起源的特殊相变和异常边带重叠。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑欧拉绝缘体出现在具有实 Bloch 哈密顿量和波函数的多带体系中。它们的脆弱拓扑由简并能带的欧拉类表征，并在二维中受 PT 或 C₂T 对称性保护，超出了拓扑物质十重 K 理论分类的范围。在这项工作中，我们将拓扑欧拉绝缘体的概念扩展到非厄米体系，并提出一个理论框架来揭示其非平庸的欧拉拓扑。我们聚焦于具有对称哈密顿量的二维三带非厄米晶格模型，对其拓扑欧拉能带、纠缠谱和体边对应给出了全面描述。文中构造并明确研究了三种典型的非厄米欧拉绝缘体模型，以阐明我们的理论。研究进一步识别出具有非厄米起源的独特拓扑相变和异常边带重叠。我们的研究确立了非厄米体系中拓扑欧拉能带的存在，并揭示其引人关注的物理特征，从而拓宽了非厄米开放体系中拓扑物质的既有疆域。

articles.title: Exchange splitting as a descriptor for giant anomalous Hall and Nernst effects in ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 交换劈裂作为铁磁体中巨反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应的描述符
