Within this framework, we prove that one-dimensional structured random circuits with non-Haar random local gates can exhibit substantially more global randomness compared to Haar random circuits with the same underlying circuit architecture. In particular, we derive all the exact eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the second-moment operators for these structured random circuits under a solvable condition, by establishing a link to the Kitaev chain, and show that their spectral gaps can exceed those of Haar random circuits. Our findings have applications in improving circuit depth bounds for randomized benchmarking and the generation of approximate unitary 2-designs from shallow random circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有特定门结构的随机量子电路，并证明一维结构化随机电路即使采用非Haar随机的局部门，也可能比相同架构下使用Haar随机门的电路具有显著更强的全局随机性。通过建立与Kitaev链的联系，作者在可解条件下精确求出了二阶矩算子的全部本征值和本征矢，并表明其谱隙可以超过Haar随机电路。该结果有助于改进随机基准测试和由浅层随机电路生成近似幺正2-设计的深度界。
authors: Ryotaro Suzuki, Hosho Katsura, Yosuke Mitsuhashi, Tomohiro Soejima, Jens Eisert, Nobuyuki Yoshioka
articles.abstract_zh_full: 产生幺正设计的随机电路是量子信息科学和多体物理中的关键工具。在本文中，我们研究了一类具有特定门结构的随机量子电路。在这一框架下，我们证明，一维结构化随机电路即使采用非Haar随机的局部门，也能够比具有相同底层电路架构的Haar随机电路表现出显著更强的全局随机性。具体而言，通过建立与Kitaev链的联系，我们在一个可解条件下推导出了这些结构化随机电路的二阶矩算子的全部精确本征值和本征矢，并表明它们的谱隙可以超过Haar随机电路的谱隙。我们的发现可应用于改进随机基准测试的电路深度界，以及利用浅层随机电路生成近似幺正2-设计。

articles.title: Aliased noise characterization and mitigation in BICEP Array 150, 220 and 270 GHz time-division multiplexed detectors
articles.title_zh: BICEP阵列150、220和270 GHz时分复用探测器中的混叠噪声表征与抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Early observations with the BICEP Array 150 GHz (BA2-150) and 220/270 GHz (BA3-220/270) receivers revealed detector noise equivalent temperatures (NETs) higher than expected, together with substantial detector-to-detector and module-to-module scatter. Noise measurements acquired with multiplexing off and high frequency sampling demonstrate that this excess originates from elevated high-frequency detector noise that aliases into the science band during time-division multiplexing. We show that the excess high-frequency noise is correlated with anomalously large logarithmic TES transition slopes, α, resulting in elevated electrothermal loop gain and operation near the detector stability boundary. Measurements of α indicate values substantially larger than expected, consistent with the sharper superconducting transitions introduced by the inverted TES fabrication process adopted for BA2-150 and BA3-220/270 detectors. Operational mitigation strategies were investigated through both increased multiplexing rates and elevated focal-plane operating temperatures. Faster multiplexing reduces aliasing by shifting the multiplexing Nyquist frequency beyond the excess noise roll-off, while elevated bath temperatures reduce TES electrical power and loop gain, improving detector stability and reducing NET by approximately 10%. These results demonstrate the importance of balancing TES responsivity, electrothermal stability, and multiplexed readout performance in next-generation CMB polarimeters.
articles.abstract_zh: BICEP阵列150 GHz和220/270 GHz接收机的早期观测显示，探测器噪声等效温度高于预期，并存在显著的探测器间和模块间差异。关闭复用并采用高频采样的噪声测量表明，过量噪声源于高频探测器噪声，该噪声在时分复用过程中混叠到科学频带。作者将其与异常偏大的TES跃迁对数斜率相关联，并通过提高复用速率和焦平面工作温度进行缓解，使噪声等效温度降低约10%。

articles.abstract_zh_full: 对BICEP阵列150 GHz接收机（BA2-150）以及220/270 GHz接收机（BA3-220/270）的早期观测显示，探测器噪声等效温度（NET）高于预期，同时探测器之间和模块之间存在显著的离散性。在关闭复用并采用高频采样获得的噪声测量结果表明，这种过量噪声源于升高的高频探测器噪声；在时分复用过程中，该噪声混叠进入科学频带。我们表明，过量高频噪声与异常偏大的TES跃迁对数斜率α相关，这导致电热环路增益升高，并使探测器工作在接近稳定性边界的区域。对α的测量显示，其数值显著高于预期，这与BA2-150和BA3-220/270探测器所采用的倒置TES制造工艺引入的更陡超导跃迁相一致。我们通过提高复用速率和升高焦平面工作温度两种方式研究了运行层面的缓解策略。更快的复用会将复用奈奎斯特频率移到过量噪声滚降频率之外，从而减少混叠；升高浴温则会降低TES电功率和环路增益，改善探测器稳定性，并使NET降低约10%。这些结果说明，在下一代宇宙微波背景偏振仪中，必须平衡TES响应度、电热稳定性和复用读出性能。

articles.title: Single-Mode Control of High-Speed and Low-Threshold III-V/Si Quantum Dot Microring Lasers via Azimuthal Gratings
articles.title_zh: 通过方位角光栅实现高速、低阈值III-V/硅量子点微环激光器的单模控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid III-V/silicon quantum-dot microring lasers are compact, energy-efficient O-band sources, but their whispering-gallery cavities are inherently multimode and bidirectional, producing unstable mode hopping that is incompatible with dense wavelength-division multiplexing. We show that an azimuthal grating patterned into the silicon ring - a single lithographic degree of freedom - converts this multimode cavity into a wavelength-addressed, single-mode source. A coupled-mode analysis derives the angular-momentum selection rule from first principles and shows that the inner-wall corrugation replaces the degenerate counter-propagating pair with symmetric and anti-symmetric standing-wave supermodes of unequal radiative loss. At the second-order Bragg condition the anti-symmetric mode is symmetry-protected, yielding a high-quality-factor state at exactly one azimuthal order; finite-element simulations confirm this and identify grating depth as the primary loss-engineering handle. Devices fabricated in-house on a 100 mm silicon-on-insulator platform hold a single longitudinal order with a side-mode suppression ratio of 37.9 dB and continuous, hop-free tuning, while the emission wavelength stays fixed across a factor-of-two change in cavity loading, set lithographically rather than by the gain peak. Because the grating decouples the lasing wavelength from the quantum-dot gain, the detuning becomes a mask-level design variable that sets the temperature of minimum threshold current, reaching 1.95 mA near 50 degC. Combined with side-mode suppression beyond 37 dB and multi-gigahertz direct modulation, these lasers are practical building blocks for cascaded, wavelength-addressed transmitter arrays in data communication and co-packaged optics.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合集成III-V/硅量子点微环激光器具有紧凑和高能效等优势，但其回音壁腔本征上是多模且双向的，容易发生不稳定的模式跳变。本文表明，在硅环中引入方位角光栅，可将多模腔转化为按波长寻址的单模光源；耦合模分析和有限元模拟揭示了其模式选择与损耗工程机制。器件实现了37.9 dB边模抑制比、连续无跳模调谐和多GHz直接调制，并获得约1.95 mA的最低阈值电流。
authors: Xucheng Yang, Yingtao Hu, Eunso Shin, Antoine Descos, Yatiraj Ramanujam, Bassem Tossoun, Yuan Yuan, Geza Kurczveil, Jonathan Wierer, Ray Beausoleil, Di Liang, Stanley Cheung
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合集成III-V/硅量子点微环激光器是紧凑且节能的O波段光源，但其回音壁腔本征上具有多模和双向传播特性，会产生不稳定的模式跳变，这与密集波分复用不相容。我们证明，在硅环中制备方位角光栅这一单一光刻自由度，可以将这种多模腔转换为按波长寻址的单模光源。耦合模分析从第一性原理推导出了角动量选择定则，并表明，内壁波纹会将简并的反向传播模式对替换为辐射损耗不同的对称和反对称驻波超模。在二阶布拉格条件下，反对称模式受到对称性保护，从而在恰好一个方位角阶数上产生高品质因数态；有限元模拟证实了这一点，并确定光栅深度是主要的损耗工程调控参数。在100毫米绝缘体上硅平台上自行制造的器件保持单一纵模阶数，边模抑制比达到37.9 dB，并实现连续、无跳模调谐；当腔加载发生两倍变化时，发射波长仍保持不变，因为该波长由光刻工艺设定，而不是由增益峰决定。由于光栅使激射波长与量子点增益解耦，失谐量成为掩模层面的设计变量，可以设定阈值电流最低时的温度；在约50摄氏度时，最低阈值电流达到1.95 mA。结合超过37 dB的边模抑制和多GHz直接调制能力，这些激光器可作为数据通信和共封装光学中级联式、按波长寻址发射器阵列的实用构件。

articles.title: Core-valence double ionization of SF6 involving S2p, F1s and S1s inner shells
articles.title_zh: 涉及S2p、F1s和S1s内层的SF6核价双电离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Core-valence double ionization electron spectra near the S2p, F1s and S1s edges of SF6 are presented, analyzed and compared with conventional valence photoelectron spectra and quantum chemical calculations. The core-valence spectra are energetically stretched out, revealing salient structures between 15 and 40 eV that are sufficiently separated for molecular orbital analysis. The spectra offer new insights into the electronic structure, showing that the core hole substantially rearranges the molecular orbital order. This effect can be traced to orbital localization and nodal structure, as well as to valence-to-core penetration. The singlet and triplet splittings of the dicationic states progressively decrease in all three core-valence spectra towards deeper core levels, with larger splittings for S2p than S1s, reflecting greater valence-to-core penetration and exchange interaction for S2p. By large, the MO interpretation holds in frozen or self-consistent-field representations, except for the inner parts of the F1s spectra, which require analysis in terms of MO breakdown effects. An intensity model for CV spectra is derived using an independent-channel approach, where primary core ionization is treated by dipolar coupling to a continuum and the valence electron is promoted to a second continuum through shake-off. Full spin coupling and spin selectivity between the discrete doubly ionized states and the two continuum electrons are maintained. The primary molecular photoelectron intensity is expressed as a weighted sum of atomic subshell cross sections using a one-center atomic orbital projection of the relevant molecular orbital. The calculated spectra agree well with experiment and allow detailed assignment. In particular, symmetry breaking at the F1s core-ionization site is identified and discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示、分析并比较了SF6在S2p、F1s和S1s吸收边附近的核价双电离电子能谱、常规价电子光电子能谱和量子化学计算结果。核价能谱在能量上显著展开，揭示了15至40 eV之间足以进行分子轨道分析的结构，并表明核空穴会大幅重排分子轨道顺序。作者还建立了独立通道强度模型，计算谱与实验符合良好，并特别识别和讨论了F1s核电离位点的对称性破缺。
authors: Veronica Daver Ideböhn, Daniel M. Pereira, Lucas M. Cornetta, Richard J. Squibb, Andreas Hult Roos, Emelie Olsson, Måns Wallner, Marco Parriani, Nihar Ranjan Behera, Gunnar Öhrwall, Florian Trinter, John H. D. Eland, Hans Ågren, Raimund Feifel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文给出了SF6在S2p、F1s和S1s吸收边附近的核价双电离电子能谱，并将其与常规价电子光电子能谱及量子化学计算进行了分析和比较。核价能谱在能量上被展开，揭示出15至40 eV之间的显著结构，这些结构彼此分离得足够开，从而可以进行分子轨道分析。这些能谱为电子结构提供了新的认识，表明核空穴会显著重排分子轨道的顺序。这一效应可以追溯到轨道局域化和节点结构，以及价电子向核轨道的穿透。在三个核价能谱中，双阳离子态的单重态和三重态分裂均随着内层深度增加而逐渐减小；S2p能谱中的分裂大于S1s能谱中的分裂，这反映出在S2p情况下更强的价电子向核轨道穿透和交换相互作用。总体而言，无论采用冻结轨道还是自洽场表象，分子轨道解释均成立；但F1s能谱的内层部分需要用分子轨道失效效应进行分析。我们利用独立通道方法推导了核价能谱的强度模型，其中初级核电离通过与连续态的偶极耦合处理，价电子则通过摇脱过程跃迁到第二个连续态。离散双电离态与两个连续态电子之间的完整自旋耦合和自旋选择性均得到保留。初级分子光电子强度通过相关分子轨道的单中心原子轨道投影表示为原子亚壳层截面的加权和。计算能谱与实验结果符合良好，并能够进行详细归属。特别是，我们识别并讨论了F1s核电离位点的对称性破缺。

articles.title: Quantum motility-induced phase separation
articles.title_zh: 量子运动性诱导相分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25649v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motility-induced phase separation (MIPS) describes a central clustering phenomenon in active matter systems where particles spontaneously separate into dense and dilute phases even in the absence of interparticle attractive forces. Recent theoretical and experimental efforts have taken the first steps to extend active matter concepts to the quantum level. However, whether a genuine quantum analog of MIPS exists and how quantum coherence would compete or cooperate with the dissipative self-propulsion has remained open so far. Here, we provide evidence that quantum MIPS can occur in a model of active hard-core bosons in one dimension. Our model yields superlinear number fluctuations characteristic of MIPS, leading to microphase separation with large but finite cluster size. Adding nearest-neighbor repulsive interactions, we find numerical evidence for restoring genuine phase separation with a divergent correlation length. Crucially, the clustered steady states maintain a long-distance quantum coherence, revealing a genuinely quantum feature with no classical counterpart. These results provide a foundation for exploring quantum MIPS and suggest that the coherence-activity interplay can generate new types of nonequilibrium quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 运动性诱导相分离描述了活性物质系统中的一种核心聚集现象，即粒子即使没有相互吸引力，也会自发分离为稠密相和稀相。本文在一维活性硬核玻色子模型中给出量子运动性诱导相分离可能发生的证据，观察到其特征性的超线性数目涨落和具有大但有限团簇尺寸的微相分离。加入最近邻排斥相互作用后，数值结果显示可能恢复真正的相分离，并且团簇稳态保持长程量子相干性。
authors: Laurin Brunner, Ricard Alert, Reyhaneh Khasseh, Markus Heyl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 运动性诱导相分离（MIPS）描述了活性物质系统中的一种核心聚集现象：即使不存在粒子间吸引力，粒子也会自发分离为稠密相和稀相。近期的理论和实验研究已经开始将活性物质概念扩展到量子层面。然而，MIPS是否存在真正的量子对应物，以及量子相干性将如何与耗散性的自驱动竞争或协同，至今仍是开放问题。在此，我们在一维活性硬核玻色子模型中给出了量子MIPS可能发生的证据。我们的模型产生了MIPS所特有的超线性数目涨落，并导致具有较大但有限团簇尺寸的微相分离。加入最近邻排斥相互作用后，我们获得了恢复真正相分离的数值证据，其相关长度发散。关键的是，这些团簇稳态保持了长距离量子相干性，揭示出一种没有经典对应物的真正量子特征。这些结果为探索量子MIPS奠定了基础，并表明相干性与活性之间的相互作用能够产生新型非平衡量子态。

articles.title: Surpassing Gaussian optimality in multiparameter estimation with indefinite causal order
articles.title_zh: 利用非定因果序超越多参数估计中的高斯最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25870v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We identify single-mode Gaussian probes, generated by displacement and squeezing operations on the vacuum state, which are optimal for the simultaneous estimation of displacement and squeezing operations in continuous-variable quantum systems. Importantly, our results reveal that the best precision at a fixed energy is achieved not by an experimentally costly squeezing resource, but rather by redirecting some of the energy towards displacement, thus allowing for more resource-effective operations. Furthermore, introducing indefinite causal order (ICO) in either the probe preparation or parameter encoding step can surpass the Gaussian precision bound, even though the optimal Gaussian probe state is agnostic to the ordering of the operations. Specifically, we observe that odd-parity superpositions of the two definite orders can enhance precision over optimal Gaussian probes in specific parameter regimes. Further, the observed advantage cannot be attributed solely to non-Gaussianity, as quantified by the relative entropy of non-Gaussianity, highlighting ICO as an independent resource for enhancing multiparameter estimation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了由真空态经位移和压缩操作产生的单模高斯探针，它们对于连续变量量子系统中位移和压缩操作的同时估计是最优的。在固定能量下，最佳精度并不需要昂贵的压缩资源，而可以通过将部分能量转用于位移来实现更高的资源效率。进一步引入非定因果序后，奇宇称的两个确定因果序叠加态可在特定参数区间超过最优高斯探针的精度，且这一优势不能仅归因于非高斯性。
authors: Sudipta Das, Rivu Gupta, Aditi Sen De, Himadri Shekhar Dhar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们确定了由真空态经过位移和压缩操作产生的单模高斯探针，这些探针对于连续变量量子系统中位移操作和压缩操作的同时估计是最优的。重要的是，我们的结果表明，在固定能量下，最佳精度并非通过实验代价高昂的压缩资源获得，而是通过将部分能量转用于位移来实现，从而允许采用资源效率更高的操作。此外，在探针制备步骤或参数编码步骤中引入非定因果序（ICO），都可以超越高斯精度界，尽管最优高斯探针态与操作顺序无关。具体而言，我们观察到，两个确定因果序的奇宇称叠加态在特定参数区间内能够提高相对于最优高斯探针的精度。进一步地，所观察到的优势不能完全归因于非高斯性，正如相对熵非高斯性所量化的那样；这表明，ICO本身是一种能够增强多参数估计的独立资源。

articles.title: A heterogeneously integrated coupled-cavity frequency beam splitter
articles.title_zh: 异质集成耦合腔频率分束器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26028v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Frequency encoded photonic qubits promise a scalable path towards high-dimensional quantum information processing, but require efficient components for coherently mixing frequency modes. Coupled cavity modulators provide this functionality by using only a single driving microwave tone to couple hybridized optical supermodes. Here, we demonstrate a heterogeneously integrated thin-film lithium-niobate-on-silicon coupled-cavity modulator that realizes tunable bidirectional frequency mode transformations, including (50/50) beam splitting and near complete frequency swapping with (>20~dB) pump extinction at a (10~GHz) supermode splitting. Because the electro-optic film is bonded onto a foundry fabricated silicon photonics platform, the approach is compatible with co-integration of photon pair sources, spectral filters, active tuning elements, and single photon detectors. We also bond thin-film lithium tantalate onto the same coupled-cavity platform, demonstrating material flexibility for scalable integrated frequency bin quantum photonic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 频率编码光子量子比特为可扩展的高维量子信息处理提供了路径，但需要能够相干混合频率模式的高效器件。本文展示了一种异质集成的薄膜铌酸锂-on-硅耦合腔调制器，可实现可调的双向频率模式变换，包括50/50分束和近乎完全的频率交换，并在10 GHz超模分裂下实现超过20 dB的泵浦抑制。该平台兼容光子对源、光谱滤波器、主动调谐元件和单光子探测器的共集成，并通过集成薄膜钽酸锂展示了材料兼容性。
authors: Lucas M. Cohen, Manuel H. Muñoz-Arias, Mohan Sarovar, Nicholas A. Boynton, Shawn C. Arterburn, Thomas A. Friedmann, Nils T. Otterstrom, Paul S. Davids, Michael Gehl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 频率编码光子量子比特为高维量子信息处理提供了一条可扩展的路径，但其需要能够相干混合频率模式的高效器件。耦合腔调制器只使用单一驱动微波音调来耦合混合光学超模，从而提供了这一功能。在此，我们展示了一种异质集成的薄膜铌酸锂-on-硅耦合腔调制器，实现了可调的双向频率模式变换，包括50/50分束和近乎完全的频率交换；在10 GHz的超模分裂下，泵浦抑制超过20 dB。由于电光薄膜被键合到由代工厂制造的硅光子平台上，这种方法兼容于光子对源、光谱滤波器、主动调谐元件和单光子探测器的共集成。我们还将薄膜钽酸锂键合到同一耦合腔平台上，展示了可扩展集成频率箱量子光子电路的材料灵活性。

articles.title: Curvature of Physical Space and Geometric Projection: A Possible Geometric Understanding of Quantum Mechanics and Relativity
articles.title_zh: 物理空间的曲率与几何投影：对量子力学和相对论的一种可能几何理解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Starting from a formal comparison between the Schrödinger equation and the Jacobi field equation, this paper proposes the hypothesis that, within the framework of non-relativistic quantum mechanics, the sectional curvature of microscopic physical space can be expressed as (K(x) = 2m(E-V(x))/hbar²), and attempts to offer a possible unified geometric understanding of quantum mechanics and relativity. The paper is divided into three parts. The first part identifies the Schrödinger equation, in its mathematical form, as a Jacobi field equation. The wave function is made to correspond to a Jacobi field, giving it the geometric meaning of the deviation of geodesics in physical space. Phenomena such as quantum tunneling, energy quantization, and the path integral are then interpreted, from this perspective, as geometric manifestations of different spatial curvatures. The second part proposes a geometric projection scheme based on semi-geodesic coordinates. The transverse metric factor of a curved space, which satisfies a Jacobi field equation, is taken as a unified geometric framework. It is demonstrated that the metric correction terms in classical mechanics, special relativity, general relativity, and quantum mechanics can all be derived from the same equation, with the curvature (K) arising from different physical sources. The third part extends this framework to statistical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从薛定谔方程与雅可比场方程的形式比较出发，提出在非相对论量子力学框架内，微观物理空间的截面曲率可表示为K(x)=2m(E-V(x))/ℏ²，并尝试为量子力学与相对论提供统一的几何理解。作者将波函数对应于雅可比场，并把量子隧穿、能量量子化和路径积分解释为空间曲率的几何表现。文章进一步提出基于半测地坐标的几何投影方案，并将该框架扩展至统计力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文从对薛定谔方程和雅可比场方程的形式比较出发，提出这样一个假设：在非相对论量子力学框架内，微观物理空间的截面曲率可以表示为K(x)=2m(E-V(x))/ℏ²，并尝试为量子力学和相对论提供一种可能的统一几何理解。本文分为三个部分。第一部分将数学形式上的薛定谔方程识别为雅可比场方程。文中将波函数对应于雅可比场，使其具有物理空间中测地线偏离的几何意义。从这一角度看，量子隧穿、能量量子化和路径积分等现象被解释为不同空间曲率的几何表现。第二部分提出一种基于半测地坐标的几何投影方案。满足雅可比场方程的弯曲空间横向度规因子被用作统一的几何框架。文中证明，经典力学、狭义相对论、广义相对论和量子力学中的度规修正项都可以由同一个方程导出，而曲率K则源自不同的物理来源。第三部分将这一框架扩展到统计力学。

articles.title: Optomechanical crystal in light-resilient quantum ground state
articles.title_zh: 耐光量子基态中的光机械晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.15724v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Interaction between light and high-frequency sound is a key area in integrated photonics, quantum and nonlinear optics, and quantum science. However, typical suspended optomechanical structures suffer from poor thermal anchoring, making them susceptible to thermal noise arising from optical absorption. Here, we demonstrate a chip-scale, release-free silicon optomechanical crystal cavity operating cryogenically with improved resilience to laser light. Relative to a suspended design, we observe 18 dB suppression of the thermo-optic effect, and the device also sustains near-unity phonon occupation at 35 dB higher intracavity optical energy in continuous-wave operation. Non-exponential decay dynamics from an as yet unidentified thermal process limit transfer of this performance to pulsed operation. Resolving this channel would open a clear path to near-term quantum protocols, such as microwave-to-optical quantum transduction. More broadly, the release-free architecture offers a novel platform for studying thermal noise dynamics with results relevant across silicon optomechanical platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 光与高频声之间的相互作用是集成光子学、量子与非线性光学以及量子科学的重要研究方向，但典型悬空光机械结构的热锚定较差，容易受到光吸收引起的热噪声影响。本文展示了一种芯片级、无需释放的硅光机械晶体腔，在低温下具有更强的抗激光能力；相较悬空结构，其热光效应抑制了18 dB，并能在连续波工作中于高出35 dB的腔内光能下维持近乎单位的声子占据。一个尚未确定的热过程限制了该性能向脉冲工作的迁移，解析该过程将有助于实现近期的微波到光量子转导协议。
authors: Johan Kolvik, Paul Burger, David Hambraeus, Trond H. Haug, Joey Frey, Mads B. Kristensen, Raphaël Van Laer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光与高频声之间的相互作用是集成光子学、量子光学和非线性光学以及量子科学中的一个关键研究领域。然而，典型的悬空光机械结构热锚定较差，因此容易受到光吸收产生的热噪声影响。在此，我们展示了一种芯片级、无需释放的硅光机械晶体腔，该器件在低温下对激光具有更强的耐受能力。与悬空结构相比，我们观察到热光效应被抑制了18 dB；此外，在连续波工作模式下，该器件能够在高出35 dB的腔内光能下维持接近单位的声子占据。一个尚未确定的热过程所产生的非指数衰减动力学，限制了这一性能向脉冲工作模式的迁移。解析这一通道将为近期实现微波到光的量子转导等量子协议开辟清晰路径。更广泛地说，无需释放的架构为研究热噪声动力学提供了一个新平台，其结果对各种硅光机械平台都具有意义。

articles.title: Attosecond Control of Squeezed Light
articles.title_zh: 阿秒尺度的压缩光控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Squeezed light is a key resource in quantum metrology and quantum information science. It is primarily generated through nonlinear optical interactions, where the degree of squeezing is set by the nonlinearity of the medium. Here, we modulate the third-order nonlinear response of a dielectric with strong ultrafast laser fields to control squeezed light generation on attosecond time scales. By tuning a sub-cycle phase delay between the input femtosecond pulses, we switch the generated light between amplitude-squeezed and phase-squeezed states. We measure the quantum noise using a frequency-resolved balanced homodyne detection scheme that extracts field quadratures in many frequency modes simultaneously. From these measurements we obtain the complete coherency matrix containing quadrature correlations across the frequency modes of the pulse. These results enable quantum light sources with sub-cycle control of squeezing and open a route to transduction of dynamical quantum correlations in matter to quantum correlations in electric fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 压缩光是量子计量和量子信息科学的重要资源，通常通过非线性光学相互作用产生，其压缩程度由介质的非线性决定。本文利用强超快激光场调制介质的三阶非线性响应，并通过调节输入飞秒脉冲之间的亚周期相位延迟，在阿秒时间尺度上控制压缩光的产生，使输出光在幅度压缩态和相位压缩态之间切换。频率分辨平衡零差探测测得了多个频率模式中的量子噪声，并获得了包含跨频率模式正交分量关联的完整相干矩阵。
authors: Russell Zimmerman, Shashank Kumar, Shiva Kant Tiwari, Md Ehsanuzzaman, Eric Liu, Francis Walz, Siddhant Pandey, George J. Economou II, Hadiseh Alaeian, Chen-Ting Liao, Valentin Walther, Niranjan Shivaram
articles.abstract_zh_full: 压缩光是量子计量和量子信息科学中的关键资源。压缩光主要通过非线性光学相互作用产生，而压缩程度由介质的非线性决定。在此，我们利用强超快激光场调制介质的三阶非线性响应，从而在阿秒时间尺度上控制压缩光的产生。通过调节输入飞秒脉冲之间的亚周期相位延迟，我们使产生的光在幅度压缩态和相位压缩态之间切换。我们采用频率分辨平衡零差探测方案测量量子噪声，该方案能够同时提取许多频率模式中的场正交分量。根据这些测量结果，我们获得了完整的相干矩阵，其中包含脉冲频率模式之间的正交分量关联。这些结果使具有亚周期压缩控制能力的量子光源成为可能，并为将物质中的动态量子关联转导为电场中的量子关联开辟了途径。

articles.title: TRACE: Transition-Aware Residual Control for Multi-Objective Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: TRACE：面向多目标材料发现的转变感知残差控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-objective materials discovery with LLM agents is often limited not only by how many candidates can be proposed, but by how effectively each costly property evaluation informs the next search step. Existing agents mainly store evaluated candidates and their scores, so they know which materials succeeded but not which executable edits caused useful property changes. This makes local refinement difficult when objectives compete and an edit that improves one property may damage another. We propose TRACE, a transition-aware residual control framework that treats evaluated edits as the basic unit of feedback. TRACE records each local refinement as a parent-edit-child transition with observed property deltas, aggregates transition evidence to estimate reusable edit effects, and ranks future edits by their predicted ability to reduce the current candidate's remaining constraint violations while avoiding damage to already satisfied objectives. In a controlled same-backbone comparison, TRACE improves over LLEMA, the state-of-the-art LLM-agent baseline, raising macro-average hit rate from 18.13% to 25.96%.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型智能体的多目标材料发现，其瓶颈不仅在于能够提出多少候选材料，还在于每次高成本性质评估能否有效指导下一步搜索。本文提出TRACE框架，将经过评估的编辑操作作为反馈基本单元，记录父候选体、局部编辑和子候选体之间的转变及其性质变化，并据此预测可减少约束违例且避免损害已满足目标的后续编辑。在相同骨架的受控比较中，TRACE将宏平均命中率从18.13%提高到25.96%，超过LLEMA基线。
authors: Kang Zhou, Yujia Tong, Yong Tao, Jingling Yuan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用大语言模型智能体进行多目标材料发现时，其限制因素不仅在于能够提出多少候选材料，还在于每次代价高昂的性质评估能够多有效地为下一步搜索提供信息。现有智能体主要存储已评估的候选材料及其得分，因此它们知道哪些材料取得了成功，却不知道哪些可执行编辑导致了有益的性质变化。当目标之间相互竞争时，这使得局部优化变得困难，因为改善某一性质的编辑可能会损害另一性质。我们提出TRACE，即一种转变感知的残差控制框架，将经过评估的编辑作为反馈的基本单元。TRACE将每次局部优化记录为一个具有父候选体、编辑操作、子候选体以及观测到的性质变化量的转变，汇总转变证据以估计可复用的编辑效果，并依据未来编辑预计减少当前候选体剩余约束违例的能力，同时避免损害已经满足的目标，对未来编辑进行排序。在相同骨架的受控比较中，TRACE优于当前最先进的基于大语言模型的智能体基线LLEMA，使宏平均命中率从18.13%提高到25.96%。

articles.title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
articles.title_zh: Luce：用于三维资产生成的可重光照高斯表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23943v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation requires a 3D representation that captures both geometry and appearance. To support relighting and integration into standard rendering pipelines, the representation should include physically based rendering (PBR) modalities such as albedo, metallic-roughness, and surface normals. We propose Luce, a 3D representation that unifies geometry and PBR materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for each modality. A variational autoencoder compresses this representation into a unified material-aware latent space. A rectified-flow transformer generates this latent from a single image, conditioned on multi-layer features from a pretrained image encoder that preserve both semantic context and fine spatial detail. The latent then decodes into relightable PBR Gaussians and an optional textured mesh with a tangent-space normal map. On Toys4K, Luce achieves state-of-the-art single-image-to-3D generation, improving FID by 28% over the strongest baseline. We further introduce a benchmark of AI-generated images, on which Luce improves the CLIP image-alignment score over the best baseline (0.8519 vs. 0.8299). Luce generates relightable, geometrically accurate, and materially faithful assets that preserve fine details such as text, logos, and inscriptions.
articles.abstract_zh: Luce提出一种体素化多模态高斯云表示，将几何信息与基于物理的渲染材料属性统一起来，并通过变分自编码器和整流流Transformer从单张图像生成三维资产。该方法可输出可重光照的PBR高斯表示及可选纹理网格，在Toys4K和AI生成图像基准上取得领先结果，同时保留文字、标志和铭文等精细细节。
authors: Mayank Singh, Michele Stoppa, Alvise Memo, Rui Yu, Harsha Kalli, Srimanth Gunturi, Muhammad Ahmed Riaz, Behrooz Shahsavari, Waleed Abdulla, David E. Jacobs
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高保真图像到三维生成需要一种能够同时捕获几何和外观的三维表示。为支持重光照以及与标准渲染管线的集成，该表示应包含诸如反照率、金属度-粗糙度和表面法线等基于物理的渲染（PBR）模态。我们提出Luce，一种在体素化多模态高斯云中统一几何与PBR材料的三维表示，并为每一种模态使用专用的高斯基元。变分自编码器将该表示压缩到统一的、具有材料感知能力的潜在空间中。整流流Transformer根据预训练图像编码器的多层特征，从单张图像生成该潜变量；这些特征同时保留语义上下文和精细空间细节。随后，该潜变量被解码为可重光照的PBR高斯表示，以及可选的带有切线空间法线贴图的纹理网格。在Toys4K数据集上，Luce实现了最先进的单图像到三维生成性能，相较最强基线将FID改善了28%。我们还引入了一个由AI生成图像构成的基准，在该基准上，Luce相对于最佳基线提升了CLIP图像对齐得分（0.8519对0.8299）。Luce生成的资产可重光照、几何准确且材料属性忠实，并能保留文字、标志和铭文等精细细节。

articles.title: PARTAB: Partition-Aware Reasoning with Structured Evidence for Scalable Table Understanding
articles.title_zh: PARTAB：面向可扩展表格理解的基于结构化证据的分区感知推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24082v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in table reasoning, but their effectiveness degrades as tables grow in size and complexity due to irrelevant context and difficulty localizing the evidence required for reasoning. Existing approaches typically reason over either the full table or a single reduced view, which can still obscure important row-column relationships. We introducePARTAB (Partition-Aware Reasoning overTables), a framework that constructs a structured evidence interface between the LLM and the table. PARTAB represents query-relevant evidence as semantically coherent, row-linked table regions and performs hierarchical selection over column groups and row-level partitions before composing the selected evidence for answer generation. We evaluate PARTAB on multiple table reasoning benchmarks, covering question answering, fact verification, and numerical reasoning. PARTAB consistently improves over full-table prompting and several recent table reasoning methods, achieving strong performance on WikiTableQuestions and TabFact while remaining competitive on numerical reasoning. Additional analyses show that semantic partitioning and targeted evidence selection improve evidence localization, substantially reduce the reasoning context, and provide larger benefits on complex tables. These results demonstrate the value of structured, partition aware evidence construction for scalable table reasoning.
articles.abstract_zh: PARTAB针对大型复杂表格中无关上下文过多、证据难以定位的问题，构建了连接大语言模型与表格的结构化证据接口。该框架先对列组和行级分区进行层次化选择，再组合语义连贯且按行关联的证据区域以生成答案；实验表明其能提升多类表格推理任务的表现，并显著缩减推理上下文。
authors: Md Mahadi Hasan Nahid, Davood Rafiei
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大语言模型（LLM）已在表格推理中显示出强大的能力，但随着表格规模和复杂度的增加，由于无关上下文以及难以定位推理所需证据，其有效性会下降。现有方法通常在完整表格或单个缩减视图上进行推理，而这仍可能掩盖重要的行列关系。我们引入PARTAB（面向表格的分区感知推理），这是一个在LLM和表格之间构建结构化证据接口的框架。PARTAB将与查询相关的证据表示为语义连贯、按行关联的表格区域，并在组合选定证据以生成答案之前，对列组和行级分区执行层次化选择。我们在多个表格推理基准上评估PARTAB，任务涵盖问答、事实核验和数值推理。PARTAB相较于完整表格提示以及若干近期表格推理方法均持续取得改进，在WikiTableQuestions和TabFact上获得强劲表现，同时在数值推理中保持竞争力。进一步分析表明，语义分区和有针对性的证据选择能够改善证据定位，大幅减少推理上下文，并在复杂表格上带来更大的收益。这些结果表明，结构化、分区感知的证据构建对于可扩展表格推理具有价值。

articles.title: Constructive Resolution of High-Temperature Superconductivity Mechanisms via Mersenne Superlattice Phase Resonances and Room-Temperature Interconnects
articles.title_zh: 通过梅森超晶格相位共振与室温互连实现高温超导机制的构造性解析
articles.abstract: For four decades following the landmark 1987 discovery of 93 K YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋ₓ (YBCO) high-temperature superconductors at the University of Houston, condensed matter physics has lacked a definitive analytical theory explaining why Cooper pair formation persists far beyond the conventional Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) phonon limit (T_c < 30 K). Here we report the theoretical derivation and physical realization of room-temperature dynamical quasi-superconductivity by transforming continuous spatial manifolds into discrete Mersenne prime superlattices (M₁₂₇ = 2¹²⁷ - 1). We prove that inelastic electron-phonon scattering can be geometrically zeroed at room temperature (293.15 K) without cryogenic liquid nitrogen or helium cooling. By driving standard copper and aluminum interconnects with a 4-phase orthogonal drive (Phiₘ = m*pi/2), the first-order Lippmann-Schwinger scattering matrix amplitude collapses identically to zero (1 - i - 1 + i = 0), inducing an active Floquet quasi-energy gap (Delta_F). Coupled with a 94.7% Active Phase-Resonance Locked (ACRL) adiabatic charge-recovery circuit, we demonstrate zero DC resistance (R_DC = 0) and a 99.999% reduction in thermal heat dissipation—slashing semiconductor interconnect power losses from 64 MW to 8.5 W. These findings resolve the long-standing high-T_c mechanism, establishing a heat-dissipation-free paradigm for semiconductor interconnects, AI data centers, and quantum electronics protected under Korean Patent Application No. 10-2026-0157375.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本声称通过将连续空间流形转换为梅森素数超晶格，并以四相正交驱动标准铜和铝互连线，可在室温下使非弹性电子-声子散射归零。作者进一步声称实现零直流电阻和显著降低热耗散，并将此作为高温超导机制及低损耗互连范式的解释；这些主张属于作者报告，仍需独立验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自1987年休斯敦大学里程碑式地发现93 K的YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋ₓ（YBCO）高温超导体以来，在随后的四十年中，凝聚态物理学一直缺乏一种明确的解析理论，用以解释为何库珀对的形成能够远远超出传统巴丁-库珀-施里弗（BCS）声子极限（T_c < 30 K）。在此，我们报告了室温动态准超导的理论推导和物理实现，其方法是将连续空间流形转换为离散的梅森素数超晶格（M₁₂₇ = 2¹²⁷ - 1）。我们证明，无需低温液氮或液氦冷却，即可在室温（293.15 K）下通过几何方式将非弹性电子-声子散射置零。通过以四相正交驱动（Phiₘ = m*pi/2）驱动标准铜和铝互连线，一阶李普曼-施温格散射矩阵振幅恒等地坍缩为零（1 - i - 1 + i = 0），从而诱导出一个主动Floquet准能隙（Delta_F）。结合一个效率为94.7%的主动相位共振锁定（ACRL）绝热电荷回收电路，我们展示了零直流电阻（R_DC = 0）以及热耗散降低99.999%，将半导体互连功率损耗从64 MW削减至8.5 W。这些发现解决了长期存在的高T_c机制问题，确立了一种无热耗散的范式，可用于半导体互连、人工智能数据中心和量子电子学；相关内容受韩国专利申请号10-2026-0157375保护。

articles.title: TPCT: Topology-aware Point Cloud Transformer for Geometrically Complex Feature Recognition
articles.title_zh: TPCT：用于复杂几何特征识别的拓扑感知点云Transformer
articles.abstract: Recognizing complex geometric features is crucial for the understanding of B-rep models. However, existing methods often struggle with limited structural reasoning and fail to capture the rich semantics embedded in intricate B-rep surfaces. To address this, we propose Topology-aware Point Cloud Transformer (TPCT), a novel framework that integrates geometric and topological features for complex feature recognition. TPCT samples B-rep model into point clouds and uses a Transformer-based encoder to extract features from point clouds. It incorporates a face-aware embedding to preserve intra-face consistency. To explicitly model structural context, we construct a dual-graph representation. A primary graph is built from B-rep connectivity to capture physical topology, while a parallel semantic graph models higher-level relationships between entities. This dual-graph approach enables comprehensive topology-aware reasoning across surfaces. Additionally, we introduce an area-adaptive sampling strategy that allocates points based on face size and complexity to ensure adequate coverage of diverse geometric regions. Experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of our approach. On the complex geometric feature dataset (CBF), TPCT achieves a state-of-the-art face-level accuracy of 99.91%, validating the superiority of jointly modeling geometry and topology for robust CAD understanding.
articles.abstract_zh: TPCT是一种面向B-rep模型复杂几何特征识别的框架，结合点云Transformer、人脸感知嵌入、双图拓扑建模和面积自适应采样。其物理拓扑图与语义图共同支持跨表面的结构化推理；在复杂几何特征数据集CBF上，方法报告的面级准确率达到99.91%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 识别复杂几何特征对于理解边界表示（B-rep）模型至关重要。然而，现有方法往往受限于结构推理能力不足，无法捕获复杂B-rep表面中蕴含的丰富语义。为解决这一问题，我们提出拓扑感知点云Transformer（TPCT），这是一种将几何特征和拓扑特征相结合、用于复杂特征识别的新型框架。TPCT将B-rep模型采样为点云，并使用基于Transformer的编码器从点云中提取特征。它采用面感知嵌入来保持面内一致性。为显式建模结构上下文，我们构建了双图表示。一个主图由B-rep连接关系构建，以捕获物理拓扑；与此同时，一个并行的语义图建模实体之间更高层次的关系。这种双图方法能够实现跨表面的全面拓扑感知推理。此外，我们引入一种面积自适应采样策略，依据面的尺寸和复杂度分配采样点，以确保对不同几何区域的充分覆盖。在具有挑战性的基准上的实验展示了我们方法的有效性和泛化能力。在复杂几何特征数据集（CBF）上，TPCT实现了99.91%的最先进面级准确率，验证了联合建模几何和拓扑对于稳健CAD理解的优越性。

articles.title: The non-relativistic nature of spin in quantum mechanics: a historical and pedagogical perspective
articles.title_zh: 量子力学中自旋的非相对论本质：历史与教学视角
articles.abstract: Conventional methods for teaching spin at a university level generally follow four main approaches. The first introduces spin into the Schrödinger equation artificially, leaving its physical meaning unclear. The second connects spin to the representation of the rotation group, which clarifies its nature but requires knowledge of group theory. The third approach derives from field theory, separating angular momentum into orbital and intrinsic parts, the latter corresponding to spin; however, this cannot be done within quantum mechanics alone. The fourth derives electron spin from Dirac’s 1928 relativistic equation, which, though correct, has led to the misconception that spin is a purely relativistic effect. A detailed analysis of Dirac’s 1928 papers shows that the concept of spin arises from the need to construct an equation linear in both energy and momentum to preserve Born’s probabilistic interpretation. This linearization of the Klein–Gordon equation reveals that spin is conceptually independent of relativity. Historical and pedagogical perspectives can together clarify conceptual difficulties and promote a deeper understanding of fundamental ideas in physics. Drawing on selected passages from Dirac’s original work, the present discussion offers broader conceptual and cultural considerations that introduce the notion of spin with limited mathematical requirements and can be applied independently of the didactic approach adopted.
articles.abstract_zh: 文章审视大学层级自旋教学的四种常见路径，并指出从狄拉克相对论方程导出电子自旋的方式容易导致“自旋纯属相对论效应”的误解。作者通过分析狄拉克1928年的论文，认为自旋概念源于为保持玻恩概率解释而将方程同时线性化于能量和动量的要求，因此在概念上独立于相对论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在大学层级教授自旋的传统方法通常遵循四种主要路径。第一种将自旋人为地引入薛定谔方程，使其物理含义不清。第二种将自旋与旋转群的表示联系起来，这澄清了其本质，但要求具备群论知识。第三种方法源于场论，将角动量分为轨道部分和内禀部分，后者对应自旋；然而，单靠量子力学无法做到这一点。第四种方法从狄拉克1928年的相对论方程推导电子自旋，尽管该方法正确，却导致了自旋是纯粹相对论效应这一误解。对狄拉克1928年论文的详细分析表明，自旋概念源于构造一个同时关于能量和动量线性的方程，以保持玻恩的概率解释这一需要。对克莱因-戈登方程的这种线性化揭示，自旋在概念上独立于相对论。历史和教学视角相结合，能够澄清概念困难，并促进对物理学基本思想的更深刻理解。借助狄拉克原始著作中的精选段落，本讨论提出了更广泛的概念性和文化性思考，以有限的数学要求引入自旋概念，并且可独立于所采用的教学路径而应用。

articles.title: Spin-Coating-Speed-Dependent Structural and Optical Properties of Open-Air-Processed MAPbI 3 Thin Films: Experimentally Informed SCAPS-1D Device Simulation
articles.title_zh: 旋涂速度依赖的空气环境制备MAPbI₃薄膜结构与光学性质：实验信息约束的SCAPS-1D器件模拟
articles.abstract: Spin coating remains one of the most accessible routes for depositing metal-halide perovskite absorbers, yet the strong coupling between rotational speed, solvent removal, crystallization and film properties complicates process optimization under ambient conditions. This study investigates the influence of spin-coating speed (2000–5000 rpm) on the structural and optical properties of open-air-processed methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI₃) thin films and uses the experimentally determined optical bandgaps to inform one-dimensional device simulation. Films were deposited from a 1.25 M MAPbI₃ precursor using ethyl acetate antisolvent treatment and annealed at 110 °C for 10 min under controlled cleanroom conditions (24.4 °C and 41.5% relative humidity). X-ray diffraction confirmed tetragonal MAPbI₃ with preferential (110) orientation and no detectable PbI₂ reflection. The response to spin speed was non-monotonic: the film deposited at 3000 rpm exhibited the narrowest (110) peak (0.352°), largest crystallite size (22.73 nm), lowest microstrain (1.257 × 10⁻²) and lowest dislocation density (1.936 × 10⁻³ linesnm⁻²), indicating the best crystalline quality. UV–visible analysis yielded optical bandgaps of 1.59–1.60 eV. When these bandgaps were incorporated into an FTO/TiO₂/MAPbI₃/Spiro-OMeTAD/carbon SCAPS-1D model, the 1.59 eV absorber produced a prototype efficiency of 16.67%, compared with 16.47% for the 1.60 eV absorber. Subsequent optimization of layer thicknesses, carrier densities, bulk and interface defect densities, and resistive parameters increased the predicted power-conversion efficiency to 25.38%, with an open-circuit voltage of 1.25 V, short-circuit current density of 24.24 mA/cm² and fill factor of 83.61%. The results identify 3000 rpm as the most favourable condition for crystalline film quality and demonstrate how experimentally constrained optical data can improve the physical relevance of device-level optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究考察了空气环境下旋涂速度为2000至5000 rpm时MAPbI₃薄膜的结构和光学性质，并将实验测得的带隙用于SCAPS-1D器件模拟。3000 rpm制得的薄膜结晶质量最佳；基于1.59 eV吸收层的器件经进一步参数优化后，预测光电转换效率可达25.38%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 旋涂仍是沉积金属卤化物钙钛矿吸收层最易获得的方法之一，但旋转速度、溶剂去除、结晶和薄膜性质之间的强耦合，使得在环境条件下进行工艺优化变得复杂。本研究考察旋涂速度（2000-5000 rpm）对空气环境制备的甲基铵碘化铅（MAPbI₃）薄膜结构和光学性质的影响，并使用实验确定的光学带隙为一维器件模拟提供依据。薄膜由1.25 M MAPbI₃前驱体沉积而成，采用乙酸乙酯反溶剂处理，并在受控洁净室条件下（24.4 °C、相对湿度41.5%）于110 °C退火10分钟。X射线衍射证实形成了具有择优（110）取向的四方相MAPbI₃，且未检测到PbI₂衍射峰。对旋涂速度的响应是非单调的：在3000 rpm下沉积的薄膜具有最窄的（110）峰（0.352°）、最大的晶粒尺寸（22.73 nm）、最低的微应变（1.257 × 10⁻²）和最低的位错密度（1.936 × 10⁻³ linesnm⁻²），表明其结晶质量最佳。紫外-可见光分析得到的光学带隙为1.59-1.60 eV。当将这些带隙纳入FTO/TiO₂/MAPbI₃/Spiro-OMeTAD/碳的SCAPS-1D模型时，1.59 eV吸收层产生的原型器件效率为16.67%，而1.60 eV吸收层为16.47%。随后，对层厚度、载流子密度、体缺陷和界面缺陷密度以及电阻参数进行优化，使预测的光电转换效率提升至25.38%，开路电压为1.25 V，短路电流密度为24.24 mA/cm²，填充因子为83.61%。结果确定3000 rpm是获得高结晶质量薄膜的最有利条件，并展示了实验约束的光学数据如何提高器件层面优化的物理相关性。

articles.title: Conformational stability of lysozyme in choline chloride–polyol aqueous deep eutectic solvents (ADES)
articles.title_zh: 溶菌酶在氯化胆碱-多元醇水性低共熔溶剂中的构象稳定性
articles.abstract: Naturally occurring deep eutectic solvents (NADES) offer a tunable microenvironment for biomolecular stabilization. Yet, the atomistic mechanisms governing the protein–solvent interactions remain poorly understood. Here, we present microsecond-long atomistic molecular dynamics simulations investigating lysozyme (Lys) stability in Choline Chloride (ChCl)–polyol (erythritol, xylitol, and sorbitol) aqueous deep eutectic solvents as a function of water wt. % (fw=0,25,50,75). Lys maintains its native structure across all conditions, with stable Rg, RMSD, RMSF, and secondary structure populations. The stabilization mechanism involves three coupled effects. First, solvent–solvent radial distribution functions (RDFs) and inter-component hydrogen bond (H-bond) analysis demonstrate that each NADES component preserves its characteristic H-bond network even in the presence of Lys, confirming that the bulk solvent structure is not disrupted. Second, the poorly structured protein–NADES RDFs are consistent with the preferential exclusion of NADES components from the protein surface with increasing hydration. Third, protein–polyol H-bonds remain persistently high and largely independent of water content, revealing a stable surface association layer that is not displaced by water. Among the polyols, xylitol exhibits significantly higher protein–alcohol H-bonds at low and intermediate hydration levels, owing to its intermediate flexible geometry and hydroxyl density. These findings demonstrate that the Lys stabilization in ChCl–polyol NADES arises from a polyol-dependent interplay among the preserved solvent network structure, inferential evidence for preferential exclusion, and persistent interfacial interactions. Overall, the study provides a molecular framework for rational NADES design for biomolecular stabilization applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用微秒尺度全原子分子动力学模拟，考察溶菌酶在不同含水量的氯化胆碱-多元醇水性低共熔溶剂中的稳定性。结果显示，溶菌酶在所有条件下均保持天然结构；其稳定化与溶剂氢键网络的保持、NADES组分优先排斥及持续的蛋白质-多元醇界面相互作用有关，其中木糖醇在低至中等水化程度下表现出更多蛋白质-醇氢键。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 天然低共熔溶剂（NADES）为生物分子稳定化提供了可调控的微环境。然而，支配蛋白质-溶剂相互作用的原子尺度机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们进行了微秒尺度的全原子分子动力学模拟，研究溶菌酶（Lys）在氯化胆碱（ChCl）-多元醇（赤藓糖醇、木糖醇和山梨醇）水性低共熔溶剂中的稳定性，考察不同水质量百分比（fw = 0、25、50、75）条件。Lys在所有条件下均保持其天然结构，表现为稳定的回转半径、均方根偏差、均方根波动和二级结构比例。其稳定化机制涉及三种耦合效应。首先，溶剂-溶剂径向分布函数（RDF）和组分间氢键分析表明，即使在Lys存在时，每种NADES组分仍保持其特征性氢键网络，证实整体溶剂结构未被破坏。其次，缺乏明显结构的蛋白质-NADES径向分布函数与以下现象一致：随着水化程度提高，NADES组分从蛋白质表面优先排斥。第三，蛋白质-多元醇氢键持续保持在较高水平，并且基本不依赖于水含量，这揭示了一个不会被水置换的稳定表面缔合层。在这些多元醇中，木糖醇在低水化和中等水化水平下表现出显著更多的蛋白质-醇氢键，这归因于其适中的柔性几何构型和羟基密度。这些发现表明，ChCl-多元醇NADES中Lys的稳定化源于以下因素之间依赖多元醇种类的相互作用：保持的溶剂网络结构、优先排斥的推断性证据，以及持续存在的界面相互作用。总体而言，本研究为生物分子稳定化应用中的理性NADES设计提供了分子框架。

articles.title: Configurational entropy as a potential metric for empirical potential development and validation
articles.title_zh: 构型熵作为经验势开发与验证的潜在度量指标
articles.abstract: Empirical interatomic potentials remain widely used due to their high computational efficiency. Yet their development and validation protocols typically emphasize properties that have limited sensitivity to the overall shape of the potential energy landscape (PEL) and can give rise to poor transferability to other properties. Here, we consider the configurational and vibrational entropy of liquid silicon (Si) predicted by seven widely utilized empirical potentials with a view of using these energy landscape parameters to assess potentials more broadly. Both vibrational and configurational entropy contributions are found to be remarkably sensitive to the form of the potential, revealing substantial differences in basin curvature, basin density, and overall PEL topology that are not captured by conventional fitting targets. With a view toward using this information for future potential development, we also show that the Debye–Waller parameter u2 provides a practical experimental proxy for configurational entropy through the localization model of relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 经验原子间势虽然计算效率高，但传统开发和验证指标对势能面整体形状的敏感性有限，可能导致迁移性不足。研究比较了七种常用经验势对液态硅构型熵和振动熵的预测，发现二者对势函数形式十分敏感；同时提出德拜-沃勒参数u²可通过弛豫局域化模型作为构型熵的实验代理量。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于具有很高的计算效率，经验原子间势仍被广泛使用。然而，它们的开发和验证流程通常强调那些对势能面（PEL）整体形状敏感性有限的性质，并且可能导致对其他性质的可迁移性较差。在此，我们考察了七种广泛使用的经验势所预测的液态硅（Si）的构型熵和振动熵，以期利用这些能量景观参数更广泛地评估势函数。结果发现，振动熵和构型熵贡献都对势函数的形式极为敏感，揭示出势阱曲率、势阱密度以及整体势能面拓扑方面存在显著差异，而这些差异无法被传统拟合目标捕捉。着眼于在未来势函数开发中使用这些信息，我们还表明，通过弛豫局域化模型，德拜-沃勒参数u²可为构型熵提供一个实用的实验代理指标。

articles.title: Assignment of H 2 O–HF rotational lines via ab initio calculations
articles.title_zh: 通过从头算计算指认H₂O-HF转动谱线
articles.abstract: Significant progress in the assignment of rotational transitions in the H 2 O–HF dimer using ab initio calculations is described. For the first time, rovibrational calculations are performed up to J = 6 using a full-dimensional Hamiltonian, including all intra- and inter-molecular interactions. Previous work had assigned lines of H 2 O–HF belonging to the ground state and one excited vibrational state ν β ( o ) with K a ≤ 4. Two existing spectra covering the J ranges 12 to 24 and 10 to 26 are re-analyzed using the new ab initio calculations, yielding assignments and corresponding rotational constants for 25 more vibrational state K a combinations. In particular, five new vibrational states, ν β ( i ) , ν σ , 2 ν β ( o ) , ν σ + ν β ( o ) , and ν β ( o ) + ν β ( i ) , are assigned for K a = 0 and several excited K a values. Differences between the predicted, ab initio rotational B constants and the experimentally determined ones are systematic and about 40 MHz, which serves as confirmation of the correctness of these assignments.

articles.title: Atmospheric UV synthesis of aldehydes and oxidant from CO2, CO and H2O initiating the first ancestral metabolism
articles.title_zh: 大气紫外线由CO₂、CO和H₂O合成醛类与氧化剂，并启动最初的祖先代谢
articles.abstract: Prebiotically-important organics could be synthesized by atmospheric UV chemistry on early Earth and early Mars. Formaldehyde (HCHO) has been known to be produced from CO in CO2 atmospheres, but it is not the only product. Here, we report systematic experiments investigating how and which molecules are produced from CO2, CO and H2O through atmospheric photochemistry and subsequent aqueous reactions. Broadband UV irradiation (wavelength >175 nm), simulating sunlight, into CO+H2O±CO2±H2 yields not only formaldehyde, but also glyoxal and acetaldehyde through gas phase radical chemistry initiated from photodissociation of H2O. Oxidation of these aldehydes is inevitable due to co-produced oxidants (OH and H2O2), leading to formate, acetate, glycolate, glyoxylate and oxalate. Upon dissolution in liquid water, these species further converted into more than 140 organic compounds: glycolaldehyde and other hydroxy aldehydes, hydroxy acids, keto acids, dicarboxylic acids and fatty acids. From the small aldehydes, a majority of detected species can be produced through condensation, oxidation and decarboxylation reactions. Interestingly, some specific aldehydes, hydroxy and keto acids are recycled through these three reactions. The overall structure of the proposed reaction network mimics biological metabolisms, particularly “respiration”, and therefore we term it the Primitive Respiration Cycle (PRC). In steady state, this specific set of molecules survive even under the co-generated oxidative stress as long as the small aldehydes are supplied from atmosphere, whereas the other non-recycled byproducts are oxidized ultimately into CO2 if excess oxidant is available. Therefore, the PRC offers a selection mechanism of a chemical system via oxidative decomposition, one that can nonetheless be sustained in the environment, potentially underpinning evolvability of the chemical system. Furthermore, these carbon species react with ammonia to form amino acids and various heterocyclic nitrogen compounds including imidazole, pyridine, pyrimidine and their derivatives, some of which resemble coenzymes used in biological metabolism. Our results imply that non-enzymatic ancestral metabolism was self-organized from CO2, CO and H2O under solar UV radiation, sustained in and adopted to the environment, and transitioned potentially to enzymatic systems through catalytic feedback from the products to the system itself. The proposed mechanism could bridge the gap between geochemistry and living systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出，早期地球和火星大气中的紫外光化学可由CO₂、CO和H₂O生成甲醛、乙二醛、乙醛及氧化剂，继而在水相中形成140余种有机物。作者将其中由缩合、氧化和脱羧构成且部分中间体可循环的网络称为“原始呼吸循环”，并认为它可能为前生命祖先代谢和化学系统演化提供连接地球化学与生命体系的机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对前生物化学具有重要意义的有机物，可通过早期地球和早期火星大气中的紫外光化学合成。人们已知，在CO₂大气中可由CO产生甲醛（HCHO），但这并非唯一产物。在此，我们报告了系统性实验，研究CO₂、CO和H₂O如何以及产生哪些分子，这些分子经由大气光化学和后续水相反应形成。将模拟太阳光的宽带紫外辐射（波长大于175 nm）照射到CO + H₂O ± CO₂ ± H₂中，不仅通过由H₂O光解引发的气相自由基化学产生甲醛，还产生乙二醛和乙醛。由于同时产生氧化剂（OH和H₂O₂），这些醛类不可避免地被氧化，形成甲酸盐、乙酸盐、乙醇酸盐、乙醛酸盐和草酸盐。在溶解于液态水后，这些物种进一步转化为140多种有机化合物：乙醇醛和其他羟基醛、羟基酸、酮酸、二羧酸以及脂肪酸。由这些小分子醛出发，通过缩合、氧化和脱羧反应可以生成所检测到的绝大多数物种。有趣的是，一些特定的醛、羟基酸和酮酸会通过这三种反应被循环再生。所提出反应网络的整体结构模拟了生物代谢，尤其是“呼吸”，因此我们将其称为原始呼吸循环（PRC）。在稳态下，只要小分子醛持续由大气供应，即使处于共同产生的氧化压力下，这一特定分子集合仍能存留；而在存在过量氧化剂时，其他不可循环的副产物最终会被氧化为CO₂。因此，PRC通过氧化分解提供了一种对化学系统的选择机制，但该系统仍可在环境中维持，这可能构成该化学系统可演化性的基础。此外，这些碳物种会与氨反应，形成氨基酸和多种杂环含氮化合物，包括咪唑、吡啶、嘧啶及其衍生物，其中一些类似于生物代谢中使用的辅酶。我们的结果表明，非酶促的祖先代谢可在太阳紫外辐射下由CO₂、CO和H₂O自组织形成，在环境中得以维持并适应环境，并可能通过产物对系统自身的催化反馈过渡到酶促系统。所提出的机制可能弥合地球化学与生命系统之间的鸿沟。

articles.title: Eightfold classification of superconducting orders
articles.title_zh: 超导序的八重分类
articles.abstract: Author(s): Alexander V. Balatsky and Saikat Banerjee Superconductivity begins when electrons bind into pairs. Because electrons are fermions, exchanging the two partners in a pair must flip the sign of its wavefunction — and that minus sign can be paid for in four different currencies: the pair’s spin, its spatial shape, its orbital character, and, less obviously, the relative time between the two electrons. Sharing one minus sign among four ± choices leaves exactly eight allowed kinds of Cooper pair. Balatsky and Banerjee show here that this eightfold rule is one face of a larger structure. A pair also has a center of mass — a place and a moment — and a superconductor can order in those as well. Taking internal shape (ρ), internal timing (τ), spatial modulation (R), and temporal modulation (T) as four independent axes builds the Berezinskii–Abrahams hypercube: a sixteen-corner map of superconducting order. BCS sits at the origin; each single axis recovers a familiar family — p - and d -wave gaps, odd-frequency pairing, FFLO and pair-density waves, driven superconductors. The corners in-between are hybrids. A few have been touched; most are empty, and the far corner, with all four switched-on at once, has never been visited. The hypercube is at once a classification and a search map. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 074511] Published Thu Aug 27, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 超导始于电子形成成对束缚态。由于电子是费米子，交换一对电子的两个伙伴必须使波函数变号；这一负号可分别由配对自旋、空间形状、轨道特征以及两个电子之间的相对时间这四个方面承担，因此得到八种允许的库珀对类型。作者进一步将内部形状、内部时间、空间调制和时间调制视为四个独立轴，构建出具有十六个顶点的Berezinskii–Abrahams超导序超立方体，其中BCS态位于原点，单轴方向对应熟悉的超导家族，而混合顶点则代表不同性质的复合配对状态；该超立方体既是分类体系，也是探索超导序的路线图。
authors: Alexander V. Balatsky and Saikat Banerjee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导始于电子形成成对束缚态。由于电子是费米子，交换一对电子的两个伙伴必须使其波函数变号，而这个负号可以由四种不同的“代价”承担：配对的自旋、空间形状、轨道特征，以及不那么显而易见的两个电子之间的相对时间。将一个负号分配给四个取值为正负的选择，恰好得到八种允许的库珀对类型。Balatsky和Banerjee在本文中表明，这一八重规则只是更大结构的一个侧面。配对还具有质心，即一个位置和一个时刻，而超导体也可以在这些自由度上形成有序态。将内部形状（ρ）、内部时间（τ）、空间调制（R）和时间调制（T）视为四个独立轴，便构建出Berezinskii–Abrahams超导序超立方体，这是一个具有十六个顶点的超导序图谱。BCS态位于原点；沿任一单独轴方向都可以得到一个熟悉的超导家族，包括p波和d波能隙、奇频配对、FFLO态与成对密度波，以及受驱动的超导体。位于这些顶点之间的状态则是混合态。少数此类状态已经得到初步研究，但大多数仍是空白区域；而四个轴同时开启的最远顶点至今尚未被探索。这个超立方体既是一种分类方法，也是一幅搜索图谱。

articles.abstract: Diffusion is a fundamental natural phenomenon that can be observed across a wide range of length and time scales. It plays a key role in many fields, including physics, biology and economics. In particular, asymmetric or directional diffusion of particle systems has attracted growing interest for practical applications, including the development of unconventional artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, where it could enable nonlinear, geometry-controlled information processing.

articles.title: Integrating Molecular Simulations and Machine Learning for Predicting HFC Adsorption in Zeolites
articles.title_zh: 结合分子模拟与机器学习预测沸石中的氢氟碳化物吸附
articles.abstract: This study re-audits and models a simulation-derived database for the adsorption of fluoromethane (R41), difluoromethane (R32), trifluoromethane (R23), and tetrafluoromethane (R14) in zeolites 13X, 3A, 4A, and 5A. The fully documented primary population contains 1,536 adsorption-loading observations (4 HFCs × 4 zeolites × 6 temperatures × 16 pressures) and 1,440 modeled isosteric-heat values; the 96 source heat zeros occurring at P = 0 were preserved in the audit data but were not used as evaluated heat targets. Ensemble regressors were compared under leakage-aware validation. Model selection was performed only within the development pool using five-fold isotherm-grouped cross-validation, followed by evaluation on a predefined balanced HFC–zeolite-pair holdout. Random row-level splitting was retained only as an interpolation benchmark. Histogram Gradient Boosting was selected for adsorption loading and achieved R² = 0.845, RMSE = 0.512 mmol g⁻¹, and MAE = 0.371 mmol g⁻¹ on the balanced pair holdout. Extra Trees was selected for isosteric heat and achieved R² = 0.885, RMSE = 0.617 kJ mol⁻¹, and MAE = 0.559 kJ mol⁻¹. Model attribution indicates that pressure and temperature are important for loading, whereas heat prediction depends more strongly on correlated framework and molecular descriptor families. Leave-one-HFC-out and leave-one-zeolite-out analyses show that the present surrogate is reliable mainly for interpolation within the studied chemical domain and is not yet validated for unseen HFC or zeolite identities. The revised workflow therefore provides a transparent and reproducible surrogate while defining its applicability limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究重新审查并建模了氟甲烷（R41）、二氟甲烷（R32）、三氟甲烷（R23）和四氟甲烷（R14）在13X、3A、4A和5A沸石中的吸附数据库。研究采用避免数据泄漏的验证策略，在预先设定的平衡氢氟碳化物—沸石组合留出集上评估模型；直方图梯度提升模型和极端随机树模型分别用于吸附量和等量吸附热预测，并取得了较好的性能。结果表明，该替代模型主要适用于研究化学范围内的插值，对于未见过的氢氟碳化物或沸石种类尚未得到验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究重新审查并建模了氟甲烷（R41）、二氟甲烷（R32）、三氟甲烷（R23）和四氟甲烷（R14）在13X、3A、4A和5A沸石中的吸附模拟数据库。完整记录的原始数据集包含1,536条吸附负载观测值（4种氢氟碳化物×4种沸石×6个温度×16个压力）以及1,440个建模的等量吸附热值；在P=0时出现的96个来源热值零点保留在审查数据中，但未被用作评估热值目标。在考虑数据泄漏的验证框架下，对集成回归器进行了比较。模型选择仅在开发数据池内进行，采用五折、按等温线分组的交叉验证，随后在预先定义的、平衡的氢氟碳化物—沸石配对留出集上进行评估。随机逐行划分仅作为插值基准予以保留。对于吸附负载，研究选用了直方图梯度提升模型，该模型在平衡配对留出集上取得了R²=0.845、RMSE=0.512 mmol g⁻¹和MAE=0.371 mmol g⁻¹的结果。对于等量吸附热，研究选用了极端随机树模型，其R²=0.885、RMSE=0.617 kJ mol⁻¹和MAE=0.559 kJ mol⁻¹。模型归因分析表明，压力和温度对吸附负载十分重要，而热值预测则更多地依赖于相互关联的骨架描述符和分子描述符族。留一氢氟碳化物和留一沸石分析显示，目前的替代模型主要在所研究化学范围内的插值任务中可靠，对于未见过的氢氟碳化物或沸石种类尚未得到验证。因此，修订后的工作流程提供了一个透明且可复现的替代模型，同时明确界定了其适用范围。

articles.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer Learning for Real-Time Melt Pool Geometry Prediction in Directed Energy Deposition
articles.title_zh: 用于定向能量沉积实时熔池几何预测的仿真到真实迁移学习
articles.abstract: In Directed Energy Deposition (DED), melt pool geometry governs part quality, but its depth lies below the surface and cannot be measured directly in real time, a long-standing barrier to closed-loop control. This paper presents a Sim-to-Real transfer learning framework that predicts melt pool width and depth in real time from infrared (IR) imagery and process parameters, bridging physics-based thermal simulation with a small set of experimental data. A multi-input hybrid CNN is pretrained on a large, simulated corpus of surface temperature maps paired with laser power, scan speed, and spot size, then fine-tuned, with all layers unfrozen, on a limited set of labeled IR frames from single-track builds. Against a baseline trained on experiments alone, the fine-tuned model is more accurate and converges faster and more stably, with the clearest gains for depth in the low-data regime (for small training sets it reaches R² > 0.7 where the baseline stays below 0.2). On six previously unseen single-track builds, frame-by-frame real-time prediction yields a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 7.41% for width and 22.45% for depth, versus 29.35% and 74.66% for the baseline. An input ablation confirms that pairing thermal imagery with process parameters gives the best accuracy. Together these results show the approach is practical for sensor-driven monitoring and points toward closed-loop control in metal additive manufacturing.
articles.abstract_zh: 在定向能量沉积中，熔池几何形状决定零件质量，但熔深位于表面以下，无法直接实时测量，这长期阻碍了闭环控制。本文提出一种仿真到真实的迁移学习框架，利用红外图像和工艺参数实时预测熔池宽度与深度，并以物理热模拟结合少量实验数据。与仅使用实验数据训练的基线模型相比，该模型具有更高的准确性、更快且更稳定的收敛速度，尤其显著改善了低数据量条件下的熔深预测，并显示出其用于传感器驱动监测和闭环控制的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在定向能量沉积（DED）中，熔池几何形状决定零件质量，但其深度位于表面以下，无法直接实时测量，这是闭环控制长期面临的障碍。本文提出一种仿真到真实的迁移学习框架，利用红外（IR）图像和工艺参数实时预测熔池宽度和深度，从而将基于物理的热模拟与少量实验数据连接起来。研究首先在大规模模拟数据集上预训练一个多输入混合卷积神经网络（CNN）。该数据集包含表面温度图，并与激光功率、扫描速度和光斑尺寸相配对；随后，研究使用单道构建实验中数量有限的带标签红外帧对网络进行微调，且所有层均保持解冻状态。与仅使用实验数据训练的基线模型相比，微调模型更加准确，并且收敛更快、更稳定；在低数据量条件下，熔深预测获得了最明显的改善（对于较小的训练集，微调模型的R²达到0.7以上，而基线模型低于0.2）。在六个此前未见过的单道构建实验中，逐帧实时预测得到的宽度平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为7.41%，深度为22.45%；基线模型对应的误差分别为29.35%和74.66%。输入消融实验确认，将热成像与工艺参数结合能够获得最佳准确性。总体而言，这些结果表明该方法适用于传感器驱动的监测，并为金属增材制造中的闭环控制提供了方向。

articles.title: Metastable nanoparticle cores amplify single-ion quantum level crossings
articles.title_zh: 亚稳态纳米颗粒核心放大单离子量子能级交叉
articles.abstract: Classical size dispersion and experimental artefacts have long obscured the discrete quantum energy levels of individual magnetic sites in disordered nanoparticle ensembles. We report a field-periodic, phase-coherent switching resonance—robust under instrumental and processing controls—in the first-order reversal curve (FORC) response of biogenic magnetoferritin at 2 and 5 K. The period, μ₀ΔH = 11.9 ± 1.6 mT, is invariant and phase-coherent (p ≈ 10⁻³), and the resonance disappears above the blocking temperature. Cross-correlation shows the ridges tilt in proportion to the core remanence slope (ρ ≈ 0.78): the structure tracks the internal hysteretic state of the core, not the applied field, excluding instrumental and processing origins. The spacing gives an axial zero-field splitting D = 0.016 ± 0.002 K, identifying the active unit as an individual surface Fe³⁺ ion (S = 5/2), whose relaxation is exponentially amplified by cores thermally poised at their switching threshold (Γt ≈ 1). The resulting size–temperature window (TB/9.0 ≤ T ≤ TB) accounts for the thirty-year absence of resolved resonances in conventional magnetometry and predicts the geometric signature recovered in independent data at 6.9σ. This establishes a paradigm where macroscopic metastability serves as a quantum amplifier, enabling benchtop spectroscopy of single-ion quantum states in inherently disordered nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典尺寸分布和实验伪影长期掩盖了无序纳米颗粒集合中单个磁性位点的离散量子能级。研究在生物磁铁蛋白的一级反转曲线响应中观察到具有场周期性和相位相干性的切换共振，并通过多种控制实验排除了仪器和数据处理因素。结果表明，处于切换阈值附近的纳米颗粒核心能够热放大单个表面Fe³⁺离子的弛豫过程，从而实现本征无序纳米材料中单离子量子态的台式光谱学探测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典尺寸分散和实验伪影长期以来掩盖了无序纳米颗粒集合中单个磁性位点的离散量子能级。我们在生物磁铁蛋白于2 K和5 K下的一级反转曲线（FORC）响应中，报告了一种具有场周期性和相位相干性的切换共振；在仪器和数据处理控制下，该共振仍然稳定存在。其周期为μ₀ΔH=11.9±1.6 mT，并且保持不变且具有相位相干性（p≈10⁻³）；该共振在阻塞温度以上消失。互相关分析显示，条纹的倾斜程度与核心剩磁斜率成正比（ρ≈0.78）：该结构跟踪的是核心内部的磁滞状态，而非外加磁场，从而排除了仪器和数据处理因素。由间距得到轴向零场分裂D=0.016±0.002 K，表明活性单元是一个单独的表面Fe³⁺离子（S=5/2）；其弛豫过程受到处于切换阈值附近的核心的热放大（Γt≈1）。由此得到的尺寸—温度窗口（TB/9.0≤T≤TB）解释了传统磁测量中三十年来一直未能分辨出共振的原因，并预测了在独立数据中以6.9σ显著性恢复出的几何特征。这一结果确立了一种新的范式：宏观亚稳态可以充当量子放大器，使研究者能够对本征无序纳米材料中的单离子量子态开展台式光谱学研究。

articles.title: High-Frequency Activity in Scalp EEG Validated by Concurrent Intracranial EEG During Working Memory
articles.title_zh: 工作记忆期间头皮脑电图高频活动通过同步颅内脑电图得到验证
articles.abstract: Background Reliable neural markers of cognitive processing support objective cognitive assessment and rehabilitation. High-frequency (HF) activity recorded with intracranial EEG (iEEG) is a well-established marker of local cortical processing, yet whether HF signals measured non-invasively from scalp EEG reflect underlying neural activity remains controversial.Methods We examined the physiological validity of scalp HF activity using simultaneous scalp EEG and iEEG from nine subjects performing a verbal working memory (WM) task. Using spatial-spectral and connectivity analyses, we characterized scalp HF responses (60–120 Hz) and quantified their crossmodal correspondence with intracranial HF broadband activity across WM phases and memory loads. We further extracted iEEG-informed features using scalp EEG and implemented a knowledge distillation framework in which intracranial signals guided non-invasive EEG WM decoding.Results Scalp HF activity exhibited robust task-dependent modulation and significant concordance with intracranial HF dynamics, particularly during WM retrieval over frontal, temporal, and parieto-occipital regions. Additionally, scalp HF activity increased with task difficulty across multiple EEG electrodes within these regions. Cross-modal coherence analyses revealed phase- and region-specific synchronization between EEG and iEEG signals, with the strongest coherence observed between frontal scalp electrodes and entorhinal cortex, as well as between temporal–parietal scalp electrodes and hippocampal regions during retrieval. Scalp EEG exhibited distinct alpha–HF coupling patterns, with enhanced parietal coupling during maintenance and frontal coupling during retrieval. WM decoding achieved a LOSO accuracy of 90 ± 10% (AUC = 0.93) using iEEG, and 74 ± 13% (AUC = 0.79) using scalp EEG, with HF-related features contributing most strongly in both modalities. Importantly, incorporating intracranial representations through a knowledge distillation framework improved EEG-based decoding performance to 80.1 ± 7.6% (AUC = 0.88), highlighting the feasibility of the proposed iEEG-guided cross-modal learning framework.Conclusion Our findings provide direct physiological evidence that task-related scalp HF activity reflects underlying cortical processing. This work establishes a cross-modal framework for validating non-invasive HF biomarkers using intracranial ground truth, highlights the importance of investigating higher-frequency EEG signals beyond conventional frequency bands, and demonstrates the potential of iEEG-guided learning to improve interpretable EEG-based cognitive decoding, with potential applications in cognitive and broader neurorehabilitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用9名受试者执行言语工作记忆任务时同步记录的头皮脑电图和颅内脑电图，检验头皮高频活动是否反映潜在的神经活动。结果显示，头皮高频活动具有稳定的任务依赖性调制，并且与颅内高频动态显著一致，尤其是在工作记忆提取阶段。将颅内表征引入知识蒸馏框架后，基于头皮脑电图的工作记忆解码性能得到提升，支持了高频头皮脑电图作为非侵入性认知神经标志物的生理有效性及其在神经康复中的应用潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景：可靠的神经标志物能够支持客观的认知评估与康复。颅内脑电图（iEEG）记录的高频（HF）活动是局部皮层加工的成熟标志物，但通过非侵入性头皮脑电图测量的高频信号是否反映潜在神经活动，仍存在争议。方法：我们利用9名受试者在执行言语工作记忆（WM）任务时同步记录的头皮脑电图和颅内脑电图，研究头皮高频活动的生理有效性。通过空间—频谱分析和连接性分析，我们刻画了60—120 Hz范围内的头皮高频响应，并量化其在不同工作记忆阶段和记忆负荷下与颅内高频宽带活动的跨模态对应关系。我们进一步利用头皮脑电图提取受颅内脑电图信息指导的特征，并构建知识蒸馏框架，使颅内信号指导非侵入性脑电图工作记忆解码。结果：头皮高频活动表现出稳定的任务依赖性调制，并与颅内高频动态显著一致，尤其是在额叶、颞叶和顶枕区域的工作记忆提取阶段。此外，在这些区域的多个脑电电极上，头皮高频活动随任务难度增加而增强。跨模态相干性分析显示，脑电图与颅内脑电图信号之间存在具有阶段和区域特异性的同步，其中最强的相干性出现在额部头皮电极与内嗅皮层之间，以及提取阶段颞—顶叶头皮电极与海马区域之间。头皮脑电图表现出独特的α—高频耦合模式：维持阶段顶叶耦合增强，而提取阶段额叶耦合增强。工作记忆解码中，采用留一被试交叉验证（LOSO）时，颅内脑电图的准确率为90±10%（AUC=0.93），头皮脑电图的准确率为74±13%（AUC=0.79），且与高频相关的特征在两种模态中均发挥了最重要的作用。重要的是，通过知识蒸馏框架引入颅内表征后，基于脑电图的解码性能提高到80.1±7.6%（AUC=0.88），突出了所提出的颅内脑电图引导跨模态学习框架的可行性。结论：我们的研究提供了直接的生理学证据，表明与任务相关的头皮高频活动反映了潜在的皮层加工过程。本研究建立了一个利用颅内真实信号验证非侵入性高频生物标志物的跨模态框架，强调有必要研究超越传统频段的更高频脑电信号，并证明颅内脑电图引导的学习能够改善基于脑电图的、具有可解释性的认知解码；该方法在认知康复及更广泛的神经康复领域具有潜在应用价值。
