authors: Martin Hájek (Institute of Physical Engineering, Brno University of Technology), Ján Rusz (Department of Physics and Astronomy, Uppsala University)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在透射电子显微镜中，电子主要通过声子激发发生非弹性散射，这一过程称为热漫散射。为了捕捉非弹性散射对弹性散射分量的影响，电子传播建模中必须包含吸收效应，以描述电子束弹性通道的逐步耗尽。对这种吸收进行建模存在若干方法。本文将广泛使用的复吸收势方法与更为复杂的冻结声子模型进行了比较，后者基于相关原子运动以及原子运动的爱因斯坦模型。

articles.title: Visualizing flat-band spatial renormalization in rhombohedral graphene superlattices
articles.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯超晶格中平带空间重整化的可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rhombohedral graphene/hBN moiré superlattices exhibit flat-band-driven emergent phases, including superconductivity and the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect (FQAHE), yet the microscopic role of the moiré potential remains unclear. Here, using scanning tunneling microscopy, we visualize moiré-modulated spatial renormalization of flat bands in rhombohedral pentalayer and tetralayer graphene/hBN superlattices. We observe spatially hierarchical filling, manifested as periodic energy shifts of the flat bands at the moiré scale, leading to spatial reshaping of correlated states in the interacting regime. Remarkably, this modulation vanishes below a ~10 nm moiré period--the same threshold below which the FQAHE is absent. Theoretical modeling attributes this mechanism to atomic-corrugation-induced charge redistribution. Our work provides real-space visualization of moiré-engineered flat-band reconstruction, resolving a key link between moiré periodic potential and emergent topological order.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱面体石墨烯/hBN 莫尔超晶格可呈现超导和分数量子反常霍尔效应等平带驱动相，但莫尔势的微观作用尚不明确。本文利用扫描隧道显微镜观察到五层和四层菱面体石墨烯/hBN 超晶格中平带受莫尔调制的空间重整化与分层填充。当莫尔周期小于约 10 nm 时，该调制消失，并与分数量子反常霍尔效应消失的阈值一致。
authors: Peng-Cheng Pan, Shihao Zhang, Yang Zhang, Ji Huang, Ling-Hui Tong, Chen-Chen Xu, Yuan Tian, Li Zhang, Lijie Zhang, Yuanyuan Hu, Wen-Xiao Wang, Zhihui Qin, Long-Jing Yin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 菱面体石墨烯/hBN 莫尔超晶格展现出由平带驱动的涌现相，包括超导和分数量子反常霍尔效应（FQAHE），但莫尔势的微观作用仍不清楚。本文利用扫描隧道显微镜，可视化了菱面体五层和四层石墨烯/hBN 超晶格中由莫尔调制的平带空间重整化。我们观察到空间上的分层填充，其表现为在莫尔尺度上平带能量的周期性移动，从而在相互作用区域中导致关联态的空间重塑。值得注意的是，当莫尔周期小于约 10 nm 时，这种调制消失，而这恰好也是分数量子反常霍尔效应缺失的阈值。理论建模将该机制归因于原子起伏诱导的电荷重新分布。我们的工作提供了莫尔工程平带重构的实空间可视化，阐明了莫尔周期势与涌现拓扑序之间一个关键环节。

articles.title: Hierarchical Quantum Transport from Coupled Topological Domain-Wall States in SSH Chains
articles.title_zh: SSH 链中耦合拓扑畴壁态引发的层级量子输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the transport properties of Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chains containing multiple topological domain walls and show that their interaction generates a hierarchy of emergent spectral structures. Each domain wall contributes a localized state inside the SSH gap, and the hybridization of these states produces minibands whose signatures are directly reflected in the transmission spectra. By combining domain-wall lattices with different domain-wall separations, we construct effective SSH structures within the miniband subspace. The resulting transmission spectra reproduce the characteristic features of conventional SSH chains, including gap formation, finite-size resonances, and the correspondence between transmission spectra and band structure. The construction can be applied recursively, generating successive generations of effective SSH structures. As a consequence, effective SSH spectra repeatedly emerge within progressively narrower energy intervals, producing a self-similar hierarchy of minibands and spectral gaps. To understand the origin of this hierarchy, we develop an effective renormalized description based on successive decimation. The effective parameters exhibit a hierarchy of interlaced singularities whose number increases at each iteration. These singularities partition the energy axis into progressively finer intervals and provide a natural interpretation of the repeated fragmentation of the spectrum. Our results show that topological domain-wall states can act as emergent degrees of freedom from which multiscale transport channels, effective couplings, and hierarchical spectral structures may be engineered. More generally, the framework introduced here establishes a connection between recursive topological constructions, effective Hamiltonians, and the emergence of self-similar spectra in one-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究含多个拓扑畴壁的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，发现畴壁局域态的杂化会产生层级化的小能带结构，并在透射谱中留下直接特征。通过组合具有不同间距的畴壁晶格，作者在小能带子空间中构造出有效 SSH 结构，且该构造可递归进行。连续重整化产生逐渐变窄能量区间内自相似的小能带和谱隙层级。
authors: Alessio Palavicini, César G. Galván, Carlos Ramírez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了包含多个拓扑畴壁的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链的输运性质，并表明它们之间的相互作用会产生层级化的涌现谱结构。每个畴壁都会在 SSH 能隙内贡献一个局域态，而这些态的杂化会产生小能带，其特征直接反映在透射谱中。通过组合具有不同畴壁间距的畴壁晶格，我们在小能带子空间中构造出有效 SSH 结构。所得透射谱重现了传统 SSH 链的特征，包括能隙形成、有限尺寸共振，以及透射谱与能带结构之间的对应关系。这种构造可以递归应用，从而生成连续世代的有效 SSH 结构。因此，有效 SSH 谱会在逐渐变窄的能量区间内反复涌现，形成小能带和谱隙的自相似层级。为理解这一层级的起源，我们基于连续消元发展了一种有效重整化描述。有效参数呈现出相互交错的奇异性层级，其数量在每次迭代中都会增加。这些奇异性将能量轴划分为逐渐更精细的区间，并为谱反复碎裂提供了自然解释。我们的结果表明，拓扑畴壁态能够作为涌现自由度，由此可工程化构建多尺度输运通道、有效耦合和层级谱结构。更一般地说，本文提出的框架建立了递归拓扑构造、有效哈密顿量与一维系统中自相似谱涌现之间的联系。

articles.title: Multiscale Modelling of Ferroelectrics using a Physics-Informed Neural Network Driven by Molecular Dynamics Data: Parameter Identification and Field Reconstruction
articles.title_zh: 利用分子动力学数据驱动的物理信息神经网络进行铁电体多尺度建模：参数识别与场重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In multiscale modeling of ferroelectrics, combining atomistic simulation with continuum-scale phase-field models (PFM) remains a fundamental challenge. A key difficulty lies in faithfully capturing discrete atomic-level information within a continuum modeling framework, while accurately representing material behavior at the mesoscale. In this paper, a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) driven by molecular dynamics (MD) data is used. The loss function of the network consists of a supervised term that fits the discrete spatial polarization distributions obtained from MD simulations of systems containing domain walls, and a physics-based term that incorporates the residuals of partial differential equations (PDEs) of steady-state PFM. To ensure stable and balanced training among the different loss components, adaptive gradient normalization (GradNorm) is used to dynamically adjust the task weights. By minimizing the total loss, the model not only reconstructs the polarization field along with the associated strain, stress, and energy landscape at the continuum scale, but also identifies critical physical parameters of the phase-field model, including the characteristic energy density, characteristic length factor, gradient energy anisotropy factor, and Landau polynomial coefficients. By using the PINN-predicted physical parameters in COMSOL Multiphysics to solve the corresponding PDEs within a finite element framework, we demonstrate that these parameters enable accurate reproduction of the ferroelectric domain structure and the associated material response, including stress/strain distributions and energy landscape. This framework provides an effective methodology for establishing multiscale connections between atomistic and continuum descriptions, and holds the potential to infer underlying physical properties directly from polarization distributions for a wide range of materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出以分子动力学数据驱动的物理信息神经网络，用于连接铁电体的原子尺度模拟与连续相场模型。网络同时拟合含畴壁体系的离散极化分布，并纳入稳态相场方程残差；采用 GradNorm 自适应平衡各损失项。该方法可重建连续尺度的极化、应变、应力和能量图景，并识别相场模型关键参数，且经 COMSOL 有限元计算验证。
authors: Xuejian Wang, Frank Wendler, Hikaru Auzuma, Michael Zaiser, Shuji Ogata, Ryo Kobayashi, Lei Zeng, Xingchen Tan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在铁电体多尺度建模中，将原子尺度模拟与连续尺度相场模型（PFM）结合仍是一项基础性挑战。一个关键困难在于，如何在连续建模框架中忠实捕捉离散的原子尺度信息，同时准确表征介观尺度的材料行为。本文使用由分子动力学（MD）数据驱动的物理信息神经网络（PINN）。该网络的损失函数由两部分构成：一部分是监督项，用于拟合由含畴壁体系的 MD 模拟得到的离散空间极化分布；另一部分是基于物理的项，其中纳入稳态 PFM 偏微分方程（PDE）的残差。为确保不同损失分量之间稳定且平衡的训练，我们采用自适应梯度归一化方法（GradNorm）动态调整任务权重。通过最小化总损失，该模型不仅能够重建连续尺度下的极化场及其相关应变、应力和能量图景，还能够识别相场模型的关键物理参数，包括特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子以及朗道多项式系数。通过在 COMSOL Multiphysics 中使用 PINN 预测的物理参数，并在有限元框架内求解相应 PDE，我们证明这些参数能够准确再现铁电畴结构及相关材料响应，包括应力/应变分布和能量图景。该框架为建立原子尺度与连续尺度描述之间的多尺度联系提供了一种有效方法，并有望针对广泛材料体系直接从极化分布中推断潜在物理性质。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作利用分子动力学得到的含畴壁体系局域极化数据训练物理信息神经网络，并在损失函数中引入稳态相场方程残差和自适应梯度归一化。模型能够在连续介观尺度重建极化、应变、应力和能量分布，同时反演相场模型的关键物理参数。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的铁电性、畴壁动力学、有效哈密顿量和机器学习材料模拟密切相关。该方法提供了从原子尺度模拟数据向相场连续模型参数化和场重建的实用途径。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可针对 HfO2 基铁电体或二维滑移铁电体，引入电场循环、缺陷和温度作为条件变量，建立可描述翻转与疲劳的多尺度模型。还应验证反演参数对不同尺寸、畴构型和非平衡加载路径的可迁移性。

articles.title: Roton Instability in Quantum Droplets with Finite-Range Soft-Core Interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有有限程软核相互作用的量子液滴中的旋子不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24813v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the emergence of roton instability in self-bound quantum droplets interacting via a finite-range soft-core potential modeled by a Heaviside step interaction. The ground-state properties are obtained by solving the extended Gross-Pitaevskii equation including Lee-Huang-Yang corrections with a nonlocal interaction term. The collective excitation spectrum reveals the formation and progressive softening of a roton minimum as the interaction strength and range increase. When the roton energy approaches zero, the system becomes unstable, signaling the onset of density modulation. The rotonic behavior is further characterized through the static structure factor, which exhibits pronounced peaks at the roton momentum.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由有限程软核势相互作用的自束缚量子液滴中旋子不稳定性的出现。作者通过含 Lee-Huang-Yang 修正和非局域相互作用项的扩展 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程获得基态性质，并发现随相互作用强度和范围增大，旋子极小值逐渐形成并软化。旋子能量趋于零时，体系发生不稳定并出现密度调制，其特征也反映在静态结构因子的峰值中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了通过有限程软核势相互作用的自束缚量子液滴中旋子不稳定性的出现，其中该势由 Heaviside 阶跃相互作用建模。通过求解包含 Lee-Huang-Yang 修正和非局域相互作用项的扩展 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程，获得了基态性质。集体激发谱揭示，随着相互作用强度和作用范围的增加，旋子极小值形成并逐步软化。当旋子能量接近零时，体系变得不稳定，表明密度调制开始出现。静态结构因子进一步刻画了这种旋子行为，该因子在旋子动量处呈现显著峰值。

articles.title: AlV₂O₄ thin films via in-situ interfacial topotaxy
articles.title_zh: 通过原位界面拓扑外延制备 AlV₂O₄ 薄膜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional oxide epitaxy approaches face challenges when the oxidation conditions of constituent elements differ significantly. Here we demonstrate that V--O thin films can serve as solid-phase precursors for epitaxial AlV₂O₄, comprising a pyrochlore V².⁵⁺ network coexisting with AlO₄ tetrahedra within the spinel structure. The epitaxial AlV₂O₄/Al₂O₃ (0001) heterostructures are realized via interfacial topotactic transformation, involving V--O growth at a moderate temperature followed by in-situ ultra-high-temperature post-annealing to drive a reaction with the Al₂O₃ substrate. Transmission electron microscopy and temperature-dependent X-ray diffraction analyses reveal excellent structural characteristics that closely reproduce the known charge-ordering transition. This study presents a novel approach to realizing epitaxial structures with convoluted oxidation states where thermodynamic and kinetic barriers would otherwise limit synthesizability.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对组成元素氧化条件差异显著而使常规氧化物外延面临困难的问题，本文展示了以 V-O 薄膜作为固相前驱体制备外延 AlV₂O₄ 的方法。该方法通过中温生长 V-O 薄膜后进行原位超高温退火，使其与 Al₂O₃ 衬底发生界面拓扑化转变。表征结果显示，所得异质结构具有优异结构品质，并再现了已知的电荷有序转变。
authors: Jeong Rae Kim, Alexis Ashby, Sandra Glotzer, Darryl Shima, Ganesh Balakrishnan, Joseph Falson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当组成元素的氧化条件显著不同时，传统氧化物外延方法面临挑战。本文证明，V-O 薄膜可作为外延 AlV₂O₄ 的固相前驱体；该材料在尖晶石结构中包含与 AlO₄ 四面体共存的焦绿石型 V².⁵⁺ 网络。通过界面拓扑化转变，我们实现了 AlV₂O₄/Al₂O₃（0001）外延异质结构：先在中等温度下生长 V-O，随后进行原位超高温后退火，以驱动其与 Al₂O₃ 衬底发生反应。透射电子显微镜和变温 X 射线衍射分析表明，该结构具有优异的结构特性，并能紧密再现已知的电荷有序转变。本研究提出了一种实现具有复杂氧化态的外延结构的新方法，在其他情况下，热力学和动力学势垒将限制这类结构的可合成性。

articles.title: Predicting THz Generation Capability of Organic Crystals through Data Mining and Crystal Nonlinearity Models
articles.title_zh: 通过数据挖掘与晶体非线性模型预测有机晶体的太赫兹产生能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24835v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the use of DFT computation and mathematical models to predict the nonlinear dielectric polarization (PNL) and nonlinear susceptibility coefficients (χ⁽²⁾IJK) of organic materials based on their crystal structures. We apply this computation approach on single-component crystals, co-crystals and ionic crystals found through data mining the Cambridge Structural Database. We verify these computational results with experimental terahertz (THz) generation efficiencies for known THz generators, demonstrating consistency between the measurements and the computed values. Several mined structures show similar or larger PNL values compared to state-of-the-art THz generation crystals DAST, OH1 and BNA, suggesting great potential for their use in nonlinear optical (NLO) applications. Importantly, we also compared the resulting model of nonlinear optical tensor components with commonly-used simplifications of nonlinearity, showing that the comprehensive approach should be the standard method to evaluate the nonlinear optical properties of single-crystalline materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 DFT 计算和数学模型，根据晶体结构预测有机材料的非线性介电极化及二阶非线性极化率系数。研究对剑桥结构数据库中挖掘得到的单组分晶体、共晶体和离子晶体进行评估，并通过已知太赫兹发生器的实验效率加以验证。若干候选结构的预测非线性极化可与 DAST、OH1 和 BNA 等先进晶体相当或更高，显示出非线性光学应用潜力。
authors: Sin Hang Ho, Ashton Roma, Connor Barlow, Matthew Lutz, Natalie Green, Stacey Smith, David Michaelis, Jeremy A Johnson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了一种方法：利用 DFT 计算和数学模型，基于有机材料的晶体结构预测其非线性介电极化（PNL）和非线性极化率系数（χ⁽²⁾_IJK）。我们将这一计算方法应用于通过挖掘剑桥结构数据库得到的单组分晶体、共晶体和离子晶体。我们利用已知太赫兹（THz）发生器的实验太赫兹产生效率验证了这些计算结果，显示测量值与计算值之间具有一致性。若干经挖掘得到的结构显示出与当前最先进的太赫兹产生晶体 DAST、OH1 和 BNA 相近或更高的 PNL 值，表明它们在非线性光学（NLO）应用中具有巨大潜力。重要的是，我们还将所得非线性光学张量分量模型与常用的非线性简化处理进行了比较，表明综合方法应成为评估单晶材料非线性光学性质的标准方法。

articles.title: Compact nondestructive generator for microsecond-class ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 紧凑型无损微秒级超快脉冲磁场发生器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23584v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The sweep rate of pulsed magnetic fields is a key factor in exploring of nonequilibrium phenomena in matter. However, the nondestructive generation of ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields is challenging because of the large time constants associated with the large inductance and capacitance of conventional pulsed magnetic field generators, as well as the residual inductance of the power devices and the system itself. We have developed a new compact pulsed magnetic field generator using commercially available state-of-the-art ultrafast power devices, enabling the generation of ultrafast pulsed magnetic fields up to approximately 1 T with a pulse duration of 3.8 μs. We present the performance of the newly developed system and compare the experimentally obtained magnetic field waveforms with the results of a simple circuit simulation. In addition, we demonstrate magnetization measurements on cobalt powder and Faraday rotation measurements on CdS single crystal using the developed system.
articles.abstract_zh: 脉冲磁场的扫描速率是探索物质非平衡现象的关键，但传统设备受大电感、电容及残余电感限制，难以无损产生超快脉冲磁场。本文开发了一种采用商用先进超快功率器件的紧凑型发生器，可产生约 1 T、持续时间为 3.8 微秒的脉冲磁场。作者还展示了该装置在钴粉磁化测量和 CdS 单晶法拉第旋转测量中的应用。
authors: Y. Ishii, A. Ikeda, H. Sun, H. Oike, Y. H. Matsuda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脉冲磁场的扫描速率是探索物质中非平衡现象的关键因素。然而，由于传统脉冲磁场发生器的大电感和电容所伴随的较大时间常数，以及功率器件和系统本身的残余电感，无损产生超快脉冲磁场具有挑战性。我们开发了一种采用商用先进超快功率器件的新型紧凑脉冲磁场发生器，能够产生最高约 1 T、脉冲持续时间为 3.8 微秒的超快脉冲磁场。我们展示了新开发系统的性能，并将实验获得的磁场波形与简单电路模拟的结果进行了比较。此外，我们还利用该系统演示了对钴粉末的磁化测量以及对 CdS 单晶的法拉第旋转测量。

articles.title: Hamiltonian Learning at Scale
articles.title_zh: 大规模哈密顿量学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23707v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Learning a quantum system's Hamiltonian is crucial for understanding and controlling its dynamics and has recently become a topic of widespread interest. To understand the learning protocol's error tolerances, i.e. its stability in the presence of inevitable errors, this work utilizes tensor network techniques to emulate Hamiltonian learning workflows at scale and with noise. Specifically, we employed a Hamiltonian learning technique based on approximate stationary states which are constructed using matrix product tools. We provide analytic bounds on the Hamiltonian learning estimation errors and perform numerical simulations that highlight learning error's stability under two families of errors. Using our workflow, we are able to scale up the protocol and learn mixed-field Ising model Hamiltonians of an N=300 site spin chain. By simulating the protocol at large scale, and empirically studying its practical limitations, our analysis of how errors affect the Hamiltonian learning process provides valuable lessons for future experiments. We conclude by discussing the avenues our work opens as well as future work that can support Hamiltonian learning experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 学习量子系统的哈密顿量对于理解和控制其动力学至关重要。本文采用张量网络技术，在存在噪声时大规模模拟基于近似稳态的哈密顿量学习流程，并给出估计误差的解析界及两类误差下的数值稳定性结果。该工作将流程扩展到 300 个自旋位点的混合场伊辛链，并讨论了实验应用的实际限制与后续方向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 学习量子系统的哈密顿量对于理解和控制其动力学至关重要，近年来已成为受到广泛关注的课题。为理解学习协议的误差容限，即其在不可避免误差存在时的稳定性，本工作利用张量网络技术对大规模且含噪声的哈密顿量学习工作流程进行模拟。具体而言，我们采用了一种基于近似稳态的哈密顿量学习技术，而这些近似稳态通过矩阵乘积工具构造。我们给出了哈密顿量学习估计误差的解析界，并进行了数值模拟，以突出学习误差在两类误差下的稳定性。借助我们的工作流程，我们能够扩展该协议的规模，并学习具有 N=300 个位点的自旋链中的混合场伊辛模型哈密顿量。通过在大规模下模拟该协议并通过经验研究其实际限制，我们对于误差如何影响哈密顿量学习过程的分析，为未来实验提供了有价值的经验。最后，我们讨论了本工作开辟的研究路径，以及可支持哈密顿量学习实验的未来工作。

articles.title: Differential Learning for Robust Prediction of Thermal Stability with Application to Energetic Materials
articles.title_zh: 用于稳健预测热稳定性的差分学习及其在含能材料中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting thermal stability during handling and storage is essential for the design of safe and reliable energetic materials. However, experimental measurements vary significantly across laboratories due to differences in protocols and analysis methods, making it difficult to train reliable predictive models. We address this challenge through differential learning. Rather than predicting absolute decomposition temperatures, we instead train message passing neural networks to predict relative differences between pairs of molecules. This approach reduces sensitivity to systematic experimental errors and achieves >85% accuracy in ranking compounds by thermal stability, outperforming conventional regression methods on the same heterogeneous dataset. To understand what drives these predictions, we compare neural network models with interpretable alternatives built from descriptors derived from ab initio calculations and cheminformatics software. This analysis identifies bond dissociation enthalpy as a key determinant of thermal stability rankings, providing further insight into the complex chemistry of thermal decomposition. The differential learning framework generalizes across model architectures, from graph neural networks to classical descriptor-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that learning relative properties rather than absolute values offers a practical solution for modeling noisy experimental data, with direct applications in materials design where thermal stability predictions inform safety protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对不同实验室因实验规程和分析方法差异而导致热稳定性数据不一致的问题，本文采用差分学习预测分子对之间的相对分解温度差异，而非绝对分解温度。该方法在异质数据集上按热稳定性对化合物排序的准确率超过85%，优于传统回归方法。模型分析表明，键解离焓是热稳定性排序的重要决定因素，且相对性质学习框架可推广至图神经网络和基于描述符的经典模型。
authors: Megan C. Davis, R. Seaton Ullberg, Jeremy N. Schroeder, Andrew H. Salij, Marc J. Cawkwell, Christopher J. Snyder, Ivana Matanovic, Wilton J. M. Kort-Kamp
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在含能材料的设计中，预测材料在处理和储存过程中的热稳定性对于确保其安全性和可靠性至关重要。然而，由于实验规程和分析方法存在差异，不同实验室获得的实验测量结果有很大差别，这使得可靠预测模型的训练变得困难。我们通过差分学习应对这一挑战。我们不再预测绝对的分解温度，而是训练消息传递神经网络来预测分子对之间的相对差异。该方法降低了模型对系统性实验误差的敏感性，并在同一异质数据集上以超过85%的准确率实现了按热稳定性对化合物进行排序，性能优于传统回归方法。为理解这些预测的驱动因素，我们将神经网络模型与可解释模型进行比较，后者采用由从头算计算和化学信息学软件得到的描述符构建。分析结果表明，键解离焓是热稳定性排序的关键决定因素，从而进一步揭示了热分解复杂化学过程的内在规律。差分学习框架可推广至不同的模型架构，包括图神经网络和基于经典描述符的方法。我们的结果表明，相较于学习绝对值，学习相对性质为处理含噪实验数据提供了一种实用方案；在材料设计中，热稳定性预测可直接用于制定安全规程。

articles.title: Time-Dependent Tunneling in the Thin-Barrier Limit
articles.title_zh: 薄势垒极限下的时间依赖隧穿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24032v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The usual WKB analysis for quantum tunneling applies when the tunneling action is large, as it is for tall, wide potential barriers. In contrast we analyze tunneling when the action is small, as it is for tunneling across a tall, thin barrier. We develop a perturbative analysis where the control parameter is the inverse of the area under the potential barrier and apply our technique to several examples in 1+1 dimensions. In resonant situations for bound particles we find that the tunneling probability grows with time as propto t², while in non-resonant situations it grows linearly with time. We evaluate not only the tunneling probability but also the time-dependent tunneling wavefunction for a particle that escapes to infinity, it i.e. from a quasi-bound state to the continuum.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常的WKB量子隧穿分析适用于隧穿作用量较大的情形，而本文研究作用量较小的高而薄势垒隧穿。作者以势垒下方面积的倒数为控制参数建立微扰分析，并将其应用于多个一维空间加时间模型。在共振情况下，束缚粒子的隧穿概率随时间按t²增长；在非共振情况下则呈线性增长，同时还计算了粒子从准束缚态逃逸到连续谱并最终到达无穷远时的时间依赖隧穿波函数。
authors: Tanmay Vachaspati, Frank Wilczek, Zara Yu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通常的量子隧穿WKB分析适用于隧穿作用量较大的情况，例如高而宽的势垒。相比之下，我们分析了作用量较小的隧穿情形，即穿过高而薄的势垒。我们建立了一种微扰分析方法，其控制参数是势垒下方面积的倒数，并将该方法应用于1+1维中的若干实例。对于束缚粒子的共振情形，我们发现隧穿概率随时间按正比于t²的方式增长，而在非共振情形下则随时间线性增长。我们不仅计算了隧穿概率，还计算了一个逃逸至无穷远的粒子的时间依赖隧穿波函数，即从准束缚态进入连续谱的波函数。

articles.title: Stable rotating vortex clusters in three-dimensional quantum droplets
articles.title_zh: 三维量子液滴中的稳定旋转涡旋簇
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24036v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We predict a new type of stable three-dimensional (3D) vortex quantum droplets in binary Bose-Einstein condensate arranged into ring clusters that per-sistently rotate in the external potential. In contrast to clusters composed from localized quantum droplets, the states introduced here represent interacting vortex lines with identical topological charges nested in common 3D envelope and existing in much broader parameter range in comparison with local-ized quantum droplets. The intricate interplay between mean-field nonlinearity of Bose-Einstein condensate, quantum fluctuations described by Lee-Huang-Yang correction, Coriolis force arising due to rotation, and external potential leads to substantial variations of cluster shape upon increase of its rotation frequency. Rotating vortex clusters bifurcate from single-vortex quantum droplets and exist only above critical value of the rotation frequency that decreases with increase of chemical potential and depends on the number of vortex lines in the cluster. The radius of the cluster decreases with increase of rotation frequency and weakly varies with chemical potential, which determines mostly localization of the individual vortices in cluster and overall width of its envelope. Vortex droplet clusters are very robust objects existing in stable form in wide intervals of the number of particles for any number (odd or even) of vortex lines forming them. Our results may open the route to observation of stable arrays of vortex lines of different configurations per-forming regular collective motion in condensate.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文预测了一类稳定的三维涡旋量子液滴：二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的涡旋线组成环状簇，并在外势中持续旋转。与由局域量子液滴组成的簇不同，这些态由具有相同拓扑荷、嵌套于共同三维包络中的相互作用涡旋线构成，存在于更宽的参数范围。研究揭示了非线性、量子涨落、科里奥利力和外势之间的作用如何调控簇的形状、半径与稳定性，并表明这类涡旋簇可在宽粒子数区间内稳定存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们预测了一类新型稳定的三维涡旋量子液滴：二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的涡旋量子液滴排列成环状簇，并在外部势场中持续旋转。与由局域量子液滴组成的簇不同，本文引入的态表现为具有相同拓扑荷、嵌套于共同三维包络中的相互作用涡旋线；与局域量子液滴相比，它们存在于宽得多的参数范围内。玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的平均场非线性、由Lee-Huang-Yang修正描述的量子涨落、旋转引起的科里奥利力以及外部势场之间复杂的相互作用，会导致簇的形状随旋转频率增加而发生显著变化。旋转涡旋簇从单涡旋量子液滴处分岔出来，并且只有在旋转频率高于某个临界值时才存在；该临界值随化学势增加而降低，并且取决于簇中涡旋线的数量。簇的半径随旋转频率增加而减小，并且随化学势仅发生微弱变化；化学势主要决定簇中单个涡旋的局域化程度以及其整体包络的宽度。对于由任意数量的涡旋线组成的簇，无论涡旋线数量为奇数还是偶数，涡旋液滴簇都非常稳健，能够在宽粒子数区间内以稳定形式存在。我们的结果可能为在凝聚体中观测不同构型的稳定涡旋线阵列开辟道路，这些阵列可执行规则的集体运动。

articles.title: Imaging atomic scale stochasticity: noise in the nearly commensurate charge density wave of 1T-TaS₂ for leaky-integrator-and-fire neuromorphic emulator
articles.title_zh: 成像原子尺度随机性：用于泄漏积分发放神经形态模拟器的1T-TaS₂近公度电荷密度波噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24693v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-dimensional materials are promising materials for emulating neuron-like firing were understanding of the atomic-scale origin of this behavior can benefit integration into neurormophic hardware. Using scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) as a highly local probe of correlations in the charge density wave (CDW), we study atomic-scale CDW noise in 1T-TaS₂ at room temperature. We statistically analyze the tunnel-junction noise and, to explain the temporally correlated current bursts, introduce a mesoscopic model in which the fractal structure and reorganization of CDW discommensurations are related. This noise mimics leaky-integrate-and-fire neuron dynamics. Our results show that atomic-scale current bursts in the tunnel junction can act as effective nonlinear elements in spiking neural emulators, enabling bioinspired processing through rich CDW dynamics at room temperature and supporting the miniaturization of spiking devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 低维材料可用于模拟类神经元放电行为，而理解其原子尺度起源有助于将其集成到神经形态硬件中。本文利用扫描隧道显微镜研究室温下1T-TaS₂电荷密度波的原子尺度噪声，并通过统计分析隧道结噪声解释时间相关的电流突发。结果表明，电荷密度波的动力学可模拟泄漏积分发放神经元，使原子尺度电流突发成为脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非线性元件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低维材料是模拟类神经元放电行为的有前景材料，而理解这种行为的原子尺度起源有助于将其集成到神经形态硬件中。我们利用扫描隧道显微镜这一能够高度局域探测电荷密度波相关性的工具，研究了室温下1T-TaS₂中的原子尺度电荷密度波噪声。我们对隧道结噪声进行了统计分析，并引入一个介观模型来解释时间上相关的电流突发；在该模型中，电荷密度波非公度畴壁的分形结构与重组过程彼此关联。这种噪声模拟了泄漏积分发放神经元的动力学。我们的结果表明，隧道结中的原子尺度电流突发可以充当脉冲神经模拟器中的有效非线性元件，使器件能够利用丰富的电荷密度波动力学在室温下实现仿生信息处理，并支持脉冲器件的小型化。

articles.title: Solution landscapes of ferronematics in microfluidic channels
articles.title_zh: 微流控通道中铁磁向列液晶的解景观
articles.abstract: arXiv:2309.16841v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study solution landscapes for ferronematics, i.e., a dilute suspension of magnetic nanoparticles in a nematic liquid crystal host, in a one-dimensional (1D) channel geometry. Adopting the modelling framework in Bisht et al.(2020), the admissible ferronematic configurations are modelled in terms of critical points of an appropriately defined ferronematic energy. There are two types of critical points: full critical points that exploit all degrees of freedom and order reconstruction (OR) critical points. OR critical points have polydomain structures, with the polydomains separated by domain walls. We find that ferronematic systems are typically multistable, i.e., the free energy has multiple competing stable critical points, which model potentially physically observable configurations; the multistability is not a priori obvious. Further, we discover multiple stable and unstable OR solutions that differ in the locations and multiplicity of domain walls. The domain walls can act as binding sites in equilibrium processes and rafts for guided transport phenomena in non-equilibrium processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一维通道几何中铁磁向列液晶的解景观，即磁性纳米颗粒在向列液晶主体中的稀悬浮体系。模型将允许的铁磁向列构型表示为相应能量的临界点，其中包括充分利用全部自由度的完整临界点和具有序重构结构的临界点。研究发现，该体系通常具有多稳态，并存在多个稳定或不稳定的序重构解，其差异体现在畴壁的位置和数量上。畴壁可在平衡过程中充当结合位点，并在非平衡过程中作为引导输运的轨道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一维通道几何中铁磁向列液晶的解景观，即磁性纳米颗粒在向列液晶主体中的稀悬浮体系。采用Bisht等人（2020年）提出的建模框架，允许的铁磁向列构型被表示为适当定义的铁磁向列能量的临界点。临界点有两类：充分利用所有自由度的完整临界点，以及序重构（OR）临界点。序重构临界点具有多畴结构，各个多畴之间由畴壁分隔。我们发现，铁磁向列体系通常是多稳态的，即其自由能具有多个彼此竞争的稳定临界点，这些临界点对应于在物理上可能被观测到的构型；这种多稳态性并非先验显而易见。此外，我们还发现了多个稳定和不稳定的序重构解，它们在畴壁的位置和数量上有所不同。在平衡过程和非平衡过程中，畴壁分别可以充当结合位点和引导输运的轨道。

articles.title: Magneto-optical transport in type-I multi-Weyl semimetals in the presence of orbital magnetic moment
articles.title_zh: 考虑轨道磁矩的I型多重外尔半金属磁光输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.09888v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-Weyl semimetals (mWSMs) are topological quantum materials whose Weyl nodes carry higher monopole charges and exhibit strongly anisotropic dispersions. We investigate the linear and nonlinear magneto-optical transport of tilted type-I mWSMs with arbitrary monopole charge J within a semiclassical Boltzmann framework that incorporates both Berry-curvature (BC) and orbital-magnetic-moment (OMM) corrections. We derive analytical expressions for the longitudinal, Hall, planar Hall and second-harmonic magnetoconductivities in the presence of external electric and magnetic fields. The resulting conductivity components exhibit characteristic scaling with the chemical potential and monopole charge, reflecting the anisotropic dispersion of multi-Weyl nodes. We further elucidate the interplay between the BC and OMM contributions and show that the OMM generally suppresses the BC-induced magnetoconductivity, while its contribution can become comparable to or larger than the BC contribution for specific transport geometries. Our results provide experimentally accessible signatures of the combined effects of cone tilt, higher monopole charge, Berry curvature, and orbital magnetic moment in the magneto-optical response of multi-Weyl semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在包含贝里曲率和轨道磁矩修正的半经典玻尔兹曼框架下，研究具有任意单极荷J的倾斜I型多重外尔半金属的线性与非线性磁光输运。作者推导了纵向、霍尔、平面霍尔及二次谐波磁电导的解析表达式，并分析其随化学势和单极荷的特征标度关系。结果显示，轨道磁矩通常会抑制贝里曲率诱导的磁电导，但在特定输运几何中，其贡献可能与贝里曲率贡献相当甚至更大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多重外尔半金属是具有较高单极荷的外尔节点并呈现强各向异性色散的拓扑量子材料。我们在纳入贝里曲率（BC）和轨道磁矩（OMM）修正的半经典玻尔兹曼框架下，研究了具有任意单极荷J的倾斜I型多重外尔半金属的线性和非线性磁光输运。我们推导了外部电场和磁场存在时纵向、霍尔、平面霍尔以及二次谐波磁电导的解析表达式。所得电导分量表现出随化学势和单极荷变化的特征标度关系，反映了多重外尔节点的各向异性色散。我们进一步阐明了贝里曲率和轨道磁矩贡献之间的相互作用，并表明轨道磁矩通常会抑制由贝里曲率诱导的磁电导；然而，在特定输运几何中，轨道磁矩的贡献可能与贝里曲率贡献相当，甚至超过后者。我们的结果为实验探测锥体倾斜、高阶单极荷、贝里曲率和轨道磁矩共同作用对多重外尔半金属磁光响应的影响提供了可观测的特征。

articles.title: Bipolarized Weyl semimetals and quantum crystal valley Hall effect in two-dimensional altermagnetic materials
articles.title_zh: 双极化外尔半金属与二维交错磁材料中的量子晶体谷霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.16603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetism and topology are two major areas of condensed matter physics. The combination of magnetism and topology gives rise to more novel physical effects, which have attracted strongly theoretical and experimental attention. Recently, the concept of altermagnetism has been introduced, characterized by a dual nature: real-space antiparallel spins with zero total magnetic moment and reciprocal-space anisotropic spin polarization. The amalgamation of altermagnetism with topology may lead to the emergence of previously unobserved topological phases and the associated physical effects. In this study, utilizing a four-band lattice model that incorporates altermagnetism and spin group symmetry, we demonstrate that type-I, type-II, and type-III bipolarized Weyl semimetals can exist in altermagnetic systems. Through the first-principles electronic structure calculations, we predict four ideal two-dimensional type-I altermagnetic bipolarized Weyl semimetals Fe₂WTe₄ and Fe₂MoZ₄ (Z=S, Se, Te). More significantly, we introduce the quantum crystal valley Hall effect, a phenomenon achievable in three of these materials namely Fe₂WTe₄, Fe₂MoS₄, and Fe₂MoSe₄, when spin-orbit coupling is considered. Therefore, our work not only enriches the topological phases but also provides a material platform for studying novel topological phases in altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性与拓扑的结合可能产生新的拓扑相及物理效应。本文利用包含交错磁性和自旋群对称性的四带晶格模型，证明交错磁系统中可以存在I型、II型和III型双极化外尔半金属，并通过第一性原理计算预测了四种理想二维I型交错磁双极化外尔半金属。进一步地，作者提出量子晶体谷霍尔效应，并指出在考虑自旋轨道耦合时，Fe₂WTe₄、Fe₂MoS₄和Fe₂MoSe₄可实现该效应。
authors: Chao-Yang Tan, Ze-Feng Gao, Huan-Cheng Yang, Kai Liu, Peng-Jie Guo, Zhong-Yi Lu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性和拓扑是凝聚态物理中的两个重要领域。磁性与拓扑的结合会产生更多新颖的物理效应，因此受到了理论和实验研究的高度关注。近年来，人们提出了交错磁性的概念，其特征是具有二重性质：实空间中的反平行自旋、零总磁矩，以及倒空间中的各向异性自旋极化。交错磁性与拓扑的结合可能导致此前未被观测到的拓扑相及其相关物理效应。在本研究中，我们利用包含交错磁性和自旋群对称性的四带晶格模型，证明了I型、II型和III型双极化外尔半金属可以存在于交错磁系统中。通过第一性原理电子结构计算，我们预测了四种理想的二维I型交错磁双极化外尔半金属：Fe₂WTe₄和Fe₂MoZ₄（Z=S、Se、Te）。更重要的是，我们提出了量子晶体谷霍尔效应；在考虑自旋轨道耦合时，该现象可在其中三种材料，即Fe₂WTe₄、Fe₂MoS₄和Fe₂MoSe₄中实现。因此，我们的工作不仅丰富了拓扑相的种类，也为研究交错磁性中的新型拓扑相提供了材料平台。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作构建包含交替磁性和自旋群对称性的四能带模型，提出交替磁体系中可存在三类双极化 Weyl 半金属。结合第一性原理电子结构计算，作者预测 Fe2WTe4 和 Fe2MoZ4 等二维材料可实现理想的 I 型双极化 Weyl 态，并提出量子晶体谷霍尔效应。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的交替磁性、二维磁体、拓扑材料、电子结构计算和自旋电子学方向高度相关。其对称性分析与第一性原理候选材料预测的结合，尤其适合用于拓展团队的磁性拓扑性质研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可验证候选体系在自旋轨道耦合、应变、层间堆垛和磁序扰动下的拓扑相稳定性，并计算边缘态与输运响应。进一步可利用 Wannier 化和贝里曲率计算量化谷霍尔及非线性霍尔信号。

articles.title: Inverted duality of Hubbard model and an equation for the Green's function
articles.title_zh: Hubbard模型的反演对偶性及一个关于格林函数的方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.09562v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Hubbard model, a cornerstone in the field of condensed matter physics, serves as a fundamental framework for investigating the behavior of strongly correlated electron systems. This paper presents a novel perspective on the model, uncovering its inherent inverted duality which has profound implications for our comprehension of this complex system. Taking advantage of this special mathematical property, we have formulated an equation that the electron Green's function must satisfy. Our findings pave the way for further exploration and potentially new insights into the dynamics of electron correlations and phase transitions in the Hubbard model.
articles.abstract_zh: Hubbard模型是研究强关联电子系统行为的基本理论框架。本文揭示了该模型内在的一种反演对偶性，并利用这一数学性质建立了电子格林函数必须满足的方程。研究结果为进一步探索Hubbard模型中的电子关联动力学和相变提供了新的视角与可能路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Hubbard模型是凝聚态物理领域的基石之一，也是研究强关联电子系统行为的基本框架。本文从一个新的视角研究该模型，揭示了其内在的反演对偶性，这一性质对我们理解这一复杂系统具有深远意义。利用这一特殊的数学性质，我们构造了一个电子格林函数必须满足的方程。我们的发现为进一步研究Hubbard模型中的电子关联动力学和相变，并可能获得新的认识，开辟了道路。

articles.title: Stacking-induced type-II quantum spin Hall insulators with high spin Chern number in unconventional magnetism
articles.title_zh: 堆叠诱导的具有高自旋陈数的II型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体：非常规磁性中的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.05365v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While stacking two type-I quantum spin Hall insulators typically results in a trivial insulator, the behavior of the assembly of type-II quantum spin Hall insulators remains unexplored. In this article, based on calculations of a lattice model, we demonstrate that stacking two type-II quantum spin Hall insulators does not yield a trivial insulator but instead forms a nontrivial quantum spin Hall insulator with high spin Chern number. In this phase, two pairs of topological edge states with opposite chirality and polarization coexist at the boundary. Our calculations further reveal that the quantized spin Hall conductivity of the bilayer is twice that of the monolayer. When U(1) symmetry is present, the high spin Chern number phase remains stable; when U(1) symmetry is broken, it persists over a broad parameter range. Furthermore, based on first-principles electronic structure calculations, we demonstrate that bilayer Nb₂SeTeO is a type-II quantum spin Hall insulator with a high spin Chern number in altermagnetism and unconventional compensated magnetism. Moreover, extending this strategy to multilayer stacks naturally leads to a quantum spin Hall insulator with a higher spin Chern number. Our work not only deepens the distinction between type-I and type-II quantum spin Hall insulators, but also offers a route toward realizing highly quantized spin Hall conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于晶格模型计算研究两个II型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体堆叠后的拓扑性质，发现其不会形成平庸绝缘体，而会形成具有高自旋陈数的非平庸量子自旋霍尔绝缘体。该双层体系边界上共存两对具有相反手性和极化的拓扑边缘态，量子化自旋霍尔电导为单层的两倍。第一性原理计算表明，双层Nb₂SeTeO可在交错磁性和非常规补偿磁性中实现这一相，并可通过多层堆叠获得更高自旋陈数。
authors: Chao-Yang Tan, Panjun Feng, Ze-Feng Gao, Fengjie Ma, Peng-Jie Guo, Zhong-Yi Lu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 虽然堆叠两个I型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体通常会产生平庸绝缘体，但II型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体堆叠后的行为尚未得到研究。在本文中，我们基于晶格模型计算证明，堆叠两个II型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体不会产生平庸绝缘体，而是形成具有高自旋陈数的非平庸量子自旋霍尔绝缘体。在这一相中，边界上共存两对具有相反手性和极化的拓扑边缘态。我们的计算进一步表明，双层体系的量子化自旋霍尔电导是单层体系的两倍。当U(1)对称性存在时，高自旋陈数相保持稳定；当U(1)对称性被破坏时，该相仍可在较宽的参数范围内存在。此外，基于第一性原理电子结构计算，我们证明双层Nb₂SeTeO在交错磁性和非常规补偿磁性中是具有高自旋陈数的II型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体。进一步将这一策略推广到多层堆叠，可以自然地产生具有更高自旋陈数的量子自旋霍尔绝缘体。我们的工作不仅深化了对I型和II型量子自旋霍尔绝缘体差异的认识，也为实现高度量子化的自旋霍尔电导提供了路径。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出堆叠 type-II 量子自旋霍尔绝缘体可形成具有高自旋陈数的非平庸拓扑绝缘态，而非通常预期的平庸绝缘体。作者结合晶格模型与第一性原理计算，预测双层 Nb2SeTeO 在交替磁性和非常规补偿磁性背景下具有高自旋陈数相及增强的量子自旋霍尔响应。
articles.focus_relation: 该研究与团队的拓扑材料、交替磁性、二维范德华材料、层间耦合、第一性原理电子结构和自旋相关量子功能材料方向高度相关。其堆叠工程调控拓扑相和自旋输运的机制，尤其适合与团队的 Wannier、输运及磁性模型研究衔接。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议核查其拓扑不变量计算、磁空间群对称性分析及自旋轨道耦合下相的稳健性。后续可研究应变、电场、扭转角和界面杂化对高自旋陈数相、边缘态及量子输运的调控。

articles.title: Self-dual Higgs transitions: Toric code and beyond
articles.title_zh: 自对偶希格斯跃迁：从环面码到更广泛的拓扑序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.20945v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The toric code, when deformed in a way that preserves the self-duality Z₂ symmetry exchanging the electric and magnetic excitations, admits a transition to a topologically trivial state that spontaneously breaks the Z₂ symmetry. Numerically, this transition was found to be continuous, which makes it particularly enigmatic given the longstanding absence of a continuum field-theoretic description. In this work we propose such a continuum field theory for the transition dubbed the SO(4)₂,₋₂ Chern-Simons-Higgs (CSH) theory. We show that our field theory provides a natural "mean-field" understanding of the phase diagram. Moreover, it can be generalized to an entire series of theories, namely the SO(4)ₖ,₋ₖ CSH theories, labeled by an integer k. For each k>2, the theory describes an analogous transition involving different non-Abelian topological orders, such as the double Fibonacci order (k=3) and the S₃ quantum double (k=4). For k=1, we conjecture that the corresponding CSH transition is in fact infrared-dual to the 3d Ising transition, in close analogy with the particle-vortex duality of a complex scalar.
articles.abstract_zh: 环面码在保持交换电激发与磁激发的自对偶Z₂对称性变形时，可以跃迁到自发破缺该Z₂对称性的拓扑平庸态。本文为这一数值上显示为连续、但长期缺乏连续场论描述的跃迁提出SO(4)₂,₋₂陈-西蒙斯-希格斯理论。该理论还可推广为由整数k标记的SO(4)ₖ,₋ₖ理论序列，用于描述涉及双Fibonacci拓扑序、S₃量子双模型等非阿贝尔拓扑序的类似跃迁。
authors: Wenjie Ji, Ryan A. Lanzetta, Zheng Zhou, Chong Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环面码经过一种保持自对偶Z₂对称性的变形后，可以从环面码相跃迁到一个拓扑平庸态；在该过程中，交换电激发和磁激发的自对偶Z₂对称性发生自发破缺。数值研究发现，这一跃迁是连续的；鉴于长期以来一直缺乏对它的连续场论描述，这一结果尤其令人费解。在本文中，我们为该跃迁提出了一个连续场论，即SO(4)₂,₋₂陈-西蒙斯-希格斯（CSH）理论。我们表明，该场论为相图提供了自然的“平均场”理解。此外，它还可以推广为一整套理论，即由整数k标记的SO(4)ₖ,₋ₖ CSH理论。对于每个k>2，这些理论描述了涉及不同非阿贝尔拓扑序的类似跃迁，例如双Fibonacci拓扑序（k=3）和S₃量子双模型（k=4）。对于k=1，我们猜想相应的CSH跃迁实际上与三维Ising跃迁存在红外对偶关系，这与复标量场的粒子-涡旋对偶性非常类似。

articles.title: Stability of Bose-Fermi mixtures in two dimensions: a lowest-order constrained variational approach
articles.title_zh: 二维玻色-费米混合物的稳定性：最低阶约束变分方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15598v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the problem of mechanical stability in two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixtures at zero temperature, focusing on systems with a tunable Bose-Fermi (BF) interaction and a weak but finite boson-boson (BB) repulsion. The analysis is carried out within the framework of the lowest-order constrained variational (LOCV) approach, which allows for a non-perturbative treatment of strong interspecies correlations while retaining analytical transparency. The BF interaction is modeled by a properly regularized attractive contact potential, enabling the exploration of both the attractive and repulsive energy branches. We determine the minimal BB repulsion required to ensure mechanical stability of the mixture by evaluating the inverse compressibility matrix over the full range of BF coupling strengths, within the domain of validity of the LOCV approximation. The interaction contribution to the energy is benchmarked against available experimental data and Quantum Monte Carlo results in the single-impurity limit, showing good agreement. Our analysis reveals how the critical BB coupling depends on interaction strength, density imbalance, and mass ratio. In particular, we find that mixtures with equal boson and fermion masses exhibit enhanced stability, requiring the smallest BB repulsion to prevent mechanical instability. In this case, a relatively small BB interaction is sufficient to stabilize attractive mixtures for all values of the BF interaction. These results provide a theoretical framework for assessing stability conditions in experimentally realizable two-dimensional Bose-Fermi mixtures with tunable interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在零温下研究二维玻色-费米混合物的机械稳定性，重点考察可调玻色-费米相互作用以及弱而有限的玻色子-玻色子排斥作用。最低阶约束变分方法能够非微扰地处理强种间关联，同时保持解析上的透明性；作者据此通过逆压缩率矩阵确定不同耦合强度下维持稳定性所需的最小玻色子-玻色子排斥。结果表明，临界排斥作用取决于相互作用强度、密度不平衡和质量比，等质量混合物最稳定，并可用相对较小的玻色子-玻色子作用稳定吸引性混合物。
authors: Pietro Cordioli, Leonardo Pisani, Pierbiagio Pieri
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了零温下二维玻色-费米混合物的机械稳定性问题，重点关注具有可调玻色-费米（BF）相互作用以及弱但有限的玻色子-玻色子（BB）排斥作用的体系。分析在最低阶约束变分（LOCV）方法框架内进行；该方法能够以非微扰方式处理强烈的种间关联，同时保持解析处理的透明性。BF相互作用采用经过适当正规化的吸引性接触势建模，从而可以研究吸引性能支和排斥性能支。我们在LOCV近似的适用范围内，通过考察整个BF耦合强度范围内的逆压缩率矩阵，确定了确保混合物机械稳定所需的最小BB排斥作用。我们将相互作用对能量的贡献与单杂质极限下已有的实验数据和量子蒙特卡洛结果进行了比较，发现二者符合良好。我们的分析揭示了临界BB耦合如何依赖于相互作用强度、密度不平衡和质量比。特别是，玻色子和费米子质量相等的混合物表现出增强的稳定性，只需要最小的BB排斥作用即可避免机械不稳定。在这种情况下，相对较弱的BB相互作用就足以在BF相互作用取任意值时稳定吸引性混合物。这些结果为评估具有可调相互作用、并可在实验中实现的二维玻色-费米混合物的稳定条件提供了理论框架。

articles.title: Granular aluminum induced superconductivity in germanium for hole spin-based hybrid devices
articles.title_zh: 颗粒铝在锗中诱导超导：面向空穴自旋混合器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.21364v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In superconductor-semiconductor hybrid structures, superconductivity and spin polarization are competing effects as magnetic fields break Cooper pairs. They can be combined using thin films and in-plane magnetic fields, an approach that enabled the pursuit of Majorana zero modes, Kitaev chains, and Andreev spin qubits (ASQs), but remains challenging for materials with small in-plane g-factors or when out-of-plane fields are required. We demonstrate that granular aluminium (grAl), composed of nanometre-scale aluminium grains embedded in an amorphous oxide matrix, can overcome this limitation. By depositing grAl on Ge/SiGe heterostructures, we induce a hard superconducting gap with BCS peaks at 305~μeV and magnetic-field resilience for both the in-plane and out-of-plane directions, allowing Zeeman splitting of Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) states beyond 50~μeV (12 GHz). Leveraging this robustness, we reveal signatures of hole physics and discuss a driving mechanism for ASQs regardless of the strength of the Rashba spin-orbit coupling in planar germanium.
articles.abstract_zh: 在超导体-半导体混合结构中，磁场会破坏库珀对，使超导性与自旋极化相互竞争。本文表明，由纳米尺度铝颗粒嵌入非晶氧化物基体构成的颗粒铝，可在Ge/SiGe异质结构中诱导具有305微电子伏特BCS峰的硬超导隙，并同时耐受面内和面外磁场。借助这种鲁棒性，作者观察到超过50微电子伏特（12 GHz）的Yu-Shiba-Rusinov态塞曼劈裂，并讨论了在平面锗中不依赖Rashba自旋轨道耦合强度驱动Andreev自旋量子比特的机制。
authors: Giorgio Fabris, Paul Falthansl-Scheinecker, Devashish Shah, Daniel Michel Pino, Maksim Borovkov, Anton Bubis, Kevin Roux, Dina Sokolova, Alejandro Andres Juanes, Tommaso Costanzo, Inas Taha, Aziz Genç, Jordi Arbiol, Stefano Calcaterra, Afonso De Cerdeira Oliveira, Daniel Chrastina, Giovanni Isella, Ruben Seoane Souto, Maria Jose Calderon, Ramon Aguado, Jose Carlos Abadillo-Uriel, Georgios Katsaros
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在超导体-半导体混合结构中，超导性和自旋极化是相互竞争的效应，因为磁场会破坏库珀对。利用薄膜和面内磁场可以将二者结合起来；这种方法推动了对马约拉纳零模、Kitaev链和Andreev自旋量子比特（ASQ）的研究，但对于面内g因子较小的材料，或需要面外磁场的情形，仍然具有挑战性。我们证明，颗粒铝（grAl）可以克服这一限制；颗粒铝由嵌入非晶氧化物基体中的纳米米级铝颗粒组成。通过在Ge/SiGe异质结构上沉积颗粒铝，我们诱导出具有305微电子伏特BCS峰的硬超导隙，并使其在面内和面外方向都具有抗磁场能力，从而允许Yu-Shiba-Rusinov（YSR）态的塞曼劈裂超过50微电子伏特（12 GHz）。利用这种鲁棒性，我们揭示了空穴物理的特征，并讨论了在平面锗中驱动Andreev自旋量子比特的一种机制，而且该机制不受Rashba自旋轨道耦合强度的限制。

articles.title: Energy-resolved transport of ultracold atoms across the Anderson transition: theory and experiment
articles.title_zh: 安德森转变附近超冷原子的能量分辨输运：理论与实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22063v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a recent experiment [X. Yu et al., arXiv:2602.07654], energy-resolved measurements of an atomic matter wave spreading in a speckle potential enabled the direct observation of the three-dimensional Anderson transition. In this work, we present a quantitative theoretical description of the matter-wave dynamics based on a tailored implementation of the self-consistent theory of localization, which incorporates both the spectral and spatial properties of the state prepared in the disorder. We benchmark this theoretical approach against ab initio numerical simulations, and use it to analyze the atom density profiles observed experimentally in the localized, diffusive, and critical regimes. Particular emphasis is placed on the key role of the atomic energy distribution, especially on the distinct contributions of Bose-condensed and thermal atoms to interpret the experimental profiles. Our framework provides a versatile and efficient theoretical toolbox for quantitatively describing wave-packet dynamics in three-dimensional disordered quantum systems, which remain challenging for state-of-the-art large-scale numerical simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期实验借助散斑势中原子物质波扩散的能量分辨测量，直接观测到了三维安德森转变。本文基于经专门调整的自洽局域化理论，对物质波动力学进行了定量描述，并纳入了无序态的谱学和空间性质。该框架经第一性原理数值模拟检验，可用于分析局域、扩散和临界区的实验原子密度分布，并突出了玻色凝聚原子与热原子的能量分布差异。
authors: Jean-Philippe Banon, Sacha Barré, Ke Xie, Hoa Mai Quach, Xudong Yu, Yukun Guo, Myneni Niranjan, Alain Aspect, Vincent Josse, Nicolas Cherroret
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在近期的一项实验中[X. Yu等，arXiv:2602.07654]，对散斑势中原子物质波扩散进行的能量分辨测量实现了对三维安德森转变的直接观测。本文提出了一种对物质波动力学的定量理论描述，其基础是经过专门调整的自洽局域化理论实现方案，该方案同时纳入了无序中所制备态的谱学性质和空间性质。我们将这一理论方法与第一性原理数值模拟进行基准比较，并利用它分析在局域、扩散和临界区域实验观测到的原子密度剖面。本文尤其强调了原子能量分布的关键作用，特别是玻色凝聚原子和热原子在解释实验剖面时所作出的不同贡献。我们的框架为定量描述三维无序量子系统中的波包动力学提供了一套通用而高效的理论工具箱；对此类动力学，当前最先进的大规模数值模拟仍面临挑战。

articles.title: Spin-polarized Andreev molecules and anomalous nonlocal Josephson effects in altermagnetic junctions
articles.title_zh: 交替磁结中的自旋极化安德烈夫分子与反常非局域约瑟夫森效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04954v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetism has emerged as a promising ingredient for realizing nontrivial Josephson phases, but so far explored in single Josephson junctions. In this work, we consider the coherent coupling of two Josephson junctions with spin-singlet s-wave superconductivity and demonstrate that d-wave altermagnetism gives rise to spin-polarized Andreev molecules due to the hybridization of Andreev bound states of each junction when the coupling is weak. Interestingly, these spin-polarized Andreev molecules induce an anomalous nonlocal Josephson effect, where the current flow across one Josephson junction due to phase changes across the other junction develops 0-π and φ₀ transitions originating from altermagnetism. Furthermore, the nonlocal Josephson current carried by spin-polarized Andreev molecules exhibits nonreciprocal critical currents, enabling a nonlocal Josephson diode effect whose polarity is tunable by the altermagnetic strength and right phase. Our findings put forward altermagnetism as a promising arena for designing nonlocal spin Josephson phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁性被视为实现非平凡约瑟夫森相位的有前景要素，但此前主要研究单个约瑟夫森结。本文研究两个自旋单态s波超导约瑟夫森结的相干耦合，发现d波交替磁性可在弱耦合下通过安德烈夫束缚态杂化形成自旋极化安德烈夫分子。这些分子诱导反常非局域约瑟夫森效应，并可产生极性可调的非局域约瑟夫森二极管效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁性已成为实现非平凡约瑟夫森相位的一种有前景的要素，但迄今为止主要是在单个约瑟夫森结中得到研究。本文考虑了两个具有自旋单态s波超导性的约瑟夫森结之间的相干耦合，并证明当耦合较弱时，d波交替磁性会由于各结安德烈夫束缚态的杂化而产生自旋极化的安德烈夫分子。有趣的是，这些自旋极化安德烈夫分子会诱导一种反常非局域约瑟夫森效应：一个约瑟夫森结中的电流由另一个结两端的相位变化所驱动，并会出现源于交替磁性的0-π转变和φ₀转变。此外，由自旋极化安德烈夫分子承载的非局域约瑟夫森电流表现出非互易临界电流，从而实现一种非局域约瑟夫森二极管效应，其极性可由交替磁强度和右侧相位调节。我们的发现表明，交替磁性是设计非局域自旋约瑟夫森现象的一个有前景的平台。

articles.title: Ultrafast Formation and Annihilation of Strongly Bound, Anisotropic Excitons
articles.title_zh: 强束缚各向异性激子的超快形成与湮灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26294v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) layered materials with long-range magnetic order have the potential to enable novel optoelectronic and spintronic applications. Among these, CrSBr is an air-stable, direct band gap semiconductor that hosts interlayer antiferromagnetic order, a highly anisotropic electronic structure, and strongly bound excitons. In particular, excitons in CrSBr have been shown to inherit the quasi-one-dimensional nature of the material and also couple to the underlying spinorder. However, mechanisms of exciton formation, dissociation, and interaction with free carriers remain largely unexplored, despite being crucial for spintronic and optoelectronic applications. Here, we employ time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to map the electronic structure and excited state dynamics in CrSBr. We directly resolve an exceptionally large exciton binding energy (~800 meV) and a highly anisotropic momentum space distribution of the exciton, revealing its quasi-1D real-space character. We observe an excitation-density-dependent interconversion between bound excitons and quasi-free carriers on sub- to few-picosecond timescales, indicating that many-body effects govern the excited-state dynamics and optical properties during the initial stages of relaxation. Our work highlights the strongly bound, anisotropic character of excitons in CrSBr, as well as the microscopic interactions steering relaxation pathways after photoexcitation in elevated density regimes relevant for future device applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有长程磁有序的范德华层状材料CrSBr兼具直接带隙、层间反铁磁序和强束缚的各向异性激子。本文利用时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，直接测得约800 meV的巨大激子束缚能及其强各向异性的动量分布。研究还观察到束缚激子与准自由载流子之间依赖激发密度、发生于亚皮秒至数皮秒尺度的相互转化，表明多体效应主导早期弛豫。
authors: Lawson T. Lloyd, Tommaso Pincelli, Mohamed Amine Wahada, Alessandro De Vita, Ferdinand Menzel, Kseniia Mosina, Túlio H. L. G. Castro, Alexander Neef, Andreas V. Stier, Nathan P. Wilson, Zdeněk Sofer, Jonathan J. Finley, Martin Wolf, Laurenz Rettig, Ralph Ernstorfer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有长程磁有序的范德华层状材料有望实现新型光电子和自旋电子应用。其中，CrSBr是一种空气稳定的直接带隙半导体，具有层间反铁磁有序、高度各向异性的电子结构以及强束缚激子。尤其是，已有研究表明CrSBr中的激子继承了该材料的准一维特性，并且还会与底层自旋有序耦合。然而，尽管激子形成、解离及其与自由载流子的相互作用机制对于自旋电子和光电子应用至关重要，但这些机制在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本文采用时间和角度分辨光电子能谱，绘制了CrSBr中的电子结构和激发态动力学。我们直接分辨出异常巨大的激子束缚能（约800 meV）以及激子在动量空间中的高度各向异性分布，揭示了其在实空间中的准一维特征。我们观察到束缚激子与准自由载流子之间存在依赖激发密度的相互转化，其时间尺度从亚皮秒到数皮秒，这表明在弛豫的初始阶段，多体效应支配了激发态动力学和光学性质。我们的工作突出了CrSBr中激子的强束缚和各向异性特征，以及在与未来器件应用相关的较高密度条件下，光激发后引导弛豫路径的微观相互作用。

articles.title: Moiré Mott correlated mosaics in twisted bilayer 1T-TaS₂
articles.title_zh: 扭转双层1T-TaS₂中的莫尔Mott关联马赛克
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02001v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The tunability and twist engineering of van der Waals materials enable the emergence of electronic states not present in individual monolayers. Among them, monolayer 1T-TaS₂ is a well-known Mott insulating system, whose star-of-David charge density wave reconstruction realizes an emergent triangular lattice of local magnetic moments. Interestingly, in its bulk form, the insulating gap is not correlation-driven, but stems from interlayer coupling. Here, we exploit the stacking-dependent nature of the insulating gap to show that in twisted 1T-TaS₂ bilayers, the spatially dependent competition between many-body and single-particle gaps creates Mott-trivial mosaic superlattices, featuring regions with local magnetic moments and non-magnetic insulating regions. We further demonstrate the tunability of the mosaic correlated state with an interlayer bias, giving rise to controllable charge transfer and quenching of correlations. Our results establish twisted 1T-TaS₂ as a flexible platform to engineer mixed spatially modulated correlated insulating phases, arising from the moiré profile.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华材料的扭转工程可产生单层中不存在的电子态。本文利用绝缘隙对堆垛方式的依赖性，表明扭转双层1T-TaS₂中多体关联隙与单粒子隙的空间竞争会形成Mott-平庸马赛克超晶格。该关联态可借助层间偏压调节，从而实现可控电荷转移和关联淬灭。
authors: Ana Vera Montoto, Jose L. Lado, Adolfo O. Fumega
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华材料的可调控性和扭转工程能够产生单个单层中不存在的电子态。其中，单层1T-TaS₂是一个众所周知的Mott绝缘体系，其大卫之星电荷密度波重构形成了由局域磁矩构成的涌现三角晶格。有趣的是，在其块体形式中，绝缘隙并非由关联驱动，而是源于层间耦合。本文利用绝缘隙对堆垛方式的依赖性表明，在扭转1T-TaS₂双层中，多体能隙与单粒子能隙之间随空间变化的竞争会产生Mott-平庸马赛克超晶格，其中包括具有局域磁矩的区域和非磁性绝缘区域。我们进一步证明，该马赛克关联态可通过层间偏压进行调控，从而产生可控的电荷转移和关联淬灭。我们的结果确立了扭转1T-TaS₂作为一个灵活平台，可利用莫尔图样调控来构造空间混合调制的关联绝缘相。
articles.focus_summary: 论文研究扭转双层1T-TaS₂中的莫尔调控关联态，揭示空间变化的多体Mott能隙与层间耦合产生的单粒子能隙之间的竞争。研究发现体系可形成由局域磁矩区域和非磁性绝缘区域组成的关联马赛克超晶格，并可通过层间偏压调控电荷转移和关联性。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的莫尔材料、二维范德华体系、磁性材料、荷电序、强关联材料和界面电荷转移方向直接相关。该工作中的空间调制关联态、局域磁矩和偏压调控机制，可借鉴到二维磁性超晶格、磁性哈密顿量及电荷序耦合研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究扭角、应变和栅压对局域磁交换、磁性相变及拓扑性质的影响，并构建包含电荷序、层间耦合和自旋自由度的有效哈密顿量。建议结合第一性原理、Wannier插值、蒙特卡洛和机器学习模型分析其有限温度行为。

articles.title: The optical Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model on a triangular lattice
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格上的光学Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.04123v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the triangular lattice optical Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model using determinant quantum Monte Carlo. By varying the model's carrier concentration, electron-phonon coupling strength, and phonon energy Ω, we identify two doping regimes of interest. At one-quarter filling (langle nrangle = 0.5), corresponding to the case of a circular noninteracting Fermi surface, we find evidence for a metal to insulating bond-order-wave (BOW) phase transition that breaks a local C₆ rotational symmetry. Conversely, at three-quarters filling (langle nrangle = 1.5), corresponding to a hexagonal Fermi surface, we find evidence for transitions to another BOW phase for small Ω and an s-wave superconducting phase for sufficiently large Ω. This tendency toward pairing appears to be associated with the possibility of a sign change in the effective intersite hopping, which can occur for sufficiently large lattice displacements. We also find no evidence for enhanced magnetic correlations in the model, contrary to what has been reported for square lattice SSH models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用行列式量子蒙特卡洛研究三角晶格光学Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型，并考察载流子浓度、电子-声子耦合和声子能量的影响。在四分之一填充时，研究发现体系可能发生金属到破缺局域C₆旋转对称性的键序波绝缘相转变；在四分之三填充时，小声子能量对应另一种键序波相，而足够大的声子能量可导致s波超导相。研究未发现磁关联增强的证据。
authors: Max Casebolt, Sohan Malkaruge Costa, Benjamin Cohen-Stead, Richard Scalettar, Steven Johnston
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用行列式量子蒙特卡洛研究三角晶格上的光学Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型。通过改变模型的载流子浓度、电子-声子耦合强度和声子能量Ω，我们识别出两个值得关注的掺杂区域。在四分之一填充时（平均粒子数〈n〉=0.5），对应于非相互作用费米面为圆形的情形，我们发现存在从金属到键序波（BOW）绝缘相的相变证据，该相变破坏局域C₆旋转对称性。相反，在四分之三填充时（平均粒子数〈n〉=1.5），对应于六角形费米面，我们发现当Ω较小时向另一种BOW相转变的证据，而当Ω足够大时则向s波超导相转变。这种配对倾向似乎与有效格点间跃迁存在变号的可能性有关；当晶格位移足够大时，便可发生这种变号。与已有关于方格子SSH模型的报道相反，我们也未发现该模型中磁关联增强的证据。

articles.title: Visons in Kitaev Spin Liquids with Majorana Fermi Surfaces
articles.title_zh: 具有马约拉纳费米面的Kitaev自旋液体中的维森
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.23014v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The excitation spectrum of Kitaev quantum spin liquids consists of itinerant Majorana fermions, which can be gapless or gapped, and vortices of a Z₂ gauge field, known as visons, which are new{gapped within a stable mathbb Z₂ spin liquid phase}. In this work, we investigate visons in Kitaev-type models where the Majorana fermions form a Fermi surface. In this case, the creation of a vison pair is analogous to introducing a local impurity potential in a metal. Since the gapless modes lead to strong finite-size effects, we compare the numerical calculation of the newtwo-vison gap on finite lattices with the result from an analytical approach based on Green's function techniques. We find that the newtwo-vison gap decreases as the size of the Fermi surface increases, signalling an instability of the quantum spin liquid ground state. We also show that larger Fermi surfaces tend to suppress the change in local spin correlations due to the Majorana-vison scattering potential.
articles.abstract_zh: Kitaev量子自旋液体的激发包括巡游马约拉纳费米子和Z₂规范场涡旋，即维森。本文研究马约拉纳费米子形成费米面的Kitaev型模型，指出产生维森对类似于在金属中引入局域杂质势。结果显示，双维森能隙会随费米面增大而减小，暗示量子自旋液体基态存在不稳定性。
authors: Caio V. S. Soares, Rodrigo G. Pereira
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kitaev量子自旋液体的激发谱由巡游马约拉纳费米子和Z₂规范场的涡旋组成，前者可以是无能隙或有能隙的，后者被称为维森，并且在稳定的Z₂自旋液体相中是有能隙的。本文研究马约拉纳费米子形成费米面的Kitaev型模型中的维森。在这种情况下，产生一对维森类似于在金属中引入局域杂质势。由于无能隙模导致强烈的有限尺寸效应，我们将有限晶格上双维森能隙的数值计算结果与基于格林函数技术的解析方法结果进行比较。我们发现，双维森能隙会随着费米面尺寸增大而减小，这表明量子自旋液体基态存在不稳定性。我们还表明，较大的费米面倾向于抑制由马约拉纳-维森散射势引起的局域自旋关联变化。

articles.title: Thermodynamic Evidence of Tetracritical Topology in the H-T Phase Diagram of UTe₂ for H parallel b
articles.title_zh: H平行b轴时UTe₂的H-T相图中四临界拓扑的热力学证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25896v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report ultrasound velocity measurements on an ultraclean UTe₂ single crystal with T_c>2~K for H parallel b, performed up to 18~T and down to 0.33~K. The measurements provide the missing bulk thermodynamic evidence for an additional high-field phase boundary near μ₀Hsim14--15~T. A distinct, non-hysteretic anomaly in the longitudinal C₃₃ mode, together with a weaker response in C₄₄, no resolvable anomaly in C₅₅, and a coincident kink in transverse magnetostriction, reveals a symmetry-selective coupling to lattice strain. This mode selectivity places constraints on the symmetry of the field-induced superconducting component. The phase line remains nearly field-constant near 14~T and meets three other phase boundaries at a tetracritical point near 13.5~T and 1.25~K. The results complete the local tetracritical topology of the H--T phase diagram and support field-induced multicomponent superconductivity in UTe₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对超洁净UTe₂单晶在磁场平行b轴条件下开展超声波声速测量，获得了约14-15 T附近额外高场相边界缺失的体相热力学证据。纵向C₃₃模中的显著非滞后异常及其他弹性模的选择性响应，表明场致超导组分与晶格应变存在对称性选择耦合。该相边界与另外三条相边界在约13.5 T、1.25 K处形成四临界点，支持场致多组分超导。
authors: Michal Vališka, Tetiana Haidamak, Andrej Cabala, Petr Proschek, Andreas Hausprug, Sergei Zherlitsyn, Vladimír Sechovský
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了对一块T_c大于2 K的超洁净UTe₂单晶所进行的超声波声速测量；在磁场H平行于b轴的条件下，测量覆盖最高18 T和最低0.33 K。该测量为约μ₀H=14-15 T附近附加高场相边界提供了此前缺失的体相热力学证据。纵向C₃₃模中清晰且无滞后的异常、C₄₄中较弱的响应、C₅₅中未能分辨的异常，以及横向磁致伸缩中同时出现的折点，揭示了对晶格应变具有对称性选择的耦合。这种模选择性对场诱导超导组分的对称性施加了约束。该相边界在约14 T附近几乎不随磁场变化，并在约13.5 T和1.25 K处与另外三条相边界相交于一个四临界点。结果完善了H-T相图局部的四临界拓扑，并支持UTe₂中存在场致多组分超导。

articles.title: Lattice Realization of Twist Defects in a Z₂× Z₂ Topological Order
articles.title_zh: Z₂×Z₂拓扑序中扭转缺陷的晶格实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02039v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we explore a microscopic realization of three types of anyonic symmetries in a Z₂×Z₂ topological order, corresponding to a double toric code. These symmetries act as nontrivial permutations on the anyon labels of the parent state. We consider a setup consisting of two decoupled Wen plaquette models stacked on top of each other and introduce dislocations that modify the Hamiltonian, giving rise to localized twist defects, eventually inducing interactions between the layers. In this context, branch cuts act as sources of anyon permutations when they cross it. We characterize the defects by calculating their quantum dimensions, and we also consider double loop operators around them that allow us to determine the non-Abelian fusion rules between the defects, including when they carry different anyon permutations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探索Z₂×Z₂拓扑序，即双环面码中的三类任意子对称性的微观实现。这些对称性会对母态任意子标签实施非平凡置换；作者通过在两层解耦Wen格点模型中引入位错，构造局域扭转缺陷和层间相互作用。研究还通过量子维数及围绕缺陷的双环算符确定缺陷的非阿贝尔融合规则。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文探索了Z₂×Z₂拓扑序中的三类任意子对称性的微观实现，该拓扑序对应于一个双环面码。这些对称性对母态的任意子标签实施非平凡置换。我们考虑这样一种设置：将两个彼此解耦的Wen格点模型上下堆叠，并引入会改变哈密顿量的位错，从而产生局域的扭转缺陷，并最终诱导层间相互作用。在此背景下，当分支割线被任意子穿过时，它充当任意子置换的源。我们通过计算缺陷的量子维数来表征这些缺陷，同时还考虑了围绕它们的双环算符；这些算符使我们能够确定缺陷之间的非阿贝尔融合规则，包括当缺陷携带不同任意子置换时的情形。

articles.title: A general thermodynamic approach for diffusion on a lattice
articles.title_zh: 晶格上扩散的一般热力学方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02579v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work presents a general thermodynamic approach to describe particle diffusion on a lattice, a model used to study transport processes in solids and on surfaces. By treating each lattice site as an open thermodynamic system, the effects of microscopic particle interactions are represented through the chemical potential. A fundamental relationship between the Onsager matrix (L) and its ideal-system counterpart (Lᵢd, where interactions are neglected) using the determinant of the covariance matrix is demonstrated. This framework allows for the calculation of transport coefficients using the combination of their ideal values and thermodynamic properties. The general result is successfully applied to reproduce the Darken equation for substitutional diffusion in solids and to derive the non-diagonal diffusion matrix of the Zhdanov model for surface diffusion of Langmuir particles. In the last case, analytical predictions are further validated through numerical simulations across various interaction potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种描述晶格粒子扩散的一般热力学框架，将每个晶格位点视为开放热力学系统，并以化学势表征微观粒子相互作用。该框架建立了Onsager矩阵与理想系统Onsager矩阵之间、涉及协方差矩阵行列式的基本关系，可将理想输运系数与热力学性质相结合。该方法成功再现了固体置换扩散的Darken方程，并推导出Langmuir粒子表面扩散Zhdanov模型的非对角扩散矩阵。
authors: Matías A. Di Muro, Miguel Hoyuelos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种描述晶格上粒子扩散的一般热力学方法；晶格模型被用于研究固体内部和表面上的输运过程。通过将每个晶格位点视为一个开放热力学系统，微观粒子相互作用的影响由化学势表征。本文证明了Onsager矩阵L与其理想系统对应量Lᵢd之间的基本关系，其中在理想系统中忽略相互作用，该关系使用协方差矩阵的行列式表述。这一框架能够通过结合输运系数的理想值和热力学性质来计算输运系数。该一般性结果被成功应用于再现固体中置换扩散的Darken方程，并推导出用于Langmuir粒子表面扩散的Zhdanov模型的非对角扩散矩阵。在后一种情形中，解析预测还通过针对各种相互作用势的数值模拟得到了验证。

articles.title: Canonical-ensemble scaling of Tan's contact in the trapped Tonks--Girardeau gas
articles.title_zh: 受限Tonks-Girardeau气体中Tan接触参数的正则系综标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.15994v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We derive the canonical-ensemble scaling of Tan's contact for N harmonically trapped Tonks--Girardeau bosons at finite temperature in the large-N limit. The leading scaling coefficient reproduces the local-density-approximation result and is obtained from a contour-integral representation of the canonical partition function followed by a saddle-point reduction to a phase-space integral with a self-consistent scaled chemical potential. The subleading coefficient is the central new object of this work: it admits an explicit representation in terms of universal phase-space integrals of the Fermi factor, having closed-form Sommerfeld and virial limits, and is identified with the canonical-versus-grand-canonical ensemble difference at fixed mean particle number. In the high-temperature Boltzmann regime the ratio of subleading to leading coefficients collapses to a universal value, traceable to the Poissonian particle-number statistics of the dilute grand-canonical gas. We construct Padé approximants for both scaling functions that interpolate uniformly between the low-temperature Sommerfeld and high-temperature virial regimes; for the subleading coefficient we report a form that is uniformly accurate on our working range of temperatures and asymptotically correct beyond. The scaling law is verified against canonical contour-integration data across the full temperature range, and the experimental visibility of the ensemble correction is quantified: for the mesoscopic particle numbers and temperatures of current one-dimensional experiments it reaches the several-percent level.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导大粒子数极限下有限温度谐振子阱Tonks-Girardeau玻色子体系中Tan接触参数的正则系综标度关系。领先标度系数再现局域密度近似结果，次领先系数则刻画固定平均粒子数时正则系综与巨正则系综的差异。在高温玻尔兹曼区，该系数比值呈现可追溯至稀薄巨正则气体泊松粒子数统计的普适值；研究还给出Padé近似并评估了实验中数百分点量级的系综修正。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导了有限温度下谐振子阱中N个Tonks-Girardeau玻色子的Tan接触参数在大N极限下的正则系综标度关系。领先标度系数再现了局域密度近似的结果，它通过正则配分函数的围道积分表示获得，随后经鞍点近似约化为一个相空间积分，其中包含自洽的标度化学势。次领先系数是本文的核心新对象：它具有以费米因子的普适相空间积分表示的显式形式，在Sommerfeld极限和维里极限下具有闭式表达，并被识别为固定平均粒子数时正则系综与巨正则系综之间的差异。在高温玻尔兹曼区，次领先系数与领先系数之比收敛至一个普适值，这可追溯到稀薄巨正则气体的泊松型粒子数统计。我们为两个标度函数都构造了Padé近似，使其在低温Sommerfeld区与高温维里区之间实现一致插值；对于次领先系数，我们给出了一种在所研究温度范围内一致精确、且在更大范围内渐近正确的形式。该标度定律通过覆盖整个温度范围的正则围道积分数据得到了验证，并且我们量化了系综修正的实验可见性：对于当前一维实验中的介观粒子数和温度，其修正可达到百分之几的水平。

articles.title: Contact-network organization and motion statistics in shear-thickening suspensions
articles.title_zh: 剪切增稠悬浮液中的接触网络组织与运动统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04605v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use lubricated-flow discrete-element-method (LF--DEM) simulations to examine how contact-network organization shapes particle motion in dense shear-thickening suspensions. The primary system studied is a two-dimensional bidisperse monolayer where rigid clusters are identified by the (3,3) pebble game; three-dimensional simulations are shown to have qualitatively similar rotational velocity statistics. Across the stress--solid-fraction state diagram, frictional contact number, kge 3 percolation, and rigid-cluster fluctuations all strengthen in the same region where translational velocity correlations grow, Revision{consistent with coherent translation within rigid clusters and a state-dependent contrast in relative motion between particles inside and outside them}. Rotational motion provides a complementary view: non-affine angular-velocity distributions broaden, Revision{near-contact non-affine rotational fluctuations become increasingly anti-correlated, and particles inside and outside rigid clusters carry distinct statistics}. Connectivity, rigidity, and velocity correlations are related but distinct signatures of the constrained collective motion that accompanies shear thickening and the approach to shear jamming.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用润滑流离散元法模拟，考察接触网络组织如何塑造致密剪切增稠悬浮液中的粒子运动。摩擦接触数、k≥3渗流、刚性团簇涨落与平动速度关联在同一状态区域增强，表明刚性团簇内存在相干平移，且团簇内外粒子的相对运动具有状态依赖性差异。转动统计则显示非仿射角速度分布展宽，近接触粒子的非仿射转动涨落趋于反关联，且刚性团簇内外粒子具有不同统计特征。
authors: Michel Orsi, Rahul Pandare, Brolin Adu-Poku, Bulbul Chakraborty, Jeffrey F. Morris
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用润滑流离散元法（LF-DEM）模拟，考察接触网络组织如何塑造致密剪切增稠悬浮液中的粒子运动。主要研究的体系是一个二维双分散单层，其中通过（3,3）卵石游戏识别刚性团簇；三维模拟显示出定性相似的转动速度统计特征。在整个应力-固相体积分数状态图中，摩擦接触数、k≥3渗流和刚性团簇涨落都在平动速度关联增强的同一区域内加强，这与刚性团簇内的相干平移以及团簇内外粒子相对运动的状态依赖性差异一致。转动运动提供了互补视角：非仿射角速度分布变宽，近接触非仿射转动涨落变得日益反关联，并且刚性团簇内外粒子具有不同的统计特征。连通性、刚性和速度关联彼此相关但又互有区别，它们都是伴随剪切增稠和接近剪切堵塞而出现的受约束集体运动的表征。

articles.title: Phase diagram of the Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ model: Classical and quantum magnetism, frustration, and subdominant interactions
articles.title_zh: Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ模型的相图：经典与量子磁性、受挫和次要相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13263v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Kitaev spin liquid provides a rare example of exactly solvable quantum spin liquid states. Intensive research over the past two decades has identified a variety of its candidate materials. In real materials, however, the Kitaev interaction is inevitably accompanied by additional magnetic interactions such as the Heisenberg and Γ interactions. These interactions often induce magnetic ordering at low temperatures, making it essential to clarify their effects in the search for and design of Kitaev spin liquid candidate materials. In this study, we revisit the ground-state phase diagram of the Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ model from both classical and quantum perspectives, using state-of-the-art numerical techniques. In the classical case, we reveal a zoo of noncollinear orders, where a variety of noncollinear multiple-Q magnetic orders with and without incommensurate modulations emerge. In the quantum case, we unravel that quantum fluctuations suppress many of the competing orders found in the classical case, resulting in a reduced number of dominant incommensurate orders. We further identify highly frustrated regions, where spiral spin liquid states as well as new magnetically ordered states are potentially stabilized by other additional magnetic interactions. Our results provide a comprehensive perspective on the Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ model for both classical and quantum spins and offer a valuable guide not only for interpreting experimental results on candidate materials, but also for searching and designing new materials to realize the Kitaev spin liquid.
articles.abstract_zh: Kitaev自旋液体是少见的可严格求解量子自旋液体，而实际材料中的Kitaev相互作用通常伴随Heisenberg和Γ相互作用。本文利用先进数值方法，从经典和量子两个角度重新研究Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ模型的基态相图。经典情形呈现多种非共线多Q磁序，量子涨落则压制其中许多竞争序并减少主导的非公度有序；研究还识别出可能由额外相互作用稳定螺旋自旋液体或新磁序的高度受挫区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kitaev自旋液体为严格可解量子自旋液体态提供了一个罕见范例。过去二十年的密集研究已经识别出多种可能的候选材料。然而，在真实材料中，Kitaev相互作用不可避免地伴随着诸如Heisenberg相互作用和Γ相互作用等额外磁相互作用。这些相互作用常常在低温下诱发磁有序，因此在寻找和设计Kitaev自旋液体候选材料时，澄清它们的影响至关重要。本研究采用最先进的数值技术，从经典和量子两个角度重新考察Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ模型的基态相图。在经典情形中，我们揭示出多种非共线有序，其中出现了各种带有或不带有非公度调制的非共线多Q磁有序。在量子情形中，我们阐明量子涨落会抑制经典情形中发现的许多竞争有序，从而导致主导的非公度有序数量减少。我们还识别出高度受挫的区域，在这些区域中，螺旋自旋液体态以及新的磁有序态可能由其他额外磁相互作用稳定。我们的结果为经典和量子自旋的Kitaev-Heisenberg-Γ模型提供了全面视角，并为解释候选材料的实验结果以及寻找和设计实现Kitaev自旋液体的新材料提供了有价值的指引。

articles.title: Capturing Nuclear Quantum Effects in Hydrogen Diffusion through MoS2 via Machine-Learning-Enhanced Path-Integral Simulations
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习增强路径积分模拟捕捉氢在MoS2中的扩散核量子效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25991v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrogen transport through layered two-dimensional (2D) materials is central to technologies such as hydrogen storage, fuel cells, and isotope separation. Among these materials, MoS2 exhibits tunable interlayer diffusion properties, whose accurate theoretical description requires accounting for nuclear quantum effects (NQEs), including zero-point motion and tunneling. Here, we present a machine-learning-enhanced atomistic study of hydrogen and deuterium diffusion in layered MoS2 based on interatomic potentials trained on r2SCAN+rVV10 density-functional-theory data. Combining well-tempered metadynamics with path-integral molecular dynamics, we investigate diffusion across multiple MoS2 polytypes and twisted bilayer structures while explicitly incorporating NQEs. Our simulations show that NQEs substantially lower free-energy barriers for hydrogen diffusion at 300 K, significantly increasing the hydrogen self-diffusion coefficient compared to classical nuclei simulations. We further identify a pronounced kinetic isotope effect, with a 35 meV difference between hydrogen and deuterium quantum free-energy barriers. In twisted bilayer MoS2, hydrogen transport exhibits strong spatial variations governed by the local stacking environments within the moiré superlattices. These results highlight the critical role of NQEs in hydrogen transport through layered materials and provide atomistic insight intoisotope-selective diffusion in structurally complex 2D systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 氢穿过层状二维材料的输运对储氢、燃料电池和同位素分离等技术至关重要。该工作以基于r2SCAN+rVV10密度泛函理论数据训练的机器学习原子间势为基础，结合阱温偏置元动力学和路径积分分子动力学，研究多种MoS2多型及扭转双层结构中的氢和氘扩散。结果表明，核量子效应会显著降低300 K下氢扩散的自由能势垒，并产生显著的动力学同位素效应和受莫尔局域堆垛环境控制的空间非均匀输运。
authors: Ismail Eren, Ege Yigit Erbil, Maria-Judith Caisachana-Lozada, Hossein Mirhosseini, Thomas D. Kühne, Agnieszka B. Kuc
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氢穿过层状二维（2D）材料的输运是储氢、燃料电池和同位素分离等技术的核心问题。对于这些材料中的MoS2，其层间扩散性质可调，而对其进行准确的理论描述需要考虑包括零点运动和隧穿在内的核量子效应（NQEs）。在此，我们提出一项由机器学习增强的原子尺度研究，考察层状MoS2中氢和氘的扩散；该研究基于采用r2SCAN+rVV10密度泛函理论数据训练得到的原子间势。通过结合阱温偏置元动力学与路径积分分子动力学，我们在显式纳入核量子效应的条件下，研究了跨越多种MoS2多型和扭转双层结构的扩散。我们的模拟显示，在300 K下，核量子效应显著降低了氢扩散的自由能势垒，与经典核模拟相比，显著提高了氢的自扩散系数。我们进一步识别出显著的动力学同位素效应：氢和氘的量子自由能势垒相差35 meV。在扭转双层MoS2中，氢输运表现出强烈的空间变化，这由莫尔超晶格内的局域堆垛环境所控制。这些结果凸显了核量子效应在层状材料中氢输运里的关键作用，并为结构复杂二维体系中的同位素选择性扩散提供了原子尺度见解。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作以 r2SCAN+rVV10 密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并结合路径积分分子动力学和偏置采样研究氢、氘在层状 MoS2 中的扩散。核量子效应显著降低室温扩散自由能势垒并提高氢扩散系数，同时产生约 35 meV 的氢氘量子势垒差和明显同位素效应。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、分子动力学、二维范德华材料、核量子效应和能源材料输运研究紧密相关。该工作展示了机器学习势与增强采样、路径积分方法结合以研究慢扩散和量子核效应的完整技术路线。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可将该范式用于固态电解质中的锂离子迁移、氢相关缺陷扩散或钙钛矿离子迁移，并比较不同泛函训练数据带来的不确定性。建议进一步分析扭转角、层间距和缺陷对量子扩散势垒及同位素效应的协同调控。

articles.title: Dispersive Readout of a SiMOS Quantum Dot Using a Flip-Chip Integrated Microwave Resonator
articles.title_zh: 利用倒装芯片集成微波谐振器对SiMOS量子点进行色散读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14559v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Heterogeneous integration provides a promising route to combine semiconductor quantum dot devices and superconducting microwave circuits, while allowing each component to be fabricated using an optimized process flow. Here, we demonstrate a flip-chip integrated platform for dispersive readout of silicon metal-oxide semiconductor (SiMOS) quantum dot devices. A SiMOS double quantum dot chip is bonded to a superconducting aluminum resonator chip using indium bump interconnects to enable microwave coupling to the quantum dot gate. We show that the developed flip-chip process is compatible with cryogenic operation of both the SiMOS device and the superconducting resonator, and demonstrate resonator-based detection of charge transitions in the quantum dot system. The readout signal-to-noise ratio follows a dependence of sqrtt with the integration time, reaching SNR = 1 at an integration time of approximately 0.3 ms. These results establish flip-chip bonding as a viable integration approach for SiMOS quantum dot devices operating at both dc and microwave frequencies, with potential applications for resonator-based techniques such as spin-photon coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 异质集成可使半导体量子点器件与超导微波电路分别采用优化工艺制造后再进行结合。该研究通过铟凸点将SiMOS双量子点芯片键合至超导铝谐振器芯片，实现量子点栅极的微波耦合及电荷跃迁的谐振器读出。读出信噪比随积分时间的平方根增长，并在约0.3 ms时达到1，证明该平台可支持直流和微波频率下的SiMOS器件集成。
authors: Vo Kim Hieu Van, Santiago Serrano, Cédric Bohémier, Ajit Dash, Fay E. Hudson, Tuomo Tanttu, Chih Hwan Yang, MengKe Feng, Ensar Vahapoglu, Florian K. Unseld, Wee Han Lim, Andrea Morello, Andrew S. Dzurak, Kok Wai Chan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异质集成为将半导体量子点器件和超导微波电路结合起来提供了一条有前景的途径，同时允许每个组件采用优化的工艺流程制造。在此，我们展示了一个用于硅金属氧化物半导体（SiMOS）量子点器件色散读出的倒装芯片集成平台。一个SiMOS双量子点芯片通过铟凸点互连键合到一块超导铝谐振器芯片上，从而实现对量子点栅极的微波耦合。我们表明，所开发的倒装芯片工艺兼容SiMOS器件和超导谐振器的低温运行，并展示了基于谐振器的量子点系统电荷跃迁探测。读出信噪比随积分时间的平方根呈依赖关系，并在约0.3 ms的积分时间下达到SNR = 1。这些结果确立了倒装芯片键合作为一种可行的集成方案，适用于同时在直流和微波频率下工作的SiMOS量子点器件，并可应用于自旋-光子耦合等基于谐振器的技术。

articles.title: Imaging and characterization of spontaneous vortices in a proximity-induced superconductor
articles.title_zh: 近邻效应诱导超导体中自发涡旋的成像与表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.14697v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Observation of spontaneous symmetry breaking is crucial for understanding continuous second-order phase transitions from disordered to ordered states, which often leads to the formation of topological defects. In superconductors, such topological defects manifest as quantized vortices. However, the formation and observation of spontaneous vortices in a uniform superconductor are challenging because extremely rapid cooling (>108 K/s) is generally required for that purpose. Here we conducted scanning superconducting quantum interference device microscope (SSM) measurements on an MgB2-based proximity-induced superconductor, an intrinsically inhomogeneous system. In this system, individual superconducting domains will reach internal equilibrium independently during cooling and choose their own phase before the global phase coherence is established via the long-range proximity coupling. The SSM measurements demonstrate that vortices are nucleated spontaneously even at a relatively slow cooling rate (~0.2 K/s). We also find that the vortices with different polarities, sizes, and shapes appear stochastically under near-zero-field conditions. The geometry of the spontaneous vortices is more extended than that of the field-induced Abrikosov vortices. Magnetic field profile analysis based on the London model elucidates that penetration depths of the extended vortices are anomalously large, exceeding several micrometers. This unusual morphology of the spontaneous vortices most likely imprints the information that is frozen at the moment of vortex formation. Our findings not only provide insights into the local phase differences present in the early stage of the phase transition in this proximity-induced superconducting system, but they also shed insights into the structure, formation, and stabilization of topological defects in highly disordered and inhomogeneous superconducting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 自发对称性破缺常伴随拓扑缺陷形成，但均匀超导体中自发涡旋通常需要极快速冷却才可观测。该研究利用扫描超导量子干涉器件显微镜，对本征非均匀的MgB2基近邻效应诱导超导体进行测量，在约0.2 K/s的缓慢冷却下观察到随机成核的自发涡旋。其尺寸和形态比外场诱导的Abrikosov涡旋更为延展，伦敦模型分析表明其穿透深度异常大，可超过数微米。
authors: Iku Nakaaki, Kotaro Taki, Mio Nomura, Haruna Ishimaru, Minagi Yono, Jun Chen, Hiroyo Segawa, Akiko Nakamura, Taku Moronaga, Minoru Tachiki, Shuuichi Ooi, Shunichi Arisawa, Tsutomu Nojima, Takashi Uchino
articles.abstract_zh_full: 观测自发对称性破缺对于理解从无序态到有序态的连续二级相变至关重要，这一过程往往会导致拓扑缺陷的形成。在超导体中，这类拓扑缺陷表现为量子化涡旋。然而，在均匀超导体中，自发涡旋的形成和观测具有挑战性，因为通常需要极快的冷却速率（>10⁸ K/s）才能实现这一目的。在此，我们对一种MgB2基近邻效应诱导超导体进行了扫描超导量子干涉器件显微镜（SSM）测量，该体系本征上是不均匀的。在该体系中，冷却期间各个超导畴会独立达到内部平衡，并在通过长程近邻耦合建立全局相干之前各自选择其相位。SSM测量表明，即使在相对较慢的冷却速率（约0.2 K/s）下，涡旋也会自发成核。我们还发现，在近零磁场条件下，具有不同极性、尺寸和形状的涡旋以随机方式出现。自发涡旋的几何尺度比磁场诱导的Abrikosov涡旋更为延展。基于伦敦模型的磁场剖面分析阐明，这些延展涡旋的穿透深度异常大，超过数微米。自发涡旋这种不同寻常的形态，极有可能记录了涡旋形成瞬间被冻结的信息。我们的发现不仅为理解该近邻效应诱导超导体系在相变早期存在的局域相位差提供了见解，也为高度无序和非均匀超导体系中拓扑缺陷的结构、形成与稳定化提供了认识。

articles.title: Spatial Leggett-Garg inequalities
articles.title_zh: 空间Leggett-Garg不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.03440v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We formulate a spatial extension of the Leggett-Garg inequality by considering three distant observers locally measuring a many-body system at three subsequent times. The spatial form is especially suitable to test the ability of quantum devices to generate spatio-temporal correlations in a Hamiltonian-agnostic manner. We illustrate our proposal for a Heisenberg chain in a magnetic field, showing indeed that the first inequality-violation time scales proportionally to the distance between measuring parties. We attribute this phenomenon to Lieb-Robinson physics and, confirming this connection, we find that violations are anticipated when increasing the interaction range. The inequality violation is readily observable in current quantum simulation platforms, particularly Rydberg atoms arrays and ultracold atoms in optical lattices. In outlook, spatial Leggett-Garg inequalities constitute a practical tool for benchmarking the complex non-relativistic dynamics of many-body quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出Leggett-Garg不等式的空间扩展形式，由相距甚远的三位观察者在连续三个时刻对多体系统进行局域测量。以磁场中的海森堡链为例，首次违反不等式的时间与测量方之间的距离成正比，这与Lieb-Robinson物理有关；增大相互作用范围会使违反更早发生。该方案可在里德伯原子阵列和光晶格中的超冷原子等现有量子模拟平台上观测，并可用于基准测试多体量子动力学。
authors: Guillem Müller-Rigat, Donato Farina, Maciej Lewenstein, Andrea Tononi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过考虑三位相距甚远的观察者在连续三个时刻对一个多体系统进行局域测量，构建了Leggett-Garg不等式的空间扩展形式。该空间形式尤其适合以一种不依赖于具体哈密顿量的方式，检验量子器件产生时空关联的能力。我们以处于磁场中的海森堡链说明该方案，结果确实显示，首次违反不等式的时间与测量方之间的距离成正比。我们将这一现象归因于Lieb-Robinson物理；作为对这种联系的确认，我们发现，当增大相互作用范围时，不等式违反会提前出现。目前的量子模拟平台可直接观测到这种不等式违反，特别是里德伯原子阵列和光晶格中的超冷原子平台。展望未来，空间Leggett-Garg不等式构成了一种实用工具，可用于基准测试多体量子系统复杂的非相对论动力学。

articles.title: Topological Dirac cluster synchronization on directed hypergraphs
articles.title_zh: 有向超图上的拓扑狄拉克簇同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.14729v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Topological higher-order synchronization reveals collective phenomena demonstrating how topology shapes dynamics, yet providing a general theoretical framework for designing and controlling dynamical states on higher-order networks remains a challenge of the field. Here we propose a dynamical systems framework for topological cluster synchronization on directed hypergraphs that can be used to design synchronization patterns on nodes and hyperedges of directed hypergraphs. By encoding oriented hyperedges into the hypergraph topological Dirac Hamiltonian, we obtain a spectrum whose isolated eigenstates correspond to distinct topological synchronization cluster states defined jointly on nodes and hyperedges. By selecting any isolated eigenstate, the system can be driven toward the associated dynamical state reflecting a specific partition of the hypergraph without modifying the underlying hypergraph structure. We numerically demonstrate the ability to design different topological cluster synchronization states on directed-hypergraph block models and empirical systems-including higher-order contact networks and the ABIDE functional brain network. Our results establish a general and interpretable route for controlling collective dynamics in directed higher-order systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 高阶拓扑同步揭示了拓扑如何塑造集体动力学，但在高阶网络上设计和控制动力学状态仍缺乏通用理论框架。该工作提出有向超图上拓扑簇同步的动力系统框架，将定向超边编码到超图拓扑狄拉克哈密顿量中，并利用对应于不同节点-超边联合同步簇状态的孤立本征态实现状态设计。数值结果表明，该方法可在有向超图块模型、接触网络和ABIDE功能脑网络中设计不同同步态，而无需改变原有超图结构。
authors: Yupeng Guo, Ahmed A. A. Zaid, Xueming Liu, Ginestra Bianconi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑高阶同步揭示了拓扑如何塑造动力学的集体现象，但为在高阶网络上设计和控制动力学状态提供通用理论框架，仍是该领域面临的挑战。在此，我们提出了一个用于有向超图上拓扑簇同步的动力系统框架，可用于设计有向超图节点和超边上的同步模式。通过将定向超边编码进超图拓扑狄拉克哈密顿量，我们获得了一种谱，其中孤立本征态对应于定义在节点和超边上的不同拓扑同步簇状态。通过选择任意一个孤立本征态，可将系统驱动至与之关联的动力学状态；该状态反映超图的一种特定划分，且无需修改底层超图结构。我们通过数值方法展示了在有向超图块模型和实证系统中设计不同拓扑簇同步状态的能力，这些系统包括高阶接触网络和ABIDE功能脑网络。我们的结果建立了一条通用且可解释的路径，用于控制有向高阶系统中的集体动力学。

articles.title: Spin bath mediated long-lived coherent oscillations of NV centers in diamond
articles.title_zh: 自旋浴介导的金刚石NV中心长寿命相干振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.30146v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Decoherence is the biggest bottleneck in all quantum technologies. For nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, the loss of coherence is caused by the electron and nuclear spin bath of the diamond lattice. Here, we demonstrate that the spin bath - that typically causes decoherence - entangles the spin states of the NV electron and the host ¹⁴N nucleus.
