What distinguishes the field is not capability but that its one-step operator admits an exact runtime stability check - a difference of kind, not of existence: learned recurrences carry certificates too, sufficient and conservative ones. A kill-gate with a positive control finds no evidence for the field as evidence accumulator (Delta AUC +0.0007 [-0.0065, +0.0079] vs a 0.03 threshold). A dynamic internal field is a viable, certifiable compute governor, but not an enhancer of cognition: it modulates, it does not think.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作考察具有显式物理动力学和可认证稳定性的低维稳态内部场，能否作为 Transformer 的计算调控器，决定计算量、停止时机及模块激活。作者给出图拉普拉斯算子上 PDE 族积分器的稳定性认证，并证明带速度耦合 Verlet 方法的离散 Schur--Cohn 判据。预注册去混杂实验显示，该内部场并未提升认知能力或充当证据累积器；其主要区别在于一步算子可进行精确的运行时稳定性检查。
authors: Francisco M. Arrabal-Campos, Ignacio Fernandez, Francisco G. Montoya, Alfredo Alcayde
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个智能系统不仅进行推理：它还要管理自身的推理，即计算多少、何时停止以及激活哪个模块。这个角色能否由一种动态内部场来承担，即一种具有显式物理规律和经认证稳定性的低维稳态状态，它调制认知而不执行认知？我们的场定义在模块图上，由图拉普拉斯算子上的一族偏微分方程支配，并随自适应深度推理器推进。我们认证的是整个方程族积分器的稳定性，即积分器证书，而不是闭环证书。本文提出并证明了一项新结果：对于具有速度耦合的 Verlet 方法，给出了离散 Schur--Cohn 判据；该判据对每个潜在根都是充要的，且不需要交换性假设。答案分为三部分：在实质能力上是否定的，在结构上仅部分成立，在可认证性上则是肯定的。场的物理类型与准确率无关：波动、扩散、门控混合以及二维 Navier--Stokes 基质的表现相当。一项包含二十个随机种子、预注册的去混杂研究界定了结构性主张：在上限均衡时，二阶效应在一个模型族中很强（+0.087 [+0.042, +0.132]，t=4.0），但在另一个模型族中未被检测到（+0.014 [-0.013, +0.040]，不显著）；因此，原先的部分对比源于容量而非阶数；并且，接口匹配的 GRU 在第一个模型族中无差异，在第二个模型族中名义上优于该场（-0.035 [-0.067, -0.002]）。该场的区别不在于能力，而在于其一步算子允许精确的运行时稳定性检查，这是一种性质上的差异，而非是否存在证书的差异：学习型递归同样具有证书，只是其证书是充分且保守的。一项带正对照的终止门实验没有发现该场作为证据累积器的证据（ΔAUC 为 +0.0007 [-0.0065, +0.0079]，而阈值为 0.03）。动态内部场是一种可行且可认证的计算调控器，但并非认知增强器：它调制，而不思考。

articles.title: Provable Quantum--Classical Separation for Continuous Gibbs Sampling
articles.title_zh: 连续 Gibbs 采样的可证明量子--经典分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24527v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove the first quantum--classical separation for a sampling problem over a continuous domain. For a class of Gibbs states ppropto e⁻β E on the torus T^d with smooth (s-Gevrey) potential and barrier amplitude α=eβΔ, where Δ = max E-min E, every classical algorithm---querying the value, gradient, or any higher-order derivatives of the log-density---requires Ω(α) queries to sample at constant accuracy in total variation distance, while a quantum algorithm based on quantum singular value thresholding and temperature annealing samples with tildeOleft(sqrtαright) queries to an oracle for the gradient. The advantage is quadratic in the barrier amplitude, which becomes exponential in the dimension, eΩ⁽d⁾, at low temperature. The classical bound is information-theoretic, holding for every classical algorithm with query access to the Gibbs potential and its derivatives at any order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作证明了连续定义域采样问题中的首个量子--经典分离结果。对于环面上的一类具有光滑势能的 Gibbs 态，任何可查询对数密度及任意阶导数的经典算法，在常数总变差精度下均需 Ω(α) 次查询；基于量子奇异值阈值化和温度退火的量子算法仅需约 Õ(√α) 次梯度预言机查询。低温时，该关于势垒振幅的二次优势会随维度变为指数级。
authors: Enrico Olivucci, Mariia Sobchuk, Sehmimul Hoque, Jeffrey Hnybida, Kyungho W. Kim, Ala Shayeghi, Pooya Ronagh
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了连续定义域上一个采样问题的首个量子--经典分离。对于环面 T^d 上一类 Gibbs 态 p ∝ e⁻βE，其势函数是光滑的（s-Gevrey），势垒振幅为 α=eβΔ，其中 Δ=max E-min E；每一种经典算法，无论其查询的是对数密度的值、梯度还是任意高阶导数，要以总变差距离中的常数精度进行采样，都需要 Ω(α) 次查询；而一种基于量子奇异值阈值化和温度退火的量子算法，对梯度预言机仅需约 Õ(√α) 次查询即可采样。这种优势关于势垒振幅是二次的，并且在低温下会随维度变为指数级，即 eΩ⁽d⁾。该经典下界是信息论意义上的，对任何能够查询 Gibbs 势及其任意阶导数的经典算法均成立。

articles.title: When Similarity Is Interaction-Driven: Quantum Kernels for Regime-Sensitive Learning
articles.title_zh: 当相似性由交互驱动时：用于机制敏感学习的量子核
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24631v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Similarity in many decision systems is governed not by distance alone but by interactions among variables. In fraud and anomaly detection, small local perturbations can cross interaction-sensitive decision boundaries while leaving ambient distance almost unchanged. Motivated by this setting, we introduce a thin-slab interaction model and an interaction-driven quantum kernel constructed from entangled Pauli-string feature maps. The feature map explicitly encodes sparse high-order block interactions. We show that the resulting fidelity kernel is positive semidefinite, admits an exact block-factorized formulation, and induces a geometry sensitive to changes in interaction regime. Across balanced and imbalanced synthetic experiments spanning third-, fourth-, sixth-, and eighth-order interactions, the proposed kernel consistently outperforms linear, radial basis function, Laplacian, and polynomial kernels, as well as an engineered-interaction linear baseline supplied with the planted block products. On real fraud-detection benchmarks, it achieves the highest mean accuracy and F1 on Credit Card Fraud Detection and ranks second on IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection. These findings show that quantum-kernel performance depends on alignment between feature-map geometry and the underlying predictive structure, rather than on Hilbert-space dimension alone. Because the prescribed block-factorized kernel can also be evaluated exactly on a classical computer, the results establish predictive and representational value rather than computational quantum speedup.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多决策问题中的相似性取决于变量间交互，而不只是样本间距离。该工作提出薄层交互模型及由纠缠 Pauli 串特征映射构建的交互驱动量子核，显式编码稀疏高阶块交互，并证明所得保真度核是半正定且可精确块分解。实验显示，该核在合成任务和部分真实欺诈检测基准上优于多种经典核，但作者强调其贡献在于预测和表示能力，而非量子计算加速。
authors: Hanqiu Peng, Jianlong Lu, Ying Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多决策系统中的相似性并非仅由距离支配，而是由变量之间的交互支配。在欺诈和异常检测中，微小的局部扰动可能跨越对交互敏感的决策边界，同时几乎不改变环境空间距离。受这一场景启发，我们引入薄层交互模型，以及一种由纠缠 Pauli 串特征映射构建的交互驱动量子核。该特征映射显式编码稀疏的高阶块交互。我们表明，所得保真度核是正半定的，具有精确的块分解形式，并诱导出对交互机制变化敏感的几何结构。在涵盖三阶、四阶、六阶和八阶交互的平衡与不平衡合成实验中，所提出的核始终优于线性核、径向基函数核、拉普拉斯核和多项式核，也优于提供了植入块乘积的工程交互线性基线。在真实欺诈检测基准上，它在 Credit Card Fraud Detection 中获得最高平均准确率和 F1 值，并在 IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection 中排名第二。这些发现表明，量子核的性能取决于特征映射几何与底层预测结构之间的匹配，而非仅取决于希尔伯特空间维度。由于所规定的块分解核也能够在经典计算机上精确求值，这些结果确立的是预测和表征价值，而不是计算上的量子加速。

articles.title: Score-Based Ideal Observer Approximation via Denoising Score Matching for Signal-Known-Exactly Detection Tasks
articles.title_zh: 通过去噪评分匹配实现信号精确已知检测任务的基于评分理想观察者近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Bayesian Ideal Observer (IO) establishes the theoretical upper bound on task performance for binary detection tasks. However, analytical computation of the IO test statistic is generally intractable. Numerical approaches based on Markov-chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods, including their recent deep generative model-based extensions, typically require extensive posterior sampling for each test image. Supervised learning has also been investigated to approximate the IO performance. However, such methods are typically trained for a specific detection task and signal and may require retraining when the task or signal changes. The score function, defined as the gradient of the log probability density, encodes the local geometry of the data distribution and is a fundamental quantity in modern score-based generative modeling. This work reformulates the IO test statistic in terms of the score function and introduces a score-based ideal observer (SIO). The proposed SIO uses a denoising convolutional neural network trained exclusively on signal-absent images to estimate the signal-absent score function. Once trained, the resulting score model can be used to approximate the IO test statistic for detection tasks involving arbitrary additive signals, without per-image posterior sampling or signal-specific retraining. Numerical studies consider a signal-known-exactly (SKE) detection task with a stochastic lumpy-background model. The results demonstrate that the proposed SIO can closely approximate the IO performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝叶斯理想观察者为二元检测任务性能提供理论上界，但其检验统计量通常难以解析计算，现有数值方法往往需要针对每幅测试图像进行大量后验采样。该工作将理想观察者检验统计量改写为评分函数形式，并提出基于评分的理想观察者（SIO）。SIO 仅使用无信号图像训练去噪卷积网络，随后便可对任意加性信号的检测任务近似理想观察者，无需逐图像采样或按信号重新训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 贝叶斯理想观察者（IO）为二元检测任务中的任务性能确立了理论上界。然而，IO 检验统计量的解析计算通常难以处理。基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法的数值方法，包括其近期基于深度生成模型的扩展，通常需要针对每幅测试图像进行大量后验采样。监督学习也已被用于近似 IO 性能。然而，这类方法通常针对特定检测任务和信号进行训练，并且当任务或信号改变时可能需要重新训练。评分函数定义为对数概率密度的梯度，它编码了数据分布的局部几何，并且是现代基于评分的生成建模中的基本量。本工作将 IO 检验统计量重新表述为评分函数的形式，并引入基于评分的理想观察者（SIO）。所提出的 SIO 使用仅在无信号图像上训练的去噪卷积神经网络，来估计无信号评分函数。一旦训练完成，所得评分模型即可用于近似涉及任意加性信号的检测任务的 IO 检验统计量，而不需要逐图像后验采样或针对特定信号重新训练。数值研究考虑了具有随机团块背景模型的信号精确已知（SKE）检测任务。结果表明，所提出的 SIO 能够紧密近似 IO 性能。

articles.title: Quantum Maximum Entropy Inference and Hamiltonian Learning
articles.title_zh: 量子最大熵推断与哈密顿量学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.11473v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Maximum entropy inference and learning of graphical models are pivotal tasks in learning theory and optimization. This work extends algorithms for these problems, including generalized iterative scaling (GIS) and gradient descent (GD), to the quantum realm. While the generalization, known as quantum iterative scaling (QIS), is straightforward, the key challenge lies in the non-commutative nature of quantum problem instances, rendering the convergence rate analysis significantly more challenging than the classical case. Our principal technical contribution centers on a rigorous analysis of the convergence rates, involving the establishment of both lower and upper bounds on the spectral radius of the Jacobian matrix for each iteration of these algorithms. Furthermore, we explore quasi-Newton methods to enhance the performance of QIS and GD. Specifically, we propose using Anderson mixing and the L-BFGS method for QIS and GD, respectively. These quasi-Newton techniques exhibit remarkable efficiency gains, resulting in orders of magnitude improvements in performance. As an application, our algorithms provide a viable approach to designing Hamiltonian learning algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 最大熵推断和图模型学习是学习理论与优化中的重要问题。该工作将广义迭代尺度法和梯度下降扩展到量子情形，并针对量子非交换性导致的收敛分析困难，严格给出每次迭代雅可比矩阵谱半径的上下界。作者还将 Anderson 混合与 L-BFGS 等拟牛顿技术分别用于量子迭代尺度法和梯度下降，实现数量级性能提升，并应用于哈密顿量学习算法设计。
authors: Minbo Gao, Zhengfeng Ji, Fuchao Wei
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最大熵推断和图模型学习是学习理论与优化中的关键任务。本工作将这些问题的算法，包括广义迭代尺度法（GIS）和梯度下降法（GD），扩展到量子领域。尽管这种推广，即量子迭代尺度法（QIS），是直接的，但关键挑战在于量子问题实例的非交换性质，这使得收敛速率分析相比经典情形显著更具挑战性。我们的主要技术贡献在于对收敛速率进行严格分析，其中包括为这些算法每次迭代中的雅可比矩阵谱半径建立下界和上界。此外，我们探索拟牛顿方法以提升 QIS 和 GD 的性能。具体而言，我们提出对 QIS 使用 Anderson 混合，对 GD 使用 L-BFGS 方法。这些拟牛顿技术表现出显著的效率增益，使性能提高了多个数量级。作为一项应用，我们的算法为设计哈密顿量学习算法提供了一种可行路径。

articles.title: Round-trip Reinforcement Learning: Self-Consistent Training for Better Chemical LLMs
articles.title_zh: 往返强化学习：用于改进化学大语言模型的自洽训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.01527v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are emerging as versatile foundation models for computational chemistry, handling bidirectional tasks like reaction prediction and retrosynthesis. However, these models often lack round-trip consistency. For instance, a state-of-the-art chemical LLM may successfully caption a molecule, yet be unable to accurately reconstruct the original structure from its own generated text. This inconsistency suggests that models are learning unidirectional memorization rather than flexible mastery. Indeed, recent work has demonstrated a strong correlation between a model's round-trip consistency and its performance on the primary tasks. This strong correlation reframes consistency into a direct target for model improvement. We therefore introduce Round-Trip Reinforcement Learning (RTRL), a novel framework that trains a model to improve its consistency by using the success of a round-trip transformation as a reward signal. We further propose an iterative variant where forward and reverse mappings alternately train each other in a self-improvement loop, a process that is highly data-efficient and notably effective with the massive amount of unlabelled data common in chemistry. Experiments demonstrate that RTRL significantly boosts performance and consistency over strong baselines across supervised, self-supervised, and synthetic data regimes. This work shows that round-trip consistency is not just a desirable property but a trainable objective, offering a new path toward more robust and reliable foundation models.
articles.abstract_zh: 大语言模型可处理反应预测和逆合成等双向计算化学任务，但常缺乏往返一致性，即无法从自身生成的描述中准确重建原始分子结构。该工作提出往返强化学习（RTRL），将往返变换成功与否作为奖励信号，以直接提升模型一致性；其迭代变体还使正向和反向映射交替自训练。实验表明，该方法在监督、自监督和合成数据条件下均提升了强基线的性能和一致性。
authors: Lecheng Kong, Xiyuan Wang, Yixin Chen, Muhan Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大语言模型（LLM）正成为计算化学中多功能的基础模型，可处理反应预测和逆合成等双向任务。然而，这些模型通常缺乏往返一致性。例如，一个最先进的化学大语言模型可能能够成功描述一个分子，却无法从自己生成的文本中准确重建原始结构。这种不一致性表明，模型学习到的可能是单向记忆，而非灵活掌握。事实上，近期工作已经表明，模型的往返一致性与其在主要任务上的表现之间存在很强的相关性。这种强相关性将一致性重新定义为模型改进的直接目标。因此，我们引入往返强化学习（RTRL），这是一个新框架，通过将往返变换成功作为奖励信号来训练模型提升其一致性。我们还提出一种迭代变体，其中正向和反向映射交替训练彼此，形成自我改进循环；该过程的数据效率很高，并且对于化学中常见的大量无标签数据尤其有效。实验表明，在监督、自监督和合成数据设置下，RTRL 均能相对于强基线显著提升性能和一致性。这项工作表明，往返一致性不仅是一种理想属性，还是一个可训练目标，为构建更稳健、更可靠的基础模型提供了新路径。

articles.title: α-PFN: Fast Entropy Search via In-Context Learning
articles.title_zh: α-PFN：通过上下文学习实现快速熵搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07134v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Information-theoretic acquisition functions such as Entropy Search (ES) offer a principled exploration-exploitation framework for Bayesian optimization (BO). However, their practical implementation relies on complicated and slow approximations, i.e., a Monte Carlo estimation of the information gain. This complexity can introduce numerical errors and requires specialized, hand-crafted implementations. We propose a two-stage amortization strategy that learns to approximate entropy search-based acquisition functions using Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) in a single forward pass. A first PFN is trained to be conditioned on information about the optima; second, the α-PFN is trained to predict the expected information gain by training on information gains measured with the first PFN. The α-PFN offers a flexible learned approximation, which replaces the complex heuristic approximations with a single forward pass per candidate, enabling rapid and extensible acquisition evaluation. Empirically, our approach is competitive with state-of-the-art entropy search implementations on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, while accelerating the different entropy search variants across all our experiments, with speed ups over 50x. Source code: https://github.com/automl/AlphaPFN.
articles.abstract_zh: 熵搜索等信息论采集函数为贝叶斯优化提供了有原则的探索与利用框架，但通常依赖复杂且缓慢的蒙特卡洛信息增益近似。该工作提出两阶段摊销策略：先训练一个以最优值信息为条件的 PFN，再训练 α-PFN 预测前者测得的期望信息增益。α-PFN 可通过每个候选点的一次前向传播快速评估采集函数，在合成和真实基准上保持竞争力，并报告超过 50 倍的加速。
authors: Herilalaina Rakotoarison, Steven Adriaensen, Tom Viering, Carl Hvarfner, Samuel Müller, Frank Hutter, Eytan Bakshy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 熵搜索（ES）等信息论采集函数为贝叶斯优化（BO）提供了一个有原则的探索--利用框架。然而，它们的实际实现依赖复杂而缓慢的近似，即对信息增益进行蒙特卡洛估计。这种复杂性可能引入数值误差，并且需要专门设计的人工实现。我们提出一种两阶段摊销策略，利用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）在单次前向传播中学习近似基于熵搜索的采集函数。第一阶段训练一个 PFN，使其以关于最优值的信息为条件；第二阶段训练 α-PFN，使其通过在由第一个 PFN 测得的信息增益上训练来预测期望信息增益。α-PFN 提供了一种灵活的学习型近似，它以每个候选点一次前向传播取代复杂的启发式近似，从而实现快速且可扩展的采集函数评估。经验上，我们的方法在合成和真实世界基准上与最先进的熵搜索实现具有竞争力，同时在全部实验中加速了不同熵搜索变体，速度提升超过 50 倍。

articles.title: Lightweight Adaptive Feature Composition for Heterogeneous Downstream Adaptation of Wireless Foundation Models
articles.title_zh: 面向无线基础模型异构下游适配的轻量级自适应特征组合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10277v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mobile systems increasingly rely on heterogeneous learning-enabled wireless functions, for which separate taskspecific models incur redundant training and model-management overhead. Wireless foundation models (WFMs) enable these functions to share a pretrained backbone, but existing adaptation either updates the backbone per task or relies on an inflexible final-layer representation. We observe that intermediate WFM layers exhibit distinct depth-dependent correlation structures. Based on this observation, we propose a Routing Adapter for Feature Composition (RAFC), which summarizes selected hidden states into compact descriptors, generates task- and sampledependent routing weights, and combines the original fullresolution features without updating the pretrained backbone. Its gains arise from giving each task adaptive access to complementary representations across multiple depths rather than restricting it to the final layer. Experiments across four task categories and three WFM backbones show improvements in every evaluated backbone-task pair, with mean relative gains across the four task categories ranging from 2.9% to 35.9%, while RAFC adds only 0.003M-0.049M trainable parameters across the evaluated backbones. Experiments on a portable softwaredefined radio testbed further demonstrate improved end-to-end receiver robustness, particularly under partial-band co-channel interference. These results establish RAFC as a lightweight, model-agnostic, and interpretable adaptation interface for WFMs in mobile systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 移动系统日益依赖异构的学习驱动无线功能，为每项任务分别训练模型会带来冗余训练和模型管理开销。本文发现无线基础模型中间层具有随深度变化的不同相关性结构，并提出特征组合路由适配器RAFC，在不更新预训练骨干网络的条件下自适应融合多层特征。实验表明，RAFC在四类任务和三种无线基础模型上均有提升，仅增加极少量可训练参数，并在软件定义无线电平台上增强了端到端接收机的鲁棒性。
authors: Yuxuan Shi, Tingting Yang, Li Sun, Liwen Jing, Kangning Ma, Yuwei Wang, Mengfan Zheng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 移动系统日益依赖异构的、由学习驱动的无线功能，而为不同任务分别配置专用模型会带来冗余的训练与模型管理开销。无线基础模型（WFM）使这些功能能够共享同一个预训练骨干网络，但现有适配方法要么针对每个任务更新骨干网络，要么依赖缺乏灵活性的最终层表示。我们观察到，WFM的中间层呈现出随网络深度而变化的不同相关性结构。基于这一观察，我们提出特征组合路由适配器（RAFC）：该方法将选定的隐藏状态概括为紧凑描述符，生成依赖任务和样本的路由权重，并在不更新预训练骨干网络的情况下组合原始的全分辨率特征。其性能提升源于为每项任务提供对跨多个深度的互补表示的自适应访问，而非将其限制于最终层。针对四类任务和三种WFM骨干网络的实验显示，RAFC在每一个被评估的骨干网络-任务组合上均实现提升，四类任务的平均相对增益范围为2.9%至35.9%；同时，在所评估的骨干网络中，RAFC仅增加0.003M至0.049M个可训练参数。便携式软件定义无线电测试平台上的实验进一步表明，其提升了端到端接收机的鲁棒性，尤其是在部分频带同信道干扰条件下。上述结果表明，RAFC是一种面向移动系统中WFM的轻量级、模型无关且可解释的适配接口。

articles.title: Data Mixing as Mixture Experiment: Response Surface Methodology and Optimal Design for Large Language Model Pretraining
articles.title_zh: 将数据混合作为混合实验：面向大语言模型预训练的响应面方法与最优设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23922v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data mixing is a central design problem in large language model pretraining: given a fixed token budget, practitioners must decide how much data to allocate to each domain. Recent proxy-based methods address this problem by training small models on candidate mixtures, fitting a response model, and using the response to select mixtures for larger-scale training. We show that this workflow has the structure of a classical mixture experiment. Under this view, data domains are mixture components, token shares are component proportions, proxy-training runs are experimental design points, and validation loss defines a response surface over the probability simplex. We develop this formulation using sparse second-order Scheffé response-surface models and construct model-robust I-optimal designs for proxy data-mixing experiments. Using RegMix as an empirical case study, we demonstrate how the framework can both interpret observed mixture responses and design more efficient proxy experiments. The Scheffé analysis shows that domain value is strongly relational: several domains that are weak under additive effects become favourable through pairwise interactions, especially through combinations with web-derived text. The sparse Scheffé model preserves mixture rankings across model scales and remains competitive with a flexible machine-learning predictor while providing an explicit decomposition of additive and interaction effects. In a simulation study calibrated to observed proxy-training responses, model-robust I-optimal designs recover the relevant mixture ordering after removing about 25% of the original proxy runs. These results suggest that LLM data mixing should be treated not only as a prediction problem, but also as an experimental-design problem in which the proxy mixtures themselves can be chosen to improve statistical efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 大语言模型预训练中的数据混合需要在固定词元预算下确定各领域数据的分配比例。本文将这一问题建模为经典混合实验，采用稀疏二阶Scheffe响应面模型，并构建模型稳健的I最优设计来提高代理实验效率。以RegMix为例的分析表明，领域价值高度依赖于交互关系，且在去除约25%的原始代理训练运行后，所提设计仍可恢复相关混合方案的排序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数据混合是大语言模型预训练中的一个核心设计问题：在固定的词元预算下，实践者必须决定向每个领域分配多少数据。近期基于代理的方法通过在候选混合方案上训练小模型、拟合响应模型，并利用该响应为更大规模训练选择混合方案，来解决这一问题。我们表明，这一工作流程具有经典混合实验的结构。在这一视角下，数据领域是混合组分，词元份额是组分比例，代理训练运行是实验设计点，而验证损失则定义了概率单纯形上的响应曲面。我们利用稀疏二阶Scheffe响应面模型构建该表述，并为代理数据混合实验设计模型稳健的I最优方案。以RegMix为实证案例研究，我们展示了该框架如何既能解释观察到的混合响应，也能设计更高效的代理实验。Scheffe分析表明，领域价值具有很强的关系性：若干在加性效应下表现较弱的领域，会通过成对交互变得更有利，尤其是通过与源自网络的文本相组合时。稀疏Scheffe模型在不同模型规模之间保持混合方案排序，并且在提供加性效应和交互效应显式分解的同时，仍与灵活的机器学习预测器具有竞争力。在一项根据观测到的代理训练响应校准的模拟研究中，模型稳健的I最优设计在移除约25%的原始代理训练运行后，仍能恢复相关的混合方案排序。这些结果表明，LLM数据混合不应仅被视为预测问题，也应被视为实验设计问题；在后者中，可通过选择代理混合方案本身来提高统计效率。

articles.title: A Non-asymptotic Analysis for Learning and Applying a Preconditioner in MCMC
articles.title_zh: MCMC中预条件器学习与应用的非渐近分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.10714v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Preconditioning is a common method applied to modify Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms with the goal of making them more efficient. In practice it is often extremely effective, even when the preconditioner is learned from the chain. We analyse and compare the finite-time computational costs of schemes which learn a preconditioner based on the target covariance or the expected Hessian of the target potential with that of a corresponding scheme that does not use preconditioning. We apply our results to various algorithms including the Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (ULA) and the proximal sampler for an appropriately regular target, establishing non-asymptotic guarantees for versions of these algorithms that learn and use preconditioners. To do so, we establish non-asymptotic guarantees on the time taken to collect N approximately independent samples from the target for schemes that learn their preconditioners under the assumption that the underlying Markov chain satisfies a contraction in the Wasserstein-2 distance. This approximate independence condition, that we formalize, allows us to bridge the non-asymptotic bounds of modern MCMC theory and classical heuristics of effective sample size and mixing time, and is needed to amortise the costs of learning a preconditioner across the samples it will help to produce.
articles.abstract_zh: 预条件化常用于提升马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法的效率，但从链中学习预条件器的有限时间代价尚缺乏充分分析。本文比较了基于目标协方差或目标势函数期望Hessian学习预条件器的方法与未预条件化方法的有限时间计算成本，并为ULA和近端采样器等算法建立非渐近保证。该分析通过形式化近似独立样本条件，将现代MCMC理论中的非渐近界与有效样本量和混合时间等经典启发式概念联系起来。
authors: Max Hird, Florian Maire, Jeffrey Negrea
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预条件化是一种常用方法，用于修改马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法，以使其更加高效。在实践中，即使预条件器是从该链中学习得到的，这种方法通常也极为有效。我们分析并比较了以下方案的有限时间计算成本：基于目标协方差或目标势函数的期望Hessian学习预条件器的方案，以及相应的不使用预条件化的方案。我们将结果应用于包括未校正朗之万算法（ULA）和针对适当正则目标的近端采样器在内的多种算法，从而为学习并使用预条件器的这些算法版本建立非渐近保证。为此，我们在底层马尔可夫链满足Wasserstein-2距离收缩的假设下，为学习其预条件器的方案建立了收集来自目标分布的N个近似独立样本所需时间的非渐近保证。我们对这一近似独立性条件进行了形式化；它使我们能够连接现代MCMC理论中的非渐近界与有效样本量和混合时间的经典启发式概念，并且是将学习预条件器的成本摊销到其将帮助生成的样本上所必需的。

articles.title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals
articles.title_zh: EMRB：评估大语言模型对原始电磁信号推理能力的多层级基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24086v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as code agents for scientific and engineering analysis, but their ability to analyze raw physical-layer measurements remains untested. We introduce EMRB (Electromagnetic Reasoning Benchmark), which evaluates whether LLMs can analyze raw I/Q data by writing and running code. EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated from 11 signal types with verified ground truth. Unlike benchmarks built on preprocessed features or structured tables, EMRB provides only the raw capture; the quantities each question refers to must first be discovered through code. We evaluate 14 LLMs spanning proprietary, open-weight, and reasoning-oriented families. Scores range from 24.1% to 78.9%, with the mean dropping from 84.9% on basic measurement to 21.2% on system design. We also propose ReconPilot, a structured method that separates signal reconnaissance, targeted analysis, and self-verification. Across three backbones, ReconPilot raises the overall score by 3.8 to 17.6 points and improves 13 of 15 backbone-level combinations tested. All data and code are publicly released in hrefhttps://github.com/mingxuZhang2/EMRBtextcolorblueour GitHub repository.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出电磁推理基准EMRB，用于评估大语言模型能否通过编写并运行代码来分析原始I/Q数据。该基准包含200道、覆盖五个难度等级和27类问题的题目，仅提供原始信号采集数据，模型须自行通过代码发现所需量。对14个模型的评测显示，系统设计类任务显著更困难；所提出的ReconPilot方法在多个骨干模型上提高了总体得分。
authors: Mingxu Zhang, Ying Sun, Yuhan Li, Yang Ji, Dazhong Shen, Ke Zhang, Shan Huang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作科学和工程分析的代码智能体，但其分析原始物理层测量数据的能力仍未得到检验。我们引入电磁推理基准（EMRB），用于评估LLM能否通过编写和运行代码来分析原始I/Q数据。EMRB包含200个问题，覆盖五个难度等级和27种问题类型，从信号检测到OFDM设计；这些问题由11种信号类型生成，并具有经验证的真实答案。不同于基于预处理特征或结构化表格构建的基准，EMRB仅提供原始采集数据；每个问题所涉及的量都必须先通过代码被发现。我们评估了14个LLM，涵盖专有模型、开放权重模型和面向推理的模型家族。得分范围为24.1%至78.9%，平均得分从基础测量任务的84.9%降至系统设计任务的21.2%。我们还提出ReconPilot，一种将信号侦察、定向分析和自验证分离开来的结构化方法。在三个骨干模型上，ReconPilot将总体得分提高了3.8至17.6分，并改善了所测试的15个骨干网络级组合中的13个。全部数据和代码均已公开发布。

articles.title: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for GUI Reward Modeling
articles.title_zh: 面向GUI奖励建模的任务自适应评分量规
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies on GUI agents have increasingly focused on outcome reward modeling, which assigns outcome rewards by judging whether an executed trajectory satisfies the success criteria implied by the user instruction. Existing GUI reward verifiers, however, often under-specify how these criteria should be constructed for each task instance. Whether using generic rubric structures or implicit model reasoning, their judging criteria are not sufficiently task-adaptive: they can transfer checks across tasks, overlook concrete constraints in the current instruction, or become overly strict by enforcing unstated requirements. To address this limitation, we propose AdaptRubric, a Coarse-to-Fine Rubrics Framework that constructs task-adaptive judging criteria through a category-level coarse stage and an instance-level fine stage. AdaptRubric performs category-level coarse rubric retrieval by routing the instruction to a GUI task family and retrieving reusable task-family criteria, then conducts instance-level fine rubric generation to surface compact cues for concrete values, scopes, and constraints in the current instruction. Across offline reward evaluation and online reinforcement learning optimization, AdaptRubric consistently outperforms prior reward agents, improving F1 by 3.6 points over the baseline average under a matched image budget and yielding a 4.23-point task-success gain.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有GUI结果奖励验证器对每个任务实例应如何构造成功判定标准的规定不足，容易迁移不适用的检查、遗漏当前指令约束，或施加未明确要求的条件。本文提出AdaptRubric粗到细评分量规框架，先按任务类别检索可复用标准，再为具体实例生成涵盖值、范围和约束的紧凑线索。在线下奖励评估和在线强化学习优化中，该方法均优于既有奖励智能体，并带来F1和任务成功率提升。
authors: Tao Xiong, Xavier Hu, Wenkai Wang, Qinzhuo Wu, Changqiao Wu, Pengzhi Gao, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Shengyu Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期关于GUI智能体的研究日益聚焦于结果奖励建模，即通过判断已执行轨迹是否满足用户指令所隐含的成功标准来赋予结果奖励。然而，现有的GUI奖励验证器通常没有充分规定应如何为每个任务实例构建这些标准。无论是采用通用的评分量规结构，还是采用隐式模型推理，其判定标准都不够适应具体任务：它们可能会跨任务迁移检查项，忽略当前指令中的具体约束，或者因强制执行未陈述的要求而变得过于严格。为解决这一局限，我们提出AdaptRubric，一种粗到细的评分量规框架；它通过类别级粗阶段和实例级细阶段构造任务自适应的判定标准。AdaptRubric首先通过将指令路由至某一GUI任务家族并检索可复用的任务家族标准，执行类别级粗粒度评分量规检索；随后，它进行实例级细粒度评分量规生成，为当前指令中的具体数值、范围和约束提炼紧凑线索。在离线奖励评估和在线强化学习优化中，AdaptRubric均持续优于先前的奖励智能体：在图像预算相同的条件下，相对于基线平均值将F1提高3.6分，并带来4.23分的任务成功率提升。

articles.title: Do Recipes Have Personas? Characterizing and Generating Creator Style in Attributed Procedural Graphs
articles.title_zh: 食谱具有创作者人格吗？带署名过程图中的创作者风格刻画与生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24369v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) possess vast zero-shot procedural knowledge, their tendency to produce homogenized logic often obscures the unique, idiosyncratic execution processes of individual human creators. In this paper, we investigate the computational discovery of procedural personas from unstructured data. To achieve this, we introduce ViralRecipesTrans, a new dataset of procedurally aligned execution flow graphs extracted from popular culinary video transcripts and explicitly mapped to specific creators. We formulate procedural stylometry as a graph learning and process discovery task, revealing a fundamental duality: while traditional lexical classifiers overfit via semantic leakage, discrete topological metrics successfully capture the rigid physical constraints of a creator's workflow. Building upon this characterization, we extend our framework into a novel generative task--predicting a creator's exact structural execution graph for unseen dishes. We expose a fundamental dichotomy in style generation between global macro-planning and local structural execution. Our results demonstrate that few-shot LLMs dominate semantic assignment but suffer from persistent macro-planning deficits, whereas our structured two-stage model achieves superior topological control via rigid Markovian priors. Together, an ensemble approach to procedural generation combines the strengths from both sides, dynamically synthesizing global semantic reasoning with localized topological footprints to automate the discovery and generation of personalized workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型具备丰富的零样本过程知识，其生成的逻辑往往趋同，难以体现人类创作者独特的执行方式。本文提出ViralRecipesTrans数据集，将热门烹饪视频转录文本中提取的执行流程图明确映射到创作者，并将过程风格计量建模为图学习和过程发现问题。研究表明，词汇分类器容易受语义泄漏影响，而离散拓扑指标能够捕捉工作流的物理约束；结合语义推理与拓扑结构控制的集成方法可生成更具个性化的流程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）拥有广泛的零样本过程知识，但其产生同质化逻辑的倾向常常掩盖个体人类创作者独特且特异的执行过程。本文研究从非结构化数据中计算发现过程人格的问题。为实现这一目标，我们引入ViralRecipesTrans这一新数据集，其中包含从热门烹饪视频转录文本中提取、在过程上对齐的执行流程图，并且这些图被显式映射到特定创作者。我们将过程风格计量学表述为图学习与过程发现任务，并揭示出一种根本性的二元关系：传统的词汇分类器会因语义泄漏而过拟合，而离散拓扑度量则能够成功捕捉创作者工作流中刚性的物理约束。在此刻画基础上，我们将框架扩展为一项新的生成任务：针对未见过的菜肴，预测创作者精确的结构化执行图。我们揭示了风格生成中全局宏观规划与局部结构执行之间的根本二分。结果表明，少样本LLM在语义指派上占据优势，但持续存在宏观规划缺陷；而我们的结构化两阶段模型则通过刚性的马尔可夫先验实现了更优的拓扑控制。总体而言，一种用于过程生成的集成方法结合了双方优势，通过动态融合全局语义推理和局部拓扑印记，实现个性化工作流的自动发现与生成。

articles.title: Implicit Q-learning-bootstrapped ant colony optimization for maritime moving-target observation scheduling with agile satellites
articles.title_zh: 用于敏捷卫星海上移动目标观测调度的隐式Q学习引导蚁群优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Maritime moving-target observation scheduling with agile Earth observation satellites is a dynamic, sequence-dependent combinatorial optimization problem. Sea-surface targets move continuously, causing feasible observation windows to vary with target motion and satellite orbital geometry. The scheduler must jointly determine task selection, satellite assignment, observation-window selection, and observation ordering under time-window, attitude-maneuvering, onboard-resource, and cloud-affected availability constraints. This paper proposes an implicit Q-learning-bootstrapped ant colony optimization method, termed IQACO, for multi-satellite maritime moving-target observation scheduling. Rather than directly learning a task-selection policy, IQACO embeds an offline implicit Q-learning module into constructive ant colony optimization to adaptively adjust the pheromone factor, heuristic factor, and evaporation rate. A compact search-state representation captures pheromone distribution, current and historical-best solution quality, and iteration progress. During online scheduling, ant colony optimization constructs feasible observation sequences, while the learned policy regulates exploration and exploitation according to the current search state. Experiments on 14 scenarios with different scales and satellite configurations show that IQACO obtains the highest mean observation benefit in every scenario, improves the result of conventional ant colony optimization by 3.40%--9.40%, accelerates convergence, and remains stable under different objective-weight settings. These results demonstrate that offline value learning provides an effective adaptive search-control mechanism for constrained maritime moving-target observation scheduling.
articles.abstract_zh: 敏捷对地观测卫星的海上移动目标观测调度是一个动态且具有序列依赖性的组合优化问题，需要同时处理任务选择、卫星分配、观测窗口选择和观测排序。本文提出IQACO，将离线隐式Q学习嵌入构造式蚁群优化，以自适应调节信息素、启发式因子和蒸发率。14个不同规模和卫星配置场景的实验表明，IQACO在所有场景中均获得最高平均观测收益，相比传统蚁群优化提升3.40%至9.40%。
authors: He Wang, Junyu Wu, Yeye Liu, Yifan Zhou, Jie Zhang, Hui Li, Yanjie Song, Liang Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用敏捷对地观测卫星进行海上移动目标观测调度，是一个动态的、具有序列依赖性的组合优化问题。海面目标持续移动，使得可行观测窗口随目标运动和卫星轨道几何关系而变化。调度器必须在时间窗口、姿态机动、星载资源以及受云层影响的可用性约束下，联合确定任务选择、卫星分配、观测窗口选择和观测排序。本文提出一种用于多卫星海上移动目标观测调度的隐式Q学习引导蚁群优化方法，称为IQACO。IQACO并不直接学习任务选择策略，而是将离线隐式Q学习模块嵌入构造式蚁群优化中，以自适应调整信息素因子、启发式因子和蒸发率。一个紧凑的搜索状态表示捕捉信息素分布、当前及历史最优解质量，以及迭代进度。在在线调度过程中，蚁群优化构造可行的观测序列，而学习得到的策略则根据当前搜索状态调节探索与利用。在具有不同规模和卫星配置的14个场景上的实验表明，IQACO在每个场景中均获得最高的平均观测收益，将传统蚁群优化的结果提升3.40%至9.40%，加快了收敛速度，并在不同目标权重设置下保持稳定。这些结果表明，离线价值学习为受约束的海上移动目标观测调度提供了一种有效的自适应搜索控制机制。

articles.title: Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space
articles.title_zh: 在统一潜在空间中渐进学习异构技能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23258v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出HetSkills框架，用于在统一潜在空间中渐进学习面向基于物理角色控制的异构技能。该框架先学习运动跟踪技能以建立共享运动解码器，再通过运动直觉蒸馏和任务引导模块，使文本到运动技能依据语言语义生成并适应高层指令。实验表明，该方法在运动跟踪、文本到运动生成、动作补全及下游任务适配中均有效，并能在具有挑战性的条件下取得较高成功率。
authors: Yue-Yi Zhang, Ming Gong, Linpu He, Wei-Shi Zheng, Zhilin Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出HetSkills，一种旨在为基于物理的角色控制在统一潜在空间中渐进学习异构技能的新框架。其核心思想是将该潜在空间视为一个共享的可执行接口，从而实现对来自多样化数据源、监督形式和任务的技能的无缝整合。HetSkills首先学习一项跟踪技能，该技能为运动控制建立坚实基础，并创建一个可跨任务复用的共享运动解码器，无需重新训练或使用独立控制器。为防止文本到运动技能利用捷径通路而非学习语言语义，我们引入运动直觉蒸馏，使文本到运动生成以语言语义为基础，并引入一个任务引导模块，根据高层语言指令动态调整动作。这使HetSkills在持续扩展技能库的同时保持自然运动，从而使其能够高度适应长时程任务。实验结果表明，该方法在运动跟踪、文本到运动生成、动作补全和下游任务适配中均具有有效性，即使在具有挑战性的条件下也实现了出色的成功率。

articles.title: A tale of perfect fit and phantom optima: how data-driven models can fail in real-time optimization
articles.title_zh: 完美拟合与虚幻最优解：数据驱动模型如何在实时优化中失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23885v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-time optimization (RTO) relies on process models to locate economically optimal operating conditions. Because developing first-principles models requires significant process knowledge, data-driven alternatives are increasingly attractive. Modern machine-learning models can fit historical plant data accurately and often pass standard validation tests. Whether such models can be trusted for economic optimization, however, remains unclear. We investigate this question using a vinyl acetate monomer benchmark process with a unique, well-conditioned economic optimum. We train a structured hybrid model that combines known mass balances and thermodynamics with a neural-network closure for unknown kinetics, and a fully data-driven neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) model. Both models reproduce plant measurements accurately and exhibit little variation in predictions across random initializations. Yet their economic optima differ substantially from that of the plant. Where the plant returns a single optimum on multistart search, the trained models return many phantom optima. We further show that the training optimizer alone can be yet another source of error. Even with noise-free data and initialization at weights that recover the plant optimum, stochastic gradient training can drift to weights that yield substantially worse RTO solutions. The identified model is thus an artifact of the training optimizer as well as the data. These results demonstrate that a good predictive fit of all available measurements does not guarantee reliable economic performance. A data-driven model for RTO should at least be required to recover the optimum on a decision-oriented benchmark like the one developed here before being considered for plant testing and application.
articles.abstract_zh: 实时优化依赖过程模型寻找经济最优运行条件，而预测拟合良好的数据驱动模型是否可用于此目的尚不明确。本文在醋酸乙烯单体基准过程上比较结构化混合模型和完全数据驱动的神经ODE模型，发现两者虽能准确重现工厂测量值，却给出与真实装置显著不同的经济最优解及多个虚幻最优解。研究还表明，随机梯度训练本身可能使模型偏离能够恢复真实最优解的参数，因此预测准确性不足以保证可靠的经济优化表现。
authors: Prithvi Dake, Rahul Bindlish, James B. Rawlings
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实时优化（RTO）依赖过程模型来定位经济上最优的运行条件。由于开发第一性原理模型需要大量过程知识，数据驱动的替代方法正变得越来越有吸引力。现代机器学习模型能够准确拟合历史工厂数据，并且通常能够通过标准验证测试。然而，此类模型能否被信任用于经济优化，仍不清楚。我们使用一个具有唯一且条件良好的经济最优解的醋酸乙烯单体基准过程来研究这一问题。我们训练了一个结构化混合模型，该模型将已知的质量平衡和热力学与用于未知动力学的神经网络闭合项相结合；同时还训练了一个完全数据驱动的神经常微分方程（ODE）模型。两个模型都能准确重现工厂测量值，并且其预测在不同随机初始化之间几乎没有变化。然而，它们的经济最优解与工厂的经济最优解存在显著差异。当工厂在多起点搜索中返回单一最优解时，训练后的模型却返回许多虚幻最优解。我们进一步表明，训练优化器本身也可能成为另一个误差来源。即使在无噪声数据条件下，并且以能够恢复工厂最优解的权重进行初始化，随机梯度训练仍可能漂移至产生显著更差RTO解的权重。因此，所识别出的模型既是训练优化器的产物，也是数据的产物。这些结果表明，对所有可用测量值具有良好预测拟合，并不能保证可靠的经济性能。数据驱动RTO模型至少应被要求在如本文所开发的、面向决策的基准上恢复最优解，然后才能被考虑用于工厂测试和应用。

articles.title: QML for Quantum Sensing under Measurement-Induced Information Loss
articles.title_zh: 测量诱导信息损失下用于量子传感的量子机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23934v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond can serve as highly sensitive solid-state quantum sensors for high-sensitivity magnetometry. However, in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, extracting reliable information from noisy, finite-shot, and measurement-limited sensing data remains a considerable challenge. Whereas, quantum machine learning (QML) offers a potential path to improve parameter estimation by learning nonlinear relationships between quantum-sensing data and the underlying physical signal. In this work, we investigate the role of QML in magnetic-field estimation within an NV center-inspired magnetometry setting. We formulated magnetic field sensing as a supervised regression task. We compared the performance of several classical machine learning models trained on measurement-based classical data with that of quantum kernel-based models trained on pre-measurement coherent quantum states. Our objective is to isolate the impact of measurement-induced information loss and therefore provide a theoretical upper bound on the sensing performance. The upper bound is achievable only when coherent quantum information is directly available to the learning model. Our results show that QML-based sensing performance improves significantly with coherent quantum-state information, and not much with changes in model complexity or learning paradigm. This observation underscores the importance of learning pipelines that tightly integrate quantum sensors and QML models to enhance magnetic field sensing under realistic constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石氮空位中心可用于高灵敏磁力测量，但从含噪、有限采样且受测量限制的数据中提取可靠信息仍具挑战。本文将磁场感知建模为监督回归任务，对比了基于测量后经典数据训练的经典机器学习模型与基于测量前相干量子态训练的量子核模型，以分离测量诱导的信息损失影响。结果显示，量子机器学习性能的显著提升主要来自直接获得相干量子态信息，而非模型复杂度或学习范式的改变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心可以作为高灵敏度磁力测量的固态量子传感器。然而，在含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）时代，从含噪、有限采样且受测量限制的传感数据中提取可靠信息仍是一项重大挑战。量子机器学习（QML）则提供了一条潜在路径：通过学习量子传感数据与底层物理信号之间的非线性关系，改善参数估计。在本工作中，我们研究了QML在受NV中心启发的磁力测量环境中进行磁场估计的作用。我们将磁场感知表述为一个监督回归任务。我们比较了多种在基于测量的经典数据上训练的经典机器学习模型，与在测量前的相干量子态上训练的基于量子核的模型的性能。我们的目标是分离测量诱导信息损失的影响，从而为传感性能提供理论上界。只有当相干量子信息可被学习模型直接获得时，这一上界才可实现。结果表明，基于QML的传感性能会随着相干量子态信息的可用而显著提升，而不会因模型复杂度或学习范式的变化而有明显提升。这一观察强调了紧密集成量子传感器与QML模型的学习流程，对于在现实约束下增强磁场感知的重要性。

articles.title: ORBITALIF: An Efficient Spiking Federated Learning Framework for Onboard Cloud Removal
articles.title_zh: ORBITALIF：用于星载去云的高效脉冲联邦学习框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24073v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-earth-orbit (LEO) satellites enable high-resolution, large-scale Earth observation for applications such as disaster monitoring and environmental surveillance. However, cloud coverage often obscures the Earth's surface, and conventional cloud-removal pipelines that download cloudy images to ground stations for processing suffer from limited contact windows, constrained satellite-to-ground bandwidth, and high latency. In this work, we propose a novel satellite federated learning framework for cloud removal across LEO constellations, named orbital attention leaky integrate-and-fire (OrbitALIF). OrbitALIF performs both onboard training and inference using a compact 2.30,M-parameter spiking neural network (SNN) backbone with an adaptive gated fusion module (AGFM) and a spectral-spatial hybrid attention module (SHAM), combined with a decentralized federated learning strategy that shares model weights via inter-satellite links. Our experiments show that OrbitALIF achieves competitive cloud removal quality while consuming only 0.287,mJ per inference on neuromorphic hardware, a 72.3 times (98.6%) energy reduction versus an equivalent artificial neural network (ANN).
articles.abstract_zh: 低地球轨道卫星的传统去云流程需要将含云图像下传至地面，受限于通信窗口、带宽和延迟。本文提出OrbitALIF卫星联邦学习框架，采用紧凑型脉冲神经网络、门控融合与光谱-空间混合注意力模块，并通过星间链路进行去中心化模型参数共享。实验显示，该方法在保持具有竞争力去云质量的同时，神经形态硬件上的单次推理能耗仅为0.287 mJ，较等效人工神经网络降低98.6%。
authors: Bohan Zhang, Chenyu Xu, Yijie Mao, Yuanming Shi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星可支持高分辨率、大范围的地球观测，用于灾害监测和环境监视等应用。然而，云层覆盖常常遮挡地球表面；而将含云图像下载到地面站进行处理的传统去云流程，受到有限接触窗口、受限星地带宽和高延迟的影响。在本工作中，我们提出一种跨LEO星座进行去云的全新卫星联邦学习框架，称为轨道注意力漏电积分发放（OrbitALIF）。OrbitALIF采用一个紧凑的、具有2.30M参数的脉冲神经网络（SNN）骨干网络，结合自适应门控融合模块（AGFM）和光谱-空间混合注意力模块（SHAM），同时采用去中心化联邦学习策略，经由星间链路共享模型权重，从而同时执行星上训练与推理。实验表明，OrbitALIF在实现具有竞争力的去云质量的同时，在神经形态硬件上每次推理仅消耗0.287 mJ能量，相比等效的人工神经网络（ANN）实现72.3倍（98.6%）的能耗降低。

articles.title: PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control
articles.title_zh: PonderPounce：作为机器人控制回合上下文引擎的预训练多模态大语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24115v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate long visual histories, reason under partial observability, and infer behavior from a few examples. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) models generally inherit pretrained representations without using this contextual capacity as episode memory. Memory-dependent policies address this gap through purpose-built history mechanisms. PonderPounce instead reuses an MLLM's native causal context as robot memory. Ponder, a System2 MLLM, accumulates episode observations, demonstrations, and prior cognition in its native causal context and can generate subgoal text and demonstration reasoning for internal use. Pounce, a System1 VLA, receives the current observation, instruction, and proprioception directly; through the Ponder--Pounce interface, it asynchronously receives only the newest continuous cognition token and its age. Both are jointly trained end to end without a purpose-built memory module or separate bridge pretraining. Optimized serving achieves p50 latencies of 78ms for cognition refresh and 25ms for action-model invocation, supporting 20Hz action playback. On RoboMME with base-scale training data, PonderPounce reaches 60.83% with 9B and 50.04% with 0.8B under the same Pounce architecture and interface, versus 44.51% for FrameSamp+Modul and 17.93% for the current-observation π₀.₅. With 9x data, it reaches 75.54% versus 57.88% for FrameSamp+Modul. On RoboCasa-DC, the same interface learns from action supervision alone and reaches 12.5% versus 11.6% for the strongest published demonstration-conditioned baseline, falling to 8.6% when cognition is replaced by a learned null state.
articles.abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型能够整合长视觉历史并在部分可观测条件下推理，但现有视觉-语言-动作模型通常未将这种上下文能力作为回合记忆使用。本文提出PonderPounce，复用MLLM原生因果上下文作为机器人记忆：Ponder积累观测、示范和既往认知，Pounce则接收当前输入及异步传来的最新认知令牌。该方法无需专门记忆模块或独立桥接预训练，在RoboMME和RoboCasa-DC上均优于所比较的基线。
authors: Suhwan Choi, Jaeyoon Jung, Sungkyung Kim, Yunsung Lee, Youngjae Yu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够整合较长的视觉历史，在部分可观测条件下进行推理，并从少量示例中推断行为。然而，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常继承预训练表示，却未将这种上下文能力用作回合记忆。依赖记忆的策略通过专门构建的历史机制来弥补这一缺口。PonderPounce则将MLLM原生的因果上下文复用于机器人记忆。作为系统2 MLLM的Ponder，在其原生因果上下文中累积回合观测、示范和先前认知，并能够生成供内部使用的子目标文本和示范推理。作为系统1 VLA的Pounce，直接接收当前观测、指令和本体感觉；通过Ponder-Pounce接口，它仅异步接收最新的连续认知令牌及其时效。二者端到端联合训练，无需专门构建的记忆模块或独立的桥接预训练。经优化的服务实现了认知刷新78ms的p50延迟和动作模型调用25ms的p50延迟，支持20Hz动作播放。在使用基础规模训练数据的RoboMME上，在相同的Pounce架构和接口下，PonderPounce的9B版本达到60.83%，0.8B版本达到50.04%，而FrameSamp+Modul为44.51%，仅使用当前观测的π₀.₅为17.93%。在使用9倍数据时，其达到75.54%，而FrameSamp+Modul为57.88%。在RoboCasa-DC上，相同接口仅通过动作监督进行学习，达到12.5%，而最强的已发表、以示范为条件的基线为11.6%；当认知被学习得到的空状态替换时，该结果降至8.6%。

articles.title: TransPhy: Visual In-Context Learning for Physically Grounded Image Editing
articles.title_zh: TransPhy：面向物理基础图像编辑的视觉上下文学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24119v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Visual demonstrations provide a natural interface for specifying image transformations that are difficult to describe exhaustively with text. However, existing visual in-context learning (VICL) methods primarily focus on appearance-level relation transfer and provide limited support for physically grounded transformations, whose outcomes depend on material properties, geometry, object interactions, and environmental conditions. Given a source--target exemplar pair and a query image, physically grounded VICL requires a model to infer the demonstrated transformation, adapt its effects to the query-specific scene context, and preserve rule-irrelevant content. We introduce PhysVICL-74, comprising 74 physically grounded transformation rules and 5,240 source--target image pairs that form nearly 75K training and evaluation contexts. Its benchmark split separately evaluates novel-instance transfer and unseen-rule generalization. We further propose TransPhy, a framework that decomposes physically grounded VICL into physical-rule induction and transition-aligned rendering. TransPhy first predicts the demonstrated rule and an explicit query-specific target-state description, and then synthesizes the target image through token-wise mixture-of-experts adaptation, with expert routing guided by localized transition cues. Experiments show that TransPhy improves physical-rule adherence, query consistency, and unseen-rule generalization over existing visual in-context editing methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 视觉示例能够直观指定难以用文字穷尽描述的图像变换，但现有视觉上下文学习方法主要处理外观关系迁移，对依赖材料属性、几何形状、物体交互和环境条件的物理基础变换支持有限。本文提出包含74条物理变换规则和5,240组源图像—目标图像对的PhysVICL-74基准，以及将规则归纳与过渡对齐渲染相结合的TransPhy框架。实验表明，该方法在物理规则遵循、查询一致性和未见规则泛化方面优于现有视觉上下文图像编辑方法。
authors: Siyi Xie, Xuanke Shi, Jinsheng Quan, Haoran Tang, Zukai Chen, Lei Yang, Quan Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 视觉示例为指定难以用文字穷尽描述的图像变换提供了自然的接口。然而，现有视觉上下文学习（VICL）方法主要聚焦于外观层面的关系迁移，对物理基础变换的支持有限；这类变换的结果取决于材料属性、几何形状、物体交互以及环境条件。给定一个源图像—目标图像示例对和一幅查询图像，物理基础的VICL要求模型推断示例中展示的变换，将其效果适应于查询图像特定的场景上下文，并保留与规则无关的内容。我们提出PhysVICL-74，其中包含74条物理基础变换规则和5,240组源图像—目标图像对，共形成近75,000个训练与评估上下文。其基准测试划分分别评估新实例迁移和未见规则泛化。我们进一步提出TransPhy框架，将物理基础VICL分解为物理规则归纳和过渡对齐渲染。TransPhy首先预测示例中展示的规则以及明确的、针对查询图像的目标状态描述，然后通过逐词混合专家适配合成目标图像，其中专家路由由局部化的过渡线索引导。实验表明，与现有视觉上下文编辑方法相比，TransPhy在物理规则遵循、查询一致性和未见规则泛化方面均有所提升。

articles.title: Co-Substituted Ni–Zn Ferrite Reinforced PVA Nanocomposites as High-Performance Electromagnetic Wave Absorbers in the X-Band Region
articles.title_zh: 钴取代镍锌铁氧体增强的PVA纳米复合材料：X波段高性能电磁波吸收剂
articles.abstract: Cobalt-substituted nickel–zinc ferrites with the composition CoₓNi₁₋ₓ₋γZnγFe₂O₄ (x = 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8; y = 0.1) were synthesized via the sol–gel method to investigate the influence of Co²⁺ substitution. XRD analysis confirmed the formation of a single-phase cubic spinel structure. Rietveld refinement further verified the crystallographic purity of the synthesized ferrites, while a systematic variation in lattice parameters was observed with increasing cobalt concentration. FESEM micrographs revealed nearly spherical nanoparticles with homogeneous grain distribution. FTIR and Raman spectroscopic studies confirmed the characteristic vibrational modes of the spinel ferrite structure, indicating the preservation of structural integrity after cobalt incorporation. UV–Visible spectroscopy showed a gradual reduction in the optical band gap from 1.45 to 1.07 eV, suggesting significant modification of the electronic structure. Electrical measurements exhibited frequency-dependent conductivity and impedance behavior, with enhanced conductivity for Co-substituted compositions. To evaluate their practical applicability, ferrite/PVA nanocomposite films were fabricated and investigated in the X-band frequency range relevant to 5G communication systems. The nanocomposites exhibited high dielectric properties and excellent electromagnetic interference shielding performance. The optimized composition demonstrated a reflection loss ranging from − 19.86 to − 45.33 dB, highlighting its strong potential for advanced microwave absorption and high-performance EMI shielding applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究采用溶胶—凝胶法制备钴取代镍锌铁氧体，并考察钴离子取代对结构、光学和电学性质的影响。材料保持单相立方尖晶石结构，复合PVA薄膜后表现出较高介电性能和优异的电磁干扰屏蔽能力。优化组成的反射损耗为−19.86至−45.33 dB，显示出用于微波吸收和电磁屏蔽的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为研究Co2+取代的影响，研究人员采用溶胶—凝胶法合成了组成为CoₓNi₁₋ₓ₋γZnγFe₂O₄（x=0.2、0.4、0.6和0.8；y=0.1）的钴取代镍锌铁氧体。X射线衍射（XRD）分析证实形成了单相立方尖晶石结构。里特维尔精修进一步验证了所合成铁氧体的晶体学纯度，同时观察到晶格参数随钴浓度增加而系统变化。场发射扫描电子显微镜（FESEM）图像显示，纳米颗粒近似球形且晶粒分布均匀。傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和拉曼光谱研究证实了尖晶石铁氧体结构的特征振动模式，表明掺入钴后结构完整性得到保持。紫外—可见光谱显示，光学带隙由1.45 eV逐渐降低至1.07 eV，说明电子结构发生了显著改变。电学测量显示电导率和阻抗行为具有频率依赖性，且钴取代组成的电导率得到增强。为评估实际应用性能，研究人员制备了铁氧体/PVA纳米复合薄膜，并在与5G通信系统相关的X波段频率范围内对其进行了研究。纳米复合材料表现出较高的介电性能和优异的电磁干扰屏蔽性能。优化组成的反射损耗范围为−19.86至−45.33 dB，凸显了其在先进微波吸收和高性能电磁干扰屏蔽应用中的巨大潜力。

articles.title: Iron-modified calcinated coconut fiber biochar for simultaneous removal of copper and zinc: optimization, production cost assessment, and machine Learning modeling
articles.title_zh: 铁改性煅烧椰子纤维生物炭同步去除铜和锌：优化、生产成本评估与机器学习建模
articles.abstract: This study developed and evaluated an iron modified biochar (AcBC) from coconut fiber in Ben Tre, Vietnam, for the adsorption of Cu²⁺ and Zn²⁺. Characterization (SEM-EDS, BET, XRD, FTIR) showed that mineral rich coconut fiber pyrolyzed without inert gas undergoes strong surface mineralization, forming crystalline silicates that block pores and functional groups, resulting in raw biochar (RBC) with low surface area, limited porosity, and few active sites. After iron salt co precipitation with NaOH, AcBC exhibited major improvements, including a nearly twenty fold increase in surface area form 5 to 100 m2/g, well developed mesopores, and the return of functional groups. Silicate minerals also contributed to adsorption by providing active sites and supporting iron oxide and iron silicate formation. AcBC achieved about twenty percent higher removal efficiency and maximum capacities of 34.75 mg/g for Cu²⁺ and 29.69 mg/g for Zn²⁺, more than double those of RBC. To systematically describe the adsorption mechanisms, four kinetic models (pseudo-first-order, pseudo-second-order, Weber-Morris intraparticle diffusion, and Boyd) and four isotherm models (Langmuir, Freundlich, Temkin, and Dubinin-Radushkevich) were utilized. Crucially, tree-based machine learning interpreted via SHAP analysis successfully quantified the mechanisms; Extreme Gradient Boosting accurately predicted adsorption capacity R2 > 92%, identifying specific surface area, % Si, and % O as the most important material properties, while that of cation descriptors relative atomic mass, effective ionic radius and first order hydrolysis constants. With low cost production, simple synthesis, and strong performance, AcBC represents a practical and scalable option for treating heavy metal contaminated wastewater in developing regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究以越南槟椥的椰子纤维制备铁改性生物炭AcBC，用于吸附Cu2+和Zn2+。铁共沉淀改性使比表面积由5提高到100 m2/g，并恢复孔隙和官能团，使最大吸附容量分别达到34.75和29.69 mg/g。结合动力学、等温线和SHAP解释的树模型，研究表明AcBC具有低成本、易制备且可规模化处理重金属废水的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究以越南槟椥的椰子纤维为原料开发并评价了一种用于吸附Cu2+和Zn2+的铁改性生物炭（AcBC）。表征结果（SEM-EDS、BET、XRD和FTIR）表明，未经惰性气体保护而热解的富含矿物质的椰子纤维会发生强烈的表面矿化，形成堵塞孔隙和官能团的晶态硅酸盐，从而使原始生物炭（RBC）具有较低的比表面积、有限的孔隙率和较少的活性位点。经NaOH参与的铁盐共沉淀后，AcBC获得了显著改善，包括比表面积从5提高到100 m2/g（接近20倍）、发育良好的介孔以及官能团的恢复。硅酸盐矿物也通过提供活性位点并促进氧化铁和硅酸铁的形成而参与吸附。AcBC的去除效率提高约20%，Cu2+和Zn2+的最大吸附容量分别为34.75 mg/g和29.69 mg/g，均超过RBC的两倍。为系统描述吸附机制，研究采用了四种动力学模型（准一级、准二级、Weber-Morris颗粒内扩散和Boyd模型）以及四种等温线模型（Langmuir、Freundlich、Temkin和Dubinin-Radushkevich模型）。重要的是，利用SHAP分析解释的基于树的机器学习成功量化了相关机制；极端梯度提升模型能够准确预测吸附容量（R2>92%），并识别出比表面积、Si含量百分比和O含量百分比是最重要的材料性质，而阳离子描述符则包括相对原子质量、有效离子半径和一级水解常数。在生产成本低、合成简单且性能良好的基础上，AcBC代表了发展中地区处理重金属污染废水的一种实用且可规模化选择。

articles.title: Dynamic Performance and Sustainable Energy Recovery Improvement of EVs Using IFOC-Based Regenerative Braking
articles.title_zh: 采用基于间接磁场控制的再生制动提升电动汽车动态性能与可持续能量回收
articles.abstract: This research presents a regenerative braking system based on the proposed Indirect Field Control technique for an induction motor, for electric vehicle applications. By recovering kinetic energy during braking and converting it into electrical energy to sustainable energy recovery system, the project aims to improve the energy efficiency and dynamic performance of electric vehicles. With precise control of the torque and magnetic flux components, the proposed IFOC technique enables a smooth transition between regenerative braking and driving modes, while maintaining system stability and rapid dynamic response. In the experimental section, a flywheel was connected to a three-phase induction motor to measure the AC voltage and current. The power produced by the flywheel at different speeds was then calculated. MATLAB Simulink software was used to model and simulate the induction motor's driving system and the regenerative braking system under various driving and braking scenarios. According to the simulation results, the proposed control strategy successfully improved braking performance, reduced energy loss, and ensured the reliable operation of the electric vehicle's driving system. The results confirm that the proposed IFOC-based regenerative braking strategy provides an effective and viable method for improving the overall performance and energy management of electric vehicles. This improves dynamic performance by reducing braking time, which is divided into a portion where energy is recovered and another portion where braking occurs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向电动汽车感应电机的基于间接磁场控制（IFOC）的再生制动系统，通过回收制动时的动能提高能量效率和动态性能。实验与MATLAB Simulink仿真显示，该策略能够平滑切换驱动与再生制动模式，改善制动性能、减少能量损失并保持快速稳定响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究提出了一种面向电动汽车应用、基于感应电机间接磁场控制技术的再生制动系统。该项目旨在通过在制动过程中回收动能并将其转换为电能，改善电动汽车的能量效率和动态性能，从而形成可持续的能量回收系统。通过精确控制转矩和磁通分量，所提出的IFOC技术能够在再生制动模式和驱动模式之间实现平稳过渡，同时保持系统稳定性和快速动态响应。在实验部分，研究人员将飞轮连接到三相感应电机，以测量交流电压和电流，并计算飞轮在不同转速下产生的功率。研究使用MATLAB Simulink对感应电机驱动系统和再生制动系统进行建模与仿真，覆盖各种驾驶和制动情景。根据仿真结果，所提出的控制策略成功改善了制动性能，减少了能量损失，并确保电动汽车驱动系统可靠运行。结果证实，基于IFOC的再生制动策略是改善电动汽车整体性能和能量管理的有效可行方法。该策略通过缩短制动时间改善动态性能；制动时间被划分为能量回收阶段和制动阶段。

articles.title: Cross-Validated Neural and Biophysical Models for Pediatric Fingerprint Ridge Breadth Age Estimation with Archaeological Applications
articles.title_zh: 经交叉验证的神经与生物物理模型：用于考古应用的儿童指纹脊宽年龄估计
articles.abstract: Small clay figurines from Neolithic Knossos, Crete occur predominantly in domestic and residential assemblages, yet whether children participated in their manufacture remains contested. Fingerprint ridge breadth, preserved in clay at the point of contact, provides a non-destructive proxy for maker age because ridge breadth expands systematically during childhood. Existing approaches are calibrated on adult-containing samples and have never been cross-validated against a dedicated pediatric reference. We address this gap by collecting fingerprint impressions from 200 children aged 6–12 years in Rhodes, Greece, using the same clay-token protocol applicable to ancient ceramic surfaces, and evaluating three models under leave-one-out cross-validation: a logistic ordinary differential equation (ODE), a Fisher-KPP reaction-diffusion partial differential equation (PDE), and a multilayer perceptron neural network (MLP). The MLP achieved a mean absolute error of 1.382 years (bootstrap 95% CI: 1.256–1.510), reducing error fivefold relative to the adult-calibrated Kamp et al. baseline (MAE 7.09 years). Applied to 11 figurines from the Heraklion Archaeological Museum and the Stratigraphical Museum at Knossos, ridge breadth estimates across all specimens fall within the childhood age range (approximately 4–12 years depending on assumed clay shrinkage), providing the first cross-validated biometric evidence consistent with child participation in Neolithic figurine production at Knossos.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究以200名6至12岁希腊儿童的指纹印痕建立儿科参考数据，并交叉验证逻辑ODE、Fisher-KPP反应—扩散PDE和多层感知机模型。MLP的平均绝对误差为1.382岁，较成人校准基线降低约五倍。对克诺索斯11件新石器时代陶俑的应用显示，其指纹脊宽均与儿童制作者相符。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 克里特岛新石器时代克诺索斯的小型黏土雕像主要出现在家庭和居住遗址组合中，但儿童是否参与了其制作仍存在争议。接触点处保存在黏土中的指纹脊宽可作为制作者年龄的无损替代指标，因为脊宽会在儿童期系统性增大。现有方法基于包含成年人的样本进行校准，且从未针对专门的儿科参考数据进行交叉验证。为弥补这一空白，我们在希腊罗得岛采集了200名6至12岁儿童的指纹印痕，使用同样适用于古代陶瓷表面的黏土标记物方案，并在留一交叉验证下评估了三种模型：逻辑常微分方程（ODE）、Fisher-KPP反应—扩散偏微分方程（PDE）和多层感知机神经网络（MLP）。MLP取得了1.382岁的平均绝对误差（自助法95%置信区间：1.256—1.510岁），相较于以成人为校准对象的Kamp等人基线模型（平均绝对误差7.09岁），误差降低了五倍。将该模型应用于赫拉克利翁考古博物馆和克诺索斯地层博物馆的11件雕像后，所有标本的脊宽估计均处于儿童年龄范围内（根据假定的黏土收缩程度，约为4—12岁），为克诺索斯新石器时代雕像制作中存在儿童参与提供了首个经过交叉验证的生物测量学证据。

articles.title: Resonant false vacuum decay in two dimensions on a 4000-qubit quantum annealer
articles.title_zh: 4000量子比特量子退火机上的二维共振假真空衰变
articles.abstract: From cosmology to quantum matter, metastable states often decay through the nucleation and growth of competing domains, with false vacuum decay providing the paradigmatic example of this process. Here we demonstrate a distinct regime in which domain growth outpaces nucleation by orders of magnitude and is controlled by local resonance conditions. Using a programmable quantum annealer with more than 4000 qubits, we realize a two-dimensional quantum Ising model whose metastable spin-polarized state encodes a false vacuum. At a specific value of the longitudinal field, single-spin flips at the boundary of a seeded bubble become resonant, enabling kinetically constrained expansion. Combining experiment with tensor-network simulations and stochastic circuit modeling, we observe nearly ballistic growth of true-vacuum domains with sub-ballistic interface broadening, consistent with Kardar--Parisi--Zhang universality. Our results establish a growth-dominated regime of false vacuum decay and show how large-scale quantum simulation can access nonequilibrium metastable dynamics relevant to quantum field theory, cosmology, and strongly correlated matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用超过4000个量子比特的可编程量子退火机，实现二维量子伊辛模型中的假真空衰变。研究观察到在特定纵向场下，真空域以近弹道方式增长，且界面展宽呈次弹道行为，与Kardar—Parisi—Zhang普适性一致。结果揭示了由局域共振控制、增长主导的假真空衰变机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从宇宙学到量子物质，亚稳态常通过竞争区域的成核和增长而衰变，假真空衰变是这一过程的典型例子。在这里，我们展示了一种不同的状态：区域增长速度比成核快几个数量级，并由局部共振条件控制。我们使用一台拥有超过4000个量子比特的可编程量子退火机，实现了二维量子伊辛模型，其中亚稳的自旋极化态编码假真空。在纵向场的特定取值下，预先形成的气泡边界处的单自旋翻转发生共振，从而实现受动力学约束的扩张。结合实验、张量网络模拟和随机电路建模，我们观察到真真空区域近似弹道式增长，同时界面展宽呈次弹道行为，这与Kardar—Parisi—Zhang普适性相一致。我们的结果确立了假真空衰变的一种增长主导状态，并表明大规模量子模拟能够研究与量子场论、宇宙学和强关联物质相关的非平衡亚稳态动力学。

articles.title: OmniGuard V2X: A Hybrid-Security Prototype Framework with Assumption-Aware Validation for Smart Vehicle Systems
articles.title_zh: OmniGuard V2X：面向智能车辆系统、具有假设感知验证的混合安全原型框架
articles.abstract: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) systems combine safety-relevant telemetry, wireless communication, distributed identity, collaborative learning, and long-lived cryptographic trust, creating security dependencies that are difficult to evaluate when each mechanism is studied in isolation. This paper presents OmniGuard V2X, a six-layer research prototype that integrates post-quantum key establishment and signatures, privacy commitments, decentralized identity, a permissioned tamper-evident ledger, federated-learning experimentation, anomaly hooks, and authenticated runtime services in a unified C++/Go/Python stack. The contribution is an assumption-aware validation model rather than a new cryptographic primitive. The supported native path uses real ML-KEM-512 and ML-DSA-44 operations, while classical Pedersen and Schnorr-style assumptions are explicitly excluded from end-to-end post-quantum claims. The prototype further implements encrypted persistent PQC identity material, stable key identifiers, guarded rotation, signed key-transition evidence, bounded historical signature verification, fail-closed provider selection, replay-aware local control, and authenticated rollback-state checks. A retained warm-start pipeline measurement is 5.34 ms in one prototype environment and is reported only as a descriptive local result. Existing anomaly and federated-learning experiments are classified as sanity checks because they do not yet support statistically defensible robustness metrics. The study shows how machine-readable security boundaries and evidence-aware claim control can improve the reproducibility and interpretability of multi-mechanism V2X security prototypes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出OmniGuard V2X，一个整合后量子密码、隐私承诺、去中心化身份、许可型防篡改账本、联邦学习、异常检测和认证运行时服务的六层研究原型。其主要贡献是具有明确假设边界的验证模型，而非新的密码学原语。研究通过机器可读的安全边界和证据约束的声明控制，提高了多机制V2X安全原型的可复现性与可解释性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 车联网（V2X）系统融合了安全相关遥测、无线通信、分布式身份、协作学习以及长期存在的密码信任，因此产生了难以在分别研究各机制时进行评估的安全依赖关系。本文提出OmniGuard V2X，这是一个六层研究原型，在统一的C++/Go/Python技术栈中集成了后量子密钥建立与签名、隐私承诺、去中心化身份、许可型防篡改账本、联邦学习实验、异常检测接口和经过认证的运行时服务。其贡献在于提出一种具有假设意识的验证模型，而不是新的密码学原语。所支持的原生路径使用真实的ML-KEM-512和ML-DSA-44操作，同时明确排除经典Pedersen和Schnorr风格假设对端到端后量子声明的支持。该原型还实现了加密持久化的后量子密码身份材料、稳定的密钥标识符、受保护的轮换、签名的密钥转换证据、有界历史签名验证、故障关闭式提供方选择、具备重放感知能力的本地控制以及经过认证的回滚状态检查。在一个原型环境中，保留的热启动流水线测量值为5.34毫秒，该数值仅作为描述性本地结果报告。现有异常检测和联邦学习实验被归类为合理性检查，因为它们尚不支持具有统计防御力的鲁棒性指标。本研究表明，机器可读的安全边界和证据感知的声明控制能够提高多机制V2X安全原型的可复现性和可解释性。

articles.title: Sequence-, Epoch-, and Integrity-Aware Detection of Replay and Peer-Spoofing Attacks in Decentralized UAV Mesh Networks: A Software-Validated Security Framework
articles.title_zh: 去中心化无人机网状网络中面向序列、纪元与完整性的重放和对等节点欺骗攻击检测：软件验证安全框架
articles.abstract: Decentralized unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms depend on rapidly changing peer-to-peer links in which a stale but previously valid state, a forged sender identity, or an unauthenticated emergency message can influence collective behavior before a centralized authority can intervene. This paper develops and analyzes a packet-admission framework for replay and peer-spoofing resistance that is grounded in the implemented edge-swarm security path of an open GPS-denied UAV research platform. Each peer packet is represented by sender identity, timestamp, time-to-live, trust epoch, sequence number, source tag, payload, and authentication hook. The implemented admission chain canonicalizes the packet with the authentication field removed, authenticates the canonical CBOR representation with a full HMAC-SHA256 tag, enforces a bounded timestamp/TTL window, requires equality with the configured trust epoch, and rejects any sequence number that is not strictly greater than the last authenticated value. Authentication failure occurs before state-cache mutation or safety-relevant peer action. We formalize this compound predicate, derive replay-rejection, tamper-rejection, epoch-isolation, and pre-action authorization properties, and quantify the operational trade-off introduced by strict monotonic sequencing under packet reordering. Source-level tests cover valid HMAC verification, payload and sender tampering, missing signatures, simulation-only unsigned exceptions, stale epochs, stale sequences, unsupported post-quantum placeholders, cache-update suppression, and authentication of emergency-corridor messages. A repository benchmark reports a swarm-authentication path median of 12.219 ms and mean of 22.603 ms, but the harness includes process-launch overhead and is therefore treated only as a coarse software-path proxy rather than isolated cryptographic latency. The analysis also identifies the principal residual risk: a shared-secret member that is fully compromised can generate valid HMACs and impersonate other identifiers. The resulting framework provides an evidence-bounded baseline for lightweight anti-replay and peer-spoof protection and a clear migration path toward per-node keys, replay windows, hardware-bound identity, and post-quantum authentication.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发并分析了一种用于去中心化无人机集群的分组接纳框架，通过身份认证、时间戳和TTL、信任纪元、严格递增序列号及HMAC-SHA256验证抵御重放和节点欺骗。框架在认证失败时禁止状态缓存更新和安全相关动作，并以源代码测试验证多种篡改、过期和异常情形。研究同时指出，共享密钥成员完全被攻陷后仍可伪造有效HMAC，这是主要残余风险。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 去中心化无人机（UAV）集群依赖快速变化的点对点链路；在这种网络中，陈旧但曾经有效的状态、伪造的发送方身份或未经认证的紧急消息，可能在集中式机构介入之前影响集群行为。本文基于一个无GPS环境无人机研究平台中已实现的边缘集群安全路径，开发并分析了一种抵御重放和对等节点欺骗的分组接纳框架。每个对等节点分组由发送方身份、时间戳、生存时间、信任纪元、序列号、源标签、载荷和认证接口组成。已实现的接纳链会在移除认证字段后对分组进行规范化，使用完整的HMAC-SHA256标签认证规范化的CBOR表示，执行有界的时间戳/TTL窗口检查，要求其与配置的信任纪元相等，并拒绝任何不严格大于上一次认证值的序列号。认证失败发生在状态缓存变更或安全相关对等节点动作之前。我们形式化了这一复合判定条件，推导出重放拒绝、防篡改、纪元隔离和动作前授权等性质，并量化了严格单调排序在分组乱序情况下引入的运行权衡。源代码级测试覆盖有效HMAC验证、载荷和发送方篡改、缺失签名、仅仿真环境的无签名例外、过期纪元、过期序列号、不受支持的后量子占位符、缓存更新抑制以及紧急通道消息的认证。仓库基准测试报告集群认证路径中位数为12.219毫秒、平均值为22.603毫秒，但由于测试工具包含进程启动开销，因此该结果仅被视为粗略的软件路径代理值，而非孤立的密码学延迟。分析还识别出主要残余风险：完全遭到攻陷的共享密钥成员能够生成有效HMAC，并冒充其他标识符。由此形成的框架为轻量级防重放和对等节点欺骗防护提供了受证据约束的基线，并为迁移至每节点密钥、重放窗口、硬件绑定身份和后量子认证提供了清晰路径。

articles.title: Testing a reduced model of transient inner-disk dynamics in magnetically arrested black-hole accretion
articles.title_zh: 检验磁阻塞黑洞吸积中瞬态内盘动力学的约化模型
articles.abstract: Transient disruption and re-formation of the inner disk in magnetically arrested (MAD) black-hole accretion is followed reliably only by general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamic (GRMHD) simulation, at a cost that precludes systematic surveys. Whether a low-cost reduced description carries independent predictive content is therefore a practical question. We study a minimal reaction–diffusion closure for a bounded connectivity order parameter and ask what of its output is not already contained in its input. Four null tests show that the collapse–recovery timescale ratio tracks the prescribed asymmetry of the driver across three decades, varies threefold with the recovery-threshold convention, and yields an amplitude scaling steepened 2.4-fold by two boundary-saturated points; timescale matching therefore cannot validate such a closure. In its place we drive the closure with the horizon magnetic flux measured in a GRMHD run, fit the kinetic coefficients once on a training window, and require the predicted inner-region connectivity on a disjoint window to beat the closure’s own memoryless limit at equal parameter count. Phase-randomised surrogates supply the null, with the whole fitting procedure repeated for each. On an empirically identified stationary interval of one axisymmetric MAD run the closure attains an out-of-sample skill of 0.53, with p = 0.002 against 500 refitted surrogates, stable under movement of the train/test split and of the aggregation radius; on the non-stationary interval the same rule returns no verdict. The physical statement is correspondingly narrow: on that interval the inner-region connectivity of this run responds to the horizon flux with finite relaxation rather than instantaneously.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文检验一种用于描述磁阻塞黑洞吸积中内盘破坏与重建的最小反应—扩散闭合模型。研究以广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟测得的视界磁通驱动模型，并通过独立测试窗口和相位随机化替代数据评估其预测能力。在一个平稳区间内，模型取得样本外技能0.53（相对于500个重新拟合替代模型的p=0.002），支持内区连接性对视界磁通具有有限弛豫而非瞬时响应的狭窄结论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁阻塞（MAD）黑洞吸积中内盘的瞬态破坏和重建，只有通过广义相对论磁流体动力学（GRMHD）模拟才能可靠追踪，而其计算成本使系统性调查无法开展。因此，一个低成本的约化描述是否具有独立的预测内容，是一个实际问题。我们研究了一个针对有界连接性序参量的最小反应—扩散闭合模型，并询问其输出中哪些内容并非已经包含在输入中。四项零假设测试表明，塌缩—恢复时间尺度之比在三个数量级范围内跟随驱动器的预设非对称性变化，随恢复阈值约定变化三倍，并且两个边界饱和点使振幅标度陡化2.4倍；因此，时间尺度匹配不能验证这类闭合模型。作为替代，我们使用一次GRMHD运行中测得的视界磁通驱动该闭合模型，在一个训练窗口上拟合一次动力学系数，并要求模型在一个不相交的测试窗口中，以相同参数数量击败该闭合模型自身的无记忆极限。相位随机化替代数据提供了零假设，并对每个替代数据重复完整拟合过程。在一次轴对称MAD运行的经验识别平稳区间内，该闭合模型取得0.53的样本外技能；相对于500个重新拟合的替代模型，p=0.002，并且在移动训练/测试分割点和聚合半径时结果保持稳定。在非平稳区间，同一规则不返回任何结论。因此，物理结论被相应限定为：在该区间内，这次运行的内区连接性对视界磁通表现出有限弛豫响应，而不是瞬时响应。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Davide Tisi, Sergey Pozdnyakov, and Michele Ceriotti Halide solid electrolytes such as Li₃YCl₆ and Li₃YBr₆ are promising candidates for safer, denser all-solid-state batteries, but their vast alloying space is hard to explore experimentally. Using the universal machine-learning potential PET-MAD, validated against a fine-tuned model, we map how halogen and metal substitution shape structure, phase stability and Li⁺ conductivity in Li₃MX₆ compounds. Halide mixing turns out to act through two competing levers: lattice contraction hinders Li motion, while shorter metal–halide bonds free up diffusion pathways, largely canceling out. Metal-site alloying, in contrast, tunes phase stability and cost with little penalty on conductivity: a practical design principle for optimizing these materials. [Phys. Rev. articles.abstract: Author(s): Julian G. Mann, Johannes Kunze, Nivedita Pan, Ekaterina Kostyurina, Markus Döblinger, Bert Nickel, Jochen Feldmann, and Sushant Ghimire Here, the authors uncover size-dependent exciton formation and biexciton dynamics in AgInS 2 quantum dots, an environmentally friendly I-III-VI semiconductor alternative. Exciton formation proceeds through phonon-mediated inter-valence-band hole relaxation. This process becomes progressively slower with decreasing quantum dot size, in contrast to the Coulomb-mediated relaxation characteristic of II-VI quantum dots. These dynamics govern the emergence of distinct exciton-to-biexciton transitions. The biexciton lifetime increases with crystallite size, with the largest quantum dots exhibiting partial biexciton emission. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125420] Published Wed Aug 26, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了环境友好型I-III-VI族半导体AgInS₂量子点中依赖尺寸的激子形成与双激子动力学。激子通过声子介导的价带间空穴弛豫形成，且量子点尺寸减小时该过程逐渐变慢，这不同于II-VI族量子点中以库仑相互作用为主的弛豫过程。上述动力学决定了不同激子到双激子的跃迁特征；双激子寿命随晶粒尺寸增大而延长，最大的量子点表现出部分双激子发光。
authors: Julian G. Mann, Johannes Kunze, Nivedita Pan, Ekaterina Kostyurina, Markus Döblinger, Bert Nickel, Jochen Feldmann, and Sushant Ghimire
