Quasi-elastic neutron scattering (QENS) techniques including inelastic fixed-window scans (IFWSs) enable the direct probing of such molecular motions throughout thermodynamic phase transitions. Here we present a QENS-IFWS global fitting methodology for systematically investigating the molecular dynamics underpinning BC performance in molecular crystals. We demonstrate this methodology on neopentyl glycol (NPG) and three derivatives spanning chemically distinct routes to dynamical perturbation. By fixing attempt frequencies across samples, we observe measurable differences in the relative activation energies and mobile fractions of hydroxymethyl and full-molecular rotations. The largest observed e9ect is on the hydroxymethyl rotation activation energies, which is closely related to hydrogen bond network stability, ranging from -3.6% to +11.1% in the derivatives compared to pure NPG. The capability of this global fitting strategy to extract subtle variations in molecular rotations highlights QENS as a versatile design tool for guiding BC molecular crystal design.
articles.abstract_zh: 压热分子晶体具有有序-无序相变，为固态加热和制冷提供了有前景的基础，但其设计需要理解驱动转变熵变的微观分子运动。本文提出一种基于准弹性中子散射非弹性固定窗口扫描的全局拟合方法，用于系统研究分子晶体中的分子动力学。以新戊二醇及其三种衍生物为例，研究揭示了羟甲基旋转和全分子旋转在活化能与可动分数方面的细微差异，表明该方法可用于指导压热分子晶体的设计。
authors: Frederic Rendell-Bhatti, David Boldrin, Markus Appel, Donald A. MacLaren
articles.abstract_zh_full: 压热（BC）分子晶体表现出有序-无序相变，为固态加热和制冷提供了有前景的基础。然而，要理性设计这类下一代材料，就需要从微观层面理解驱动转变熵变的分子动力学。包括非弹性固定窗口扫描（IFWS）在内的准弹性中子散射（QENS）技术，能够直接探测热力学相变过程中此类分子运动的变化。在此，我们提出一种QENS-IFWS全局拟合方法，用于系统研究分子晶体压热性能背后的分子动力学。我们以新戊二醇（NPG）及其三种衍生物为例，考察了三条化学性质不同的动力学扰动路径。通过在不同样品之间固定尝试频率，我们观测到羟甲基旋转和全分子旋转的相对活化能及可动分数存在可测量的差异。观察到的最大效应体现在羟甲基旋转活化能上，这与氢键网络的稳定性密切相关；与纯NPG相比，衍生物中的该活化能变化范围为−3.6%至+11.1%。这种全局拟合策略能够提取分子旋转的细微变化，凸显了QENS作为指导压热分子晶体设计的多用途工具的能力。

articles.title: Voltage dynamics of spherical membranes from single ion channel currents
articles.title_zh: 由单个离子通道电流产生的球形膜电压动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ion channels and pumps drive ion-selective currents through cell membranes at localized sites, yet a cell's electrical state is routinely summarized by a single transmembrane voltage. Combining theory and numerical simulations, we resolve the spatiotemporal dynamics of charge reorganization driven by a localized current on a spherical membrane vesicle. At early times, the response is insensitive to membrane geometry: as in the case of a flat membrane (arXiv:2407.11947; arXiv:2508.14001), the transmembrane voltage decays in a monopolar fashion, varying inversely with distance from the source, and crosses over to a dipolar tail that scales as the inverse cube of distance. Under sustained current, this monopolar response spreads outward from the source. Because the vesicle is closed, this response cannot persist indefinitely; once the monopolar front traverses the entire vesicle, the subsequent charging dynamics is dominated by a spatially uniform mode corresponding to capacitive charging of the membrane. We further decompose the bulk potentials into an electrostatic image-charge component that generates the bulk electric fields and a spatially uniform capacitive mode that can be represented as an equivalent circuit. We also derive a nonlocal cable equation governing the transmembrane voltage dynamics and show that the uniform mode is its long-time solution. This work provides a first-principles basis for the electrophysiological simplification of an electrotonically compact cell.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合理论与数值模拟，解析球形膜囊泡上局域电流驱动的电荷重组时空动力学。早期响应与膜几何无关，跨膜电压先呈随距源点反比的单极形式，随后过渡为按距离三次方反比衰减的偶极尾部；持续电流下，单极响应向外扩展。由于囊泡是封闭的，长时间动力学最终由代表膜电容充电的空间均匀模式主导，作者还据此建立了非局域电缆方程及等效电路描述。
authors: Sirui Ning, Joshua B. Fernandes, Karthik Shekhar, Kranthi K. Mandadapu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离子通道和离子泵在局部位置驱动选择性离子流穿过细胞膜，但细胞的电状态通常被概括为单一的跨膜电压。我们结合理论和数值模拟，解析球形膜囊泡上由局域电流驱动的电荷重组时空动力学。在早期阶段，响应对膜的几何形状不敏感：与平面膜的情形（arXiv:2407.11947；arXiv:2508.14001）一样，跨膜电压以单极形式衰减，随距源点的距离成反比，并过渡到按距离的三次方成反比的偶极尾部。在持续电流作用下，这种单极响应从源点向外扩展。由于囊泡是封闭的，该响应不可能无限期持续；一旦单极前沿遍历整个囊泡，随后的充电动力学便由空间均匀模式主导，该模式对应于膜的电容充电。我们进一步将体相电势分解为空间静电像电荷分量和空间均匀的电容模式，前者产生体相电场，后者可用等效电路表示。我们还推导了描述跨膜电压动力学的非局域电缆方程，并表明均匀模式是该方程的长时间解。本工作为将电学紧致细胞进行电生理学简化提供了第一性原理基础。

articles.title: Even-harmonic generation from topological edge states in generalized Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models
articles.title_zh: 广义Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型拓扑边缘态产生偶次谐波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22136v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-order harmonic generation (HHG) in solids has emerged as a powerful probe of symmetry and topological properties in quantum materials. In this work, we investigate the HHG response in one-dimensional solids with edge or midgap states under global and local illumination. We numerically compute the HHG spectrum for the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with next-nearest-opposite sublattice hopping, dubbed the extended SSH (ESSH) model, and the Rice-Mele model, a one-dimensional system with broken inversion symmetry introduced via staggered on-site potentials. By contrasting the spectral features of the ESSH and Rice-Mele models under global illumination, our analysis reveals that although midgap states provide additional pathways for transitions, the resulting interference is destructive, leading to spectral features distinct from those of edge states. Furthermore, when a single boundary of the topological insulator is locally illuminated, the HHG spectrum of the edge states exhibits vanishing odd harmonics, leaving even harmonics dominant in the spectrum. We identify this even-harmonic selection rule as a consequence of the zero-energy character of the edge states and the particle-hole symmetry of the system, which enforces even field parity of the zero-mode response. These findings reveal that the spatial location of the laser illumination offers a route to control the symmetry of the system, thereby selectively suppressing or enhancing even- and odd-order harmonics in low-dimensional nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有边缘态或带隙中态的一维固体中的高次谐波产生，重点考察全局照明和局部照明下的扩展SSH模型与Rice-Mele模型。结果表明，带隙中态虽提供额外跃迁通道，但其干涉为相消干涉，因而与边缘态产生的谱特征不同。对拓扑绝缘体单个边界进行局部照明时，边缘态的奇次谐波消失而偶次谐波占主导，这一选择定则源于零能边缘态和粒子-空穴对称性。
authors: Chi-Ting Liu, J-S You, Hsiu-Chuan Hsu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固体中的高次谐波产生（HHG）已成为探测量子材料对称性和拓扑性质的有力工具。在本工作中，我们研究具有边缘态或带隙中态的一维固体在全局照明和局部照明下的高次谐波响应。我们数值计算了具有次近邻异子晶格跃迁的一维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型，即所谓扩展SSH（ESSH）模型，以及通过交错现场势引入反演对称性破缺的一维Rice-Mele模型的HHG谱。通过比较ESSH模型和Rice-Mele模型在全局照明下的谱特征，我们的分析表明，尽管带隙中态提供了额外的跃迁路径，但由此产生的干涉是相消的，因此其谱特征不同于边缘态的谱特征。此外，当拓扑绝缘体的单个边界受到局部照明时，边缘态的HHG谱中奇次谐波消失，偶次谐波在谱中占主导。我们确认，这一偶次谐波选择定则是零能边缘态特征和体系粒子-空穴对称性的结果；粒子-空穴对称性强制零模响应具有偶数场宇称。这些发现表明，激光照明的空间位置为控制体系对称性提供了一条途径，从而能够在低维纳米结构中选择性地抑制或增强偶次和奇次谐波。

articles.title: Unified Bonding Entropy Model for Kekulé Graphene Nanoflakes
articles.title_zh: Kekulé石墨烯纳米片的统一成键熵模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The open-shell character of Kekulé graphene nanoflakes (GNFs) is conventionally rationalized by the gain of Clar aromatic π-sextets upon electron unpairing. While this rule successfully explains many quinoidal diradicaloids, it treats only the maximum number of sextets and neglects the multiplicity and spatial distribution of resonance configurations that realize the same Clar count. Here, we identify a second route to open-shell stabilization in which the maximum Clar-sextet number remains unchanged while the number of accessible Clar resonators increases substantially. We term this mechanism emph{Clar-number-invariant resonance-space expansion}. By enumerating closed-shell and open-shell Clar resonators and combining this analysis with a bonding entropy model (BEM), we show that electron unpairing can release closed-shell pairing constraints, enlarge the resonance manifold, and redistribute C--C bond occupancies away from localized single- and double-bond limits. The BEM-predicted number and spatial distribution of unpaired electrons correlate strongly with density-functional-theory diradical character, local magnetic moments, optimized C--C bond lengths, and relative energies across a broad set of GNFs. The resulting framework offers a graph-based and physically transparent route for screening open-shell carbon nanostructures and for designing tunable molecular spins without requiring an increase in the maximum Clar number.
articles.abstract_zh: Kekulé石墨烯纳米片的开壳层特征通常用电子解配对后获得更多Clar芳香性π六元环来解释，但这一规则忽略了实现相同Clar数量的共振构型的多重性和空间分布。本文提出一种“Clar数量不变的共振空间扩展”机制，指出电子解配对可以扩大可访问的共振流形并重新分配碳-碳键占据。结合成键熵模型，研究结果显示，预测的未成对电子数量和空间分布与密度泛函理论得到的自由基特征、局域磁矩、键长及相对能量高度相关。
authors: Chang-Chun He, Yu-Jun Zhao, Xiao-Bao Yang
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kekulé石墨烯纳米片（GNF）的开壳层特征通常被解释为电子解配对后获得Clar芳香性π六元环。尽管这一规则能够成功解释许多醌式双自由基分子，但它只处理六元环的最大数量，而忽略了实现相同Clar数量的共振构型的多重性和空间分布。在此，我们识别出另一种开壳层稳定化路径：最大Clar六元环数保持不变，但可访问的Clar共振体数量显著增加。我们将这一机制称为“Clar数量不变的共振空间扩展”。通过枚举闭壳层和开壳层Clar共振体，并将这一分析与成键熵模型（BEM）结合，我们表明，电子解配对能够解除闭壳层配对约束，扩大共振流形，并使碳-碳键占据率偏离局域化的单键和双键极限。BEM预测的未成对电子数量及其空间分布，与一系列GNF中的密度泛函理论双自由基特征、局域磁矩、优化后的碳-碳键长以及相对能量均具有很强的相关性。由此形成的框架为筛选开壳层碳纳米结构和设计可调分子自旋提供了一条基于图论且具有清晰物理意义的途径，而不要求最大Clar数量增加。

articles.title: Coordinate transformations and matter waves cloaking
articles.title_zh: 坐标变换与物质波隐身
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22256v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformation method provides an efficient tool to control wave propagation inside the materials. Using the coordinate transformation approach, we study invisibility cloaks with sphere, cylinder and ellipsoid structures for electronic waves propagation. The underlying physics behind this investigation is the fact that the Schrödinger equation with position-dependent mass tensor and potentials has a covariant form that follows the coordinate transformation. Using this technique we obtain the exact spatial form of the mass tensor and potentials for a variety of cloaks with different shapes.
articles.abstract_zh: 变换方法为控制材料内部的波传播提供了有效工具。本文利用坐标变换方法研究球形、柱形和椭球形结构对电子波传播的隐身作用。其理论基础是：具有位置依赖质量张量和势能的薛定谔方程具有遵循坐标变换的协变形式，由此可得到不同形状隐身结构所需质量张量和势能的精确空间形式。
authors: Reza G. Mohammadi, Ali G. Moghaddam, Ramin Mohammadkhani
articles.abstract_zh_full: 变换方法为控制材料内部的波传播提供了有效工具。利用坐标变换方法，我们研究了具有球形、柱形和椭球形结构的电子波传播隐身器。该研究所依据的物理原理是：具有位置依赖质量张量和势能的薛定谔方程具有协变形式，并遵循坐标变换。利用这一技术，我们获得了各种不同形状隐身器所需质量张量和势能的精确空间形式。

articles.title: Anomalous metallic states at magnetic interfaces in an antiferromagnetic topological insulator candidate DyPtBi with ferroquadrupolar order
articles.title_zh: 具有铁四极有序的反铁磁拓扑绝缘体候选材料DyPtBi磁性界面上的反常金属态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic topological insulators provide a fertile platform where symmetry-breaking magnetic order is intertwined with topological electronic states. In particular, magnetic domain walls have attracted much attention, as they can be easily controlled by external fields as in general magnets, and moreover, host nontrivial electronic states distinct from those in bulks and sample surfaces. Here, we report a new antiferromagnetic topological insulator candidate DyPtBi, which hosts conductive magnetic domain walls controllable by uniaxial stress and magnetic field. We find that the resistivity exhibits abrupt increase upon the magnetic and structural phase transition. Concomitantly, the transverse ultrasonic mode shows remarkable softening of 6 %, indicating that the Dy 4f ferroquadrupolar order plays a vital role in the phase transition. Furthermore, we reveal by neutron experiments that applying compressive uniaxial stress aligns the magnetic domain state, leading to the strong resistivity enhancement of 14 % while eliminating the conductive magnetic domain walls. These findings demonstrate that DyPtBi exhibits topological electronic states entangled with multipolar degrees of freedom, providing a promising route for in situ control of topological properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了反铁磁拓扑绝缘体候选材料DyPtBi，并发现其中存在可由单轴应力和磁场控制的导电磁畴壁。磁性和结构相变伴随电阻率突增以及横向超声模式约6%的显著软化，表明Dy的4f铁四极有序在相变中发挥重要作用。中子实验显示，压缩单轴应力能够排列磁畴并消除导电磁畴壁，使电阻率增强14%，揭示了多极自由度与拓扑电子态的耦合及其原位调控潜力。
authors: Kentaro Ueda, Hiraku Saito, Zen Ogame, Isao Ishii, Ruo Hibino, Tatsuya Yanagisawa, Shinichi Itoh, Taro Nakajima, Yoshinori Tokura
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体提供了一个富有潜力的平台，在其中，破缺对称性的磁有序与拓扑电子态相互交织。特别是，磁畴壁受到了广泛关注，因为它们像一般磁体中的磁畴一样容易通过外场控制，而且还承载着不同于体相和样品表面中电子态的非平庸电子态。在此，我们报道了一种新的反铁磁拓扑绝缘体候选材料DyPtBi，其中存在可由单轴应力和磁场控制的导电磁畴壁。我们发现，在磁性和结构相变发生时，电阻率会突然增加。与此同时，横向超声模式表现出约6%的显著软化，表明Dy的4f铁四极有序在相变中发挥了重要作用。此外，我们通过中子实验揭示，施加压缩单轴应力能够排列磁畴状态，使电阻率显著增强14%，同时消除导电磁畴壁。这些发现表明，DyPtBi具有与多极自由度纠缠的拓扑电子态，为原位调控拓扑性质提供了一条有前景的途径。

articles.title: Engineering exact mobility edges in quasiperiodic Aharonov-Bohm chains
articles.title_zh: 准周期Aharonov-Bohm链中精确迁移率边的工程构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate localization phenomena and exact mobility edges in a quasiperiodic Aharonov-Bohm chain, where the 1D canonical diagonal and off-diagonal Aubry-André-Harper models are laterally coupled to an auxiliary sublattice threaded by a synthetic magnetic flux. By analytically computing the Lyapunov exponent via Avila's global theory of one-frequency Schrödinger operators, we derive exact expressions for mobility edges. In the diagonal limit, the coupling to the auxiliary sublattice generates hyperbolic mobility edges that exhibit a sign-changing divergence and can be continuously tuned by the magnetic flux. In the off-diagonal regime, the interference between quasiperiodic hopping and indirect tunneling through the auxiliary sublattice gives rise to exact anomalous mobility edges that separate critical and extended states. Critical states and anomalous mobility edges emerge even in the absence of incommensurately distributed zeros in the hopping modulation, a behavior distinct from that of conventional off-diagonal models. Our results establish a rigorous theoretical framework for engineering controllable mobility edges, with the synthetic flux providing a tunable experimental knob that paves the way for realizations in platforms such as superconducting quantum circuits and photonic waveguides.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究准周期Aharonov-Bohm链中的局域化现象和精确迁移率边，其中一维对角和非对角Aubry-André-Harper模型横向耦合到穿过合成磁通的辅助子晶格。通过利用一频薛定谔算子Avila全局理论解析计算Lyapunov指数，作者推导出精确迁移率边表达式。结果显示，合成磁通可连续调节具有符号变号发散特征的双曲迁移率边，并在非对角情形下产生分隔临界态和延展态的反常迁移率边。
authors: Hai-Ying Cui, Yi-Cong Yu, Xiaoming Cai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究准周期Aharonov-Bohm链中的局域化现象和精确迁移率边。在该体系中，一维标准对角和非对角Aubry-André-Harper模型横向耦合到一个穿过合成磁通的辅助子晶格。通过利用一频薛定谔算子的Avila全局理论解析计算Lyapunov指数，我们推导出迁移率边的精确表达式。在对角极限下，与辅助子晶格的耦合产生双曲迁移率边；这些迁移率边具有符号变换发散特征，并可通过磁通连续调节。在非对角区域，准周期跃迁与经辅助子晶格发生的间接隧穿之间的干涉产生精确的反常迁移率边，将临界态和延展态分隔开来。即使在跃迁调制中不存在非互相位分布的零点，临界态和反常迁移率边仍会出现，这一行为不同于传统的非对角模型。我们的结果建立了一个用于工程构造可控迁移率边的严格理论框架，其中合成磁通作为可调实验参数，为在超导量子电路和光子波导等平台上实现相关体系铺平了道路。

articles.title: Machine-learning-guided molecular dynamics simulations of point defect evolution in beta-Ga2O3 during ion implantation and annealing
articles.title_zh: 机器学习引导的分子动力学模拟：离子注入与退火过程中β-Ga2O3点缺陷的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In beta-gallium oxide (beta-Ga2O3), Ga-ion implantation and annealing induce abundant point defects. To overcome conventional Wigner-Seitz (WS) defect analysis limitations, a defect identification algorithm based on similarity matching and DBSCAN clustering is developed for beta-Ga2O3. It distinguishes lattice atoms from defects at high concentrations and identifies eight Ga interstitial configurations (Gaia to Gaih). Comparing SRIM and MD data highlights electronic stopping effects: neglecting them overestimates ion range and defect concentration. Across five fluences (1 to 5 x 10¹⁴ cm-2), 1373 K is the optimal recovery temperature. Multiscale analyses using hydrostatic stress, PRDF, and defect concentration reveal defect evolution. Ga interstitials (Gai) occupy tetrahedral and octahedral sites, driving a defect-mediated phase transition from beta- to gamma-Ga2O3. Increasing fluences reduce beta-phase recovery and increase gamma-phase transformation irreversibly. Oxygen interstitial (Oi) migration is sensitive to annealing temperature, which enhances O-sublattice recrystallization.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对β-Ga2O3中镓离子注入和退火产生的大量点缺陷，本文开发了结合相似性匹配与DBSCAN聚类的缺陷识别算法，以克服传统Wigner-Seitz分析的局限。该算法可在高缺陷浓度下区分晶格原子与缺陷，并识别八种镓间隙构型；SRIM与分子动力学数据的比较还显示，忽略电子阻止会高估离子射程和缺陷浓度。研究确定1373 K为五种注量下的最佳恢复温度，并揭示了镓间隙原子驱动β相向γ相转变、注量升高抑制β相恢复以及退火促进氧子晶格再结晶等现象。
authors: Huawen Li, Mengzhi Yan, Zongwei Xu, Junlei Zhao, Jiale Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在β-氧化镓（β-Ga2O3）中，镓离子注入和退火会诱导大量点缺陷。为克服传统Wigner-Seitz（WS）缺陷分析的局限，我们开发了一种基于相似性匹配和DBSCAN聚类的缺陷识别算法，用于β-Ga2O3。该算法能够在高缺陷浓度下区分晶格原子与缺陷，并识别出八种镓间隙构型（Gaia至Gaih）。对SRIM和分子动力学数据的比较突出了电子阻止效应：忽略电子阻止会高估离子射程和缺陷浓度。在1至5 × 10¹⁴ cm⁻²的五种注量下，1373 K是最佳恢复温度。结合静水应力、部分径向分布函数（PRDF）和缺陷浓度进行的多尺度分析揭示了缺陷演化过程。镓间隙原子（Gai）占据四面体和八面体位置，驱动了由缺陷介导的β-Ga2O3向γ-Ga2O3的相变。随着注量增加，β相恢复程度降低，而γ相转变不可逆地增强。氧间隙原子（Oi）的迁移对退火温度敏感，退火会促进氧子晶格的再结晶。

articles.title: Flexo-Strain Engineering of Phonons and Ferrons in Thin Films of Van der Waals Ferrielectrics
articles.title_zh: 范德瓦耳斯亚铁电薄膜中声子与铁子（ferron）的挠曲应变工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The influence of the flexoelectric coupling on the fluctuations of electric polarization and elastic strains can lead to the principal changes of the dispersion law of soft optical and acoustic phonons and ferrons in a bulk van der Waals ferrielectrics. Since the size, gradient and strain effects determine phase diagrams and polarization behavior in thin films, it is reasonable to assume that the flexocoupling and mismatch strains should have a strong influence on the dispersion of phonons and ferrons in thin films of van der Waals ferroelectrics. Using the Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire approach, in this work we reveal that the dispersion of soft phonons and ferrons is strongly dependent on the sign and magnitude of elastic strains, which originate from the lattice constants mismatch in thin strained films of van der Waals ferrielectric CuInP2S6. In particular, the frequency of acoustic phonons and ferrons tends to zero at nonzero wavevectors k>k_cr, where the critical value of the wavevector k_cr is determined by the mismatch strain, flexoelectric coupling strength and temperature. Zeroing of the acoustic phonon frequency, that appears with increase of tensile strains, indicates a possible emergence of a spatially modulated incommensurate polar phase induced by the flexo-strain effects. Analytical results, derived in this work, open the way for flexo-strain engineering of soft phonon and ferron dispersion in thin films of van der Waals ferrielectrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 挠曲电耦合与晶格失配应变会显著改变范德瓦耳斯亚铁电体薄膜中软光学声子、声学声子和铁子的色散关系。基于朗道–金兹堡–德文希尔理论，研究表明，CuInP2S6薄膜中的声子和铁子色散强烈依赖弹性应变的符号与大小；在一定条件下，有限波矢处的声学模频率趋于零，预示着挠曲应变诱导的空间调制极性相可能形成。该结果为调控范德瓦耳斯亚铁电薄膜中的软模色散提供了理论途径。
authors: Anna N. Morozovska, Eugene A. Eliseev, Yujie Zhu, Mykola Yelisieiev, Hanna V. Shevliakova, Yulian M. Vysochanskii, Venkatraman Gopalan, Long-Qing Chen, Jia-Mian Hu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 挠曲电耦合对电极化和弹性应变涨落的影响，可能导致块体范德瓦耳斯亚铁电体中软光学声子、声学声子和铁子色散关系发生根本性变化。由于尺寸、梯度和应变效应决定着薄膜中的相图与极化行为，因此有理由认为，挠曲电耦合和失配应变应当会强烈影响范德瓦耳斯铁电薄膜中声子和铁子的色散。本文采用朗道–金兹堡–德文希尔方法，揭示了范德瓦耳斯亚铁电体CuInP2S6的薄膜中，源于晶格常数失配的弹性应变的符号和大小会强烈影响软声子和铁子的色散。特别是，当波矢为非零值且满足k>k_cr时，声学声子和铁子的频率趋于零，其中波矢临界值k_cr由失配应变、挠曲电耦合强度和温度共同决定。随着拉伸应变增加，声学声子频率归零，这表明可能出现由挠曲应变效应诱导的空间调制非公度极性相。本文得到的解析结果为范德瓦耳斯亚铁电薄膜中软声子和铁子色散的挠曲应变工程开辟了道路。

articles.title: Strain-driven spin-flop transition and collapse of the giant magnon gap in the bilayer iridate Sr₃Ir₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 双层铱酸盐Sr₃Ir₂O₇中应变驱动的自旋翻转转变与巨磁振子能隙塌缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The bilayer iridate Sr₃Ir₂O₇ is a c-axis collinear antiferromagnet, held there by a giant interlayer pseudodipolar anisotropy, whereas single-layer Sr₂IrO₄ cants in the ab plane. We show from first principles that biaxial compression of a few percent (ε_capprox-2.4%) flops the easy axis of Sr₃Ir₂O₇ into the plane. A magnetic model Hamiltonian built from Wannier functions with no fitted parameter---reproducing the giant magnon gap of the bulk, so far known only from fits to experiment---identifies the mechanism. Compression collapses the interlayer exchange channel, whose straight Ir--O--Ir path weakens as the bent in-plane path strengthens. Hund's exchange sets the scale of the anisotropy and, beyond J/Uapprox0.15, removes the collinear state altogether. The flop is not a rigid rotation---the ordered moments of the two states cross at ε_c---and it carries a stark fingerprint, in that the giant easy-axis magnon gap collapses to a gapless, Goldstone-like spectrum. Compressively strained films thus sit on a metamagnetic phase boundary ending in a zero-temperature bicritical point, a charge-neutral handle on the moment direction.
articles.abstract_zh: 第一性原理计算表明，几个百分点的双轴压缩应变可使双层铱酸盐Sr₃Ir₂O₇的易磁化轴从c轴翻转至面内方向。其机制在于层间交换通道减弱，而面内交换通道增强；Hund交换决定了各向异性的能标，并在较大J/U下消除共线反铁磁态。该自旋翻转伴随着巨大的易轴磁振子能隙塌缩为近似无能隙的Goldstone型谱，说明受压薄膜可处于亚铁磁相变边界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双层铱酸盐Sr₃Ir₂O₇是一种c轴共线反铁磁体，其这一磁结构由巨大的层间赝偶极各向异性维持，而单层材料Sr₂IrO₄的自旋则在ab平面内发生倾斜。我们通过第一性原理计算表明，几个百分点的双轴压缩应变（ε_c≈−2.4%）会使Sr₃Ir₂O₇的易磁化轴翻转到面内。我们利用Wannier函数构建了一个不含拟合参数的磁性模型哈密顿量；该模型能够再现块体材料的巨大磁振子能隙，而这一能隙此前只能通过实验拟合得到，并由此确定了相应机制。压缩应变会使层间交换通道塌缩，因为直线型Ir–O–Ir路径变弱，而弯曲的面内路径增强。Hund交换决定了各向异性的尺度，并且当J/U超过约0.15时，会彻底消除共线态。该翻转并非刚性旋转，因为两种状态中的有序磁矩会在ε_c处相交；它还具有鲜明特征，即巨大的易轴磁振子能隙会塌缩为无能隙的、类似Goldstone模的谱。因此，受压应变的薄膜处在一条以零温双临界点为终点的变磁相边界上，为调节磁矩方向提供了一种电荷中性的控制手段。

articles.title: Time reversal of complex evolution on a quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上复杂演化的时间反演
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Boltzmann-Loschmidt dispute in 1876-1877 discussed the problem of time reversal of ther- malization from time reversible classical equations of motion. Here, 150 years later, we highlight this problem in the frame of quantum computing. A quantum protocol is proposed that allows to perform a time reversal of complex evolution in the regime of many-body quantum chaos with many qubits. The system represents an evolution of qubits on a square lattice with inter-qubit next-nearest static couplings with a driven pulsed magnetic field. The system entropy grows rapidly to maximal values but returns to initial small values after time reversal. This time reversal is shown to be stable with respect to quantum gate imperfections. However, similar to the Lorenz butterfly effect, there is the butterfly effect of qubit when inversion of only one qubit breaks time reversibility of the whole system. It is argued that this protocol is accessible to nowadays quantum computers and annealers with hundreds of qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将1876—1877年关于热化时间反演的玻尔兹曼–洛施密特争论置于量子计算框架下进行研究，并提出一种可在多量子比特多体量子混沌体系中实现复杂演化时间反演的量子协议。模拟表明，体系熵在快速增长至最大值后可返回初始的小值，而且该反演对量子门误差具有一定稳定性。与此同时，只反转一个量子比特就可能破坏整个体系的时间可逆性，呈现出类似洛伦兹蝴蝶效应的量子比特蝴蝶效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 1876—1877年间的玻尔兹曼–洛施密特争论讨论了这样一个问题：如何从时间可逆的经典运动方程出发实现热化过程的时间反演。150年后，我们在量子计算的框架下重新强调这一问题。本文提出了一种量子协议，可以在具有许多量子比特的多体量子混沌体系中实现复杂演化的时间反演。该体系描述了正方形晶格上的量子比特演化，其中量子比特之间存在次近邻静态耦合，并受到驱动的脉冲磁场作用。体系熵会迅速增长到最大值，但在时间反演后又返回初始的小值。研究表明，这种时间反演对于量子门的不完善具有稳定性。然而，与洛伦兹蝴蝶效应类似，只反转一个量子比特就会破坏整个体系的时间可逆性，从而产生量子比特蝴蝶效应。本文认为，该协议可由当今拥有数百个量子比特的量子计算机和量子退火机实现。

articles.title: Anomalous dynamical energy flows via nonlinear phononics in spin-Peierls chains
articles.title_zh: 自旋–Peierls链中经由非线性声子学的反常动态能量流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium spin-phonon dynamics and energy cascades in a strongly dimerized spin-Peierls chain using a multi-tiered nonlinear phononics architecture. To bypass linear selection rules prohibiting the direct excitation of the Raman-active dimerization mode, a terahertz laser drives an infrared mode that nonlinearly couples to the Raman lattice displacement, subsequently modulating the magnetic exchange. Employing a bond-operator formalism with a second-order cumulant expansion of the Lindblad master equation, we show that maximum energy transfer into the magnetic sector is governed by a dynamical impedance-matching condition rather than the unperturbed triplon density of states. We find that the sustained energy input of continuous-wave driving builds high excitation densities that severely back-act on the lattice, overdamping the primary phonon and smearing magnetic features via power broadening. Conversely, the small time-integrated energy of a pulse keeps the response perturbative, terminating before back-action accumulates and preserving sharp Fano-like quantum interferences. These insights establish limits for controlling dynamic magnetic states without quenching the driving lattice modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了强二聚化自旋–Peierls链中的非平衡自旋–声子动力学与能量级联，并利用红外声子与拉曼二聚化模之间的非线性耦合间接激发磁性自由度。结果表明，向磁性扇区的最大能量转移由动态阻抗匹配条件决定，而不是由未扰动的三重态激发子态密度决定。连续波驱动会因晶格反作用导致主声子过阻尼和磁性特征展宽，而脉冲驱动的总能量输入较小，可保持微扰响应与清晰的Fano型量子干涉。
authors: Jakob Dolgner, Dirk Manske, James K. Freericks, Mohsen Yarmohammadi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用多层级非线性声子学架构，研究了强二聚化自旋–Peierls链中的非平衡自旋–声子动力学和能量级联。为绕过禁止直接激发拉曼活性二聚化模的线性选择定则，太赫兹激光驱动一个红外模，该红外模与拉曼晶格位移发生非线性耦合，随后调制磁性交换。我们采用键算符形式，并对Lindblad主方程进行二阶累积展开，结果表明，向磁性扇区的最大能量转移由动态阻抗匹配条件控制，而不是由未扰动的三重态激发子态密度控制。研究发现，连续波驱动持续输入能量，会建立很高的激发密度并对晶格产生强烈反作用，使主声子发生过阻尼，同时通过功率展宽抹平磁性特征。相反，脉冲驱动的时间积分能量较小，使响应保持在微扰范围内，并在反作用累积之前终止，从而保留清晰的类Fano量子干涉。这些认识明确了在不淬灭驱动晶格模的情况下控制动态磁态的限制。

articles.title: High-throughput identification of ferromagnetic Kagome candidates in the AT6X4 and AT6X5 families
articles.title_zh: AT₆X₄和AT₆X₅家族中铁磁性Kagome候选材料的高通量筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic high-throughput density-functional theory study of the thermodynamic stability, collinear magnetic ground states, and electronic structures of layered kagome compounds in the AT6X4 and AT6X5 families. Using the experimentally reported structure types as templates, we screened 78 substitutional compositions in each family. Our calculations reproduce the stability and antiferromagnetic character of the known Fe-based Ge compounds and identify six additional stable candidates with robust ferromagnetism. Within collinear spin configurations, we find a clear chemistry-dependent trend: stable Fe-based Ge compounds predominantly adopt AFM2 ground states, whereas stable Mn-based Ge compounds consistently favor ferromagnetic order. Exchange analysis further shows that the magnetic phase space is governed by competing interlayer interactions, consistent with the mechanism established for AT6X6 kagome magnets. Representative ferromagnetic members from the two structural families also retain kagome-derived dispersive band features near K, although the AT6X5 phase exhibits stronger band folding and hybridization. Overall, these results establish AT6X4 and AT6X5 as promising layered kagome families for realizing ferromagnetism and kagome-derived electronic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用高通量密度泛函理论，系统研究了AT₆X₄和AT₆X₅层状Kagome化合物的热力学稳定性、共线磁性基态和电子结构，并在每个家族中筛选了78种替代组分。除重现已知铁基锗化合物的稳定性和反铁磁性外，研究还发现了六种具有稳健铁磁性的稳定候选材料。交换相互作用分析表明，磁性相空间主要由竞争性的层间相互作用决定，代表性铁磁成员在K点附近保留了源于Kagome结构的色散能带特征。
authors: Shiya Chen, Vladimir Antropov, Yang Sun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用高通量密度泛函理论，系统研究了AT₆X₄和AT₆X₅家族层状Kagome化合物的热力学稳定性、共线磁性基态以及电子结构。我们以实验报道的结构类型为模板，在每个家族中筛选了78种替代组分。计算结果再现了已知铁基锗化合物的稳定性和反铁磁特征，并识别出另外六种具有稳健铁磁性的稳定候选材料。在共线自旋构型范围内，我们发现了明显的依赖化学组成的趋势：稳定的铁基锗化合物主要采用AFM2基态，而稳定的锰基锗化合物则始终倾向于铁磁有序。进一步的交换相互作用分析表明，磁性相空间由相互竞争的层间相互作用支配，这与AT₆X₆ Kagome磁体中已确立的机制一致。两个结构家族中的代表性铁磁成员在K点附近也保留了源于Kagome结构的色散能带特征，不过AT₆X₅相表现出更强的能带折叠和杂化。总体而言，这些结果表明，AT₆X₄和AT₆X₅是实现铁磁性及源于Kagome结构电子态的有前景层状材料家族。

articles.title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
articles.title_zh: 分子自旋链与超导体的奇偶依赖耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22736v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological order can fractionalize the quantum numbers of the underlying particles. A paradigmatic example is the spin-1/2 states at the edges of an antiferromagnetic integer-spin chain, protected by a topological Haldane gap in the bulk and mutually coupled in short chains. Owing to their topological protection, they are natural building blocks for hybrid spin-superconductor quantum systems. Whether fractionalization survives the coupling to a superconducting condensate, however, remains an open question. Here we grow molecular Haldane chains of antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1 triangulene units on a proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110) surface and resolve a parity-dependent coupling of their spin-1/2 edge states to the superconducting condensate by scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. Odd-length chains host Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states inside the superconducting gap, originating from the net S=1 ground state, whereas even-length chains form an S=0 ground state decoupled from the superconductor. A two-site superconductor model reveals that this alternation arises from the sign and strength of the inter-edge interaction, a mechanism independently validated by extra-gap spin excitations in tunnelling spectra. Collective many-body spin excitation modes are also detected decoupled from the superconductor by the much larger Haldane gap. The length-tunable coupling of the edge spins to the superconductor opens a route toward molecular spin qubits based on π-conjugated carbon architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在近邻化的Au(111)/Nb(110)表面上制备了由反铁磁耦合自旋-1三角烯单元组成的分子Haldane链，并通过扫描隧道谱观测到自旋-1/2边缘态与超导凝聚态之间依赖链长奇偶性的耦合。奇数长度链具有源于总自旋S=1基态的Yu–Shiba–Rusinov隙内束缚态，而偶数长度链形成与超导体解耦的S=0基态。边缘自旋与超导体之间可由链长调节的耦合，为构筑基于π共轭碳结构的分子自旋量子比特提供了途径。
authors: Katerina Vaxevani, Jon Ortuzar, Stefano Trivini, Georg Monninger, Dongfei Wang, Vilas-Varela, Lucía Gómez-Rodrigo, Diego Peña, Jose Ignacio Pascual
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑序可以使底层粒子的量子数发生分数化。一个典型例子是反铁磁整数自旋链边缘处的自旋-1/2态；这些态受到体内拓扑Haldane能隙的保护，并在短链中相互耦合。由于具有拓扑保护，它们是混合自旋–超导量子系统的天然构件。然而，分数化在与超导凝聚态耦合后是否仍能保持，至今仍是一个开放问题。在近邻化的Au(111)/Nb(110)表面上，我们生长了由反铁磁耦合的自旋-1三角烯单元组成的分子Haldane链，并通过扫描隧道谱分辨出其自旋-1/2边缘态与超导凝聚态之间依赖链长奇偶性的耦合。奇数长度链具有位于超导能隙内的Yu–Shiba–Rusinov束缚态，该束缚态源于总自旋S=1的基态；而偶数长度链形成S=0基态，并与超导体解耦。一个双位点超导体模型表明，这种交替行为源于边缘之间相互作用的符号和强度；隧道谱中超出能隙的自旋激发进一步独立验证了这一机制。由于较大的Haldane能隙，集体多体自旋激发模也被探测到，并且与超导体解耦。边缘自旋与超导体之间可由链长调节的耦合，为基于π共轭碳结构构筑分子自旋量子比特开辟了道路。

articles.title: Role of d-electron density of states in the quantum size effect newline of Pt-Ni and Pt-Pd nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: d电子态密度在Pt–Ni和Pt–Pd纳米颗粒量子尺寸效应中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated the quantum size effect (QSE) in bimetallic Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ and Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ nanoparticles, using ¹⁹⁵Pt nuclear magnetic resonance measurements. The temperature and size dependencies of the anomaly in the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate divided by temperature 1/T₁T in the Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ nanoparticles suggest similar electron states between Pt and Pd atoms and are well understood by the QSE. The temperature and composition variations of 1/T₁T and Knight shift reveal a systematic increase in the density of states and reduction of the characteristic energy scale T^* with increasing Ni content, consistent with the Kubo gap δKᵤbₒ. In contrast to Pt₁₋ₓCuₓ nanoparticles where the QSE is suppressed, the Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ nanoparticles exhibit clear signatures of quantum energy discretization. This discrepancy highlights the essential role of d-electrons in the manifestation of the QSE. Furthermore, analysis of the modified Korringa parameter K(α) suggests enhanced ferromagnetic correlations with increasing Ni concentration, approaching a ferromagnetic quantum critical regime. These results provide experimental evidence that d-electron density of states plays a crucial role in the manifestation of the QSE in the nanoparticles formed by the metallic d-electron atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用¹⁹⁵Pt核磁共振测量研究了双金属Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ和Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒中的量子尺寸效应。Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ纳米颗粒中核自旋晶格弛豫率除以温度后的异常行为与量子尺寸效应相符，而Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ体系中随Ni含量增加，态密度系统性增强、特征能标T*降低。与Pt₁₋ₓCuₓ纳米颗粒中量子尺寸效应受到抑制不同，Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒表现出清晰的量子能级离散化，并显示出增强的铁磁关联，说明d电子态密度对金属纳米颗粒量子尺寸效应的形成至关重要。
authors: S. Kitagawa, T. Ihara, Y. Kinoshita, K. Ishida, K. Kusada, H. Kitagawa
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用¹⁹⁵Pt核磁共振测量，研究了双金属Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ和Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒中的量子尺寸效应（QSE）。Pt₁₋ₓPdₓ纳米颗粒中，核自旋晶格弛豫率除以温度后的异常行为1/T₁T在温度和尺寸上的依赖性表明，Pt原子和Pd原子的电子态相似，并且可以用QSE很好地理解。1/T₁T和Knight位移随温度及组分的变化显示，随着Ni含量增加，态密度系统性升高，而特征能标T*降低，这与Kubo能隙δ_Kubo一致。与Pt₁₋ₓCuₓ纳米颗粒中QSE受到抑制的情况相反，Pt₁₋ₓNiₓ纳米颗粒表现出量子能量离散化的清晰特征。这一差异突出了d电子在QSE显现过程中的关键作用。此外，修正的Korringa参数K(α)分析表明，随着Ni浓度增加，铁磁关联增强，并趋近于铁磁量子临界区域。这些结果为d电子态密度在由金属d电子原子形成的纳米颗粒中QSE显现所发挥的关键作用提供了实验证据。

articles.title: A Novel Decoupling Method for Investigating Distinct Domain Evolution in Ferroelectric Film
articles.title_zh: 研究铁电薄膜中不同畴演化的新型解耦方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional polarization characterization techniques provide only the averaged response of ferroelectric films, limiting the investigation of domain-dependent reliability mechanisms in HfO2-based ferroelectrics. In this work, a new domain decoupling method is proposed to separately analyze ferroelectric domains with distinct switching behaviors. A three-domain model consisting of upward non-switchable domains, downward non-switchable domains, and switchable domains (Pd) is first introduced to describe heterogeneous domain populations during electrical cycling. By combining complementary switching-current measurements, the responses of different domain populations can be selectively extracted and reconstructed. The proposed method enables quantitative tracking of individual domain populations during cycling. As a demonstration, the method is further applied to analyze the time-dependent evolution of domain populations after electrical cycling. This approach provides a new route for investigating imprint, fatigue, and other reliability-related phenomena in ferroelectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统极化表征技术只能提供铁电薄膜的平均响应，因此难以研究与畴相关的可靠性机制。本文提出一种畴解耦方法，通过包含向上不可切换畴、向下不可切换畴和可切换畴（Pd）的三畴模型，结合互补的开关电流测量，分别提取并重构不同畴群的响应。该方法可定量追踪电循环过程中各类畴的演化，并用于分析电循环后的时间依赖性畴演变，为研究印记、疲劳等铁电器件可靠性现象提供了新途径。
authors: Keying Sun, Jiajun Qiu, Hao Li, Zongwei Shang, Lang Zeng, Ming Li, Lining Zhang, Runsheng Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的极化表征技术只能提供铁电薄膜的平均响应，从而限制了对依赖畴的可靠性机制的研究。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的畴解耦方法，用于分别分析具有不同开关行为的铁电畴。首先引入一个三畴模型，其中包括向上不可切换畴、向下不可切换畴以及可切换畴（Pd），以描述电循环过程中的非均匀畴群。通过结合互补的开关电流测量，可以选择性地提取和重构不同畴群的响应。所提出的方法能够在电循环过程中定量追踪各个畴群的数量。作为示例，我们进一步利用该方法分析电循环之后畴群随时间的演化。该方法为研究铁电器件中的印记、疲劳以及其他与可靠性相关的现象提供了新的途径。

articles.title: Mechanistic Phase-Field Modelling of Woven-Domain Formation in Ferroelectric Material
articles.title_zh: 铁电材料中编织畴形成的机制相场建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent experimental study reports the spontaneous formation of a three-dimensional woven ferroelectric domain fabric in bulk KTN:Li during sufficiently slow cooling through the ferroelectric transition. The present work develops a nondimensional phase-field framework to examine a physically plausible route by which such a state can emerge. A large-area two-dimensional model first resolves the cooling-rate-dependent formation of a frustrated crossing precursor by combining first-order ferroelectric thermodynamics, electrostatic and elastic interactions, compositional modulation, and effective charge screening. Slow cooling produces a persistent population of charge-associated crossings, whereas the corresponding fast-cooling pathway does not. A three-dimensional extension then incorporates cubic gradient anisotropy, flexoelectric coupling, and strain-gradient regularization to examine whether the planar precursor can develop a genuine woven topology. Within the explored nondimensional parameter regime, slow cooling produces a directly resolved geometrical separation and exchange of depth ordering between the intersecting wall families, whereas the corresponding fast-cooling pathway does not. This distinction is reproduced across independent realisations and remains robust to timestep refinement and changes in computational domain size. The simulations suggest that slow cooling provides a kinetic window for topological selection and that global charge relaxation can coexist with strong local charge concentration at surviving crossings. The model is not calibrated to material-specific KTN:Li coefficients and does not reproduce the experimentally observed low-temperature disappearance of the woven state.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期实验研究发现，体KТN:Li在足够缓慢地冷却通过铁电相变时，会自发形成三维编织状铁电畴结构。本文建立无量纲相场框架，研究这一结构可能的形成路径：二维模型显示，慢冷却可在热力学、电静力、弹性、组分调制和电荷屏蔽共同作用下形成持久的受挫交叉前驱结构；三维模型进一步表明，梯度各向异性、挠曲电耦合和应变梯度正则化可促成交叉畴壁族之间的深度排序交换。模拟提示，慢冷却为拓扑选择提供动力学窗口，但该模型未针对具体材料参数标定，也未再现实验中低温编织结构消失的现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期的一项实验研究报道，在足够缓慢地冷却通过铁电相变时，块体KTN:Li中会自发形成三维编织状铁电畴结构。本文建立了一个无量纲相场框架，用于考察这种状态可能通过何种物理上合理的路径产生。首先，一个大面积二维模型通过结合一级铁电热力学、电静力相互作用、弹性相互作用、组分调制和有效电荷屏蔽，解析了依赖冷却速率形成的受挫交叉前驱结构。慢冷却会产生持久存在的电荷关联交叉，而相应的快速冷却路径不会产生这种结构。随后，三维扩展模型引入立方梯度各向异性、挠曲电耦合和应变梯度正则化，以考察平面前驱结构是否能够发展为真正的编织拓扑。在所探索的无量纲参数范围内，慢冷却会直接形成可分辨的几何分离，以及相交畴壁族之间深度排序的交换，而相应的快速冷却路径不会出现这些现象。这一区别在相互独立的实现中均得到重现，并且对时间步长加密和计算区域尺寸变化保持稳健。模拟表明，慢冷却为拓扑选择提供了一个动力学窗口，同时全局电荷弛豫可以与幸存交叉处的强局部电荷集中共存。该模型没有使用材料特定的KTN:Li系数进行标定，也不能再现实验中观察到的编织结构在低温下消失的现象。

articles.title: A Topological Magnonic Black-White Hole Crystal
articles.title_zh: 拓扑磁振子黑白洞晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22783v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy dynamics of antiferromagnetic spin waves map onto a massive Klein-Gordon scalar field, providing a solid-state platform for analogue-horizon physics. We show that an inhomogeneous spin current generates an effective magnon flow capable of forming black- and white-hole horizons. Horizon-pair cavities exhibit resonant transport and superradiant-like amplification mediated by magnon-antimagnon mixing. Our central result is that a periodic arrangement of submagnonic and supermagnonic regions forms a non-reciprocal magnonic crystal in which entering the supermagnonic regime makes negative-norm propagating channels available and enables the bulk gap to close and reopen. This drives a topological transition characterized by a change in the Zak phase and the emergence of a hybrid magnon-antimagnon edge state. These results establish a direct connection between analogue-horizon physics and topological magnonics, providing an electrically tunable route for controlling magnonic band topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁自旋波的低能动力学可映射为有质量的Klein–Gordon标量场，为研究模拟视界提供固态平台。本文表明，不均匀自旋流能够产生有效磁振子流，并形成黑洞和白洞视界；视界对腔体可产生共振输运以及由磁振子–反磁振子混合介导的类超辐射放大。周期排列亚磁速和超磁速区域可形成非互易磁振子晶体，并通过体能隙闭合与重开驱动Zak相变，产生混合磁振子–反磁振子边缘态。
authors: D. Galvez-Poblete, R. M. Otxoa, A. S. Nunez, S. Allende
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁自旋波的低能动力学可以映射为有质量的Klein–Gordon标量场，从而为模拟视界物理提供一个固态平台。我们表明，不均匀的自旋流能够产生一种有效磁振子流，并形成黑洞视界和白洞视界。视界对构成的腔体会表现出共振输运和类超辐射放大，而这种放大由磁振子–反磁振子混合介导。我们的核心结果是，周期性排列亚磁速区域和超磁速区域会形成一种非互易磁振子晶体；进入超磁速区域后，负范数传播通道变得可用，并使体能隙闭合和重开。这一过程驱动拓扑转变，其特征是Zak相发生变化，并出现混合磁振子–反磁振子边缘态。这些结果建立了模拟视界物理与拓扑磁振子学之间的直接联系，并为电调控磁振子能带拓扑提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Extreme mixing enables broadband high-temperature electromagnetic absorption in high-entropy perovskites
articles.title_zh: 极端混合使高熵钙钛矿实现宽带高温电磁吸收
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing oxide absorbers with broadband high-temperature electromagnetic absorption performance has long been desirable in the electromagnetic absorption field, yet their absorption performance has remained unsatisfactory. Here, through an extreme mixing strategy, we successfully develop an ultrabroad effective absorption bandwidth (EAB) of 9.3 GHz in high-entropy perovskites up to 600 degree celsius, surpassing the previously reported oxide absorbers. Specifically, we achieve the extreme mixing in high-entropy perovskites by the successful incorporation of up to 13 cation elements, with 8 and 5 cations occupying the A- and B-sites, respectively, using a laser-driven controllable synthesis technique. Such extreme mixing maximally promotes the formation of atomic-scale interfaces to markedly amplify atomic-level interfacial polarization loss for the effective dissipation of electromagnetic wave energy, thereby giving rise to a remarkably broad EAB of 9.3 GHz in high-entropy perovskites up to 600 degree celsius. Owing to the profoundly increased electrical conductivity that causes impedance mismatch at elevated temperatures, however, their EAB deteriorates to 4.6 GHz at 700 degree celsius. This work establishes a new extreme mixing design paradigm for enabling high-entropy oxide absorbers with unprecedented high-temperature EM absorption performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过极端混合策略，在高熵钙钛矿中实现了最高600摄氏度下9.3 GHz的超宽有效吸收带宽，超过了此前报道的氧化物吸收材料。研究利用激光驱动的可控合成技术，将多达13种阳离子引入钙钛矿结构，从而最大限度形成原子尺度界面并增强界面极化损耗。由于高温下电导率显著增加并造成阻抗失配，材料在700摄氏度时的有效吸收带宽降至4.6 GHz。
authors: Ziyu Feng, Fangchao Gu, Lei Zhuang, Wu Wang, Hulei Yu, Yanhui Chu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长期以来，开发具有宽带高温电磁吸收性能的氧化物吸收材料一直是电磁吸收领域所期望实现的目标，但其吸收性能始终不够理想。在本文中，我们通过极端混合策略，成功在高熵钙钛矿中实现了高达600摄氏度时9.3 GHz的超宽有效吸收带宽（EAB），超过了此前报道的氧化物吸收材料。具体而言，我们利用激光驱动的可控合成技术，将多达13种阳离子成功引入高熵钙钛矿，其中8种阳离子占据A位，5种阳离子占据B位，从而实现极端混合。这种极端混合最大限度地促进了原子尺度界面的形成，显著放大了原子尺度的界面极化损耗，有效耗散电磁波能量，因此使高熵钙钛矿在最高600摄氏度下获得了9.3 GHz的极宽EAB。然而，由于电导率显著提高并在升温过程中造成阻抗失配，其EAB在700摄氏度时恶化至4.6 GHz。本工作确立了一种新的极端混合设计范式，为高熵氧化物吸收材料实现前所未有的高温电磁吸收性能提供了可能。

articles.title: Antidot superlattices in two-dimensional topological insulators
articles.title_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体中的反点超晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the electronic properties of a two-dimensional topological insulator patterned with an array of circular holes. The band structures of the topological insulator superlattices are calculated using the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model, discretized with the finite element method. The band topology is studied using the Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki method, exploiting the fact that topological charge is conserved when a band gap closes and reopens. We find that when the holes are close to each other and the edge states overlap significantly, the material loses its topological character and becomes a trivial insulator. The results show that patterning topological insulators changes their properties, and this can be achieved with a feature size compatible with current lithographic techniques. This shows the potential to incorporate patterned topological insulators in future electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了带有圆形孔阵列的二维拓扑绝缘体的电子性质，并利用有限元离散化的Bernevig–Hughes–Zhang模型计算其超晶格能带。通过Fukui–Hatsugai–Suzuki方法分析能带拓扑发现，当孔洞彼此接近、边缘态显著重叠时，材料会失去拓扑性质并转变为平庸绝缘体。结果表明，图案化拓扑绝缘体能够改变其物性，而且所需结构尺寸与当前光刻技术兼容。
authors: Haolin Huang, Jackson S. Smith, Fabio Taddei, Michele Governale, Jared H. Cole
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了带有圆形孔阵列的二维拓扑绝缘体的电子性质。利用有限元方法离散化的Bernevig–Hughes–Zhang模型，计算了拓扑绝缘体超晶格的能带结构。我们采用Fukui–Hatsugai–Suzuki方法研究能带拓扑，并利用这样一个事实：当能隙闭合并重新打开时，拓扑荷守恒。我们发现，当孔洞彼此接近且边缘态发生显著重叠时，材料会失去其拓扑特征并成为平庸绝缘体。结果表明，对拓扑绝缘体进行图案化可以改变其性质，而且这种图案化所需的特征尺寸与当前光刻技术兼容。这说明，图案化拓扑绝缘体具有应用于未来电子学的潜力。

articles.title: Observation of current-induced orbital quadrupole accumulation
articles.title_zh: 电流诱导轨道四极矩积累的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronics and orbitronics rely on current-induced accumulations of magnetic dipoles: spin and orbital angular momentum. However, electronic orbitals inherently carry multipoles beyond the dipole, with the rank-2 orbital quadrupole as the leading term. Here we use polarization-resolved Kerr microscopy to observe current-induced orbital-quadrupole accumulation at the surfaces of Ti and Pt, metals with markedly different spin--orbit-coupling strengths. By separating the symmetric and antisymmetric components of the off-diagonal optical conductivity, we isolate the time-reversal-even quadrupolar response from the conventional time-reversal-odd magnetic-dipolar one, and find that the quadrupolar optical response exceeds the dipolar one in both metals. First-principles analysis of the measured responses indicates that the quadrupole accumulations are of the same order of magnitude in the two metals despite their widely different spin--orbit-coupling strengths, consistent with a previously unidentified channel of charge-to-orbital conversion that does not require spin--orbit coupling. Our findings establish that current-induced orbital polarization is fundamentally multipolar, expanding current-induced phenomena from the dipolar to the multipolar regime and opening a route to electrical control of orbital-ordered phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋电子学和轨道电子学通常研究电流诱导的磁偶极矩，即自旋和轨道角动量积累。本文利用偏振分辨克尔显微术，在自旋轨道耦合强度显著不同的钛和铂表面观测到电流诱导的轨道四极矩积累，并发现其光学响应超过偶极响应。第一性原理分析表明，两种金属中的四极矩积累量级相近，说明存在一种无需自旋轨道耦合的电荷到轨道转换通道。
authors: Geun-Hee Lee, Yubin Ji, Yongho Park, Changmin An, San Ko, Hye-Won Ko, Jinseob Lim, Jung Hyun Oh, Farzad Mahfouzi, Byong-Guk Park, Kab-Jin Kim, Mark D. Stiles, Kyoung-Whan Kim, Paul M. Haney, Kyung-Jin Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋电子学和轨道电子学依赖于电流诱导的磁偶极矩积累：自旋角动量和轨道角动量。然而，电子轨道本质上还携带超越偶极矩的多极矩，其中秩为2的轨道四极矩是最主要的高阶项。在此，我们利用偏振分辨克尔显微术，在钛和铂的表面观测到电流诱导的轨道四极矩积累；这两种金属具有显著不同的自旋轨道耦合强度。通过分离非对角光学电导的对称和反对称分量，我们将时间反演偶的四极响应与传统的时间反演奇的磁偶极响应区分开来，并发现两种金属中的四极光学响应都超过了偶极响应。对测量响应的第一性原理分析表明，尽管两种金属的自旋轨道耦合强度相差很大，但其四极矩积累量级相同，这与一种此前未被发现的电荷到轨道转换通道相一致，而该通道不需要自旋轨道耦合。我们的研究确立了电流诱导轨道极化从根本上说是多极的，将电流诱导现象从偶极领域拓展到多极领域，并为电控轨道有序相开辟了途径。

articles.title: Fidelity susceptibility of Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with further neighbour hopping term
articles.title_zh: 含进一步近邻跃迁项的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型的保真度易感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, topological phase transition in Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with a further neighbour hopping term has been studied in terms of fidelity susceptibility. Topological phase transition point in the standard SSH model has been identified before by noting the divergence of fidelity susceptibility. The same approach has been employed here where fidelity susceptibility is found to diverge at the phase transition points. Additionally, effect of staggered potential on the fidelity susceptibility has been explored. Analytic expression for fidelity susceptibility has been obtained along with its numerical estimation on finite chains by exact diagonalization. Fidelity susceptibility exhibits sharp peaks at the phase transition points in both approaches. Scaling exponent of this divergence has been obtained numerically which is found to agree to that of the standard SSH model without further neighbour terms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用保真度易感性研究含进一步近邻跃迁项的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型中的拓扑相变。保真度易感性在相变点发散，且在有限链的精确对角化和解析计算中均表现为尖锐峰值。数值所得发散标度指数与无进一步近邻项的标准 SSH 模型一致，并考察了交错势的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究通过保真度易感性研究含进一步近邻跃迁项的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型中的拓扑相变。此前，标准 SSH 模型中的拓扑相变点已通过观察保真度易感性的发散加以确定。本文采用相同方法，发现保真度易感性在相变点发散。此外，还研究了交错势对保真度易感性的影响。研究获得了保真度易感性的解析表达式，并通过精确对角化对有限链进行了数值估计。在这两种方法中，保真度易感性都在相变点表现出尖锐峰值。研究还对该发散的标度指数进行了数值求取，发现其与不含进一步近邻项的标准 SSH 模型的标度指数一致。

articles.title: Composition- and Ordering-Dependent Evolution of Simulated Kikuchi Patterns of Au-Ni Alloys
articles.title_zh: Au-Ni 合金模拟菊池花样随成分与有序化的演变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how Kikuchi patterns behave with subtle material variations is essential for developing machine learning (ML) based indexing methods for structurally and chemically complex cases, such as phases with potential sub-lattice order or (meta)stable defects with segregation (defect phases). Simulated Kikuchi patterns of the binary Au-Ni system were systematically analysed to investigate the effects of lattice parameter, chemical composition, partial site occupancy and ordering. The full compositional range from pure nickel to pure gold was considered, including a hypothetical ordered L1₂ Au₃Ni structure. Simulation parameters were optimised by comparison with experimental patterns. Normalized cross correlation showed limited sensibility to subtle differences between patterns. EMsoft simulation results revealed a systematic increase in mean intensity and more reflections contribute significantly as gold content increases. A surprising four-fold increase in mean intensity from 99 % gold to the pure gold sample highlighted limitations of partial site occupancy simulation by EMsoft. Difference maps showed enhanced normalised intensity along the 111 and 200 bands for the sample with 20 % gold compared to higher gold compositions. By isolating lattice parameter and chemical composition effects, chemical composition contributes predominantly to the mean intensity and strong reflections count, although the normalised intensity distribution was affected by both. Introducing L1₂ ordering increased the number of strong reflections and mean intensity, and redistributed normalised intensity along 111 and 200 bands and selected zone axis. Normalised intensity distribution and band width, are key descriptions to distinguish the Kikuchi patterns, which can be incorporated in future representation learning based indexing methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统分析二元 Au-Ni 合金的模拟菊池花样，以研究晶格参数、化学成分、部分占位和有序化的影响。结果表明，化学成分主要影响平均强度和强反射数量，而晶格参数与化学成分共同影响归一化强度分布。L1₂ 有序化会增加强反射数量和平均强度，因此归一化强度分布与带宽可用于区分菊池花样，并服务于机器学习索引方法。
authors: Camila A. Teixeira, Lukas Berners, Sandra Korte-Kerzel, Ulrich Kerzel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解细微材料变化如何影响菊池花样，对于开发基于机器学习的索引方法至关重要，尤其适用于具有结构和化学复杂性的情形，例如可能存在亚晶格有序的相，或发生偏析的（亚）稳态缺陷相。本文系统分析了二元 Au-Ni 体系的模拟菊池花样，以研究晶格参数、化学成分、部分占位和有序化的影响。研究涵盖从纯镍到纯金的完整成分范围，包括假想的有序 L1₂ Au₃Ni 结构。通过与实验花样比较，对模拟参数进行了优化。归一化互相关对花样之间细微差异的敏感性有限。EMsoft 模拟结果显示，随着金含量增加，平均强度系统性增强，且有更多反射对花样产生显著贡献。从含金量99%的样品到纯金样品，平均强度出乎意料地增加了四倍，这凸显了 EMsoft 部分占位模拟的局限性。差分图显示，与更高金含量的成分相比，含20%金的样品在111和200带附近具有增强的归一化强度。通过分离晶格参数和化学成分的影响可知，化学成分主要决定平均强度和强反射数量，但归一化强度分布同时受到两者影响。引入 L1₂ 有序化后，强反射数量和平均强度增加，并且归一化强度沿111和200带以及选定晶带轴发生重新分布。归一化强度分布和带宽是区分菊池花样的关键描述量，未来可将其纳入基于表征学习的索引方法。

articles.title: Discovery of New Zintl Films and Nanowires Grown by Topotaxy Conversion of III-V Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 通过 III-V 半导体的拓扑转换生长发现新型 Zintl 薄膜和纳米线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zintl phases draw broad interest for their diverse structural, magnetic, thermoelectric, topological and optical properties. Recently, Zintl Eu₃In₂As₄ and Eu₅In₂As₆ nanowires with axion magneto-topology have been synthesized by molecular beam epitaxy via topotactic conversion of InAs wurtzite and zincblende nanowires. Here we extend this methodology, demonstrating that topotaxial mutual-exchange growth applies not only to a broader set of III-V semiconductors beyond InAs but also to three-dimensional substrates whose surfaces are converted into Zintl thin films, as well as to nanowires. We report the growth of two new compounds: Eu₅Ga₂As₆ thin films converted from GaAs substrates, and Eu₅Al₂As₆ thin films from AlAs films. We also convert GaAs nanowires of both wurtzite and zincblende structures into Eu₅Ga₂As₆ nanowires. Though the stoichiometry is the same as in the previously reported Eu₅In₂As₆ case, microscopy and diffraction reveal a single-phase Pnma symmetry group rather than Pbam, highlighting symmetry-guided topotactic pathways to new Zintl frameworks. The compounds host an intricate magnetic phase diagram with three magnetic transitions, including two distinct antiferromagnetic orders and a canted antiferromagnetic phase that evolves into another antiferromagnetic phase under applied field through a spin-flop transition. Ab initio calculations predict that both Zintls are semiconductors with gaps of 0.79 eV in Eu₅Ga₂As₆ and 0.90 eV in Eu₅Al₂As₆. The lower symmetry and increased structural complexity suggest suppressed lattice thermal conductivity, pointing to thermoelectric potential alongside prospects in spintronics and detector technologies. These results give an epitaxy-compatible route for discovering and integrating magnetic Zintl thin films and nanowires directly from relevant III-V semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文拓展了通过分子束外延和拓扑转换制备 Zintl 材料的方法，展示了该方法可适用于更广泛的 III-V 半导体以及三维衬底表面。研究报道了 Eu₅Ga₂As₆ 薄膜和 Eu₅Al₂As₆ 薄膜，并将不同结构的 GaAs 纳米线转换为 Eu₅Ga₂As₆ 纳米线。两种材料具有复杂的磁相图和半导体性质，并显示出热电、自旋电子学及探测器应用潜力。
authors: Man Suk Song, Lothar Houben, Jean Souza, Edanel Fishbein, Moshe Haim, Ambikesh Gupta, Yufei Zhao, Anna-Eden Kossoy, Binghai Yan, Haim Beidenkopf, Hadas Shtrikman
articles.abstract_zh_full: Zintl 相因其多样的结构、磁性、热电、拓扑和光学性质而受到广泛关注。最近，研究人员通过分子束外延，将纤锌矿和闪锌矿 InAs 纳米线进行拓扑转换，合成了具有轴子磁拓扑的 Zintl Eu₃In₂As₄ 和 Eu₅In₂As₆ 纳米线。在此，我们拓展了这一方法，证明拓扑互交换生长不仅适用于 InAs 之外更广泛的 III-V 半导体，也适用于三维衬底：其表面可以被转换为 Zintl 薄膜，同时还可用于纳米线。我们报道了两种新化合物：由 GaAs 衬底转换得到的 Eu₅Ga₂As₆ 薄膜，以及由 AlAs 薄膜转换得到的 Eu₅Al₂As₆ 薄膜。我们还将纤锌矿和闪锌矿结构的 GaAs 纳米线转换为 Eu₅Ga₂As₆ 纳米线。尽管其化学计量比与此前报道的 Eu₅In₂As₆ 相同，但显微和衍射结果显示，该材料具有单相 Pnma 空间群对称性，而不是 Pbam，这凸显了由对称性引导的拓扑路径能够通向新的 Zintl 框架。这些化合物具有复杂的磁相图，包括三个磁相变：两种不同的反铁磁有序，以及一种倾斜反铁磁相；在外加磁场下，该倾斜反铁磁相通过自旋翻转相变演化为另一种反铁磁相。第一性原理计算预测，两种 Zintl 材料都是半导体，Eu₅Ga₂As₆ 和 Eu₅Al₂As₆ 的带隙分别为0.79 eV和0.90 eV。较低的对称性和更高的结构复杂性意味着晶格热导率可能受到抑制，除自旋电子学和探测器技术前景外，也显示出热电应用潜力。这些结果提供了一条与外延工艺兼容的途径，可直接从相关 III-V 半导体中发现并集成磁性 Zintl 薄膜和纳米线。

articles.title: Displacement-field-driven reconstruction of low energy transport in few-layer PtSe2
articles.title_zh: 位移场驱动的少层 PtSe₂ 低能输运重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In layered semiconductors, a perpendicular displacement field generates an interlayer potential difference that competes with interlayer hybridization, modifying both the band gap and the finite-density electronic states that carry current. Resolving this interplay requires a material lying close to the semiconductor-to-semimetal transition, where moderate electric fields can strongly reshape the low-energy electronic structure. Here, we investigate displacement-field-driven transport in dual-gated semiconducting PtSe2, whose pronounced thickness-dependent electronic structure provides access to this low-band-gap regime. Unlike thinner layers, the displacement-field response is strong in six-layer PtSe2, which lies at the verge of the semiconductor-to-semimetal crossover with only a small residual transport gap. Even weak displacement fields rapidly suppress this residual gap near charge neutrality, driving the system toward a band-overlap regime. At the same time, the conductivity decreases in the heavily hole-doped regime, demonstrating that the displacement field modifies not only the gap but also the conducting valence-band states. Fixed-relaxation-time Wannier transport calculations reproduce both responses, showing that they originate from field-induced band overlap together with reconstruction of the valence-band dispersion. These results establish finite-density transport as a sensitive probe of displacement-field-driven electronic structure reconstruction and extend electrical control beyond conventional band-gap engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究双栅半导体 PtSe₂ 中由垂直位移场驱动的输运变化。六层 PtSe₂ 接近半导体到半金属的转变，弱位移场即可压低电中性附近的残余输运带隙并诱导能带重叠。位移场还会重构价带色散，使重空穴掺杂区的电导降低；Wannier 输运计算再现了这些现象。
authors: Xiao Liu, Yaroslav Zhumagulov, Yuang Jie, Ahmet Enes Bozcali, Johan Felisaz, Qi Zhang, Oldvrich Cicvarek, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Zdeněk Sofer, Oleg V. Yazyev, Ahmet Avsar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在层状半导体中，垂直位移场会产生层间势差，该势差与层间杂化竞争，从而同时改变带隙和承载电流的有限载流子密度电子态。要解析这种相互作用，需要一种接近半导体到半金属转变的材料，因为中等强度的电场即可显著重塑其低能电子结构。在此，我们研究了双栅半导体 PtSe₂ 中由位移场驱动的输运；PtSe₂ 显著依赖厚度的电子结构使其能够进入这一小带隙状态。与更薄的层数不同，六层 PtSe₂ 对位移场的响应很强；该材料处于半导体到半金属交叉的边缘，仅具有很小的残余输运带隙。即使很弱的位移场，也会在电荷中性附近迅速压低这一残余带隙，使体系趋向能带重叠状态。同时，在重空穴掺杂区域，电导降低，表明位移场不仅改变带隙，也改变了承载输运的价带态。固定弛豫时间的 Wannier 输运计算再现了这两种响应，说明它们源于电场诱导的能带重叠以及价带色散的重构。这些结果确立了有限载流子密度输运作为探测位移场驱动电子结构重构的灵敏手段，并将电控能力拓展到传统带隙工程之外。

articles.title: Interplay of Magnetic Order, Structural Stability, and Orbital Ordering in BaFe2X3 (X = S and Se)
articles.title_zh: BaFe₂X₃（X = S 和 Se）中磁有序、结构稳定性与轨道有序的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: BaFe2X3 (X= S and Se) are quasi-one-dimensional Mott insulators with a ladder structure that exhibit Stripe- and Block-type antiferromagnetic order, respectively. The ladder arrangement of Fe atoms and strong electron correlations give rise to rich magnetic and orbital phenomena, including pressure-induced superconductivity and orbital-selective electronic states. Both compounds also show resistivity anomalies above the Neel temperature, suggesting that orbital degrees of freedom play an important role in their electronic properties. To clarify the interplay among magnetic order, structural stability, orbital ordering, and transport properties, we performed resistivity measurements and first-principles calculations for BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3, systematically comparing candidate magnetic and crystal structures. We find that the magnetic configuration strongly influences the stable crystal structure, orbital ordering, and transport anisotropy, providing a microscopic understanding of the contrasting electronic properties of the two compounds.
articles.abstract_zh: BaFe₂S₃ 和 BaFe₂Se₃ 是具有梯状结构的准一维莫特绝缘体，分别表现出条纹型和区块型反铁磁有序。本文结合电阻率测量与第一性原理计算，系统比较不同候选磁结构和晶体结构。结果表明，磁构型会强烈影响稳定晶体结构、轨道有序和输运各向异性，从而解释了两种化合物不同的电子性质。
authors: Kunihiko Yamauchi, Takuya Aoyama, Kenya Ohgushi
articles.abstract_zh_full: BaFe₂X₃（X = S 和 Se）是具有梯状结构的准一维莫特绝缘体，分别表现出条纹型和区块型反铁磁有序。Fe 原子的梯状排列和强电子关联产生了丰富的磁性和轨道现象，包括压力诱导的超导性和轨道选择性电子态。两种化合物在 Néel 温度以上也都表现出电阻率异常，这表明轨道自由度在其电子性质中发挥了重要作用。为阐明磁有序、结构稳定性、轨道有序和输运性质之间的相互作用，我们对 BaFe₂S₃ 和 BaFe₂Se₃ 进行了电阻率测量和第一性原理计算，并系统比较了候选磁结构和晶体结构。我们发现，磁构型会强烈影响稳定晶体结构、轨道有序和输运各向异性，从而为理解两种化合物不同的电子性质提供了微观解释。

articles.title: Three-dimensional Ising superconductors designed via inversion-symmetry breaking in intercalated NbSe₂ and NbTe₂
articles.title_zh: 通过插层 NbSe₂ 和 NbTe₂ 中的反演对称性破缺设计三维 Ising 超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ising superconductors exhibit in-plane upper critical fields far exceeding the Pauli paramagnetic limit, a hallmark first established in two-dimensional (2D) monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). This field resilience requires the coexistence of strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and broken inversion symmetry, yet three-dimensional (3D) bulk realizations remain scarce because equilibrium stacking typically restores inversion symmetry. Here we demonstrate that intercalation provides a practical route to break this symmetry, systematically designing 16 NbSe₂₋ and NbTe₂₋based compounds from four intercalants (In, Sn, Pb, Bi) across two polytypes: non-centrosymmetric Pbar6m2 and centrosymmetric P6₃/mmc. Four compounds in the Pbar6m2 phase, InNbSe₂, SnNbSe₂, PbNbSe₂, and PbNbTe₂, emerge as promising 3D Ising superconductors. They exhibit SOC splittings of 80-100 meV near the Fermi level, dominant out-of-plane spin polarization, and anisotropic superconductivity with T_c=2.6-5.4 K. Notably, spin-texture analysis reveals that the efficiency of Ising protection is governed not by the magnitude of SOC splitting alone but by the out-of-plane spin purity on the Fermi surface. Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG) calculations predict in-plane upper critical fields reaching 4-7 times the Pauli limit. These findings establish intercalation as a promising symmetry-engineering strategy for realizing 3D Ising superconductors in TMDs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出利用插层破缺反演对称性，以设计三维 Ising 超导体。研究系统分析了由 In、Sn、Pb、Bi 插层形成的16种 NbSe₂ 和 NbTe₂ 基化合物，其中四种非中心对称相化合物表现出较强的面外自旋极化和显著的 Ising 保护。计算预测其面内上临界场可达到 Pauli 极限的4至7倍，说明插层是实现三维 Ising 超导性的有效对称性工程策略。
authors: Wenqian Tu, Run Lv, Xiaoying Li, Li'e Liu, Dingfu Shao, Yuping Sun, Wenjian Lu
articles.abstract_zh_full: Ising 超导体表现出远超 Pauli 顺磁极限的面内上临界场，这是二维（2D）过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）单层中首先确立的典型特征。这种抗场能力要求强自旋轨道耦合（SOC）与反演对称性破缺共存，但三维（3D）块体实现仍然少见，因为平衡堆垛通常会恢复反演对称性。在此，我们证明插层提供了一条破缺这种对称性的可行途径，并以四种插层元素（In、Sn、Pb、Bi）和两种多型为基础，系统设计了16种 NbSe₂ 和 NbTe₂ 基化合物：非中心对称的 P ar6m2 相和中心对称的 P6₃/mmc 相。P ar6m2 相中的四种化合物 InNbSe₂、SnNbSe₂、PbNbSe₂ 和 PbNbTe₂ 脱颖而出，成为有前景的三维 Ising 超导体。它们在费米能级附近具有80至100 meV的 SOC 分裂、以面外方向为主的自旋极化以及各向异性超导性，其临界温度 T_c 为2.6至5.4 K。值得注意的是，自旋纹理分析表明，Ising 保护的效率并不只由 SOC 分裂的大小决定，而是由费米面上的面外自旋纯度决定。Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）计算预测，其面内上临界场可达到 Pauli 极限的4至7倍。这些发现表明，插层是通过对称性工程在 TMD 中实现三维 Ising 超导体的有前景策略。

articles.title: Probing the transport properties of Cantor-Wu alloys by means of femtosecond and nanosecond laser ablation
articles.title_zh: 利用飞秒和纳秒激光烧蚀探测 Cantor-Wu 合金的输运性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-pulse laser ablation thresholds of selected equiatomic Cantor-Wu alloys - FeNi, CoNi, CrFeNi, CrCoNi, and CrMnFeCoNi - are measured for femtosecond and nanosecond pulse durations and interpreted through first-principles calculations of the electronic structure, the electron-phonon coupling, and the electronic thermal conductivity. Alloy synthesis, ablation experiments, and theory are performed consistently on the same set of samples. The absorbed femtosecond thresholds decrease systematically by up to 36 % from FeNi to the Cr-containing alloys, a trend that reflectance variations cannot explain. Two-temperature-model scaling of the thresholds with the electronic thermal conductivity and the electron-phonon coupling, with all parameters taken from the spin-disordered phase, reproduces the measured hierarchy. The nanosecond thresholds instead probe the thermal equilibrium conductivity averaged along the heating path. The apparent outlier of CoNi, whose room-temperature transport over-predicts its thresholds by up to a factor of two for both pulse durations, is resolved quantitatively by the collapse of its conductivity upon loss of ferromagnetic order. Single-pulse ablation thresholds thereby emerge as sensitive, contact-free probes of electronic transport and of its magnetic-phase dependence in compositionally complex alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文测量了 FeNi、CoNi、CrFeNi、CrCoNi 和 CrMnFeCoNi 等等原子比 Cantor-Wu 合金在飞秒和纳秒脉冲下的单脉冲激光烧蚀阈值，并结合第一性原理电子结构、电子-声子耦合和电子热导率计算进行解释。飞秒阈值随含铬合金变化而系统降低，二温模型能够再现实验层次关系。结果表明，单脉冲烧蚀阈值可作为无接触探针，用于研究复杂合金的电子输运及其磁相依赖性。
authors: David Redka, Maximilian Spellauge, Rosemary Babu, Christopher D. Woodgate, Hubert Ebert, Ján Minár, Daniel J. Förster, Heinz P. Huber
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们测量了选定等原子比 Cantor-Wu 合金 FeNi、CoNi、CrFeNi、CrCoNi 和 CrMnFeCoNi 在飞秒和纳秒脉冲持续时间下的单脉冲激光烧蚀阈值，并通过第一性原理计算的电子结构、电子-声子耦合和电子热导率对其进行解释。合金合成、烧蚀实验和理论计算均在同一组样品上以一致方式完成。测得的飞秒吸收阈值从 FeNi 到含铬合金系统性降低，最大降幅达36%；反射率变化无法解释这一趋势。采用自旋无序相的全部参数，二温模型将阈值与电子热导率和电子-声子耦合进行标度，能够再现实验测得的层次关系。相比之下，纳秒阈值探测的是沿加热路径平均的热平衡电导率。CoNi 表面上是一个异常值：如果使用其室温输运性质，会对两种脉冲持续时间下的阈值产生最高达两倍的过高预测；而当铁磁有序丧失、电导率崩塌后，这一现象可以得到定量解释。因此，单脉冲烧蚀阈值成为电子输运及其磁相依赖性的灵敏、无接触探针，尤其适用于成分复杂的合金。

articles.title: First-Principles Spin-Lattice Coupling from Downfolded Electron-Phonon Interaction
articles.title_zh: 基于下折叠电子-声子相互作用的第一性原理自旋-晶格耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a method to calculate spin-phonon coupling parameters from first-principles perturbation theory by downfolding the electron-phonon coupling (EPC). We exploit the localized nature of magnetic moments and atomic displacements by working in the Wannier representation of the electronic Hamiltonian and the EPC matrix. The spin system is mapped to a classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian, whose parameters are obtained by treating local spin rotations as a perturbation within a Green's-function formalism. The spin and phonon perturbations are connected through the EPC parameters, which enter as lattice-induced perturbations to the tight-binding Hamiltonian. By combining these lattice perturbations with local spin rotations, we obtain real-space derivatives of magnetic exchange parameters without performing displaced magnetic supercell calculations. We illustrate the method on SrMnO₃ and show that it can be integrated directly into standard workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种通过下折叠电子-声子耦合计算自旋-声子耦合参数的第一性原理方法。该方法在 Wannier 表象中利用磁矩和原子位移的局域性，将局域自旋转动作为微扰，并通过格林函数形式获得磁交换参数的实空间导数。以 SrMnO₃ 为例，研究表明该方法无需计算位移磁性超胞即可直接整合进标准计算流程。
authors: Xu He, Álvaro Adrián Carrasco Álvarez, Gian-Marco Rignanese, Eric Bousquet, Samuel Poncé, Matthieu J. Verstraete
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种通过下折叠电子-声子耦合（EPC）从第一性原理微扰理论计算自旋-声子耦合参数的方法。我们利用磁矩和原子位移的局域性质，在电子哈密顿量和 EPC 矩阵的 Wannier 表象中开展计算。通过在格林函数形式下将局域自旋转动作为微扰，将自旋系统映射为经典 Heisenberg 哈密顿量，其参数由此获得。自旋微扰和声子微扰通过 EPC 参数相连接；这些参数作为晶格诱导的紧束缚哈密顿量微扰而进入计算。将这些晶格微扰与局域自旋转动结合后，我们无需进行位移磁性超胞计算，就能得到磁交换参数的实空间导数。我们以 SrMnO₃ 为例展示了该方法，并表明它可以直接整合进标准工作流程。

articles.title: Predicted High n-Type zT and Ultralow Lattice Thermal Conductivity in A₂AgIrCl₆ (A = Cs, Rb)
articles.title_zh: A₂AgIrCl₆（A = Cs、Rb）中预测的高 n 型 zT 与超低晶格热导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A useful thermoelectric device must impede heat flow without impeding charge transport. Here, we examine how closely cubic Cs₂AgIrCl₆ and Rb₂AgIrCl₆ approach this balance using first-principles calculations of structural stability, chemical bonding, elastic response, lattice dynamics, and scattering-resolved carrier transport. Both materials satisfy the cubic elastic-stability criteria, and neither harmonic phonon spectrum contains an imaginary mode. Replacing Cs with Rb mainly exerts chemical pressure: the lattice contracts by 1.34% and the Ag--Cl and Ir--Cl bonds strengthen, whereas the band-edge topology changes little. HSE06 calculations including spin--orbit coupling yield direct X-point gaps of 1.597 and 1.637,eV for Cs₂AgIrCl₆ and Rb₂AgIrCl₆, respectively. The three symmetry-equivalent X valleys have light electron masses of 0.43--0.57,m₀, whereas the hole masses span 2.10--4.68,m₀. For Cs₂AgIrCl₆ and Rb₂AgIrCl₆, respectively, the modified Debye--Callaway model gives lattice thermal conductivities of 0.346 and 0.428,mathrmW,m⁻¹,K⁻¹ at 300 K, decreasing to 0.118 and 0.150,mathrmW,m⁻¹,K⁻¹ at 800 K. Treating acoustic-deformation-potential, ionized-impurity, and polar-optical-phonon scattering with AMSET gives peak n-type zT values of 2.81 and 2.36 at 800 K near 6×10¹⁹,mathrmcm⁻³. This response arises from the convergence of light, valley-degenerate electrons, intermediate doping, and weak lattice heat transport rather than from a single exceptional coefficient. The predicted values are experimentally testable targets, contingent on retaining the cubic phases and controlled electron doping at elevated temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究立方 Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 和 Rb₂AgIrCl₆ 的稳定性、电子结构、晶格动力学及载流子输运。两种材料均具有稳定的立方结构、直接带隙、较轻的电子有效质量和超低晶格热导率。考虑多种散射机制后，计算得到它们在800 K附近的峰值 n 型热电优值 zT 分别为2.81和2.36，具体性能取决于保持立方相及实现受控电子掺杂。
authors: Neeraj Kulhari, Krishna Swaroop Sharma, Sung Gu Kang, K. C. Bhamu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有用的热电器件必须在阻碍热流的同时不阻碍电荷输运。在此，我们利用第一性原理计算研究立方 Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 和 Rb₂AgIrCl₆ 在多大程度上接近这一平衡，计算内容包括结构稳定性、化学键、弹性响应、晶格动力学以及按散射机制分解的载流子输运。两种材料都满足立方晶体的弹性稳定性判据，且其谐性声子谱中均不含虚频。用 Rb 替代 Cs 主要施加化学压力：晶格收缩1.34%，Ag-Cl 和 Ir-Cl 键增强，而带边拓扑变化很小。包含自旋轨道耦合的 HSE06 计算得到，Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 和 Rb₂AgIrCl₆ 在 X 点的直接带隙分别为1.597和1.637 eV。三个对称等价的 X 谷具有0.43至0.57 m₀的轻电子质量，而空穴质量范围为2.10至4.68 m₀。对于 Cs₂AgIrCl₆ 和 Rb₂AgIrCl₆，修正的 Debye-Callaway 模型给出的晶格热导率在300 K时分别为0.346和0.428 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹，在800 K时降至0.118和0.150 W m⁻¹ K⁻¹。采用 AMSET 处理声学形变势、离化杂质和极性光学声子散射后，在约6×10¹⁹ cm⁻³的载流子浓度附近、800 K时得到的峰值 n 型 zT 分别为2.81和2.36。这一响应源于轻质量、谷简并的电子、中等掺杂和较弱晶格热输运的共同作用，而不是某一个异常突出的单一系数。预测值是可通过实验检验的目标，但其实现取决于保持立方相并在高温下实现受控电子掺杂。

articles.title: Electrostatic control of Li+ density and transport rate in double-gated van der Waals devices
articles.title_zh: 双栅范德华器件中 Li⁺ 密度与输运速率的静电控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ion transport in crystalline hosts is controlled by an applied potential that simultaneously sets ionic distribution and transport rate, restricting operation to a one-dimensional control space. Here we show that the transport rate of Li+ ions in double-gated van der Waals devices can be modulated while the system occupies fixed ionic-density states. We measure the ionic current along the van der Waals interface between hexagonal boron nitride and graphene or MoS2 while simultaneously monitoring the in-plane electronic response. The ionic current exhibits pronounced hysteresis, with plateaus marking discrete ionic-density states balanced by electronic charge, while an independently tuneable electrochemical-potential drop controls the ionic transport rate. The devices sustain over 1,000 switching cycles and function as hybrid ionic-electronic transistors capable of logic operations and memory retention, with ON/OFF ratios exceeding two orders of magnitude. This work demonstrates a two-dimensional control space for ion transport in layered materials, opening new operating regimes for energy storage and ion-based computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了双栅范德华器件能够在保持 Li⁺ 固定离子密度状态的同时调节其输运速率。研究测量了六方氮化硼与石墨烯或 MoS₂ 界面处的离子电流，并同步监测面内电子响应。器件具有离散离子密度平台、显著滞后和超过两个数量级的开关比，可实现逻辑运算与存储保持，表明离子输运具有二维电控自由度。
authors: E. Hoenig, X. Zhang, C. Li, J. Tong, G. Chen, L. Chen, D. Domaretskiy, D. R. da Costa, F. M. Peeters, M. Lozada-Hidalgo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 晶体主体中的离子输运由外加电势控制，而该电势同时决定离子分布和输运速率，从而将工作限制在一维控制空间内。在此，我们证明，在双栅范德华器件中，即使体系处于固定的离子密度状态，也可以调节 Li⁺ 离子的输运速率。我们测量了六方氮化硼与石墨烯或 MoS₂ 之间范德华界面沿面的离子电流，同时监测面内电子响应。离子电流表现出明显的滞后现象，其中的平台对应于由电子电荷平衡的离散离子密度状态，而可独立调节的电化学势降控制着离子输运速率。这些器件可承受超过1000次开关循环，并可作为混合离子-电子晶体管执行逻辑运算和保持存储，开关比超过两个数量级。本工作展示了层状材料中离子输运的二维控制空间，为储能和离子计算开辟了新的工作状态。

articles.title: Enhanced intrinsic spin-orbit driving of a Loss-DiVincenzo qubit near the spin-valley hotspot in Si/SiGe
articles.title_zh: Si/SiGe 中自旋-谷热点附近 Loss-DiVincenzo 量子比特的增强本征自旋轨道驱动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In most Si/SiGe-based spin qubit implementations, high-fidelity single-qubit gates are achieved using micromagnets, which enable the use of electric spin dipole resonance via synthetic spin-orbit coupling (s-SOC). In contrast, intrinsic spin-orbit coupling (i-SOC) in silicon is generally considered to be weak. However, in Si/SiGe heterostructures, theory predicts a substantial enhancement when the Zeeman splitting approaches the valley splitting if symmetry is reduced by an imperfect interface. Here, we demonstrate a Si/SiGe Loss-DiVincenzo qubit driven by i-SOC close to this so-called spin-valley hotspot. In particular, we characterize the Rabi frequency as a function of the energy detuning from the hotspot by sweeping both the magnetic field and quantum dot position. We observe the predicted enhancement of the Rabi frequency near the hotspot, but also find an asymmetry that deviates from existing theoretical models as well as distortions of the Chevron patterns near the hotspot. While we achieve an average single-qubit Clifford fidelity of 98.6 %, the strong variability of the valley splitting may impede the use of i-SOC-based control as a scalable operational strategy; understanding its effect is nevertheless important for reproducible high-fidelity control. Our results provide an empirical basis for refining current theoretical models of spin-valley physics in Si/SiGe heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 Si/SiGe 自旋量子比特中，通常利用微磁体产生合成自旋轨道耦合来实现高保真度单量子比特门。本文在自旋劈裂接近谷劈裂的热点附近，实现了由硅中本征自旋轨道耦合驱动的 Loss-DiVincenzo 量子比特，并观测到 Rabi 频率增强。实验还发现热点附近存在现有理论未解释的不对称性和 Chevron 图案畸变；尽管单比特 Clifford 门平均保真度达到98.6%，谷劈裂的强烈变化可能限制该控制策略的可扩展性。
authors: Alexander Willmes, Max Oberländer, Max Beer, Denny Dütz, Jhih-Sian Tu, Stefan Trellenkamp, Marco Lisker, Felix Reichmann, Lars R. Schreiber, Hendrik Bluhm
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在大多数基于 Si/SiGe 的自旋量子比特实现中，高保真度单量子比特门通过微磁体实现；微磁体能够利用合成自旋轨道耦合（s-SOC）产生电自旋偶极共振。相比之下，硅中的本征自旋轨道耦合（i-SOC）通常被认为较弱。然而，理论预测，在界面不完美导致对称性降低的情况下，当塞曼劈裂接近谷劈裂时，Si/SiGe 异质结构中的 i-SOC 会显著增强。在此，我们展示了一个在所谓自旋-谷热点附近由 i-SOC 驱动的 Si/SiGe Loss-DiVincenzo 量子比特。具体而言，我们通过同时扫描磁场和量子点位置，表征了 Rabi 频率随其相对于热点的能量失谐变化。我们观测到热点附近 Rabi 频率出现理论预测的增强，但还发现了偏离现有理论模型的不对称性，以及热点附近 Chevron 图案的畸变。尽管我们实现了98.6%的单量子比特 Clifford 门平均保真度，但谷劈裂的强烈变化可能妨碍将基于 i-SOC 的控制用作可扩展的运行策略；不过，理解其影响对于实现可重复的高保真度控制仍然十分重要。我们的结果为改进当前 Si/SiGe 异质结构中自旋-谷物理的理论模型提供了实验依据。

articles.title: Quantum Geometry Driven Optical Responses in 1T-MX₂ Monolayers: A Symmetry-Constrained Slater-Koster Tight-Binding Approach
articles.title_zh: 1T-MX₂单层中的量子几何驱动光学响应：对称性约束的Slater-Koster紧束缚方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Centrosymmetric 1T-MX₂ monolayers(MLs) have attracted considerable attention owing to their intriguing transport properties and potential technological applications arising from the interplay among quantum geometry, electronic band structure, and band-gap characteristics. Despite this rich physics, a comprehensive microscopic tight-binding(TB) description that simultaneously captures these properties remains insufficiently established, while first-principles approaches can be computationally demanding for systematic investigations across different materials and perturbations. Here, we develop a transferable eleven-band Slater-Koster TB description of ML 1T-MX₂ TMDs and use it to establish a connection among their microscopic electronic structure, quantum geometry, and optical response. The model is constructed in an orthogonal orbital basis from the crystal geometry and symmetry-constrained SK parameters, with material-specific parametrizations obtained from DFT calculations for ML ZrS₂ and HfS₂. The resulting geometry-based Hamiltonian accurately describes the low-energy electronic structures and provides a natural framework for extending the analysis to the broader isostructural 1T-MX₂ family. We find that the pristine MLs possess a finite quantum metric, with the dominant contribution concentrated in the two highest occupied bands owing to the small near-gap energy separation and strong metal-chalcogen p-d hybridization. Furthermore, we verify the interband f-sum rule, which directly relates the integrated optical spectral weight to the Brillouin-zone-averaged quantum metric. Our results establish optical spectral weight as an experimentally accessible probe of the quantum geometry of occupied Bloch states and provide a unified microscopic framework for connecting electronic structure, quantum geometry, and measurable optical responses across the 1T-MX₂ family.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个可迁移的十一能带Slater-Koster紧束缚模型，用于描述1T-MX₂过渡金属二硫族化物单层的电子结构、量子几何与光学响应。以ZrS₂和HfS₂为例，研究发现本征单层具有有限量子度量，其主要贡献来自最高的两个占据能带，并验证了将积分光学谱权重与布里渊区平均量子度量联系起来的带间f和规则。研究表明，光学谱权重可作为实验探测占据Bloch态量子几何的手段。
authors: Bikram Baruah, Snehasish Nandy, Subhasis Panda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有中心对称性的1T-MX₂单层由于量子几何、电子能带结构与带隙特征之间的相互作用所产生的引人关注的输运性质和潜在技术应用，受到了广泛关注。尽管存在丰富的物理现象，但能够同时描述这些性质的全面微观紧束缚模型仍未得到充分建立，而第一性原理方法对于跨不同材料和扰动开展系统研究而言可能计算成本较高。在本文中，我们建立了一个可迁移的、适用于1T-MX₂型过渡金属二硫族化物单层的十一能带Slater-Koster紧束缚描述，并利用该模型建立其微观电子结构、量子几何与光学响应之间的联系。该模型在正交轨道基组中由晶体几何和受对称性约束的Slater-Koster参数构造，并通过对ZrS₂和HfS₂单层进行密度泛函理论计算获得材料特定的参数化结果。所得基于几何的哈密顿量能够准确描述低能电子结构，并为将分析推广到更广泛的同构1T-MX₂家族提供了自然框架。我们发现，本征单层具有有限的量子度量，其中主要贡献集中在最高的两个占据能带，这是由于其靠近带隙处的能量间隔较小以及显著的金属-硫族元素p-d杂化所致。此外，我们验证了带间f和规则，该规则直接将积分光学谱权重与布里渊区平均量子度量联系起来。我们的结果表明，光学谱权重可作为实验上可获取的占据Bloch态量子几何探针，并为在1T-MX₂家族中联系电子结构、量子几何和可测量光学响应提供了统一的微观框架。

articles.title: Absence of lateral domain wall mobility in Zn1-xMgxO thin films
articles.title_zh: Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO薄膜中横向畴壁运动性的缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23305v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polarization reversal in ferroelectrics arises from the coupled processes of domain nucleation and subsequent growth, yet the governing mechanisms differ fundamentally between classical perovskite oxides and emerging wurtzite ferroelectrics. While switching in perovskites is typically governed by mobile domain walls whose field-driven propagation dominates macroscopic kinetics, here we show that polarization reversal in wurtzite Zn1-xMgxO proceeds through a qualitatively different pathway. Using scanning oscillator microscopy, in combination with point pulse-imaging methods, we directly map local switching events and domain wall responses, revealing that domain walls in Zn1-xMgxO exhibit negligible lateral mobility (sub 10nm) and that polarization reversal proceeds predominantly through the nucleation of vertically extended columnar filaments with a lateral size on the order of the grains. This nucleation-controlled switching contrasts sharply with the growth-mediated dynamics characteristic of perovskite ferroelectrics and explains the abrupt, spatially localized switching behavior observed in wurtzite systems. These results establish nucleation-dominated filamentary reversal as a defining switching mechanism in Zn1-xMgxO and point towards the need for further studies to understand correlation lengths and nucleation processes across a range of grain sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了纤锌矿Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO薄膜中的极化反转机制。扫描振荡显微术结合点脉冲成像表明，畴壁的横向运动性可以忽略，位移小于10 nm，极化反转主要通过形成横向尺寸接近晶粒大小的垂直延伸柱状细丝实现。该结果说明纤锌矿铁电体属于成核控制的细丝状反转机制，与钙钛矿铁电体中由畴壁运动主导的生长控制动力学明显不同。
authors: Jack Eckstein, Kyle P. Kelley, William Prudnick, Jon-Paul Maria, Stephen Jesse, Neus Domingo, Rama K. Vasudevan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电体中的极化反转源于畴成核及其随后生长的耦合过程，但经典钙钛矿氧化物与新兴纤锌矿铁电体中的控制机制存在根本差异。在钙钛矿中，开关过程通常由可移动的畴壁控制，其在外场驱动下的传播主导宏观动力学；而在本文中，我们表明纤锌矿Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO中的极化反转遵循一种性质上不同的路径。我们利用扫描振荡显微术结合点脉冲成像方法，直接绘制局域开关事件和畴壁响应，发现Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO中的畴壁表现出可忽略的横向运动性（小于10 nm），极化反转主要通过成核形成横向尺寸约为晶粒尺度的垂直延伸柱状细丝来进行。这种成核控制的开关过程与钙钛矿铁电体中具有代表性的生长介导动力学形成鲜明对比，并解释了纤锌矿体系中观察到的突发性、空间局域化开关行为。这些结果确立了成核主导的细丝状反转是Zn₁₋ₓMgₓO中的一种特征性开关机制，并表明有必要进一步研究不同晶粒尺寸范围内的关联长度和成核过程。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文通过扫描振荡显微和局域脉冲成像研究Zn1-xMgxO薄膜中的铁电极化翻转与畴壁运动。结果显示畴壁横向迁移极弱，极化反转主要通过垂直延伸的柱状畴成核完成，表现为成核控制而非畴壁生长控制。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的铁电性、极化翻转、畴壁动力学、缺陷诱导开关和HfO2基铁电体研究高度直接相关。该工作揭示的纤锥结构铁电体成核主导机制，可用于比较不同晶体结构铁电体的开关动力学。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可结合第一性原理、有效哈密顿量和分子动力学研究ZnMgO中合金无序、缺陷和内建电场对成核势垒及畴壁迁移的影响。建议进一步比较其与HfO2及其他非传统铁电体在疲劳、保持和尺寸效应方面的差异。

articles.title: Anomalous stabilization of excitons by metallic proximity
articles.title_zh: 金属邻近效应对激子的反常稳定化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic environments are generally expected to suppress excitons through strong dielectric screening, yet their influence can differ in composite systems where metallic and insulating regions coexist. Here, we investigate excitonic states in PdxCu1-xCrO2 thin films across a percolation-driven metal-insulator transition. Optical spectroscopy and many-body GW calculations show that CuCrO2 hosts strongly bound excitons with a binding energy of about 489 meV. With increasing Pd substitution, the system approaches an insulator-to-metal transition near x = 0.5, consistent with the site-percolation threshold of a triangular lattice. In the pre-percolation regime, the excitonic resonance redshifts by 241 meV while the Tanguy continuum onset remains nearly unchanged, consistent with a substantial increase in exciton binding energy before metallization. An image-charge-based excitonic hydrogen model shows that isolated metallic regions can enhance electron-hole binding through image-charge interactions, whereas conventional screening is recovered once a continuous metallic network forms. Although this model provides a possible interpretation of the observed excitonic evolution, an alternative scenario in which metallic and excitonic responses originate from electronically distinct states and evolve independently cannot be excluded. These results reveal unusual metallic-excitonic coexistence near a percolation-driven metal-insulator transition and suggest nanoscale metallic proximity as a possible route for modifying excitonic interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属环境通常因强介电屏蔽而抑制激子，但在金属区与绝缘区共存的复合体系中，金属可能产生不同作用。对跨越渗流驱动金属-绝缘体转变的PdₓCu₁₋ₓCrO₂薄膜进行光谱和GW计算表明，在金属渗流形成前，孤立金属区域可通过像电荷相互作用增强电子-空穴束缚，使激子结合能显著增加。研究揭示了渗流转变附近异常的金属-激子共存现象，同时指出金属邻近效应可能成为调控激子相互作用的纳米尺度途径。
authors: Jeongkeun Song, Uksam Choi, Shan Lin, Du Li, Baekjune Kang, Li Yang, Ambrose Seo, Changhee Sohn, Ho Nyung Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通常认为，金属环境会通过强介电屏蔽抑制激子；然而，在金属区域和绝缘区域共存的复合体系中，金属的影响可能有所不同。在本文中，我们研究了跨越渗流驱动金属-绝缘体转变的PdₓCu₁₋ₓCrO₂薄膜中的激子态。光学光谱和多体GW计算表明，CuCrO₂具有强束缚激子，其结合能约为489 meV。随着Pd取代量增加，体系在x = 0.5附近接近绝缘体到金属的转变，这与三角晶格的位点渗流阈值一致。在渗流形成前区域，激子共振峰红移了241 meV，而Tanguy连续谱起始位置几乎保持不变，这与金属化之前激子结合能显著增加相一致。基于像电荷的激子氢模型表明，孤立的金属区域可以通过像电荷相互作用增强电子-空穴束缚，而一旦形成连续金属网络，常规屏蔽机制便会恢复。尽管该模型为观察到的激子演化提供了一种可能解释，但不能排除另一种情形，即金属响应和激子响应源自电子上彼此不同的态，并且各自独立演化。这些结果揭示了渗流驱动金属-绝缘体转变附近异常的金属-激子共存现象，并表明纳米尺度的金属邻近效应可能成为调控激子相互作用的一种途径。

articles.title: Determination of the ferrimagnetic structure of monoclinic TbFe₂D₄.₂ deuteride and its evolution versus temperature and high magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 单斜TbFe₂D₄.₂氘化物亚铁磁结构的确定及其随温度和高磁场的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic properties of monoclinic TbFe₂D₄.₂ have been investigated by combining different magnetic measurements, including those involving a high pulsed magnetic field, with neutron diffraction experiments versus temperature and applied field. TbFe₂D₄.₂ displays a ferrimagnetic ground state with MTb = 8.2(2) μB and MFₑ = 2.1(2) μB. At 4.2 K a large magnetic anisotropy related to the Tb moments is observed, as saturation is not reached at 50 T. In addition, two metamagnetic transitions are observed for fields of 3 and 29 T.
