articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究了势垒高度随时间波动且服从高斯白噪声的量子隧穿问题，并将随机动力学映射为等效的定态 Lindblad 密度矩阵方程，从而得到完全解析的解。对于薛定谔粒子，噪声引入耗散并抑制 Fabry-Pérot 振荡，导致透射率指数衰减；对于石墨烯，噪声使势垒内的纵向波矢变为复数，从而即使在正入射时也强烈抑制透射和 Klein 隧穿。该结果表明，噪声势垒可作为可调耗散元件，用于控制石墨烯器件中的电子输运，并可能为石墨烯量子点自旋量子比特的设计提供参考。
authors: Kamal Azaidaoui, Ahmed Jellal, Hocine Bahlouli, A. Al Luhaibi, Michael Vogl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了穿过势垒的量子隧穿问题，其中势垒高度随时间波动，并用高斯白噪声进行建模。我们将随机动力学映射为一个等效的、与时间无关的 Lindblad 密度矩阵方程，从而得到完全解析的解。对于薛定谔粒子，噪声引入耗散，抑制 Fabry-Pérot 振荡，并产生指数衰减的透射率。将同一形式体系应用于石墨烯后，我们证明噪声会使势垒内的纵向波矢变为复数，从而强烈抑制透射和 Klein 隧穿，即使在正入射时也是如此。我们的方法有望改善对 Klein 隧穿的控制。这些结果表明，含噪势垒可以充当可调的耗散元件，为增强石墨烯基器件中的电子输运控制提供一条途径。我们还简要讨论了这些结果如何指导石墨烯量子点的设计，以及其在自旋量子比特器件中的潜在应用。

articles.title: Optical-Fiber Activation of Observer-Split Source Terms in a Rotating Aluminum Disc
articles.title_zh: 利用光纤激活旋转铝盘中的观察者分裂源项
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an optical-fiber implementation of the Observer-Split source framework for finite rotating systems in extended Aharonov-Bohm electrodynamics. A covariantly conserved current, rewritten in a rotating 3+1 split, produces the observer-adapted source term Iₘ̊ ₛₚₗᵢₜ=N⁻¹Dᵢ₍ₕ̊oβⁱ⁾, which in the weak-field rigid-rotation limit becomes I_G=Ωpartial_φρ. We use an optically gated rotating aluminum disc to create a localized, calibratable induced density, with the optical evanescent/tunneling coefficient acting only as a control gate rather than as a charge density. The resulting source scales as Iₘ̊ ₒₚₜsimeqΩpartial_φρₘ̊ ᵢₙd,Aₗ and reverses sign under CW/CCW reversal. The proposed demonstrator combines ON/OFF gating, a localized 10--20 degree active sector, uniform-source suppression, material and dummy controls, quantitative null bounds, and independent density calibration. The residual response is parameterized by the experimentally identifiable product Λₘ̊ ₒₚₜ=κₘ̊ ₒₚₜχₘ̊ Aₗ, so both positive and null measurements constrain the phenomenology without assuming an uncalibrated force amplitude. Historical rotating magnetic systems, including the Roshchin-Godin report, are used only as benchmarks and not as evidence. The work is a falsifiable protocol for testing anomalous gravitational-response signatures; it reports no anomalous-weight measurement and makes no claim of evidence for a gravitational anomaly or for extended Aharonov-Bohm electrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种光纤实现方案，用于在扩展 Aharonov-Bohm 电动力学中检验有限旋转系统的观察者分裂源框架。该方案利用光学门控的旋转铝盘产生局域且可校准的感应密度，光学倏逝场或隧穿系数仅作为控制门，而不作为电荷密度。实验设计包括开关门控、局部活动扇区、均匀源抑制、材料和空白对照、定量零结果界限以及独立密度校准，并通过顺时针与逆时针旋转反转信号符号。作者强调该工作是检验异常引力响应特征的可证伪方案，不报告异常重量测量，也不声称发现引力异常或扩展 Aharonov-Bohm 电动力学的证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种光纤实现方案，用于在扩展 Aharonov-Bohm 电动力学中实现有限旋转系统的观察者分裂源框架。一个协变守恒的电流在旋转的 3+1 分解中重写后，产生与观察者相适应的源项 Iₛₚₗᵢₜ = N⁻¹Dᵢ₍ₕ₀βⁱ⁾，在弱场刚性旋转极限下变为 I_G = ω∂_φh₀。我们使用一个光学门控的旋转铝盘来产生局域且可校准的感应密度，其中光学倏逝场或隧穿系数仅作为控制门，而不作为电荷密度。所得源项按 Iₒₚₜₛ ≃ ω∂_φh₀ⁱⁿd,Al 的形式标度，并在顺时针与逆时针旋转反转时改变符号。所提出的验证装置结合了开关门控、一个局域的 10--20 度活动扇区、均匀源抑制、材料对照和空白对照、定量零结果界限，以及独立的密度校准。剩余响应由实验上可识别的乘积 Λₒₚₜ = κₒₚₜχₘ A_Al 参数化，因此无论测得正响应还是零响应，都可以在不假设未经校准的力幅值的情况下约束该现象学模型。包括 Roshchin-Godin 报告在内的历史旋转磁系统仅被用作基准，而不是作为证据。该工作是一项用于检验异常引力响应特征的可证伪实验方案；它不报告任何异常重量测量，也不声称发现引力异常或扩展 Aharonov-Bohm 电动力学的证据。

articles.title: Femtosecond Laser Induced Metallization in Silicon via Photon Momentum Mediated Band Transition
articles.title_zh: 通过光子动量介导的能带跃迁实现飞秒激光诱导硅金属化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon-based technology has been at the forefront of electronic and photonic research since the dawn of the electronic revolution. However, silicon is fundamentally an indirect-bandgap semiconductor: the conduction band minimum and valence band maximum occur at different points in momentum space, so optical transitions require phonon assistance to conserve crystal momentum. This three-body electron-photon-phonon interaction renders silicon an inefficient material for light-absorbing applications such as solar cells and optoelectronic devices. In this work, we build on an established nanoscale photon-momentum confinement mechanism, which broadens the photon momentum distribution and enables phonon-free absorption in silicon, by subsequently applying a high-intensity femtosecond pulsed excitation that injects hot carriers beyond the Mott density, collapsing the bandgap and inducing a reversible semiconductor-to-metal transition. While nanoscale photon-momentum confinement itself has been previously established, the central contribution of this work is this subsequent, carrier density-driven stage, which drives the momentum-enhanced region into a reversible transient metallic phase. Our simulations report highly negative permittivity, enhanced optical power absorption, a large absorption coefficient, and low skin depth, with carrier densities reaching a notable value, far exceeding the Mott threshold. We have shown carrier driven metallization with stable operation below melting threshold of silicon. These results establish a general mechanism for dynamically inducing metallic states in silicon, offering a potential pathway toward monolithically integrated active photonic components and dynamically reconfigurable electro-optical devices within conventional CMOS platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅是间接带隙半导体，其导带底和价带顶位于动量空间的不同位置，因此光学跃迁通常需要声子辅助以守恒晶体动量。作者在纳米尺度光子动量约束机制的基础上，利用高强度飞秒脉冲激发注入超过 Mott 密度的热载流子，使带隙塌缩并诱导可逆的半导体到金属相变。模拟显示该过程具有强负介电率、增强的光功率吸收、大吸收系数和小皮肤深度，并可在低于硅熔化阈值的条件下实现稳定的载流子驱动金属化，为 CMOS 平台中的有源光子器件和可重构电光器件提供潜在路径。
authors: Ehatasham Haque, Sunjana Tarannum, Jannatul Shahrin Shoshi, Mahdy Rahman Chowdhury
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自电子革命开始以来，硅基技术一直处于电子学和光子学研究的前沿。然而，硅在本质上是间接带隙半导体：导带最低点和价带最高点位于动量空间的不同位置，因此光学跃迁需要声子辅助来守恒晶体动量。这种电子--光子--声子三体相互作用使硅成为太阳能电池和光电器件等光吸收应用中的低效材料。在本工作中，我们以一种已经确立的纳米尺度光子动量约束机制为基础。该机制能够拓宽光子动量分布，并使硅中的无声子吸收成为可能；随后，我们施加高强度飞秒脉冲激发，注入超过 Mott 密度的热载流子，使带隙塌缩并诱导可逆的半导体--金属相变。尽管纳米尺度光子动量约束本身此前已经得到确立，但本工作的核心贡献在于随后发生的、由载流子密度驱动的阶段，该阶段将动量增强区域推进到可逆的瞬态金属相。我们的模拟显示出高度负的介电率、增强的光功率吸收、大吸收系数和较小的皮肤深度，同时载流子密度达到显著数值，远高于 Mott 阈值。我们展示了在低于硅熔化阈值的条件下实现载流子驱动金属化，并保持稳定运行。上述结果确立了一种在硅中动态诱导金属态的通用机制，为在传统 CMOS 平台内单片集成有源光子器件和动态可重构电光器件提供了潜在途径。

articles.title: Machine Learning to Foundation Models: Artificial Intelligence for Nanophotonic Modeling and Scientific Discovery
articles.title_zh: 从机器学习到基础模型：用于纳米光子学建模与科学发现的人工智能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to model, design, and study nanophotonic systems. This review traces the development of the field from classical machine learning and deep learning to generative models, transfer learning, transformers, and emerging foundation models. It first introduces major nanophotonic platforms, including nanoparticles, nanoholes, metasurfaces, photonic crystals, multilayer thin films, and integrated photonic devices, together with their main forward and inverse problems. It then reviews data-driven methods for predicting optical spectra and fields, generating structures from target responses, improving designs through optimization, and accounting for fabrication constraints. Generative models are discussed as a way to produce multiple valid solutions to nonunique inverse problems, while transfer learning, few-shot learning, and physics-aware training help reduce data requirements and improve generalization. Recent domain-specific foundation models show that different optical structures and responses can be handled within shared representations, but current systems remain limited in scope and physical grounding. Future progress will depend on multimodal models that connect geometry, materials, spectra, electromagnetic (EM) fields, fabrication data, experiments, and scientific literature with reliable simulation and validation tools. Current foundation models remain domain-specific, and their extension to broader nanophotonic tasks will require stronger physical grounding and validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述人工智能在纳米光子系统建模、设计和研究中的发展历程，涵盖经典机器学习、深度学习、生成模型、迁移学习、Transformer 以及新兴基础模型。文章介绍纳米颗粒、纳米孔、超表面、光子晶体、多层薄膜和集成光子器件等平台及其正向和逆向问题，并总结光谱与场预测、目标响应结构生成、优化设计和制造约束处理等方法。生成模型能够为非唯一逆问题产生多个有效解，迁移学习、少样本学习和物理感知训练则有助于减少数据需求并提高泛化能力。作者指出，未来需要将几何、材料、光谱、电磁场、制造数据、实验和科学文献连接起来的多模态模型，并配合可靠的仿真与验证工具。
authors: Chaobin Yang, Xueqing Liu, Yiqun Fu, Fengbo Zhou, Krzysztof Kempa, Stefano Anzellotti, Michael J. Naughton
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能正日益用于纳米光子系统的建模、设计和研究。本综述追溯了该领域从经典机器学习和深度学习，到生成模型、迁移学习、Transformer 以及新兴基础模型的发展过程。文章首先介绍主要的纳米光子平台，包括纳米颗粒、纳米孔、超表面、光子晶体、多层薄膜和集成光子器件，并介绍它们的主要正向问题和逆向问题。随后，文章综述了用于预测光学光谱和场、根据目标响应生成结构、通过优化改进设计，以及考虑制造约束的数据驱动方法。生成模型被讨论为非唯一逆问题产生多个有效解的一种方法，而迁移学习、少样本学习和物理感知训练则有助于减少数据需求并改善泛化能力。近期的领域专用基础模型表明，不同的光学结构和响应可以在共享表示中进行处理，但现有系统在适用范围和物理基础方面仍然受到限制。未来的进展将取决于多模态模型的发展，这些模型需要把几何结构、材料、光谱、电磁场、制造数据、实验和科学文献与可靠的仿真及验证工具连接起来。当前的基础模型仍然是领域专用的，将其扩展到更广泛的纳米光子任务需要更强的物理基础和验证能力。

articles.title: Precise Modeling of a Complex Solenoidal Magnetic Field Using a Combination of Analytic Functions and a PINN
articles.title_zh: 结合解析函数与 PINN 对复杂螺线管磁场进行精确建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21658v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate an iterative approach to modeling a sparsely measured magnetic field in a large-bore solenoid. This approach uses a hybrid of traditional and machine learning techniques. The traditional technique is a linear least-squares fit using a series solution to Laplace's equation, while the machine learning technique involves the training of a physics-informed neural network (PINN) on the least-squares fit residuals. We use a newly defined activation function "DELTAsnake," a modification to the snake activation function proposed by Ziyin et al. that allows for stronger curvature and non-monotonicity. The combined model approximately obeys Maxwell's equations to a level sufficient for producing high quality physics simulations and analysis. Our approach is applied to a highly realistic calculation of the expected magnetic field in the Mu2e experiment's Detector Solenoid which includes a simple model for the expected statistical measurement uncertainties. Using ten toy measurement simulations, we demonstrate the capabilities of our model in comparison to the least-squares method alone; the least-squares method alone results in a reduced chi-squared statistic of 2.15 ± 0.01, while our approach improves the reduced chi-square to 1.034 ± 0.005. Furthermore, for an average toy simulation, we show that the range of the RMS of the three field component residuals reduces from 0.07-0.37 Gauss to 0.05-0.07 Gauss. We find that this novel method is robust against a realistic systematic uncertainty deriving from Hall probe calibration bias and can be used to significantly reduce the number of measurements required to achieve an accurate model.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者展示了一种对大孔径螺线管中稀疏测量磁场进行建模的迭代方法，该方法结合了传统数值技术与机器学习。传统部分使用基于拉普拉斯方程级数解的线性最小二乘拟合，机器学习部分则在最小二乘拟合残差上训练物理信息神经网络，并采用改进的 DELTAsnake 激活函数。应用于 Mu2e 实验探测器螺线管的高真实度计算时，该混合模型将约化卡方从 2.15 ± 0.01 降至 1.034 ± 0.005，并显著降低三种磁场分量残差的 RMS 范围。结果表明，该方法对霍尔探头校准偏差具有稳健性，并有望减少获得精确磁场模型所需的测量数量。
authors: Cole Kampa, Susan Dittmer, Henry Glass, Michael Schmitt
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了一种对大孔径螺线管中稀疏测量磁场进行建模的迭代方法。该方法结合了传统技术与机器学习技术。传统技术是利用拉普拉斯方程的级数解进行线性最小二乘拟合；机器学习技术则包括在最小二乘拟合残差上训练物理信息神经网络（PINN）。我们使用了一种新定义的激活函数 DELTAsnake，它是对 Ziyin 等人提出的 snake 激活函数的改进，可实现更强的曲率和非单调性。组合模型对麦克斯韦方程近似成立，其程度足以支持高质量的物理模拟和分析。我们将该方法应用于 Mu2e 实验探测器螺线管中预期磁场的高真实度计算，并加入了对预期统计测量不确定度的简单模型。通过十次玩具测量模拟，我们展示了该模型相对于单独使用最小二乘方法的能力：单独使用最小二乘方法得到的约化卡方统计量为 2.15 ± 0.01，而我们的方法将其改善为 1.034 ± 0.005。此外，对于一次平均的玩具模拟，我们显示三种磁场分量残差的 RMS 范围从 0.07--0.37 高斯降低至 0.05--0.07 高斯。我们发现，该新方法能够抵抗源自霍尔探头校准偏差的现实系统误差，并且可以显著减少实现精确模型所需的测量数量。

articles.title: Inverted model selection in physics-informed neural networks: when a lower residual selects a worse solution
articles.title_zh: 物理信息神经网络中的反转模型选择：较低残差何时选择了较差解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are commonly evaluated via a single aggregate residual, assuming a smaller residual indicates a better solution. Testing this directly across three constrained PDE systems, I find this assumption can systematically fail. In matched pairs of solvers differing only in whether a defining structural identity is hard-wired or penalized, the penalized variant frequently attains a lower equation residual while violating that identity by several orders of magnitude, causing the exact variant to be falsely ranked worse. Over 64 matched pairs spanning two systems, four network variants, and eight seeds, this inversion occurs in 83% of cases (95% Wilson CI: 72--90%), with rates from 72% to 94% across systems. Testing across six architectures--MLP, cPINN, XPINN, hp-VPINN, and physics-informed DeepONet and FNO--inverts the ranking in 46 of 48 pairs, indicating that this variability is problem-dependent rather than specific to the approximator. A third, larger vorticity--streamfunction problem shows the same ordering: the residual-optimal solver violates its structural identity by over six orders above tolerance, despite a residual margin of only 9.37%. Because a scalar loss cannot expose this, I introduce a lexicographic admissibility gate spanning the structural identity, boundary trace, and a solvability integral that must vanish independently of the equation residual. All three must pass before residuals can compete. This gate catches three artifact classes but misses a fourth: a prescribed-structure prior yields fields that pass every single-run check, yet deleting the source term reveals that 97% of the reported structure survives removal of the physics. Reference data and figures accompany the paper.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文检验了以单一聚合残差评价物理信息神经网络，并假设较小残差对应更优解这一常见做法。结果显示，在多个受约束偏微分方程系统中，仅对定义性结构恒等式进行惩罚的求解器经常获得更低的方程残差，却严重违反该恒等式，导致真正满足结构约束的求解器被错误地判为较差。作者在 64 对匹配实验中观察到 83% 的排序反转，并在六种网络架构的 48 对比较中发现 46 对发生反转。为解决标量损失无法暴露这一问题，作者提出按字典序执行的可容许性门控，要求结构恒等式、边界迹和可解性积分分别通过后，方可比较方程残差；但该方法仍无法识别由预设结构先验导致的第四类伪影。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）通常通过单一聚合残差进行评估，并假设较小的残差意味着更好的解。我们在三个受约束的偏微分方程系统中直接检验这一假设，发现它可能系统性地失效。在仅有一个差异的匹配求解器对中，该差异是某个定义性结构恒等式被硬编码满足还是通过惩罚项约束；采用惩罚项的变体经常取得更低的方程残差，却违反该恒等式达数个数量级，从而使严格满足恒等式的变体被错误地排在较差位置。在覆盖两个系统、四种网络变体和八个随机种子的 64 对匹配实验中，这种反转在 83% 的案例中发生（95% Wilson 置信区间：72--90%），不同系统中的发生率为 72% 至 94%。在六种架构中进行测试时，这些架构包括 MLP、cPINN、XPINN、hp-VPINN，以及物理信息 DeepONet 和 FNO，48 对比较中有 46 对出现了排序反转，这表明该现象取决于问题本身，而不是特定于某种近似器。第三个规模更大的涡量--流函数问题呈现出相同的排序：残差最优的求解器违反其结构恒等式，超出容差六个数量级以上，尽管其残差优势仅为 9.37%。由于标量损失无法揭示这一点，我提出了一个按字典序执行的可容许性门控，涵盖结构恒等式、边界迹和必须独立于方程残差而为零的可解性积分。只有三者全部通过后，残差才可以相互竞争。该门控能够识别三类伪影，但无法识别第四类：预设结构先验会产生在单次运行的所有检查中均通过的场，但删除源项后发现，所报告结构的 97% 仍然存在。论文同时提供了参考数据和图示。

articles.title: State-Space Model-Enabled Reinforcement Learning for Magnetic Configuration Controlon EXL-50U
articles.title_zh: 用于 EXL-50U 磁构型控制的状态空间模型增强强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate feedback control of the plasma current (Iₚ₎ and centroid position (R_c,Z_c) is essential for the stable operation of spherical torus (ST) plasmas. Conventional proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controllers require extensive manual tuning and struggle with the fast, strongly coupled dynamics that arise as plasma performance improves. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising alternative to such complex magnetic control problems, yet its practical deployment on ST devices remains challenging. This paper presents a practical RL controller for the EXL-50U ST, trained within a rigid RZIP state-space model (SSM) that enables efficient offline policy learning. A lightweight plasma position reconstructor is developed to estimate (R_c,Z_c) from magnetic probe signals within the real-time control cycle. The trained policy is seamlessly deployed on the EXL-50U plasma control system, achieving stable regulation of Iₚ and (R_c,Z_c) and sustaining discharges up to 650 ms under RL control. These results demonstrate the feasibility and practical potential of model-informed RL for magnetic configuration control in ST devices, offering a promising direction beyond conventional PID-based schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 等离子体电流 Iₚ 以及质心位置 (R_c, Z_c) 的精确反馈控制，对于球形托卡马克等离子体的稳定运行至关重要。传统 PID 控制器需要大量人工调参，并难以应对等离子体性能提高后出现的快速且强耦合动力学。作者在刚性的 RZIP 状态空间模型中训练强化学习控制器，以实现高效的离线策略学习，并开发轻量级等离子体位置重构器，根据磁探针信号实时估计质心位置。该策略部署到 EXL-50U 等离子体控制系统后，实现了 Iₚ 和 (R_c, Z_c) 的稳定调节，并在强化学习控制下将放电维持至 650 ms，展示了模型驱动强化学习用于球形托卡马克磁构型控制的可行性和应用潜力。
authors: Pei Guo, Zhengyuan Chen, Jianguo Chen, Xuanhe Wang, Guoyang Shi, Siqi Ding, Yapeng Zhang, Lei Xing, Yong Liu, Xiang Gu, Tiantian Sun, Xiuchun Lun, Jia Li, Zhengxiong Wang, Huasheng Xie, Hanyue Zhao, Yuejiang Shi, Xianming Song, Tianyuan Liu, EXL-50U Team
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对等离子体电流（Iₚ）和质心位置（R_c, Z_c）进行精确反馈控制，对于球形托卡马克（ST）等离子体的稳定运行至关重要。传统的比例--积分--微分（PID）控制器需要大量人工调节，并且难以应对随着等离子体性能提高而出现的快速且强耦合的动力学。近年来，强化学习（RL）已成为处理这类复杂磁控制问题的一种有前景的替代方案，但其在 ST 装置上的实际部署仍然面临挑战。本文提出了一种用于 EXL-50U ST 的实用 RL 控制器，该控制器在刚性的 RZIP 状态空间模型（SSM）中进行训练，从而能够高效地开展离线策略学习。我们开发了一种轻量级等离子体位置重构器，在实时控制周期内根据磁探针信号估计（R_c, Z_c）。训练完成的策略被无缝部署到 EXL-50U 等离子体控制系统中，实现了 Iₚ 和（R_c, Z_c）的稳定调节，并在 RL 控制下将放电维持至 650 ms。这些结果证明了模型知情强化学习用于 ST 装置磁构型控制的可行性和实际潜力，并为超越传统基于 PID 的方案提供了有前景的方向。

articles.title: Simple data fusion from several ocean and atmosphere hindcast models improves surface drifter trajectory prediction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating the trajectory of surface drifters in the ocean matters for search and rescue, pollution tracking, oil and chemical spill response, and marine risk analysis. Accurate prediction remains difficult, as widely acknowledged in the literature, and also illustrated by the ``Forecasting Floats in Turbulence'' challenge issued by the US Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) in 2021, and which ultimately led to this paper. The main source of error usually comes from uncertain ocean currents, while errors in wind forcing and object drift properties are often smaller [Dagestad and Röhrs, 2019]. Here, we use an open one-year dataset of Sofar Spotter trajectories together with several ocean and atmospheric hindcast products to test data-driven drift models at scale. We compare three approaches: i) a standard (baseline) drifter trajectory simulation based on one ocean model and one atmospheric model, ii) linear regression (LR) models that fuse all available predictors, and iii) neural networks (NN) using similar inputs. A simple LR model that combines all predictors performs equally well as the NN. Because LR is simpler, cheaper, and more robust, we retain it as the preferred approach. In 2-day trajectory prediction, this improves the Liu-Weisberg skill score by around 40% relative to the baseline. These findings apply to hindcast mode; applying this methodology for forecast mode remains for future work.
authors: Jean Rabault, Knut Frode Dagestad, Gaute Hope

articles.title: Mie Optical Computing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical computing is emerging as a promising paradigm for next-generation information processing. Diffractive optical processors rely on spatially distributed trainable degrees of freedom, leading to extended architectures. Here, we propose a compact neuromorphic optical-computing approach where the entire trainable transformation is implemented by a single Mie scatterer. By formulating computation in vector spherical harmonics basis, trainable modal couplings can be concentrated within a finite object through its T-matrix. Since available T-matrix parameters scale as the fourth power of maximal multipole order, this architecture can overcome trainable-parameter-density limitations of conventional spatially distributed diffractive processors. We demonstrate classification of phase-encoded MNIST images using scattered-field intensity. At a particle size parameter of ka = 15, the trained T-matrix reaches approximately 90% test accuracy, comparable to a single-layer artificial neural network. Similar performance can be achieved using near-fields, enabling on-chip integration. We further show how reciprocity, passivity, and particle symmetry constrain performance: passivity reduces the accessible operator space while improving robustness, whereas symmetry reduces the number of independent parameters. Finally, we inverse-design a non-absorbing dielectric scatterer that realizes the classification task with 84% accuracy. These results demonstrate that nontrivial neuromorphic transformations can be encoded within the multipolar response of a single compact scatterer.
authors: Vsevolod Kleshchenko, Vladimir Igoshin, Costantino De Angelis, Mihail Petrov

articles.title: PhysECD: A Physics-Constrained E(3)-Equivariant Framework for Electronic Circular Dichroism Spectrum Prediction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic circular dichroism (ECD) spectrum is a primary experimental probe for assigning the absolute configuration of chiral molecules, yet interpreting a measured spectrum requires time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) calculations that can cost hours per molecule and must be repeated for every candidate stereoisomer and conformation. We present PhysECD, a physics-constrained, parity-aware E(3)-equivariant framework that bypasses computationally expensive TDDFT and predicts ECD spectra directly from the 3D structure of an individual conformer. Instead of regressing the spectrum as an opaque sequence, PhysECD predicts the physical quantities that generate it: per-state excitation energies and electric and magnetic transition dipoles. These quantities determine the rotatory strength R -- the dot product of the two dipoles, a pseudoscalar that reverses sign under mirror reflection -- and yield the final spectrum through a differentiable Gaussian-broadening formula derived from the underlying physics. The parity structure of the equivariant features guarantees the correct chiroptical symmetry: reflecting a molecule exactly negates the predicted spectrum. On the CMCDS dataset, PhysECD attains a per-molecule spectral Pearson correlation of 0.642 (mean) / 0.822 (median), substantially exceeding prior learned predictors while remaining physically interpretable. Experiments across multiple backbones further show that the framework is backbone-agnostic, paving the way for real-time assignment of absolute configuration.
authors: Yi Jiang, Letian Chen, Runhan Shi, Liangzhaoxuan Han, Tong Zhu, Yang Yang

articles.title: Plasmon-polaritons in a rarefied nonrelativistic neutron gas
articles.title_zh: 稀薄非相对论中子气体中的等离激元-极化激元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electromagnetic properties of a dilute unpolarized nonrelativistic neutron gas are described in the case when neutron-by-neutron scattering is negligible. The Gaussian (Maxwell-Boltzmann) and Fermi-Dirac one-particle density matrices for the neutron gas are considered, the typical space scale of variations of these density matrices being assumed to be much larger than the the typical space scale of variations of the electromagnetic field. The Green functions for the static effective Maxwell equations are obtained. The parameters of a nonequilibrium neutron gas are found where this gas possesses a ferromagnetic instability. The analog of Friedel oscillations is described. The properties of plasmon-polaritons in the neutron gas are revealed. It turns out that the dispersion law of longitudinal and transverse plasmon-polaritons has an infinite number of branches at a given momentum. The region of parameters where the plasmon-polaritons can be regarded as quasiparticles is found. The plasmon-polaritons on a Gaussian wave packet of a single electron are described. Their dispersion law proves to have an infinite number of branches at a given momentum. It is shown that there exist stable longitudinal plasmon-polaritons even on a single electron.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究中子间散射可忽略时，稀薄、非极化、非相对论中子气体的电磁性质，并分别考虑高斯分布和费米-狄拉克分布的一粒子密度矩阵。研究获得了静态有效麦克斯韦方程的格林函数，确定了非平衡中子气体发生铁磁不稳定性的参数范围，并描述了类似弗里德尔振荡的现象。结果表明，纵向和横向等离激元-极化激元在给定动量下具有无穷多个色散分支，且即使在单个电子上也存在稳定的纵向等离激元-极化激元。
authors: P. O. Kazinski, A. M. Trushchuk
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22177v1；公告类型：新提交。本文研究在中子-中子散射可以忽略的情况下，稀薄、非极化、非相对论中子气体的电磁性质。研究考虑了中子气体的高斯（麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼）和费米-狄拉克一粒子密度矩阵，并假定这些密度矩阵变化的典型空间尺度远大于电磁场变化的典型空间尺度。研究获得了静态有效麦克斯韦方程的格林函数。研究确定了非平衡中子气体具有铁磁不稳定性时的参数。研究描述了类似弗里德尔振荡的现象。研究揭示了中子气体中等离激元-极化激元的性质。结果表明，纵向和横向等离激元-极化激元的色散关系在给定动量下具有无穷多个分支。研究确定了等离激元-极化激元可以被视为准粒子的参数区域。研究描述了单个电子的高斯波包上的等离激元-极化激元。事实证明，它们的色散关系在给定动量下同样具有无穷多个分支。研究表明，即使在单个电子上也存在稳定的纵向等离激元-极化激元。

articles.title: Wavefront-Guided Electron Injection for Direct Laser Acceleration in Relativistic Laser-Driven Plasma Channel
articles.title_zh: 相对论激光驱动等离子体通道中用于直接激光加速的波前引导电子注入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate electron injection into direct laser acceleration (DLA) in relativistic laser-driven plasma channels using particle-in-cell simulations. We identify and characterize a wavefront-guided injection mechanism, in which electrons are continuously fed into the plasma channel through the density pile-up layer at the laser-pulse front. Phase-space analysis reveals a localized injectable region within the pile-up layer, indicating that only a selected subset of electrons satisfies the conditions required for the subsequent direct laser acceleration. This mechanism provides a physical interpretation for the high-charge capability of DLA by explaining how electrons are continuously supplied to the accelerating channel. Beyond this continuous supply process, the injection dynamics are further modulated by the periodic variation of the carrier phase at the laser-pulse front. The spatial locations of injected electrons are found to be closely associated with magnetic-island structures formed under laser-phase modulation, suggesting that the laser wavefront not only supplies electrons but also organizes their entry into the accelerating channel. These findings advance the physical understanding of energetic-electron generation in relativistic laser-driven subcritical-density plasma channels and are relevant to the development of compact DLA-based particle and radiation sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用粒子模拟研究相对论激光驱动等离子体通道中的直接激光加速电子注入，并发现一种波前引导的注入机制。电子通过激光脉冲前沿的密度堆积层持续进入等离子体通道，但只有该层中满足后续直接激光加速条件的部分电子能够被注入。研究还表明，激光载波相位的周期变化会调制注入过程，注入位置与磁岛结构密切相关，从而解释了直接激光加速产生高电荷量电子束的机制。
authors: Heng Wang, Liang Sheng, Long Zeng, Yang Li, Zheng Gong
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22211v1；公告类型：新提交。我们利用粒子模拟研究相对论激光驱动等离子体通道中电子向直接激光加速（DLA）过程的注入。我们识别并表征了一种波前引导的注入机制，在该机制中，电子通过激光脉冲前沿的密度堆积层持续进入等离子体通道。相空间分析揭示了堆积层内一个局域化的可注入区域，表明只有满足后续直接激光加速所需条件的特定部分电子才能被注入。该机制解释了DLA具有高电荷量能力的物理原因，即电子能够持续补充到加速通道中。除这一持续供给过程之外，注入动力学还受到激光脉冲前沿载波相位周期性变化的进一步调制。研究发现，注入电子的空间位置与激光相位调制下形成的磁岛结构密切相关，这表明激光波前不仅能够供应电子，还能组织电子进入加速通道的过程。这些发现推进了对相对论激光驱动亚临界密度等离子体通道中高能电子产生机制的理解，并与发展基于DLA的紧凑型粒子源和辐射源有关。

articles.title: A well-balanced weakly compressible SPH formulation for free-surface flows and its GPU implementation
articles.title_zh: 自由表面流动的平衡弱可压缩光滑粒子流体动力学格式及其GPU实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study proposes a well-balanced formulation of weakly compressible smoothed particle hydrodynamics (WCSPH) for free-surface flows, which preserves hydrostatic equilibrium exactly at the discrete level--a property essential for reliable long-term simulations. Although well-balanced schemes are well established for mesh-based methods, the property remains largely unaddressed in WCSPH, where the particle approximation of the pressure gradient fails to balance the gravitational force exactly. The imbalance stems from two difficulties: the nonlinearity of the pressure-gradient-over-density term, and the approximation error of gradients evaluated by particle summation. The first is resolved by introducing an auxiliary potential variable that recasts the nonlinear term as the gradient of a single scalar, which reduces to a linear function of position under hydrostatic conditions. The second is resolved by a Riemann-based gradient approximation with kernel correction, which is first-order consistent and recovers linear fields exactly. These two ingredients ensure that the discrete potential gradient balances gravitational force exactly. Widely used techniques, including δ-SPH, particle shifting and tensile instability control, are readily incorporated. The formulation is further extended to three dimensions and implemented on GPU with architecture-tailored optimizations. Hydrostatic tests with rectangular, triangular and Gaussian bottom topographies show that the proposed formulation attains the well-balanced property to machine precision, reducing the spurious velocity error of conventional SPH from 10⁻³ to the order of 10⁻¹³. More complex benchmarks confirm its robustness, accuracy and low pressure oscillation, with simulations of up to 17.53 million particles performed on a single consumer-grade GPU.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于自由表面流动的平衡弱可压缩光滑粒子流体动力学格式，可在离散层面精确保持静水力学平衡。该方法通过辅助势函数处理压力梯度与密度之比的非线性，并结合带核函数修正的黎曼梯度近似，精确恢复线性场，从而使离散势梯度与重力完全平衡。数值测试表明，该方法将传统SPH的伪速度误差从10⁻³量级降低至约10⁻¹³，并在单张消费级GPU上完成了最多1753万个粒子的模拟。
authors: Jiawang Zhang, Fengxiang Zhao, Jianping Gan, Kun Xu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22269v1；公告类型：新提交。本研究提出了一种用于自由表面流动的平衡弱可压缩光滑粒子流体动力学（WCSPH）格式，该格式能够在离散层面精确保持静水力学平衡，这一性质对于可靠的长期模拟至关重要。尽管平衡格式在基于网格的方法中已经得到充分发展，但在WCSPH中，这一性质仍然基本未得到解决，因为粒子对压力梯度的近似不能与重力完全平衡。这种不平衡源于两个困难：压力梯度与密度之比具有非线性，以及通过粒子求和计算的梯度存在近似误差。针对第一个问题，研究引入辅助势变量，将该非线性项改写为单个标量的梯度；在静水条件下，该标量退化为位置的线性函数。针对第二个问题，研究采用带核函数修正的基于黎曼问题的梯度近似，该近似具有一阶一致性，并能够精确恢复线性场。这两个要素共同保证了离散势梯度能够与重力完全平衡。包括δ-SPH、粒子移位和拉伸不稳定性控制在内的常用技术都可以方便地纳入该格式。研究还将该格式扩展至三维，并通过针对硬件架构的优化在GPU上实现。针对矩形、三角形和高斯形底部地形的静水测试表明，所提出的格式以机器精度达到平衡性质，并将传统SPH的伪速度误差从10⁻³降低到10⁻¹³量级。更复杂的基准测试进一步证实了该方法的稳健性、准确性和较低的压力振荡；研究在单张消费级GPU上完成了最多1753万个粒子的模拟。

articles.title: Shimmer: End-to-End Open-Source Passive B0 Shimming Methodology for Low-Field MRI Magnets
articles.title_zh: Shimmer：面向低场MRI磁体的端到端开源无源B0匀场方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-field MRI scanners based on permanent magnet arrays require accurate B0 shimming to achieve sufficient field homogeneity for imaging. Here, we present Shimmer, an open-source methodology for passive shimming of low-field MRI magnets using additional NdFeB magnets placed outside the main magnet array. The end-to-end methodology combines magnetic field mapping, magnetic field simulations, numerical optimization of shim magnet positions and orientations, and automated generation of 3D-printable shim holders. Continuous magnet rotations and several optimization strategies are considered and evaluated. The method was validated and applied to three different permanent magnet arrays ~50 mT in 200 mm diameter spherical volumes, reducing initial field inhomogeneities of 9361ppm, 31721 ppm and 34143 ppm to 888 ppm, 1812 ppm and 1602 ppm respectively. The improved homogeneity enabled undistorted MR imaging of a phantom. Shimmer provides a reproducible and adaptable approach for improving the performance of low-field MRI magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出Shimmer，一种利用放置在主磁体阵列外部的附加钕铁硼磁体对低场MRI磁体进行无源匀场的开源方法。该端到端流程结合磁场测绘、磁场仿真、匀场磁体位置与方向的数值优化，以及可自动生成的3D打印磁体支架。该方法应用于三个约50 mT、直径200 mm球形区域的永磁体阵列后，将初始场不均匀性分别从9361、31721和34143 ppm降至888、1812和1602 ppm，并实现了无畸变的模体MR成像。
authors: Ilia Kulikov, David Schote, Helge Herthum, Martin Häuer, Kimon Hadjikiriakos, Jan Gregor Frintz, Sonja Buxbaum-Conradi, Manuel Moritz, Tobias Redlich, Lukas Winter
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22351v1；公告类型：新提交。基于永磁体阵列的低场MRI扫描仪需要准确的B0匀场，以实现足够的成像场均匀性。本文提出Shimmer，一种利用放置在主磁体阵列外部的附加NdFeB磁体对低场MRI磁体进行无源匀场的开源方法。该端到端方法结合了磁场测绘、磁场仿真、匀场磁体位置和方向的数值优化，以及自动生成可进行3D打印的匀场磁体支架。研究考虑并评估了连续磁体旋转以及多种优化策略。该方法在三个不同的永磁体阵列上得到验证并应用于直径为200 mm、磁场约为50 mT的球形体积，将初始场不均匀性分别为9361 ppm、31721 ppm和34143 ppm的系统，改善至888 ppm、1812 ppm和1602 ppm。改善后的均匀性使模体能够实现无畸变MR成像。Shimmer为提升低场MRI磁体性能提供了一种可复现且适应性强的方法。

articles.title: Volume-Surface-Wire Integral Equations for EEG Source Imaging
articles.title_zh: 用于脑电图源成像的体积-表面-线积分方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In EEG source imaging, the precision of the imaging of the brain activity depends on the accuracy of the forward head model which is, in turn, affected by the representation of tissue conductivity, including anisotropic compartments such as the skull and white matter. We introduce an EEG source imaging framework based on a hybrid volume-surface-wire integral formulation, enabling tract-aware modeling of anisotropic white matter contributions without a full volumetric head discretization. The proposed framework is assessed on a realistic MRI-derived head anatomy, showing close agreement with FEM reference solutions while avoiding full-volume meshing and providing a natural representation of white matter fiber tracts. We then integrate this model into a real-time pipeline that couples EEG processing with immersive visualization, enabling synchronized inspection of scalp potentials, cortical sources, and white matter fiber tracts-related quantities. The results support the proposed formulation as a tract-aware alternative to canonical formulations, combining robust localization performance with interactive visualization capabilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于体积-表面-线混合积分方程的脑电图源成像框架，可在无需对头部进行完整体积离散的情况下，建模与白质纤维束相关的各向异性贡献。该方法在真实MRI重建的头部解剖模型上进行了评估，结果与有限元法参考解高度一致，同时能够自然表示白质纤维束。研究还将该模型集成到实时处理流程中，实现头皮电势、皮层源以及白质纤维束相关量的同步沉浸式可视化检查。
authors: Paolo Ricci, Maxime Monin, Alessandro Mascherin, Adrien Merlini, Francesco P. Andriulli
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22477v1；公告类型：新提交。在脑电图源成像中，脑活动成像的精度取决于头部正向模型的准确性，而正向模型又受到组织电导率表示方式的影响，其中包括颅骨和白质等各向异性区室。我们提出一种基于体积-表面-线混合积分方程的脑电图源成像框架，使得无需对头部进行完整的体积离散，即可考虑与纤维束相关的白质各向异性贡献。我们在一个由真实MRI数据得到的头部解剖模型上评估了所提出的框架，结果显示其与有限元法参考解高度一致，同时避免了全体积网格剖分，并提供了对白质纤维束的自然表示。随后，我们将该模型集成到一个实时流程中，将脑电图处理与沉浸式可视化相结合，从而能够同步检查头皮电势、皮层源以及与白质纤维束相关的物理量。结果支持将所提出的公式作为经典公式的纤维束感知型替代方案；该方案兼具稳健的定位性能和交互式可视化能力。

articles.title: Interpretable statistical feature engineering for early disruption prediction in the short pulse ADITYA tokamak
articles.title_zh: 用于短脉冲ADITYA托卡马克早期破裂预测的可解释统计特征工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable early disruption prediction is critical for the safe operation and real-time control of tokamaks. However, machine learning based prediction frameworks have predominantly targeted medium and long pulse devices, with comparatively limited attention given to short pulse tokamaks where available warning time is inherently constrained. In this work, an interpretable machine learning framework is developed for feature engineering and early prediction of disruptions in the ADITYA using the initial plasma evolution information, prior to the activation of the negative converter of the ohmic transformer power supply. Statistical descriptors comprising the mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis and wavelet energy entropy are extracted from routinely available plasma diagnostics over different operation time windows. Decision tree based feature selection is employed to identify physically meaningful disruption precursors and to reduce feature dimensionality. These selected features are used to train a random forest classifier. The proposed framework achieves stable predictive performance across different analysis windows, with a maximum ROC-AUC of 0.87 for 0-35 ms and 0-40 ms windows. Comparable and in some cases improved, performance is obtained using the reduced feature set, demonstrating that the selected statistical descriptors retain the essential information required for disruption prediction. The proposed methodology provides an interpretable and computationally efficient framework for real time disruption prediction in short pulse tokamaks and establishes that carefully engineered statistical descriptors can effectively replace raw time series inputs for early disruption prediction, thereby offering a practical pathway toward real time plasma control in short pulse tokamaks similar to ADITYA and ADITYA-U.
articles.abstract_zh: 可靠的早期破裂预测对于托卡马克的安全运行和实时控制至关重要，但现有机器学习方法主要面向中长脉冲装置，对预警时间天然受限的短脉冲托卡马克关注较少。本文从负变流器启动前的初始等离子体演化信息中提取均值、方差、偏度、峰度和小波能量熵等统计特征，通过决策树筛选具有物理意义的破裂先兆，并利用随机森林进行分类。该方法在0-35 ms和0-40 ms分析窗口内取得最高0.87的ROC-AUC，表明经过精心设计的统计描述量能够以较低计算成本替代原始时间序列，支持短脉冲托卡马克的实时破裂预测与等离子体控制。
authors: Jyoti Agarwal, Kavit Patel, Bhaskar Chaudhury, Abhishek Sharma, Shrichand Jakhar, Manika Sharma
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22515v1；公告类型：新提交。可靠的早期破裂预测对于托卡马克的安全运行和实时控制至关重要。然而，基于机器学习的预测框架主要针对中脉冲和长脉冲装置，而对短脉冲托卡马克的关注相对有限；对于短脉冲装置，可用预警时间本身受到限制。在本研究中，我们利用初始等离子体演化信息，在欧姆变压器电源负变流器启动之前，开发了一种用于ADITYA破裂特征工程和早期预测的可解释机器学习框架。研究从不同运行时间窗口内常规可用的等离子体诊断数据中提取均值、方差、偏度、峰度和小波能量熵等统计描述量。采用基于决策树的特征选择方法识别具有物理意义的破裂先兆，并降低特征维度。随后使用筛选出的特征训练随机森林分类器。所提出的框架在不同分析窗口下表现出稳定的预测性能，在0-35 ms和0-40 ms窗口内取得最高0.87的ROC-AUC。使用降维后的特征集也获得了相当甚至更好的性能，这表明所选统计描述量保留了破裂预测所需的关键信息。所提出的方法为短脉冲托卡马克的实时破裂预测提供了可解释且计算高效的框架，并表明经过恰当设计的统计描述量能够有效替代原始时间序列输入，用于早期破裂预测，从而为ADITYA和ADITYA-U等短脉冲托卡马克的实时等离子体控制提供了一条切实可行的途径。

articles.title: Hydrogen Molecular Ion and Molecule in Classical Electrodynamics with Classical Zero-Point Radiation
articles.title_zh: 包含经典零点辐射的经典电动力学中的氢分子离子与氢分子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The hydrogen molecular ion and the hydrogen molecule are treated in an approximate calculation based on classical electrodynamics which includes classical zero-point radiation. It is found within the classical theory that a molecular ion is less-well bound than a hydrogen atom plus a distant proton. The smaller binding energy is explained due to the repulsive nature of the force between the proton and the atom when considering the most natural resonant orbit of the electron. The approximate classical electromagnetic calculation gives a binding energy of 2.1eV and a proton separation of 0.916Ao for the hydrogen molecular ion. The hydrogen molecule is formed by adding a single additional electron to the ion. The electrostatic attraction of the electron to the ion gives a binding energy of 4.6eV and a inter-proton separation of 0.6Ao for the hydrogen molecule in this classical electromagnetic approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在包含经典零点辐射的经典电动力学框架下，对氢分子离子和氢分子进行了近似计算。经典理论结果表明，氢分子离子的束缚弱于氢原子与远处质子组成的体系，这归因于电子最自然的共振轨道下质子与原子之间呈排斥作用。计算得到氢分子离子的束缚能为2.1 eV、质子间距为0.916 Å；在该离子上增加一个电子后，氢分子的束缚能为4.6 eV、质子间距为0.6 Å。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22535v1；公告类型：新提交。本文在包含经典零点辐射的经典电动力学基础上，对氢分子离子和氢分子进行了近似计算。在经典理论中发现，分子离子的束缚程度低于氢原子加一个远处质子的体系。较小的束缚能可以解释为：当考虑电子最自然的共振轨道时，质子与原子之间的作用力具有排斥性。近似的经典电磁学计算得到，氢分子离子的束缚能为2.1 eV，质子间距为0.916 Å。氢分子通过向该离子增加一个电子形成。在这一经典电磁学近似中，电子与分子离子之间的静电吸引使氢分子的束缚能为4.6 eV，质子间距为0.6 Å。

articles.title: General Symmetry-Based Potential Energy Surface Grid Reduction in Normal Coordinates
articles.title_zh: 基于一般对称性的法向坐标势能面网格约简
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22650v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The construction of a grid-based potential energy surface (PES) can be prohibitively expensive as the number of grid points grows exponentially with molecular size. Molecular symmetry can reduce this cost by eliminating symmetry-equivalent points. We present an algebraic symmetry-based grid reduction method, ASyBGR, that is capable of handling non-Abelian and higher-order cyclic symmetry groups. Non-coordinate-mixing operations are encoded into a vector space bit-string, where Gaussian elimination and closure can identify all symmetry-valid sign change patterns and the coordinate axes whose grids can be halved about the origin. In the presence of degenerate subspaces, we optimize the coordinate basis to maximize reduction. The method was validated by comparing vibrational configuration interaction (VCI) energies calculated using the full and symmetry-reduced fourth-order HDMR PESs for molecules spanning a broad range of symmetries. The number of grid points required to construct the PES was reduced by as much as 81%, while VCI energies deviated below 1 1/cm for all test cases on average. The relative root-mean-square deviation (RRMSD) between the full and symmetry-reduced potential energy and dipole moment surfaces were at most on the order of 10⁻³ and 10⁻², respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 势能面网格点数量会随分子尺寸指数增长，导致构建成本极高。本文提出代数对称性网格约简方法ASyBGR，可处理非阿贝尔对称群和高阶循环对称群，并通过识别对称等价点、可减半的坐标网格以及简并子空间中的最优坐标基来降低计算量。对多种对称性的分子进行测试时，势能面构建所需网格点数最多减少81%，而振动组态相互作用能量的偏差平均低于1 cm⁻¹；势能面和偶极矩面的相对均方根偏差分别不超过10⁻³和10⁻²量级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22650v1；公告类型：新提交。随着分子尺寸增大，基于网格构建势能面（PES）的成本可能变得难以承受，因为网格点数量呈指数增长。分子对称性可以通过消除对称等价点来降低这一成本。我们提出一种代数对称性网格约简方法ASyBGR，该方法能够处理非阿贝尔对称群和高阶循环对称群。非坐标混合操作被编码到向量空间位字符串中，通过高斯消元和闭包运算，可以识别所有符合对称性要求的符号变化模式，以及其网格可以关于原点对半划分的坐标轴。在存在简并子空间时，我们优化坐标基以最大化约简程度。我们针对具有广泛对称性的多种分子，通过比较利用完整势能面和对称性约简后的四阶HDMR势能面计算得到的振动组态相互作用（VCI）能量，对该方法进行了验证。构建势能面所需的网格点数最多减少了81%，而在所有测试案例中，VCI能量的偏差平均低于1 cm⁻¹。完整势能面与对称性约简势能面之间的相对均方根偏差（RRMSD）最高分别约为10⁻³和10⁻²，对应势能面和偶极矩面。

articles.title: On the feasibility of model-based feedback control of vertical instability growth rate using out-vessel coils in ARC-like scenarios
articles.title_zh: ARC类场景中利用真空室外线圈进行垂直不稳定性增长率模型反馈控制的可行性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we propose a model-based feedback controller that regulates the vertical instability growth rate (γgᵣ) of a high-elongation, double-null tokamak directly, using only out-vessel poloidal field (PF) coils. High elongation raises the achievable plasma current and fusion performance but makes the plasma vertically unstable, and in a fusion power plant the in-vessel coils that present devices rely on for stabilization may be absent, leaving only distant out-vessel circuits. The controller couples a machine learning surrogate of non-rigid, profile agnostic vertical instability metric to a constrained quadratic program: the surrogate supplies real-time γgᵣ estimates and, via automatic differentiation, the actuator sensitivities, while the program allocates coil voltages to track a target growth rate, maintain double-null divertor balance, and respect electromechanical limits. We tested this method on the ARC~V3A power plant design configuration across 24 closed-loop simulations spanning equilibrium variations, actuator degradations, and transient disturbances. We achieved full or marginal success in 83% of these cases (full in 50%, marginal in a further 33%) and lose control in the remaining 17%; the failures map the boundary of out-vessel controllability (occurring at the highest growth rates) and under actuator limits. The controller does not regulate boundary shape explicitly: separatrix geometry follows indirectly from growth rate and flux balance control and would require a separate shape control layer for sustained scenario evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于模型的反馈控制器，仅利用真空室外极向场线圈直接调节高拉长比双零点托卡马克的垂直不稳定性增长率。控制器将机器学习代理模型提供的实时增长率及其执行器灵敏度，与受约束二次规划相结合，以跟踪目标增长率、维持双零点偏滤器平衡并满足机电约束。在ARC V3A电站设计构型的24次闭环模拟中，83%的案例取得完全或边际成功；剩余失败案例揭示了真空室外控制能力在高增长率和执行器受限条件下的边界。
authors: Arunav Kumar, Cesar Clauser, Theodore Golfinopoulos, Jon C. Hillesheim
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22677v1；公告类型：新提交。在本研究中，我们提出一种基于模型的反馈控制器，直接利用真空室外极向场（PF）线圈调节高拉长比双零点托卡马克的垂直不稳定性增长率（γgr）。高拉长比能够提高可实现的等离子体电流和聚变性能，但也会使等离子体在垂直方向上不稳定；在聚变电站中，现有装置用于稳定控制的真空室内线圈可能不存在，因此只能依靠距离较远的真空室外电路。该控制器将一个与形状无关且不依赖剖面的垂直不稳定性指标机器学习代理模型，与一个受约束二次规划相耦合：代理模型提供实时γgr估计值，并通过自动微分提供执行器灵敏度；二次规划则分配线圈电压，以跟踪目标增长率、维持双零点偏滤器平衡并满足机电约束。我们在ARC V3A电站设计构型上进行了24次闭环模拟，涵盖平衡变化、执行器性能退化和瞬态扰动等情况。在这些案例中，83%取得了完全成功或边际成功，其中完全成功占50%，另有33%为边际成功；其余17%的案例失去控制。这些失败案例界定了真空室外控制能力的边界，失败发生在最高增长率和执行器受到限制的情况下。该控制器并不显式调节边界形状；分离面几何形状通过增长率控制和磁通平衡控制间接随之变化，而要实现情景的持续演化，还需要单独的形状控制层。

articles.title: Periodic Spin Dynamics and Duty-Cycle Optimization in a PWM Bell--Bloom Magnetometer
articles.title_zh: PWM Bell-布卢姆磁力计中的周期自旋动力学与占空比优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the duty-cycle-dependent response of a pulse-width-modulated Bell--Bloom atomic magnetometer. A Bloch-equation model is developed to describe the pump-on and pump-off spin dynamics, leading to analytical transient solutions and a periodic steady-state description. An extended free-induction-decay fitting method is introduced to calibrate the effective relaxation rates W and W₀, which are then used to predict the modulated atomic response. The model agrees with time-domain waveform measurements, fast virtual lock-in analysis, and practical hardware lock-in measurements in the near-resonant operating regime. We show that maximizing the signal amplitude does not generally optimize the magnetometer sensitivity, because the lock-in slope also depends on the detuning-dependent phase response. The results provide a practical framework for duty-cycle and pump-rate optimization in PWM-modulated atomic magnetometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究脉宽调制Bell-布卢姆原子磁力计对占空比变化的响应，并建立描述泵浦开启和关闭阶段自旋动力学的布洛赫方程模型。研究推导了解析瞬态解和周期稳态描述，引入扩展自由感应衰减拟合方法标定有效弛豫率，并用其预测调制原子响应。结果表明，最大化信号幅度并不一定能优化磁力计灵敏度，因为锁相放大器斜率还受到失谐相关相位响应的影响；该模型可用于PWM原子磁力计的占空比和泵浦率优化。
authors: Ying-Hao Ye, Ling-Yan Hu, Dui-Gao Yi, Zhi-Fei Yu, Bing Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22737v1；公告类型：新提交。我们研究了脉宽调制Bell-布卢姆原子磁力计依赖占空比的响应。我们建立了布洛赫方程模型，用于描述泵浦开启和泵浦关闭阶段的自旋动力学，并由此得到解析瞬态解和周期稳态描述。我们引入一种扩展的自由感应衰减拟合方法，用于标定有效弛豫率W和W₀，随后利用这些参数预测调制原子响应。在接近共振的工作区域内，该模型与时域波形测量、快速虚拟锁相分析以及实际硬件锁相测量相符合。我们表明，最大化信号幅度通常并不能实现磁力计灵敏度的最优，因为锁相斜率还取决于与失谐有关的相位响应。研究结果为PWM调制原子磁力计中的占空比和泵浦率优化提供了实用框架。

articles.title: Exchange and core-polarization effects on Rydberg-transition electric-dipole matrix elements in Rb and Cs
articles.title_zh: 交换与核极化效应对Rb和Cs里德伯跃迁电偶极矩阵元的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Microwave electric-field measurements with Rydberg atoms require accurate Rydberg-transition electric-dipole matrix elements. We calculate these matrix elements for Rb and Cs using a Dirac-Fock plus core-polarization method, which core-valence exchange is treated explicitly and core-valence correlation is represented by a cutoff core-polarization potential. A smooth cutoff-radius model fitted to quantum-defect energies reproduces the target energies with MHz-level residuals for states up to n=90. Comparisons with model-potential matrix elements and internal length-velocity consistency show that the s-p transitions are generally the most robust, whereas the p-d and d-f transitions show stronger atom- and branch-dependent sensitivity to short-range modeling. The largest relative differences arise from radial-integral cancellation, where short-range phase changes are amplified by the small final matrix element. These results provide a practical reliability assessment for Rydberg-transition electric-dipole matrix elements used in field-sensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 利用里德伯原子测量微波电场需要准确的里德伯跃迁电偶极矩阵元。本文采用狄拉克-福克加核极化方法计算Rb和Cs中的相关矩阵元，其中显式处理核-价交换，并用带截断的核极化势表示核-价关联。通过量子亏损能量拟合得到的平滑截断半径模型可使最高至n=90的态达到MHz量级残差；结果表明s-p跃迁通常最稳健，而p-d和d-f跃迁对短程模型更敏感。
authors: Yu Shi-Cheng, Zhen-Xiang Zhong, Cheng-Bin Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22798v1；公告类型：新提交。利用里德伯原子进行微波电场测量需要准确的里德伯跃迁电偶极矩阵元。我们采用狄拉克-福克加核极化方法计算Rb和Cs中的这些矩阵元，其中显式处理核-价交换，而核-价关联则通过带截断的核极化势表示。利用量子亏损能量拟合得到的平滑截断半径模型，能够使最高至n=90的态所对应目标能量的残差达到MHz量级。通过与模型势矩阵元的比较以及内部长度-速度规范一致性检验，我们发现s-p跃迁通常最为稳健，而p-d和d-f跃迁对短程建模表现出更强的、依赖原子种类和分支的敏感性。最大的相对差异来自径向积分抵消现象：当最终矩阵元很小时，短程相位变化会被放大。这些结果为场传感应用中使用的里德伯跃迁电偶极矩阵元提供了实用的可靠性评估。

articles.title: Polymer-Linked Nanoparticle Networks Running on Heat Can Act as Computing Devices
articles.title_zh: 由聚合物连接的纳米颗粒网络利用热能运行并可充当计算设备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing physical neural network (PNN) hardwares is important to next generation artificial intelligence systems. Phononic devices-using heat current to encode and process information-is one of the solutions to neuromorphic computing. In this work, we back map an artificial neural network (ANN) into a PNN simulation model using polymer networked nanoparticles (PNNPs). Our atomistic simulation results demonstrate that the polymer linked nanoparticle networks can potentially realize information processing using heat current. Using high-throughput molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and the trust region Bayesian optimization (TuRBO) methods, we tune the plasticity of polymer linkers and the temperatures of nanoparticles to optimize the performance of the PNNP machines, which is similar to tune the weights and bias in ANNs. After 5 rounds of high-throughput MD simulations, we show that the PNNP machines have improved in performance. We also use a testing data set to verify the heat flow outputs from the top 5 PNNP machines in each round.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将人工神经网络映射到由聚合物网络连接的纳米颗粒组成的物理神经网络模拟模型中，探索利用热流进行信息处理的可能性。原子级模拟表明，聚合物连接的纳米颗粒网络能够通过热流实现潜在的信息处理功能。研究利用高通量分子动力学模拟和信赖域贝叶斯优化，调节聚合物连接体的塑性及纳米颗粒温度，以优化机器性能；经过5轮优化后，网络性能得到改善，并通过测试数据集验证了各轮排名前五的网络的热流输出。
authors: Xingfei Wei, Manuel Palma Banos, Rigoberto Hernandez
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.22841v1；公告类型：新提交。开发物理神经网络（PNN）硬件对于下一代人工智能系统十分重要。利用热流编码和处理信息的声子器件，是神经形态计算的解决方案之一。在本研究中，我们将一个人工神经网络（ANN）反向映射到由聚合物网络连接的纳米颗粒（PNNP）构成的物理神经网络模拟模型中。我们的原子级模拟结果表明，由聚合物连接的纳米颗粒网络有望利用热流实现信息处理。我们利用高通量分子动力学（MD）模拟和信赖域贝叶斯优化（TuRBO）方法，调节聚合物连接体的塑性以及纳米颗粒的温度，以优化PNNP机器的性能，这类似于调节人工神经网络中的权重和偏置。经过5轮高通量MD模拟后，我们表明PNNP机器的性能得到改善。我们还利用一个测试数据集，对每一轮中排名前五的PNNP机器产生的热流输出进行了验证。

articles.title: Binding Affinity between Polymer Dots (Pdots) and Ovalbumin Protein at Varying pH
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining the binding mechanisms between polymer dots and proteins is important for developing novel nanotechnologies for biomedicine and bioimaging. In this work, we use all-atom molecular dynamics simulations to determine the binding affinity of Pdots with ovalbumin protein at pH = 7 and 1. The selected Pdots are mixtures of Poly[(9,9-dioctylfluorenyl-2,7-diyl)-alt-co-(1,4-benzo-(2,1',3)-thiadiazole)] (PFBT) and poly(styrene/maleic anhydride) (PSMA) with varying composition. At pH = 7, the Pdots have a net negative charge due to the COO- functional groups on the PFBT, and the protein also has a net negative charge. At pH = 1, the Pdots are charge neutral with PFBT containing only COOH functional groups, and the protein also has a net positive charge. We sample the initial position of the protein by varying its initial position through all 6 orientations of a cube. For each orientation, we pull the protein towards the PFBT region of the Pdot. We compare the Coulombic and Lennard-Jones interaction energies for the 6 different interacting faces and two selected pH values. We find that the LJ interaction energies are similar among all 12 of these cases. The measured Coulombic interaction energies suggest that pH = 1 has better binding affinity than pH = 7. The potentials of mean force (PMF) along the pulling coordinates differ with pH. The PMFs from 2 of the 6 initial configurations at pH = 1 are negative whereas none of them are negative at pH = 7, confirming the preferred binding affinity when pH = 1. One of the faces at pH = 1 has the lowest PMF of about -30 kcal/mol, which is much lower than about 6 kcal/mol seen for the lowest case at pH = 7. Comparison of protein residue charge distributions at pH = 7 and 1 further shows that the electrostatic interaction is critical to the binding affinity, and negatively charged residues reduce at pH = 7 does not bind to negatively charged Pdot.
authors: Xingfei Wei, Wandi Xu, Kushani Mendis, Zeev Rosenzweig, Rigoberto Hernandez

articles.title: Geometry-calibrated equilibrium sensing for inverse design of nonlocal topological photonic lattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological photonic lattices are commonly designed using short-range Hamiltonians, yet realistic nanophotonic structures are governed by geometry- and wavelength-dependent long-range electromagnetic interactions. Here we introduce a geometry-calibrated quantum equilibrium-propagation framework for inference and inverse design in finite nonlocal plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices. A two-qubit equilibrium sensor is trained in effective-coupling space to distinguish boundary-localized from trivial finite-lattice responses. Because labels inherited from the nearest-neighbor SSH model become unreliable in the presence of nonlocal hopping, each sample is independently relabeled using nonlocal winding numbers and a finite-gap criterion. On this physics-verified evaluation set, the sensor achieves 99.8% sensitivity and 98.1% specificity. A physics-gated robustness score then ranks verified configurations by boundary response, response contrast, gap stability and compatibility with the selected nonlocality regime. Full-wave extinction spectra of isolated and paired gold nanoparticles establish a geometry-to-coupling calibration linking particle size and separation to wavelength-resolved pair couplings. Projecting this calibration onto the verified coupling landscape identifies a finite plasmonic geometry supporting spectrally distinct corner- and edge-dominated responses at 546 and 642 nm, with sector-to-bulk intensity contrasts of 2.4 × 10⁴ and 1.5 × 10³, respectively. The framework links realistic electromagnetic geometry to nonlocal topological design, moving beyond nearest-neighbor design rules with physics-verified, geometry-resolved inference.

articles.title: Photonic Crystal Defect Nanocavities Based on Monocrystalline Yttrium Iron Garnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monocrystalline yttrium iron garnet (YIG) is a key material for magneto optics and quantum magnonics owing to its high optical transparency, large magneto-optical (MO) effects at room temperature, and exceptionally-long spin coherence. While rich MO phenomena have been demonstrated in the microwave regime, extending these concepts to technologically important telecommunication wavelengths remains challenging due to the difficulty of fabricating high-quality YIG nanostructures. Here, we demonstrate photonic crystal (PhC) defect nanocavities based on monocrystalline Bi-substitudted YIG by developing a YIG-on-insulator platform and high-precision YIG nanopatterning. The fabricated nanocavities exhibit cavity resonances around lambda = 1500 nm with Q factors up to 1,800 and a mode volume V of 1.1(lambda/n)³, corresponding to Q/V reaching around 10³. The measured Q factor is primarily governed by intentionally introduced lattice modulations for out-of-plane light coupling, suggesting that further optimization of the cavity geometry and measurement configuration could yield an order-of-magnitude improvement of the experimental Q factor. YIG-based PhC nanocavities provide a platform for strongly confined light-magnetism interactions in the optical regime, opening pathways toward downsized nonreciprocal photonic devices and enhanced photon-magnon coupling.
authors: Kota Taniguchi, Siyuan Gao, Tatsuya Kitai, Takeru Yambe, Daisuke Sato, Hironobu Yoshimi, Satoshi Iwamoto, Yasutomo Ota

articles.title: Dynamics of an internally actuated elastic particle in a plane Poiseuille flow
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analytically analyse the dynamics of an internally actuated particle, modelled as a compressible elastic sphere embedded with a magnetic bead at its undeformed centre, translating in a plane Poiseuille flow in the Stokes limit. The particle is constrained to translate with a prescribed velocity while remaining at an arbitrary position within the flow by applying an external point force and external point torque at its undeformed centre. The governing equations for the fluid and particle are the Stokes and Navier elasticity equations, respectively. We use the series solutions to the governing equations and the domain perturbation method to capture the deformed shape of the particle, assuming α łl 1. Here, α quantifies the elastic strain induced in the particle due to the viscous stress from the fluid. The external force and external torque are obtained until O(α²⁾. The particle translating along the channel length experiences an elastic-induced hydrodynamic lift as well as hydrodynamic torque both at O(α) and O(α²⁾. The leading-order lift depends linearly on the local shear rate and on the combined effects of slip velocity and flow curvature, where the slip velocity is defined as the particle velocity relative to the local ambient flow. The particle reaches a stable equilibrium position away from the centreline, where the net lift vanishes. We show that the direction of deformation-induced lateral migration of the internally actuated particle is qualitatively distinct from that of drops, capsules, and vesicles in the Stokes limit and from that of rigid spheres undergoing inertial migration.
authors: Shashikant Verma, Prateek Anand, Navaneeth Kizhakke Marath

articles.title: A Cosmic Muon Tomography System with Machine Learning based Momentum Measurement for Multi-Object Reconstruction and Material Characterization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cosmic muon tomography is a powerful non-destructive imaging technique for inspecting dense and shielded materials through multiple Coulomb scattering. In this work, we present the design, simulation, and performance evaluation of a complete muon tomography system comprising six scintillator-strip tracking stations for trajectory reconstruction and a four-station magnetic spectrometer for muon momentum estimation. The detector geometry is implemented in the GEANT4 framework and optimized for object localization and material characterization. The reconstructed momentum is combined with the scattering angle to define the scattering density ρₛ = (θ p)²/Lₑff, which enhances sensitivity to material-dependent scattering. Point-of-Closest-Approach (PoCA) reconstruction is used to estimate scattering locations within the imaging volume. To detect and separate multiple unknown objects, Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) is applied to the reconstructed PoCA cloud. Cluster-level scattering and geometric features are then extracted for object characterization. The proposed framework enables object detection, localization, volume estimation, shape reconstruction, and material ranking within a unified analysis pipeline. Simulation studies with multiple objects of different compositions demonstrate accurate reconstruction of object positions and geometries, while providing reliable material discrimination based on scattering density. The developed system offers a scalable approach for next-generation cosmic muon tomography applications in security screening, nuclear waste characterization, and non-destructive inspection.
authors: Bharat Kumar Sirasva, Rohit Gupta, Satyajit Jena

articles.title: Model dependent analytic spin torsion corrections to Blandford Znajek energy extraction in Einstein Cartan gravity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the leading near-horizon response of Blandford-Znajek energy extraction to a compact, neutral spin-polarized source within minimally coupled Einstein-Cartan-Dirac-Maxwell theory. Eliminating the algebraic contortion yields an effective axial contact interaction, which we embed into a conserved, anisotropic phenomenological completion. Working at leading order in the torsion parameter ϵ_T, spatial anisotropy ξ, and slow rotation χ=a/M on the fixed-ADM branch, we derive the modified energy extraction rate at optimal load. We find that the leading-order power ratio Pₘ̊ BZrm EC/Pₘ̊ BZrm K receives distinct contributions from rotational dragging (ell=1) and magnetostatic flux redistribution (ell=2). In the isotropic limit (ξ=0), the power is enhanced for a co-rotating completion and suppressed for a counter-rotating one, whereas for ξ≠0 the net shift depends on the polar quadrupole response. We also formulate the generalized Znajek identity and linearized Grad--Shafranov framework, demonstrating that undetermined load-factor shifts leave the leading power coefficient invariant due to stationarity at the matched load point.
authors: Jingxu Wu, Liangyu Luo, Zhenzhou Lei, Xiao Heng

articles.title: AI Surrogate Modeling for Real-Time Tokamak Equilibrium Prediction: Benchmarking Neural Architectures and Validation on EXL-50U
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast and reliable plasma equilibrium prediction is essential for real-time tokamak operation and control, but conventional Grad-Shafranov (GS) solvers are often too costly for real-time deployment. We develop an AI surrogate framework and benchmark five architectures (MLP, CNN, FNO, Transformer, and KAN) on a numerical GS database with 100,000 IID and 10,000 OOD samples. Under a unified protocol, we evaluate accuracy, inference efficiency, model scaling, and robustness. We also establish device-level validation on the EXL-50U tokamak by linking numerical GS solutions, surrogate predictions, and the standard Shape Editor reference to assess simulation-to-device consistency. The surrogates achieve errors of 10⁻³-10⁻² relative to GS solutions, while the GS-to-device discrepancy remains at 10⁻³. Transformer gives the best IID accuracy, whereas CNN offers the best balance of accuracy, robustness, and speed, reaching 0.7 ms TensorRT latency. On unseen plasma geometries and parameter regimes, CNN and FNO show the strongest extrapolation stability, with 4%-5% relative L₂ error, while models with weaker inductive biases degrade more substantially. Scaling data and model capacity improves interpolation but not necessarily extrapolation, revealing a trade-off between capacity and OOD generalization. Overall, this work provides a systematic, device-consistent benchmark for AI-based GS prediction and practical guidance for selecting reliable surrogates for real-time plasma control and fusion applications.
authors: Guoyang Shi, Zitong Zhang, Siqi Ding, Jianguo Chen, Yapeng Zhang, Jiayi Zhi, Hanyue Zhao, Tianyuan Liu

articles.title: Quantum Hydrodynamic Framework of Coherent Terahertz Emission in MXenes Driven via Engineered Femtosecond Waveforms
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent terahertz (THz) emitters based on low dimensional quantum materials have attracted significant interest for compact broadband photonic technologies. However, theoretical descriptions that consistently connect microscopic quantum dynamics to emitted THz radiation remain limited for MXenes, whose electronic properties are governed by transition metal d orbitals and chemically tunable surface terminations. A multiscale density-matrix formalism for coherent THz generation in metallic MXenes driven by engineered three color femtosecond waveforms is developed. Material-specific electronic structures are described by parameterized multiband tight binding Hamiltonians, while ultrafast carrier dynamics are treated using a non-secular Redfield master equation that explicitly retains interband coherence, carrier populations, electron phonon interactions, impurity scattering, and environment-induced relaxation. The transient photocurrent is explicitly decomposed into population and coherence driven contributions and linked to the emitted THz field through its time derivative, establishing a direct connection between microscopic quantum dynamics and macroscopic radiation. The results show that environmental coupling does not merely attenuate THz emission, but redistributes coherent and population currents and reshapes the emitted waveform in both the time and frequency domains. Systematic investigations of optical waveform parameters, effective electronic structure, and open system relaxation identify physically grounded strategies for enhancing broadband THz generation. The proposed methodology establishes a transferable microscopic design platform for connecting material specific electronic structure, quantum coherence, open system relaxation, nonlinear carrier transport, and coherent THz emission across MXenes and related low dimensional quantum materials.
authors: Ali Asghar Molavi Choobini, Abbas Chimeh, Jinhui Zhong

articles.title: The Photon Gas in Classical Mechanics: A Statistical-Mechanical Treatment of Classical Field Theory
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The thermodynamics of cavity radiation is usually introduced through the quantum theory of a photon gas. In contrast, we investigate which features of thermal radiation follow from classical electrodynamics alone. We show, using two complementary approaches, that the proportionalities between energy density, radiation pressure, and energy flux arise without invoking photons or quantum statistics. The first approach is based on explicit solutions of Maxwell's equations and spatio-temporal averaging of electromagnetic waves. The second approach develops the classical statistical mechanics of the electromagnetic field from first principles by constructing the canonical Hamiltonian, implementing the gauge constraints, formulating the partition function as a functional integral, and evaluating the corresponding field correlation functions. By combining wave analysis, statistical mechanics, constrained Hamiltonian dynamics, and functional methods within a single classical framework, this work provides a coherent classical formulation of electromagnetic radiation thermodynamics.

articles.title: Revealing Hidden Orbital Pathways in NonThermal Hot Carrier Relaxation of MXenes via Non-Secular Redfield Quantum Kinetic
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonthermal carrier relaxation is routinely inferred from population dynamics or spectroscopic observables, yet neither class of quantity uniquely identifies the microscopic channels through which energy and coherence are redistributed. We introduce a pathway-resolved quantum kinetic framework that simultaneously projects ultrafast relaxation onto orbital populations, inter-orbital energy fluxes, coherence, spectroscopic visibility, and a hidden-pathway sector of the dynamical transfer network. Application to MXenes exposes strongly nonuniform orbital redistribution together with material specific hierarchies of microscopic transfer channels. Temperature, excitation amplitude, and dissipative parameters modulate pathway competition and spectral amplitudes while leaving the identity of the dominant channels largely intact. Instantaneous energy flux, cumulative transfer, coherence, and spectroscopic visibility are shown to follow inequivalent hierarchical orderings. This nonequivalence isolates a set of hidden pathways that remain dynamically consequential despite weak conventional spectroscopic signatures. The resulting time energy coherence representation recasts nonthermal relaxation as a structured dynamical network comprising observable and hidden sectors, thereby providing a general methodology for resolving microscopic energy-transfer pathways in driven quantum materials.
authors: Ali Asghar Molavi Choobini, Abbas Chimeh, Jinhui Zhong

articles.title: First-Principles Electron-Magnon Coupling with Machine-Learning Hamiltonians: From Band Renormalization to Transport
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In analogy to electron-phonon coupling (EPC), electron-magnon coupling (EMC) is expected to shape electronic structure, transport, and possibly unconventional superconductivity in magnetic materials. However, unlike EPC, which is now routinely treated within first-principles frameworks, a quantitative description of EMC, especially for transport, remains elusive because of the lack of theoretical formalism. Consequently, even for elemental iron, EPC-only calculations miss both the magnitude and the T² component of resistivity. This discrepancy has long been attributed to EMC, although direct computational evidence has been lacking and the underlying transport mechanism remains unresolved. Here we develop a unified first-principles formalism for EMC in collinear magnetic systems within many-body perturbation theory, complemented by machine-learning spinful Hamiltonians that supply quantities not directly accessible from conventional first-principles methods. Our framework enables ab initio transport calculations including EMC effects for the first time. Applied to ferromagnetic α-Fe, our approach yields electron spectral functions consistent with previous studies. More importantly, we recover the full T² component of resistivity with a coefficient in quantitative agreement with measurement and reveal that the T² component cannot be attributed solely to EMC, as has long been assumed, but is dominated by the strong EPC-EMC interplay. Extending to antiferromagnetic K-doped BaMn₂As₂, our method captures the ARPES-observed magnon-induced kink and a large EMC strength of sim 3 comparable to experimental measurements, demonstrating the generality of the framework. Our work closes a longstanding gap in the quantitative understanding of transport in magnetic systems and provides a predictive foundation for examining magnon-mediated phenomena.
authors: Shixu Liu, Xingding Li, Haozhe Li, Yang Zhong, Hongjun Xiang, Xin-Gao Gong, Ji-Hui Yang

articles.title: Nonlocality is the missing design rule for topological photonics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological photonics has provided powerful design rules for routing and localizing light through geometry, symmetry and engineered coupling. However, fabricated nanophotonic and plasmonic devices rarely realize only the local or short-range interaction networks assumed in compact topological models. Long-range near-field coupling, retardation, radiation leakage, substrate-assisted hybridization, material dispersion and fabrication disorder can reshape the optical modes that are interpreted as topological. In this Perspective, I argue that nonlocality should be treated as a design parameter rather than as a residual perturbation. This shift requires moving from ideal phase labels toward calibrated interaction models, finite-structure observables, robustness maps and graded confidence measures. I discuss how full-wave simulations, experiments and physics-informed learning can connect geometric design variables to effective electromagnetic interaction networks. Such calibrated workflows can clarify when a topological design rule is reliable, when it fails, and how nonlocal coupling can be exploited for robust nanophotonic devices.

articles.title: Helical jets driven by a ring of laser irradiation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasma jets are formed in various astrophysical systems as plasma is rapidly ejected from a source, with a subset of these jets being magnetized and having a helical structure. Here, we demonstrate that helical jets may be formed using a ring of laser pulses that arrive on planar foils sequentially with increasing energy. The formation of the jets and their properties, including kinetic helicity, are studied through a set of three-dimensional magneto-hydrodynamics simulations with conditions informed by the parameters of the OMEGA laser facility. We find that jets with a higher degree of helicity may be generated under realistic experimental conditions when compared to a uniform jet. Synthetic x-ray and Thomson scattering diagnostics computed from simulated data demonstrate that the helical jet provides a unique fingerprint in both its morphology and plasma parameters. This laboratory helical jet platform may allow for controlled experimental study of the dynamics of helical plasma structures and, through interaction with other jets or targets, can allow for studies of shear-driven turbulence and mixing relevant to interactions between astrophysical jets and ambient clouds or crosswind.
authors: Kian Orr, Brandon K. Russell, Kirill Lezhnin, Yang Zhang, Geoffrey Pomraning, Petros Tzeferacos, Hantao Ji, Lan Gao

articles.title: Extreme-ultraviolet spectroscopy using quantum logic: a feasibility study for singly-ionized helium
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23516v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extreme-ultraviolet (XUV) spectroscopy represents an important new direction in precision physics, with potential applications ranging from the metrology of fundamental constants to tests of physics beyond the Standard Model. However, the application of quantum control methods for precision spectroscopy remains an open challenge in the XUV range. Here we present a novel quantum logic (QL) spectroscopy method for precision spectroscopy of weak XUV transitions, and numerically validate its feasibility for the 1S-2S transition at 40.81,eV in singly-ionized helium (He⁺). We propose a scheme based on a single He⁺ ion co-trapped with a Be⁺ ion in a Paul trap, and He⁺ excitation with pairs of frequency-comb (FC) laser pulses upconverted to the XUV via High-Harmonic Generation (HHG). We investigate a nondestructive QL scheme to detect 1S-2S excitation, and compare its performance with a destructive readout based on state-selective ionization. Phase coherence of the XUV light is modelled and an optical cavity is used to filter the FC pulses prior to HHG. We model the motional excitation dynamics of trapped ions outside the Lamb-Dicke regime, and numerically validate a scheme we proposed in i̧teGrundeman to cancel the first-order Doppler broadening and the recoil shift by synchronizing the ion's secular period with the time delay between the two excitation pulses. We show that precision spectroscopy of the 1S-2S transition in He⁺ at the 10 kHz level is feasible, for improved tests of quantum electrodynamics (QED), a measurement of the Rydberg constant Rᵢₙfₜy independent of hydrogen measurements, or an improved determination of the alpha particle and helion charge radii. The proposed method may also be applied to XUV spectroscopy of other ions outside the Lamb-Dicke regime.
authors: A. Martínez de Velasco, V. P. J. Barbé, E. L. Gründeman, A. Díaz Calderon, M. Collombon, J. J. Krauth, C. F. Roth, M. Favier, R. Taieb, T. E. Mehlstäubler, P. O. Schmidt, L. S. Dreissen, K. S. E. Eikema

articles.title: A Tensor Network Framework for Interpretable Graph Analysis of Brain Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21368v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Identifying robust neurobiological signatures of brain disorders requires machine learning approaches that combine predictive performance with interpretable representations of feature interactions. Here we introduce a quantum-inspired framework based on tensor network machine learning that learns distributed representations of gray-matter features encoded in a Matrix Product State representation, a variational ansatz originally developed for quantum many-body systems. The trained model is then used not only as a classifier but to extract quantum connected correlations between features, which encode higher-order feature interactions and which we map onto a weighted graph. This construction allows us to track, within a single representation, both: (i) the global spectral properties of the network (capturing collective learning dynamics), and (ii) node-level centrality measures (providing interpretable signatures of individual brain regions). Using repeated train-test sampling schemes, we analyze two classification tasks on structural MRI data as examples of complex brain disorders: healthy controls versus schizophrenia and versus bipolar disorder. Node-level analysis identifies a stable set of gray-matter features, most prominently Heschl gyrus, insular cortex, and frontal regions, that act as hubs across multiple centrality measures and across resamplings. These centralities display lower variability across resamplings than Shapley values, supporting the interpretive value of the network representation. The bipolar feature set emerges as a subset of the schizophrenia one, consistent with the hierarchically organized neuroanatomical alterations reported in neuroimaging studies and offering a network-based characterization of this hierarchy.
authors: Domenico Pomarico, Giuseppe Magnifico, Alessandro Grecucci, Loredana Bellantuono, Jesus M. Cortes, Marianna La Rocca, Alfonso Monaco, Marlis Ontivero-Ortega, Alessandro Scarano, Massimo Stella, Roberto Bellotti, Sebastiano Stramaglia, Nicola Amoroso

articles.title: Emulating non-Markovian system-bath dynamics with parametrically driven cavities
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21569v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce and characterize a scheme for emulating non-Markovian quantum system-bath dynamics using the discrete electromagnetic field modes of a parametrically driven cavity. In this scheme, the character of a bosonic bath (the form of the bath spectral density) is tied directly to the shape of the real-time waveform describing periodic parametric cavity modulation. As an explicit example, we demonstrate the feasibility of this scheme for a fiber-loop experiment with currently achievable parameters, supported by numerical simulations and analytical estimates. In particular, we show that a localization transition of the spin-boson model can be accurately emulated in this fiber-loop cavity system. This localization effect is characterized by a sharp transition from partial decay to complete decay for a two-level system coupled to a bosonic bath as the bath spectral density J(ω)propto ωs is continously tuned from the sub-ohmic (s<1) to the super-ohmic (s>1) regime. The transition is only exactly realized in the thermodynamic limit (for an infinite number of bath modes) and for sufficiently weak system-bath coupling. We highlight a competition between the weak-coupling and thermodynamic limits in this problem and show that challenges in approximately realizing the transition can nevertheless be overcome. Finally, we provide bounds on the systematic error introduced when emulating non-Markovian dynamics for arbitrary system observables. The scheme presented here can enable the realization of a modular platform for engineering custom non-Markovian baths, with potential applications in quantum thermodynamics, thermalization of many-body systems, and resource-efficient quantum simulations of open quantum systems.
authors: Valentin Boettcher (McGill University, Montréal, Canada), Félix Pellerin (Université de Montréal, Montréal, Canada), Philippe St-Jean (Université de Montréal, Montréal, Canada), William A. Coish (McGill University, Montréal, Canada, University of Konstanz, Konstanz, Germany)

articles.title: Pair Discharges and Radio Emission from Pulsar Magnetospheres
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21920v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Radio pulsars can power their coherent radio emission through intermittent plasma discharges in magnetospheric gaps. The nonlinear coupling between particle acceleration, quantum electrodynamic (QED) processes, and electric field screening remains difficult to model self-consistently. We present an analytical concurrency model and first-principles particle-in-cell (PIC) simulations of polar cap discharges. The model predicts limit-cycle behavior where the electric field and plasma density oscillate with a frequency set by the local plasma frequency, modified by the plasma inertia. One-dimensional simulations with exact QED rates and realistic plasma parameters validate these predictions. The discharges generate pair multiplicities up to M_± sim 10⁴ and excite electric field oscillations with spectra consistent with pulsar radio microstructure. These results provide a theoretical framework connecting microphysical gap dynamics to macroscopic observables.

articles.title: Pair Discharges and Radio Emission from Millisecond-Pulsar and White-Dwarf Magnetospheres
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22027v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coherent radio emission is observed from compact astrophysical objects with relatively weak magnetic fields, including millisecond pulsars and white dwarfs, the latter being proposed as possible sources of long-period radio transients. In such environments, the standard pair discharge mechanism---driven by curvature radiation and one-photon pair production---can fail because the low magnetic field strength suppresses photon conversion.
