articles.abstract: Transformer models pre-trained on sensory stimuli such as vision and audition have been shown to capture neural representations and to effectively predict brain responses to corresponding stimuli. Olfactory perception, however, remains a relatively underexplored sensory modality in this context. Understanding the alignment between chemical transformer models and brain activity during olfactory processing is particularly challenging due to the distributed nature of olfactory neural processing and the inherently subjective character of olfactory experience, which is strongly shaped by individual memory and prior exposure. In this work, we evaluate the representational alignment between pre-trained transformer models of chemical structure and functional magnetic resonance imaging recordings collected from human participants during olfactory perception. Using voxel-wise encoding models, we show that representations extracted from state-of-the-art molecular transformers exhibit strong alignment with olfactory brain responses, often exceeding handcrafted molecular fingerprints and physicochemical descriptors. We further analyze how this alignment varies across brain regions, model layers, and temporal response components, revealing distinct region-specific and temporal patterns. These findings represent a step toward understanding how that pre-trained chemical transformers capture meaningful structure relevant to human olfactory perception and provide insight into how molecular features relate to neural processing in the olfactory system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估了化学结构Transformer模型表征与人类嗅觉感知功能磁共振成像信号之间的一致性。基于体素层面的编码模型，研究发现先进分子Transformer提取的表征与嗅觉脑反应具有较强一致性，且通常优于人工设计的分子指纹和理化描述符。进一步分析揭示了这种一致性在不同脑区、模型层和时间响应成分之间存在差异。
authors: Farzaneh Taleb, Fahimeh Darki, Miguel Vasco, Antonio H Ribeiro, Nona Rajabi, Mariya Toneva, Johan N Lundström and Danica Kragic
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在视觉和听觉等感官刺激上进行预训练的Transformer模型，已被证明能够捕捉神经表征，并有效预测大脑对相应刺激的反应。然而，在这一研究背景下，嗅觉仍是相对缺乏探索的感官模态。理解化学Transformer模型与嗅觉加工过程中脑活动之间的一致性尤其具有挑战性，这是因为嗅觉神经加工具有分布式特征，而且嗅觉体验本质上具有主观性，并受到个体记忆和既往接触经历的强烈塑造。在本研究中，我们评估了预训练化学结构Transformer模型与人类参与者在嗅觉感知过程中采集的功能磁共振成像记录之间的表征一致性。利用逐体素编码模型，我们表明，当前最先进的分子Transformer所提取的表征与嗅觉脑反应表现出较强的一致性，并且通常超过人工设计的分子指纹和理化描述符。我们进一步分析了这种一致性如何随脑区、模型层以及时间响应成分而变化，并揭示了具有区域特异性和时间特异性的不同模式。这些发现是理解预训练化学Transformer如何捕捉与人类嗅觉感知相关的有意义结构的一步，也为分子特征如何关联到嗅觉系统中的神经加工提供了见解。

articles.title: TopoHSE-DB: a topological materials database for generative and predictive models
articles.title_zh: TopoHSE-DB：面向生成模型和预测模型的拓扑材料数据库
articles.abstract: We introduce TopoHSE-DB, a dataset of topological classifications for non-magnetic crystalline materials computed using the screened hybrid functional HSE06, which incorporates a fraction of exact Hartree–Fock exchange. While previous high-throughput catalogs of topological materials (TMs) have predominantly relied on semi-local exchange–correlation functionals, our workflow uses a consistent set of relaxed structures for electronic-structure calculations performed with both semi-local and hybrid functionals. The resulting electronic structures are analyzed within the topological quantum chemistry formalism to assign materials to topological classes. Comparison with semi-local classifications shows that the predicted topological character is highly sensitive to the exchange–correlation functional, with HS assigning a smaller fraction of materials to nontrivial topological classes. In a benchmark of 20 experimentally reported TMs, PBE and HS retained 70% and 40%, respectively. These retention rates highlight the limitations of comparing ideal-bulk, symmetry-based classifications directly with heterogeneous experimental reports. TopoHSE-DB provides a systematically generated resource for training generative and predictive models aimed at the discovery and design of new TMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了TopoHSE-DB，这是一个利用包含部分精确Hartree–Fock交换的屏蔽杂化泛函HSE06计算得到的非磁性晶体材料拓扑分类数据集。研究表明，预测的拓扑性质对交换-相关泛函高度敏感，采用杂化泛函时被归入非平庸拓扑类别的材料比例更低。该数据库为训练用于发现和设计新拓扑材料的生成模型与预测模型提供了系统化资源。
authors: Hossein Mirhosseini, Luis Elcoro, Andreas Knüpfer and Thomas D Kühne
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍TopoHSE-DB，这是一个针对非磁性晶体材料的拓扑分类数据集，其分类结果采用包含一定比例精确Hartree–Fock交换的屏蔽杂化泛函HSE06计算得到。以往的拓扑材料高通量目录主要依赖半局域交换-相关泛函，而我们的工作流程使用一套一致的弛豫结构，分别通过半局域泛函和杂化泛函进行电子结构计算。随后，我们在拓扑量子化学形式体系下分析所得电子结构，并将材料分配到相应的拓扑类别。与半局域泛函分类结果的比较表明，预测的拓扑性质对交换-相关泛函高度敏感；使用HSE泛函时，被分配到非平庸拓扑类别的材料比例更低。在包含20种实验报道拓扑材料的基准测试中，PBE和HSE分别保留了70%和40%的材料。上述保留率凸显了这样一个局限：不能将基于理想体材料和对称性的分类结果直接与异质性的实验报道进行比较。TopoHSE-DB提供了一个系统生成的资源，可用于训练旨在发现和设计新拓扑材料的生成模型和预测模型。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文构建了基于HSE06杂化泛函和拓扑量子化学分类的非磁性晶体拓扑材料数据库，并系统比较了半局域泛函与杂化泛函对拓扑判定的影响。结果表明，拓扑性质对交换-相关泛函较为敏感，HSE06筛选出的非平凡拓扑材料比例和实验材料保留率均低于PBE。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的高通量第一性原理计算、电子结构分析、拓扑磁性及材料信息学方向相关。该数据库和泛函敏感性分析可为拓扑材料筛选、机器学习数据集构建以及高精度电子结构预测提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合团队发展的图神经网络或机器学习哈密顿量，建立从PBE到HSE06拓扑分类的快速校正模型。也可将筛选扩展到磁性、交替磁性和自旋轨道耦合体系。

articles.title: Criticality in Neural Network Function Space through Wilsonian Fixed Points and Finite-Width Corrections
articles.title_zh: 通过威尔逊固定点与有限宽度修正研究神经网络函数空间中的临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks can be studied not only as parameterized computational models but also as probability distributions over functions. In this paper we develop a Wilsonian interpretation of criticality in the neural network-quantum field theory correspondence, treating the infinite width Gaussian-process limit as a free field fixed point and finite width corrections as perturbations that create non-Gaussian interactions. In this way, we do not see the departure from infinite width as a small approximation error but as the process by which interaction, complexity, expressivity and phase-like behaviour enter neural network function space. Width, depth, activation nonlinearity, initialization variance, and training dynamics are considered as control parameters that change the effective action of the network ensemble. The critical regime is when the higher-order connected correlation functions become non-negligible, and when the finite width operators become relevant or marginal scaling factors, and when the function distribution becomes sensitive to scale-dependent structure. There we can view overparameterization as suppressing a relationship of interacting terms and we find that the critical structure of finite neural networks is given by finite-width effects. This framework is a theoretical basis for studying trainability, generalization, and architectural universality of neural network functions through Wilsonian fixed points, perturbations, and critical surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将神经网络视为函数上的概率分布，并在神经网络—量子场论对应关系中建立临界性的威尔逊式解释。无限宽度的高斯过程极限被视为自由场固定点，而有限宽度修正则作为产生非高斯相互作用的扰动。研究将宽度、深度、激活函数非线性、初始化方差和训练动力学视为控制参数，用以分析可训练性、泛化能力和神经网络函数的架构普适性。
authors: Eric Howard, Iftekher S. Chowdhury, Hardique Dasore, Hom Nath Dhungana
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经网络不仅可以被研究为参数化的计算模型，也可以被研究为定义在函数上的概率分布。在本文中，我们在神经网络—量子场论对应关系中建立了对临界性的威尔逊式解释，将无限宽度的高斯过程极限视为自由场固定点，并将有限宽度修正视为产生非高斯相互作用的扰动。通过这种方式，我们不再把偏离无限宽度看作一个小的近似误差，而是将其视为相互作用、复杂性、表达能力以及类似相变的行为进入神经网络函数空间的过程。我们将宽度、深度、激活函数的非线性、初始化方差和训练动力学视为控制参数，它们会改变网络系综的有效作用量。当高阶连通相关函数变得不可忽略、有限宽度算子成为相关或边缘的标度因子，并且函数分布对依赖尺度的结构变得敏感时，系统处于临界区域。在这一框架下，我们可以将过参数化看作对相互作用项之间某种关系的抑制，并发现有限神经网络的临界结构由有限宽度效应决定。该框架为通过威尔逊固定点、扰动和临界面研究神经网络函数的可训练性、泛化能力以及架构普适性提供了理论基础。

articles.title: Graphon Spin Systems as Exactly Solvable Models
articles.title_zh: 作为精确可解模型的图子旋量系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graphons are measurable functions used to describe the asymptotic behavior of convergent graph families. Originally motivated by problems in combinatorics and graph theory, graphons have found numerous applications in the modeling and analysis of dynamical processes on networks. In this work, we use graphons to formulate the Ising model on convergent graph sequences, which include many network topologies common in applications. We derive the mean-field limit for the resulting model and obtain exact results for phase transitions in such systems. Specifically, we show that the critical temperatures of the Ising model on graphons are determined by the eigenvalues of the Hilbert-Schmidt operator associated with the graph limit. For many important network topologies, these eigenvalues can be computed explicitly. We illustrate our results with three representative random network models: Erdős-Rényi, small-world, and power-law. In the small-world case, we demonstrate phase transitions to both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic phases, as well as coexistence of local minima of the free energy. The latter gives rise to multistability, as confirmed by Monte Carlo simulations. The results of this work demonstrate that the Ising model on graphons combines the analytical tractability of exactly solvable mean-field models with the ability to accommodate a broad range of network topologies. We expect that the use of graphons in spin models will lead to new insights into the statistical physics of interacting systems on complex networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用图子描述收敛图序列上的伊辛模型，并推导了相应模型的平均场极限与相变精确结果。研究表明，图子上的伊辛模型临界温度由与图极限相关的希尔伯特–施密特算子的特征值决定，并以Erdős–Rényi网络、小世界网络和幂律网络为例进行了说明。该模型兼具精确可解平均场模型的解析可处理性和适应多种复杂网络拓扑的能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图子是用于描述收敛图族渐近行为的可测函数。图子最初由组合学和图论问题推动发展，如今已广泛应用于网络上动力学过程的建模与分析。在本研究中，我们利用图子在收敛图序列上建立伊辛模型，而这些图序列包含许多应用中常见的网络拓扑。我们推导了所得模型的平均场极限，并获得了此类系统相变的精确结果。具体而言，我们证明，图子上伊辛模型的临界温度由与图极限相关的希尔伯特–施密特算子的特征值决定。对于许多重要的网络拓扑，这些特征值可以显式计算。我们以三种具有代表性的随机网络模型说明所得结果：Erdős–Rényi网络、小世界网络和幂律网络。在小世界网络情形中，我们展示了向铁磁相和反铁磁相的相变，以及自由能局部极小值共存的现象。后者会产生多稳态，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟得到了验证。本研究结果表明，图子上的伊辛模型将精确可解平均场模型的解析可处理性，与容纳广泛网络拓扑的能力结合起来。我们预计，在自旋模型中使用图子将为复杂网络上相互作用系统的统计物理学带来新的认识。

articles.title: One-dimensional Polar Spinor Droplets
articles.title_zh: 一维极性自旋量子液滴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a channel-resolved Lee-Huang-Yang correction and construct an extended GrossPitaevskii model for one-dimensional polar spin-1 quantum droplets. The fluctuation contribution separates into density and spin channels, which supports self-bound droplets even when the spinindependent mean-field interaction is repulsive. Stationary solutions exhibit a continuous crossover from soliton-like to flat-top droplets, accompanied by saturation of the chemical potential and peak density as the particle number increases. Within the parameter range examined here, linear Bogoliubov analysis together with weak-perturbation dynamics supports the stability of both droplet types. A quadratic-Zeeman quench reveals a finite-size crossover in breathing dynamics and distinct nonequilibrium roles of the density and spin fluctuation channels. Representative head-on collisions further show that the finite-size crossover modulates phase-sensitive nonlinear scattering, with in-phase impact producing coalescence-like central retention and out-of-phase impact favoring quasi-elastic separation. The analysis clarifies how density and spin fluctuations shape equilibrium structure and nonequilibrium response in low-dimensional polar spinor droplets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了通道分辨的一维Lee–Huang–Yang修正，并构建了极性自旋-1量子液滴的扩展Gross–Pitaevskii模型。涨落贡献分为密度通道和自旋通道，即使自旋无关的平均场相互作用具有排斥性，也能支持自束缚液滴。研究还分析了液滴从类孤子到平顶结构的连续转变、稳定性、呼吸动力学及碰撞中的相位敏感非线性散射。
authors: Hao Zhu, Wen-Kai Bai, Yi-Ran Shen, Xiao-Fei Zhang, Wu-Ming Liu, Boris A. Malomed
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导了通道分辨的Lee–Huang–Yang修正，并构建了一个描述一维极性自旋-1量子液滴的扩展Gross–Pitaevskii模型。涨落贡献分解为密度通道和自旋通道；即使自旋无关的平均场相互作用是排斥性的，这种分解仍支持自束缚液滴。稳态解表现出从类孤子液滴到平顶液滴的连续交叉转变；随着粒子数增加，化学势和峰值密度趋于饱和。在本文考察的参数范围内，线性Bogoliubov分析与弱扰动动力学共同支持两类液滴的稳定性。二次Zeeman猝灭揭示了呼吸动力学中的有限尺寸交叉，以及密度和自旋涨落通道在非平衡过程中的不同作用。具有代表性的正面碰撞进一步表明，有限尺寸交叉会调制依赖相位的非线性散射：同相碰撞会产生类似聚并的中心滞留，而反相碰撞则倾向于准弹性分离。这些分析阐明了密度涨落和自旋涨落如何塑造低维极性自旋量子液滴的平衡结构与非平衡响应。

articles.title: Conservation capacity of local learning rules in physical networks
articles.title_zh: 物理网络中局部学习规则的守恒容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How many memories can a local learning rule protect, and what fixes the number? Physical learning rules train resistive networks through local measurements, and the standard rules conserve a mass-like function of the conductances, a law whose general form was posed as an open problem with the expectation that no useful solution theory exists. We answer it, in the direction the expectation ran against, and the answer is a capacity theory. The Tellegen identity behind the conserved mass localizes: the feedback state is pinned to zero at the inputs, so every sector of the circuit that the input electrodes separate carries its own private conserved mass, by an argument consuming only Kirchhoff's law and that boundary condition, hence valid for arbitrary nonlinear branch laws. The number of independent sector masses is a topological property of the circuit, bounded by the number of output electrodes. An untrainable element can destroy the mass of its own sector and of no other, which says where fixed nonlinear components may be placed; per-edge learning rates select which functionals are conserved and never how many; and adjoint coupled learning, which clamps its outputs before measuring, drains every output-carrying sector at a rate set by the squared output multipliers. In linear circuits we then classify the identities: exact rational computation over all 502 circuits on up to five vertices with two inputs and one or two outputs, and hundreds of larger ones, yields a closed-form count, proved on that family and conjectured in general, with the sector statement a theorem at every circuit size. The anticipated series-parallel polynomial laws appear as exactly the series-class cubic differences, and the number the opening question asks for is a budget: one designed mass per sector, the differences the topology donates, and one broadcast scalar for each protected functional beyond.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究局部学习规则能够保护多少记忆，以及这一容量由什么决定。作者证明，Tellegen恒等式所对应的守恒质量可以在输入电极分隔出的每个电路区域中局部化，因此独立守恒质量的数量是电路的拓扑性质，并受输出电极数量约束。在线性电路中，作者进一步对这些守恒恒等式进行分类，并提出了由拓扑决定的记忆容量理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 局部学习规则能够保护多少记忆，这一数量由什么决定？物理学习规则通过局部测量训练电阻网络，而标准规则会守恒一个与电导相关、类似质量的函数；这一守恒定律的一般形式曾被作为一个开放问题提出，并且人们预期不存在有用的解理论。我们解决了这个问题，而且所得答案与上述预期相反：它是一种容量理论。守恒质量背后的Tellegen恒等式可以实现局部化：反馈状态在输入端被固定为零，因此输入电极分隔出的电路每个区域都具有自己的私有守恒质量；这一论证只使用基尔霍夫定律和该边界条件，所以对任意非线性支路定律都成立。独立扇区质量的数量是电路的拓扑性质，并且受输出电极数量的上界约束。一个不可训练元件可以破坏其所在扇区的质量，但不会破坏其他扇区的质量，这说明了固定非线性元件可以放置在何处；逐边学习率能够选择哪些泛函被守恒，却永远不能改变守恒泛函的数量；而伴随耦合学习在测量之前钳制其输出，并以由输出乘子平方决定的速率耗散每个承载输出的扇区。在此基础上，对于线性电路，我们对这些恒等式进行了分类：通过对全部502个包含不超过五个顶点、具有两个输入和一个或两个输出的电路，以及数百个更大电路进行精确有理数计算，我们得到一个闭式计数公式；该公式已在这一电路族上得到证明，并被猜想可推广到一般情形，而关于扇区的结论则在任意电路规模下都是定理。预期中的串并联多项式规律，恰好表现为串联类的三次差分；开头问题所询问的数量是一种预算：每个扇区有一个经过设计的质量，拓扑提供相应的差分，而对于每个超出部分且受到保护的泛函，还需要一个广播标量。

articles.title: The friction-era VOS amplitude of a Z₂ string network from nematic disclination data
articles.title_zh: 由向列相缺陷数据确定Z₂弦网络摩擦时代的VOS振幅
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A tangle of line defects coarsens as the mean spacing L between neighbouring lines grows. In a viscous medium the motion is overdamped, and the velocity-dependent one-scale (VOS) model predicts a late-time attractor L²=A,ell_d,t, with ell_d=T/Γ the ratio of line tension to drag and A a dimensionless amplitude. The growth law Lpropto t¹/² holds for every value of the three model parameters---the momentum parameter kłe1, the sink coefficient tildec, and the curvature ratio λequiv R/L---since all three enter only through A=κ(κ+tildec), κequiv k/λ. Thus, the exponent constrains none of them, and the amplitude is the only quantity a density history can deliver. We measure it from the disclination data of Chuang, Turok and Yurke on a nematic liquid crystal, whose companion measurement of loop collapse fixes ell_d on the same samples, canceling the 5CB material constants. Treating the unmatched per-quench ell_d as a nuisance parameter with a Gaussian prior and marginalizing it analytically, we obtain A=10.0⁺¹.³₋₁.₁ from the three quenches in the 234~μm cell; the fourth, the only one in the thinner 158~μm cell, gives A=3.0⁺⁰.⁸₋₀.₆ and is fitted separately. Converting either into tildec requires λ, which these data do not determine, so the result is a curve, tildec(λ)=Aλ/k-k/λ, not a number. At λ=1 with kłe1 they give tildecge9.0 and tildecge2.0, against tildec=0.23--0.57 from relativistic U(1) simulations, values reached only at λsimeq0.33--0.35 and 0.62--0.68. We know of no VOS calibration for a cosmological Z₂ network, so we cannot attribute the excess to topology, and we list what a repeat experiment must measure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用向列液晶中的位错数据测量Z₂弦网络在摩擦主导时代的VOS振幅。对234微米液槽中三次淬火的联合分析得到振幅约为10.0，158微米液槽中的一次淬火则给出约为3.0；但将其转换为汇系数仍需曲率比这一未被数据确定的参数。作者指出，现有数据不足以判断异常偏大是否源于拓扑差异，并提出了重复实验需要测量的量。
authors: Dimitrios Efstratiou, Evangelos Achilleas Paraskevas, Leandros Perivolaropoulos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一团线缺陷会发生粗化，相邻线之间的平均间距L随之增大。在黏性介质中，运动是过阻尼的，而速度依赖的一尺度模型（VOS模型）预言晚期吸引子满足L²=Aℓ_dt，其中ℓ_d=T/Γ是线张力与阻力之比，A是无量纲振幅。对于三个模型参数的任意取值，即动量参数k≤1、汇系数c以及曲率比λ≡R/L，增长定律L∝t¹/²都成立，因为这三个参数只通过A=κ(κ+c)进入，其中κ≡k/λ。因此，增长指数不能约束其中任何一个参数，而振幅是密度历史唯一能够给出的量。我们利用Chuang、Turok和Yurke在向列液晶中的位错数据测量该振幅；他们对环坍缩的配套测量确定了同一批样品中的ℓ_d，从而消去了5CB材料常数。我们将每次淬火中不匹配的ℓ_d视为具有高斯先验的干扰参数，并对其进行解析边缘化；由234微米液槽中的三次淬火得到A=10.0，上误差为1.3、下误差为1.1；第四次淬火是唯一一次在较薄的158微米液槽中进行的实验，得到A=3.0，上误差为0.8、下误差为0.6，因此被单独拟合。将任一结果转换为c都需要λ，而这些数据无法确定λ，所以结果是一条曲线c(λ)=Aλ/k-k/λ，而不是一个确定数值。当λ=1且k≤1时，两组结果分别给出c≥9.0和c≥2.0，这与相对论U(1)模拟得到的c=0.23–0.57形成对比；后者只有在λ约为0.33–0.35和0.62–0.68时才能达到。我们不知道有针对宇宙学Z₂网络的VOS标定，因此不能将这一过量归因于拓扑，并列出了重复实验必须测量的内容。

articles.title: Carrier Capture at Defects from Finite-Temperature Lattice Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 有限温度晶格动力学中的缺陷载流子俘获
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defect-assisted carrier capture is commonly described within nonradiative multiphonon (NMP) theory using normal modes of the equilibrium defect structure. This description becomes inadequate when finite-temperature lattice fluctuations explore configurations that cannot be represented by a fixed normal-mode basis. Here, we present a trajectory-based method for calculating carrier capture rate from first principles, which allows lattice relaxation and electron--lattice coupling matrix element to be reconstructed directly from correlation functions of finite-temperature lattice dynamics. For hole capture at C_N in GaN within harmonic regime, the method reproduces static NMP results including mode mixing and agrees with experiment. For oxygen vacancy in SiO₂, by contrast, the thermally sampled potential energy surface is substantially softer than the zero-temperature normal-mode harmonic expansion, strongly modifying the lattice relaxation and electron--lattice coupling, and producing pronounced changes in both the capture coefficient and its temperature dependence. These results establish the finite-temperature configurational ensemble, rather than phonon occupations alone, as an essential ingredient of defect-assisted carrier capture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于有限温度晶格动力学轨迹、从第一性原理计算载流子俘获速率的方法。该方法能够直接从相关函数重建晶格弛豫和电子—晶格耦合矩阵元。在GaN中的C_N空位体系中，该方法再现了静态非辐射多声子理论的结果并符合实验；而在SiO₂氧空位中，有限温度采样到的势能面明显比零温简正模近似更软，显著改变了俘获系数及其温度依赖性。
authors: Menglin Huang, Shanshan Wang, Shiyou Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 缺陷辅助载流子俘获通常在非辐射多声子理论（NMP）框架下描述，并使用平衡缺陷结构的简正模。当有限温度下的晶格涨落探索到无法用固定简正模基组表示的构型时，这种描述便不再充分。在这里，我们提出一种基于轨迹、从第一性原理计算载流子俘获速率的方法；该方法允许直接从有限温度晶格动力学的相关函数中重建晶格弛豫和电子—晶格耦合矩阵元。对于谐性区域内GaN中C_N缺陷的空穴俘获，该方法再现了包括模态混合在内的静态NMP结果，并与实验相符。相比之下，对于SiO₂中的氧空位，热采样得到的势能面明显比零温简正模谐性展开更为柔软，从而显著改变了晶格弛豫和电子—晶格耦合，并使俘获系数及其温度依赖性发生显著变化。这些结果表明，对于缺陷辅助载流子俘获而言，有限温度构型系综，而不仅仅是声子占据数，是一个不可或缺的因素。

articles.title: Quantum critical behavior in chains of hindered dipolar planar rotors
articles.title_zh: 受阻偶极平面转子链中的量子临界行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the ground-state properties of linear chains of dipolar planar rotors hindered by a six-fold on-site potential, a model motivated by water molecules confined in the hexagonal cavities of beryl. Using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations, we locate the quantum phase transition between the disordered and ferroelectrically ordered phases using the von Neumann entanglement entropy and the Binder ratio of the polarization. A sweep of the six-fold pinning strength shows that increasing hindrance shifts the critical dipolar coupling gc to smaller values. These results suggest that crystal-field hindrance can promote, rather than suppress, dipolar ordering. This work has implications for ferroelectricity and quantum-device tuning in confined molecular rotors
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了受六重现场势限制的偶极平面转子线性链基态性质，该模型受到受限于绿柱石六边形孔洞中的水分子启发。利用密度矩阵重整化群计算，作者通过冯·诺伊曼纠缠熵和极化Binder比定位无序相与铁电有序相之间的量子相变。结果表明，增强六重钉扎会使临界偶极耦合移向更小值，说明晶场阻碍可能促进而非抑制偶极有序。
authors: Wenxue Zhang, Muhammad Shaeer Moeed, Estevao De Oliveira, Hui Li, Pierre-Nicholas Roy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了受六重现场势限制的偶极平面转子线性链的基态性质；该模型的动机来源于受限在绿柱石六边形孔洞中的水分子。利用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算，我们通过冯·诺伊曼纠缠熵和极化的Binder比确定了无序相与铁电有序相之间的量子相变。对六重钉扎强度进行扫描表明，随着阻碍增强，临界偶极耦合g_c会移向更小的数值。这些结果表明，晶场阻碍能够促进而非抑制偶极有序。这项工作对受限分子转子体系中的铁电性和量子器件调控具有启示意义。

articles.title: PT and anti-PT phase transitions in a trimerized Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chain with nonreciprocal Rashba spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有非互易Rashba自旋轨道耦合的三聚化Su–Schrieffer–Heeger链中的PT与反PT相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate a one-dimensional trimerized Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chain with three sublattices per unit cell subjected to a nonreciprocal Rashba spin-orbit coupling. Invoking a spin-flip symmetry, the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian decomposes into two independent spin sectors, enabling a spin-resolved analysis of non-Hermitian skin effects and system symmetries. We identify a rich phase diagram consisting of four bulk phases and two edge-state phases. The bulk phases include fully PT-unbroken (real-spectrum) and fully anti-PT-unbroken (imaginary-spectrum) regimes, as well as two mixed phases where one band remains on the real or imaginary axis while the other two form complex-conjugate pairs. The two edge-state phases correspond to topological edge modes with either PT-unbroken (real) or anti-PT-unbroken (imaginary) energies. Using non-Bloch band theory and Cardano's method, we derive closed-form expressions for phase boundaries and establish the bulk-edge correspondence for each spin sector. Calculations of Berry phase and directional inverse participation ratios confirm our analytical predictions. Our results provide a minimal platform for realizing spin-resolved non-Hermitian topology and edge-selective symmetry preservation, in which the bulk and edge states belong to distinct symmetry classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了具有三个子晶格、并受到非互易Rashba自旋轨道耦合的一维三聚化Su–Schrieffer–Heeger链。借助自旋翻转对称性，非厄米哈密顿量可分解为两个独立自旋扇区，从而能够分别分析非厄米皮肤效应和系统对称性。研究得到包含四种体相和两种边缘态相的丰富相图，并利用非布洛赫能带理论与Cardano方法推导相边界，建立各自旋扇区的体边对应关系。
authors: Milad Jangjan, Linhu Li, Longwen Zhou, Mir Vahid Hosseini
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们理论研究了一个一维三聚化Su–Schrieffer–Heeger链，该链每个晶胞包含三个子晶格，并受到非互易Rashba自旋轨道耦合。利用自旋翻转对称性，非厄米哈密顿量可以分解为两个相互独立的自旋扇区，从而能够对非厄米皮肤效应和系统对称性进行自旋分辨分析。我们确定了一个丰富的相图，其中包含四种体相和两种边缘态相。体相包括完全PT未破缺的实谱区域、完全反PT未破缺的虚谱区域，以及两种混合相；在混合相中，一个能带保持在实轴或虚轴上，而另外两个能带形成复共轭对。两种边缘态相分别对应具有PT未破缺实能量和反PT未破缺虚能量的拓扑边缘模。利用非布洛赫能带理论和Cardano方法，我们推导了相边界的闭式表达式，并为每个自旋扇区建立了体边对应关系。Berry相和方向性逆参与率的计算证实了我们的解析预言。我们的结果提供了一个实现自旋分辨非厄米拓扑和边缘选择性对称性保持的最小平台，其中体态和边缘态属于不同的对称性类别。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文研究具有非互易Rashba自旋轨道耦合的三聚化SSH链，分析其PT和反PT相变、非厄米皮肤效应及拓扑边缘态。作者利用非布洛赫能带理论和解析方法建立了不同自旋扇区的相图及体边对应关系。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的自旋轨道耦合、有效电子哈密顿量、拓扑材料和自旋相关性质存在一定联系，但该工作主要是理想一维非厄米模型，缺少团队重点关注的真实材料、第一性原理模拟和材料设计内容。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可将该模型推广到真实二维磁性或拓扑材料异质结构，并通过第一性原理构造含自旋轨道耦合和非厄米项的有效哈密顿量。若关注团队主线，可优先研究具有非互易输运、磁性边缘态或光激发拓扑转变的材料体系。

articles.title: Interplay of nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交错磁体中非相对论与相对论自旋劈裂的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite their compensated magnetic moments, altermagnets (AMs) exhibit nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) that offers routes to spintronic functionality without relying on relativistic spin-orbit coupling. However, how NRSS influences relativistic phenomena remains largely unexplored. Here we show that NRSS plays a crucial role in reshaping the Rashba effect in AMs with broken inversion symmetry. Using a tight-binding model, we demonstrate that Rashba spin splitting, whose magnitude is typically limited by the strength of spin-orbit coupling, is governed by NRSS energy scales. The resulting Rashba bands combined with NRSS generate anomalously large charge-to-spin conversion with a Néel-vector-tunable spin polarization. First-principles calculations for the noncentrosymmetric AM GdAlSi corroborate the emergence of these effects in a real system. Our results reveal the interplay between nonrelativistic and relativistic effects in AMs and identify them as fertile platforms for spin-orbitronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管交错磁体的磁矩相互补偿，它们仍表现出不依赖相对论效应的非相对论自旋劈裂，为无需依赖相对论自旋轨道耦合的自旋电子学功能提供了路径。本文表明，在破缺反演对称性的交错磁体中，非相对论自旋劈裂会重塑Rashba效应，并使其强度由非相对论自旋劈裂的能量尺度控制。紧束缚模型和GdAlSi第一性原理计算均显示，这种机制能够产生异常大的电荷到自旋转换及可由Néel矢量调控的自旋极化。
authors: Daegeun Jo, Peter M. Oppeneer, Mohsen Yarmohammadi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管具有相互补偿的磁矩，交错磁体仍表现出非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS），这为实现不依赖相对论自旋轨道耦合的自旋电子学功能提供了途径。然而，NRSS如何影响相对论现象，仍未得到充分探索。在这里，我们表明，在反演对称性破缺的交错磁体中，NRSS在重塑Rashba效应方面发挥着关键作用。利用紧束缚模型，我们证明，Rashba自旋劈裂的大小通常受自旋轨道耦合强度限制，但在此处却由NRSS的能量尺度控制。由此形成的Rashba能带与NRSS结合，会产生异常大的电荷到自旋转换，并具有可由Néel矢量调控的自旋极化。针对非中心对称交错磁体GdAlSi的第一性原理计算证实了这些效应在真实体系中的出现。我们的结果揭示了交错磁体中非相对论效应与相对论效应之间的相互作用，并指出交错磁体是实现自旋轨道电子学应用的有前景平台。

articles.title: Perspectives on Magnetic/Superconductor Hybrid Systems: Long-range Electromagnetic Phenomena Induced by Proximity Effect and Interfacial Spin-orbit Coupling
articles.title_zh: 磁体/超导体杂化系统展望：邻近效应与界面自旋轨道耦合诱导的长程电磁现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this Perspective we review recent achievements in physics and applications of hybrid superconductor-ferromagnet structures. In particular, we focus on the manifestations of the electromagnetic phenomena in these systems originating from the response of the induced superconducting correlations modified by the exchange field and additional effects coming from the interface Rashba-type spin-orbit coupling. The review includes the long-range electromagnetic proximity effect and related modification of magnetic textures, spontaneous currents, properties of vortex matter and its interaction with magnetic ordering, spin-galvanic, photogalvanic and nonreciprocal transport phenomena in exemplary hybrid systems. We also present our views on the future development of this field including both the theoretical challenges and promising opportunities for fundamental experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了超导体—铁磁体杂化结构的物理和应用进展，重点关注交换场和界面Rashba型自旋轨道耦合修饰诱导超导关联所产生的电磁现象。内容涵盖长程电磁邻近效应、磁性织构调控、自发电流、涡旋物质及其与磁有序的相互作用，以及自旋回旋、光回旋和非互易输运现象。文章还讨论了该领域未来的理论挑战和基础实验机会。
authors: S. V. Mironov, A. S. Mel'nikov, A. I. Buzdin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们综述了超导体—铁磁体杂化结构物理学与应用方面的最新进展。特别是，我们关注这些体系中的电磁现象：这些现象源于诱导超导关联的响应，而该响应受到交换场的修饰，并受到界面Rashba型自旋轨道耦合所产生的额外效应影响。综述内容包括长程电磁邻近效应及其相关的磁性织构修饰、自发电流、涡旋物质的性质及其与磁有序的相互作用，以及示例性杂化体系中的自旋回旋、光回旋和非互易输运现象。我们还提出了对该领域未来发展的看法，其中包括理论挑战和基础实验的潜在机遇。

articles.title: Machine Learning Guided Discovery of Corundum High Entropy Oxides
articles.title_zh: 机器学习引导的刚玉型高熵氧化物发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Early thinking in the field of high entropy oxides (HEOs) emphasized their likely abundance, with combinatorial arguments hinting at a myriad of new materials. The experimental reality has proven more challenging: the stability of HEOs cannot be straightforwardly predicted based on ionic radii, lattice geometry, and charge-balancing considerations alone. In this work, we employ machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) to predict the synthesizability of HEOs of the form A₂O₃ derived from a selection of trivalent cations. From nearly 500 possible compositions, we identify 16 promising candidates for experimental validation with solid-state and combustion synthesis. We discover three new HEOs in the corundum structure, including (Al,Cr,Fe,Rh,Sc)₂O₃, and one novel cation-ordered phase, (Al,Fe,Ga,Sc)₂O₃. By far the most common synthesis outcome was a mixture of competing phases, sometimes involving redox reactions. Our results also reveal profound synthesis method dependence for the final product, where qualitatively equivalent outcomes between the two synthesis methods were only observed for 3 of the 16 tested compositions. We conclude that the occurrence rate of HEOs is far rarer than initially believed and that machine learning approaches can effectively guide us to the "needle in the haystack".
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用机器学习原子间势预测由三价阳离子构成的A₂O₃型高熵氧化物的可合成性，并从近500种组成中筛选出16种候选物进行实验验证。研究发现了3种刚玉结构的新型高熵氧化物，包括（Al、Cr、Fe、Rh、Sc）₂O₃，以及一种新颖的阳离子有序相（Al、Fe、Ga、Sc）₂O₃。结果表明，多相竞争和合成方法依赖性十分显著，高熵氧化物的实际生成远少于早期预期，而机器学习能够有效引导候选材料发现。
authors: Abraham A. Mancilla, Oliver A. Dicks, Solveig S. Aamlid, Mario Ulises González-Rivas, Karl Tsang, Dongjoon Song, Jörg Rottler, Alannah M. Hallas
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高熵氧化物（HEO）领域早期的观点强调了其可能具有丰富的种类，组合学论证也暗示了大量新材料的存在。然而，实验现实更加复杂：仅依据离子半径、晶格几何结构和电荷平衡考虑，无法直接预测高熵氧化物的稳定性。在本研究中，我们采用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）预测由一组选定三价阳离子构成的A₂O₃型高熵氧化物的可合成性。在近500种可能的组成中，我们筛选出16种有希望的候选物进行固相合成和燃烧合成实验验证。我们发现了3种刚玉结构的新型高熵氧化物，其中包括（Al、Cr、Fe、Rh、Sc）₂O₃，以及一种新颖的阳离子有序相（Al、Fe、Ga、Sc）₂O₃。到目前为止，最常见的合成结果是竞争相的混合物，其中有时还伴随氧化还原反应。我们的结果还揭示，最终产物高度依赖合成方法；在测试的16种组成中，仅有3种在两种合成方法下表现出定性等价的结果。我们据此得出结论：高熵氧化物的实际出现率远低于最初的预期，而机器学习方法能够有效地帮助我们在“海量候选中寻找少数目标”。

articles.title: Distinguishing Mott and strain-induced anisotropic semimetals in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene using Landau level spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用朗道能级光谱区分魔角扭转双层石墨烯中的莫特半金属与应变诱导各向异性半金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent quantum twisting microscopy experiments [1] have provided unprecedented momentum- and energy-resolved imaging of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, revealing a stark dichotomy between the heavy and light electronic characters of its narrow bands. In this work, we provide a sharp distinguishing criterion between the two most likely candidate states that exhibit spectroscopic features consistent with the experimental results. Focusing on charge neutrality, these states are 1) the 'Mott semimetal', governed by strong dynamical correlations, and 2) the 'strain-induced anisotropic semimetal', characterized by weak Hartree-Fock effects. We demonstrate that an out-of- plane magnetic field serves as a sharp discriminating probe based on the expected Landau level gap size hierarchy. We find that the strain-induced anisotropic semimetal has a robust gap hierarchy where the Chern C gaps, Δ_C , decrease in order Δ± ₄ > Δ± ₈ > Δ± ₁₂. In contrast, for the Mott semimetal, Δ± ₄ remains the largest gap, while the relative magnitude of the C = ± 8, ± 12 gaps depends sensitively on the applied magnetic field. We test the robustness of these results against strain orientation and lattice relaxation finding consistency between the gap hierarchy of the strained semimetal and previous incompressibility measurements at finite magnetic field [2].
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对电荷中性点，比较了两种可解释魔角扭转双层石墨烯实验光谱特征的候选状态：由强动态关联主导的莫特半金属和具有弱Hartree-Fock效应的应变诱导各向异性半金属。研究表明，面外磁场可通过朗道能级间隙大小层级区分两种状态。应变诱导各向异性半金属具有稳定的Δ±4 > Δ±8 > Δ±12间隙层级，而莫特半金属中Δ±4仍最大，C = ±8和±12间隙的相对大小则对磁场敏感。
authors: Keshav Singh, Juan Felipe Mendez-Valderrama, Erez Berg, B. Andrei Bernevig, Oskar Vafek
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期的量子扭转显微镜实验[1]提供了对魔角扭转双层石墨烯前所未有的动量和能量分辨成像，揭示了其窄带中重电子与轻电子特征之间的鲜明二分性。在本工作中，我们针对两个最可能、且其光谱特征与实验结果相符的候选态，提出了一个明确的区分标准。在电荷中性点，这两种状态分别是：1）由强动态关联主导的“莫特半金属”；2）以弱Hartree-Fock效应为特征的“应变诱导各向异性半金属”。我们证明，面外磁场可依据预期的朗道能级间隙大小层级，作为一种明确的区分探针。我们发现，应变诱导各向异性半金属具有稳健的间隙层级，其中陈数为C的间隙Δ_C按Δ±4 > Δ±8 > Δ±12的顺序递减。相比之下，对于莫特半金属，Δ±4仍然是最大的间隙，而C = ±8和±12间隙的相对大小取决于所施加的磁场。我们进一步检验了这些结果对于应变方向和晶格弛豫的稳健性，发现应变半金属的间隙层级与此前在有限磁场下的不可压缩性测量结果[2]一致。

articles.title: Orbital-Selective Spin Splitting in the Altermagnetic Ti₂XX' Monolayers
articles.title_zh: Altermagnetic Ti₂XX'单层中的轨道选择性自旋劈裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets have attracted intensive attention recently, owing to their unique combination of zero net magnetic moment of antiferromagnets and momentum space spin-splitting of ferromagnets. Herein, we systematically explore monolayer altermagnetic Ti₂XX' (X/X' = F, Cl, Br, I) materials for novel electronic properties. Especifically, spin-splitting exists in the valence bands of all studied materials, whereas several compositions exhibit nearly spin-degenerate conduction bands near the Fermi level, which is markedly different from conventional altermagnets. This phenomenon can be attributed to the bond-angle-sensitive super-exchange occurring in the dₓz or dyz orbitals, while the super-exchange of the dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbital is not sensitive to the Ti-X-Ti bond angle. Motivated by this intriguing phenomenon, Fermi level modulation via doping or heterostructure construction enables the transition between two electronic states, endowing these materials great application potential in information storage devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了单层反铁磁材料Ti₂XX'（X/X' = F、Cl、Br、I）的新型电子性质。所有研究材料的价带均存在自旋劈裂，而部分组成在费米能级附近的导带几乎自旋简并，这与传统反铁磁材料明显不同。该现象可归因于对键角敏感的dₓz或dᵧz轨道超交换作用，而dₓ²₋ᵧ²轨道的超交换对Ti-X-Ti键角不敏感；通过掺杂或构建异质结构调节费米能级，可实现两种电子态之间的转换。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁材料近年来受到广泛关注，这是由于它们兼具反铁磁体的零净磁矩和铁磁体的动量空间自旋劈裂等独特特征。在此，我们系统探索了单层反铁磁Ti₂XX'（X/X' = F、Cl、Br、I）材料的新型电子性质。具体而言，所有研究材料的价带中都存在自旋劈裂，而若干组成在费米能级附近的导带则几乎保持自旋简并，这与传统反铁磁材料显著不同。该现象可归因于发生在dₓz或dᵧz轨道中的、对键角敏感的超交换作用，而dₓ²₋ᵧ²轨道中的超交换作用对Ti-X-Ti键角并不敏感。受这一引人关注的现象启发，通过掺杂或构建异质结构调节费米能级，可以实现两种电子态之间的转换，从而赋予这些材料在信息存储器件中的巨大应用潜力。

articles.title: Magnetic-Field Selection of Magnetic Order in Altermagnets and Noncollinear Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁材料与非共线反铁磁材料中磁序的磁场选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20700v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional field selection of magnetic order relies on the Zeeman coupling, which, however, vanishes in magnets without net magnetization, a rapidly growing class including altermagnets (AMs), noncollinear antiferromagnets (nc-AFMs), and PT-symmetric antiferromagnets (PT-AFMs). Here we show that the quantity that fundamentally couples a magnet to a uniform magnetic field is not the magnetization, but the binary order parameter eta that labels the two time-reversal-related minima of the Landau free energy. We develop a Landau theory of order selection based on eta under the constraints of magnetic point-group (MPG) symmetry, in which eta couples to odd-degree polynomials in the magnetic field. Within this framework, the linear term is the ferromagnetic Zeeman coupling, while higher-order couplings with leading degree n = 3, 5, 7, and 9 naturally appear in AMs and nc-AFMs. In contrast, combined PT symmetry forbids any such coupling. Consequently, it is the order-(n-1) magnetic susceptibility, rather than the net magnetization, that serves as the primary experimental observable for identifying the magnetic order of AMs and nc-AFMs. For all 122 MPGs, we classify the leading coupling degree and the corresponding polynomial forms. We demonstrate our framework in two representative materials: the AM MnF2 and the nc-AFM MnTe2. We further construct a symmetry-allowed spin model for an AM system to reveal the microscopic origin of the higher-order coupling and establish the coupling coefficient explicitly in terms of the spin-model parameters. Our work unifies the description of magnetic-order selection across magnets with and without net magnetization, offers a microscopic origin for this counterintuitive physics, and provides fingerprints for distinguishing intrinsic field selection from extrinsic switching.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的磁序选择依赖塞曼耦合，但在无净磁化强度的反铁磁体系中该耦合消失，包括反交错磁体、非共线反铁磁体和具有PT对称性的反铁磁体。本文提出，均匀磁场与磁体根本耦合的量是标记两个时间反演相关朗道自由能极小值的二元序参量η，而非磁化强度；在磁点群对称性约束下，η可与磁场的奇次多项式耦合。研究进一步对全部122个磁点群分类了最低耦合阶数及相应多项式，并以MnF₂和MnTe₂为例建立微观解释和实验判据。
authors: Qiu-Shi Huang, Chaoxi Cui, Yilin Han, Junxi Duan, Zhi-Ming Yu, Yugui Yao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的磁序选择依赖于塞曼耦合，然而在没有净磁化强度的磁体中，这种耦合会消失；这类磁体正迅速发展成为一个庞大的类别，其中包括反交错磁体（AM）、非共线反铁磁体（nc-AFM）和PT对称反铁磁体（PT-AFM）。在这里，我们表明，与均匀磁场发生根本耦合的量并不是磁化强度，而是二元序参量η；该序参量标记朗道自由能中两个由时间反演联系的极小值。我们在磁点群（MPG）对称性约束下，发展了基于η的序参量选择朗道理论；在该理论中，η与磁场的奇次多项式相耦合。在这一框架下，一次项就是铁磁塞曼耦合，而最低次数分别为n = 3、5、7和9的高阶耦合则自然出现在反交错磁体和非共线反铁磁体中。相比之下，联合PT对称性禁止任何此类耦合。因此，对于识别反交错磁体和非共线反铁磁体的磁序，主要实验观测量不是净磁化强度，而是n-1阶磁化率。对于全部122个磁点群，我们分类了最低耦合阶数及相应的多项式形式。我们以两种代表性材料为例展示了这一框架：反交错磁体MnF₂和非共线反铁磁体MnTe₂。进一步地，我们为一个反交错磁性体系构建了满足对称性允许的自旋模型，以揭示高阶耦合的微观起源，并用自旋模型参数明确建立了耦合系数。我们的工作统一描述了有净磁化强度和无净磁化强度磁体中的磁序选择，提供了这种反直觉物理现象的微观起源，并为区分内禀磁场选择与外源性切换提供了特征判据。

articles.title: Prediction of a layer nonlinear Hall effect in bilayer nonmagnetic or antiferromagnetic systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20724v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlinear Hall effects provide a powerful probe of quantum geometry in solids and enable rectification phenomena beyond the constraints of linear response. In this Letter, we predict a emphlayer nonlinear Hall effect (LNHE) in stacked bilayer systems composed of nonmagnetic or antiferromagnetic materials with a vanishing linear Hall conductivity. In such systems, the second- or third-order nonlinear Hall responses are intrinsically layer odd: the contributions from the two constituent layers have equal magnitude but opposite sign, resulting in exact cancellation under layer-exchange symmetry. An out-of-plane electric field E_z can break this symmetry, thereby unveiling the hidden response and converting it into a switchable macroscopic nonlinear Hall signal. Using a minimal k!·!p model, we demonstrate that the LNHE can originate from the Berry curvature dipole mechanism. A systematic symmetry analysis of all 80 layer groups further yields a complete classification of the symmetry constraints and stacking configurations that allow for this type of LNHE. Beyond this mechanism, additional symmetry analysis reveals that LNHE may also arise from quantum metric dipole or inversed mass dipole. Remarkably, even in cases where second-order nonlinear Hall responses are symmetry forbidden, a third-order LNHE can still survive in certain stacked bilayer configurations. First-principles calculations on representative bilayers---nonmagnetic 1T'-WTe₂ and 1T'-ReS₂₋₋₋ₑₓₚₗᵢcitly demonstrate electrically reversible second-order LNHE, in full agreement with our symmetry-based predictions. Overall, our results establish LNHE as a universal phenomenon in a wide range of layered quantum materials and provide a robust route toward electrically tunable nonlinear transport.
authors: Zehou Li, Shenda He, Pan Zhou, Baoru Pan, Rui Tan, Lizhong Sun

articles.title: Quantum Wake Dynamics from Distinct Spectroscopic Perturbations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum wake dynamics in quantum magnets have recently been inferred from the dynamical spin structure factor, which probes only a restricted class of local perturbations. Here, we show that resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) selection rules act as an operator filter on fractionalized excitations, producing distinct quantum wakes in the spin-frac12 Heisenberg antiferromagnetic chain. Using explicit real-time evolution of single-spin and spin-conserving bond correlators, we find that the conventional spin response propagates up to the maximum spinon velocity, vₛ₌fracπ2 J, whereas the bond channels concentrate their spectral weight into a slower dominant wake with vsimeq 0.92 J, while weaker components remain bounded by the full spinon light cone. The corresponding momentum- and frequency-resolved responses map onto experimentally accessible RIXS channels, demonstrating that different spectroscopic perturbations resolve complementary pathways of many-body propagation beyond the neutron-scattering spin structure factor. Their inelastic spectral weights further provide access to quantum Fisher information, while equal-time bond sum rules connect the same spectroscopic channels to the ground-state energy. Because the same correlators can be prepared and measured on quantum hardware, they also define direct, experimentally anchored benchmarks for quantum simulations, particularly in frustrated and higher-dimensional magnets where controlled classical real-time calculations become challenging.
authors: Umesh Kumar, Gonzalo Alvarez, David Alan Tennant, Satoshi Okamoto

articles.title: Phase control of magnon-phonon coupling via magnetic field
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the phase of the coupling between magnons and surface acoustic wave (SAW) phonons in magnetic thin films. The coupling constant changes from a real to a complex number as the external magnetic field is reduced. Below a transition field, the imaginary coupling constant allows SAW phonons to couple to overdamped magnons whose resonance frequency is close to zero and far from the SAW resonance. The strength of the imaginary coupling constant and the magnitude of the transition field both scale with magnetic damping. We find the coupling produces a broad, pronounced minimum in the SAW transmittance spectrum near zero magnetic field in a Ni/Ru/Ni synthetic antiferromagnet with large magnetic damping. These results demonstrate that the phase of the complex magnon-phonon coupling constant can be tuned via magnetic field in strongly damped magnets, offering a platform to explore novel regimes of magnon-phonon interactions.
authors: Yasuhiro Todaka, Motoki Asano, Isamu Yasuda, Masashi Kawaguchi, Daiki Hatanaka, Masamitsu Hayashi

articles.title: Electronic Toroidal Metals: Landau Theory and Magnetoelectric Fingerprints
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Toroidal order is a higher-rank multipolar order whose intrinsic realization in itinerant-electron systems remains unexplored. Here, we develop a generic theory of the electronic toroidal metal (ETM), in which toroidal order emerges spontaneously from electronic degrees of freedom near the Fermi surfaces. Because candidate toroidal bilinears can overlap by symmetry with the uniform charge current, we formulate a projected instability criterion that removes the noncondensable current component. Within this current-orthogonal sector, we identify a soft collective mode in the P-odd and T-odd particle-hole channel and demonstrate that ETM arises as a Fermi-liquid instability. We then define the toroidal moment in an itinerant system through the antisymmetric magnetoelectric response tensor. We further establish an intimate connection between this response and the topology of pseudospin texture: the rearrangement of pseudospin vortices changes the winding structure of the Fermi surfaces and markedly enhances the magnetoelectric response. ETM also exhibits characteristic nonlinear charge transport, including a pronounced enhancement of its interband quantum-geometric contribution. Our results establish ETM as a distinct metallic Landau phase and provide a general framework for understanding toroidal order generated by itinerant electrons.

articles.title: Towards Ultra Scalability of Non-Volatile Magnetic Tunnel Junctions with a 3D Storage Layer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The perpendicular Spin Transfer Torque Magnetic Random Access Memory is one of the most promising emerging non-volatile memory technologies, based on ultra-thin magnetic tunnel junctions. However, as these devices are limited by their thermal stability factor at technological nodes smaller than 20 nm, their scalability is compromised. A possible solution to this limitation relies on taking advantage of the shape anisotropy, by increasing substantially the thickness of the storage layer. Thanks to the combination of a vertical aspect-ratio and enhanced volume, high thermal stability can be maintained at sub-10 nm nodes. Here, we present the technological advancements and understanding of the magnetisation reversal that led to faster switching speeds at reduced switching voltage, providing a viable approach for dense arrays of ultra-small magnetic tunnel junctions.
authors: Nuno Caçoilo, Shunsuke Fukami, Olivier Fruchart, Ioan-Lucian Prejbeanu

articles.title: Long-lived Laughlin pairs in a depleted quantum Hall edge channel
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On-demand sources and mesoscopic beam splitters allow individual ballistic electrons to collide in depleted quantum Hall edge channels, where their unscreened Coulomb interaction acts as a strong, controllable nonlinearity. Theory suggests a more striking possibility: in a strong magnetic field, the repulsion can drive quantized relative circulation, allowing two electrons to propagate together as a positive-energy Laughlin pair. The relevance of such pairs to experiment depends on quantitative lifetimes in realistic guiding potentials and on whether the proposed collision pathway to pair formation survives full two-dimensional dynamics. We develop a microscopic theory of quasibound Laughlin pairs using the physical two-electron Hamiltonian. For a general local electric-field gradient, we determine the dissociation threshold, number of quasibound states, and decay rates. Complex scaling and analytic tunneling theory show that lifetimes grow exponentially with pair energy above threshold. Applied to reported GaAs parameters, the theory indicates that existing devices may already support the lowest spin-polarized pair, with a leading lifetime estimate about three orders of magnitude longer than typical propagation times. We simulate a collision with the full finite-field Hamiltonian, demonstrating both a framework for nonlinear two-electron quantum dynamics and the creation of a Laughlin pair in a representative two-electron collision. We use Husimi distributions and their zeros to visualize both quasibound resonances and transient collision states in phase space. These results place the preparation, propagation, and detection of repulsively paired electrons within reach of existing single-electron circuit technology. They identify kinematic stabilization under constrained one-dimensional propagation as a pairing mechanism that may extend to anyonic quantum Hall edge excitations.
authors: Girts Barinovs, Agris Buzs, Vyacheslavs Kashcheyevs

articles.title: Systematic and accurate anharmonic formation free energies of metastable defects via a constrained Bayesian Adaptive Biasing Force framework
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20902v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computing the formation free energies of metastable defects at finite temperature remains challenging due to anharmonicity, the multiplicity of basins and the frequent occurrence of migration events. Using the previously introduced constrained Bayesian Adaptive Biasing Force method (BABFc), we establish a practical thermodynamic integration framework for computing restricted anharmonic formation free energies associated with individual metastable defect basins. We demonstrate that BABFc can be exploited as a robust, systematic and numerically efficient tool for addressing a long standing bottleneck in atomistic materials science: the finite temperature thermodynamic characterization of metastable defects in complex, highly anharmonic energy landscapes. The proposed workflow requires only a reference local minimum and a confinement strategy and does not rely on defect specific collective variables. It therefore provides a general route to assign well-defined free energies to individual metastable basins, even when these basins are separated by low barriers and embedded in a dense landscape of competing configurations. In this setting, BABFc enables stable, bias corrected free energy estimates with statistical accuracies at the meV/atom level and a very low failure rate, including for systems containing approximately one thousand atoms. We demonstrate this capability through thousands of independent free energy calculations covering hundreds of four-interstitial and four-vacancy configurations in bcc α-Fe over a broad temperature range, using both a traditional empirical potential and a data driven force field.
authors: Clovis Lapointe, Anruo Zhong, Manuel Athènes, Mihai-Cosmin Marinica

articles.title: The Trachenko-Zaccone equation: nonlinear relaxation from glasses to complex systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Trachenko-Zaccone equation provides a compact nonlinear dynamical framework for describing non-Debye relaxation in disordered condensed matter. Originally developed to rationalize stretched- and compressed-exponential relaxation in liquids and glasses from the dynamics of interacting local relaxation events, the same equation has subsequently appeared in broader contexts, including polymer relaxation and nonlinear models of global population dynamics. This review retraces the conceptual development of the equation, with particular emphasis on its physical origin in Kostya Trachenko's feed-forward interaction mechanism, its mathematical structure, and its possible generalizations. We also include personal recollections of the work with Kostya Trachenko at Queen Mary University of London in August 2019, during which the equation emerged in essentially its present form. After reviewing applications to stress relaxation, glassy materials, polymer relaxation and population dynamics, we discuss future directions including time-dependent feedback parameters, coupled order parameters, heterogeneous and spatially resolved formulations, flux terms, network versions and stochastic extensions. The central theme of the review is that the Trachenko-Zaccone equation should be viewed not only as a model of glassy relaxation, but as a general nonlinear feedback equation with potential applications across complex systems.
authors: Alessio Zaccone, Valeriy V. Ginzburg, Oleg V. Gendelman, Sofia F. Mauro, John C. Mauro

articles.title: Artificial spin ice systems on single edge length tilings
articles.title_zh: 单一边长铺砌上的人工自旋冰系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin ices (ASIs) are decorations of single domain nanomagnets on geometric lattices allowing for study of magnetic interactions on easily varied lattice geometries. We extend the study of ASIs on single rhomb tilings by simulating an ASI with the aperiodic hexagonal Hfᵣₐc₁₂fᵣₐc₁₂ tiling as the base structure, and the periodic dice lattice for additional comparison. Using a point dipole metropolis Monte Carlo approach, we cool our arrays of nanoislands to form a low energy configuration, assessing individual vertex excitations as identified through complementary micromagnetic simulations. Using the energy and charge landscape of final spin states, we propose a potential ground state spin configuration for the aperiodic system.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工自旋冰是在几何晶格上排列单畴纳米磁体形成的体系，可用于研究不同晶格几何中的磁相互作用。本文以非周期六边形铺砌和周期性骰子晶格为基础，通过点偶极子Metropolis蒙特卡洛方法模拟纳米岛阵列的低能构型，并结合微磁模拟分析顶点激发。研究基于最终自旋态的能量与电荷景观，提出了非周期体系的一种潜在基态自旋构型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工自旋冰（ASI）是在几何晶格上排列单畴纳米磁体形成的结构，从而能够在易于改变的晶格几何中研究磁相互作用。我们将单菱形铺砌上的ASI研究进一步扩展到以非周期六边形Hfᵣₐc₁₂fᵣₐc₁₂铺砌为基础结构的ASI模拟，并采用周期性骰子晶格进行补充比较。我们使用点偶极子Metropolis蒙特卡洛方法冷却纳米岛阵列，使其形成低能构型，并结合互补的微磁模拟来评估所识别出的单个顶点激发。通过分析最终自旋态的能量景观和电荷景观，我们为该非周期体系提出了一种潜在的基态自旋构型。

articles.title: Interedge backscattering in quantum spin Hall-based NS and SNS junctions
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋霍尔基NS与SNS结中的边间反向散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20939v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the microscopic conditions that allow for the coupling between opposite quantum spin Hall (QSH) edges in hybrid junctions with superconductors. Using a microscopic Bernevig--Hughes--Zhang model and the Bogoliubov--de Gennes formalism, we model a potential barrier along the NS interface and identify the parameter regimes in which the QSH edges are coupled. In normal--superconductor junctions, such coupling manifests as deviations from the quantized zero-bias Andreev conductance G=4e²/h. These deviations are controlled by the induced gap in the barrier, the barrier geometry, the interface transparency, orbital and Fermi-velocity mismatch, and disorder strength as well as the bias voltage leading to a zero-bias peak. We then analyze the impact of this interedge-coupling mechanism in Josephson junctions at equilibrium and show that it hybridizes the edge-resolved Andreev branches, opens gaps at the time-reversal-invariant phase differences ϕ=0 and ϕ=π, and modifies the superconducting quantum interference pattern. In a reflection-symmetric geometry, the relative sizes of the two gap openings provide complementary information about the interedge dynamical phase, which also determines the parity of the suppressed lobes in the magnetic interference pattern. This investigation sheds light on the microscopic details that control the coupling of helical edge states in actual devices and the resulting consequences for superconducting hybrid systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究超导体混合结中相反量子自旋霍尔边缘发生耦合的微观条件，并利用微观BHZ模型和Bogoliubov–de Gennes形式进行分析。在NS结中，边间耦合会导致零偏压安德烈夫电导偏离量子化值；在约瑟夫森结中，它会使边缘分辨的安德烈夫分支杂化、在时间反演不变相位处开隙，并改变超导量子干涉图样。研究揭示了界面参数、失配和无序等因素对实际器件中螺旋边缘态耦合及其输运后果的控制作用。
authors: Cajetab Heinz, Patrik Recher, Fernando Dominguez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在含超导体的混合结中实现相反量子自旋霍尔（QSH）边缘耦合的微观条件。我们采用微观的Bernevig–Hughes–Zhang模型和Bogoliubov–de Gennes形式，对沿NS界面的势垒进行建模，并确定QSH边缘发生耦合的参数区域。在正常金属–超导体结中，这种耦合表现为量子化零偏压安德烈夫电导G=4e²/h的偏离。这些偏离受到势垒中的诱导能隙、势垒几何形状、界面透明度、轨道和费米速度失配以及无序强度的控制，同时也受到会导致零偏压峰的偏置电压影响。随后，我们分析了这种边间耦合机制在平衡态约瑟夫森结中的影响，发现它会使按边缘区分的安德烈夫分支发生杂化，在时间反演不变的相位差φ=0和φ=π处打开能隙，并改变超导量子干涉图样。在具有反射对称性的几何结构中，两个能隙开口的相对大小能够提供关于边间动力学相位的互补信息；该动力学相位还决定磁干涉图样中被抑制瓣的奇偶性。本研究阐明了实际器件中控制螺旋边缘态耦合的微观细节，以及由此产生的超导混合体系效应。

articles.title: Broken Inversion Symmetry via a Magic Methyl Effect
articles.title_zh: 通过“神奇甲基效应”破缺反演对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polar liquid crystals - fluid phases in which molecular dipoles organise into ferro- or antiferroelectric states - present a highly constrained molecular design space, where small changes can entirely suppress polar organisation. Here we demonstrate, contrary to expectations, that installation of a methyl group in the 5-position of a 1,3-dioxane ring substantially increases the onset temperature of polar order. Remarkably, this effect proves transferable across several liquid-crystal families, including examples where the methylated derivative exhibits a polar phase whereas its parent compound does not. Across 8 matched pairs, we find that a 5-methyl group can enhance the onset temperature of polar order in 1,3-dioxane materials by up to 120 degC. These findings establish a simple and general molecular design strategy for enhancing and enabling spontaneous dipolar ordering in liquid crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 极性液晶的分子设计空间受到严格限制，微小结构变化就可能抑制极性有序。本文发现，在1,3-二氧六环环的5位引入甲基，反而能显著提高极性有序的起始温度，而且这一效应可迁移到多个液晶家族。对8组匹配化合物的比较表明，5-甲基取代最高可使极性有序起始温度提高120摄氏度，并可使原本无极性相的母体化合物产生极性相。
authors: Calum J Gibb, Jordan Hobbs, Caitlin O Brien, Kate Hille, Benji Maher, Christopher M Pask, Richard J Mandle
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极性液晶是分子偶极组织成铁电或反铁电状态的流体相，其分子设计空间受到高度限制，微小的结构变化就可能完全抑制极性有序。本文证明，与预期相反，在1,3-二氧六环环的5位引入甲基，能够大幅提高极性有序的起始温度。值得注意的是，这种效应可迁移到多个液晶家族中，包括一些甲基化衍生物出现极性相而其母体化合物并不出现极性相的实例。在8组匹配化合物中，我们发现，5-甲基能够使1,3-二氧六环材料的极性有序起始温度最高提高120摄氏度。这些发现确立了一种简单且具有普适性的分子设计策略，用于增强液晶中的自发偶极有序，或促成这种有序的形成。

articles.title: Scalable Cyclic Olefin Copolymer Encapsulation for High Optical Quality of TMD Monolayers
articles.title_zh: 用于提高TMD单层光学质量的可扩展环烯烃共聚物封装
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20973v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) combine a direct bandgap, strongly bound excitons, and pronounced second-order optical nonlinearity, which makes them promising materials for ultrathin optoelectronic and nanophotonic devices. However, their optical performance is often degraded by environmental exposure and substrate-induced charge trapping, motivating the development of scalable encapsulation strategies. Here, we investigate spin-coated cyclic olefin copolymer (COC) as a scalable encapsulant for TMDs. Room-temperature and cryogenic optical spectroscopy reveal enhanced photoluminescence and second-harmonic generation, accompanied by excitonic linewidth narrowing and an increased exciton-to-trion ratio. In addition, COC encapsulation induces an excitonic peak splitting and an overall spectral blueshift. First-principles calculations attribute these spectral modifications to local symmetry breaking at the chalcogen interface and macroscopic compressive strain, respectively. These findings establish spin-coated COC as an effective, scalable encapsulation strategy and a potential platform for post-growth excitonic and band-structure engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了旋涂环烯烃共聚物作为过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）单层的可扩展封装材料。室温和低温光谱表明，封装后光致发光和二次谐波产生增强，激子线宽变窄，激子与三重激子的比值提高。第一性原理计算将观察到的峰分裂归因于界面局部对称性破缺，将整体光谱蓝移归因于宏观压缩应变。
authors: Suprova Das, Md Tarik Hossain, Zlata Fedorova, Zifei Zhang, Axel Printschler, Begimai Adilbekova, Honey Jayeshkumer Shah, Stefan Velja, Caterina Cocchi, Andrey Turchanin, Isabelle Staude
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）单层兼具直接带隙、强束缚激子和显著的二阶光学非线性，因此成为超薄光电器件和纳米光子器件的有前景材料。然而，环境暴露和衬底诱导的电荷俘获往往会降低其光学性能，这推动了可扩展封装策略的发展。在本文中，我们研究了旋涂环烯烃共聚物（COC）作为TMD可扩展封装材料的可行性。室温和低温光学光谱显示，封装后光致发光和二次谐波产生得到增强，同时激子线宽变窄，激子与三重激子的比值增加。此外，COC封装还诱导了激子峰分裂和整体光谱蓝移。第一性原理计算表明，这些光谱变化分别源于硫属元素界面的局部对称性破缺和宏观压缩应变。这些结果表明，旋涂COC是一种有效且可扩展的封装策略，也可能成为实现生长后激子和能带结构工程的平台。

articles.title: Optical conductivity signature of Van Hove singularity in altermagnetic topological systems
articles.title_zh: 交错磁拓扑体系中范霍夫奇点的光学电导特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the topological phases, joint density of states (JDOS), optical conductivities, and magneto-optical responses of a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet with spin-orbit coupling and Zeeman splitting. The system hosts Dirac gaps at the high-symmetry points Γ, M, X, and Y. We show that the JDOS exhibits kinks at the corresponding Dirac gap frequencies and pronounced peaks at Van Hove singularities, whose positions can be tuned by the altermagnetic order. These features are reflected in the optical conductivities, with complementary signatures in their real and imaginary parts. Particularly, the Van Hove signatures in the transverse optical conductivity disappear in the absence of d-wave altermagnetism, revealing an altermagnet-induced optical signature of the Van Hove singularity. Finally, the Faraday and Kerr rotations inherit characteristic features of the optical conductivity. Our results establish optical and magneto-optical spectroscopy as sensitive probes of Dirac gaps and Van Hove singularities in altermagnetic topological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有自旋轨道耦合和塞曼劈裂的二维d波交错磁体中的拓扑相、联合态密度、光学电导和磁光响应。体系在Γ、M、X和Y高对称点形成狄拉克能隙，联合态密度在相应频率处出现拐点，并在范霍夫奇点处产生可由交错磁序调节的峰。横向光学电导中的范霍夫特征在缺少d波交错磁性时消失，表明其可作为交错磁性诱导的光学标志。
authors: Fang Qin, Rui Chen, Xiao-Bin Qiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有自旋轨道耦合和塞曼劈裂的二维d波交错磁体的拓扑相、联合态密度（JDOS）、光学电导和磁光响应。该体系在高对称点Γ、M、X和Y处形成狄拉克能隙。我们表明，JDOS在相应的狄拉克能隙频率处表现出拐点，并在范霍夫奇点处出现显著峰值；这些峰的位置可以通过交错磁序进行调节。这些特征会反映在光学电导中，并且其实部和虚部呈现互补信号。特别是，在没有d波交错磁性的情况下，横向光学电导中的范霍夫特征会消失，从而揭示出一种由交错磁性诱导的范霍夫奇点光学特征。最后，法拉第旋转和克尔旋转会继承光学电导的特征。我们的结果表明，光学和磁光谱学是探测交错磁拓扑体系中狄拉克能隙和范霍夫奇点的灵敏手段。

articles.title: Scalable photoexcitation-induced molecular dynamics with machine-learned Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习哈密顿量实现可扩展的光激发诱导分子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast photoexcitation offers a controllable route to steer structural dynamics in solids, yet predicting how nonequilibrium electronic excitation drives lattice motion across extended spatial and temporal scales remains a major computational challenge. Here we introduce time-dependent ab-initio propagation with electronic machine learning (TDAP-eML), a framework that explicitly incorporates electronic evolution into scalable simulations of photoexcitation-induced lattice dynamics. By integrating machine-learned electronic structure with atomistic propagation, TDAP-eML describes how photoexcitation reshapes the evolving energy landscapes and forces governing structural motion. Across representative examples including silicon and FeSe, the framework reproduces key photoexcited lattice responses obtained from first-principles time-dependent density functional theory calculations and captures coherent phonon dynamics together with their dependence on excitation conditions. Its computational advantage increases with system size, reaching nearly three orders of magnitude reduction in computational cost for the large systems examined. TDAP-eML thus establishes a scalable framework for coupled electronic and lattice evolution, linking nonequilibrium excitation to photoinduced forces, predictive structural dynamics, and experimentally accessible observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出时间依赖从头算传播与电子机器学习框架（TDAP-eML），将电子演化显式纳入光激发诱导晶格动力学的可扩展模拟。该方法结合机器学习电子结构和原子传播，能够描述光激发对结构运动所处能量景观及作用力的重塑，并在硅和FeSe等体系中再现第一性原理时间依赖密度泛函理论得到的关键响应。其计算优势随体系尺寸增大而提升，在所研究的大型体系中计算成本降低近三个数量级。
authors: Leyu Cai, Yunzhe Jia, Daqiang Chen, Sheng Meng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超快光激发为调控固体中的结构动力学提供了可控途径，但预测非平衡电子激发如何在扩展的空间和时间尺度上驱动晶格运动，仍是一个重大的计算挑战。在此，我们提出时间依赖从头算传播与电子机器学习（TDAP-eML）框架，将电子演化显式纳入光激发诱导晶格动力学的可扩展模拟。通过将机器学习电子结构与原子尺度传播相结合，TDAP-eML描述了光激发如何重塑控制结构运动的演化能量景观和作用力。在包括硅和FeSe在内的代表性实例中，该框架再现了由第一性原理时间依赖密度泛函理论计算得到的关键光激发晶格响应，并捕捉到相干声子动力学及其对激发条件的依赖性。随着体系尺寸增大，其计算优势不断提升；对于所研究的大型体系，计算成本降低幅度接近三个数量级。因此，TDAP-eML建立了一个可扩展的电子与晶格耦合演化框架，将非平衡激发与光诱导作用力、可预测的结构动力学以及实验可观测量联系起来。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文提出TDAP-eML框架，将机器学习电子结构与原子运动相结合，用于可扩展地模拟光激发诱导的晶格动力学。该方法在硅和FeSe中复现了实时含时密度泛函理论得到的光激发晶格响应和相干声子动力学，并显著降低了大体系计算成本。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习哈密顿量、非绝热分子动力学、含时密度泛函理论、热载流子弛豫和光激发动力学方向高度相关。其电子机器学习与原子动力学耦合的思路可直接借鉴到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体和界面电荷转移研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议重点跟踪其机器学习电子哈密顿量的训练策略、时间传播稳定性和非绝热力实现方式。进一步可研究缺陷、极化子、电子-声子耦合以及界面体系中的光激发载流子动力学。

articles.title: On Transmission Function Amplitude and Phase Recovery in Multislice Electron Ptychography
articles.title_zh: 多层切片电子叠层成像中的透射函数振幅与相位恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: {Multislice electron ptychography commonly accounts for inelastic scattering by including an absorptive object potential in the reconstruction forward model that attenuates the elastic signal. However, it remains unclear how the reconstruction is quantitatively impacted by thermal scattering. Here, we use the quantum excitation of phonons (QEP) formalism, which explicitly separates elastic and inelastic (thermal diffuse) scattering within a single multislice propagation, to simulate four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D STEM) datasets of PbTiO₃ and SrTiO₃ and reconstruct their phase and amplitude. We find that reconstructions of the QEP total and elastic-only datasets are nearly indistinguishable across sample thicknesses from 11 to 40 nm and across atomic species, demonstrating that the reconstruction is largely insensitive to incoherent thermal diffuse scattering within the collected angular range. Reconstructions from multislice phase-only simulations further confirm that appreciable amplitude does not arise from multiple elastic scattering, but instead reflects attenuation of the coherent elastic signal due to thermal scattering. Further comparison of the QEP elastic-only reconstruction with absorptive multislice simulations reveals substantial amplitude contrast deviations for heavy Pb columns (up to 17%), arising from the approximations used to evaluate the absorptive potential for the 4D STEM simulation. These results thus indicate that reconstruction phase and amplitude accuracy are not significantly limited by the absorptive potential forward model, even in the presence of thermal diffuse scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用声子量子激发（QEP）形式，将弹性散射与非弹性热漫散射分离，以模拟PbTiO₃和SrTiO₃的4D STEM数据并重建透射函数的相位和振幅。结果显示，在11至40纳米厚度及不同原子种类范围内，QEP总散射与仅弹性散射数据的重建几乎不可区分，说明重建对收集角范围内的非相干热漫散射不敏感。与吸收势多层切片模拟的比较表明，重建精度并不会显著受吸收势前向模型限制，但重元素Pb柱的振幅对比仍可能出现最高17%的偏差。
authors: Bridget R. Denzer, Colin Gilgenbach, James M. LeBeau
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多层切片电子叠层成像通常通过在重建前向模型中加入吸收性物体势来描述非弹性散射，该势会衰减弹性信号。然而，热散射如何定量影响重建仍不明确。在本文中，我们采用声子量子激发（QEP）形式，在单次多层切片传播中显式分离弹性散射和非弹性（热漫）散射，用于模拟PbTiO₃和SrTiO₃的四维扫描透射电子显微镜（4D STEM）数据，并重建其相位和振幅。我们发现，在11至40纳米的样品厚度范围内，并且对于不同原子种类，QEP总散射数据和仅弹性散射数据的重建几乎无法区分，这表明在所收集的角度范围内，重建对非相干热漫散射总体上不敏感。多层切片仅相位模拟得到的重建进一步证实，显著的振幅并非来自多重弹性散射，而是反映了热散射对相干弹性信号的衰减。进一步将QEP仅弹性散射重建与吸收性多层切片模拟进行比较后发现，重元素Pb柱的振幅对比存在明显偏差，最高可达17%；这种偏差源于4D STEM模拟中用于计算吸收势的近似。因此，这些结果表明，即使存在热漫散射，吸收势前向模型也不会显著限制重建相位和振幅的准确性。

articles.title: An autonomous feedback protocol: responding to temperature and potential changes in energy converters
articles.title_zh: 自主反馈协议：响应能量转换器中的温度与势变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21113v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoscale thermoelectric devices convert tiny amounts of heat into power. But what happens if the external conditions and resulting temperature differences are not a priori known? We propose a feedback mechanism that optimizes the performance of a quantum-point-contact-based heat engine (QPC). A quantum-dot detector measures the external conditions and gives autonomous feedback on the QPC's properties. We expect this feedback mechanism to be experimentally relevant for steady-state engines with unknown external conditions and for adapting dynamic charging processes to the potential buildup.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对外部条件和由此产生的温差事先未知的情形，提出一种用于优化量子点接触热机性能的反馈机制。量子点探测器测量外部条件，并对量子点接触的性质实施自主反馈。该机制有望应用于外部条件未知的稳态热机，也可用于适应动态充电过程中不断形成的电势积累。
authors: Krishna Lyn Delima, Elsa Danielsson, Bruno Bertin-Johannet, Janine Splettstoesser
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳米尺度热电器件能够将极少量的热转换为功率。但如果外部条件及其产生的温差事先未知，会发生什么情况？我们提出一种反馈机制，用于优化基于量子点接触（QPC）的热机性能。量子点探测器测量外部条件，并对QPC的性质提供自主反馈。我们预计，这种反馈机制对于外部条件未知的稳态热机具有实验相关性，也适用于使动态充电过程适应电势的积累。

articles.title: Symmetry-engineering ferroelectricity in silicon dioxides
articles.title_zh: 在二氧化硅中通过对称性工程实现铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is a long-established rule for classical ferroelectricity that any ferroelectric crystal must adopt one of the 10 specific polar point groups. Here we predict a unique type of ferroelectricity that can be generated in some crystals belonging to nonpolar noncentrosymmetric groups. This principle can be applicable to many systems including silicon dioxides, the most widely used dielectric materials. Most of their crystalline phases do not belong the polar groups, while the nonlinear Si-O-Si configurations lead to multiple identical states. We show first-principles evidence that the crystal symmetry forbidding the formation of polarizations, can be broken by either parallel surfaces in thin-films or applying a uniaxial strain. As a result, the multiple identical states are endowed with polarizations of different directions, and low-barrier ferroelectric switching can be realized via transition between them, which can be room-temperature robust down to the thickness of 1 nm. Our findings may not only enable low-cost and large-scale manufacture of ferroelectrics directly integrated in silicon chips, but also open a new avenue for exploring ferroelectricity in prevalent nonpolar materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文预测了一种可在属于非极性非中心对称点群的晶体中产生的新型铁电性。以二氧化硅为例，薄膜中的平行表面或单轴应变能够破坏原本禁止极化形成的晶体对称性，使多个等价状态获得不同方向的极化。由此可实现低势垒铁电翻转，并在厚度低至1纳米时保持室温稳定性，为硅芯片中低成本、大规模集成铁电材料提供了可能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典铁电性的一个长期确立的规则是，任何铁电晶体都必须采用10种特定极性点群中的一种。在此，我们预测了一种独特类型的铁电性：它可以在属于非极性非中心对称点群的某些晶体中产生。这一原理可适用于包括二氧化硅在内的许多体系，而二氧化硅是应用最广泛的介电材料。二氧化硅的大多数晶相并不属于极性点群，但其中非线性的Si-O-Si构型会产生多个彼此相同的状态。我们通过第一性原理证据表明，原本禁止极化形成的晶体对称性，可以通过薄膜中的平行表面或施加单轴应变加以破缺。这样，多个彼此相同的状态便获得了方向不同的极化，并且可以通过它们之间的转变实现低势垒铁电翻转；即使厚度降低至1纳米，这种铁电性仍可在室温下保持稳定。我们的发现不仅可能实现直接集成于硅芯片中的铁电材料的低成本、大规模制造，也为探索普遍存在的非极性材料中的铁电性开辟了新途径。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文提出通过对称性工程在原本非极性但非中心对称的晶体中产生可切换铁电性，并以多种二氧化硅晶相为主要例子。第一性原理结果显示，薄膜表面或单轴应变能够打破相关晶体对称性，使等价构型获得不同方向的极化，并实现低能垒翻转。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的铁电性、极化翻转、应变工程、薄膜界面和有效哈密顿量研究直接相关。二氧化硅体系还连接了团队关注的HfO2铁电体及硅基器件集成问题，可借鉴其对称性分析和低维边界条件设计思路。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算表面、界面、缺陷和有限温度对该类铁电态稳定性及疲劳行为的影响，并构建描述多稳态极化翻转的有效哈密顿量。还可比较其与滑移铁电和量子铁电机制的异同。

articles.title: Berry-Curvature Effect in Anomalous Transport
articles.title_zh: 反常输运中的贝里曲率效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A theory of the Berry-phase effect in anomalous transport in ferromagnets driven by statistical forces such as the gradient of temperature or chemical potential has been developed by Di Xiao et al in Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 026603 (2006) based on a field-dependent density of states generating an additional contribution to the current density. We present an alternative derivation of the Berry- phase effect in anomalous transport in altermagnets and noncentrosymmertric metals based on quasiclassic matrix kinetic equation. Along with anomalous Hall effect an anomalous heat flow and anomalous thermalelectric currents are also derived.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在准经典矩阵动力学方程的基础上，重新推导了交错磁体和非中心对称金属中由贝里相位引起的反常输运效应。研究同时推导了反常霍尔效应、反常热流和反常热电流，并将其与温度梯度或化学势梯度等统计力驱动的输运联系起来。该工作为这些体系中的贝里曲率输运提供了替代性的理论描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Di Xiao等人在Physical Review Letters 97, 026603（2006）中建立了铁磁体内由温度梯度或化学势梯度等统计力驱动的反常输运中的贝里相位效应理论，该理论基于一个与外场有关的态密度，并由此产生对电流密度的额外贡献。本文基于准经典矩阵动力学方程，给出了交错磁体和非中心对称金属中反常输运贝里相位效应的另一种推导。除反常霍尔效应外，本文还推导了反常热流和反常热电流。

articles.title: Continuously control of polarization via electrically driven long-distance superlubric sliding
articles.title_zh: 通过电驱动的长距离超润滑滑移连续调控极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21162v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sliding ferroelectricity widely exists in various van der Waals bilayers or multilayers, which is induced by asymmetric stacking of commensurate interface. The greatly reduced switching barriers via interlayer sliding lead to high speed with low energy cost, while they are still much higher compared with superlubric sliding of incommensurate interfaces. The polarizations of such incommensurate interfaces are not switchable, which is the major obstacle of combing superlubricity and sliding ferroelectricity for ultralow barriers. Here we propose a design of such combination based on previous synthesis of lateral heterojunctions of 2D materials, which can be extensively applicable to various systems including PN junctions. In such long-distance superlubric ferroelectricity, the vertical polarization can be continuously controlled by superlubric sliding of incommensurate interfaces between lateral heterojunction bilayers, where the series of multiple stable states are long-sought for artificial synaptic devices. The unconventionality of our findings does not only include unprecedented barriers down to the magnitude of mu-eV, but also unprecedented long ion displacements distinct from the small deviations in classical paradigm of ferroelectricity. Our predicted superlubric sliding electrically driven by low vertical voltage is also hitherto reported, much more efficient compared with previously reported sliding mechanically driven by tips, resolving a major issue for practical applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 滑移铁电性广泛存在于范德华双层或多层材料中，但非公度界面的超润滑滑移通常无法切换极化。本文提出利用二维材料横向异质结双层，将非公度界面的超润滑性与滑移铁电性结合，使垂直极化能够通过长距离滑移连续调控。该设计可产生一系列稳定状态，滑移势垒低至微电子伏量级，并可由低垂直电压电驱动，从而适用于超低能耗人工突触器件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 滑移铁电性广泛存在于各种范德华双层或多层材料中，其起源是公度界面的不对称堆垛。层间滑移显著降低的翻转势垒带来了高速和低能耗特性，但与非公度界面的超润滑滑移相比，这些势垒仍然较高。此类非公度界面的极化无法切换，这是将超润滑性与滑移铁电性结合起来以实现超低势垒的主要障碍。在此，我们基于此前对二维材料横向异质结的合成，提出一种将两者结合的设计，并指出它可广泛适用于包括PN结在内的多种体系。在这种长距离超润滑铁电性中，横向异质结双层之间非公度界面的超润滑滑移能够连续调控垂直极化，从而产生人工突触器件长期寻求的多个稳定状态。我们的发现具有多方面的非传统特征，包括低至微电子伏量级的前所未有的势垒，以及不同于经典铁电性范式中微小偏移的、前所未有的长距离离子位移。我们预测的由低垂直电压驱动的超润滑滑移也是迄今报道的首例电驱动方式，相比此前利用探针机械驱动的滑移更加高效，从而解决了实际应用中的一个主要问题。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文提出在横向异质结双层材料之间实现电驱动的长距离超润滑滑移，从而连续调控界面垂直极化。该机制结合了非公度界面的超低滑移势垒与滑移铁电性，并预测了多个稳定极化状态及微电子伏量级的切换能垒。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的滑移铁电、二维范德华体系、双层堆叠、界面电荷转移和低维材料设计方向高度直接相关。其连续极化调控、多稳态和超低能垒机制对人工突触器件及低功耗铁电器件研究具有重要参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步使用第一性原理、机器学习势和分子动力学研究真实温度下的滑移路径、摩擦、缺陷钉扎和边界效应。还可计算不同横向异质结的极化、电荷转移、隧穿输运及光电响应，并评估器件尺度下的稳定性。

articles.title: Emergent Vibronic Spectral Hierarchy in a Kagome Flat-Band Insulator
articles.title_zh: 笼目平带绝缘体中涌现的振电光谱层级结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-phonon coupling is usually understood in terms of electronic quasiparticles interacting with dispersive lattice vibrations. Much less is known about the complementary limit in which the relevant phonon mode is itself localized or weakly dispersive. Here we investigate this regime in the kagome compound Rb₂Ni₃S₄, which undergoes an unconventional insulating transition near T* approx 260-280~K. Combining polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy with temperature-dependent x-ray diffraction, scanning tunneling microscopy, and electrical, thermal, and magnetic measurements, we show that the transition involves electronic localization without a conventional structural or magnetic order parameter. Raman spectra reveal a giant Franck-Condon progression associated with a nearly dispersionless 333.7~cm⁻¹ phonon, decorated by an equally spaced comb-like fine structure with a characteristic spacing of 40.6~cm⁻¹. The comb spacing is insensitive to magnetic field, whereas its spectral weight is strongly field tunable. Rather than treating either hierarchy alone as pure phonon effect, we interpret their nested coexistence as evidence for a strongly coupled electron-vibrational manifold involving a localized lattice coordinate. These results identify dispersionless phonons as an active route to vibronic correlations in solids and suggest that such electron-vibrational self-trapping is closely associated with the insulating phase of Rb₂Ni₃S₄.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了笼目化合物Rb₂Ni₃S₄中局域或弱色散声子主导的电子-声子耦合。多种实验表明，该材料在约260至280 K附近经历一种不伴随常规结构或磁有序参量的电子局域化绝缘转变。拉曼光谱显示，近乎无色散的333.7 cm⁻¹声子产生巨大的Franck–Condon级数，并叠加间隔为40.6 cm⁻¹的梳状精细结构。结果表明，局域晶格坐标参与形成强耦合的电子-振动流形，并可能与Rb₂Ni₃S₄的绝缘相密切相关。
authors: Jun Shu, Jun Shen, Yanmin Zhang, Hong Du, Qingsong Wang, Zeyuan Wang, Bin Wang, Zeliang Xu, Dengjing Wang, Hengfu Lin, Zunming Lu, Lei Qin, Jie Yuan, Jinbo Peng, Zhida Song, Fedor V Kusmartsev, Anna Kusmartseva, Kui Jin, Ruidan Zhong, Ge He
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子-声子耦合通常被理解为电子准粒子与具有色散的晶格振动之间的相互作用。相比之下，对于相关声子模本身局域化或弱色散的互补极限，人们所知甚少。在此，我们研究笼目化合物Rb₂Ni₃S₄中的这一情形；该化合物在T*约为260–280 K附近经历一种非传统的绝缘转变。结合偏振分辨拉曼光谱与变温X射线衍射、扫描隧道显微镜以及电学、热学和磁学测量，我们表明，该转变涉及电子局域化，但不存在常规的结构或磁有序参量。拉曼光谱显示，与一个近乎无色散的333.7 cm⁻¹声子相关的巨大Franck–Condon级数，并且其上叠加了间隔均匀、呈梳状的精细结构，特征间隔为40.6 cm⁻¹。梳状结构的间隔对磁场不敏感，而其光谱权重则可通过磁场强烈调节。我们并未将其中任一层级单独视为纯粹的声子效应，而是将这两种嵌套共存的层级结构解释为一种强耦合电子-振动流形的证据，其中包含一个局域化的晶格坐标。这些结果表明，无色散声子可以成为固体中振电关联的一条主动途径，并暗示这种电子-振动自陷与Rb₂Ni₃S₄的绝缘相密切相关。

articles.title: Meandering stripes in the frustrated J₁₋J₂ Ising model on the honeycomb lattice
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格受挫J₁-J₂伊辛模型中的曲折条纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the frustrated J₁₋J₂ Ising model on the honeycomb lattice with ferromagnetic nearest-neighbor couplings fixed at J₁₌₁ and strong antiferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor interactions, i.e., J₂ ≤ -1/4. Little is known for this range of J₂, whereas for less negative values of J₂ the system orders ferromagnetically at low temperatures and appears to remain in the Ising universality class. In previous work it was shown that the model has a largely degenerate ground state, and it was conjectured that there is some kind of phase transition. We introduce a complex-valued nematic order parameter, which can differentiate between the high-temperature paramagnetic phase and the observed partially-disordered stripe phase at lower temperatures. Configurations in this phase consist of stripes of spins parallel with respect to one lattice direction, which collectively meander along the remaining two, producing partially disordered ground states. The sharp peaks in the specific heat observed in earlier work only appear when using periodic boundary conditions and are absent for free boundaries. Additionally, we reveal a striking dependence of the behavior on the aspect ratio of the considered samples. Ultimately, even a careful finite-size scaling analysis for J₂ = -0.5 and J₂ = -1 is unable to clearly discern between a crossover without any singularities and some form of continuous transition, including the possibility of an infinite-order transition of the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) type. For J₂₌₋₁/4 we find that the system remains disordered at all temperatures and that it exhibits a finite ground-state entropy per site, for which our simulations provide the accurate asymptotic estimate S(T=0)/N = 0.230,960,93(14) in the thermodynamic limit N→infty.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了蜂窝晶格上最近邻铁磁耦合固定为J₁=1、次近邻相互作用较强且为反铁磁性的受挫J₁-J₂伊辛模型。研究发现，低温下体系形成部分无序的条纹相，其条纹沿一个晶格方向平行排列，并沿另外两个方向发生曲折。对于J₂=-0.5和-1，有限尺寸标度分析仍无法明确区分无奇异性的交叉行为与连续相变；而在J₂=-1/4时，体系始终无序，并具有每格点有限的基态熵。
authors: Denis Gessert, Martin Weigel, Wolfhard Janke
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了蜂窝晶格上的受挫J₁-J₂伊辛模型，其中铁磁最近邻耦合固定为J₁=1，且次近邻相互作用较强并满足J₂≤-1/4。对于这一J₂范围，人们知之甚少；而在J₂较不负的情况下，体系在低温下呈铁磁有序，并且似乎仍属于伊辛普适类。先前的研究表明，该模型具有高度简并的基态，并据此推测体系可能存在某种相变。我们引入了一个复值向列序参量，用于区分高温顺磁相与低温下观测到的部分无序条纹相。该相中的构型由自旋相对于一个晶格方向平行排列的条纹组成，而这些条纹整体沿其余两个方向曲折延伸，从而产生部分无序的基态。先前研究中观察到的比热尖锐峰仅在采用周期性边界条件时出现，在自由边界条件下则不存在。此外，我们揭示了体系行为对所考察样品长宽比的显著依赖。最终，即使对J₂=-0.5和J₂=-1进行细致的有限尺寸标度分析，也无法清楚地区分没有任何奇异性的交叉行为与某种连续相变，其中还包括无限阶的Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）型相变的可能性。对于J₂=-1/4，我们发现体系在所有温度下都保持无序，并且具有有限的每格点基态熵；模拟给出了热力学极限N→∞下该熵的精确渐近估计S(T=0)/N=0.230,960,93(14)。

articles.title: LCST and Closed-Loop Phase Behavior in Non-Associating Fully Symmetric Multicomponent Polymer Systems
articles.title_zh: 非缔合完全对称多组分聚合物体系中的LCST与闭环相行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21264v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multicomponent liquids can phase separate upon heating, exhibiting a lower critical solution temperature (LCST). Moreover, a narrow class of materials can undergo disordering transition upon further heating, yielding closed-loop phase diagrams. Previously, it was shown that LCST or closed-loop phase behavior can appear in the models of liquids in which components are asymmetric or interaction potentials have a specifically designed attraction. Here, we show theoretically that LCST and closed-loop phase behavior can occur in a significantly wider set of models. In particular, we found that these phenomena can be exhibited by the simplest and widely used coarse-grained (CG) models of any multicomponent liquid in which species are fully symmetric and where all particles interact via an arbitrary repulsive potential. In addition, we discovered that LCST and closed-loop phase behavior in these models emerges merely due to the basic property of CG liquid models, namely, the appearance of strong monomer-monomer positional correlations at low monomer number density ρ. We simulated the models of fully symmetric binary blends and diblock copolymer melts where nonbonded monomers interacted via a generic T-independent purely repulsive harmonic potential. As predicted, LCST and closed-loop phase behavior emerged at ρ sufficiently low to cause strong monomer-monomer correlations leading to a strong T-dependence of the effective coordination number, which, in turn, induced a nonmonotonic T-dependence of the Flory-Huggins parameter. To summarize, we discovered that the simplest fully symmetric non-associating CG models of multicomponent liquids can exhibit complex temperature response due to a mechanism stemming from the basic nature of any CG liquid model. This mechanism might contribute to the emergence of LCST and closed-loop phase behavior in many existing polymer materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从理论上表明，即使在组分完全对称、粒子之间仅存在任意排斥势的最简单粗粒化多组分液体模型中，也能够出现低临界溶解温度（LCST）和闭环相图。其机制源于低单体数密度下增强的单体位置相关性，该相关性导致有效配位数具有显著的温度依赖性，并进一步使Flory-Huggins参数随温度呈非单调变化。对完全对称二元共混物和嵌段共聚物熔体的模拟验证了这一预测，说明该机制可能参与许多现有聚合物材料中LCST和闭环相行为的形成。
