articles.abstract_zh_full: 多组分液体可能在升温时发生相分离，并表现出低临界溶解温度（LCST）。此外，一小类材料在进一步升温时能够经历无序化转变，从而产生闭环相图。先前的研究表明，在组分不对称或相互作用势具有特定设计的吸引作用的液体模型中，可能出现LCST或闭环相行为。在这里，我们从理论上证明，这些现象可以出现在范围显著更广的模型中。具体而言，我们发现，任何多组分液体的最简单且广泛使用的粗粒化（CG）模型，只要其组分完全对称且所有粒子通过任意排斥势相互作用，就可能表现出这些现象。此外，我们发现，这些模型中的LCST和闭环相行为仅仅源于粗粒化液体模型的一个基本性质，即在较低单体数密度ρ₀下会出现强烈的单体-单体位置相关性。我们模拟了完全对称的二元共混物和嵌段共聚物熔体模型，其中非键合单体通过一种与温度无关的通用纯排斥谐势相互作用。正如预测的那样，当ρ₀足够低以产生强烈的单体-单体相关性时，模型中出现了LCST和闭环相行为；这种相关性导致有效配位数具有显著的温度依赖性，进而诱导Flory-Huggins参数随温度呈非单调变化。总之，我们发现，最简单的完全对称、非缔合粗粒化多组分液体模型也能够表现出复杂的温度响应，其原因在于任何粗粒化液体模型的基本性质。这一机制可能促成许多现有聚合物材料中LCST和闭环相行为的出现。

articles.title: Superconducting ground state study of Cr-based equiatomic high-entropy alloy through μSR
articles.title_zh: 通过μSR研究Cr基等原子高熵合金的超导基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-entropy alloy superconductors, characterized by extreme chemical disorder and complex electronic environments, have attracted significant attention as model systems for exploring superconductivity in disordered materials. Here, we investigate a Cr-based equiatomic HEA, Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta, which contains a magnetic 3d element, providing an opportunity to examine the influence of magnetic elements on superconductivity in highly disordered systems. Despite expected magnetic pair-breaking, this alloy exhibits bulk type-II superconductivity with a transition temperature of T_c = 2.33(3) K and a high upper critical field. Transverse-field μSR measurements reveal an s-wave superconducting gap close to the BCS value, while zero-field μSR suggests preserved time-reversal symmetry. These results establish Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta as a promising platform for exploring the interplay between disorder, magnetism and superconductivity in high entropy alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了含有磁性3d元素Cr的Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta等原子高熵合金。尽管预期磁性会导致成对破缺，该合金仍表现出转变温度为T_c=2.33(3) K、具有高上临界场的体相II型超导性。横向场μSR测量显示其具有接近BCS值的s波超导能隙，而零场μSR表明时间反演对称性得以保持。该材料为研究高熵合金中无序、磁性与超导性之间的相互作用提供了平台。
authors: Sonika Jangid, Rhea Stewart, Adrian D. Hillier, R. P. Singh
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高熵合金超导体具有极端的化学无序和复杂的电子环境，近年来作为探索无序材料中超导性的模型体系受到了广泛关注。在这里，我们研究了一种以Cr为基础的等原子高熵合金Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta；该合金含有磁性3d元素，为考察磁性元素对高度无序体系中超导性的影响提供了机会。尽管人们预期磁性会导致成对破缺，该合金仍表现出体相II型超导性，其转变温度为T_c=2.33(3) K，并具有较高的上临界场。横向场μSR测量揭示出接近BCS值的s波超导能隙，而零场μSR则表明时间反演对称性得以保持。这些结果表明，Cr-V-Ti-Nb-Ta是探索高熵合金中无序、磁性和超导性相互作用的有前景平台。

articles.title: Two distinct gap structures in the mid-infrared optical conductivity of the Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: Hubbard模型中中红外光学电导的两种不同能隙结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mid-infrared (MIR) optical conductivities in cuprate superconductors show universal features. In this study, we demonstrate that these originate from two distinct gaps: the pseudogap mediated by antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations and the Mott-Hubbard gap. The MIR spectra from these two gaps show a characteristic and distinct shape and doping dependence, and can thus be distinguished. Specifically, the Mott-Hubbard correlations, while rendering a peak in the visible spectrum for small dopings, yield a broad optical response starting in the MIR when a ``waterfall'' develops in the one-particle spectrum at larger dopings. The numerically and analytically determined doping-dependence of both gaps consistently reproduce experiments, and provide a unified microscopic understanding of the cuprate MIR optical conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明，铜酸盐超导体中红外光学电导的普适特征源于两种不同的能隙：由反铁磁自旋涨落介导的赝能隙和Mott-Hubbard能隙。这两种能隙产生具有不同形状和掺杂依赖性的中红外光谱，因此可以加以区分。对两种能隙掺杂依赖性的数值和解析结果能够一致地再现实验现象，并为铜酸盐中红外光学电导提供统一的微观解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铜酸盐超导体的中红外（MIR）光学电导表现出普适特征。在本研究中，我们证明这些特征源于两种不同的能隙：由反铁磁自旋涨落介导的赝能隙和Mott-Hubbard能隙。这两种能隙产生的MIR光谱具有特征性且彼此不同的形状和掺杂依赖性，因此可以加以区分。具体而言，Mott-Hubbard关联在低掺杂时会使可见光谱中出现一个峰；而在较高掺杂、单粒子谱中形成“瀑布”结构时，则会产生一个从MIR频段开始的宽广光学响应。通过数值和解析方法确定的两种能隙的掺杂依赖性能够一致地再现实验结果，并为铜酸盐超导体的MIR光学电导提供统一的微观理解。

articles.title: Neural quantum states in condensed matter: advances, best practices, and prospects
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态物质中的神经量子态：进展、最佳实践与前景
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide flexible variational representations of quantum many-body wave functions by combining neural-network parametrizations with Monte Carlo sampling. In this perspective, we review recent advances in their application to condensed-matter systems, focusing on frustrated quantum magnets, interacting lattice fermions, and non-equilibrium dynamics. We discuss the architectures, symmetry constraints, optimization methods, and sampling strategies underlying state-of-the-art calculations, and summarize practical guidelines for reliable simulations. We also examine the principal remaining challenges, including learning non-trivial sign and phase structures, controlling variational bias, enforcing physical symmetries, scaling optimization to large networks, and achieving stable real-time evolution. Finally, we outline promising directions in which neural quantum states may extend the reach of classical simulations of strongly correlated quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态通过将神经网络参数化与蒙特卡罗采样相结合，为量子多体波函数提供了灵活的变分表示。本文综述其在受挫量子磁体、相互作用晶格费米子和非平衡动力学中的最新应用，并讨论网络架构、对称性约束、优化方法及采样策略。文章还总结了可靠模拟的实践指南，分析了符号与相位结构学习、变分偏差控制、物理对称性施加、大规模网络优化及稳定实时演化等挑战，并展望其拓展强关联量子物质经典模拟能力的方向。
authors: Jonas B. Rigo, Björn J. Wurst, Rajah Nutakki, Markus Schmitt, Dante Kennes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经量子态通过将神经网络参数化与蒙特卡罗采样相结合，为量子多体波函数提供了灵活的变分表示。在这篇观点文章中，我们回顾神经量子态在凝聚态体系中的最新进展，重点关注受挫量子磁体、相互作用晶格费米子和非平衡动力学。我们讨论当前先进计算所依据的网络架构、对称性约束、优化方法和采样策略，并总结开展可靠模拟的实用指南。我们还考察了仍待解决的主要挑战，包括学习非平凡的符号和相位结构、控制变分偏差、施加物理对称性、将优化扩展到大型网络，以及实现稳定的实时演化。最后，我们概述了神经量子态有望进一步拓展经典模拟强关联量子物质能力的方向。

articles.title: Ultralow-Field Triplon Condensation in a Spin-Ladder Magnet
articles.title_zh: 自旋梯磁体中的超低场三重态凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We realise the first ultralow-field Bose-Einstein condensation of triplons in a spin-ladder magnet, uncovering a quantum critical point at only μ₀ Hc₁=0.17 T in Henmilite (Ca₂Cu(OH)₄[B(OH)₄]₂₎. Unlike dimer magnets, a ladder retains extended one-dimensional correlations in its gapped parent state, making this limit strongly fluctuation dominated. Thermodynamic, magnetoelastic, μSR, and neutron-diffraction measurements overturn the previous assignment of zero-field antiferromagnetic order, establishing a quantum-disordered coupled-ladder parent state with persistent low-energy dynamics. The weak low-temperature anomaly instead marks a gap-controlled crossover from the correlated ladder regime into the activated quantum-disordered state. These measurements further reveal an exceptionally asymmetric ordered dome extending to μ₀ Hc₂simeq 8.2 T. Quantum Monte Carlo simulations for the relevant spin Hamiltonian place Henmilite just on the gapped side of the zero-field ladder-ordering instability, naturally accounting for the strong separation between the exchange and residual-gap scales and the tiny critical field. Our findings extend ultralow-field triplon condensation beyond the dimer paradigm and establish Henmilite as a platform for controlled tuning across quantum criticality in a fluctuation-dominated spin ladder.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们在自旋梯磁体Henmilite中实现了首个超低磁场三重态玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，并发现量子临界点仅位于μ₀H_c1=0.17 T。热力学、磁弹性、μSR和中子衍射测量表明，其零场基态并非此前认为的反铁磁有序态，而是具有持续低能动力学的量子无序耦合自旋梯态。量子蒙特卡罗模拟显示，该材料位于零场梯有序不稳定性的有隙一侧，从而解释了极小临界场及其高度不对称的有序区域。
authors: Ankit Labh, Ross H. Colman, Jakub Šebesta, Noah Oefele, Elsa Lhotel, Adam Berlie, Paul Steffens, Oksana Zaharko, Pascal Manuel, Iurii Kibalin, Philipp Gegenwart, Dominik Legut, Johanna K. Jochum, Alexander A. Tsirlin, Petr Čermák
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在自旋梯磁体中实现了首个超低磁场三重态玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，并在Henmilite（Ca₂Cu(OH)₄[B(OH)₄]₂）中发现了仅位于μ₀H_c1=0.17 T的量子临界点。与二聚体磁体不同，自旋梯在其有隙母态中保留了延展的一维关联，使这一极限状态受到强烈涨落的支配。热力学、磁弹性、μSR和中子衍射测量推翻了此前关于零场反铁磁有序的判断，确立了一个具有持续低能动力学的量子无序耦合自旋梯母态。低温下较弱的异常反而标志着一个由能隙控制的交叉过程，即从关联自旋梯区域进入热激活的量子无序态。这些测量还揭示了一个极度不对称的有序穹顶，其范围延伸至μ₀H_c2≈8.2 T。针对相关自旋哈密顿量的量子蒙特卡罗模拟表明，Henmilite恰好位于零场自旋梯有序不稳定性的有隙一侧，这自然解释了交换能标与剩余能隙能标之间的巨大分离以及极小的临界场。我们的研究将超低场三重态凝聚拓展到了二聚体范式之外，并确立了Henmilite作为一个可在受涨落主导的自旋梯中跨量子临界性进行可控调谐的平台。

articles.title: Dirac Surface States and Nonlocal Quantum Tunneling in Topological Semiconductor Mo₂SeTe₃ for High-Performance Tunnel FETs
articles.title_zh: 拓扑半导体Mo₂SeTe₃中的狄拉克表面态与非局域量子隧穿：面向高性能隧穿场效应晶体管
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A first-principles and device-level study of the quasi-two-dimensional transition-metal chalcogenide Mo₂SeTe₃ is performed. The material is found to be a weak topological semiconductor with a finite bulk band gap and symmetry-protected Dirac surface states, indicating strong potential for next-generation low-power quantum electronic devices. An SOC-driven band inversion accompanied by an indirect semiconducting gap of approximately 0.75 eV is observed. Topological nontriviality is rigorously confirmed through Wannier charge-center evolution and Z₂ invariant analysis, yielding weak topological indices of (0;001), while iterative Green's-function surface-state calculations corroborate Dirac-cone conducting states traversing the bulk gap on symmetry-preserving surfaces. Mo₂SeTe₃ additionally exhibits exceptional dynamical and mechanical stability, pronounced optical anisotropy, high dielectric polarizability, broad infrared-to-visible optical absorption, a large static dielectric constant, and substantial birefringence, making it favorable for photonic and optoelectronic applications. Thermoelectric transport analyses further reveal enhanced carrier mobility and a competitive figure of merit under n-type doping near room temperature. A dual-source tunnel field-effect transistor (TFET) is implemented via TCAD simulations with nonlocal band-to-band tunneling, yielding subthreshold switching below the thermionic limit, a high ON/OFF current ratio, and enhanced tunneling efficiency driven by SOC-induced orbital hybridization and topologically enhanced interband coupling. The concurrent realization of nontrivial bulk-boundary correspondence, robust transport properties, and steep-slope switching characteristics establishes Mo₂SeTe₃ as a multifunctional quantum material platform for topological and next-generation energy-efficient nanoelectronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对准二维过渡金属硫属化物Mo₂SeTe₃进行了第一性原理和器件层面的研究。该材料被确定为具有有限体能隙和受对称性保护狄拉克表面态的弱拓扑半导体，并表现出约0.75 eV的自旋轨道耦合驱动带反转及间接半导体带隙。器件模拟表明，采用非局域带间隧穿的双源隧穿场效应晶体管具有低于热发射极限的亚阈值摆幅、高开关电流比和增强的隧穿效率，显示出其作为新一代低功耗纳米电子材料的平台潜力。
authors: Zafar Sadik Mehrub, Suvodip Kundu Arnob, Md. Tareq Mahmud, Nazmul Hasan, Alamgir Kabir
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对准二维过渡金属硫属化物Mo₂SeTe₃进行了第一性原理和器件层面的研究。研究发现，该材料是一种弱拓扑半导体，具有有限的体能隙和受对称性保护的狄拉克表面态，显示出其在下一代低功耗量子电子器件中的巨大潜力。我们观察到由自旋轨道耦合驱动的能带反转，并伴随约0.75 eV的间接半导体带隙。通过Wannier电荷中心演化和Z₂拓扑不变量分析，我们严格确认了其拓扑非平庸性，得到弱拓扑指标(0;001)；迭代格林函数表面态计算进一步证实，在保持对称性的表面上存在穿越体能隙的狄拉克锥导电态。Mo₂SeTe₃还表现出优异的动力学和机械稳定性、显著的光学各向异性、高介电极化率、从红外到可见光的宽谱光学吸收、较大的静态介电常数以及明显的双折射，因此有利于光子学和光电应用。热电输运分析进一步表明，在接近室温的n型掺杂条件下，该材料具有增强的载流子迁移率和具有竞争力的优值。我们通过TCAD模拟实现了一种采用非局域带间隧穿的双源隧穿场效应晶体管（TFET），其亚阈值开关低于热发射极限，并具有较高的开关电流比和增强的隧穿效率；这些性能源于自旋轨道耦合诱导的轨道杂化以及拓扑增强的带间耦合。体-边界对应关系的非平庸性、稳健的输运性质和陡峭斜率开关特性的共同实现，使Mo₂SeTe₃成为面向拓扑器件和下一代高能效纳米电子器件的多功能量子材料平台。

articles.title: Real-time ESR tracking for sub-micron 3D magnetic mapping with VB- quantum sensors in hexagonal boron nitride
articles.title_zh: 利用六方氮化硼中的VB⁻量子传感器进行亚微米三维磁成像的实时ESR跟踪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20502v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The discovery of spin-dependent luminescent properties of negatively charged boron-vacancy centers (V⁻_B) in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) enabled a new platform for quantum sensing with van der Waals materials. Particularly, the possibility of performing optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) for determining the electron spin resonance (ESR) frequencies of hBN color centers became a strong tool for quantum sensing of magnetic fields with submicrometric resolution. However, due to low ODMR contrast, current techniques proposed for mapping DC magnetic fields require hours of integration to obtain a magnetic image of a micron-sized region. In this work, we report the implementation of a frequency-tracking approach for real-time monitoring of ESR frequencies of localized V⁻_B centers in hBN. With this technique, magnetic field monitoring was used to map the field pattern generated by a micron-sized conical magnetic tip in only a few minutes. By controlling the magnetic sample's position relative to the quantum sensor, three-dimensional magnetic mapping of the field was achieved with diffraction-limited resolution and shot-noise-limited sensitivity of 54 μT/sqrtHz. Magnetic field gradients of 3.6 ± 0.2 μT/nm were measured with our system, in which a maximum detected field rate of 6 mT/s was achieved. The results of this study establish spin resonance frequency-tracking as a viable technique and fast method for minute-scale magnetic imaging, reducing acquisition times by at least one order of magnitude if compared to conventional techniques.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们实现了一种频率跟踪方法，用于实时监测六方氮化硼中局域负电荷硼空位中心的电子自旋共振频率。借助该方法，仅需数分钟即可绘制微米级锥形磁性探针产生的磁场图案，并通过控制样品相对于量子传感器的位置实现三维磁场成像。系统达到衍射极限分辨率和54 μT/√Hz的散粒噪声极限灵敏度，测得磁场梯度为3.6±0.2 μT/nm，最大探测磁场变化率为6 mT/s。
authors: Jefferson A. O. Galindo, Edwin D. C. Sanchez, Cecília L. A. V. Campos, Allison R. Pessoa, Hugo A. D. Correia, José D. M. de Lima, Klaus Krambrock, Leonardo de S. Menezes, Anderson M. Amaral
articles.abstract_zh_full: 负电荷硼空位中心（V⁻_B）具有自旋依赖的发光性质，这一发现使六方氮化硼（hBN）范德瓦耳斯材料成为量子传感的新平台。特别是，通过光学探测磁共振（ODMR）确定hBN色心的电子自旋共振（ESR）频率的可能性，已经成为实现亚微米分辨率磁场传感的重要工具。然而，由于ODMR对比度较低，目前用于绘制直流磁场图像的技术需要数小时积分时间，才能获得微米级区域的磁图。在本研究中，我们报告了对hBN中局域V⁻_B中心的ESR频率进行实时监测的频率跟踪方法。利用该技术，我们对磁场进行监测，并在仅数分钟内绘制出了微米级锥形磁性探针产生的磁场图案。通过控制磁性样品相对于量子传感器的位置，我们实现了磁场的三维成像，分辨率达到衍射极限，散粒噪声极限灵敏度为54 μT/√Hz。利用该系统，我们测得磁场梯度为3.6±0.2 μT/nm，并实现了最高6 mT/s的探测磁场变化率。本研究结果确立了自旋共振频率跟踪作为一种可行且快速的技术，可用于分钟尺度的磁成像；与传统技术相比，它将采集时间至少缩短了一个数量级。

articles.title: Impact of Plasmonic Modes and Thermophysical Properties on the Double-Pulse Structuring of Highly-Ordered LIPSS for Biosensing Applications
articles.title_zh: 等离激元模式与热物性对用于生物传感的高度有序LIPSS双脉冲构造的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20573v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The fabrication of highly ordered laser-induced periodic surface structures (LIPSS) on thin metallic films is dictated, predomaninatly, by a synergy of periodic electromagnetic energy deposition and complex fluid dynamics. In this work, we present a combined experimental and theoretical study on the formation of ultra-regular LIPSS on 32-nm-thick Au films using a double-pulse femtosecond laser scheme. We demonstrate that for thin films, the excitation of coupled Surface Plasmon Polaritons (SPPs) at both interfaces dictates the initial energy distribution. On the othe hand, the final morphology is greatly influenced by hydrodynamical processes. Interestingly, due to the low electron-phonon coupling of Au and the high thermal confinement of the thin film, single-pulse irradiation leads to uncontrolled hydrodynamic instabilities a non uniform topographies. Thus, we demonstrate that a double-pulse approach with an optimized interpulse delay (Δτ=1.2 ns) effectively controls the melt duration and viscosity, suppressing complex fluid motion and promoting the growth of highly ordered arrays. These structures support narrow surface lattice resonances (SLRs) suitable for high-sensitivity plasmonic biosensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们结合实验和理论研究，考察了利用双脉冲飞秒激光在32 nm厚金膜上形成超规则激光诱导周期性表面结构（LIPSS）的机制。结果表明，两个界面处耦合表面等离激元极化激元决定初始能量分布，而流体动力学过程主导最终形貌；单脉冲照射会产生不受控的流体动力学不稳定性。通过采用优化的1.2 ns脉冲间隔，双脉冲方案能够控制熔融持续时间和黏度，抑制复杂流动并促进高度有序阵列形成，从而支持适用于高灵敏度等离激元生物传感的窄线宽表面晶格共振。
authors: G. D. Tsibidis, F. Fraggelakis, P. Lingos, E. Cusworth, V. G. Kravets, A. N. Grigorenko, A. V. Kabashin, E. Stratakis
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在薄金属膜上制备高度有序的激光诱导周期性表面结构（LIPSS），主要由周期性电磁能量沉积与复杂流体动力学之间的协同作用决定。在本工作中，我们针对利用双脉冲飞秒激光方案在32 nm厚金膜上形成超规则LIPSS，开展了实验与理论相结合的研究。我们证明，对于薄膜，两个界面处耦合表面等离激元极化激元（SPP）的激发决定了初始能量分布。另一方面，最终形貌在很大程度上受到流体动力学过程的影响。有趣的是，由于金的电子-声子耦合较弱且薄膜具有较高的热约束，单脉冲照射会导致不受控的流体动力学不稳定性和不均匀的表面形貌。因此，我们证明，采用具有优化脉冲间隔（Δτ=1.2 ns）的双脉冲方法，能够有效控制熔融持续时间和黏度，抑制复杂流体运动，并促进高度有序阵列的生长。这些结构支持窄线宽表面晶格共振（SLR），适用于高灵敏度等离激元生物传感。

articles.title: Nonlinear Diamagnetic Interactions in Ultrastrongly Coupled 2D Electrons
articles.title_zh: 超强耦合二维电子系统中的非线性抗磁相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20578v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Hopfield model is widely used to describe ultrastrong light--matter coupling between cavity photons and collective bosonic excitations in solids, where the diamagnetic interaction is conventionally assumed to be a constant. We experimentally demonstrate that the diamagnetic response of Landau polaritons is reduced under strong terahertz field excitation. We show that this behavior originates from field-driven redistribution of electrons into the nonparabolic regime of the conduction band of GaAs, which reduces the plasma frequency and consequently the diamagnetic interaction strength. A microscopic hot-electron model reproduces the observed nonlinear response. Motivated by this microscopic picture, we propose a nonlinear extension of the Hopfield model with a Kerr-like interaction. Our results establish a route toward nonlinear cavity quantum electrodynamics and driven ultrastrong light--matter coupling beyond the conventional linear Hopfield description, which is capable of creating uniquely quantum optical effects such as squeezed light generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子Hopfield模型通常将抗磁相互作用视为常数，用于描述腔光子与固体中集体玻色激发之间的超强光-物质耦合。我们实验发现，在强太赫兹场激发下，Landau极化激元的抗磁响应会减弱，并证明其源于电子被驱动重新分布到GaAs导带的非抛物区域，从而降低等离子体频率及抗磁相互作用强度。基于这一微观机制，我们提出了带有类Kerr相互作用的非线性Hopfield模型，为研究超越传统线性描述的非线性腔量子电动力学和受驱动超强光-物质耦合提供了路径。
authors: Dasom Kim, Kiran M. Kulkarni, Vaibhav Sharma, Dukhyung Lee, Geon Lee, Sunghwan Kim, Jonas Grumm, Shuang Liang, Hongjing Xu, Fuyang Tay, Andrey Baydin, Motoaki Bamba, Andreas Knorr, Christopher J. Stanton, Michael J. Manfra, Minah Seo, Stephen Hughes, Junichiro Kono
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子Hopfield模型被广泛用于描述腔光子与固体中集体玻色激发之间的超强光-物质耦合，其中抗磁相互作用通常被假定为常数。我们实验上证明，在强太赫兹场激发下，Landau极化激元的抗磁响应会减弱。我们表明，这一行为源于电子在场驱动下重新分布到GaAs导带的非抛物区域，从而降低了等离子体频率，并因此减小了抗磁相互作用强度。一个微观热电子模型再现了观测到的非线性响应。受这一微观图像启发，我们提出了带有类Kerr相互作用的Hopfield模型非线性扩展。我们的结果为发展非线性腔量子电动力学以及超越传统线性Hopfield描述的受驱动超强光-物质耦合建立了路径；后者能够产生诸如压缩光生成等独特的量子光学效应。

articles.title: Restoring heat and particle flow in strongly coupled non-equilibrium devices
articles.title_zh: 恢复强耦合非平衡器件中的热流与粒子流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20737v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Under non-equilibrium conditions, energy/particle currents flow through a quantum system coupled to multiple baths. Although the fluxes increase in the weak coupling regime as the coupling strengthens, the reason why they decrease to zero for large coupling remains unknown. This counterintuitive behavior of energy exchange or transport phenomena is called the turnover effect. It has been predicted in several quantum systems such as photosynthetic complexes, mesoscopic junctions, quantum heat machines, and chemical networks without a single counterexample, and it results in constrained performance due to limited currents. Here, we use scattering theory to study the turnover effect produced by low-zdensity reservoirs of free particles scattered by a quantum system through localized potentials. We find that the turnover effect is a consequence of total reflection that impedes the reservoir particle from reaching the interaction region and exchanging energy with the quantum system. Moreover, we design a protocol based on quantum tunneling to avoid the turnover and to increase the maximum current. This strategy could be used to unleash the full potential of devices based on temperature/chemical potential gradients.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们利用散射理论研究了低密度自由粒子库在局域势作用下被量子系统散射时产生的输运周转效应。研究表明，强耦合下能量或粒子流下降至零，是由于粒子发生全反射，无法到达相互作用区域并与量子系统交换能量。我们还设计了一种基于量子隧穿的方案，以避免周转效应并提高最大电流，从而有望释放温度梯度或化学势梯度驱动器件的输运潜力。
authors: Noa Ludwin, Ohad Cremerman, Milan Šindelka, David Gelbwaser-Klimovsky
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在非平衡条件下，与多个热库耦合的量子系统中会有能量流和粒子流通过。尽管在弱耦合区域，随着耦合增强，通量会增加，但当耦合很强时通量为何会降至零仍然未知。这种违反直觉的能量交换或输运现象被称为周转效应。它已在光合作用复合物、介观结、量子热机和化学网络等多个量子体系中被预言，且迄今没有反例；该效应会因电流受限而导致器件性能受约束。在这里，我们利用散射理论研究了由低密度自由粒子库产生的周转效应，其中自由粒子通过局域势被量子系统散射。我们发现，周转效应源于全反射：全反射阻止热库粒子到达相互作用区域并与量子系统交换能量。此外，我们设计了一种基于量子隧穿的方案，以避免周转效应并提高最大电流。这一策略可用于释放依赖温度梯度或化学势梯度的器件的全部潜力。

articles.title: Spectral Anisotropy in Transition Radiation from Biaxial Media
articles.title_zh: 双轴介质中过渡辐射的光谱各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20746v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In anisotropic optical media, the electromagnetic response depends on the orientation of the optical field relative to the material's principal dielectric axes. While this direction dependence is well understood in conventional optics, it should also influence light-generation processes driven by free electrons. Here, we experimentally observe spectrally anisotropic transition radiation from biaxial van der Waals crystals. Using cathodoluminescence spectroscopy on germanium sulphide (GeS) and molybdenum oxydichloride (MoOCl₂₎ crystals, we show that the transition-radiation spectra differ along the principal in-plane optical axes. To describe this spectral anisotropy, we develop a thin-film transition-radiation model that reproduces the experimental observations. Our results demonstrate that transition radiation is a sensitive probe of the axis-dependent dielectric response of biaxial optical media and suggest that optical anisotropy can provide an additional degree of freedom for free electron-driven spectroscopy, radiation sources, and transition-radiation-based diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在各向异性光学介质中，电磁响应取决于光场相对于材料主介电轴的方向。我们通过阴极发光光谱实验观察到，双轴范德瓦耳斯晶体会产生具有光谱各向异性的过渡辐射；在GeS和MoOCl₂晶体的两个面内主光学轴方向上，过渡辐射光谱存在差异。我们建立的薄膜过渡辐射模型能够再现实验结果，表明过渡辐射可作为探测双轴介质轴向介电响应的灵敏工具。
authors: Sven Ebel, Bibi Mary Francis, Min Seok Jang, Brian D. Gerardot, N. Asger Mortensen, Mauro Brotons-Gisbert, Sergii Morozov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在各向异性光学介质中，电磁响应取决于光场相对于材料主介电轴的方向。尽管这种方向依赖性在传统光学中已经得到充分理解，但它也应当影响由自由电子驱动的光生成过程。在这里，我们实验观察到了双轴范德瓦耳斯晶体中过渡辐射的光谱各向异性。通过对硫化锗（GeS）和二氯化氧化钼（MoOCl₂）晶体进行阴极发光光谱测量，我们表明，沿面内主光学轴的不同方向，过渡辐射光谱存在差异。为了描述这种光谱各向异性，我们建立了一个薄膜过渡辐射模型，该模型再现了实验观测结果。我们的研究表明，过渡辐射是探测双轴光学介质轴向依赖介电响应的灵敏工具，并说明光学各向异性能够为自由电子驱动的光谱学、辐射源以及基于过渡辐射的诊断提供额外的自由度。

articles.title: Coherence-Based Identification of Carbon-Based Spin Qubits in Hexagonal Boron Nitride from First Principles
articles.title_zh: 基于相干性的六方氮化硼中碳基自旋量子比特的第一性原理识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20833v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Carbon-related defects in hexagonal boron nitride are promising room-temperature single-spin qubits and quantum sensors, but their atomic structures remain largely unidentified. Here we show, using first-principles calculations of electron-spin decoherence, that the atomic structure of each defect is imprinted in its spin coherence. Mapping the Hahn-echo dynamics of seven candidate carbon defects across magnetic field and four isotope-engineered nuclear-spin baths, we find that electron-spin-echo envelope modulation emerges at defect-specific magnetic fields, at which the nearest-neighbor nuclear spins satisfy a cancellation condition set by their hyperfine and quadrupole couplings. Both the fields and the modulation frequencies follow from an analytical model using computed hyperfine and quadrupole tensors alone, and they shift or vanish upon isotope substitution. At low fields, the field dependence of the coherence time separates the defects into two classes according to the sublattice occupied by carbon. These decoherence fingerprints, directly testable in isotope-engineered samples, establish a structural identification route complementary to optical spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 碳相关缺陷是有前景的室温单自旋量子比特和量子传感器，但其原子结构尚未得到充分识别。本文通过第一性原理计算表明，缺陷的原子结构会反映在自旋相干性中，并利用不同磁场和同位素工程核自旋浴下的 Hahn 回波动力学，建立结构识别方法。
authors: Hyeonsu Kim, Jaewook Lee, Huijin Park, Hosung Seo
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.20833v1，公告类型：交叉。六方氮化硼中的碳相关缺陷是很有前景的室温单自旋量子比特和量子传感器，但它们的原子结构在很大程度上仍未被确定。在这里，我们利用电子自旋退相干的第一性原理计算表明，每种缺陷的原子结构都印刻在其自旋相干性中。我们研究了七种候选碳缺陷在四种同位素工程化核自旋浴以及不同磁场下的 Hahn 回波动力学，发现电子自旋回波包络调制会在缺陷特定的磁场处出现；在这些磁场处，最近邻核自旋满足由超精细耦合和四极耦合共同决定的抵消条件。磁场位置和调制频率均可仅利用计算得到的超精细张量与四极张量，通过解析模型推导出来，并且会在同位素替换后发生移动或消失。在低磁场下，相干时间随磁场的变化关系可依据碳所占据的子晶格将缺陷分为两类。这些退相干指纹可在同位素工程化样品中直接检验，从而建立了一条与光谱学互补的结构识别途径。

articles.title: Spin models with critical ground space degeneracy from Lie algebra relations
articles.title_zh: 源于李代数关系的具有临界基态空间简并度的自旋模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20849v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce an SO(3)-symmetric spin model derived from the algebraic structure of mathfrakso(3): It is obtained as the nearest-neighbor parent Hamiltonian of a Matrix Product State (MPS) built from the generators of the Lie algebra mathfrakso(3) and the identity matrix, and therefore encodes the quadratic relations of the Lie algebra. We characterize the ground space structure of the resulting model and show that for open boundary conditions (OBC), it exhibits a quadratic ground space degeneracy, given by one irreducible representation (irrep) of each odd dimension (integer spin). For periodic boundary conditions (PBC), it has a linear ground space degeneracy, consisting of a singlet --- namely, the MPS underlying the model --- and a ferromagnet (the irrep with maximal spin), and thus exhibits gapless excitations. We also generalize the construction and the analysis of the OBC ground space to SO(d) and other compact simple Lie groups. The MPS on which the model is based is an injective MPS, and therefore, its 3-site parent Hamiltonian has a unique ground space and is gapped. The observed critical behavior thus has its origin in the small parent Hamiltonian considered. The model's algebraic ground space scaling thus provides an example distinct from that reported in (Schuch et al., 2025, arXiv:2503.10767), where it was shown that small parent Hamiltonians of injective MPS generically have unique ground states, and examples with an exponential ground space degeneracy were given.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从 so(3) 李代数的代数结构出发，构造了一个具有 SO(3) 对称性的自旋模型。其开放边界条件下的基态简并度呈二次增长，每个奇数维不可约表示各贡献一个基态；周期边界条件下则呈线性增长，并包含单态和铁磁态。作者还将构造推广到 SO(d) 及其他紧致简单李群，并指出临界行为源于所采用的小尺度母哈密顿量。
authors: Andras Molnar, Efekan Kökcü, Norbert Schuch, Bojko N. Bakalov
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.20849v1，公告类型：交叉。我们介绍了一种从 so(3) 李代数的代数结构导出的 SO(3) 对称自旋模型：该模型是由 so(3) 李代数生成元和单位矩阵构成的矩阵乘积态（MPS）的最近邻母哈密顿量，因此编码了李代数的二次关系。我们刻画了所得模型的基态空间结构，并证明在开放边界条件（OBC）下，它具有二次的基态空间简并度，其形式是每个奇数维的一个不可约表示（整数自旋）。对于周期边界条件（PBC），其基态空间简并度呈线性增长，由一个单态（即作为该模型基础的 MPS）和一个铁磁态（具有最大自旋的不可约表示）组成，因而表现出无隙激发。我们还将 OBC 下基态空间的构造和分析推广到 SO(d) 及其他紧致简单李群。该模型所基于的 MPS 是一个可注入 MPS，因此其三位点母哈密顿量具有唯一基态空间并且是有能隙的。由此，所观察到的临界行为源于所考虑的小尺度母哈密顿量。该模型基态空间的代数标度行为提供了一个不同于 Schuch 等人（2025，arXiv:2503.10767）所报告情形的例子；后者表明，可注入 MPS 的小尺度母哈密顿量通常具有唯一基态，并给出了基态简并度呈指数增长的例子。

articles.title: Characterizing Multimode Effects in a Guided Matterwave Gyroscope
articles.title_zh: 导引物质波陀螺仪中的多模效应表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20889v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We theoretically investigate the performance of a compact matterwave vortex gyroscope formed by a two-component Bose-Einstein condensate in a toroidal potential. Unlike conventional atomic gyroscopes that rely on the Sagnac effect, the topological stability of the vortex state yields rotation sensitivity independent of the enclosed area, making the device robust against geometric drifts. Using fully quantum multimode simulations, we quantify two interaction-driven mechanisms that degrade performance: phase diffusion from one-axis-twisting and four-wave mixing from intercomponent scattering. We identify regimes where tuning interaction and trapping parameters produces a trade-off between these effects, and find that reducing the intercomponent scattering length can counterintuitively worsen sensitivity. Finally, we compare the vortex gyroscope to a guided Sagnac interferometer, demonstrating superior scaling, establishing it as a promising candidate for compact precision rotation sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了由环形势中的双组分玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚构成的紧凑型物质波涡旋陀螺仪。量子多模模拟表明，单轴扭转引起的相位扩散以及组分间散射导致的四波混频会降低性能。研究还揭示了相互作用和俘获参数之间的权衡，并表明该涡旋陀螺仪相较导引式 Sagnac 干涉仪具有更优的标度特性。
authors: Jessica K. Eastman, Ellen Zheng, Stuart S. Szigeti, Simon A. Haine
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.20889v1，公告类型：交叉。我们从理论上研究了一种由环形势中的双组分玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚构成的紧凑型物质波涡旋陀螺仪。不同于依赖 Sagnac 效应的传统原子陀螺仪，涡旋态的拓扑稳定性使旋转灵敏度与所围面积无关，从而使该器件能够抵抗几何漂移。利用完全量子的多模模拟，我们量化了两种由相互作用驱动的性能退化机制：单轴扭转引起的相位扩散，以及组分间散射引起的四波混频。我们确定了通过调节相互作用和俘获参数可以在这两种效应之间实现权衡的参数区域，并发现降低组分间散射长度反而可能恶化灵敏度。最后，我们将涡旋陀螺仪与导引式 Sagnac 干涉仪进行了比较，证明前者具有更优的标度特性，表明其是紧凑型精密旋转传感的有希望候选方案。

articles.title: Quantum thermodynamics and semidefinite optimization: Boltzmann, Fermi-Dirac, and Bose-Einstein frameworks
articles.title_zh: 量子热力学与半定优化：玻尔兹曼、费米-狄拉克和玻色-爱因斯坦框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21123v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Here we argue how quantum thermodynamics offers a unifying interpretation for a wide class of semidefinite programs (SDPs) that arise in quantum information. Three SDP variable constraints, namely trace-one density operators, operator-bounded measurements, and the unbounded positive semidefinite cone, admit thermodynamic regularizations associated with Boltzmann, Fermi-Dirac, and Bose-Einstein statistics, respectively. In each case the entropy-regularized dual is unconstrained and concave in a chemical-potential vector, and the primal optimum is a thermal operator of the matched statistics. The dual gradient and Hessian are thermal expectation values, enabling hybrid quantum-classical algorithms for solving a wide variety of SDPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出，量子热力学能够统一解释量子信息中出现的多类半定规划问题。迹为一的密度算符、有界测量算符和无界正半定锥分别对应玻尔兹曼、费米-狄拉克和玻色-爱因斯坦统计的热力学正则化。相应的熵正则化对偶问题是关于化学势向量的无约束凹优化问题，其梯度和 Hessian 可由热期望值表示，从而支持混合量子-经典算法。
authors: Michele Minervini, Nana Liu, Dhrumil Patel, Mark M. Wilde
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.21123v1，公告类型：交叉。在这里，我们论述量子热力学如何为量子信息中出现的广泛半定规划（SDP）提供一种统一解释。三类 SDP 变量约束，即迹为一的密度算符、有算符界的测量以及无界的正半定锥，分别具有与玻尔兹曼、费米-狄拉克和玻色-爱因斯坦统计相联系的热力学正则化。在每种情况下，熵正则化后的对偶问题关于化学势向量是无约束的凹函数，而原问题的最优解则是具有相应统计形式的热算符。对偶梯度和 Hessian 都是热期望值，这使得能够利用混合量子-经典算法求解广泛的 SDP。

articles.title: The transverse matter Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 横向物质哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21211v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Enrico Fermi in 1932 used classical Gauss equation to derive the Coulomb density--density interaction from the longitudinal electromagnetic potential. In this work we extend the Fermi procedure to the transverse component of the vector potential. By using a fully quantum canonical transformation, we replace the transverse vector potential with a current--current and current--current--density interactions. The transformed Hamiltonian is, then, projected in the fermionic space providing a matter--only, totally incoherent and gauge respecting Hamiltonian. The removal of coherence will avoid the breakdown of perturbation theory predicted by Haag's theorem, and make possible to introduce, in the transformed space, the diagrammatic approach. After discussing the implications of the transverse interactions on the current theories based on the Fermi procedure, we conclude by showing how the transverse Hamiltonian provides the quantum origin of the electromagnetic longitudinal--transverse splitting of phonons and other elemental excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将费米利用经典高斯方程从纵向电磁势导出库仑密度-密度相互作用的方法，推广到矢势的横向分量。通过完全量子的正则变换，横向矢势被替换为电流-电流和电流-电流-密度相互作用，并得到仅含物质、完全非相干且保持规范对称性的哈密顿量。作者进一步讨论了该横向哈密顿量对声子及其他基本激发中电磁纵向-横向分裂起源的解释。
authors: Andrea Marini, Kai Wu, Riccardo Reho
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.21211v1，公告类型：交叉。1932 年，恩里科·费米利用经典高斯方程，从纵向电磁势导出了库仑密度-密度相互作用。在本工作中，我们将费米的方法推广到矢势的横向分量。通过使用完全量子的正则变换，我们以电流-电流相互作用和电流-电流-密度相互作用替换横向矢势。随后，将变换后的哈密顿量投影到费米子空间中，得到一个仅含物质、完全非相干且保持规范对称性的哈密顿量。去除相干性将避免 Haag 定理所预言的微扰理论崩溃，并使得能够在变换后的空间中引入图形方法。在讨论横向相互作用对基于费米方法的现有理论的影响之后，我们最后展示横向哈密顿量如何提供声子及其他基本激发中电磁纵向-横向分裂的量子起源。

articles.title: Pressure sensitivity in non-local flow behaviour of dense hydrogel particle suspensions
articles.title_zh: 致密水凝胶颗粒悬浮液非局域流动行为中的压力敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2308.00140v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Slowly sheared particulate media like sand and suspensions flow heterogeneously as they yield via shear bands, in which most strain accumulates. Understanding shear band localization from microscopics is still a major challenge. One class of so-called non-local theories identified that the width of the shearing zone should depend on the stress field, in particular through the local distance to the yield point of the material. We explicitly test this stress sensitivity picture by using a uniquely stress-tunable suspension while probing its flow behavior in a classic geometry in which shear bands are known to scale nontrivially with local stress: the Split-Bottom Shear Cell. The stress-tunable suspension is composed of mildly polydisperse soft, slippery hydrogel spheres submersed in water. We measure their flow profiles and rheology while controlling the confinement stress via both hydrostatic effects and compression. Unique for these soft particles is that we can probe flow fields under confining normal stresses that reach about 1% of their elastic modulus. We determine the average angular velocity profiles in the quasi-static flow regime using Magnetic Resonance Imaging based particle image velocimetry and discrete element method simulations. We explicitly match a pressure-sensitive non-local granular fluidity (NGF) model to observed flow behavior. We find that shear bands for this type of suspension become extremely broad under the low confining stresses from the almost density-matched fluid particle mixture, while collapsing to a narrow shear zone under finite, externally imposed compression levels. The DEM and NGF results match the observations qualitatively, confirming the conjectured pressure sensitivity for suspensions and its role in the NGF model. Our results indicate that pressure sensitivity should be part of non-local flow rules to describe slow flows of granular media.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用可调应力的软水凝胶颗粒悬浮液，在分裂底部剪切池中检验非局域理论关于剪切带宽度依赖局部应力的预测。磁共振成像粒子图像测速和离散元模拟显示，接近密度匹配、低约束压力下剪切带极宽，而施加有限压缩后会收缩为窄剪切区。结果支持非局域颗粒流动性模型中的压力敏感性，并表明其应纳入慢速颗粒介质流动规律。
authors: Zohreh Farmani, Nazanin Ghods, Harkirat Singh, Jing Wang, Ralf Stannarius, Stefan Radl, David L. Henann, Joshua A. Dijksman
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2308.00140v2，公告类型：替换。缓慢剪切的颗粒介质，如沙子和悬浮液，在屈服时会通过剪切带发生非均匀流动，其中大部分应变会累积在剪切带内。从微观层面理解剪切带局域化仍然是一个重大挑战。一类所谓的非局域理论认为，剪切区域的宽度应取决于应力场，尤其取决于材料局部状态距离屈服点的程度。我们使用一种独特的应力可调悬浮液，在一个经典几何构型中明确检验这一应力敏感图景；在该构型中，剪切带已知会以非平凡方式随局部应力变化，即分裂底部剪切池。该应力可调悬浮液由轻度多分散、柔软且低摩擦的水凝胶球浸没在水中构成。我们通过静水效应和压缩两种方式控制约束应力，同时测量其流动廓线和流变性质。这些柔性颗粒的独特之处在于，我们能够在达到其弹性模量约 1% 的约束法向应力下探测流场。我们利用基于磁共振成像的粒子图像测速和离散元方法模拟，确定准静态流动状态下的平均角速度廓线。我们将压力敏感的非局域颗粒流动性（NGF）模型明确拟合到观测到的流动行为。我们发现，对于这类悬浮液，在近似密度匹配的流体-颗粒混合物所产生的低约束应力下，剪切带会变得极宽；而在施加有限的外部压缩后，剪切带会收缩为狭窄的剪切区域。离散元模拟和 NGF 模型结果与观测结果在定性上相符，证实了悬浮液中的压力敏感性猜想及其在 NGF 模型中的作用。我们的结果表明，在描述颗粒介质的慢速流动时，压力敏感性应当成为非局域流动规律的一部分。

articles.title: Robustness of real-space topology in moiré systems
articles.title_zh: 莫尔系统中实空间拓扑的稳健性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.00130v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The appearance of fractional Chern insulators in moiré systems can be rationalized by the presence of a fictitious magnetic field associated with the spatial texture of layer-resolved electronic wavefunctions. Here, we present a systematic study of real-space topology and the associated fictitious magnetic fields in moiré systems. We first show that at the level of individual Bloch wavefunctions, the real-space Chern number, akin to a Pontryagin index, is a fragile marker. It generically vanishes except for specific limits where the Bloch functions exhibit fine-tuned zeroes within the unit cell, such as the chiral limit of twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) or the adiabatic regime of twisted homobilayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMD). We then show that these limitations do not apply to textures associated with ensembles of Bloch wavefunctions, such as entire bands or the ensemble of states at a given energy. The Chern number of these textures defines a robust topological index protected by a spectral gap. We find that symmetries constrain it to be nonzero for both twisted TMDs and TBG across all twist angles and levels of corrugation, implying experimental signatures in scanning tunneling microscopy measurements. By projection to the band ensemble texture, a single-component Hamiltonian under fictitious magnetic field emerges in a broad regime, enabling a direct comparison of multicomponent bands to Landau-level wavefunctions. We also study real-space topology within the topological heavy fermion model of TBG, finding that the real-space topological features are supported only by the light c-electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了莫尔系统中的实空间拓扑及其对应的虚拟磁场。作者指出，单个布洛赫波函数的实空间陈数通常是脆弱标记，只有在特定精细调谐极限下才非零；但由整条能带或固定能量态组成的波函数集合可定义受谱隙保护的稳健拓扑指标。对扭转 TMD 和扭转双层石墨烯，该指标受到对称性约束而在各种扭角和起伏条件下保持非零，并可能在扫描隧道显微镜中留下实验信号。
authors: Kryštof Kolář, Kang Yang, Felix von Oppen, Christophe Mora
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2507.00130v2，公告类型：替换。莫尔系统中分数陈绝缘体的出现，可以通过一种与分层电子波函数空间纹理相关的虚拟磁场来理解。在这里，我们系统研究了莫尔系统中的实空间拓扑及其相关虚拟磁场。我们首先表明，在单个布洛赫波函数的层面，类似于庞加莱指标的实空间陈数是一种脆弱标记。除非处于某些特定极限，在这些极限中布洛赫函数在晶胞内表现出精细调谐的零点，例如扭转双层石墨烯（TBG）的手性极限或扭转同质双层过渡金属二硫属化物（TMD）的绝热区域，否则该陈数通常为零。随后我们表明，这些限制并不适用于与布洛赫波函数集合相关的纹理，例如完整能带或给定能量上的态集合。这些纹理的陈数定义了一个由谱隙保护的稳健拓扑指标。我们发现，对于扭转 TMD 和 TBG，在所有扭角和所有起伏程度下，对称性都约束该指标为非零，这意味着它们可能在扫描隧道显微镜测量中产生实验信号。通过投影到能带集合纹理，在广泛参数区域内会出现一个处于虚拟磁场中的单组分哈密顿量，从而能够直接将多组分能带与朗道能级波函数进行比较。我们还研究了 TBG 拓扑重费米子模型中的实空间拓扑，发现实空间拓扑特征仅由轻的 c 电子支持。

articles.title: Superfluid weight in disordered flat-band superconductors as a competition between localization functionals
articles.title_zh: 无序平带超导体中的超流权重：局域化泛函之间的竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.05224v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: According to Anderson's theorem, the gap of a time-reversal symmetric weak-coupling superconductor is unaffected by non-magnetic disorder. However, the superfluid weight (stiffness) is reduced in the disordered limit by a factor of Δ τ, a product of the scattering time τ and the superconducting order parameter Δ. Here we show that the opposite holds true in flat-band superconductors. While non-magnetic disorder does reduce the order parameter, we find that its direct effect on superfluid weight is mostly negligible. We show analytically that the effect of disorder is to lowest order given in terms of the difference between the intraband and interband parts of the localization functional of impurity wavefunctions, finding it to be typically vanishing.
articles.abstract_zh: 根据安德森定理，非磁性无序不会改变时间反演对称弱耦合超导体的能隙，但会按 Δτ 因子降低其超流权重。本文表明，平带超导体具有相反的行为：无序会降低序参量，却几乎不直接影响超流权重。解析结果显示，无序效应最低阶由杂质波函数带内与带间局域化泛函之差决定，而该差值通常趋于消失。
authors: Kryštof Kolář, Tero T. Heikkilä, Päivi Törmä
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2510.05224v2，公告类型：替换。根据安德森定理，时间反演对称的弱耦合超导体的能隙不受非磁性无序影响。然而，在无序极限下，超流权重（刚度）会被一个由超导序参量 Δ 与散射时间 τ 的乘积 Δτ 决定的因子所降低。在这里，我们表明，平带超导体中的情况恰恰相反。虽然非磁性无序确实会降低序参量，但我们发现它对超流权重的直接影响大多可以忽略。我们解析地证明，无序效应在最低阶上由杂质波函数的带内局域化泛函与带间局域化泛函之差决定，并发现该差值通常趋于零。

articles.title: Systematic global structure search of bismuth-based binary systems under pressure using machine learning potentials
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习势对压力下铋基二元体系进行系统性全局结构搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05188v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning potentials (MLPs) have significantly advanced global crystal structure prediction by enabling efficient and accurate property evaluations. In this study, global structure searches are performed for 11 bismuth-based binary systems, including Na-Bi, Ca-Bi, and Eu-Bi, under pressures ranging from 0 to 20 GPa, employing polynomial MLPs developed specifically for these systems. The searches reveal numerous compounds not previously reported in the literature and identify all experimentally known compounds that are representable within the explored configurational space. These results highlight the robustness and reliability of the current MLP-based structure search. The study provides valuable insights into the discovery and design of novel bismuth-based materials under both ambient and high-pressure conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习势能够高效且准确地评估材料性质，从而推动全局晶体结构预测。本文利用针对 11 个铋基二元体系开发的多项式机器学习势，在 0 至 20 GPa 压力范围内开展全局结构搜索。研究发现了大量文献中未曾报道的化合物，并识别出探索构型空间内所有已知实验化合物，显示出该方法的稳健性和可靠性。
authors: Hayato Wakai, Shintaro Ishiwata, Atsuto Seko
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2511.05188v2，公告类型：替换。机器学习势（MLP）通过实现高效且准确的性质评估，显著推进了全局晶体结构预测。在本研究中，我们针对 11 个铋基二元体系开展全局结构搜索，其中包括 Na-Bi、Ca-Bi 和 Eu-Bi，压力范围为 0 至 20 GPa，并采用专门为这些体系开发的多项式 MLP。搜索发现了许多文献中此前未曾报道的化合物，并识别出所有能够在所探索构型空间中表示的实验已知化合物。这些结果凸显了当前基于 MLP 的结构搜索方法的稳健性和可靠性。本研究为环境条件和高压条件下新型铋基材料的发现与设计提供了有价值的见解。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作利用针对铋基二元体系开发的机器学习势，在0至20 GPa压力范围内对11个体系开展全局晶体结构搜索。研究发现了多种此前未报道的化合物，并在可探索构型空间内重现了已知实验化合物，展示了机器学习势用于高压材料发现的有效性。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、晶体结构预测、全局优化和高通量材料筛选方向直接相关。其高压二元体系搜索流程和机器学习势验证策略可借鉴到功能材料及新型磁性、铁电或储能材料的结构发现中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注机器学习势在不同化学空间和压力范围下的可迁移性、不确定性评估及主动学习策略。团队可将类似方法用于高压铁电相、拓扑磁性相或锂电池材料新结构的预测，并结合第一性原理计算筛选其功能性质。

articles.title: Microscopic origin of orbital magnetization in chiral superconductors
articles.title_zh: 手性超导体中轨道磁化的微观起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12387v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral superconductivity is a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking superconducting phase that has attracted broad interest as a potential platform for topological quantum computation. A fundamental consequence of this symmetry breaking is orbital magnetization, yet a clear microscopic formulation of this quantity has remained elusive. This difficulty arises because Bogoliubov quasiparticles do not carry a definite electric charge, precluding a simple interpretation of orbital magnetization in terms of circulating quasiparticle currents. Moreover, superconductivity and ferromagnetism rarely coexist, and in the few materials where they do (e.g. uranium-based compounds), strong spin-orbit coupling obscures the orbital contribution to the magnetization. The recent report of chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral multilayer graphene, which has negligible spin-orbit coupling, therefore provides a unique opportunity to develop and test a microscopic theory of orbital magnetization in chiral superconductors. Here we develop such a theory, unifying the interband coherence effects underlying normal-state orbital magnetization with the intrinsic orbital moments of the Cooper-pair condensate. Applying our theory to rhombohedral tetralayer graphene, we find that the onset of superconductivity can either enhance or suppress the normal-state orbital magnetization, depending on the bandstructure. We further identify a generalized clapping mode with a gap set by the sublattice winding form factor. This collective mode is unique to chiral superconductors and contributes to the orbital magnetization through its role in dressing the photon vertex. Our theory resolves a long-standing conceptual difficulty in defining orbital magnetization in superconducting systems, and measurements of the orbital magnetization relative to the quarter-metal phase would provide a direct experimental test.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性超导性破坏时间反演对称性，并伴随轨道磁化，但由于 Bogoliubov 准粒子不具有确定电荷，其微观描述长期存在困难。本文建立了统一理论，将正常态轨道磁化中的带间相干效应与 Cooper 对凝聚体的内禀轨道磁矩联系起来。应用于菱面体四层石墨烯时，超导转变可增强或抑制正常态轨道磁化；此外，手性超导体特有的广义拍击模也会通过修饰光子顶角贡献于轨道磁化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2601.12387v3，公告类型：替换。手性超导性是一种破坏时间反演对称性的超导相，作为拓扑量子计算的潜在平台，已经引起广泛关注。这种对称性破缺的一个基本后果是轨道磁化，然而，对这一物理量的清晰微观表述一直难以建立。其困难在于，Bogoliubov 准粒子不携带确定的电荷，因此无法简单地将轨道磁化解释为循环准粒子电流。此外，超导性与铁磁性很少共存；而在少数二者共存的材料中，例如铀基化合物，强自旋-轨道耦合又会掩盖磁化中的轨道贡献。近期关于菱面体多层石墨烯中手性超导性的报道，为发展和检验手性超导体轨道磁化的微观理论提供了独特机会，因为该体系的自旋-轨道耦合可以忽略。在这里，我们建立了这样一种理论，将正常态轨道磁化背后的带间相干效应与 Cooper 对凝聚体的内禀轨道磁矩统一起来。将该理论应用于菱面体四层石墨烯，我们发现，超导性的出现可以增强或抑制正常态轨道磁化，具体取决于能带结构。我们还发现了一种广义拍击模，其能隙由子晶格绕转形状因子决定。这种集体模是手性超导体所特有的，并通过其对光子顶角的修饰作用为轨道磁化作出贡献。我们的理论解决了定义超导体系轨道磁化时长期存在的概念困难，而相对于四分之一金属相测量轨道磁化，将为理论提供直接的实验检验。

articles.title: Direct Observation of Antimagnons with Inverted Dispersion
articles.title_zh: 反色散反磁振子的直接观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.15231v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report direct spectroscopic evidence of antimagnons, i.e., negative-energy spin waves identified by their signature inverted dispersion and left-handed precession with Brillouin light scattering (BLS) spectroscopy. We investigate an ultrathin BiYIG film with a perpendicular magnetized anisotropy that compensates the demagnetizing field. By injecting a spin-orbit torque, the magnetization is driven into auto-oscillation and eventually into a non-equilibrium reversed state above a secondary current threshold (sim1.2×10⁷~A/cm²⁾. The dispersion is measured by wavevector-resolved BLS and exhibits a sharp change from an upward dispersion to a downward one, in agreement with theoretical predictions and micromagnetic simulations. Around the threshold current, we observe the coexistence of conventional magnons and antimagnons. Our work establishes antimagnons with inverted dispersion and is a first step towards exploring novel phenomena and applications due to magnon-antimagnon coupling, such as magnon amplification and magnon-antimagnon entanglement, which are part of the emerging field of antimagnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用布里渊光散射光谱直接观测到反磁振子，即具有负能量、反向色散和左手进动特征的自旋波。在垂直磁化的超薄 BiYIG 薄膜中，注入自旋轨道力矩可驱动磁化进入自振荡，并在超过第二电流阈值后进入非平衡反转态。波矢分辨测量显示色散关系由上升转为下降，并在阈值附近观察到普通磁振子与反磁振子共存。
authors: Hanchen Wang, Junfeng Hu, Wenjie Song, Artim L. Bassant, Jinlong Wang, Haishen Peng, Emir Karadža, Paul Noël, William Legrand, Richard Schlitz, Jilei Chen, Song Liu, Dapeng Yu, Jean-Philippe Ansermet, Rembert A. Duine, Pietro Gambardella, Haiming Yu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2601.15231v2，公告类型：替换。我们利用布里渊光散射（BLS）光谱报告了反磁振子的直接光谱证据；反磁振子是具有负能量的自旋波，其特征是反向色散和左手进动。我们研究了一种具有垂直磁化各向异性的超薄 BiYIG 薄膜，其中该各向异性补偿了退磁场。通过注入自旋轨道力矩，磁化被驱动进入自振荡状态，并最终在超过第二个电流阈值（约 1.2×10⁷ A/cm²）后进入非平衡反转态。我们利用波矢分辨的 BLS 测量色散关系，观察到其从向上的色散突然变为向下的色散，这与理论预言和微磁模拟相一致。在阈值电流附近，我们观察到传统磁振子与反磁振子共存。我们的工作确立了具有反向色散的反磁振子，并为探索由磁振子-反磁振子耦合引起的新现象和新应用迈出了第一步，例如磁振子放大和磁振子-反磁振子纠缠；这些现象属于正在兴起的反磁振子学领域。

articles.title: Machine learning protocol to identify pairing symmetries via quasiparticle interference imaging in Ising superconductors
articles.title_zh: 利用伊辛超导体中的准粒子干涉成像通过机器学习协议识别配对对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.19791v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Identifying the pairing symmetry in unconventional superconductors is essential for reliably characterizing their superconducting states and for enabling their integration into realistic quantum devices. Here, we introduce a machine-learning-guided strategy to determine pairing symmetry from quasiparticle interference (QPI) data, which integrates first-principles calculations, tight-binding modeling, and symmetry-based classification of the superconducting pairing function. We demonstrate the approach on monolayer NbSe2 as an experimentally accessible probe of superconductivity in real materials, within a single scalar-impurity Bogoliubov-de Gennes framework. Our analysis shows that the QPI-to-parameter inverse problem can be solved with high accuracy for most superconducting pairing channels in this setting, indicating that QPI carries rich, learnable information about the superconducting gap structure. Taken together, these results demonstrate that machine-learning-assisted QPI analysis provides a promising pathway for precise learning of superconducting pairing functions in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种机器学习引导的方法，从准粒子干涉数据确定非常规超导体的配对对称性。该方法结合第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型和基于对称性的超导配对函数分类，并以单层 NbSe2 为例进行验证。在标量杂质 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 框架下，结果表明准粒子干涉数据包含可学习的能隙结构信息，能够高精度区分多数配对通道。
authors: Adam Hložný, Jozef Haniš, Martin Gmitra, Marko Milivojević
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2602.19791v2，公告类型：替换。识别非常规超导体中的配对对称性，对于可靠表征其超导态以及推动其集成到现实量子器件中至关重要。在这里，我们提出一种机器学习引导的策略，从准粒子干涉（QPI）数据确定配对对称性；该策略融合了第一性原理计算、紧束缚建模以及基于对称性的超导配对函数分类。我们在单层 NbSe2 上展示了这一方法；单层 NbSe2 是一种可在实验上接近的真实材料超导性探针，并采用单个标量杂质的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 框架。我们的分析表明，在这一设定下，对于大多数超导配对通道，QPI 到参数的逆问题都可以高精度求解，这说明 QPI 包含关于超导能隙结构的丰富且可学习的信息。总的来说，这些结果表明，机器学习辅助的 QPI 分析为在量子材料中精确学习超导配对函数提供了一条有前景的途径。
articles.focus_summary: 本文提出一种结合机器学习、第一性原理计算、紧束缚模型和对称性分类的方法，通过准粒子干涉成像识别 Ising 超导体中的配对对称性。以单层 NbSe2 为例，结果表明该方法能够较高精度地从 QPI 数据反演多数超导配对通道。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的超导、量子功能材料、机器学习和电子结构计算方向直接相关，也涉及对称性分析及材料哈密顿量建模。其机器学习辅助实验数据反演的思路，可借鉴到超导能隙、磁性序参量或电子结构性质预测中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合第一性原理电子结构、Wannier 哈密顿量和自旋轨道耦合，研究更多二维超导体及异质结中的配对对称性。也可探索将等变神经网络用于 QPI 图像与动量空间电子结构之间的联合建模。

articles.title: Fast Nuclear Spin Read-Out in Single Molecule Magnets
articles.title_zh: 单分子磁体中的快速核自旋读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13047v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nuclear spins in 4f single-molecule magnets (SMMs) are promising qubits or qudits candidates for quantum information processing due to their relative isolation and reduced susceptibility to environmental disturbances, while their hyperfine coupling to the 4f magnetic moments enable readout and control. So far, the nuclear spin states of individual TbPc2 SMMs have been detected in transport measurements via the spin-cascade effect. Here, we demonstrate a fast, field-sweep-free readout of nuclear spin in individual 163DyPc2 (I = 5/2) and 159TbPc2 (I = 3/2) using millikelvin spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy. This fast readout is enabled by the hyperfine interactions, which modifies the statistics of the telegraph noise generated by reversals of the Ln3+ moment, thereby revealing the nuclear spin state. We observe nuclear spin relaxation times T1 in excess of minutes. Furthermore, we drive nuclear spin transitions using a radio-frequency field and detect the resulting nuclear magnetic resonance directly in the tunneling current. Thus our approach enables fast access to long-lived nuclear spin states in an individual molecule
articles.abstract_zh: 研究展示了利用毫开尔文自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜，在无需扫场的条件下快速读出单个163DyPc2和159TbPc2分子的核自旋态。核自旋态通过超精细相互作用对镧系离子磁矩翻转所产生的电报噪声统计特征的调制来识别，其弛豫时间T1超过数分钟。研究还利用射频场驱动核自旋跃迁，并在隧穿电流中直接探测核磁共振。
authors: Hongyan Chen, Simon Gerber, Philip Schmid, Nola Warwick, Charanpreet Singh, Svetlana Klyatskaya, Eufemio Moreno-Pineda, Mario Ruben, Wulf Wulfhekel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于相对孤立且不易受到环境扰动，4f单分子磁体中的核自旋是量子信息处理的有前景的量子比特或量子位候选者；同时，它们与4f磁矩之间的超精细耦合使得核自旋能够被读出和操控。迄今为止，单个TbPc2单分子的核自旋态已经通过自旋级联效应在输运测量中被探测到。在这里，我们利用毫开尔文自旋极化扫描隧道显微镜，在无需扫场的条件下，展示了对单个163DyPc2（I = 5/2）和159TbPc2（I = 3/2）分子核自旋的快速读出。该快速读出得以实现，是因为超精细相互作用改变了镧系离子Ln3+磁矩翻转所产生的电报噪声统计特征，从而揭示出核自旋态。我们观测到核自旋弛豫时间T1超过数分钟。此外，我们利用射频场驱动核自旋跃迁，并在隧穿电流中直接探测由此产生的核磁共振。因此，该方法能够快速访问单个分子中寿命较长的核自旋态。

articles.title: Gate-tunable synthetic antiferromagnetism with nonrelativistic spin splitting in a graphene/MnS/graphene heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯/MnS/石墨烯异质结构中具有非相对论自旋劈裂的栅压可调合成反铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.20458v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose encapsulating type-A antiferromagnetic semiconductors between graphene layers to realize a gate-tunable synthetic antiferromagnet with nonrelativistic spin splitting, enabling efficient spintronic transport via graphene. Ab initio calculations and tight-binding models of graphene/MnS/graphene heterostructure reveal that gate-tuning of the heterostructure breaks top/bottom graphene equivalence, inducing opposite ferromagnetic proximity exchange that lifts spin degeneracy to yield nonrelativistic spin splitting at the Fermi level, dominating over relativistic effects. The induced effects manifest as conductance dips in spin-resolved transport through proximitized graphene nanoribbons, observable as giant magnetoresistance within a narrow energy window around the Fermi level. Our graphene/type-A antiferromagnetic heterostructure, a readily synthesizable platform incorporating antiferromagnets with nonrelativistic spin splitting, pave the way for gate-manipulated, low-dimensional antiferromagnetic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出将A型反铁磁半导体封装在石墨烯层之间，以构建具有非相对论自旋劈裂且可由栅压调控的合成反铁磁体。对石墨烯/MnS/石墨烯异质结构的第一性原理计算和紧束缚模型表明，栅压可打破上下石墨烯层的等价性，诱导相反的铁磁近邻交换作用。由此产生的费米能级附近自旋劈裂可在石墨烯纳米带输运中表现为自旋分辨电导凹陷和窄能窗内的巨磁阻。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出将A型反铁磁半导体封装在石墨烯层之间，以实现一种具有非相对论自旋劈裂且可由栅压调控的合成反铁磁体，从而通过石墨烯实现高效自旋电子输运。对石墨烯/MnS/石墨烯异质结构的第一性原理计算和紧束缚模型表明，异质结构的栅压调控打破了上下石墨烯层之间的等价性，诱导出相反的铁磁近邻交换作用，从而解除自旋简并，并在费米能级处产生非相对论自旋劈裂，其作用强于相对论效应。这些诱导效应表现为近邻化石墨烯纳米带中自旋分辨输运的电导凹陷，并可在费米能级附近的窄能量窗口内作为巨磁阻观测到。我们的石墨烯/A型反铁磁异质结构是一种易于合成的平台，将具有非相对论自旋劈裂的反铁磁体纳入其中，为栅压操控的低维反铁磁器件铺平了道路。

articles.title: Explicit proof of Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe for the one-dimensional Fermi polaron with attractive interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有吸引相互作用的一维费米极化子中安德森正交灾变的显式证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12475v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We provide a fully analytical derivation of Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe for the one dimensional Fermi polaron integrable model, describing a system of N spin-up fermions, with fixed density n=N/L, interacting with a single spin-down fermion via an attractive contact potential. The proof combines the determinant representations of the norm of the many-body wave function and of its scalar product with the noninteracting ground state, obtained from the Bethe ansatz solution, with the special properties of Cauchy matrices. We derive the leading asymptotics of the two determinants in the thermodynamic limit and show that the quasi-particle residue Z decays algebraically, Z=W N⁻θ. We confirm that the Anderson exponent θ is equal to 2δ_F²/π², where δ_F is the Bethe-ansatz phase shift at the Fermi edge. We also derive the asymptotic behavior of the prefactor W at strong coupling and compare it against exact numerics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对具有吸引接触势的一维可积费米极化子模型给出了安德森正交灾变的完整解析推导。研究利用Bethe Ansatz得到的多体波函数范数及其与非相互作用基态标量积的行列式表示，并结合柯西矩阵的性质，推导出热力学极限下的渐近行为。结果表明准粒子残数按幂律衰减，安德森指数等于费米边缘处Bethe Ansatz相移平方的两倍除以π平方，并进一步研究了强耦合下前因子的行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对一维费米极化子可积模型中的安德森正交灾变给出了完整的解析推导。该模型描述了一个由N个自旋向上费米子组成的体系，这些费米子具有固定密度n=N/L，并通过吸引性接触势与一个自旋向下费米子相互作用。该证明结合了多体波函数范数及其与非相互作用基态标量积的行列式表示；这些表示由Bethe Ansatz解获得，并利用了柯西矩阵的特殊性质。我们推导出这两个行列式在热力学极限下的主导渐近行为，并表明准粒子残数Z按代数形式衰减，即Z = W N⁻θ。我们确认安德森指数θ等于2δ_F²/π²，其中δ_F是费米边缘处的Bethe Ansatz相移。我们还推导了强耦合条件下前因子W的渐近行为，并将其与精确数值结果进行了比较。

articles.title: Simulating altermagnets using mumax+
articles.title_zh: 使用mumax+模拟交错磁体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15454v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate how altermagnets can be simulated in the recently released micromagnetic simulation package mumax+. We have added a new magnet class for d-wave altermagnets and demonstrate how mumax+ is able to reproduce the analytical solutions for line profiles of the Néel vector and net magnetization for a Bloch domain wall. Next, we show simulation results of the magnon dispersion relation and its dependence on the anisotropic nature of the exchange interaction. Finally, we study the motion of a Néel skyrmion by applying a spin transfer torque. This new feature was implemented by extending the pre-existing code base for antiferromagnetic simulations. The object-oriented design of mumax+ allows for a correct calculation of the magnetostatic field in multi-sublattice systems, a feature that many other micromagnetic simulators lack.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何在新近发布的微磁学模拟软件mumax+中模拟交错磁体，并新增了用于d波交错磁体的磁体类别。模拟结果再现了布洛赫畴壁中尼尔矢量和净磁化线剖面的解析解，并给出了交换相互作用各向异性对磁振子色散的影响。研究还模拟了自旋转移力矩驱动下尼尔斯格明子的运动，体现了mumax+对多子晶格体系磁静场的正确计算能力。
authors: Lars Moreels, Nicolai Bechler, Bartel Van Waeyenberge, Jonathan Leliaert, Jan Masell
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文展示了如何在新近发布的微磁学模拟软件包mumax+中模拟交错磁体。我们新增了一个用于d波交错磁体的磁体类别，并展示mumax+能够再现布洛赫畴壁中尼尔矢量和净磁化线剖面的解析解。随后，我们展示了磁振子色散关系的模拟结果及其对交换相互作用各向异性的依赖。最后，我们通过施加自旋转移力矩研究了尼尔斯格明子的运动。该新功能是在扩展原有反铁磁模拟代码库的基础上实现的。mumax+的面向对象设计能够正确计算多子晶格体系中的磁静场，这是许多其他微磁学模拟器所缺乏的功能。

articles.title: Reentrant behavior and possible 2/3 magnetization plateau on the double-trillium langbeinite K₂Ni₂₍SO₄₎₃
articles.title_zh: 双三角螺旋langbeinite化合物K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃中的再入行为与可能的2/3磁化平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.13263v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: K₂Ni₂₍SO₄₎₃ is a member of the langbeinite family, consisting of two intertwined S=1 trillium lattices, out of which one is strongly coupled (strong-TL) and the other is weakly coupled (weak-TL). Further inter-trillium interactions give rise to a highly-frustrated Heisenberg Hamiltonian. Despite ordering at low temperatures, K₂Ni₂₍SO₄₎₃ lies close in parameter space to a spin-liquid region that surrounds the tetratrillium limit, where each triangle belonging to strong-TL turns into a tetrahedron by connecting to a single spin from weak-TL. Here, we compare the experimentally determined magnetization process using pulsed magnetic fields up to 40 T with classical Monte Carlo calculations, uncovering a series of phase transitions at both low and intermediate fields. Furthermore, we reveal a signature of a 2/3 magnetization plateau consisting of a 1/3 phase on strong-TL and a fully polarized phase on weak-TL. Although in the classical limit no plateau is expected, we find a very prominent dome structure reflecting the tendency of the system to stabilize this particular spin configuration. The presence of a dome leads to a reentrant phenomenon in which the system recovers the Hamiltonian symmetries when increasing the magnetic field. Finally, we show that this plateau-like phase is also present in the classical Heisenberg model on the single trillium and tetratrillium lattices, indicating its possible presence in the large family of double-trillium langbeinite compounds. Our findings motivate future studies on the presence of the plateau phase in the quantum limit of both trillium and double-trillium materials within the langbeinite family.
articles.abstract_zh: K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃由相互交织的两个S=1三角螺旋晶格组成，其中一个强耦合、另一个弱耦合，并由额外的晶格间相互作用形成高度受挫的海森堡模型。脉冲磁场实验与经典蒙特卡罗计算揭示了低场和中间场区域的一系列相变，以及由强耦合晶格的1/3磁化相和弱耦合晶格的完全极化相组成的2/3磁化平台特征。该平台样结构导致随磁场增强而恢复哈密顿量对称性的再入现象，并可能存在于更广泛的双三角螺旋langbeinite化合物中。
authors: Matías G. Gonzalez, Yurii Skourski, Johannes Reuther, Ivica Živković
articles.abstract_zh_full: K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃是langbeinite家族的一员，由两个相互交织的S=1三角螺旋晶格组成，其中一个是强耦合晶格（强TL），另一个是弱耦合晶格（弱TL）。进一步的三角螺旋晶格间相互作用产生了高度受挫的海森堡哈密顿量。尽管K₂Ni₂(SO₄)₃在低温下发生有序化，但其参数空间位置接近自旋液体区域；该区域围绕着四三角螺旋极限，在此极限中，强TL中的每个三角形通过与弱TL中的一个自旋相连接而转变为四面体。在这里，我们将利用最高达40 T的脉冲磁场实验确定的磁化过程与经典蒙特卡罗计算进行比较，从而揭示出低场和中间场区域的一系列相变。此外，我们发现了2/3磁化平台的特征，该平台由强TL上的1/3相和弱TL上的完全极化相组成。尽管经典极限下不应出现平台，但我们发现了一个非常明显的穹顶结构，反映出体系倾向于稳定这一特定自旋构型。穹顶结构导致了一种再入现象，即随着磁场增强，体系重新恢复哈密顿量的对称性。最后，我们表明，这种类似平台的相也存在于单三角螺旋晶格和四三角螺旋晶格上的经典海森堡模型中，说明它可能存在于广泛的双三角螺旋langbeinite化合物中。我们的发现推动了未来对langbeinite家族三角螺旋材料和双三角螺旋材料量子极限下平台相存在性的研究。

articles.title: Charge imprinting biases topology of correlated insulator in hBN-aligned rhombohedral multilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 电荷印记偏置hBN对齐菱面体多层石墨烯中关联绝缘体的拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20377v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene aligned with hexagonal boron nitride (RMG-hBN) hosts correlated Chern phases, but the microscopic role of hBN stacking remains unclear, especially when the active carriers are displaced away from the moiré interface. Using Hartree-Fock calculations over layer numbers, twist angles, displacement fields, fillings, and hBN alignments, we show that correlated insulators are most robust at small twist angles and intermediate layer number (Nsimeq 6), where bandwidth suppression is balanced by layer delocalization of the wavefunctions of the active carriers. Under moiré-distant conditions at filling ν=1, the topology of the insulating state is strongly biased by charge imprinting: the hBN alignment shapes the occupied valence-band charge texture near the interface via moiré potential, which acts through long-range Coulomb interactions as a remote electrostatic template for doped conduction electrons. Depending on the alignment, this template favors either triangular charge localization associated with trivial insulators or honeycomb-like charge networks compatible with Chern insulators. Our results identify valence-band charge textures as a microscopic route by which a remote moiré interface controls correlated topology in multilayer graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用Hartree-Fock计算考察了hBN对齐菱面体多层石墨烯中关联绝缘体的形成，并揭示了远离莫尔界面时电荷印记对其拓扑的强烈影响。在填充数ν=1时，hBN对齐方式通过界面附近价带电荷纹理和长程库仑作用，为掺杂导带电子提供远程静电模板。该模板可分别促进平庸绝缘体中的三角形电荷局域化，或与陈绝缘体相容的蜂窝状电荷网络。
authors: Lei Qiao, Xin Lu, Fu-Chun Zhang, Jianpeng Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与六方氮化硼对齐的菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG-hBN）能够承载关联陈相，但hBN堆垛方式的微观作用仍不清楚，尤其是在活性载流子偏离莫尔界面的情况下。通过对不同层数、扭转角、位移场、填充数和hBN对齐方式进行Hartree-Fock计算，我们表明，关联绝缘体在小扭转角和中等层数（N约为6）时最为稳定，此时带宽抑制与活性载流子波函数在层间的离域化达到平衡。在填充数ν=1且载流子远离莫尔界面的条件下，绝缘态的拓扑受到电荷印记的强烈偏置：hBN的对齐方式通过莫尔势塑造界面附近占据价带的电荷纹理，并通过长程库仑相互作用，将其作为掺杂导带电子的远程静电模板。根据对齐方式的不同，该模板会促进与平庸绝缘体相关的三角形电荷局域化，或促进与陈绝缘体相容的蜂窝状电荷网络。我们的结果确定了价带电荷纹理这一微观途径，即远程莫尔界面能够通过它控制多层石墨烯中的关联拓扑。

articles.title: Structural, electronic, and optical properties of 2D α-graphdiyne from first-principles
articles.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的二维α-石墨二炔结构、电子与光学性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03841v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The structural, electronic, and optical properties of monolayer α-graphdiyne (α-GDY) are systematically investigated using density-functional theory within the plane-wave pseudopotential formalism. The electronic band structure reveals a gapless Dirac crossing at the K point, indicating Dirac-semimetallic behavior within the PBE/GGA framework. The calculated total and orbital-projected density of states show that the electronic states near the Fermi level are dominated by the carbon 2p orbitals, while the contribution of the 2s orbitals is comparatively weak. The optical response exhibits pronounced polarization dependence. The in-plane dielectric function displays a strong low-energy electronic response and negative values of its real part, whereas the out-of-plane component remains positive throughout the investigated energy range. Consistently, the absorption coefficient, extinction coefficient, reflectivity, and electron energy-loss spectra reveal pronounced optical anisotropy. The calculated plasma frequencies are approximately 3.21~eV for in-plane polarization and 1.06~eV for out-of-plane polarization, highlighting the strongly anisotropic electronic response of the monolayer. These findings demonstrate that α-GDY combines Dirac-like electronic behavior with highly anisotropic optical properties, indicating its potential relevance to polarization-sensitive optoelectronic, plasmonic, and nanoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在平面波赝势形式下采用密度泛函理论，系统研究了单层α-石墨二炔的结构、电子和光学性质。PBE/GGA计算显示其在K点存在无带隙狄拉克交叉，表现出狄拉克半金属性，费米能级附近的电子态主要由碳2p轨道贡献。其介电函数、吸收、消光、反射和电子能量损失谱均呈现显著的偏振依赖和光学各向异性，面内与面外等离子体频率约为3.21 eV和1.06 eV。
authors: Ashkan Shekaari, Mahmoud Jafari, Sana Afshar, Rahil Mansouri
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在平面波赝势形式下利用密度泛函理论，系统研究了单层α-石墨二炔（α-GDY）的结构、电子和光学性质。电子能带结构在K点显示出无带隙狄拉克交叉，表明在PBE/GGA框架下该材料具有狄拉克半金属性。计算得到的总态密度和轨道投影态密度表明，费米能级附近的电子态主要由碳2p轨道决定，而2s轨道的贡献相对较弱。光学响应表现出明显的偏振依赖性。面内介电函数显示出强烈的低能电子响应，其实部取负值；相比之下，面外分量在所研究的整个能量范围内均保持为正。与此一致，吸收系数、消光系数、反射率和电子能量损失谱均显示出显著的光学各向异性。计算得到的等离子体频率在面内偏振和面外偏振下分别约为3.21 eV和1.06 eV，突出了该单层材料强烈的各向异性电子响应。这些结果表明，α-GDY兼具类狄拉克电子行为和高度各向异性的光学性质，因而在偏振敏感光电、等离激元和纳米电子应用中具有潜在价值。

articles.title: Structural Origin of Water Heat Capacity Anomaly from Classical and Quantum Simulations
articles.title_zh: 经典与量子模拟揭示水热容反常的结构起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08957v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Water isobaric heat capacity is anomalously large under ambient conditions and exhibits a sharp maximum upon supercooling. Using classical and path-integral molecular dynamics with accurate machine-learning interatomic potentials, we show that nuclear quantum effects primarily act by suppressing high-frequency vibrations, while the anomalous temperature dependence of the isobaric heat capacity originates from structural fluctuations, quantified by the second-solvent-shell intruder order parameter. A simple two-state mapping reveals an effective enthalpy scale of about 4 kJ/mol associated with the interconversion of low- and high-density-like local structures, providing a microscopic link between their population changes and the excess heat capacity from supercooled to ambient conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用结合机器学习原子间势的经典分子动力学和路径积分分子动力学，分析了水在常压下异常大的等压热容及其过冷时的尖锐极大值。结果表明，核量子效应主要通过抑制高频振动发挥作用，而等压热容的反常温度依赖性源于结构涨落，可由第二溶剂壳层侵入序参量量化。两态映射给出了约4 kJ/mol的有效焓尺度，将低密度样和高密度样局域结构的转化与过冷至环境条件下的过量热容联系起来。
authors: Kam-Tung Chan, Dylan A. Folkner, Zekun Chen, Margaret L. Berrens, Alexei A. Stuchebrukhov, Lee-Ping Wang, Davide Donadio
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在环境条件下，水的等压热容异常地大，并且在过冷过程中出现尖锐极大值。我们利用结合高精度机器学习原子间势的经典分子动力学和路径积分分子动力学表明，核量子效应主要通过抑制高频振动发挥作用，而等压热容的反常温度依赖性源于结构涨落，这种涨落可通过第二溶剂壳层侵入序参量进行量化。一个简单的两态映射揭示出约4 kJ/mol的有效焓尺度，该尺度与低密度样和高密度样局域结构之间的相互转化相关，从而在过冷条件至环境条件的范围内，为这些结构的数量变化与过量热容建立了微观联系。

articles.title: Effects of interface regularity on the bulk-edge correspondence in continuum photonic systems
articles.title_zh: 界面规整性对连续光子系统体边对应关系的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this study we analyze the topological invariants and edge states of transverse magnetic wave propagation in continuum photonic systems at a finite-width interface between two gyrotropic materials with different magnetic biases. Where previous studies have almost exclusively considered sharp transitions between two different electromagnetic media, we consider the more general geometry where the magnetic field bias is allowed to vary arbitrarily in a finite-width interface between two bulk regions. We find that when the magnetic field bias varies continuously between the two bulk regions, the Bulk Edge Correspondence (BEC) holds robustly with respect to well-defined Chern invariants. However, discontinuities in the magnetic field bias introduce new edge modes and anomalous high-wavenumber spectral effects which alter the BEC. We analyze these spectral alterations and define a new anomalous BEC in continuum photonic systems which includes contributions from topological invariants and discontinuities in magnetic field bias.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了两个具有不同磁偏置的旋磁材料之间有限宽度界面中横磁波传播的拓扑不变量和边缘态，并允许磁场偏置在界面内任意变化。结果表明，当磁场偏置在两个体区域之间连续变化时，基于定义良好的陈不变量的体边对应关系具有稳健性；而磁场偏置的不连续会引入新的边缘模和反常高波数谱效应。研究据此定义了包含拓扑不变量和磁场偏置不连续贡献的连续光子系统反常体边对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本研究中，我们分析了两个具有不同磁偏置的旋磁材料之间有限宽度界面中横磁波传播的拓扑不变量和边缘态。以往研究几乎全部考察两个不同电磁介质之间的尖锐过渡，而我们研究了更一般的几何构型，其中允许磁场偏置在连接两个体区域的有限宽度界面内任意变化。我们发现，当磁场偏置在两个体区域之间连续变化时，体边对应关系相对于定义良好的陈不变量具有稳健性。然而，磁场偏置的不连续会引入新的边缘模和反常的高波数谱效应，从而改变体边对应关系。我们分析了这些谱的变化，并在连续光子系统中定义了一种新的反常体边对应关系，其中包括拓扑不变量以及磁场偏置不连续所产生的贡献。

articles.title: MatMMExtract: An Open-Source Pipeline for Panel-Level Extraction of Grounded Image-Text Pairs from Materials Science Literature
articles.title_zh: MatMMExtract：从材料科学文献中提取面板级有依据图文对的开源流水线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.29667v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale. The core difficulty is structural: most scientific figures are compound, with a single caption describing multiple sub-panels simultaneously, making direct image-text pairing unreliable. We present MatMMExtract, an end-to-end open-source pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy. Applied to 14,810 open-access articles, MatMMExtract produces MatSciFig; 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures, each annotated with a sub-caption, a two-level visualisation category spanning 19 classes and over 100 subtypes, and a scientific summary. To enable accurate panel localisation, we introduce MaterialScope, a domain-specific detection dataset of 2,811 manually annotated materials science figures, on which a fine-tuned YOLO12-m detector achieves mAP₅₀ of 0.9227. Among six benchmarked language models, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite delivers the best cost-quality trade-off for annotation generation, with 82% of outputs rated good and a hallucination rate of 4.8%. A dual-encoder retrieval baseline on MatSciFig achieves a 4.4 times improvement in R@1 over zero-shot CLIP, demonstrating the dataset's immediate utility for vision-language learning. All resources are released openly to the community.
articles.abstract_zh: MatMMExtract是一种端到端开源流水线，用于将材料科学文献中的复合图分解为独立子面板，并利用材料科学分类体系生成结构化、有依据的标注。该系统应用于14,810篇开放获取论文，构建了包含391,606个面板级图文对的MatSciFig数据集，并配套建立了材料科学图像检测数据集MaterialScope。实验表明，YOLO12-m能够实现较高的面板定位精度，双编码器检索基线相较零样本CLIP在R@1上提升4.4倍，所有资源均向社区开放。
authors: Subham Ghosh, Shubham Tiwari, Mohammad Ibrahim, Abhishek Tewari
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料科学文献通过图表记录了数十年的实验知识，但这一视觉记录仍然被封锁在文献中，难以被人工智能大规模访问。其核心困难在于结构问题：大多数科学图表都是复合图，一个图注同时描述多个子面板，因此直接建立图像与文本的配对并不可靠。我们提出MatMMExtract，这是一种端到端开源流水线，通过将复合图分解为独立子面板，并利用由精选材料科学分类体系引导的大语言模型生成结构化、有依据的标注，解决了这一问题。将该方法应用于14,810篇开放获取论文后，MatMMExtract生成了MatSciFig数据集，其中包含来自180,571幅图的391,606个面板级图文对；每个图文对均标注有子图注、涵盖19个类别和100多个子类型的两级可视化类别，以及科学摘要。为实现准确的面板定位，我们引入了MaterialScope，这是一个包含2,811幅人工标注材料科学图表的领域专用检测数据集；在该数据集上，经过微调的YOLO12-m检测器取得了0.9227的mAP₅₀。在基准测试的六个语言模型中，Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite在标注生成方面实现了最佳的成本与质量平衡，其输出中有82%被评为良好，幻觉率为4.8%。在MatSciFig上的双编码器检索基线相较零样本CLIP实现了R@1提高4.4倍，表明该数据集能够立即用于视觉语言学习。所有资源均向社区公开发布。

articles.title: GOES-East full-disk AI nowcasting of cloud evolution in observation space
articles.title_zh: 观测空间中的GOES-East全圆盘云演变人工智能临近预报
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clouds affect aviation, solar energy, remote sensing, and storm prediction, yet they remain among the hardest atmospheric features to forecast, particularly at convective scales. Because clouds are shaped by processes spanning a wide range of space and time scales, numerical weather prediction, extrapolation methods, and existing machine learning (ML) approaches are each limited by some combination of accuracy, domain size, and temporal resolution. We present DOP+, an ML approach for clouds that forecasts GOES-East full-disk infrared brightness temperatures by extending direct observation prediction (DOP) with conditioning on meteorological fields. The domain covers tropical, midlatitude, and marine regimes across sim 10⁸ ~ km², roughly a fifth of Earth's surface. DOP+ forecasts cloud evolution at 10-minute resolution and outperforms persistence, synoptic-scale NWP, and a pure DOP baseline across 0-6 h lead times in fractions skill score and mean absolute error skill score. Convective structure is retained out to 2-3 h. DOP+ thus achieves a state-of-the-art combination of accuracy, temporal resolution, and spatial coverage. Our work lays the foundation for fully global cloud nowcasting at convective timescales.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出DOP+，一种通过结合气象场条件信息改进直接观测预测的机器学习方法，用于预测GOES-East全圆盘红外亮温和云演变。该方法覆盖热带、中纬度和海洋区域，空间范围约为10⁸ km²，以10分钟分辨率进行预报，并在0至6小时预报时效内优于持续性预报、天气尺度数值天气预报和纯DOP基线。DOP+能够将对流结构保持约2至3小时，为全球对流时间尺度的云临近预报奠定基础。
authors: Dhamma Kimpara, Omid Bagheri, Ivette Hernandez Banos, Byoung-Joo Jung, Chris Snyder
articles.abstract_zh_full: 云会影响航空、太阳能、遥感和风暴预报，但它们仍然是最难预报的大气特征之一，尤其是在对流尺度上。由于云受到跨越广泛空间和时间尺度的过程影响，数值天气预报、外推方法和现有机器学习方法分别受到准确率、覆盖范围和时间分辨率等因素组合的限制。我们提出DOP+，一种面向云的机器学习方法；该方法通过在直接观测预测（DOP）的基础上加入气象场条件信息，预测GOES-East全圆盘红外亮温。其覆盖范围包括热带、中纬度和海洋区域，总面积约为10⁸ km²，大致相当于地球表面积的五分之一。DOP+以10分钟的时间分辨率预报云的演变，并在0至6小时的预报时效内，在分数技巧评分和平均绝对误差技巧评分方面均优于持续性预报、天气尺度数值天气预报和纯DOP基线。对流结构可以保持到2至3小时。由此，DOP+在准确率、时间分辨率和空间覆盖范围之间实现了当前先进的综合性能。我们的工作为在对流时间尺度上开展完全全球范围的云临近预报奠定了基础。

articles.title: Power-law-anchored residual learning for H-mode energy confinement time in tokamaks: interpolation and parameter-defined extrapolation
articles.title_zh: 面向托卡马克H模能量约束时间的幂律锚定残差学习：插值与参数定义外推
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable prediction of the energy confinement time is essential for magnetic-confinement fusion. Conventional power-law scalings provide constrained extrapolation trends but cannot represent complex nonlinearities, whereas neural networks interpolate accurately but may behave unpredictably outside the training distribution. We propose a unified power-law-anchored residual-learning framework in which a frozen empirical power-law scaling supplies the global trend and a nonlinear model learns only the systematic residual in logarithmic space. PLR-KAN is developed as the primary implementation, while a parameter-matched PLR-MLP serves as a controlled architecture replacement. Using the ITPA DB5.2.3 H-mode confinement database, we evaluate interpolation and parameter-defined held-out cohorts over ten complete training pipelines. PLR-KAN retains near-best interpolation accuracy, achieving R2=0.9671+/-0.0027, while substantially improving the stability of direct KAN under parameter-defined distribution shifts. It outperforms direct KAN across all five non-epsilon single-parameter-defined cohorts and the core-five joint cohort, reaching R2=0.9263+/-0.0157 in the latter. Results from PLR-MLP further demonstrate that the benefit of power-law anchoring is not specific to KAN, although the effectiveness of residual transfer remains architecture and direction dependent. As an exploratory extension, a Mahalanobis-distance-based prediction-time gate improves stability in selected shifted regions but is not universally beneficial and cannot compensate for missing device or physics-regime coverage. Overall, power-law-anchored residual learning provides a practical balance between nonlinear interpolation capability and empirically constrained extrapolation behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出一种统一的幂律锚定残差学习框架，用冻结的经验幂律标度提供全局趋势，并由非线性模型在对数空间中学习系统性残差，以兼顾插值精度和分布外预测稳定性。基于ITPA DB5.2.3 H模约束数据库的评估表明，PLR-KAN保持了接近最佳的插值精度，并显著提高了参数定义分布偏移下的稳定性，在核心五参数联合队列中达到R²=0.9263±0.0157。PLR-MLP结果表明幂律锚定的优势并不局限于KAN，但残差迁移效果依赖于模型架构和外推方向。
authors: Zhaokun Wang, Tianyuan Liu, Jianguo Chen, Guoyang Shi, Siqi Ding, Yuejiang Shi, Xianmei Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可靠地预测能量约束时间对于磁约束聚变至关重要。传统幂律标度能够提供受约束的外推趋势，但无法表示复杂的非线性；神经网络虽然能够准确插值，却可能在训练分布之外表现不可预测。我们提出一种统一的幂律锚定残差学习框架，其中冻结的经验幂律标度提供全局趋势，而非线性模型仅在对数空间中学习系统性残差。PLR-KAN作为主要实现，同时采用参数量匹配的PLR-MLP作为受控的架构替代。利用ITPA DB5.2.3 H模约束数据库，我们在十套完整训练流程中评估了插值性能和参数定义的留出队列。PLR-KAN保持了接近最佳的插值精度，R²达到0.9671±0.0027，同时显著提高了直接KAN在参数定义分布偏移下的稳定性。在全部五个非ε单参数定义队列和核心五参数联合队列中，PLR-KAN均优于直接KAN；在后者中达到R²=0.9263±0.0157。PLR-MLP的结果进一步表明，幂律锚定带来的收益并非KAN所特有，尽管残差迁移的有效性取决于模型架构和外推方向。作为探索性扩展，基于马氏距离的预测时门控机制在部分分布偏移区域改善了稳定性，但并非始终有益，也无法弥补设备或物理状态覆盖不足的问题。总体而言，幂律锚定残差学习在非线性插值能力与经验约束的外推行为之间提供了一种实用平衡。

articles.title: Message Order Selects Opposite Collective Opinions on Laplacian-Cospectral Networks
articles.title_zh: 消息顺序选择拉普拉斯余谱网络中的相反集体意见
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Receiving the same messages in different orders can change an agent's judgement. We construct a network model in which this local sequence effect determines the final opinion of an entire network. Each agent has a two-level quantum-like state with an expressed opinion and an auxiliary context coordinate that can affect the next update. Two valid update rules of equal strength leave the neutral state unchanged and add no positive or negative opinion bias. Nevertheless, reversing their order gives the exact opinions +0.01 and -0.01 from the same initial state. We place four ordered pairs so that their positive and negative contributions sum to zero but occupy different labelled nodes. After this single input, all cases follow the same nonlinear network rule, which preserves valid states and admits two stable consensuses. We compare two 16-node networks whose complete Laplacian spectra are identical. With every local ingredient fixed, they converge to opposite consensuses. A separate local calculation identifies a specific overlap between the labelled pulse and Laplacian eigenspace projectors that sets the leading displacement of the basin boundary. Rigorous interval arithmetic proves the finite registered example independently. The construction connects message order to collective selection and shows why Laplacian eigenvalues alone do not determine which opinion wins.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种网络模型，展示相同消息的不同接收顺序如何通过局部序列效应决定整个网络的最终意见。研究比较了两个具有完全相同拉普拉斯谱的16节点网络，发现即使所有局部成分均保持不变，它们仍会收敛到相反的共识。严格的区间算术验证表明，标记脉冲与拉普拉斯特征子空间投影算子的特定重叠决定了吸引域边界的主要位移，从而说明仅凭拉普拉斯特征值无法确定最终获胜的意见。
authors: Ruiwu Niu, Xincheng Shu, Ying Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 接收相同的消息但顺序不同，可能改变一个智能体的判断。我们构建了一种网络模型，其中这种局部序列效应决定整个网络的最终意见。每个智能体具有一个二能级类量子状态，包括一个表达意见和一个能够影响下一次更新的辅助语境坐标。两个强度相等的有效更新规则都使中性状态保持不变，并且不引入正向或负向的意见偏置。然而，将这两个规则的顺序反转后，从同一初始状态出发会分别得到精确的意见值+0.01和-0.01。我们设置了四个有序规则对，使其正向和负向贡献之和为零，但这些贡献分布在不同的标记节点上。在这次单一输入之后，所有情形都遵循相同的非线性网络规则，该规则保持状态的有效性并允许存在两个稳定共识。我们比较了两个具有完全相同拉普拉斯谱的16节点网络。在所有局部成分均固定的情况下，它们却收敛到相反的共识。一个独立的局部计算确定了标记脉冲与拉普拉斯特征子空间投影算子之间的特定重叠，该重叠决定了吸引域边界的主要位移。严格的区间算术独立地证明了这一有限注册示例。该构造将消息顺序与集体选择联系起来，并说明了为什么仅拉普拉斯特征值并不能决定哪一种意见最终获胜。

articles.title: Differentiable high-fidelity vectorial propagator
articles.title_zh: 可微的高保真矢量传播器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The numerical accuracy and computational efficiency of free-space field propagation directly determine what physics can be predicted and what devices can be designed, from nanophotonic metasurfaces to optically addressed quantum processors. Existing methods face a fundamental accuracy-speed trade-off, which is further compounded in the vectorial regime, where major formalisms remain fragmented with no unified computational framework. Here we address both challenges: a theory that unifies the vectorial diffraction framework, and an algorithm that resolves the accuracy-speed trade-off, each reinforcing the other. We prove that all major vectorial diffraction formalisms and vector-potential seeding methods arise from a single surface equivalence principle and reduce, without approximation, to a finite sequence of scalar angular-spectrum operations. Any advance in scalar propagation can therefore be exploited across the entire vectorial ecosystem. The error-compensating angular spectrum method (E-ASM) serves as a fast and accurate scalar solver, delivering peak signal-to-noise-ratio gains exceeding 60 dB over the state-of-the-art band-extended angular spectrum method at order-of-magnitude faster speed, with a freely configurable observation window. Their combination, implemented in a GPU-accelerated, fully differentiable form, turns rigorous vectorial field computation, previously prohibitive for higher-order beams over macroscopic distances, into a practical, inverse-design-ready tool. We demonstrate the framework on optically addressed local qubit gates and on vectorial Hermite-Gaussian and Laguerre-Gaussian beam propagation, resolving field structures inaccessible to scalar or approximate vectorial methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个统一矢量衍射理论与高效传播算法的框架，以解决自由空间场传播中的精度与速度权衡问题。作者证明，主要矢量衍射形式和矢量势种子方法均可由单一表面等效原理导出，并在无近似条件下化为有限次标量角谱运算。结合误差补偿角谱方法、GPU加速和完全可微实现，该框架能够高效计算严格矢量场，并应用于光寻址局域量子比特门以及矢量厄米特-高斯和拉盖尔-高斯光束传播。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自由空间场传播的数值精度和计算效率，直接决定了从纳米光子超表面到光寻址量子处理器等系统中能够预测哪些物理现象以及能够设计哪些器件。现有方法面临根本性的精度—速度权衡，而在矢量情形下，这一问题还会进一步加剧，因为主要形式体系彼此分散，尚无统一的计算框架。在此，我们同时应对这两个挑战：提出一种统一矢量衍射框架的理论，以及一种解决精度—速度权衡的算法，二者相互促进。我们证明，所有主要的矢量衍射形式和矢量势种子方法都源自单一的表面等效原理，并且无需近似即可化为有限次标量角谱运算。因此，对标量传播的任何改进都可以应用于整个矢量传播体系。误差补偿角谱方法（E-ASM）是一种快速且精确的标量求解器；与当前最先进的带宽扩展角谱方法相比，它的峰值信噪比增益超过60 dB，速度提高了一个数量级，同时具有可自由配置的观测窗口。二者结合后，以GPU加速、完全可微的形式实现，使此前对于宏观距离传播中的高阶光束而言计算成本过高的严格矢量场计算，转变为一种实用且适用于逆向设计的工具。我们在光寻址局域量子比特门，以及矢量厄米特-高斯光束和拉盖尔-高斯光束传播问题上展示了该框架，解析出了标量方法或近似矢量方法无法获得的场结构。

articles.title: Two-fluid effects on the nonlinear dynamics of RFP relaxation
articles.title_zh: 双流体效应对反场箍缩弛豫非线性动力学的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study investigates the role of two-fluid effects during magnetic relaxation in reversed-field pinch (RFP) plasmas. Within the multiple-helicity (MH) regime, two-fluid simulations produce distinct sawtooth oscillations, in contrast to the sawtooth-free state obtained in single-fluid simulations. Analysis of the magnetic field aligned projection of Faraday's law reveals that, tearing modes collectively generate a dynamo electric field that sustains the magnetic relaxation, a process analogous to the flux-pumping in tokamaks. Despite the reduced linear tearing-mode growth rates, stronger two-fluid effects produce more pronounced sawtooth activity over the parameter range considered. Modal energy analysis shows that Hall-mediated nonlinear energy redistribution disrupts the coherent tearing-mode dynamics required to sustain steady flux-pumping, thereby facilitating intermittent reconnection.
