The examples demonstrate recovery of known eigenfunctions, sensitivity to reference trajectory and hyperparameters, limit-cycle harmonics and isochrons, discontinuous indicator eigenfunctions and isostables, symmetry exploitation, and construction of state-dependent lifted input dynamics. For the turbojet example, the identified model is further used for state estimation and design of a gain-scheduled tracking linear quadratic Gaussian controller. The results indicate the applicability of SADFED to Koopman spectral identification and control-oriented modeling of nonlinear dynamical systems.

articles.title: Learning Minimal-Deviation Corrections for Multi-Dimensional Mismodelling in HEP Simulations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.07460v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate Monte Carlo (MC) modelling in high-energy physics is challenging, particularly in complex scenarios where simulations fail to reproduce observed data. In practice, experimental information is often limited to one-dimensional (1D) distributions, while mismodelling arises in a multidimensional feature space. This restricts traditional correction methods, as one-dimensional reweighting ignores correlations and fully multidimensional approaches require large target datasets. We propose a neural network-based method that operates under these constraints by learning a transformation of simulated events that reproduces the available 1D target distributions while remaining close to the original simulation. This minimal-deviation principle preserves the global correlation structure of the baseline model while enabling targeted corrections of mismodelled features. Using controlled studies with simulated pseudo-data, we show that the method improves agreement with target distributions and maintains a consistent multidimensional structure. The approach is designed for complex, high-dimensional analyses where traditional techniques are insufficient, providing a scalable way to enhance MC modelling under limited information.

articles.title: Separating Covariate Shift from Mechanism Change with Two Discriminators: CJSD, a Conditional Discrepancy with an Exact Covariate-Concept Decomposition
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19885v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: After the inputs X are known, how much additional information does the label Y carry about which dataset a sample came from? That single quantity -- estimable as the difference of two discriminators' held-out cross-entropies, D_CJS = CE(Z|X) - CE(Z|X,Y) -- is exactly the part of a dataset difference that covariate shift cannot explain. We propose the Conditional Jensen-Shannon Discrepancy (CJSD): with a task indicator Z, the chain rule I(Z;X,Y) = I(Z;X) + I(Z;Y|X) splits total task discrepancy exactly into a covariate axis and a functional axis, both estimable from two ordinary classifiers, with no task-specific predictors, generative models, or bootstrap surrogates. We prove a covariate-null property (the functional axis is exactly zero under pure covariate shift, however severe), a drift-mass law (D_CJS/ln2 equals the mass of the disagreement region for deterministic labels), a one-sided misspecification-control inequality (each direction of estimation error is bounded, unconditionally, by the excess risk of a single discriminator), and a fixed-measure metrization via an identifiability lemma. Empirically, on a ten-measure battery over 202 dataset pairs (synthetic, Electricity, Covertype), only the two conditional-information estimators -- CJSD and a kNN plug-in for the same estimand -- separate concept from covariate shift with AUC 1.0; the case for CJSD is the estimator: under controlled dimensionality scaling the kNN plug-in fails from d=64 while the discriminator route holds to d=256 with a swappable classifier, and it alone yields paired confidence intervals and sequential extensions from the same learned object. The same estimator audits the conditional fidelity of synthetic-data generators that marginal and joint QA metrics pass, detects annotation-guideline changes invisible to input-space monitors, and supports null-calibrated fairness audits.

articles.title: Actively Learning Joint Contours of Multiple Computer Experiments
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13530v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Contour location---the process of sequentially training a surrogate model to identify the design inputs that result in a pre-specified response value from a single computer experiment---is a well-studied active learning problem. Here, we tackle a related but distinct problem: identifying the input configuration that returns pre-specified values of multiple computer experiments simultaneously. Motivated by computer experiments of the rotational torques acting upon a vehicle in flight, we aim to identify stable flight conditions that result in zero torque forces. We propose a ``joint contour location'' (jCL) scheme that strikes a strategic balance between exploring the multiple response surfaces while exploiting learning of the intersecting contours. Rather than working exploration and exploitation into a single acquisition function, we devise two distinct acquisition schemes with a decision rule to choose between the two, which also provides a natural stopping criterion if no solution is present. We employ traditional Gaussian processes (GPs), multitask GPs, and deep GPs, but our jCL procedure is applicable to any surrogate that can provide posterior predictive distributions. Our jCL designs significantly outperform existing (single response) CL strategies, optimization-based alternatives, and previous strategies for targeting joint contours, enabling us to efficiently locate the optimal configurations for our motivating computer experiments.
authors: Shih-Ni Prim, Kevin R. Quinlan, Paul Hawkins, Jagadeesh Movva, Annie S. Booth

articles.title: Categorical AI phenomenology: A first-person approach
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper develops a phenomenology-first approach to artificial consciousness by reframing consciousness as the subjective experience enacted through an agent's interface with the world. We shift the methodological focus to first-person structures, modeled mathematically by categories derived from Q-networks to capture actions and phenomenological invariants. In this framework, Q-networks are conceptualized as relational interfaces encoding agent-world interaction, analogous to how the dynamical states of a computer depend on its sensory inputs, previous states, and actions. Our work provides a rigorous framework for interface consciousness to describe computational systems that embed information-processing into phenomenological structure. The approach aligns with 4E approaches to cognition by emphasizing enactive, embedded, and extended dimensions of experience. The paper thus offers a principled, relational, and phenomenological account of artificial phenomenology grounded in categorical mathematics.

articles.title: STCO: Conditional Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural operators have emerged as efficient surrogates for time-dependent physical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), but their future-state predictions are often conditioned only on observed states and static problem descriptors. For control or optimization, however, body motion, inflow, or forcing are prescribed for the query without being determined solely by the observed state. We introduce the Spatiotemporal Conditional Operator (STCO) for prescribed-condition operator learning (PCOL), a common interface that supplies prescribed target-time condition fields to heterogeneous backbone architectures while retaining their architecture-specific core computation and context pathways. Its condition interface combines Flow-Aware Graph Leaf (FAGL) with Dual-Site Feature-wise Linear Modulation (DSFiLM). Non-learned FAGL uses vorticity from the final observed frame to construct a fixed-cardinality adaptive partition, then co-locates the observed history and target-time condition fields at its regional coordinates. DSFiLM injects separate motion, inflow, and force routes before and after operator computation through current-feature-driven slot- and channel-wise gates. We evaluate twelve matched backbone architectures with different existing physical and temporal inputs. The immersed-boundary computational fluid dynamics (CFD) benchmark spans prescribed motion, inflow disturbances, body-force actuation, and morphology. Across twelve matched backbones, three regimes, and two lead ranges, STCO yields mean paired reductions of 31.1% in relative-L2 field error and 24.7% in normalized pressure-derived load error. It also lowers longer-lead field error for 11 backbones, while interventions on individual condition groups produce measurable prediction changes for every group evaluated.
authors: Xingxin Yang, Zhan Zhang, Juan Li

articles.title: Continuous-Time Quantum Walks based Graph Neural Network
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used on graph-structured data, but most suffer from two key weaknesses. First, message passing behaves as a low-pass filter under the homophily assumption, leading to poor performance on heterophilic graphs. Second, stacking layers drives node features toward constants, causing over-smoothing. Existing methods usually address these issues separately, while the few joint solutions rely largely on empirical heuristics, and many over-smoothing remedies sacrifice model expressiveness. We propose CTQW-GNN, a GNN based on Continuous-Time Quantum Walks (CTQW), to address both issues with theoretical justification. Its design exploits two properties of the CTQW propagator e⁻ⁱHt. First, it is unitary and has eigenvalues on the unit circle, so no frequency component is damped, counteracting the low-pass bias. Second, unitarity preserves feature norms and prevents the Dirichlet energy from decaying exponentially with depth, thereby mitigating over-smoothing. CTQW-GNN combines three complementary aggregation modules. CTQW-based Aggregation evolves node features through the unitary propagator, preserving mid- and high-frequency signals for heterophilic graphs while preventing Dirichlet-energy collapse. CTQW-Attention Aggregation constructs a multi-hop neighbor graph from CTQW amplitudes and applies attention over it, enabling access to distant homophilic nodes missed by single-hop aggregation. LF Aggregation uses a standard low-pass GAT branch to retain strong performance on homophilic graphs, where pure CTQW aggregation can be suboptimal. We further provide a spectral-gap analysis explaining energy preservation and a Lieb--Robinson-type bound that gives a principled rule for selecting the walk time t.
authors: Yuliang Zhan, Zefeng Gao, Jian Li, Yang Liu, Hao sun
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出基于连续时间量子行走的图神经网络，通过酉传播算子缓解异质图上的低通偏置和深层网络过平滑问题。研究重点是图神经网络的通用架构与理论性质，摘要未显示其针对材料体系或物性预测开展应用。
articles.focus_relation: 仅与团队使用图神经网络的技术方向存在间接关系，与材料模拟、电子结构或机器学习势的直接联系较弱。其酉传播和频率保持思想可能为设计更稳定的材料图网络提供方法参考。

articles.title: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World models for continuous control are commonly trained for a fixed physical system and can degrade when known morphology parameters such as link lengths, masses, damping, and actuation change. Existing approaches often provide these parameters as conditioning information, but leave unspecified which part of the learned transition should remain reusable and which part should change with morphology. We propose Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model for generalization across unseen morphology parameters within related articulated robot families. GraphOp-WM represents bodies and their kinematic relations as an attributed graph and factorizes each transition into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned structured operator. The operator combines node-local modulation, kinematic-tree coupling, and a low-rank global correction, while architectural information separation, basis normalization, and paired-morphology supervision encourage static morphology dependence to be carried by the operator pathway. Graph-level readout and edge-wise action representations provide a compatible interface for reward, value, and TD-MPC-style planning. We further define controlled MuJoCo parameter splits covering interpolation, extrapolation, and held-out compositions of link geometry, mass, damping, and actuation parameters in Hopper, Walker2d, and HalfCheetah.
authors: Xu Yang, Yiqin Yang, Qianchuan Zhao

articles.title: Generalizing Soft Tissue Deformation and Force Prediction Across Material Stiffness and Geometry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate soft tissue simulation is essential for surgical training, pre-operative planning, and haptic feedback systems. While learning-based surrogate models trained on data using the finite element method (FEM) offer a promising path to real-time inference, their reliability depends on well-calibrated constitutive models. Existing approaches neither provide systematic guidance on model selection across stiffness levels, nor generalize across different tissue stiffnesses or geometries. We perform a comprehensive calibration of hyperelastic constitutive models in the SOFA Framework using gravity-loaded silicone beams with different stiffnesses. Using calibrated simulations as training data, we use a softness conditioned equivariant graph neural network, enabling deformation and force prediction across multiple tissue types and unseen geometries. Our model achieves sub-millimeter mean deformation accuracy at 0.010s inference time, while showing that force prediction quality is directly tied to upstream calibration consistency.
authors: Madina Kojanazarova, Sidaty El Hadramy, Philippe C. Cattin

articles.title: The Cost of a Physics Prior Is Bounded by the Ablation Gap
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Shape-constrained and physics-informed learning reports an accuracy cost of enforcing a prior and treats it as a property of the prior. We show it is mostly a property of the free features and the validation split. Let P be the excess risk of restricting a hypothesis class to functions with a shape constraint on features S, and D the excess risk of the ablated model that ignores S. Because a function constant in xⱼ is both non-decreasing and non-increasing in xⱼ, the ablated class is contained in the constrained class, so 0 <= P <= D for every risk functional, with no convexity, smoothness, or realizability assumption. Empirically the bound is a sign test: a constrained model must never be beaten by its own ablation. We instantiate it on an ordinal wildfire-severity task (N = 26,681, K = 3) with hard monotone constraints on four meteorological drivers, coordinates left free, and a validation ladder from i.i.d. resampling to 2-degree spatial blocking. Coordinates act as a shield: alone they recover 92.9% of the full model's macro-F1 under spatial blocking, collapsing D from 0.1288 to 0.0427; the same prior costs 0.0473 shielded and 0.3470 unshielded, a ratio of 7.3 with identical physics. Because D is protocol-dependent it does not transfer: coarsening blocks from 1 to 10 degrees drives D from 0.0942 to 0.0050, leaving two configurations unidentifiable a priori. Inversions of the certified nesting bound the pipeline's additive resolution: over 318 comparisons they give a self-calibrating floor of 0.0220 macro-F1, below which no reported price is interpretable, including four cells in our own headline grid. Cost and compliance are independent: the unconstrained model violates the prior at rate 0.48-0.49 while enforcing it costs 0.0473. We give a two-fit screen that rejects unidentifiable experiments before a constrained model is trained.

articles.title: Evaluation-as-Search: Adaptive Discovery of Grounding Failures in Meeting Assistants
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20392v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-powered meeting assistants are deployed at scale, yet systematic evaluation of their grounding fidelity remains limited to static benchmarks that miss failure modes tied to specific discourse structures or reasoning demands. We propose Evaluation-as-Search (EaS), a feedback-driven methodology that frames quality evaluation as an adaptive search over the space of natural questions a meeting participant might ask. Rather than sampling uniformly, EaS learns from evaluator feedback across iterations to concentrate probing effort on cognitive demands where failures are most likely, guided by a UCB-scored coverage map and blind multi-dimensional quality evaluation. Using EaS, we construct MeetingProbe, a benchmark of over 3,000 annotated question--answer pairs spanning 20 transcripts from three meeting genres and three LLM assistants. In ablations, adaptive search surfaces 2.5× more failures than random probing (7.1% vs. 2.9% finding rate), with the strategic planner contributing the largest individual effect. Across three models, we observe a clear capability gradient and identify eight recurring failure categories dominated by discourse-pragmatic challenges rather than factual recall errors. We further validate MeetingProbe across multiple model families and providers, finding a clean capability gradient and a curated subset of universal failures that no model handles. MeetingProbe is released publicly to support reproducible evaluation of meeting assistant grounding fidelity.
authors: Sami Khairy, Yasaman Hosseinkashi, Vishak Gopal, Ross Cutler

articles.title: One Hierarchy, Two Systems: Semantic Product IDs for Discovery-Surface Ranking and Search-Page Query Reformulation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20640v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-merchant e-commerce catalogs contain equivalent and related products under different merchant-scoped identifiers, fragmenting behavioral evidence across merchants. Expert-defined taxonomies, meanwhile, are often too coarse for fine-grained discovery. We investigate whether a single hierarchical Semantic ID (sid{}) representation can support personalized ranking and query reformulation. Learned once from product-content embeddings, the hierarchy defines product concepts at multiple granularities that each application combines with its own behavioral and serving context. For ranking, we aggregate consumer affinity and product performance over sid{} prefixes and derive sequence features for candidate products and consumer histories. Controlled ablations show improved offline relevance, while online evaluation of the full ranking treatment shows stronger top-slot add-to-cart engagement and broader exposure for less-popular products. For query reformulation, we ground queries and session transitions in sid{} concepts, use the hierarchy for navigation and refinement, and filter suggestions against the merchant's assortment. Offline evaluation shows finer intent preservation than taxonomy and higher-quality suggestions than raw query-string transitions; online evaluation shows reduced search effort and earlier access to purchasable products. These results show that a shared semantic product hierarchy can support both recommendation and search while preserving the task-specific context required by each application.
authors: Steven Xu, Sanjyot Thete, Saathvik Dirisala, Raghav Saboo, Nimesh Sinha, Leo Shao, Elyse Winer, Sudeep Das, Martin Wang, Kyle MacDonald

articles.title: Geometry-controlled vortex dynamics and critical currents in asymmetric superconducting loops with Dayem and nano-bridge weak links
articles.abstract: Dated: August 11, 2026) We study vortex patterns and transport behavior in an asymmetric mesoscopic superconducting loop that incorporates two non-equivalent constriction-type weak links: a Dayem-bridge and a nano-bridge. Employing time-dependent Ginzburg–Landau simulations in the thin-film limit, we examine the magnetization, spatial distribution of supercurrents, Cooper-pair density, voltage response, and current–phase characteristics in the presence of perpendicular magnetic fields and applied transport currents. Without transport current, the geometric asymmetry generates non-uniform vortex arrangements and alters the local circulation of supercurrents. When a current bias is applied, the two constrictions display different degrees of order-parameter suppression, giving rise to distinct voltage responses and critical-current values. By tuning the bridge widths, we demonstrate that both the onset of the resistive state and the resulting vortex configuration can be tailored geometrically. Collectively, our findings identify asymmetric mesoscopic loops as an adjustable platform for engineering vortex entry, phase-slip processes, and critical currents in superconducting circuits based on weak links.

articles.title: Voronoi-entropy characterisation of geometric disorder in two-dimensional porous networks
articles.abstract: Fluid transport through a porous medium may depend not only on how much pore space is available but on how that space is arranged. Porosity and permeability, the standard descriptors, leave unquantified a geometric disorder that can differ widely between samples of equal porosity. We test the Shannon entropy of the Voronoi cell-area distribution as a scalar, porosity-independent measure of this disorder, and ask how it relates to single-phase flow in two-dimensional pore networks. Combining a Voronoi analysis with lattice-Boltzmann simulations parameterised by molecular-dynamics properties of a brine in a montmorillonite matrix, we vary positional disorder, obstacle size and porosity systematically. Across the studies the permeability is governed by the pore-throat scale, so media of equal porosity differ in permeability when their throats differ in width. The Voronoi cell-area entropy complements this account by measuring the geometric disorder that porosity and permeability leave out. Computable from the obstacle positions alone, the entropy is a property of the pore geometry: in a single number it reflects the growing complexity of the pore space, where disorder widens some throats and narrows others at fixed porosity. Therefore, the Shannon entropy helps to capture this local reorganisation, condensing the geometric complexity into a single variable.

articles.title: Geo-electrical Resistivity Investigation of Iron Ore Mineral Deposits in Mbeu Area, Meru County, Kenya
articles.abstract: Global demand for iron and its products has increased in recent years due to the expansion of the housing, road, and railway sectors as well as machinery manufacture, making the search for additional iron ore deposits increasingly important. This study used two-dimensional electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) to characterise the subsurface of the Mbeu area, Meru County, Kenya (approximately 0°06′24″N, 37°50′49″E). Subsurface resistivity was measured at the ground surface using an ABEM Terrameter LS2 along eleven profiles, and the apparent resistivity pseudosections were quantitatively inverted using RES2DINV software. The results delineate two principal subsurface zones: alluvium and rock enriched with iron ore, and alluvium and rock containing disseminated iron ore. Resistivity values of 17.4–406 Ωm and 208–886 Ωm are interpreted as alluvium and rock enriched with iron ore, respectively, while values of 110–487 Ωm and 542–995 Ωm correspond to alluvium and rock containing disseminated iron ore. The Mbeu deposits constitute an extensive resource occurring at both shallow and deep levels, predominantly as granular magnetite mixed with alluvium and host rock, with magnetite identified as the dominant ore mineral. Ore-bearing alluvium and rock were detected at depths of approximately 1.25–65.6 m, and beyond 65.6 m on several profiles.

articles.title: An Explainable Android-Based Decision Support System for High-Performance Concrete Strength Prediction Using XGBoost and Monte Carlo SHAP
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of high-performance concrete (HPC) compressive strength is essential for optimizing mixture design and reducing experimental costs. However, deploying accurate and interpretable machine learning models on mobile devices remains challenging. This study presents an explainable Android-based decision support system for real-time HPC strength prediction and interpretation. A dataset containing 2,171 HPC mixtures with eight input variables was used to develop six machine learning models, including AdaBoost, Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), CatBoost, and XGBoost. Comparative analysis revealed that XGBoost achieved the highest predictive performance (RMSE = 3.512 MPa), outperforming the other models. The trained XGBoost model was exported in JSON format and deployed in an Android application developed using Basic4Android, enabling offline prediction directly on smartphones. To provide model interpretability, a Monte Carlo SHAP approximation algorithm was implemented. Since exact SHAP computation is computationally prohibitive for real-time mobile applications, the proposed approach significantly reduces computational cost while preserving reliable feature attribution. SHAP values are visualized through an interactive waterfall plot, enabling users to understand the contribution of each mixture parameter to the predicted strength. The developed framework integrates prediction, portability, and explainability into a practical tool for HPC engineering decision-making.

articles.title: Dual-Stream Network for Width Inversion of Composite Defects and Experimental Validation
articles.title_zh: 复合缺陷宽度反演的双流网络及其实验验证
articles.abstract: Magnetic flux leakage (MFL) testing is a widely used nondestructive evaluation method for detecting and sizing defects in pipelines. Under nested composite defect conditions, the nonlinear magnetic field interference among defects distorts the multi-component MFL signals, rendering width-associated signal features susceptible to corruption. To address this issue, this paper proposes a dual-stream multiscale attention network (MS-BiGRU-Attn). The architecture processes the axial and normal signal components independently in parallel branches, employs multiscale convolution (MS) and bidirectional gated recurrent units (BiGRU) to capture spatial characteristics across different receptive fields and temporal dependencies, respectively, and applies an attention mechanism to adaptively refine features in high-gradient regions. Trained exclusively on single-defect data, the model achieves a width coefficient of determination ((:RW²)) of 0.883 on an out-of-distribution (OOD) test set comprising 150 composite defects, significantly outperforming the early-fusion baseline (0.178) and the single-stream BiGRU (0.648). Specimen experiments further validate these findings: models trained with five independent random seeds all accurately capture the overall increasing trend of the width, with the mean (:RW²) reaching 0.807. The proposed dual-stream network architecture thus provides effective support for robust width inversion of defect boundaries under nonlinear magnetic field interference conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁漏磁检测是管道缺陷检测与尺寸评估中广泛采用的无损评价方法，但嵌套复合缺陷之间的非线性磁场干扰会使与宽度相关的信号特征发生畸变。本文提出双流多尺度注意力网络，通过分别处理轴向和法向信号，在仅使用单缺陷数据训练的条件下，实现了对复合缺陷宽度的稳健反演，并通过试样实验进行了验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁漏磁（MFL）检测是用于检测和测量管道缺陷的一种广泛应用的无损评价方法。在嵌套复合缺陷条件下，缺陷之间的非线性磁场相互干扰会使多分量磁漏磁信号发生畸变，从而导致与宽度相关的信号特征容易受到破坏。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种双流多尺度注意力网络（MS-BiGRU-Attn）。该架构通过并行分支独立处理轴向和法向信号分量，分别采用多尺度卷积（MS）和双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）来捕获不同感受野下的空间特征和时间依赖关系，并利用注意力机制对高梯度区域中的特征进行自适应细化。在仅使用单缺陷数据训练的情况下，该模型在包含150个复合缺陷的分布外（OOD）测试集上取得了0.883的宽度决定系数（R_W²），显著优于早期融合基线模型的0.178和单流BiGRU模型的0.648。试样实验进一步验证了这些结果：使用五个相互独立的随机种子训练的模型均准确捕捉到了宽度总体上升的趋势，平均R_W²达到0.807。因此，所提出的双流网络架构能够在非线性磁场干扰条件下，为缺陷边界宽度的稳健反演提供有效支持。

articles.title: Numerical Investigation of the Thermo-structural Performance of an Automotive Ventilated Brake Disc Using a Proposed Al- Based Metal Matrix Composite
articles.title_zh: 采用所提出铝基金属基复合材料的汽车通风制动盘热结构性能数值研究
articles.abstract: Automotive brake discs experience severe thermo-mechanical loading during braking, involving complex interactions among heat transfer, thermal expansion, and structural deformation. This study develops a sequential thermo-structural finite element model in ANSYS Workbench to evaluate the performance of a proposed aluminum-based metal matrix composite (Al-based MMC) for ventilated brake discs. A mesh sensitivity analysis was performed, and a refined 2.5 mm element size was selected to capture localized thermo-mechanical responses. A realistic boundary configuration was implemented using a fixed caliper bracket support and a tangential-free cylindrical constraint at the five hub mounting holes to avoid artificial over-constraint. The proposed Al-based MMC was compared with Structural Steel and Gray Cast Iron under identical braking conditions. The results show that the Al-based MMC significantly reduces the maximum operating temperature to 283.23°C, compared with 317.07°C for Structural Steel and 322.77°C for Gray Cast Iron, owing to its high thermal conductivity of 160 W/m·K. Although the MMC produces a higher maximum total deformation of 0.85316 mm, the value remains within an acceptable range under the investigated operating conditions. In addition, the proposed material achieves a 65.6% reduction in density compared with Structural Steel, demonstrating considerable potential for lightweight brake rotor applications. The developed numerical framework provides a reliable approach for the comparative assessment of advanced brake disc materials prior to experimental validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了基于 ANSYS Workbench 的顺序热结构有限元模型，用于评估一种铝基金属基复合材料在通风制动盘中的性能。与结构钢和灰铸铁相比，该复合材料显著降低了最高工作温度，并在保持可接受变形的同时大幅减轻密度，显示出用于轻量化制动转子的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 汽车制动盘在制动过程中承受严重的热机械载荷，其中涉及传热、热膨胀和结构变形之间的复杂相互作用。本研究在 ANSYS Workbench 中建立了顺序热结构有限元模型，用于评估所提出的铝基金属基复合材料（铝基MMC）在通风制动盘中的性能。研究进行了网格敏感性分析，并选择2.5 mm的细化单元尺寸，以捕捉局部热机械响应。模型采用了现实的边界配置：固定卡钳支架支撑，并在五个轮毂安装孔处施加切向自由的圆柱约束，以避免人为过度约束。在相同制动条件下，将所提出的铝基MMC与结构钢和灰铸铁进行了比较。结果表明，由于其热导率达到160 W/m·K，铝基MMC将最高工作温度显著降低至283.23°C，而结构钢和灰铸铁分别为317.07°C和322.77°C。尽管MMC产生了较高的最大总变形0.85316 mm，但在所研究的工作条件下，该数值仍处于可接受范围内。此外，与结构钢相比，所提出材料的密度降低了65.6%，显示出其用于轻量化制动转子的巨大潜力。所建立的数值框架为实验验证前先进制动盘材料的比较评估提供了可靠方法。

articles.title: Topology-based Physical Reconstruction of Biological Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于拓扑的生物网络物理重构
articles.abstract: Biological networks are one of the key tools for describing complex systems in biophysics, systems biology and bioinformatics. However, the raw data from most biological knowledge bases, in particular STRING, contain only information about the network topology, without the spatial coordinates of the nodes, which makes it impossible to directly apply physical and mathematical methods that require the existence of a metric space. This paper proposes a reproducible approach to the physical reconstruction of biological networks, which restores the spatial coordinates of nodes based solely on the topological structure of the graph. The reconstruction is treated as the problem of finding the equilibrium configuration of a mechanical system of interacting elements by minimising the effective potential energy of that system. The approach was tested on a network of protein associations obtained from the STRING database for the query ‘COVID-19 + pneumonia’ (51 nodes, 412 interactions). The reconstruction fully preserved the topology of the original network — as confirmed by graph isomorphism, complete agreement in nodes, edges and the local structure of connections — with the relaxation process reaching a stable configuration after approximately 250 iterations. Thirty independent reconstructions with different random initialisations confirmed the high reproducibility of the network’s geometric characteristics (median Spearman’s correlation R = 0.944 for the radial ranking of nodes). Unlike the traditional use of spatial embedding algorithms, which are primarily employed for visualisation, the proposed approach constructs a metric coordinate space in which the spatial coordinates of the nodes become an independent, reproducible quantitative dataset suitable for analysing inter-node distances, local density and other physical and mathematical characteristics of the network.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可复现的生物网络物理重构方法，仅依据图的拓扑结构恢复节点的空间坐标。该方法将重构视为相互作用机械系统的平衡构型搜索问题，通过最小化有效势能构造度量坐标空间，并在STRING数据库的蛋白质关联网络上验证了拓扑保持性、稳定性和可复现性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生物网络是生物物理学、系统生物学和生物信息学中描述复杂系统的关键工具之一。然而，大多数生物知识库，尤其是STRING中的原始数据，只包含网络拓扑信息，而没有节点的空间坐标，因此无法直接应用那些要求存在度量空间的物理和数学方法。本文提出一种可复现的生物网络物理重构方法，仅根据图的拓扑结构恢复节点的空间坐标。该重构被视为寻找相互作用元素组成的机械系统平衡构型的问题，具体通过最小化该系统的有效势能来实现。该方法在从STRING数据库中针对“COVID-19 + 肺炎”查询获得的蛋白质关联网络上进行了测试，该网络包含51个节点和412条相互作用。重构完全保留了原网络的拓扑结构；图同构检验以及节点、边和连接局部结构的完全一致性均证实了这一点；经过约250次迭代，松弛过程达到稳定构型。采用不同随机初始条件进行的30次独立重构证实了网络几何特征具有很高的可复现性，节点径向排序的Spearman相关系数中位数为R=0.944。与主要用于可视化的传统空间嵌入算法不同，所提出的方法构造了一个度量坐标空间，使节点的空间坐标成为独立且可复现的定量数据集，可用于分析节点间距离、局部密度以及网络的其他物理和数学特征。

articles.title: Urban Heat Island Dynamics and 2030 Thermal Scenario in Pokhara, Nepal Using Landsat and CA– Markov Modeling
articles.title_zh: 利用Landsat与CA-Markov模型研究尼泊尔博卡拉城市热岛动态及2030年热环境情景
articles.abstract: Urban heat islands are an increasing concern in rapidly urbanizing cities where vegetation and cultivated land are being converted into impervious and exposed surfaces. This study assessed land use/land cover change, vegetation condition, land surface temperature, and urban heat island intensity in the 37.42 km² core urban area of Pokhara Metropolitan City, Nepal. Landsat imagery from 2014, 2019, and 2024 was processed in Google Earth Engine. Support Vector Machine classification was used for land-cover mapping, while NDVI and EVI were used to examine vegetation conditions. Landsat-derived land surface temperature was evaluated using MODIS LST, and DHM air-temperature records were used as supplementary thermal-consistency evidence. A CA–Markov model was applied to generate a 2030 land-cover scenario and assess its likely thermal implications. Results showed that settlement increased from 20.01% in 2014 to 37.45% in 2024, while cultivation declined from 78.04% to 55.53%. Mean land surface temperature increased from 29.87°C to 37.46°C, and maximum temperature increased from 36.19°C to 44.58°C. Landsat LST showed reasonable agreement with MODIS LST, with a correlation coefficient of 0.736 and RMSE of 2.79°C. The 2030 scenario suggests that settlement and airport-related built-up surfaces may occupy 50.43% of the study area, while High and Extremely High UHI classes may together cover 50.63%. The findings highlight the need for urban greening, exposed-surface management, and heat-sensitive planning in Pokhara.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用2014、2019和2024年的Landsat影像，评估尼泊尔博卡拉大都会市核心城区的土地覆盖变化、植被状况、地表温度和城市热岛强度，并采用CA-Markov模型预测2030年情景。研究发现，聚落扩张和地表温度升高趋势明显，2030年高等级及极高等级热岛区域可能覆盖研究区约一半，凸显城市绿化、裸露地表管理和热敏感规划的必要性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在快速城市化、植被和耕地不断转变为不透水地表及裸露地表的城市中，城市热岛日益成为一个令人关注的问题。本研究评估了尼泊尔博卡拉大都会市37.42 km²核心城区的土地利用/土地覆盖变化、植被状况、地表温度和城市热岛强度。研究使用Google Earth Engine处理Landsat影像，影像年份为2014、2019和2024。采用支持向量机分类进行土地覆盖制图，并利用NDVI和EVI考察植被状况。基于Landsat反演的地表温度通过MODIS地表温度进行评估，DHM气温记录则作为补充的热一致性证据。研究应用CA-Markov模型生成2030年土地覆盖情景，并评估其可能的热环境影响。结果显示，聚落面积占比从2014年的20.01%增加至2024年的37.45%，而耕地占比从78.04%下降至55.53%。平均地表温度从29.87°C升至37.46°C，最高温度从36.19°C升至44.58°C。Landsat地表温度与MODIS地表温度表现出较为合理的一致性，相关系数为0.736，均方根误差为2.79°C。2030年情景表明，聚落和机场相关建成区地表可能占研究区的50.43%，而高等级和极高等级城市热岛类别合计可能覆盖50.63%。研究结果强调了在博卡拉开展城市绿化、裸露地表管理和热敏感规划的必要性。

articles.title: Spatiotemporal Network Analysis of Actual Evapotranspiration Dynamics and Causal Teleconnections in Iran
articles.title_zh: 伊朗实际蒸散动态及因果遥相关的时空网络分析
articles.abstract: Long-term monitoring of actual evapotranspiration (ETa) is critical for assessing land–atmosphere water dynamics, yet optimizing monitoring networks requires a deeper understanding of spatial synchronization and predictive dependencies in water-limited environments. Utilizing GLEAM v4 satellite-derived data (1980–2023), we propose an integrated trend–topology–directionality framework to assess ETa variability across Iran. By combining long-term trend detection, complex network analysis, and Granger causality, this approach evaluates spatial connectivity to inform the design and optimization of regional environmental monitoring systems. Trend assessments (–0.03 to +0.13 mm/year) reveal rising ETa in the west/northwest and declines in the northeast, reflecting shifting hydroclimatic stress. Topological analysis of the spatial data exhibits a distinct core–periphery structure; high-degree centrality (0.001–0.43) in the central plateau (e.g., Dasht-e Kavir, Dasht-e Lut) indicates a highly synchronized core sensitive to large-scale atmospheric perturbations. Betweenness centrality metrics (≤0.03) highlight northeastern and central-eastern zones as critical spatial bridges, identifying priority locations for continuous monitoring stations. Furthermore, Granger causality isolates the northeast as a predictive source region influencing central/southeastern follower zones. Validated via spatial bootstrapping (correlation: 0.064–0.57), this framework provides a scientific basis for optimizing monitoring networks. By identifying predictive source regions and transitional nodes, the methodology provides a transferable template for environmental risk assessment and adaptive water resource management in similar large-scale, water-limited environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 长期监测实际蒸散对于评估陆地-大气水分动态十分重要。本文利用1980—2023年GLEAM v4卫星数据，结合趋势检测、复杂网络分析和格兰杰因果关系，识别伊朗实际蒸散的空间同步性、核心-边缘结构及预测源区，为区域环境监测网络优化和水资源适应性管理提供依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 长期监测实际蒸散（ETa）对于评估陆地-大气水分动态至关重要，但优化监测网络需要更深入地理解水资源受限环境中的空间同步性和预测依赖关系。利用GLEAM v4卫星反演数据（1980—2023年），我们提出一个集趋势、拓扑和方向性于一体的框架，用于评估伊朗各地ETa的变化。通过结合长期趋势检测、复杂网络分析和格兰杰因果关系，该方法评估空间连通性，从而为区域环境监测系统的设计和优化提供信息。趋势评估显示变化范围为−0.03至+0.13 mm/年：伊朗西部和西北部ETa上升，而东北部下降，反映出水文气候压力正在转移。空间数据的拓扑分析呈现出明显的核心-边缘结构；中部高原（例如达什特-卡维尔和达什特-卢特）的高节点度中心性（0.001—0.43）表明这里存在一个高度同步的核心，对大尺度大气扰动较为敏感。介数中心性指标（≤0.03）突出显示东北部和中东部区域是关键空间桥梁，并据此确定了连续监测站的优先位置。此外，格兰杰因果关系分析识别出东北部是预测源区，可影响中部和东南部的跟随区域。通过空间自助法验证后（相关系数：0.064—0.57），该框架为监测网络优化提供了科学依据。通过识别具有预测作用的源区和过渡节点，该方法为类似大尺度水资源受限环境中的环境风险评估和适应性水资源管理提供了可迁移的模板。

articles.title: Engineering Printable PNIPAM/HPC Thermochromic Hydrogels through Multi-Parameter Optimization for Energy-Efficient Smart Windows
articles.title_zh: 通过多参数优化设计用于节能智能窗的可打印PNIPAM/HPC热致变色水凝胶
articles.abstract: Thermochromic hydrogels based on poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) (PNIPAM) have attracted considerable attention for smart-window applications; however, their practical implementation is restricted by limited tunability of the lower critical solution temperature (LCST), inadequate processability, and relatively high material cost. In this study, a systematic strategy was developed to optimize the structure, thermal response, and optical performance of PNIPAM hydrogels through the combined regulation of crosslinking density, ionic environment, and hydroxypropyl cellulose (HPC) incorporation. The effects of N,N′-methylenebisacrylamide concentration on microstructure, swelling behavior, LCST, and thermochromic performance were first investigated, and response surface methodology identified 0.03 wt.% as the optimum crosslinker content. Subsequently, sodium chloride and calcium chloride were employed to tailor the phase-transition temperature, revealing that NaCl effectively reduced the LCST while preserving superior optical contrast, whereas CaCl₂ produced a stronger salting-out effect and complex formation at the expense of optical performance. HPC was then incorporated using in-situ polymerization to improve printability and reduce material consumption. Moderate HPC loading significantly enhanced transparency and optical contrast without substantially altering the transition temperature, while excessive HPC broadened the phase transition and reduced opacity. Among all formulations, the PNIPAM/HPC ratio of 70/30 exhibited the most balanced combination of transition temperature, optical contrast, and structural uniformity, demonstrating excellent potential as a printable thermochromic ink for four-dimensional printing. These findings provide an effective approach for engineering cost-efficient, printable, and high-performance thermochromic hydrogels for next-generation energy-efficient smart windows.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统优化了聚(N-异丙基丙烯酰胺)水凝胶的结构、热响应和光学性能，调控因素包括交联密度、离子环境以及羟丙基纤维素的引入。研究确定了适宜的交联剂含量和PNIPAM/HPC配比，其中70/30配方在转变温度、光学对比度和结构均一性之间实现了最佳平衡，具有作为四维打印热致变色油墨的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于聚(N-异丙基丙烯酰胺)（PNIPAM）的热致变色水凝胶已受到智能窗应用的广泛关注；然而，其实际应用受到下临界溶液温度（LCST）可调性有限、可加工性不足以及材料成本相对较高的限制。本研究通过综合调节交联密度、离子环境和羟丙基纤维素（HPC）的引入，建立了一种系统优化PNIPAM水凝胶结构、热响应和光学性能的策略。首先研究了N,N′-亚甲基双丙烯酰胺浓度对微观结构、溶胀行为、LCST和热致变色性能的影响，并通过响应面法确定0.03 wt.%为最佳交联剂含量。随后采用氯化钠和氯化钙调节相变温度，结果表明，NaCl能够有效降低LCST，同时保持较优的光学对比度；CaCl₂则产生更强的盐析效应和络合形成，但会牺牲光学性能。之后通过原位聚合引入HPC，以提高可打印性并减少材料消耗。适量HPC显著提高了透明度和光学对比度，而不会明显改变转变温度；HPC含量过高则会拓宽相变区间并降低不透明度。在所有配方中，PNIPAM/HPC为70/30的配比在转变温度、光学对比度和结构均一性之间实现了最平衡的组合，显示出作为四维打印用可打印热致变色油墨的出色潜力。这些发现为设计成本高效、可打印且高性能的热致变色水凝胶提供了有效途径，可用于下一代节能智能窗。

articles.title: Temporal Completeness Reveals Long-Term Hydroclimatic Trend Reversal: A Multi-Temporal Remote Sensing Assessment of Lake Belevi (Türkiye), 2000–2026
articles.title_zh: 时间完整性揭示长期水文气候趋势反转：对土耳其贝莱维湖（2000—2026年）的多时相遥感评估
articles.abstract: Climate-induced hydrological change increasingly threatens Mediterranean freshwater systems, yet many satellite-based monitoring studies end before the recent sequence of severe droughts, potentially biasing long-term trend assessments. This study presents a temporally complete 26-year (January 2000–April 2026) hydroclimatic assessment of Lake Belevi (İzmir, Türkiye) using 273 monthly Landsat-derived surface water observations integrated with CHIRPS precipitation, ERA5 temperature, and watershed NDVI within Google Earth Engine. Seasonal Mann–Kendall analysis of the full series revealed a significant decreasing trend (p = 0.014, Sen slope = − 1.27 ha month⁻¹), whereas the truncated 2000–2020 record showed a significant increasing trend (p = 0.008), suggesting that extending observations beyond recent droughts can change the inferred direction of long-term hydrological trends. PELT detection identified five hydrological regime shifts (2005, 2013, 2016, 2022, and 2025), while the 2025 drought reduced lake area to 4.7 ha (96.5% below the 2013–2016 peak), followed by rapid recovery to 180.7 ha by February 2026. Watershed NDVI increased significantly (+ 53.2%, p < 0.001) despite declining water extent. These findings indicate that temporally truncated satellite records may underestimate drought-induced hydrological degradation and even reverse the inferred direction of long-term trends, supporting more robust climate-change attribution and adaptive water-resource management.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用2000年1月至2026年4月的完整26年数据，对土耳其伊兹密尔贝莱维湖开展水文气候评估。完整序列显示湖面面积显著下降，而截短至2020年的记录却显示显著上升，说明纳入近期干旱事件可能改变长期趋势判断，并揭示了湖泊面积的多次水文状态转变及2025年干旱后的快速恢复。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 气候引起的水文变化日益威胁地中海淡水系统，但许多基于卫星的监测研究在近期一系列严重干旱发生前就已结束，因而可能造成长期趋势评估偏差。本研究利用Google Earth Engine，将273个月度Landsat反演地表水观测与CHIRPS降水、ERA5温度和流域NDVI相结合，对土耳其伊兹密尔贝莱维湖开展了一个时间完整的26年水文气候评估，时间范围为2000年1月至2026年4月。完整序列的季节性Mann-Kendall分析显示湖面面积呈显著下降趋势（p=0.014，Sen斜率=−1.27 ha/月），而截短的2000—2020年记录却显示显著上升趋势（p=0.008），表明将观测延伸至近期干旱之后，可能改变所推断的长期水文趋势方向。PELT检测识别出五次水文状态转变，发生于2005、2013、2016、2022和2025年；2025年干旱使湖面面积降至4.7 ha，比2013—2016年的峰值低96.5%，随后到2026年2月迅速恢复至180.7 ha。尽管水域范围下降，流域NDVI仍显著增加了53.2%（p<0.001）。这些发现表明，时间上截短的卫星记录可能低估干旱引起的水文退化程度，甚至反转所推断的长期趋势方向；因此，更完整的观测有助于更稳健的气候变化归因和适应性水资源管理。

articles.title: Solving layered rough contact via a physics-informed operator framework
articles.title_zh: 利用物理信息算子框架求解分层粗糙接触问题
articles.abstract: Predicting three-dimensional layered rough surface contact behavior is fundamental to modern tribological interface design and surface engineering. However, experimental measurements lack sub-surface resolution, theoretical models rely on oversimplified geometric assumptions, and high-fidelity numerical methods remain computationally prohibitive for multiscale interface problems. To address these limitations, we develop a physics-informed operator-decomposition framework that separates the unknown nonlinear contact-state mapping from the analytically known elastic compliance operator. This framework combines an attention-enhanced U-Net with a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) to capture localized and long-range interactions while decomposing the predicted surface deformation into elastic and plastic components. By incorporating penalty terms derived from the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) contact conditions into the loss function, the framework promotes physically admissible predictions with respect to nonpenetration, pressure nonnegativity, and contact complementarity. Furthermore, a multiscale feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) module dynamically injects dimensionless physical parameters into the convolutional feature maps, facilitating generalization across broad ranges of coating properties and system scales. Validation against standard boundary element method (BEM) calculations demonstrates that the framework achieves high fidelity across diverse topographies while reducing full-field inference times from minutes to milliseconds. Overall, the proposed framework provides an efficient and physically interpretable surrogate for resolving full-field pressure and displacement responses in layered rough contact across broad geometric, material, and loading regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理信息算子分解框架，用于高效预测三维分层粗糙表面的接触行为。该方法结合注意力增强U-Net和傅里叶神经算子，利用KKT接触条件约束预测结果，并通过多尺度FiLM模块实现对材料和系统参数变化的泛化。与边界元法结果的验证表明，该框架能够保持较高精度，同时将全场推理时间从分钟级降至毫秒级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测三维分层粗糙表面的接触行为是现代摩擦学界面设计和表面工程的基础。然而，实验测量无法获得次表面分辨率，理论模型依赖过度简化的几何假设，而高保真数值方法在多尺度界面问题中的计算成本仍然过高。为解决这些限制，我们开发了一种物理信息算子分解框架，将未知的非线性接触状态映射与解析已知的弹性柔度算子分离开来。该框架结合注意力增强U-Net和傅里叶神经算子（FNO），以捕捉局部和长程相互作用，同时将预测的表面变形分解为弹性和塑性分量。通过在损失函数中加入源自Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）接触条件的惩罚项，该框架促进了满足物理条件的预测，包括不可穿透性、压力非负性和接触互补性。此外，多尺度特征线性调制（FiLM）模块将无量纲物理参数动态注入卷积特征图，从而促进模型在宽范围涂层性质和系统尺度上的泛化。与标准边界元法（BEM）计算结果的验证表明，该框架能够在多种地形条件下实现高保真预测，同时将全场推理时间从分钟级降低到毫秒级。总体而言，所提出的框架为在广泛几何、材料和载荷范围内解析分层粗糙接触的全场压力和位移响应，提供了一种高效且具有物理可解释性的替代模型。

articles.title: Magnetic rigidity reveals the PeVatron acceleration region in SS 433
articles.title_zh: 磁刚性揭示SS 433中的PeVatron加速区
articles.abstract: PeVatrons are cosmic accelerators capable of driving particles to petaelectronvolt (PeV) energies[1,3]. Recently, microquasar jets have emerged as compelling Galactic PeVatron candidates[2,4,5]. This is especially the case for SS 433 as its >100 TeV gamma-ray emission is spatially coincident with an atomic cloud. However, the exact region where PeV protons are accelerated and injected within these jets remains unresolved. Here we report, using archival, multi-frequency VLBA observations, the magnetic field profile B(H) along the SS 433 inner jet on tens of AU scale, where H is the distance from the central compact object. We find that the field declines as B(H) ∝ H−⁰.⁵⁰±⁰.¹², demonstrating that the magnetic rigidity B(H)Rₐcc grows with H for a conical jet. This implies the Hillas limit (Eₘₐₓ∝BH) to lie well beyond a PeV at a few hundred-AU scale[6], which becomes a highly potential site for accelerating protons to energies E_cut≃2.6 PeV inferred from the LHAASO gamma-ray spectrum. These results reveal a hidden PeVatron within the baryonic ejecta of microquasar SS 433, well upstream of the extended TeV-emitting lobes.
articles.abstract_zh: PeVatron能够将粒子加速至拍电子伏（PeV）能区，微类星体喷流已成为银河系PeVatron的有力候选者。基于多频VLBA档案观测，研究测量了SS 433内喷流数十天文单位尺度上的磁场剖面，发现磁场随距中心致密天体距离H按H⁽⁻⁰.50±0.12)衰减，因此圆锥喷流中的磁刚性随H增大。结果表明，数百天文单位尺度处的Hillas极限可远超1 PeV，可能是加速能量约2.6 PeV质子的区域，揭示了位于延展TeV辐射瓣上游、隐藏在SS 433重子喷出物中的PeVatron。
articles.abstract_zh_full: PeVatron是能够将粒子驱动至拍电子伏（PeV）能量的宇宙加速器[1,3]。近期，微类星体喷流已成为银河系PeVatron的有力候选者[2,4,5]。SS 433尤其如此，因为其超过100 TeV的伽马射线辐射在空间上与一片原子云重合。然而，在这些喷流内部，PeV质子究竟在哪个区域被加速并注入，仍未得到解决。在此，我们利用档案多频甚长基线阵列（VLBA）观测，报告了SS 433内喷流沿线、数十天文单位尺度上的磁场剖面B(H)，其中H是距中心致密天体的距离。我们发现，磁场按B(H)∝H⁽⁻⁰.50±0.12)衰减，这表明对于圆锥形喷流，磁刚性B(H)Rₐcc随H增大。这意味着在数百天文单位尺度处，Hillas极限（Eₘₐₓ∝BH）远高于1 PeV[6]；该区域很可能是将质子加速至LHAASO伽马射线能谱所推断的E_cut≈2.6 PeV能量的场所。这些结果揭示了微类星体SS 433重子喷出物中一个隐藏的PeVatron，它位于延展TeV辐射瓣的显著上游。

articles.title: Temperature-induced structural changes and mechanical degradation in phosphoric acid- based geopolymers
articles.title_zh: 温度诱导的磷酸基聚合地质聚合物结构变化与力学退化
articles.abstract: Understanding the high-temperature behavior of geopolymers is essential for their potential applications in refractory materials, thermal insulation, and fire-resistant structural systems. Here, atomistic simulations were conducted to investigate the temperature-dependent structural evolution and mechanical response of phosphate acid-based polymers (PABGs) over a temperature range of 300–1173 K. Results indicate that the local Si–O, P–O, and Al–O units remain largely intact, while the nanoscale network gradually becomes disordered with increasing temperature. This evolution is reflected by the attenuation of higher-order radial distribution function peaks, the reduction of P-related bridging bonds, the redistribution of Al coordination states, the enhanced mobility of P atoms, and the increase in porosity. In particular, Si–O–P and Al–O–P linkages are more temperature-sensitive than Si–O–Al bonds. The porosity increases from 35.32% to 47.44%, while the bulk density decreases from 1.885 g/cm− 3 to 1.390 g/cm− 3, indicating progressive structural loosening under thermal exposure. Tensile simulations further show a marked decrease in Young’s modulus from 42.5 GPa at 300 K to 25.5 GPa at 1173 K, corresponding to an overall reduction of 40.0%. This mechanical degradation is closely associated with bond weakening, coordination rearrangement, increased atomic mobility, and pore growth. All these factors collectively reduce network connectivity and stress transfer efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究考察了300–1173 K范围内磷酸基地质聚合物的温度依赖性结构演化和力学响应。局部Si–O、P–O和Al–O单元基本保持完整，但纳米尺度网络逐渐无序化，孔隙率由35.32%升至47.44%，体密度由1.885降至1.390 g/cm³。拉伸模拟显示杨氏模量由42.5 GPa降至25.5 GPa，降幅为40.0%，其原因与键弱化、配位重排、原子迁移增强和孔隙增长有关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解地质聚合物的高温行为，对于其在耐火材料、热绝缘材料和防火结构系统中的潜在应用至关重要。在本研究中，我们开展了原子尺度模拟，以考察300–1173 K温度范围内磷酸基聚合物（PABGs）的温度依赖性结构演化和力学响应。结果表明，局部Si–O、P–O和Al–O单元总体上保持完整，而纳米尺度网络随着温度升高逐渐变得无序。这一演化表现为高阶径向分布函数峰减弱、与P相关的桥联键减少、Al配位状态重新分布、P原子迁移率提高以及孔隙率增加。特别是，Si–O–P和Al–O–P连接比Si–O–Al键对温度更加敏感。孔隙率从35.32%增加到47.44%，而体密度从1.885 g/cm³下降到1.390 g/cm³，表明热暴露过程中结构逐步松弛。拉伸模拟进一步显示，杨氏模量从300 K时的42.5 GPa显著下降至1173 K时的25.5 GPa，对应总体降幅40.0%。这种力学退化与键弱化、配位重排、原子迁移增强及孔隙增长密切相关。所有这些因素共同降低了网络连通性和应力传递效率。
