articles.title: Fingerprinting fractons with pump-probe spectroscopy
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05594v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate how pump-probe techniques enable specific spectroscopic diagnostics of fracton phases of matter by studying lineon-planon braiding in the paradigmatic X-cube model. Our discussion builds on previous works probing anyonic exchange statistics in conventional spin liquids, but the extension to fracton phases reveals qualitatively new phenomena due to the restricted mobility of fractionalized excitations. A key feature is that nearby planons can form an emergent bound state by accessing different planes via alternative pairing configurations. We show that this bound state qualitatively modifies the long-time linear and nonlinear responses, leading to an asymptotic linear-in-t behavior for the pump-probe signal χ_ZZX. By contrast, swapping the pump and probe polarizations produces a nonlinear response χ_XXZ that is asymptotically t-independent. This asymmetry reflects the fact that the two species of fractionalized excitations live in different spatial dimensions. Thus, the pump-probe signals studied here are sensitive to (i) nontrivial braiding statistics in three dimensions, (ii) the existence of bound states among fractionalized excitations, and (iii) the one-dimensional mobility of lineons. Our results therefore provide spectroscopic signatures that distinguish fracton phases from conventional topologically ordered spin liquids.
authors: Wei-En Tseng, Oliver Hart, Rahul Nandkishore

articles.title: Analog Simulation of Massive Relativistic Quantum Fields in 2 + 1 Dimensions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08840v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum field theories provide fundamental models of complex interacting systems, from high-energy physics and cosmology to condensed matter. However, solving these models in non-perturbative and dynamical regimes is often challenging, particularly in more than one spatial dimension. Analog simulation using tunable synthetic quantum systems can both verify existing theoretical predictions and lead to new physical insights. Here, we realize analog simulation of massive relativistic quantum fields in 2+1 dimensions (two spatial dimensions and time), using two coherently coupled spin components in a uniform two-dimensional atomic Bose--Einstein condensate. Specifically, we encode the paradigmatic sine-Gordon model in the long-wavelength modes of the field describing the relative phase, φ, of the two components. In the perturbative regime, collective field excitations exhibit a relativistic dispersion with a tunable mass gap. We also observe explicitly non-perturbative phenomena, including the existence of topological domain walls across which φ rapidly winds by 2π. Our work opens possibilities for studies of cosmologically relevant phenomena including preheating, dynamics of topological defects, and relativistic false-vacuum decay.
authors: Yansheng Zhang, Feiyang Wang, Paul H. C. Wong, Alexander C. Jenkins, Yi Jiang, Konstantinos Konstantinou, Gehrig Carlse, Nishant Dogra, Joseph H. Thywissen, Christoph Eigen, Zoran Hadzibabic

articles.title: Solvable model of noisy coupled oscillators with fully random interactions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.04404v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a solvable spherical model of coupled oscillators with fully random interactions and distributed natural frequencies. Using the dynamical mean-field theory, we derive self-consistent equations for the stationary response and correlation functions. We show that the finite-temperature spin-glass transition is suppressed for any nonmonodisperse natural-frequency distribution, including continuous, discrete, and asymmetric distributions, because the resulting low-frequency singularity of the correlation function is incompatible with the spherical constraint. At zero temperature, however, a spin-glass phase persists for arbitrary frequency dispersion. This residual zero-temperature glassiness is likely a special feature of the spherical dynamics and would be destroyed by local nonlinearities. The model thus provides a solvable oscillator framework for studying how nonequilibrium perturbations suppress finite-temperature glassy freezing.

articles.title: Toward Greater Autonomy in Materials Discovery Agents: Unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.05616v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We aim at designing language agents with greater autonomy for crystal materials discovery. While most of existing studies restrict the agents to perform specific tasks within predefined workflows, we aim to automate workflow planning given high-level goals and scientist intuition. To this end, we propose Materials Agent unifying Planning, Physics, and Scientists, known as MAPPS. MAPPS consists of a Workflow Planner, a Tool Code Generator, and a Scientific Mediator. The Workflow Planner uses large language models (LLMs) to generate structured and multi-step workflows. The Tool Code Generator synthesizes executable Python code for various tasks, including invoking a force field foundation model that encodes physics. The Scientific Mediator coordinates communications, facilitates scientist feedback, and ensures robustness through error reflection and recovery. By unifying planning, physics, and scientists, MAPPS enables flexible and reliable materials discovery with greater autonomy, achieving a five-fold improvement in stability, uniqueness, and novelty rates compared with prior generative models when evaluated on the MP-20 data. We provide extensive experiments across diverse tasks to show that MAPPS is a promising framework for autonomous materials discovery.
authors: Lianhao Zhou, Hongyi Ling, Keqiang Yan, Kaiji Zhao, Xiaoning Qian, Raymundo Arróyave, Xiaofeng Qian, Shuiwang Ji

articles.title: Time correlations from steady-state expectation values
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.08661v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recovering properties of correlation functions is typically challenging. On the one hand, experimentally, it requires measurements with a temporal resolution finer than the system's dynamics. On the other hand, analytical or numerical analysis requires solving the system evolution. Here, we use recent results of quantum metrology with continuous measurements to derive general lower bounds on the relaxation and second-order correlation times that are both easy to calculate and measure. These bounds are based solely on steady-state expectation values and their derivatives with respect to a system parameter, and can be readily extended to the autocorrelation of arbitrary observables. We validate our method on two examples of critical quantum systems: a critical driven-dissipative resonator, where the bound matches analytical results for the dynamics, and the infinite-range Ising model, where only the steady state is solvable, and thus the bound provides information beyond the reach of existing analytical approaches. Our results can be applied to the experimental characterization of ultrafast systems and to the theoretical analysis of many-body models whose dynamics are hard to compute.
authors: Wojciech Górecki, Simone Felicetti, Lorenzo Maccone, Roberto Di Candia

articles.title: Ergotropic Mpemba crossings in finite-dimensional quantum batteries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11056v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect is a counterintuitive phenomenon in which a state initially farther from equilibrium relaxes more rapidly than one that starts nearer to equilibrium. In the context of finite-dimensional quantum batteries interacting with an environment, we introduce the notion of an ergotropic Mpemba crossing (EMC), defined by the intersection of ergotropy trajectories during the dynamics. For qubit batteries subjected to amplitude damping noise, we derive a condition for the occurrence of EMC in terms of the relative coherence of the initial states and fully characterize the region of state space that exhibits EMC with respect to a fixed reference state. Interestingly, our analysis reveals that under anisotropic Pauli noise, the emergence of EMC is jointly governed by the coherence and the energy of the initial states. To elucidate the physical origin of EMC, we decompose ergotropy into coherent and incoherent contributions and show that, in qubit systems, the coherent component plays a crucial role for EMC, an observation that strikingly does not extend to three-level batteries, providing the dimensional role in observing EMC. Further, by extending our analysis to non-Markovian environments, we demonstrate that, unlike the Markovian case, non-Markovian dynamics can give rise to multiple Mpemba crossings, with the total number of crossings always being odd. Also, we propose a set-up showing that EMC can be utilized to suppress the ergotropic loss, occurred due to dissipation. Moreover, analyzing the connection between the EMC and the conventional state Mpemba effect reveals that, for qubits, an EMC necessarily entails a state Mpemba crossing, while this correspondence breaks down for qutrits, where EMCs may arise without any state Mpemba crossing.
authors: Triyas Sapui, Tanoy Kanti Konar, Aditi Sen De

articles.title: UPLOAD-ANYON: Progress Towards an Optimised Twisted Anyon Cavity with High-Sensitivity AM-Noise Detection for an Ultralight Axion Dark Matter Search
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a superconducting single-mode microwave haloscope based on helical cavity resonators for the detection of ultralight dark matter axions over the mass range 10⁻¹⁸ to 10⁻¹³,eV. Building on the single-mode helical-cavity concept introduced by Bourhill et al. [Phys. Rev. D 108, 052014 (2023); arXiv:2208.01640], we use an inverse-design framework to develop practical resonator geometries compatible with superconducting niobium fabrication. The optimisation employs a figure of merit derived to minimise the measurement time required to achieve a fixed experimental sensitivity. Relative to the heuristic Möbius-geometry benchmark, the best subtractively manufacturable bulk-niobium design achieves a figure of merit more than three orders of magnitude larger. An experimentally informed microwave interferometric readout model, incorporating measured electronics noise and active suppression of pump amplitude noise, is used to project the sensitivity of the proposed experiment. For an acquisition time of three months, the haloscope is projected to reach gₐγγ<10⁻¹¹,GeV⁻¹ across more than four orders of magnitude in axion mass. The projected sensitivity extends approximately one order of magnitude below the current exclusion limits set by CAST, providing a practical pathway towards a high-sensitivity direct search for ultralight dark matter axions.
authors: Robert Crew, Emma Paterson, Maxim Goryachev, Eugene Ivanov, Pashupati Dhakal, Tugrul Talha Ersoz, Michael Tobar, Jeremy Bourhill

articles.title: Which pulse maximizes resonant nonlinear conversion?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: At fixed pulse energy, which drive waveform extracts the most nth-order nonlinear conversion from a resonator (n=2 for second harmonic)? A short pulse couples poorly to a narrow resonance, a long one dilutes its energy, and no linear rule fixes the compromise. We solve the problem exactly for a single mode of amplitude decay rate κ. Eliminating the drive turns fixed incident energy into a constraint on the stored field alone, and the optimization becomes a sharp Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequality whose extremal is the ground-state soliton of the nonlinear Schrödinger equation. The optimal stored field is sech¹/⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾[(n-1)κ t], sustained by an asymmetric input that rises as eκ t and falls as e⁻⁽²ⁿ⁻¹⁾κ t; the largest converted energy follows in closed form. A rising exponential, the time-reversal recipe, retains at most 79.0% of the bound at n=2 and 2/e at large n; a two-rate pulse retains above 97%. Critical coupling generalizes to n-fold overcoupling, with optimal input coupling n times the intrinsic loss rate. The bound applies from microrings to superconducting circuits and caps the per-pulse brightness of broadband photon-pair sources.

articles.title: Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Subsystem Density Functional Theory
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a new computational approach based on Nuclear-Electronic Orbital and Subsystem Density Functional Theory. The resulting NEO-sDFT methodology enables quantum chemical calculations of large molecular systems composed of thousands of atoms while also describing selected protons quantum mechanically. A key feature of the associated program implementation is its flexibility in assigning quantum protons to subsystems, allowing different embedding schemes to be employed within a unified framework. The accuracy of NEO-sDFT is assessed by computing water dimer interaction energies, which exhibit errors of only a few meV compared to reference Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Density Functional Theory results. The favorable computational scaling of NEO-sDFT is further showcased through calculations on water clusters of increasing size, with up to 303 protons being treated quantum mechanically. Our results demonstrate that NEO-sDFT is an accurate and efficient approach for incorporating nuclear quantum effects into large-scale simulations, providing a foundation for future applications to proton transfer processes in biochemical systems.

articles.title: Mutually phase-stable tunable attosecond soft X-ray attosecond pulses from a free-electron laser
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the production of mutually phase-stable attosecond X-ray pulse pairs with tunable relative time delays and phases in a cascaded X-ray free-electron laser. We showcase the method in an experiment at the LCLS-II, in which a shaped electron beam is used in a split undulator configuration to generate the two attosecond pulses. We achieve mutual phase stability by reusing microbunching generated in the first undulator in order to seed the FEL process in the second at a detuned frequency. We measure controllable temporal delays between the two pulses directly in the time domain using angular streaking of photoelectrons, with a step size of 250 attoseconds. We then show that the behavior of the X-ray spectrum is consistent with phase stability between the two pulses, with a relative phase that can be easily tuned using inter-undulator phase shifters. This method is particularly well-suited to few to ten eV energy separations and sub to few femtosecond time delays, which are ideal for experiments in the soft X-ray regime for pushing the limits of our models for molecular dynamics and exerting direct coherent control over quantum systems.
authors: River Robles, David Cesar, Taran Driver, Paris Franz, Veronica Guo, Gabriel Just, Kirk A. Larsen, Randy Lemons, Ming-Fu Lin, Razib Obaid, Nicholas Sudar, Jun Wang, Zhen Zhang, James Cryan, Agostino Marinelli

articles.title: Mid-infrared distributed-feedback lasing from black phosphorus under nanosecond excitation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mid-infrared (MIR) light sources compatible with silicon photonics are highly desirable for environmental sensing and free-space optical communications. Conventional GaSb-based quantum-well and interband-cascade lasers, however, rely on complex epitaxial heterostructures, complicating their integration with silicon photonic platforms. Here, we demonstrate a room-temperature MIR surface-emitting distributed-feedback (DFB) laser using black phosphorus (b-P) as the active gain medium. By deterministically integrating exfoliated b-P flakes onto lithographically patterned SiO₂ gratings, we obtain narrowband emission with a full width at half maximum below 3 nm under 1064 nm optical excitation. The lasing wavelength is tunable from 3.79 to 4.05~μm through the b-P flake thickness, covering a technologically important region of the mid-infrared. Room-temperature thresholds as low as (0.25 ± 0.07) mJ/cm² are achieved under nanosecond excitation. Upon cooling to 110 K, the threshold decreases tenfold to (0.015 ± 0.005) mJ/cm². These results establish planar b-P DFB cavities as a promising platform for heterogeneously integrated MIR lasers based on van der Waals semiconductors.
authors: Julien Brodeur, Laure Sène, Stéphane Kéna-Cohen

articles.title: Geometric Control of Cat States in High Harmonic Generation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20119v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-harmonic generation (HHG) provides a powerful platform for exploring the interaction between intense laser fields and matter on ultrafast timescales. Beyond its conventional description in terms of emitted radiation and electron dynamics, a fully quantum treatment of HHG reveals that the nonlinear light-matter interaction can modify the quantum state of the driving field itself, establishing correlations between the fundamental and harmonic modes. This perspective opens new possibilities for using HHG as a tool to engineer and control nonclassical states of light. In this work, we investigate the geometric properties of optical Schroedinger cat states generated in HHG via conditioning and post-selection. By analyzing the coherent-state displacements induced by different structured driving fields, we characterize the resulting phase-space evolution and the associated geometric phases of the generated quantum states. Particular emphasis is placed on how the polarization and spatial-mode structure of the driving light influence the geometry and evolution of displaced coherent states. Our results demonstrate that structured light offers a versatile means of controlling the geometric dynamics of HHG-generated cat states across the parameter space. Furthermore, we discuss the prospects for realizing genuinely topological optical cat states by exploiting more complex structured light configurations.
authors: Arti Gaharwar, Rocío Borrego-Varillas, Marcelo F. Ciappina, Anna G. Ciriolo, Javier Rivera-Dean, Philipp Stammer, Paraskevas Tzallas, Emilio Pisanty, Maciej Lewenstein

articles.title: Symmetry-guided modal control in elliptical femtosecond-laser-written photonic waveguides
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Few-mode photonic circuits can increase functionality without multiplying waveguide paths, but bends and fabrication errors can mix their transverse modes. We investigate a strategy in which waveguide confinement and perturbation parity are engineered together in vertically elliptical, femtosecond-laser-written glass waveguides. The intended modal basis comprises the even 1S mode and the vertically odd 2P_y mode. No window-converged 2Pₓ state is resolved for a lower-confinement (LC) design, whereas a higher-confinement (HC) design guides 2Pₓ, which must therefore be isolated by symmetry. In scalar beam-propagation calculations, the 1S-2P_y propagation-constant splitting predicts the optimized periods of a vertically modulated coherent modal splitter to within 1.0%. Horizontal S-bends remain parity-mismatched for 1S ↔ 2P_y coupling, while the symmetry-allowed HC 1S → 2Pₓ transfer reaches only 0.6% at the largest displacement. At a displacement of 150~μm, the HC design retains approximately the same 2P_y power as the LC design retains at 40~μm. Thermal and stochastic writing-error calculations reveal the resulting trade-off: stronger confinement improves modal-power retention, but writing jitter that breaks x-parity can populate the guided 2Pₓ mode. These results demonstrate how modal-basis engineering can shift part of the crosstalk-control burden from the trajectory to waveguide symmetry, supporting joint path--mode degrees of freedom in quantum photonic applications.
authors: Tadas Paulauskas, Ubaid Ur Rehman, Eimantas Dermauskas, Valdemar Stankevic

articles.title: Observables and Anti-Hermitian Generators in Time-Dependent Unitary Coupled Cluster Theory
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work presents a time-dependent (TD) unitary coupled-cluster (UCC) formulation for electronic quantum dynamics, including the propagation of excited states and their superpositions, in both single- and multi-reference regimes. Standard TD coupled-cluster techniques offer size-extensivity, but they rely on non-Hermitian bivariational action functionals that break time-reversibility, giving transition matrix elements and amplitude estimators that are asymmetric (though accurate and systematically improvable). Here we use the time-evolution operator as an exponential map driven by TD anti-Hermitian cluster operators and first-order generators. Applying the Dirac-Frenkel action principle, we extract equations of motion governed by Heisenberg-picture-like commutators. This approach connects to our previous non-Hermitian formulations, where observables are expressed in terms of regular and extended cluster operators. From that connection we obtain a generator cluster operator whose unperturbed TD limit leads to the UCC eigenvalue problem. Even though this problem can be exact, the time dependence of the generator holds only at short propagation times, so we use the generator to prepare the initial state and then propagate that state with the formal TD UCC equation of motion. The theory is tested on an extended hard-core Bose-Hubbard ring with connections to neutral atom chains, and we discuss the theory's present limitations and possible extensions.

articles.title: Vibrational Activation Triggers Ultrafast Excited State Intramolecular Proton Transfer in Single-Benzene Fluorophores
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-benzene fluorophores (SBFs) are exceptionally light-weight quantum emitters which have recently been shown to display Excited State Intramolecular Proton Transfer (ESIPT) and highly tunable dual-fluorescence that could be exploited for multiple applications. Here, we employ excited-state molecular dynamics to investigate the ultrafast dynamics of ESIPT in two different SBFs, one of which with a new structure proposed in this work. We find that both single and double ultrafast proton transfers can be triggered by exciting specific molecular vibrations. Strikingly, the kinetic activation of these vibrations - selected by atomistic, symmetry-based analysis - can considerably enhance the yield of proton transfer(s), as well as direct the reaction towards either single or double-transfer products. In-depth analysis elucidates the origins of this vibronic control, providing atomistic guidelines through which both the rate and fate of ESIPT could be steered using ultrafast IR-Vis spectroscopies.
authors: Brieuc Le Dé, Simon Huppert, Riccardo Spezia, Alex W. Chin

articles.title: Computational Methods of Wave Propagation for Semiclassical Models of High Harmonic Generation in Bulk Solids
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical framework for self consistent treatment of nonlinear light-matter interactions in the ultra-fast strong-field regime based on numerical solution of Maxwell's equations and semiconductor Bloch equations. This framework is shown to describe high-order harmonic generation and propagation in bulk semiconductors, investigating differences in reflected and transmitted harmonic spectra due to propagation effects. We show that the propagation of the combined field of the driving laser pulse and generated harmonics in a bulk semiconductor significantly modifies the harmonic spectra, affecting interpretation of experimental results relating the transmitted harmonic spectra to the underlying electronic structure of the material. This model allows the self-consistent description of strong-field light-matter interactions in the non-perturbative regime, opening the way to explore the transition between fully classical and quantum regimes of interaction, tunneling and multiphoton regimes of material ionization, and perturbative and non-perturbative regimes of harmonic generation in bulk materials.
authors: Ava N. Hejazi, Nicholas Karpowicz, Gregory D. Scholes, Julia M. Mikhailova

articles.title: Vacuum viscosity and relativistic inertia: Motion of a massive object with charged internal degrees of freedom interacting with a classical field
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20140v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Our present investigation into a rather rudimentary problem is motivated by two classes of problems studied since the 70's, cosmological particle creation and its more accessible analog, the dynamical Casimir effect on the one hand, and quantum friction a neutral atom moving along a dielectric surface would experience, on the other. The backreaction effects of produced particles being able to isotropize the expansion of the universe, or to slow down the moving mirror can be understood via the concept of vacuum viscosity arising from fluctuations of the quantum field. We want to track down the origin of this effect by asking the question whether a moving massive M object with a charged internal degrees of freedom χ interacting with a free unbounded classical field φ at zero temperature would experience a viscous force, similar to the said precedents. Adopting a microphysics model for optomechanics which can treat the unequal tripartite χ-φ-M interactions, we first perform a nonrelativistic calculation, which seems perfectly legitimate considering the needs of atomic physics, and found the answer to be yes, but a relativistic covariant calculation says no. We identify where the nonrelativistic framework is defective. The resolution of this latent yet real conflict is technically nontrivial but physically quite inspirational. It results in added enriched contents to Newton's first and second laws when the principles of special relativity are enforced, and rules to follow to get the correct nonrelativistic answer

articles.title: An Irreducible Quantum Advantage in Aligning World Models with Reality
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: World models provide digital simulacra of the true world, allowing agents to be trained and tested before costly real-world deployment. At each time step, they receive an action and generate an observation and reward matching the statistics of the true world. In complex environments where present outcomes depend on events far in the past, this requires memory. One might expect that, by increasing memory, we can always build a model accurately enough to align the optimal agent policies of the real and virtual worlds. We show that this is false for classical world models, even when the true world itself is classical. We construct true worlds for which every finite classical model fails along the same possible trajectory: it either loses the ability to distinguish actions when the true world clearly prefers one, or repeatedly assigns the highest expected reward to suboptimal actions. Its expected-reward estimates also retain a nonvanishing average error. In contrast, each such true world admits a quantum world model using a single qutrit that reproduces it exactly: its reward estimates and preferred actions always match those of the true world, ensuring that the optimal policies of the real and virtual worlds remain perfectly aligned.
authors: Josep Lumbreras, Hailan Ma, Jayne Thompson, Mile Gu

articles.title: Self-Correcting Toric-Code Memory in a Globally Controlled Rydberg Array
articles.abstract: The central prerequisite of any fault-tolerant quantum architecture is a quantum memory: a block of encoded physical qubits whose logical state is actively preserved against noise across many rounds of error correction. In neutral-atom Rydberg arrays, realizing such a memory is obstructed not by the entangling gates themselves, which are already fast and high-fidelity, but by the auxiliary operations that a conventional error-correction cycle requires — mid-circuit fluorescence measurement, inter-zone atom transport, and locally focused single-qubit addressing. Each of these introduces latency, atom loss, or optical crosstalk that exceeds the cost of the underlying gates by orders of magnitude. These costs accumulate cycle after cycle, progressively degrading the very logical information the code is meant to protect. Here we propose a protocol that stabilizes a toric-code quantum memory without moving, measuring or local addressing atoms. The key is to use a three-species Rydberg atom array for the complete stabilizer cycle, including syndrome extraction, coherent correction, and ancilla reset, under global, species-selective laser pulses. Numerical simulation of a 4!×!4 rotated toric code shows a longer qubit lifetime when the physical error rate is below a pseudo-threshold p^star!approx!0.034. The scheme offers a concrete, hardware-efficient route to topological quantum memory in neutral-atom platforms.

articles.title: Theoretical analysis of forces generated by mitotic spindle
articles.abstract: The mitotic spindle acts as the generator of force that drives mitosis. In prometaphase and metaphase the force is required to align kinetochore/chromosome pairs in the bio-orientated configuration while in anaphase the force is required to drive the separation of kinetochore/chromosome pairs. The forces have been measured experimentally in prometaphase or metaphase of many organisms. For example, in grasshopper spermatocytes, the force on each microtubule (kMT) attached to kinetochores in prometaphase was determined to be about 7 pN. By contrast, in anaphase of grasshopper spermatocytes the force required to halt the motion of a kinetochore/chromosome was determined to be about 700 pN, equivalent to a force of about 50 pN per kMT. A puzzling issue is why in grasshopper spermatocytes the force to stall the kinetochore/chromosome (700 pN) exceeds significantly the normal anaphase force (0.1 ~ 0.7 pN) and why the force of 50 pN per kMT in anaphase is also much larger than 7 pN in prometaphase. Here, based on our proposed model for the spindle in metaphase and anaphase, we study theoretically the forces generated by the spindle, explaining the puzzling issue. Moreover, prediction is provided that the total force to stall all kinetochores in anaphase of grasshopper spermatocytes is about 4-fold larger than the force to stall the single kinetochore or the force on each kinetochore to stall all kinetochores is only about 17% fraction of the force to stall the single kinetochore.

articles.title: High-resolution analysis of the S 1 –S 0 transition of magnesium phthalocyanine: Rotational structure and electronic angular momentum
articles.abstract: We report a high-resolution spectroscopic analysis of the S 1 –S 0 transition of magnesium phthalocyanine (MgPc), obtained by probing buffer-gas-cooled molecules with a narrow-linewidth laser. The observed spectrum exhibits a characteristic three-peak pattern, which is well reproduced by modeling MgPc as an oblate symmetric top with D 4h symmetry. A key result of this work is that the spectrum is strongly influenced by electronic Coriolis coupling, which is associated with electronic angular momentum. The electronic Coriolis constant is determined to be ∼2, indicating an effective orbital angular momentum of about 2 in the excited S 1 state, originating from the π-conjugated ring excitation. This provides a direct spectroscopic signature of electronic angular momentum in a large polyatomic molecule. The presence of nonzero electronic orbital angular momentum is qualitatively consistent with the perimeter model of phthalocyanines. The value lies within the range inferred from previous magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) studies. Compared with the previous MCD estimate, the present analysis provides a more state-specific and narrower constraint, demonstrating that high-resolution spectroscopy enables direct access to electronic and magnetic properties beyond conventional structural characterization.

articles.title: Universal pattern revealed in quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 量子物质中揭示的普适规律
articles.abstract: When different materials transition from one phase to another, such as water coming to a boil or a magnet losing its ability to attract metals, something remarkable can happen: They begin to behave identically, following the same mathematical rules. "Physicists call this trait universality—the messy, microscopic details wash out and only a few essential features survive," explains Jason Alicea, William K. Davis Professor of Theoretical Physics. The math underlying these universal traits is commonly described by a theoretical framework called conformal field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同材料在发生相变时，尽管微观细节各异，却可能呈现相同的行为规律，这种性质被称为普适性。共形场论通常用于描述支配这些普适性质的数学结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当不同材料从一种相态转变为另一种相态时，例如水开始沸腾或磁体失去吸引金属的能力，可能会发生一件非凡的事情：它们开始以完全相同的方式表现，并遵循同一套数学规律。理论物理学威廉·K·戴维斯教授 Jason Alicea 解释道：“物理学家将这种特性称为普适性（universality）——复杂而混乱的微观细节会被消除，只留下少数几个本质特征。”支撑这些普适特征的数学通常由一种称为共形场论的理论框架来描述。

articles.title: Connecting the power of the stars to geometry
articles.title_zh: 将恒星之力与几何学相连接
articles.abstract: In the world of fusion energy, scientists and engineers study the fourth state of matter known as plasma in an effort to design and build a new type of power plant. Relying on the heat produced by two small atoms smashing together, a network of such facilities would help create a novel source of stable electricity and help ensure America's energy independence. And while scientists in this endeavor are devoting their attention to complex machinery and temperatures hotter than the surface of the sun, they are also trying to determine the best designs for such a power plant by focusing on geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚变能源研究致力于利用等离子体和轻原子聚变产生的热量，建设稳定供电的新型发电设施。除研究高温和复杂设备外，研究人员还通过几何设计寻找更优的聚变电站方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在聚变能源领域，科学家和工程师研究被称为等离子体的第四态物质，力图设计并建造一种新型发电厂。依靠两个小原子相互碰撞所产生的热量，由此类设施构成的网络将有助于创造一种新型稳定电力来源，并帮助确保美国的能源独立。尽管从事这一事业的科学家将注意力投入到复杂机械以及比太阳表面更高的温度上，他们也正通过聚焦几何学来确定此类发电厂的最佳设计。

articles.title: WTFFN-YOLO: An Improved Lightweight Method for Surface Defect Detection on Wind Turbine Blades
articles.title_zh: WTFFN-YOLO：一种用于风电叶片表面缺陷检测的改进型轻量化方法
articles.abstract: As critical components of wind turbines, blade surfaces may develop defects such as cracks and wear, which significantly affect operational stability and service life.Therefore, accurate and efficient defect detection is essential for the maintenance and safe operation of wind turbines.This paper proposes a blade surface defect detection method based on the WTFFN-YOLO framework.First,the C3K2 module is replaced with the C3K2-SACA attention mechanism.Second,the traditional upsampling layer is replaced with a frequency-aware feature fusion module (FreqFusion).Finally,we designed the neck network introduces the WTFFN module to replace the conventional concatenation layer.This design enables more effective multi-scale feature integration,achieving accurate detection while reducing model parameters and computational cost,thereby improving both efficiency and feature representation capability.Experimental results show that the improved model achieves 6.9% increase in mean average precision (mAP), In small-object mAP improvement 8.2%,and 8% reduction in model parameters, satisfying both accuracy and lightweight design requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对风电叶片表面的裂纹和磨损等缺陷，研究提出基于 WTFFN-YOLO 的检测方法。该方法通过 SACA 注意力机制、频率感知特征融合模块和 WTFFN 颈部网络改善多尺度特征整合，在降低参数量的同时提升检测精度。实验表明，模型 mAP 提升 6.9%，小目标 mAP 提升 8.2%，参数量减少 8%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作为风力涡轮机的关键部件，叶片表面可能出现裂纹、磨损等缺陷，这些缺陷会显著影响其运行稳定性和使用寿命。因此，准确且高效的缺陷检测对于风力涡轮机的维护和安全运行至关重要。本文提出了一种基于 WTFFN-YOLO 框架的叶片表面缺陷检测方法。首先，使用 C3K2-SACA 注意力机制替换 C3K2 模块。其次，使用频率感知特征融合模块（FreqFusion）替代传统上采样层。最后，我们设计了在颈部网络中引入 WTFFN 模块，以替换常规拼接层的方法。该设计能够更有效地整合多尺度特征，在实现准确检测的同时减少模型参数量和计算成本，从而同时提高效率和特征表征能力。实验结果表明，改进模型的平均精度均值（mAP）提高了 6.9%，小目标 mAP 提高了 8.2%，模型参数量减少了 8%，同时满足精度和轻量化设计要求。

articles.title: Production-network embedding and embodied carbon–energy footprints in semiconductor supply chains: An MRIO scenario analysis of Taiwan, Japan, and the United States
articles.title_zh: 生产网络嵌入与半导体供应链隐含碳-能源足迹：台湾、日本和美国的多区域投入产出情景分析
articles.abstract: Resilience-oriented reconfiguration of strategic supply chains may create environmental co-benefits or trade-offs, yet its embodied carbon and energy consequences remain poorly understood. Using the Eora Full multi-region input–output (MRIO) database, we compare Taiwan’s Semiconductors sector with observed semiconductor-related production structures in Japan and the United States. These comparisons are scenario-based footprint envelopes, not relocation forecasts or identical-fab efficiency estimates. Relative to Taiwan’s baseline, EDGAR CO₂ multipliers are 88.9% lower for the descriptive midpoint of the two Japanese sector scenarios and 93.6% lower for the US sector scenario; Eora I-ENERGY multipliers, interpreted only as 2022 cross-sector diagnostics, are 96.4% and 97.4% lower. Under cumulative B1b, which retains Taiwan’s upstream input structure while substituting the host target-sector direct intensity and reassigning only the direct electricity input, CO₂ reductions are 20.4% for the Japan midpoint and 22.9% for the United States. Upstream decomposition links Taiwan’s high multiplier to identifiable domestic electricity and heavy-industry sectors, while strict residual-account shares remain below 0.5% in all CO₂ decompositions. The results suggest that the environmental implications of semiconductor reconfiguration are associated mainly with upstream production-network embedding rather than siting or cleaner host electricity alone. The analysis covers embodied CO₂ and energy requirements, not material, water, social, or economic sustainability outcomes.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用 Eora Full 多区域投入产出数据库，比较台湾半导体部门与日本、美国观察到的半导体相关生产结构，以评估供应链重构的隐含碳和能源影响。结果显示，台湾较高的排放乘数主要与其上游生产网络嵌入有关，而非仅由生产选址或东道国较清洁的电力决定。研究仅覆盖隐含二氧化碳与能源需求，不涉及材料、水资源、社会或经济可持续性结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 面向韧性的战略供应链重构可能带来环境协同效益或权衡，但其隐含碳和能源后果仍缺乏充分认识。我们利用 Eora Full 多区域投入产出（MRIO）数据库，将台湾的半导体部门与日本和美国已观察到的半导体相关生产结构进行比较。这些比较是基于情景的足迹范围估计，而非迁移预测，也不是对相同晶圆厂效率的估计。相对于台湾基准情景，就两个日本部门情景的描述性中点而言，EDGAR 二氧化碳乘数低 88.9%；对于美国部门情景，该乘数低 93.6%。Eora I-ENERGY 乘数仅被解释为 2022 年跨部门诊断指标，在日本和美国情景下分别低 96.4% 和 97.4%。在累积情景 B1b 下，台湾的上游投入结构得到保留，同时替换东道国目标部门的直接强度，并且仅重新分配直接电力投入，日本中点情景和美国情景的二氧化碳减排幅度分别为 20.4% 和 22.9%。上游分解表明，台湾较高的乘数与可识别的国内电力和重工业部门相关，而在所有二氧化碳分解中，严格残差账户份额均低于 0.5%。结果表明，半导体重构的环境影响主要与上游生产网络嵌入有关，而非仅取决于选址或东道国更清洁的电力。该分析涵盖隐含二氧化碳和能源需求，不涵盖材料、水资源、社会或经济可持续性结果。

articles.title: Latent debt in PINNs with SIR Models: Dynamical Compensation and Topological Bottlenecks
articles.title_zh: SIR 模型中 PINN 的潜在债务：动力学补偿与拓扑瓶颈
articles.abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for parameter inference in nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with increasing relevance in data-scarce domains such as digital health, where reliable inference under limited observations is critical for decision-making. However, their behaviour in early dynamical regimes, characterised by sparse information and near-linear system dynamics, remains insufficiently understood, particularly regarding loss landscape geometry and error propagation. By analyzing the Normalized Hessian within a subdetermined SIR model, we show that parameter inference becomes fundamentally ill-conditioned during the exponential growth phase, where the loss landscape exhibits a locally flat, rank-deficient structure. In this regime, optimization algorithms can minimize residual losses while converging to incorrect parameter values, compensating through systematic distortions in unobserved latent state variables. Temporal domain decomposition further introduces failure mechanisms whereby small initial-condition errors propagate across windows. As a result, the model may produce solutions that are numerically accurate yet associated with incorrect parameter estimates, reflecting a trade-off between insufficient curvature in short windows and the embedding of early-phase artefacts in longer horizons. These findings reveal that the limitations of PINNs arise from deeper topological pathologies in the optimization landscape and underscore the need to move beyond standard residual minimization toward structurally informed regularization strategies, providing a principled foundation for more robust and biologically consistent scientific machine learning models.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究分析物理信息神经网络在欠定 SIR 模型早期指数增长阶段的参数推断问题，发现此时损失景观局部平坦且秩亏，导致参数估计本质上病态。模型可通过扭曲未观测潜在状态变量来补偿错误参数，并且时间域分解会使初始条件误差跨窗口传播。研究指出，需要超越标准残差最小化，采用具有结构信息的正则化策略。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已成为非线性常微分方程（ODE）参数推断的强大范式，并且在数字健康等数据稀缺领域日益重要，因为在有限观测条件下进行可靠推断对于决策至关重要。然而，人们对其在早期动力学阶段的行为仍缺乏充分理解；该阶段以信息稀疏和系统动力学近似线性为特征，尤其是在损失景观几何和误差传播方面。通过分析欠定 SIR 模型中的归一化 Hessian 矩阵，我们表明，在指数增长阶段，参数推断会变得根本性地病态，此时损失景观呈现局部平坦、秩亏的结构。在这一状态下，优化算法能够最小化残差损失，却收敛到错误的参数值，并通过对未观测潜在状态变量进行系统性扭曲来实现补偿。时间域分解还会引入失效机制，使较小的初始条件误差跨时间窗口传播。因此，模型可能产生数值上准确、但参数估计错误的解，这反映了短窗口中曲率不足与较长时间范围内嵌入早期阶段伪影之间的权衡。这些发现揭示，PINN 的局限性源于优化景观中更深层的拓扑病理，并强调需要超越标准残差最小化，转而采用具有结构信息的正则化策略，从而为构建更稳健、更符合生物学一致性的科学机器学习模型提供原则性基础。

articles.title: Deep Learning-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization of Surface Finish and Tool Wear in CNC Dry Turning
articles.title_zh: 深度学习驱动的数控干式车削表面质量与刀具磨损多目标优化
articles.abstract: Achieving fine surface finish without sacrificing tool life is the defining trade-off of computer numerical control (CNC) turning, yet parameter selection on production-grade lathes still relies largely on conservative handbook values. This paper develops a fully data-driven, deep-learning-enabled multi-objective optimization framework for dry turning of medium-carbon steel and validates it experimentally on a production CNC lathe. A three-factor, three-level full factorial experiment spanning the practical operating envelope of spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut provides the training dataset. Analysis of variance establishes that surface roughness and tool wear are governed by different, partly conflicting subsets of the cutting parameters, confirming a genuine two-objective conflict. Deep neural network regression surrogates are trained for both responses and benchmarked against classical power-law models under leave-one-out cross-validation; the superior surrogates are then embedded in the reference-point-based evolutionary algorithm NSGA-III to trace the Pareto front, and TOPSIS ranking with knee-point identification and weight-sensitivity analysis converts the front into operatorready recommendations in which feed rate and depth of cut collapse to single robust values, leaving spindle speed as the sole trade-off dial. Quantitatively, the deep networks reduce the cross-validated mean absolute percentage error of the roughness model from 9.79% to 7.65% and of the wear model from 6.68% to 1.01%; the predicted Pareto front extends 28% deeper into the fine-finish region than the power-law front, exposing an experimentally observed optimum that the parametric model overestimates by 40% and would therefore misprice; and the knee-point compromise recommendation is complemented by a TOPSIS ranking that is robust for all roughness weightings up to 55%.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究构建并实验验证了一个面向中碳钢数控干式车削的深度学习多目标优化框架，以协调表面粗糙度与刀具寿命之间的权衡。深度神经网络代理模型优于传统幂律模型，并结合 NSGA-III、TOPSIS 和膝点识别生成可操作的参数建议。其表面粗糙度和刀具磨损模型的交叉验证误差分别降至 7.65% 和 1.01%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在不牺牲刀具寿命的前提下获得精细表面质量，是计算机数控（CNC）车削中的决定性权衡；然而，生产级车床上的参数选择仍在很大程度上依赖保守的手册数值。本文开发了一个完全数据驱动、由深度学习支持的中碳钢干式车削多目标优化框架，并在一台生产型数控车床上对其进行了实验验证。涵盖主轴转速、进给率和切削深度实际工作范围的三因素、三水平全因子实验提供了训练数据集。方差分析表明，表面粗糙度和刀具磨损由切削参数中不同且部分相互冲突的子集所支配，从而证实存在真正的双目标冲突。针对两个响应变量训练深度神经网络回归代理模型，并在留一交叉验证下与经典幂律模型进行基准比较；随后，将表现更优的代理模型嵌入基于参考点的进化算法 NSGA-III，以描绘帕累托前沿；再利用结合膝点识别和权重敏感性分析的 TOPSIS 排序，将该前沿转换为可供操作人员使用的建议，其中进给率和切削深度收敛为单一稳健取值，仅保留主轴转速作为唯一的权衡调节变量。定量而言，深度网络将粗糙度模型的交叉验证平均绝对百分比误差从 9.79% 降至 7.65%，将磨损模型的该误差从 6.68% 降至 1.01%；预测的帕累托前沿比幂律前沿向精细表面质量区域延伸得更深 28%，揭示了一个实验观测到的最优点，而参数模型对该最优点高估了 40%，因而会导致错误定价；膝点折中建议还辅以 TOPSIS 排序，并且在表面粗糙度权重不高于 55% 的所有情形下均具有稳健性。

articles.title: Cascading Congestion Collapse and Proactive Admission Control in Quantum Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中的级联拥塞崩溃与主动接纳控制
articles.abstract: Quantum repeater networks distribute entanglement using quantum memories with finite coherence time. Under load, a hop whose entangled pair must wait for sibling hops can decohere and time out, forcing regeneration at the very node that is already congested — a feedback loop we show produces a genuine cascading congestion collapse: a phase transition from stable operation to network-wide congestion above a critical arrival rate λc. We formalize this as a fold bifurcation in a mean-field loss-network model, derive an explicit stability criterion, and validate our core fidelity and decoherence formulas to floating-point precision against SeQUeNCe, an independent quantum network simulator. This decoherence-timeout-driven cascade mechanism has not, to our knowledge, been previously characterized. We propose DALSAC, a proactive admission-control policy that estimates per-node cascade risk from occupancy, trend, and timeout signals and sheds load before it can propagate. Across four topologies, three baselines, a four-parameter sensitivity analysis, and a scale-up to 100-node networks, DALSAC delays or avoids collapse, delivers 23–152% higher throughput and 19–125% higher success rate than baselines at high demand (significant in eleven of twelve comparisons), recovers about twice as fast from a transient demand shock, and does so without sacrificing fidelity — its advantage growing, not shrinking, with network scale. We further show that structural robustness to targeted attack depends on background congestion load, a dependency invisible to evaluations that test attacks on idle networks. All code, data, and figures are reproducible.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究表明，量子中继网络在高负载下会因纠缠对等待、退相干超时与再生操作形成正反馈，从而在临界到达率以上发生全网级联拥塞崩溃。作者提出 DALSAC 主动接纳控制策略，根据节点占用、趋势和超时信号提前分担负载。多种拓扑和规模实验显示，该方法在高需求下提高吞吐量和成功率，并加快对瞬时需求冲击的恢复，且不牺牲保真度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子中继网络利用具有有限相干时间的量子存储器分发纠缠。在负载条件下，某一跳的纠缠对若必须等待同级其他跳，便可能发生退相干并超时，迫使已经拥塞的节点进行再生；我们表明，这一反馈环会产生真正的级联拥塞崩溃：当到达率超过临界值 λc 时，网络将从稳定运行发生相变，转入全网拥塞。我们将其形式化为平均场损失网络模型中的折叠分岔，推导出显式稳定性判据，并利用独立量子网络模拟器 SeQUeNCe 将核心保真度和退相干公式验证至浮点精度。据我们所知，这种由退相干超时驱动的级联机制此前尚未被刻画。我们提出 DALSAC，一种主动接纳控制策略；该策略根据占用率、趋势和超时信号估计每个节点的级联风险，并在风险传播之前卸载负载。在四种拓扑、三种基线方法、四参数敏感性分析以及扩展至 100 节点网络的测试中，DALSAC 可延迟或避免崩溃；在高需求下，相比基线方法实现 23% 至 152% 更高的吞吐量和 19% 至 125% 更高的成功率，在十二项比较中的十一项达到显著差异；它从瞬时需求冲击中恢复的速度约快一倍，同时不牺牲保真度，其优势会随网络规模扩大而增强而非减弱。我们还表明，针对性攻击下的结构鲁棒性取决于背景拥塞负载；在空闲网络上测试攻击的评估无法发现这种依赖关系。全部代码、数据和图表均可复现。

articles.title: JURY: A Comprehensive Training-Free to Fully-Supervised Framework for Evaluating Chemical Language Models
articles.title_zh: JURY：用于评估化学语言模型的从免训练到全监督综合框架
articles.abstract: Language models have reshaped computational chemistry by learning from SMILES strings, a compact textual notation for a molecule's atoms and bonds. Trained on millions of such strings, these models compress each molecule into a fixed-length embedding usable for tasks like property prediction and de novo generation. To predict a property, researchers attach a prediction head and finetune the model, but a capable head can learn much of a property from labels alone, reaching strong results even on embeddings that carry little relevant chemistry. Since most models in the literature are evaluated only through such finetuned heads, reported performance conflates the model with the head, its training, and the labelled dataset's size and quality, leaving what the model itself contributes unclear. To close this gap, we present JURY, a stringent evaluation framework that probes chemical language models directly. Two probes require no training: the Neighbourhood Probe predicts from a molecule's nearest neighbours in embedding space, and the Cluster Probe groups molecules by that space alone and predicts from each group's labels. Two probes are trained: the Linear Probe fits a single linear map from embedding to property, and the Nonlinear Probe trains a small network on as few as two labelled molecules up to the full training set. Together the four span zero-shot to fully supervised prediction. We apply each probe to 10 chemical language models across 3 architecture families on 73 ADMET tasks, we find these models are far more alike than prior evaluation suggests: no model dominates across probes, and ECFP fingerprints, used as a baseline, sit comfortably among them. Scientific Contribution: A powerful prediction head recovers what a weak one cannot, and in doing so hides what the model failed to supply. JURY makes this distinction visible, replacing a single performance value with a profile across four probes, where agreement marks what a model encodes. Across ten chemical language models and ECFP, this profile shows an embedding space is defined by three properties, how much chemistry it holds, in what form, and how readily it can be recovered, none conveyed by a single prediction head.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出 JURY 框架，以避免仅通过微调预测头评估化学语言模型时混淆模型表征能力与预测头、标签数据影响的问题。该框架包含邻域、聚类、线性和非线性四类探针，覆盖零样本至全监督预测。对 10 个化学语言模型和 73 项 ADMET 任务的评估显示，各模型之间的差异小于既有评估所暗示的程度，ECFP 指纹基线也处于相近水平。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 语言模型通过学习 SMILES 字符串重塑了计算化学；SMILES 是一种用于表示分子原子和化学键的紧凑文本符号。此类模型在数百万个字符串上训练，将每个分子压缩为固定长度的嵌入表示，可用于性质预测和从头生成等任务。为了预测某项性质，研究人员会附加一个预测头并对模型进行微调，但一个能力强的预测头仅依赖标签就能学习某项性质的大部分信息，即使嵌入表示中几乎不包含相关化学信息，也能取得很强的结果。由于文献中的大多数模型仅通过这类微调预测头进行评估，所报告的性能混合了模型本身、预测头、其训练过程以及带标签数据集的规模与质量，使得模型自身究竟作出了何种贡献并不明确。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出 JURY，这是一个直接探测化学语言模型的严格评估框架。其中两个探针不需要训练：邻域探针根据嵌入空间中某个分子的最近邻来预测，聚类探针则仅根据该空间对分子分组，并利用每个分组的标签进行预测。另外两个探针需要训练：线性探针拟合从嵌入到性质的单一线性映射，非线性探针则使用从仅两个带标签分子到完整训练集的不同规模数据训练一个小型网络。这四种探针共同覆盖了从零样本到全监督的预测。我们将每种探针应用于来自 3 个架构家族的 10 个化学语言模型，并在 73 项 ADMET 任务上进行测试；结果发现，这些模型比先前评估所显示的更加相似：没有任何模型能在所有探针上占据主导地位，作为基线的 ECFP 指纹表示也稳居其中。科学贡献：强大的预测头能够恢复弱预测头无法恢复的信息，同时也因此掩盖了模型未能提供的信息。JURY 使这种区分变得可见，它以跨四种探针的性能谱替代单一性能值，其中不同探针间的一致性标志着模型实际编码的信息。该性能谱在十个化学语言模型和 ECFP 上表明，一个嵌入空间由三种性质定义：其包含多少化学信息、这些信息以何种形式存在，以及这些信息多么容易被恢复；而单一预测头无法传达其中任何一种性质。

articles.title: Fast probabilistic spike deconvolution using optimized Markov chain Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 利用优化马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛实现快速概率性尖峰反卷积
articles.abstract: Two-photon calcium imaging allows monitoring of large populations of neurons, but individual action potentials are often obscured under typical recording conditions. Algorithms for spike deconvolution estimate the underlying spike train of a neuron given an observed calcium trace. One powerful approach, Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) spike inference, models the underlying calcium dynamics, iteratively adding, removing, and shifting spikes in an inferred spike train in continuous time to sample from the posterior probability of the spike train given the observed calcium signal. However, MCMC is computationally taxing, requiring many hours of compute time for typical datasets. Here, we introduce a method for Optimized MCMC Spike Inference (OMSI) that preserves the performance of the full probabilistic framework while achieving a >90% reduction in compute time. Benchmarking using simulated data and simultaneous electrophysiology and calcium imaging confirms that our approach maintains accuracy comparable to traditional MCMC and matches or exceeds non-probabilistic alternatives. These performance gains establish continuous-time probabilistic inference as a practical, high-throughput tool for large-scale calcium imaging pipelines.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出优化 MCMC 尖峰推断方法（OMSI），用于从双光子钙成像信号中高效推断神经元尖峰序列。该方法保留完整概率框架的性能，同时将计算时间减少超过 90%。模拟数据以及电生理与钙成像同步记录的基准测试表明，其准确性可与传统 MCMC 相当，并达到或超过非概率方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双光子钙成像能够监测大规模神经元群体，但在典型记录条件下，单个动作电位往往被掩盖。尖峰反卷积算法根据观测到的钙信号轨迹估计神经元潜在的尖峰序列。一种强大的方法是马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）尖峰推断；该方法对潜在钙动力学进行建模，在连续时间内对推断尖峰序列中的尖峰反复执行添加、删除和移动操作，以便从给定观测钙信号条件下尖峰序列的后验概率中采样。然而，MCMC 的计算负担很重，典型数据集需要数小时的计算时间。本文提出优化 MCMC 尖峰推断（OMSI）方法，该方法在保留完整概率框架性能的同时，将计算时间减少超过 90%。利用模拟数据以及同步电生理和钙成像记录进行的基准测试证实，我们的方法保持了与传统 MCMC 相当的准确性，并且达到或超过非概率替代方法。这些性能提升使连续时间概率推断成为大规模钙成像流程中实用的高通量工具。

articles.title: Marine Cold Spells Induced by Tropical Cyclone Seroja in the Savu Sea
articles.title_zh: 热带气旋 Seroja 在萨武海诱发的海洋冷事件
articles.abstract: Tropical Cyclone (TC) Seroja was the only TC recorded in the Savu Sea in 2021 and was among the first TCs to cause extensive damage to buildings and infrastructure on Indonesian land. Despite its significant impact, the TC effect on the oceanic thermal energy balance in this region remains poorly studied. This study examines the dynamical ocean response of the Savu Sea to TC Seroja using a combination of satellite-derived sea surface temperatures (SST) observations, TC best-track records, and atmosphere-ocean reanalysis output. The findings indicate that the Savu Sea is highly susceptible to cyclogenesis, as long-term mean SST consistently exceed 28°C. Elevated Tropical Cyclone Heat Potential (TCHP) values above 80 kJ/cm2 were observed prior to the development of TC Seroja, suggesting that substantial subsurface heat may have contributed to cyclone intensification in the Savu Sea. During the cyclone, TCHP values declined markedly below the climatological mean. The cyclone also induced a pronounced marine cold spells and Ekman pumping, which was associated with upwelling. Mixed-layer heat budget analysis demonstrates that upper Savu Sea cooling during TC Seroja was primarily driven by latent heat loss due to intense wind speeds. Furthermore, heat loss attributed to the residual term, representing turbulent mixing, was also considerable.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究结合卫星海表温度、热带气旋最佳路径和海气再分析数据，考察热带气旋 Seroja 对萨武海热力与动力响应的影响。结果表明，气旋期间出现显著海洋冷事件和与上升流相关的 Ekman 抽吸，海洋上层冷却主要由强风引起的潜热损失驱动，湍流混合的作用也较大。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热带气旋（TC）Seroja 是 2021 年萨武海唯一记录到的热带气旋，也是最早在印度尼西亚陆地上对建筑物和基础设施造成大范围破坏的热带气旋之一。尽管其影响显著，该热带气旋对该地区海洋热能平衡的影响仍缺乏深入研究。本研究结合卫星反演海表温度（SST）观测、热带气旋最佳路径记录以及海气再分析输出，考察萨武海对热带气旋 Seroja 的动力学海洋响应。研究结果表明，萨武海极易发生气旋生成，因为长期平均海表温度持续超过 28°C。在热带气旋 Seroja 形成之前，观测到超过 80 kJ/cm2 的高热带气旋热势（TCHP）值，表明大量次表层热量可能促进了气旋在萨武海的增强。气旋期间，TCHP 值显著下降至低于气候平均值。该气旋还诱发了明显的海洋冷事件和 Ekman 抽吸，后者与上升流有关。混合层热收支分析表明，热带气旋 Seroja 期间萨武海上层海洋冷却主要由强风速导致的潜热损失驱动。此外，归因于残差项的热量损失也相当显著，该项代表湍流混合。

articles.title: Predictingthe Trainability of Variational Quantum Circuits: A Data-Driven Model for BarrenPlateaus
articles.title_zh: 预测变分量子电路的可训练性：一种用于识别贫瘠高原的数据驱动模型
articles.abstract: Barren plateaus are the main obstacle to training quantum machine-learning models. On a barren plateau, the cost-function gradient shrinks exponentially as the circuit grows, and training stalls. Today the only reliable test is to measure it. That means sampling many gradients for every candidate circuit, which is expensive. We ask a different question. Can a classical model predict trainability from the circuit architecture alone? The architecture here means qubit count, depth, ansatz type, entanglement pattern, entangler gate, and cost-observable locality. We test this directly. We use an exact statevector simulator to build a dataset of Nrows{} random variational circuits. For each circuit we estimate the gradient variance Var[partial C/partialθ] from Samples{} random parameter vectors, using the parameter-shift rule. This variance is the label. A gradient-boosted regressor then predicts log₁₀Var with R² = RsqHold{} on held-out architectures. A classifier separates barren from trainable circuits with an area under the ROC curve of AucHold{}. We also test transfer to larger circuits. We train only on small circuits and test on the two largest unseen sizes (n=11,12). The model still reaches R² = RsqExtrap{}. Permutation importance then recovers established theory. Cost-observable locality and entanglement structure matter most. We make no quantum-advantage claim. This is classical machine learning about quantum circuits. It offers a cheap way to screen ansätze, and it shows which design choices cause untrainability.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究探讨能否仅根据量子电路架构预测其可训练性，以减少直接采样大量梯度的成本。作者利用精确态矢量模拟器生成随机变分电路数据集，以梯度方差作为标签，并使用梯度提升模型预测可训练性及区分贫瘠高原电路。文中用于报告部分数据集规模和性能指标的占位符尚未被具体数值替换，但研究指出可观测量局域性与纠缠结构最为关键。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 贫瘠高原是训练量子机器学习模型的主要障碍。在贫瘠高原上，随着电路规模增大，代价函数梯度会呈指数级缩小，训练因而停滞。如今唯一可靠的测试方法是直接测量它。这意味着必须针对每个候选电路采样大量梯度，而这一过程代价高昂。我们提出一个不同的问题：经典模型能否仅根据电路架构预测其可训练性？这里的架构包括量子比特数、深度、ansatz 类型、纠缠模式、纠缠器门以及代价可观测量的局域性。我们直接检验这一问题。我们使用精确态矢量模拟器构建包含 Nrows{} 个随机变分电路的数据集。对于每个电路，我们使用参数移位规则，通过 Samples{} 个随机参数向量估计梯度方差 Var[partial C/partialθ]。该方差即为标签。随后，梯度提升回归器在留出架构上的预测达到 R² = RsqHold{}。分类器则以 AucHold{} 的 ROC 曲线下面积区分处于贫瘠高原的电路和可训练电路。我们还测试了向更大电路的迁移能力。我们仅在小型电路上训练，并在两个最大的未见规模，即 n=11 和 n=12 上测试。该模型仍然达到 R² = RsqExtrap{}。置换重要性分析随后恢复了既有理论。代价可观测量的局域性和纠缠结构最为重要。我们并未提出任何量子优势主张。这是关于量子电路的经典机器学习。它提供了一种低成本筛选 ansatz 的方法，并揭示了哪些设计选择会造成不可训练性。

articles.title: A Hybrid Deep-Quantum Framework for Robust Stress Classification from EEG Signals
articles.title_zh: 用于 EEG 信号稳健压力分类的混合深度-量子框架
articles.abstract: Mental stress detection through electroencephalography (EEG) signals faces difficulties because EEG signals display non-stationary behavior and are vulnerable to artifact interference. The research introduces a hybrid deep-quantum learning framework which combines a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a quantum support vector classifier (QSVC) to differentiate between stress and calm states. The CNN functions as a trainable feature extractor which converts raw EEG time-series data into compressed latent representations that undergo mapping to a quantum Hilbert space through ZZFeatureMap before being classified by a quantum kernel. The research demonstrates through experiments on a multi-subject EEG dataset that the hybrid model reaches its highest accuracy of (81.00%) (F1: 0.81) under optimal configuration using 8-dimensional features with MinMax scaling to [0,1] and 1000 training samples because it surpasses both the classical SVM (76.80%) and end-to-end CNN (78.85%) baselines. The analysis demonstrates that quantum kernel performance depends on feature dimensionality and scaling because lower dimensions (F-4) lack expressivity while higher dimensions (F-12) reach a performance limit and scaling to [-1,1] causes accuracy loss of 16 percentage points when compared to [0,1] scaling. The quantum classifier shows good sample efficiency because it gains more from additional training data compared to the traditional model. The research demonstrates that hybrid deep-quantum architectures function in the NISQ era while creating a performance standard for quantum-based physiological signal processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出结合一维卷积神经网络与量子支持向量分类器的混合深度-量子学习框架，用于区分 EEG 中的压力与平静状态。CNN 负责从原始时序信号提取低维特征，再经 ZZFeatureMap 映射至量子希尔伯特空间并通过量子核分类。实验中，最优配置的准确率为 81.00%，优于经典 SVM 和端到端 CNN 基线，且结果表明特征维度与缩放范围对量子核性能具有显著影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于脑电图（EEG）信号的心理压力检测面临困难，因为 EEG 信号具有非平稳行为，且容易受到伪影干扰。该研究提出了一种混合深度-量子学习框架，将一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）与量子支持向量分类器（QSVC）结合起来，以区分压力状态与平静状态。CNN 作为可训练的特征提取器，将原始 EEG 时间序列数据转换为压缩的潜在表示；这些表示随后通过 ZZFeatureMap 映射到量子希尔伯特空间，并由量子核进行分类。该研究在一个多受试者 EEG 数据集上的实验表明，在采用 8 维特征、将数据进行 MinMax 缩放至 [0,1]、并使用 1000 个训练样本的最优配置下，混合模型取得最高准确率 81.00%（F1 值为 0.81），超过了经典 SVM（76.80%）和端到端 CNN（78.85%）基线模型。分析表明，量子核性能取决于特征维度和缩放方式，因为较低维度（F-4）缺乏表达能力，而较高维度（F-12）达到性能上限；与缩放至 [0,1] 相比，缩放至 [-1,1] 会导致准确率下降 16 个百分点。与传统模型相比，量子分类器从更多训练数据中获得的收益更大，表现出良好的样本效率。该研究表明，混合深度-量子架构能够在 NISQ 时代发挥作用，并为基于量子的生理信号处理建立了性能基准。

articles.title: Breaking the mutual exclusivity between metallicity and ferroelectricity in a non-polar covalent semiconductor via orbital selective doping
articles.title_zh: 通过轨道选择性掺杂打破非极性共价半导体中金属性与铁电性的相互排斥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mutual exclusion of ferroelectricity and metallic conductivity is a long-standing tenet because itinerant electrons screen long-range Coulomb forces that stabilize the bulk polar order. Here, we break this paradigm by heavily doping a non-polar covalent semiconductor of cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC) with nitrogen. This introduces heavy electron doping, inducing metallicity and driving a structural transition from the non-polar F-43m to the polar R3m symmetry via the pseudo-Jahn-Teller effect. Remarkably, we provide direct, atomic-scale visualization of about 180deg polarization reversal under an external voltage bias in a ferroelectric metal. The strongly directional character of antibonding orbitals occupied by conduction electrons prevents them from screening the local Si-C polarization, resulting in the coexistence of metallicity and ferroelectricity. Ferroelectric tunnel junctions demonstrate nonvolatile memory properties with a well-defined high-resistance state (HRS) and low-resistance state (LRS), an ultrahigh response speed (~50 ns), an ultralow operating voltage (1 V), an endurance exceeding 85927 cycles, and a projected retention time of 100 years. Our results provide a novel strategy for pioneering ferroelectricity in a metal, a new ferroelectric metal platform for exploring exotic properties, and a ferroelectric device with high performance that meets the requirements for low consumption and high-speed non-volatile devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于巡游电子会屏蔽稳定体相极性有序所需的长程库仑力，铁电性与金属导电性通常被认为相互排斥。作者通过氮重掺杂立方碳化硅，使材料由非极性F-43m结构转变为极性R3m结构，并实现了金属性与铁电性的共存。研究还在原子尺度直接观察到约180°的极化反转，并展示了具有非易失存储特性的铁电隧道结。
authors: Hui Li, Yunfan Yang, Junquan Huang, Yukun Feng, Guobin Wang, Qinci Wu, Jun Deng, Zhaolong Liu, Subi Du, Dongliang Gong, Zaihui Shen, Anmin Nie, Yang Xu, Junwei Yang, Zesheng Zhang, Huaping Song, Jiangang Guo, Wenjun Wang, Hailin Peng, Yongjun Tian, Xiaolong Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电性与金属导电性的相互排斥是一个长期存在的基本认识，因为巡游电子会屏蔽稳定体相极性有序所需的长程库仑力。在此，我们通过对一种非极性共价半导体立方碳化硅（3C-SiC）进行氮重掺杂，打破了这一范式。该掺杂引入了大量电子，使材料产生金属性，并通过拟 Jahn-Teller 效应驱动结构从非极性F-43m对称性转变为极性R3m对称性。值得注意的是，我们在外加电压偏置下直接以原子尺度观察到了铁电金属中约180°的极化反转。导电电子所占据的反键轨道具有很强的方向性，使其无法屏蔽局域的Si-C极化，从而实现了金属性与铁电性的共存。铁电隧道结表现出非易失存储特性，具有明确的高电阻态（HRS）和低电阻态（LRS）、超高响应速度（约50 ns）、超低工作电压（1 V）、超过85927次的耐久性以及预计100年的保持时间。我们的结果为在金属中开创铁电性提供了新的策略，为探索奇异性质提供了新的铁电金属平台，并构建了一种高性能铁电器件，满足低功耗和高速非易失器件的需求。
articles.focus_summary: 研究通过氮掺杂使非极性立方3C-SiC发生由F-43m到极性R3m的结构转变，并实现了金属性与铁电性的共存。作者将其归因于赝Jahn-Teller效应和具有方向性的反键轨道占据，并展示了可逆极化翻转和铁电隧道结存储性能。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的铁电材料、SiC半导体、缺陷与化学掺杂、极化翻转和铁电器件方向高度直接相关。该工作尤其适合结合缺陷形成能、掺杂补偿、局域结构畸变和电子结构计算进行机制分析。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究氮掺杂浓度、缺陷复合体和载流子屏蔽对极化稳定性及翻转势垒的影响，并计算金属铁电态下的界面输运、疲劳机制和隧穿电阻变化。

articles.title: Chern insulator boundary criticality
articles.title_zh: 陈绝缘体边界临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate signatures of chirality at Chern insulator transitions in the presence of a boundary. The transition between a trivial insulator and a Chern insulator with Chern number C=1 is described by a massless Dirac fermion whose parity anomaly gives a critical Hall conductivity σₓy=frac12frace²h. Using a Dirac mass domain wall construction, we show that the chiral edge mode delocalizes into the bulk at criticality, but the boundary fermion correlation function retains a chiral structure and acquires the scaling dimension of the bulk fermion. We compute current correlation functions and demonstrate that the anomaly of the bulk Hall response is matched by delocalized chiral modes near the boundary. Using only the residual conformal symmetry of a (2+1)d conformal field theory (CFT) in a half-space, we identify parity-odd terms in current and energy-momentum tensor correlation functions that encode these modes and determine their electromagnetic and gravitational anomaly coefficients. Our analysis therefore applies to general time-reversal breaking (2+1)d CFTs, beyond the free Dirac transition. We also extend our results to higher Chern number transitions and to the transition between a (3+1)d topological insulator and a trivial insulator.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究存在边界时陈绝缘体相变中的手性特征。平庸绝缘体与陈数C=1的陈绝缘体之间的相变由无质量狄拉克费米子描述，其宇称反常导致临界霍尔电导为σₓᵧ=1/2 e²/h。研究表明，临界点处手性边缘模向体内离域，但边界费米子关联函数仍保留手性结构，并获得体费米子的标度维数；该分析还推广到更高陈数相变及三维拓扑绝缘体相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究存在边界时陈绝缘体相变中的手性特征。平庸绝缘体与陈数C=1的陈绝缘体之间的相变由一个无质量狄拉克费米子描述，其宇称反常给出临界霍尔电导σₓᵧ=1/2 e²/h。利用狄拉克质量畴壁构造，我们表明手性边缘模在临界点处向体内离域，但边界费米子关联函数仍保留手性结构，并获得体费米子的标度维数。我们计算了电流关联函数，并证明体霍尔响应的反常由边界附近离域的手性模补偿。仅利用半空间中（2+1）维共形场论（CFT）的剩余共形对称性，我们识别出电流关联函数和能量-动量张量关联函数中的宇称奇项，这些项编码了相关模态，并确定了它们的电磁和引力反常系数。因此，我们的分析适用于一般的破坏时间反演对称性的（2+1）维CFT，而不仅限于自由狄拉克相变。我们还将结果推广到更高陈数相变，以及（3+1）维拓扑绝缘体与平庸绝缘体之间的相变。

articles.title: Writing and erasing skyrmions by single ultrafast laser pulses in monolayer Janus 2D magnets
articles.title_zh: 利用单个超快激光脉冲在单层Janus二维磁体中写入和擦除斯格明子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Skyrmions in 2D magnets are promising candidates for nonvolatile, low-power, and high-density spintronic memories. However, their experimental realization at the 2D limit remains challenging, owing to the difficulty in engineering the required chiral magnetic interactions. Here, we report the creation and direct imaging of Néel-type skyrmions in Janus 2D chromium chalcogenides using synchrotron X-ray photoemission electron microscopy, and scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry, which exhibit field-free stability, nonvolatility, and size tunability. First-principles calculations and micromagnetic simulations reveal that Janus-surface-induced inversion-symmetry breaking enhances the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, providing the microscopic mechanism for skyrmion stabilization and tunability. We further achieve reversible skyrmion writing and erasing using a single ultrafast laser pulse in a magnetic field as low as 300 Oe, demonstrating the excellent manipulability of this 2D magnetic system. These results establish Janus engineering as a route to creating and manipulating nonvolatile skyrmions in atomically thin magnets, with implications for skyrmion-based low-power spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在Janus二维铬硫属化物中制备并直接成像了尼尔型斯格明子，并发现其具有无外场稳定性、非易失性和尺寸可调性。第一性原理计算与微磁模拟表明，Janus表面诱导的反演对称性破缺增强了Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，从而稳定并调控斯格明子。研究进一步实现了在低至300 Oe磁场下利用单个超快激光脉冲可逆地写入和擦除斯格明子。
authors: Guangyao Miao, Yonglong Ga, Chang Liu, Pan Chen, Yichen Jin, Florian Kronast, Wenxin Cheng, Zhaoqing Ding, Kai Hu, Zongnan Zhang, Nikolai Severin, Chenxi Meng, Patil Shubhada, Sergio Valencia, Meng Meng, Qinlin Guo, Xiaoran Liu, Jiandi Zhang, Yangmu Li, Carlos-Andres Palma, Jürgen P. Rabe, Hongxin Yang, Weihua Wang, Jiandong Guo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 斯格明子是二维磁体中有望用于非易失、低功耗和高密度自旋电子存储器的候选对象。然而，由于难以构建所需的手性磁相互作用，在二维极限下实现斯格明子仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们利用同步辐射X射线光电子发射电子显微镜和扫描氮-空位磁力计，在Janus二维铬硫属化物中实现了尼尔型斯格明子的产生和直接成像；这些斯格明子表现出无外场稳定性、非易失性和尺寸可调性。第一性原理计算和微磁模拟表明，Janus表面诱导的反演对称性破缺增强了Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，为斯格明子的稳定和可调控性提供了微观机制。我们进一步在低至300 Oe的磁场下，利用单个超快激光脉冲实现了斯格明子的可逆写入和擦除，展示了这一二维磁性系统出色的操控能力。这些结果确立了Janus工程作为在原子级薄磁体中产生和操控非易失斯格明子的一种途径，并对基于斯格明子的低功耗自旋电子器件具有重要意义。
articles.focus_summary: 研究在Janus二维磁性材料中通过表面反演对称性破缺增强Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，从而稳定可调的Néel型斯格明子。实验实现了利用单个超快激光脉冲对斯格明子的可逆写入和擦除。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的二维范德华磁体、DMI、非共线磁性、斯格明子和自旋动力学方向高度相关。第一性原理计算结合微磁模拟的研究路径，以及光激发调控磁织构的思路具有直接借鉴价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步开展含温度和缺陷效应的自旋动力学研究，分���激光脉冲诱导的瞬态自旋转移、磁阻尼和斯格明子寿命，并探索铁电或应变调控Janus材料中的DMI。

articles.title: Rare-earth spin textures and a route to electronic inhomogeneity in Pr₂Ir₂O₇
articles.title_zh: Pr₂Ir₂O₇中的稀土自旋织构与电子不均匀性的形成途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pyrochlore iridate Pr₂Ir₂O₇ remains metallic at low temperatures where its family members insulate. Recently, scanning tunneling spectroscopy experiments have revealed an inhomogeneous mixture of Kondo-screened and Kondo-destroyed regions when its surface is produced by cleaving at room temperature while it remains uniform when cleaved at low temperatures. We ask whether the frustrated praseodymium spin texture seeds this inhomogeneity. To study this, we produce Monte-Carlo-sampled Pr spin-ice configurations, presumed to evolve slowly in time, and couple through a local Kondo exchange J_K to an eight-band Hartree-Fock model of the Ir electrons. We further find the charge gap of the all-in-all-out state common in the other family members closes smoothly with the coupling J_K, and the recently proposed monopole-rich ``jellyfish'' textures further suppress the insulating behavior by Δ JKcapprox 0.03,t. Additionally, scanning a small cluster across a large Pr surface yields a synthetic tunneling map that fractures into islands within a sea. Although our classical simulable theory omits the Kondo singlet, the spatial modulation of the Fermi-level density of states it produces is, through the exponential Doniach sensitivity of the Kondo temperature, sufficient to tip the local balance between screening and magnetic order; a frustration-driven route to the observed Kondo/Kondo-destroyed inhomogeneity.
articles.abstract_zh: Pr₂Ir₂O₇在低温下仍保持金属性，而其同族材料则表现为绝缘体。作者通过蒙特卡洛采样的镨自旋冰构型，并将其与铱电子的八带Hartree-Fock模型通过局域Kondo交换耦合，研究受挫自旋织构是否能够诱发电子不均匀性。结果表明，空间调制的费米能级态密度可通过Kondo温度对Doniach机制的指数敏感性，使局域区域在Kondo屏蔽与磁有序之间发生转变，从而为实验观察到的非均匀性提供受挫驱动的解释。
authors: Kyle G Sherman, Michael J Lawler
articles.abstract_zh_full: 焦绿石铱酸盐Pr₂Ir₂O₇在低温下仍保持金属性，而其同族材料则在低温下成为绝缘体。近期扫描隧道谱实验发现，当其表面在室温下解理时，会出现Kondo屏蔽区域与Kondo破缺区域的不均匀混合；而在低温下解理时，表面则保持均一。我们探讨受挫的镨自旋织构是否会孕育这种不均匀性。为研究这一问题，我们生成了通过蒙特卡洛采样得到的Pr自旋冰构型，并假定这些构型随时间缓慢演化；随后通过局域Kondo交换J_K，将其与铱电子的八带Hartree-Fock模型耦合。我们还发现，其他同族材料中常见的全进全出态的电荷能隙会随耦合J_K平滑闭合，而近期提出的富含磁单极子的“水母”织构则进一步抑制绝缘行为，其临界变化量约为ΔJ_Kc≈0.03t。此外，在大尺寸Pr表面上扫描一个小团簇，会得到一种断裂成岛状区域、分布于连续背景中的合成隧穿图。尽管我们的经典可模拟理论忽略了Kondo单态，但它产生的费米能级态密度空间调制，通过Kondo温度对Doniach机制的指数敏感性，足以改变局域屏蔽与磁有序之间的平衡；这为所观察到的Kondo屏蔽与Kondo破缺不均匀性提供了一条由自旋受挫驱动的形成途径。

articles.title: Interface-Controlled Spin-Orbit Torques in Rare-Earth Synthetic Ferrimagnets Probed by Sagnac Magneto-Optics and Harmonic Hall Measurements
articles.title_zh: 稀土合成亚铁磁体中界面控制的自旋轨道力矩：基于Sagnac磁光学与谐波霍尔测量的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) provides an efficient route for manipulating magnetization in spintronic devices, and its accurate quantification is essential. Here, we investigate Co/Gd-based synthetic ferrimagnets using complementary magnetotransport and magneto-optical techniques. We use a Sagnac magneto-optical interferometry method to directly quantify current-induced magnetization tilting and extract the damping-like SOT effective field. The Sagnac measurements show good agreement with harmonic Hall analysis across different Co/Gd and Gd/Pt/Co heterostructures, providing a quantitative determination of the damping-like SOT effective field that does not rely on electrical transport signatures. By varying the Gd thickness and multilayer stacking order, we demonstrate that the damping-like torque is strongly influenced by spin transport and angular momentum conversion at rare-earth and heavy-metal interfaces. The observation of a finite torque in Gd/Pt/Co/Pt structures, where conventional Pt spin Hall contributions are expected to compensate, highlights the active role of the Gd layer in SOT generation. Furthermore, interface engineering enables perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in Gd/Pt/Co/Al heterostructures with a 2-nm-thick Co layer, allowing current-induced SOT switching at current densities of 8-10 MA/cm². These results establish rare-earth-based synthetic ferrimagnets as a versatile platform for engineering spin-orbit phenomena and optimizing low-power spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合磁输运和磁光学技术，研究了Co/Gd基合成亚铁磁体中的自旋轨道力矩。Sagnac磁光学干涉法能够直接测量电流诱导的磁化倾斜，并提取类阻尼自旋轨道力矩有效场，其结果与谐波霍尔分析吻合良好。通过改变Gd厚度和多层膜堆叠顺序，作者证明稀土层与重金属界面处的自旋输运和角动量转换显著影响力矩，并在Gd/Pt/Co/Al异质结构中实现了垂直磁各向异性及电流诱导开关。
authors: Akilan K, Koral Aykin, Jose-Luis Ampuero, Laurent Badie, Stephane Mangin, Sébastien Petit-Watelot, Michel Hehn, Andrew D. Kent, J. -Carlos Rojas-Sánchez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道力矩（SOT）为操控自旋电子器件中的磁化提供了有效途径，而对其进行准确量化至关重要。在此，我们结合互补的磁输运和磁光学技术，研究了Co/Gd基合成亚铁磁体。我们采用Sagnac磁光学干涉方法直接量化电流诱导的磁化倾斜，并提取类阻尼SOT有效场。对于不同的Co/Gd和Gd/Pt/Co异质结构，Sagnac测量结果与谐波霍尔分析表现出良好一致性，从而定量确定了类阻尼SOT有效场，而且不依赖电输运信号。通过改变Gd厚度和多层膜堆叠顺序，我们证明类阻尼力矩受到稀土层与重金属界面处自旋输运和角动量转换的强烈影响。在Gd/Pt/Co/Pt结构中，尽管通常预期传统Pt自旋霍尔贡献会相互抵消，但仍观测到有限力矩，这凸显了Gd层在SOT产生中的积极作用。此外，界面工程使Gd/Pt/Co/Al异质结构具备垂直磁各向异性；其中Co层厚度为2 nm，并可在8-10 MA/cm²的电流密度下实现电流诱导的SOT开关。这些结果表明，稀土基合成亚铁磁体是工程化自旋轨道现象和优化低功耗自旋电子器件的多功能平台。

articles.title: Magnetic interactions and origin of high Curie temperatures in high Mn content (MnSb2Te4)x(Sb2Te3)1-x quantum materials
articles.title_zh: 高锰含量（MnSb₂Te₄）ₓ（Sb₂Te₃）₁₋ₓ量子材料中的磁相互作用与高居里温度起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the magnetic interactions that promote high TC in topological quantum materials is essential to effectively design materials whose magnetic configuration persists at high temperatures and are thus practical to integrate into commercial spintronic devices. Here we provide evidence of the origin of the high TC observed in mixed Mn1+ySb2-yTe4 septuple layers and Sb2-yMnyTe3 quintuple layer structures. Analysis of the quintuple layer/septuple layer structures explored their magnetic behavior through different models of Mn-incorporation in the crystal, evidenced as Mn spin S = 5/2, and provided an explanation for the low magnetization per Mn atom observed, signature of competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions between Mn2+ ions. Our studies provide insight to better understand and control the Mn incorporation in our samples to optimize their properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解促进拓扑量子材料获得高居里温度的磁相互作用，对于设计可在高温下保持磁构型并适用于商用自旋电子器件的材料至关重要。作者研究了混合Mn₁₊ᵧSb₂₋ᵧTe₄七层结构和Sb₂₋ᵧMnᵧTe₃五层结构中的磁行为，并将其归因于晶体中Mn的不同掺入方式。分析显示，Mn以S=5/2的自旋形式存在，Mn²⁺离子之间竞争性的铁磁和反铁磁相互作用可解释每个Mn原子较低的磁化强度。
authors: Candice R. Forrester, Christophe Testelin, Kaushini Wickramasinghe, David Hrabovsky, Lia Krusin-Elbaum, Maria C. Tamargo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解促进拓扑量子材料获得高居里温度的磁相互作用，对于有效设计能够在高温下保持磁构型、从而适合集成到商用自旋电子器件中的材料至关重要。在此，我们为混合Mn₁₊ᵧSb₂₋ᵧTe₄七层结构和Sb₂₋ᵧMnᵧTe₃五层结构中观测到的高居里温度起源提供了证据。我们通过不同的Mn掺入晶体模型分析了五层结构与七层结构的磁行为；结果表明，Mn以自旋S=5/2的形式存在，并解释了观测到的每个Mn原子较低磁化强度，这种较低磁化强度是Mn²⁺离子之间铁磁和反铁磁相互作用相互竞争的表现。我们的研究为更好地理解和控制样品中的Mn掺入、进而优化其性能提供了见解。

articles.title: Optical Voltage Profiling of 2D Semiconductors via Proximal Exciton Sensing
articles.title_zh: 通过邻近激子传感实现二维半导体的光学电压剖面测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High contact resistances in atomically thin semiconductors often mask intrinsic electrical transport properties, particularly at low carrier densities where exotic correlated states emerge. We introduce optical voltage profiling, a noninvasive wide-field technique that replaces local voltage probes with a proximal monolayer MoSe₂ exciton sensor. Isolated by thin hexagonal boron nitride, this sensor converts the target's local electrostatic potential into spatially resolved modulations of exciton reflectance. Through pixel-wise in situ calibration, these signals yield quantitative two-dimensional voltage maps of an actively biased semiconductor device. Using this method, we demonstrate the carrier-density-driven metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe₂ and obtain channel resistances below 1 kΩ despite MΩ-scale two-terminal resistances in the metallic region. The optically derived resistance exhibits a metal-insulator crossover near the resistance quantum h/e², and the voltage maps and reconstructed local conductivity reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity in both insulating and metallic regimes. Beyond resolving channel resistance under high contact-resistance conditions, the technique provides spatially resolved access to microscopic transport heterogeneity in functional van der Waals devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种非侵入式宽场光学电压剖面技术，以邻近的单层MoSe₂激子传感器取代局域电压探针。该传感器将目标器件的局域静电势转换为空间分辨的激子反射率调制，并通过逐像素原位标定获得二维电压图。利用该方法，研究实现了双层MoSe₂中由载流子密度驱动的金属-绝缘体转变，并在两端电阻达到兆欧量级时测得低于1 kΩ的沟道电阻，同时揭示了输运性质的显著空间不均匀性。
authors: Ha-Leem Kim, Hyungbin Lim, Yuanyi Yang, Ruishi Qi, Ruichen Xia, Can Uzundal, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Feng Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子级薄半导体中的高接触电阻常常掩盖其本征电输运性质，尤其是在低载流子密度下，而此时可能会出现奇异的关联态。我们提出一种光学电压剖面技术，这是一种非侵入式宽场方法，以邻近的单层MoSe₂激子传感器取代局域电压探针。该传感器由薄层六方氮化硼隔离，并将目标器件的局域静电势转换为空间分辨的激子反射率调制。通过逐像素的原位标定，这些信号能够给出工作偏置半导体器件的定量二维电压图。利用该方法，我们展示了双层MoSe₂中由载流子密度驱动的金属-绝缘体转变；尽管金属区域的两端电阻达到兆欧量级，仍获得了低于1 kΩ的沟道电阻。光学推导出的电阻在电阻量子h/e²附近表现出金属-绝缘体交叉，而电压图和重构的局域电导显示，无论在绝缘态还是金属态中都存在明显的空间不均匀性。除能够在高接触电阻条件下解析沟道电阻外，该技术还为空间分辨地研究功能性范德华器件中的微观输运不均匀性提供了途径。

articles.title: Isolating the natural edges of bilayer graphene in gate-defined mesoscopic devices
articles.title_zh: 在栅极定义的介观器件中隔离双层石墨烯的天然边缘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a graphite-gated architecture for bilayer graphene devices in which the active device is completely isolated from the natural graphene edges. Using a single patterned graphite-gate layer, we realize a fully electrostatically defined Hall-bar. Longitudinal and Hall measurements reveal mesoscopic transport features, including Hall-effect quenching and magnetoresistance peaks associated with boundary scattering. The dependence of the mesoscopic features on the carrierdensity shows that the effective channel width increases with the Fermi level and the electrostatic confinement at the gate-defined boundaries, and indicates that the carriers scatter at the electrostatic boundary. Raman spectroscopy and Kelvin probe force microscopy suggest that this boundary is disordered due to the used fabrication methods. Comparably, the quantum mobility in a fieldeffect transistor fabricated with the same architecture is not limited by boundary scattering and the visibility of quantum oscillations down to 4 mT suggests a record value of 2.5 x 10⁶ cm2/Vs.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种石墨栅极架构，使双层石墨烯有源器件完全避开天然石墨烯边缘，并利用单层图案化石墨栅实现完全静电定义的霍尔条器件。纵向和霍尔测量揭示了霍尔效应淬灭、与边界散射相关的磁阻峰等介观输运特征。结果表明，有效沟道宽度随费米能级和栅极定义边界处的静电限域增强而增加，载流子会在静电边界处发生散射；相同架构制备的场效应晶体管则表现出高达2.5×10⁶ cm²/Vs的量子迁移率。
authors: Francesco Blanda, Grazia Raciti, Thilo Glatzel, Aurin Strathmann, Fabrizio Volante, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ilaria Zardo, Thomas Ihn, Klaus Ensslin, Andrea Hofmann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种用于双层石墨烯器件的石墨栅极架构，其中有源器件完全与石墨烯的天然边缘隔离。利用单层图案化石墨栅，我们实现了一个完全由静电定义的霍尔条器件。纵向和霍尔测量揭示了介观输运特征，包括霍尔效应淬灭以及与边界散射相关的磁阻峰。介观特征对载流子密度的依赖表明，有效沟道宽度会随费米能级以及栅极定义边界处的静电限域而增加，并说明载流子会在静电边界处发生散射。拉曼光谱和开尔文探针力显微镜表明，由于所采用的制备方法，该边界存在无序。相比之下，利用相同架构制备的场效应晶体管中的量子迁移率并不受边界散射限制；其量子振荡在低至4 mT的磁场下仍清晰可见，表明其量子迁移率达到2.5×10⁶ cm²/Vs这一创纪录数值。

articles.title: Localized Excitons and Exciton-Phonon Coupling in Antiferromagnetic AgCrP2S6
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁AgCrP₂S₆中的局域激子与激子-声子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AgCrP2S6 combines a low-symmetry thiophosphate framework with an antiferromagnetic Cr sublattice and nonmagnetic Ag sites, providing a setting in which covalency and magnetic localization compete in the low-energy optical response. We combine single-crystal x-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, lattice-dynamical calculations, and self-consistent vertex corrected Feynman diagrammatic many-body approaches to determine the structural, electronic, and excitonic properties of bulk AgCrP2S6. The material remains monoclinic between 100 and 300 K, with additional Ag-site disorder resolved at low temperature, and the optimized structure is dynamically stable. The many-body calculations yield a reduced quasiparticle gap relative to Cr trihalides, but the lowest excitons remain predominantly local: the calculated low-energy (~1.4 eV) excitation cluster is best described as a weakly bright, strongly anisotropic Frenkel exciton with dominant onsite d-d character and substantial ligand-assisted d-p admixture. Symmetry analysis in the C2h setting identifies this state as predominantly Bu and constrains its leading exciton-phonon coupling channels to Ag diagonal renormalization and Bg-mediated bright-dark mixing. These results place AgCrP2S6 in a localized excitonic regime in which the stronger p-d hybridization, relative to the more ionic Cr trihalides, narrows the quasiparticle gap, while the antiferromagnetic exchange and Ag-site dilution disfavor the intersite coherence associated with strongly delocalized low-energy excitons.
