articles.title: Hydrogen as a Molecular Probe for Nanopore Structure Characterization
articles.title_zh: 以氢作为分子探针进行纳米孔结构表征
articles.abstract: The design of advanced adsorbents for hydrogen storage and isotope separation requires a reliable methodology for pore-structure characterization. Due to its smallest size and relatively weak adsorption strength, hydrogen preferentially adsorbs in the smallest ultramicropores, which are insufficiently resolved using standard nitrogen adsorption measurements. Here, we demonstrate, using a representative example of ACC-ILL microporous carbon, the advantages of employing hydrogen as a molecular probe for adsorption characterization. The kernels of reference H2 and D2 isotherms at 77.4 K in cylindrical carbon pores ranging from 0.35 to 20 nm in diameter are generated with a classical density functional theory (DFT), which accounts for the fluid-solid interactions via statistical associating fluid theory (SAFT) with quantum-corrected Mie potentials (SAFT-VRQ Mie). We found that the isotope-specific differences in adsorption behavior are consistently captured by this quantum-corrected DFT model. The constructed kernels are used to derive the pore-size distributions from the experimental H2 and D2 isotherms. Furthermore, we show that the experimental D2 isotherm can be predicted by convolving the pore-size distribution determined from the experimental H2 isotherm with the D2 adsorption kernel. Reliable prediction of D2 adsorption behavior from relatively inexpensive H2 experiments greatly expands the practicality of nanoporous material screening for isotope separation applications, where distinguishing candidate materials often depends on subtle differences in confinement behavior that are costly to measure directly. The proposed H2 adsorption methodology is recommended for testing nanoporous carbons for hydrogen-based applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 先进储氢与同位素分离吸附剂的设计，需要可靠的孔结构表征方法。由于氢分子尺寸最小且吸附较弱，它更偏好吸附于最小的超微孔中，因此比常规氮吸附更适合作为探针。本文以ACC-ILL微孔碳为例，展示了用氢分子进行吸附表征的优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设计用于氢存储和同位素分离的先进吸附剂，需要一种可靠的孔结构表征方法。由于氢分子尺寸最小且吸附强度相对较弱，氢会优先吸附在最小的超微孔中，而这些孔隙用标准氮吸附测量无法得到充分分辨。本文以具有代表性的ACC-ILL微孔碳为例，展示了将氢作为吸附表征分子探针的优势。基于经典密度泛函理论（DFT），并采用通过量子修正Mie势（SAFT-VRQ Mie）引入流体-固体相互作用的统计缔合流体理论（SAFT），生成了直径0.35至20 nm圆柱形碳孔中77.4 K下参考H2和D2吸附等温线的核函数。我们发现，该量子修正DFT模型能够一致地捕捉吸附行为中的同位素特异性差异。利用所构建的核函数，从实验H2和D2等温线中推导孔径分布。此外，我们还表明，可将由实验H2等温线确定的孔径分布与D2吸附核函数卷积，以预测实验D2等温线。能够从相对低成本的H2实验可靠预测D2吸附行为，极大拓展了用于同位素分离应用的纳米孔材料筛选的可行性，因为区分候选材料往往取决于局域限域行为的细微差异，而直接测量这些差异的成本很高。本文提出的H2吸附方法建议用于测试氢相关应用中的纳米孔碳材料。

articles.title: Optimizing Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks to Solve Multilayered Static Linear Elastic PDEs
articles.title_zh: 优化参数化物理信息神经网络以求解多层静态线性弹性偏微分方程
articles.abstract: Designing multilayered materials for controlled deformation is heavily bottlenecked by the immense computational costs and time of traditional, industrial-grade finite element methods (FEM). This excessive expense severely limits design space exploration and gradient-based optimization. To streamline the workflow, we propose a framework for parameterized physics-informed neural networks (P2INNs). The framework encompasses three core components: I. a FEM baseline with a Hex8 element and trilinear basis functions, II. a P2INN displacement field model across variable material stiffness and layer thicknesses, and III. FEM-referenced evaluation. The PINN enforces static linear elasticity via Navier-Cauchy residuals with training strategies that prioritize physics, including layerwise PDE decomposition, interface continuity penalty, and compliance aware scaling. For one-layer, pure physics-driven configurations, the PINN achieves a mean volume MAE of 1.56% and worst-case volume MAE of 2.87% against the FEM benchmark. For three-layer configurations with controlled supervised training, the PINN achieves a mean volume MAE of 2.53% and worst-case volume MAE of 4.66%, meeting the near-5% worst-case volume-MAE target for preliminary design-space exploration. The trained P2INN model remains a lightweight model with a simple forward pass for future calculations, creating an alternative to traditional FEM. By drastically reducing the need for expensive FEM evaluations, this approach could accelerate the inverse design and optimization of advanced layered architectures for protective structures in various load-heavy or potentially collision-heavy fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统工业级有限元方法在多层材料变形设计中计算成本高、耗时长，严重限制了设计空间探索与基于梯度的优化。本文提出一种参数化物理信息神经网络框架，结合有限元基线、可变材料刚度与层厚的位移场模型，以及基于有限元的评估。结果表明，该方法在一层和三层配置下均能以较低误差逼近有限元基准，可作为传统有限元的轻量替代方案，用于层状结构的逆向设计与优化。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出参数化物理约束神经网络来求解多层静态线弹性偏微分方程。方法主要用于提高有限元求解效率和多层结构设计的优化速度。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们团队的材料模拟方向只有很弱的交叉，主要是通用的物理信息神经网络方法。它不涉及电子结构、磁性、铁电或缺陷等核心问题。
articles.focus_suggestion: 若团队未来关注多尺度力学或界面应力问题，可参考其物理约束训练和界面连续性惩罚设计。当前阶段更适合作为通用数值方法阅读，而非重点跟进。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为实现可控变形而设计多层材料时，传统工业级有限元方法（FEM）带来的巨大计算成本和时间开销构成了主要瓶颈。这种过高的代价严重限制了设计空间探索和基于梯度的优化。为简化工作流程，我们提出了一个参数化物理信息神经网络（P2INNs）框架。该框架包含三个核心部分：I. 采用Hex8单元和三线性基函数的FEM基线；II. 跨可变材料刚度和层厚度的P2INN位移场模型；III. 以FEM为参照的评估。该PINN通过Navier-Cauchy残差来施加静态线性弹性约束，并采用强调物理性的训练策略，包括逐层PDE分解、界面连续性惩罚以及顺应度感知缩放。对于单层、纯物理驱动的配置，该PINN相对于FEM基准在体积平均绝对误差（MAE）上达到1.56%，最差情况体积MAE为2.87%。对于采用受控监督训练的三层配置，该PINN实现了2.53%的平均体积MAE和4.66%的最差情况体积MAE，满足了用于初步设计空间探索的接近5%最差情况体积MAE目标。训练后的P2INN模型保持为一个轻量级模型，并具有用于未来计算的简单前向传播过程，从而为传统FEM提供了一种替代方案。通过大幅减少对昂贵FEM评估的需求，这种方法有望加速用于防护结构的先进层状架构在各种高载荷或潜在碰撞场景中的逆向设计与优化。

articles.title_zh: 橘皮素减轻聚苯乙烯纳米塑料诱导的TM3莱迪希细胞氧化应激和类固醇生成损伤：细胞与分子对接证据
articles.abstract: The widespread presence of nanoplastics has raised concerns regarding their potential impact onmale reproductive health. This study characterized 50 nm polystyrene nanoplastics (PSNPs) and evaluated their effects on oxidative stress and steroidogenesis in TM3 immature mouse Leydig cells, as well as tangeretin’s protective role, using combined in vitro and in silico approaches. Cells were exposed to PSNPs (50 µg/mL) with or without tangeretin (10–40 µM) for 24–72 h. PSNPs displayed uniform primary size but exhibited increased hydrodynamic diameter and reduced surface charge in serum-containing medium. Exposure caused a time-dependent decline in cell viability and redox imbalance evidenced by increased reactive oxygen species, elevated lipid peroxidation and depletion of antioxidant defenses. These changes were associated with modulation of the NOX4/Nrf2 signaling, induction of HO-1 and downregulation of key steroidogenic markers (StAR, CYP11A1, CYP17A1, and 3β-HSD) at mRNA and protein levels, resulting in reduced testosterone production. Tangeretin alone was non-cytotoxic and dose-dependently attenuated these effects, partially restoring redox balance and steroidogenesis impairment. Molecular docking supported these findings by showing favorable interactions between tangeretin and NOX4, Keap1, and steroidogenic proteins. Overall, tangeretin mitigates PSNP-induced Leydig cell dysfunction through modulation of the NOX4/Nrf2 axis and preservation of steroidogenic pathways, highlighting its capacity as a promising candidate against nanoplastics-related reproductive dysfunction.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米塑料的广泛存在引发了人们对其潜在影响男性生殖健康的担忧。本研究结合体外与计算方法，考察了50 nm聚苯乙烯纳米塑料对TM3未成熟小鼠莱迪希细胞氧化应激和类固醇生成的影响，并评估了橘皮素的保护作用。结果表明，橘皮素可在一定程度上恢复氧化还原平衡并缓解类固醇生成障碍，提示其可能成为对抗纳米塑料相关生殖功能损伤的候选物。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纳米塑料的广泛存在引发了人们对其潜在影响男性生殖健康的担忧。本研究采用体外和计算机模拟相结合的方法，表征了50 nm聚苯乙烯纳米塑料（PSNPs），并评估了其对TM3未成熟小鼠莱迪希细胞氧化应激和类固醇生成的影响，以及橘皮素的保护作用。细胞在有或无橘皮素（10–40 µM）的条件下暴露于PSNPs（50 µg/mL）24–72小时。PSNPs表现出均一的初级粒径，但在含血清培养基中其水动力学直径增大、表面电荷降低。暴露导致细胞活力随时间下降，并出现氧化还原失衡，表现为活性氧增加、脂质过氧化升高以及抗氧化防御耗竭。这些变化与NOX4/Nrf2信号的调节、HO-1诱导，以及关键类固醇生成标志物（StAR、CYP11A1、CYP17A1和3β-HSD）在mRNA和蛋白水平上的下调有关，从而导致睾酮产量降低。橘皮素本身无细胞毒性，并以剂量依赖方式减轻这些效应，部分恢复了氧化还原平衡和类固醇生成受损。分子对接结果支持了这些发现，显示橘皮素与NOX4、Keap1以及类固醇生成蛋白之间具有良好的相互作用。总体而言，橘皮素通过调节NOX4/Nrf2轴并维持类固醇生成通路，减轻了PSNPs诱导的莱迪希细胞功能障碍，显示出其作为应对纳米塑料相关生殖功能障碍的有前景候选物的潜力。

articles.title: Permeability Evolution and Cross-Specimen Machine-Learning Prediction of Geothermal-Reservoir Sandstone under Coupled Temperature and Pressure
articles.title_zh: 耦合温压条件下地热储层砂岩渗透率演化及跨试样机器学习预测
articles.abstract: Variations in temperature, injection pressure, and cyclic confining pressure during the injection and production of deep geothermal reservoirs alter the pore–fracture structure of sandstone and produce path-dependent permeability. To address the statistical dependence of repeated measurements from the same specimen and the data leakage caused by random row-wise splitting, this study developed a machine-learning framework for predicting unseen specimens using 336 coupled temperature–pressure seepage measurements from 16 sandstone specimens. Temperature, injection pressure, confining pressure, and porosity were used as inputs to compare multiple linear regression, support vector regression, random forest, extremely randomized trees, and gradient boosting regression. Model generalization was evaluated using nested specimen-grouped cross-validation. Random forest achieved the best overall performance, with pooled out-of-fold R², MAE, RMSE, and MAPE values of 0.748, 0.0144 mD, 0.0190 mD, and 15.29%, respectively; gradient boosting and extremely randomized trees produced comparable results. Permutation analysis on held-out specimens identified confining pressure as the most stable predictive source, whereas the importance of temperature, injection pressure, and porosity was affected by specimen differences and confounding among factor combinations. For 144 loading–unloading pairs at matched confining pressures, the median permeability difference was − 0.0040 mD (− 4.41%), indicating incomplete permeability recovery after unloading. A permeability prediction interface was developed from the final random-forest model to support parameter input, applicability-domain checking, and result output. Using specimens rather than individual measurements as validation units effectively limits data leakage, provides more credible cross-specimen predictions, and offers a practical tool for rapid permeability assessment of geothermal-reservoir sandstone within the experimental domain.
articles.abstract_zh: 深部地热储层在注采过程中，温度、注入压力和循环围压的变化会改变砂岩孔隙—裂隙结构，并导致渗透率具有路径依赖性。为解决同一试样重复测量之间的统计相关性以及随机按行划分带来的数据泄漏问题，本研究基于16个砂岩试样的336组耦合温压渗流数据，建立了面向未知试样的机器学习预测框架。随机森林模型表现最佳，且结果表明围压是最稳定的预测来源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在深部地热储层的注入和生产过程中，温度、注入压力以及循环围压的变化会改变砂岩的孔隙—裂隙结构，并产生路径依赖性的渗透率。为解决来自同一试样重复测量所带来的统计相关性，以及随机按行划分所引起的数据泄漏问题，本研究利用来自16个砂岩试样的336组耦合温度—压力渗流测量，建立了一个用于预测未知试样的机器学习框架。以温度、注入压力、围压和孔隙度作为输入，对多元线性回归、支持向量回归、随机森林、极端随机树和梯度提升回归进行了比较。模型泛化能力通过嵌套的按试样分组交叉验证进行评估。随机森林总体性能最佳，汇总后的样本外R²、MAE、RMSE和MAPE分别为0.748、0.0144 mD、0.0190 mD和15.29%；梯度提升和极端随机树也给出了相近结果。对保留试样进行的置换分析表明，围压是最稳定的预测来源，而温度、注入压力和孔隙度的重要性则受试样差异及因素组合之间的混杂影响。对于144组在相同围压下的加载—卸载对，中位渗透率差异为−0.0040 mD（−4.41%），表明卸载后渗透率恢复不完全。基于最终随机森林模型开发了一个渗透率预测界面，用于支持参数输入、适用域检查和结果输出。以试样而非单个测量值作为验证单元，可有效限制数据泄漏，提供更可信的跨试样预测，并为实验域内地热储层砂岩的快速渗透率评估提供实用工具。

articles.title: Deep Learning-Assisted Multi-Objective Optimization and Microstructure Property Correlation in Rotary Friction Welding of Dissimilar AA1100–AA2014 Aluminium Alloys
articles.title_zh: 深度学习辅助的多目标优化与显微组织—性能相关性研究：异种AA1100–AA2014铝合金旋转摩擦焊
articles.abstract: Joining dissimilar aluminium alloys is still a challenge due to the differences in their thermal and mechanical properties which cause non-uniform deformation and poor joint performance. The present study aims to study the mechanical behavior, microstructural evolution and intelligent optimization of AA1100–AA2014 dissimilar aluminium joints produced by rotary friction welding. The Taguchi L27 experimental design was used to change the rotational speed, friction pressure, forging pressure, friction time, and forging time. The tensile test, microhardness test, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD) were used to assess the weld quality. A deep neural network (DNN) combined with the NSGA-II algorithm was designed to predict and optimize welding performance. The optimized joints had a maximum tensile strength of 142 MPa, hardness of 122.3 HV, and a predictive accuracy of R² = 0.987, indicating good agreement between the experimental and predicted results. Microstructural analyses showed fine grains, defect-free interfaces and no harmful intermetallic phases. The proposed hybrid experimental–AI framework is an efficient decision-support tool for intelligent process optimization and reliable dissimilar aluminium joining in the aerospace, automotive and lightweight structural manufacturing sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 异种铝合金由于热学和力学性质差异，容易产生不均匀变形和较差接头性能，因此连接仍具挑战。本文研究了AA1100与AA2014异种铝合金旋转摩擦焊接接头的力学行为、显微组织演变及智能优化。结果表明，深度神经网络结合NSGA-II能够较准确地预测并优化焊接性能，优化后接头具有较高的抗拉强度和硬度，且微观组织致密、界面良好。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于热学和力学性质存在差异，连接异种铝合金仍然是一个挑战，这些差异会导致变形不均匀和较差的接头性能。本研究旨在研究通过旋转摩擦焊制备的AA1100–AA2014异种铝合金接头的力学行为、显微组织演化以及智能优化。采用Taguchi L27试验设计来改变转速、摩擦压力、顶锻压力、摩擦时间和顶锻时间。通过拉伸试验、显微硬度试验、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和X射线衍射（XRD）评估焊缝质量。设计了一个结合NSGA-II算法的深度神经网络（DNN），用于预测和优化焊接性能。优化后的接头最高抗拉强度为142 MPa，硬度为122.3 HV，预测精度R² = 0.987，表明实验结果与预测结果吻合良好。显微组织分析表明，晶粒细小、界面无缺陷，且未形成有害的金属间化合物相。所提出的“实验—人工智能”混合框架是一个高效的决策支持工具，可用于航空航天、汽车以及轻量化结构制造领域中异种铝连接的智能工艺优化和可靠连接。

articles.title: Groundwater potential mapping of the Imiter region, Anti-Atlas, Morocco
articles.title_zh: 摩洛哥Anti-Atlas地区Imiter区域地下水潜力制图
articles.abstract: Groundwater is a critical resource in the arid Imiter region of the central Anti-Atlas, Morocco, where surface water is scarce, and groundwater occurrence is mainly controlled by fracture-related secondary permeability, terrain conditions, and hydrothermal alteration. This study delineates groundwater potential zones (GWPZs) by integrating multisource remote sensing, morphostructural analysis, terrain-derived indices, and airborne radiometric data within a GIS-based multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) framework. Eight thematic factors were considered: lineament density, topographic wetness index (TWI), slope, drainage density, normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), and three ASTER-derived hydrothermal alteration indicators, namely carbonate, kaolinite, and Fe³ alteration. Slope, TWI, and drainage density were derived from SRTM-based terrain analysis, NDVI was calculated from Sentinel-2 imagery, lineament density was extracted from morphostructural analysis, and hydrothermal alteration layers were obtained from ASTER VNIR–SWIR data. The reclassified thematic layers were integrated using weighted overlay analysis, with lineament density assigned the strongest influence, followed by TWI, slope, drainage density, carbonate alteration, kaolinite alteration, NDVI, and Fe³ alteration. The resulting GWPZ map reveals strong structural and morphometric controls on groundwater favorability, with high-potential zones preferentially concentrated along fractured corridors and hydrothermally altered domains, where terrain conditions favor infiltration and subsurface accumulation. To evaluate the model independently, single-band airborne radiometric layers of uranium, thorium, and potassium were used to calculate U/Th and Th/K ratios, which were then compared with the predicted GWPZ classes through point-based validation. A total of 5307 validation points were used. The Th/K ratio provided the strongest agreement with the groundwater-favorable zones, with an accuracy of 0.601, precision of 0.632, recall of 0.857, and F1-score of 0.728. The U/Th ratio provided complementary support, with an accuracy of 0.537, precision of 0.571, recall of 0.828, and F1-score of 0.676. These results indicate that the proposed workflow provides a reproducible and physically meaningful framework for regional-scale groundwater prospectivity mapping in structurally complex arid hard-rock terrains.
articles.abstract_zh: 摩洛哥中部Anti-Atlas干旱区的Imiter地区地表水稀缺，地下水是关键资源，其赋存主要受断裂相关次生渗透性、地形条件和热液蚀变控制。本文将多源遥感、构造形态分析、地形指数和机载辐射数据整合到GIS多准则决策框架中，绘制地下水潜力区图。结果显示，断裂带与热液蚀变区往往对应更高的地下水潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 地下水是摩洛哥中部Anti-Atlas干旱Imiter地区的一项关键资源，该区地表水稀缺，而地下水的赋存主要受与断裂相关的次生渗透性、地形条件和热液蚀变控制。本研究在基于GIS的多准则决策分析（MCDA）框架中，整合多源遥感、构造形态分析、地形派生指数和机载辐射数据，以划定地下水潜力区（GWPZs）。共考虑了八个专题因子：线性构造密度、地形湿润指数（TWI）、坡度、排水密度、归一化植被指数（NDVI），以及三个基于ASTER的热液蚀变指示因子，即碳酸盐蚀变、高岭石蚀变和Fe³蚀变。坡度、TWI和排水密度通过基于SRTM的地形分析获得，NDVI由Sentinel-2影像计算，线性构造密度通过构造形态分析提取，热液蚀变图层则来自ASTER VNIR–SWIR数据。重分类后的专题图层通过加权叠加分析进行整合，其中线性构造密度被赋予最大的影响权重，其次依次为TWI、坡度、排水密度、碳酸盐蚀变、高岭石蚀变、NDVI和Fe³蚀变。所得GWPZ图显示，地下水有利性受到构造和地貌因素的强烈控制，高潜力区优先集中于破碎廊道和热液蚀变域，在这些区域中，地形条件有利于入渗和地下聚集。为独立评估该模型，采用单波段机载辐射图层中的铀、钍和钾数据计算U/Th和Th/K比值，并通过基于点的验证与预测的GWPZ类别进行比较。共使用5307个验证点。Th/K比值与地下水有利区的一致性最强，其准确率为0.601，精确率为0.632，召回率为0.857，F1分数为0.728。U/Th比值提供了补充性支持，其准确率为0.537，精确率为0.571，召回率为0.828，F1分数为0.676。这些结果表明，所提出的工作流程为结构复杂的干旱硬岩地区开展区域尺度地下水远景预测提供了一个可重复且具有物理意义的框架。

articles.title: Chronic life-cycle exposure to atrazine at an environmentally relevant concentration induces redox imbalance, mortality, and developmental malformations in zebrafish (Danio rerio)
articles.title_zh: 在环境相关浓度下，阿特拉津的全生命周期慢性暴露会诱导斑马鱼（Danio rerio）氧化还原失衡、死亡和发育畸形
articles.abstract: Atrazine (ATZ) is a widely used herbicide and is frequently detected in water bodies, potentially affecting non-target organisms such as fish. This study investigated the effects of chronic exposure to ATZ, at an environmentally relevant concentration (1 µg/L), on behavioral and biochemical parameters of Danio rerio. The fish were exposed from the embryonic stage to adulthood. Heart rate (HR), spontaneous movement (SM), and malformations in larvae were evaluated. After 96h of exposure biomarkers of oxidative damage: thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS) and reactive oxygen species (ROS) were evaluated. In addition, the activity of the enzymes acetylcholinesterase (AChE), and some antioxidant defense parameters also were evaluated: superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), non-protein thiols (NPSH) and total antioxidant capacity against peroxyl radicals (ACAP). No significant changes were observed in spontaneous movement (SM). However, heart rate (HR) was significantly reduced in the atrazine-exposed group. However, a high mortality rate (87.5%) was shown, and malformations were observed after 72 hours post-fertilization in atrazine exposed group. TBARS and SOD levels were not altered by ATZ exposure. In contrast, a significant increase in ROS was observed, along with a reduction in ACAP and in the activity of the enzymes CAT and AChE. NPSH levels were also reduced by chronic exposure to atrazine. The sum of results indicated oxidative damage and impairment of both enzymatic and non-enzymatic antioxidant defenses. In addition, the results concerning AChE activity suggest possible neuromuscular effects. The results also highlight the issue of environmental contamination, because an environmentally relevant concentration of ATZ was used.
articles.abstract_zh: 阿特拉津是一种广泛使用的除草剂，常在水体中检出，可能影响鱼类等非靶标生物。研究表明，环境相关浓度的阿特拉津长期暴露会降低斑马鱼心率，并引起高死亡率和发育畸形，同时伴随活性氧升高、抗氧化能力下降以及胆碱酯酶活性改变。这些结果提示阿特拉津在环境相关水平下仍可能造成显著生态毒性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 阿特拉津（ATZ）是一种广泛使用的除草剂，且在水体中经常被检出，可能影响鱼类等非靶标生物。本研究调查了在环境相关浓度（1 µg/L）下慢性暴露于ATZ对斑马鱼（Danio rerio）行为和生化参数的影响。鱼从胚胎阶段一直暴露到成体阶段。评估了幼鱼的心率（HR）、自发运动（SM）以及畸形情况。暴露96小时后，测定氧化损伤生物标志物：硫代巴比妥酸反应物（TBARS）和活性氧（ROS）。此外，还评估了乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）活性，以及一些抗氧化防御参数：超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、非蛋白巯基（NPSH）和对过氧自由基的总抗氧化能力（ACAP）。结果未观察到自发运动（SM）有显著变化。然而，阿特拉津暴露组的心率（HR）显著降低。同时，阿特拉津暴露组表现出高死亡率（87.5%），并在受精后72小时观察到畸形。ATZ暴露未改变TBARS和SOD水平。相反，ROS显著升高，同时ACAP以及CAT和AChE酶活性降低。NPSH水平也因阿特拉津的慢性暴露而降低。综合结果表明，存在氧化损伤以及酶促和非酶促抗氧化防御受损。此外，关于AChE活性的结果提示可能存在神经肌肉效应。结果还凸显了环境污染问题，因为研究使用的是环境相关浓度的ATZ。

articles.title: Hybrid electrocoagulation - anodic oxidation for decentralized greywater reuse pilot plant: performance, energy demand, and kinetics at domestic scale
articles.title_zh: 用于分散式灰水回用的混合电絮凝—阳极氧化中试装置：家庭尺度下的性能、能耗与动力学
articles.abstract: Water scarcity affects more than 2.7 billion people worldwide, highlighting the need to identify alternative water sources such as greywater (GW), which represents a potential resource for domestic use. In this study, a domestic-scale hybrid electrochemical reactor combining electrocoagulation (EC) and anodic oxidation (AO) was fabricated and evaluated for the treatment of real household GW. The reactor performance was investigated by varying the active electrode area using three configurations (140, 280, and 420 cm²), referred to as single (SCE), double (DCE), and triple (TCE) electrochemical treatments. The TCE configuration was identified as the optimal operating condition, achieving maximum removals of turbidity (95.3%), chemical oxygen demand (COD, 67.9%), and biochemical oxygen demand (BOD₅, 67.9%) within 2.5–4 h of treatment, while reducing the energy consumption per cubic meter of treated water by 58% compared to the SCE configuration. Identified degradation by-products included monoterpenes/terpenoids, aromatic esters, substituted phenols, and aliphatic ester-containing carboxylic acids. Finally, kinetic parameters and models were developed to enable scaling of the reactor to different sizes. This work demonstrates the simultaneous application of anodic oxidation and electrocoagulation in a single system pilot plant, opening new opportunities for implementation in decentralized GW treatment plants.
articles.abstract_zh: 全球超过27亿人面临缺水，亟需寻找替代水源，灰水因此成为具有潜力的家庭用水资源。本文构建并评估了一种家庭尺度的混合电化学反应器，将电絮凝与阳极氧化结合，用于处理真实生活灰水。结果表明，采用更大活性电极面积的三电化学配置性能最佳，可在2.5–4小时内高效去除浊度、COD和BOD₅，并显著降低单位水量能耗。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全球水资源短缺影响着超过27亿人，这凸显了识别替代水源的必要性，例如灰水（GW），其具有家庭用途的潜在资源价值。本研究制备并评估了一种家庭尺度的混合电化学反应器，将电絮凝（EC）与阳极氧化（AO）相结合，用于处理真实家庭灰水。通过改变活性电极面积来考察反应器性能，设置了三种配置（140、280和420 cm²），分别称为单重（SCE）、双重（DCE）和三重（TCE）电化学处理。TCE配置被确定为最佳运行条件，在2.5–4小时处理内实现了浊度（95.3%）、化学需氧量（COD，67.9%）和五日生化需氧量（BOD₅，67.9%）的最大去除率，同时与SCE配置相比，将每立方米处理水的能耗降低了58%。鉴定出的降解副产物包括单萜/萜类、芳香酯、取代酚以及含脂肪族酯的羧酸。最后，建立了动力学参数和模型，以便将该反应器放大到不同尺寸。本研究展示了在单一系统中同时应用阳极氧化和电絮凝的中试装置，为分散式灰水处理厂的实施开辟了新的机会。

articles.title: Revisiting the Coupling of Thermodynamics and Electromagnetics
articles.title_zh: 重新审视热力学与电磁学的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit the coupling of continuum thermodynamics and electromagnetic theory for polarisable and magnetisable matter in motion. Two routes are followed and then compared. The first route is the axiomatic bulk theory of Dreyer, Guhlke and Müller, in which universal balance laws are closed by an entropy principle. We show that the source of the internal energy balance must be built with the non-convective electric current, that the polarisation current and the Lorentz magnetisation enter through one single identity, which Dreyer et al. do not write down, and that this identity fixes both the admissible entropy variables and the signs of the bound-current ansatz. The second route is the statistical-mechanical one of Mazur, in which the macroscopic Maxwell equations are obtained by ensemble averaging over a system of atoms with internal charge carriers. Mazur stops before the conservation laws, so we derive them, and we estimate the size of the mass-correction terms that appear. The comparison shows that after a redefinition of polarisation and magnetisation the two sets of equations agree structurally. The only irreducible difference is a momentum contribution from microscopic field fluctuations, which can not be reproduced in a purely macroscopic theory. We further show that the electromotive intensity E and the Lorentz magnetisation M are not modelling choices but appear by themselves, and that the asymmetric look of the entropy function is a consequence of the chosen energy variable and not a defect of the theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新考察了运动中的可极化、可磁化物质中连续介质热力学与电磁理论的耦合问题，并比较了两条理论路径。作者指出，源项、极化电流与洛伦兹磁化等在内部能守恒与熵变量选择中起关键作用，且宏观与统计力学描述在结构上可一致，唯微观场涨落带来的动量项无法由纯宏观理论重现。
authors: Stefanie Braun, Henning Struchtrup, Manuel Torrilhon
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文重新考察了运动中的可极化、可磁化物质中连续介质热力学与电磁理论的耦合问题，并比较了两条理论路径。第一条路径是 Dreyer、Guhlke 和 Müller 的公理化体理论，其中普适守恒定律通过熵原理闭合。我们表明，内部能方程的源项必须由非对流电流构成，极化电流和洛伦兹磁化通过一个单一的恒等式进入，而 Dreyer 等人并未写出这一恒等式；该恒等式同时确定了允许的熵变量以及束缚电流假设中的符号。第二条路径是 Mazur 的统计力学方法，其中通过对具有内部电荷载流子的原子系统做系综平均来得到宏观麦克斯韦方程。Mazur 在得到这些方程后并未推进到守恒定律，因此我们推导了这些定律，并估计了其中出现的质量修正项的大小。比较表明，在重新定义极化和磁化之后，这两套方程在结构上是一致的。唯一不可约的差异是来自微观场涨落的动量贡献，它无法由纯宏观理论再现。我们进一步表明，电动势强度 E 和洛伦兹磁化 M 不是建模选择，而是自然出现的；熵函数看似不对称的形式，是所选能量变量的结果，而非理论缺陷。

articles.title: Fuzzy Spectroscopy of Bound States in Massive Quantum Field Theories
articles.title_zh: 大质量量子场论中束缚态的模糊光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07655v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mesons and glueballs are paradigmatic bound states of confining quantum field theories (QFTs), but their nonperturbative spectroscopy in the continuum remains challenging beyond one spatial dimension. Here we perform such spectroscopy for the Ising QFT using a recently developed regularization based on noncommutative ``fuzzy'' geometry. On a thin fuzzy torus, we reproduce the universal low-lying mathbb E₈ meson masses of the magnetically perturbed (1+1)D Ising QFT. By increasing the torus aspect ratio, we continuously track the second-lightest mathbb E₈ meson as the system effectively crosses over from 1D to 2D. On the 2D fuzzy torus and sphere, we find a subthreshold scalar level and above-threshold response features consistent with previous estimates of glueball masses. The same excitations are revealed away from equilibrium using quench dynamics. Our results establish fuzzy geometries as nonperturbative spectroscopic probes of massive QFTs, including their bound-state evolution through dimensional crossover.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用非交换“模糊”几何的正则化方法，对大质量量子场论中的束缚态谱进行了非微扰研究。作者在 Ising 量子场论中重现实验上熟知的低能 meson 质量，并进一步展示了在二维与维度交叉过程中，相关激发如何演化为类似 glueball 的谱特征。
authors: Joseph Taylor, Matthew Yusuf, Zlatko Papić
articles.abstract_zh_full: Meson 和 glueball 是约束量子场论（QFT）中典型的束缚态，但在连续极限中，超出一个空间维度后的非微扰谱学研究仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们利用一种最近发展起来的、基于非交换“模糊”几何的正则化方法，对 Ising 量子场论进行了这类谱学研究。在一个狭长的模糊环面上，我们重现了在磁场扰动的（1+1）维 Ising 量子场论中具有普适性的低能 mathbb E₈ meson 质量。通过增大环面的长宽比，我们连续追踪第二轻的 mathbb E₈ meson，此时系统实际上从一维跨越到二维。在二维模糊环面和球面上，我们发现一个阈下标量能级以及阈上响应特征，这些特征与先前对 glueball 质量的估计一致。相同的激发也可通过淬火动力学在平衡态之外揭示出来。我们的结果表明，模糊几何可作为大质量量子场论的非微扰谱学探针，包括其在维度交叉过程中的束缚态演化。

articles.title: Defect-Controlled Multiferroicity via Stacking Control in Nonmagnetic van der Waals Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 通过堆叠控制在非磁性范德华双层中实现缺陷调控的多铁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a general paradigm that directly couples vacancy-localized magnetism to interfacial sliding ferroelectricity in nonmagnetic van der Waals (vdWs) bilayers. Utilizing bilayer hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) as a prototypical vdWs host system, we use first-principles calculations to show that a single vacancy acts as a local registry sensor, lifting the degeneracy between polar sliding partners via a defect-centered polarization offset. For interlayer vacancy pairs, we discover a defect selectivity where the hosting sublattice fully dictates the interlayer exchange, stabilizing either ferrimagnetic or antiferromagnetic configurations. Applying an out-of-plane electric field selects the polar registry and drives an amplitude modulation of the compensated Néel order parameter. These findings establish a robust, sublattice-dependent engineering of multiferroic functionality via stacking control across a wide class of nonmagnetic 2D heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种将空位局域磁性与界面滑移铁电性直接耦合的通用方案，用于非磁性范德华双层中的多铁功能设计。以双层六方氮化硼为例，作者表明单个空位可充当局部配位传感器，而电场和缺陷亚晶格位置可共同决定磁序与极性构型。
authors: Bumseop Kim, Sayed Ali Akbar Ghorashi, Andrew M. Rappe
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种通用范式，可在非磁性范德华（vdWs）双层中，将空位局域磁性直接耦合到界面滑移铁电性上。以双层六方氮化硼（hBN）作为典型的 vdWs 宿主体系，我们利用第一性原理计算表明，单个空位可作为局域配位传感器，通过缺陷中心的极化偏移打破极性滑移伙伴之间的简并性。对于层间空位对，我们发现一种缺陷选择性，其中承载缺陷的亚晶格完全决定层间交换作用，从而稳定亚铁磁或反铁磁构型。施加垂直于层面的电场可选择极性配位，并驱动补偿型 Néel 序参量的幅度调制。这些发现表明，可以通过堆叠控制，在广泛的非磁性二维异质结构中实现一种稳健的、依赖亚晶格的多铁功能工程。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作提出通过堆叠调控在非磁性二维范德华双层中实现缺陷控制的多铁性。以 hBN 双层为例，单空位可作为局域注册传感器，调控滑移铁电序；空位对还能选择性稳定铁磁或反铁磁构型，并可被外电场进一步调控。
articles.focus_relation: 这与我们在二维滑移铁电、范德华材料、缺陷效应、多铁性和磁电耦合方面的研究非常契合。论文将缺陷、层间堆叠和铁电/磁性耦合联系起来，和团队关注的问题几乎同频。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步研究缺陷位置、层间堆叠与交换作用之间的定量关系，并尝试推广到其他二维磁体或异质结体系。也可结合有效哈密顿量或机器学习模型，探索缺陷驱动多铁性的高通量筛选。

articles.title: Engineering correlated phases through manipulation of Van Hove singularities
articles.title_zh: 通过调控范霍夫奇点工程关联相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the ordered phases of correlated electron systems remains a central challenge in quantum materials design. Divergences in the electronic density of states, known as Van Hove singularities (VHSs), are one obvious route to such control. It is clear from recent work that the exact functional form of these divergences can profoundly affect which phases are realized; a full picture, however, remains elusive. In this work, we use both the hot-spot parquet renormalization group and the truncated-unity functional renormalization group to theoretically study the emergent correlated states of a two-dimensional square-lattice Hubbard model with VHSs at or near the Fermi level. By varying a single hopping parameter, t₃, we are able to change the strength of the VHS divergence in the density of states from logarithmic (for t₃ < t₃c) to power-law (for t₃ = t₃c). Further increase of t₃ (t₃ > t₃c) causes each original Van Hove point to split into two, both of the conventional logarithmic type. We show that which of these regimes we are in strongly influences the predicted ordered states. We also study the dependence on doping, and find that the ferromagnetic state that occurs at Van Hove filling in these models is unstable to very small shifts in the Fermi level, often giving way to distinct ordered states depending on whether the model is electron- or hole-doped. These results highlight the importance of tuning VHS properties to control ordered states in correlated materials, and offer design rules to engineer these phases in novel systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维方格 Hubbard 模型中，接近费米能级的范霍夫奇点如何影响关联有序相的形成。结果表明，只需调节单个跃迁参数就能改变态密度奇异性的形式，而这会显著改变预测的磁性与其他有序态，说明调控范霍夫奇点是设计关联材料相图的重要途径。
authors: Thomas P. Sheerin, Maria Ramirez, Chris A. Hooley, Luke C. Rhodes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 控制关联电子系统的有序相仍是量子材料设计中的一个核心挑战。态密度中的发散，即所谓范霍夫奇点（VHS），为这种控制提供了一条显而易见的路径。近期工作已经表明，这些发散的精确函数形式会深刻影响实现哪种相；然而，完整图景仍不清晰。在这项工作中，我们同时使用热点 parquet 重整化群和截断统一功能重整化群，从理论上研究了一个二维方格 Hubbard 模型的涌现关联态，其中 VHS 位于或接近费米能级。通过改变单个跃迁参数 t₃，我们能够将态密度中 VHS 发散的强度从对数型（t₃ < t₃c）改变为幂律型（t₃ = t₃c）。进一步增大 t₃（t₃ > t₃c）会使每个原始范霍夫点分裂为两个，二者都属于常规的对数型。我们表明，我们所处的这些不同区间会强烈影响所预测的有序态。我们还研究了掺杂的依赖关系，发现这些模型中在范霍夫填充处出现的铁磁态对费米能级极小的偏移就不稳定，常常会根据模型是电子掺杂还是空穴掺杂而让位于不同的有序态。这些结果凸显了调控 VHS 性质以控制关联材料有序态的重要性，并为在新体系中工程化这些相提供了设计规则。

articles.title: Ferroelectric-controllable spin-orbit torque in two-dimensional multiferroic heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 二维多铁异质结构中可由铁电性调控的自旋轨道力矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT), which enables electrical control of magnetization, plays a crucial role in the development of next-generation spintronic devices. Realizing SOT in two-dimensional van der Waals systems, together with achieving efficient nonvolatile manipulation via ferroelectricity, would be highly beneficial for the implementation of tunable logic devices with enhanced storage density. In this work, based on first-principles calculation and using a multiferroic Fe₃GeTe₂/In₂Se₃ heterostructure as a representative example, we demonstrate that switching the ferroelectric polarization of the In₂Se₃ layer induces a pronounced modification in the magnetization-dependent distribution of torkance within the heterostructure. Specifically, when the magnetization is in the plane, where the torque is maximal, reversing the polarization of In₂Se₃ from upward to downward enhances the total torkance to more than 150% of its original value. This substantial variation primarily originates from the polarization-induced modulation of the z component of the time-reversal-odd torkance, which is mainly associated with an approximately 233% change in the atomic-resolved torque contributed from the middle Fe layer in Fe₃GeTe₂ layer. Further analysis reveals that the electronic states near Γ on the Fermi surface undergo significant reconstruction upon polarization switching, which is responsible for the observed variation in the time-reversal-odd torque. Our results not only provide new insights into the functional potential of van der Waals multiferroic heterostructures, but also offer a viable strategy for achieving electrically tunable SOT, paving the way for future programmable spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理研究了二维范德华多铁异质结构中自旋轨道力矩对铁电极化翻转的响应。结果表明，极化方向的切换可显著改变力矩分布与总扭矩大小，为实现可电控、可编程的自旋电子器件提供了思路。
authors: Weiyi Pan, Gusthavo M. S. Brizolla, Jaroslav Fabian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋轨道力矩（SOT）使磁化的电学控制成为可能，在下一代自旋电子器件的发展中起着关键作用。在二维范德华体系中实现 SOT，并进一步借助铁电性实现高效的非易失调控，将有助于构建具有更高存储密度的可调逻辑器件。在这项工作中，我们基于第一性原理计算，并以多铁 Fe₃GeTe₂/In₂Se₃ 异质结构作为代表性例子，证明翻转 In₂Se₃ 层的铁电极化会显著改变异质结构中依赖磁化方向的扭矩导纳分布。具体而言，当磁化位于面内、即扭矩最大时，将 In₂Se₃ 的极化从向上翻转为向下会使总扭矩导纳增强到原始值的 150% 以上。这种显著变化主要来源于极化诱导的时间反演奇异扭矩导纳 z 分量调制，而该分量主要与 Fe₃GeTe₂ 中间 Fe 层的原子分辨扭矩发生约 233% 的变化有关。进一步分析表明，费米面上 Γ 点附近的电子态在极化翻转后发生了显著重构，这正是所观察到的时间反演奇异扭矩变化的原因。我们的结果不仅为范德华多铁异质结构的功能潜力提供了新的认识，也为实现电可调自旋轨道力矩提供了一种可行策略，从而为未来可编程自旋电子器件铺平道路。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作以 Fe₃GeTe₂/In₂Se₃ 多铁异质结构为例，利用第一性原理证明了铁电极化翻转可以显著调控自旋轨道力矩。结果显示，极化反转会明显改变 torkance 的分布，并增强某些磁化方向下的总力矩响应。
articles.focus_relation: 这与我们关注的多铁异质结、二维磁体、铁电可控自旋输运和磁电耦合方向密切相关。其关于极化调控 SOT 的机制分析，对设计低功耗自旋器件很有参考意义。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步研究极化翻转对界面电荷转移、轨道重构和自旋轨道耦合的影响机制，并推广到其他二维磁/铁电异质结构。若结合模型哈密顿量或输运计算，可更系统地评估器件可调性。

articles.title: Dynamical quantum phase transitions in a hybrid quantum dot system with superconducting and ferromagnetic leads
articles.title_zh: 超导与铁磁电极耦合杂化量子点系统中的动力学量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically explore the non-equilibrium dynamics of a single quantum dot system coupled to both ferromagnetic and superconducting electrodes. To investigate its time evolution, we utilize the time-dependent numerical renormalization group technique, which captures the system's response to abrupt parameter changes in a fully non-perturbative manner. Our analysis focuses on dynamics following a sudden modification in the couplings to the leads or a shift of the orbital level. In particular, we calculate the time evolution of the induced local superconducting pairing correlations and magnetization. In this context, the relevant energy spectra are examined. Moreover, we study the behavior of the Loschmidt echo and the return function to shed light on the signatures of dynamical quantum phase transitions. The determined dependencies reveal non-trivial competition between relevant correlations, involving superconducting pairing and ferromagnetic-contacted induced exchange field, and deepen our understanding of nanoscale hybrid systems' dynamical behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了同时耦合超导电极与铁磁电极的单量子点体系的非平衡动力学。作者借助时变数值重整化群分析突变参数后的时间演化，考察了诱导配对、磁化以及 Loschmidt 回波等量，从而揭示动力学量子相变的特征。
authors: Antoni Jankiewicz, Kacper Wrześniewski, Ireneusz Weymann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了一个同时耦合到铁磁和超导电极的单量子点系统的非平衡动力学。为考察其时间演化，我们采用了时间依赖的数值重整化群方法，以完全非微扰的方式捕捉系统对突变参数变化的响应。我们的分析重点是耦合到导线的作用强度突然改变，或者轨道能级发生位移之后的动力学。具体而言，我们计算了诱导的局域超导配对关联和磁化的时间演化。在这一背景下，我们考察了相关能谱。此外，我们研究了 Loschmidt 回波和回返函数的行为，以揭示动力学量子相变的信号。所得依赖关系显示出相关关联之间的非平凡竞争，涉及超导配对与来自铁磁接触的感生交换场，并加深了我们对纳米尺度杂化系统动力学行为的理解。

articles.title: Understanding the Oxygen Reduction Reaction and Oxygen Evolution Reaction in Metal Intercalated Biphenylene Bilayers
articles.title_zh: 金属插层联苯烯双层中的氧还原反应与氧析出反应机理理解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We conducted an it ab initio study of the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in metal-encapsulated biphenylene bilayers, B/M/B, with M = Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Nb, Ru, W, Os and Pt. In most systems, the intercalated metal sits at the square carbon sites (C⁴⁶⁸) of the biphenylene lattice. Using a computational hydrogen electrode approach, we evaluated the reaction energetics at these active sites. Several B/M/B systems show competitive ORR and OER performance. Among the investigated systems, Cu, Pt, Ru, and Mn exhibit the lowest ORR overpotentials of 0.42, 0.44, 0.50, and 0.56 V, respectively, while Fe is identified as the most active catalyst for OER with an overpotential of 0.44 V. To understand the catalytic trends, we looked at the electronic structure through the metal d-band centers, the C⁴⁶⁸ p_z-band centers, and the corresponding orbital charge populations. The band centers did not give a simple polynomial dependence on the overpotentials, though they did point to favorable electronic ranges for the best catalysts. The d-orbital charge population of the encapsulated metal, however, correlated most clearly with activity-especially for OER-yielding volcano-type plots. From these, B/Fe/B emerges as the best OER catalyst, while B/Mn/B lies closest to the ORR optimum. The p-orbital population at the active carbon site also captures the main trends, albeit less strongly. Overall, these results show that straightforward electronic descriptors can predict catalytic behavior in metal-encapsulated biphenylene bilayers and guide the search for efficient catalysts where the carbon framework itself drives the reactivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用第一性原理系统研究了金属封装联苯烯双层中的 ORR/OER 反应活性，并比较了不同过渡金属插层后的催化性能。结果表明，若干体系具有竞争性的双功能催化能力，其中部分金属对应较低的 ORR 过电位，而 Fe 体系则表现出最优的 OER 活性。
authors: Henri G. Mendonça, Pedro H. Souza, Walter Orellana, Roberto H. Miwa
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对金属封装的联苯烯双层 B/M/B（其中 M = Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Nb、Ru、W、Os 和 Pt）中的氧还原反应（ORR）和氧析出反应（OER）进行了第一性原理研究。在大多数体系中，插层金属位于联苯烯晶格的方形碳位点（C⁴⁶⁸）。我们采用计算氢电极方法，评估了这些活性位点上的反应能量学。若干 B/M/B 体系表现出具有竞争力的 ORR 和 OER 性能。在所研究的体系中，Cu、Pt、Ru 和 Mn 分别表现出最低的 ORR 过电位，数值为 0.42、0.44、0.50 和 0.56 V；而 Fe 被识别为最活跃的 OER 催化剂，其过电位为 0.44 V。为理解催化趋势，我们通过金属 d 带中心、C⁴⁶⁸ p_z 带中心以及相应的轨道电荷占据情况考察了电子结构。带心并未与过电位呈现简单的多项式依赖关系，但它们确实指出了最佳催化剂对应的有利电子结构区间。然而，封装金属的 d 轨道电荷占据与活性之间的相关性最为清晰，尤其对于 OER，呈现出火山型关系。由此，B/Fe/B 成为最佳 OER 催化剂，而 B/Mn/B 最接近 ORR 最优点。活性碳位点上的 p 轨道占据也能反映主要趋势，尽管相关性较弱。总体而言，这些结果表明，简单的电子描述符可以预测金属封装联苯烯双层中的催化行为，并为寻找由碳骨架本身驱动反应性的高效催化剂提供指导。

articles.title: Spin selective non-van der Waal electride nature in manganese under ambient pressure
articles.title_zh: 常压下锰中自旋选择性非范德华电化物特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrides are an unusual class of ionic materials in which electrons localized in non-nuclear, interstitial regions act as anions within the crystal lattice. Here, we employ first-principles quantum mechanical calculations to investigate the structural, electronic, magnetic, and electride characteristics of elemental manganese (Mn) at an ambient pressure (0 GPa), focusing on its three crystalline phases: cubic (α)-Mn (Ibar43m,no.217), cubic (β)-Mn (P4₁₃₂, no.213), and hexagonal (hex)-Mn (P6₃/mmc, no.194). Our calculations reveal pronounced interstitial-electron character in all three phases, accompanied by spin-selective electron localization function (ELF), establishing elemental Mn as a non-van der Waals electride system. Bader charge analysis indicates substantial electron redistribution from the Mn host framework toward the interstitial anionic-electron (IAE) regions, with an effective charge transfer of approximately -1.645e, -1.477e, and -1.083e per interstitial basin in α-Mn, β-Mn, and hex-Mn, respectively. The electride character is further supported by the electronic density of states, where the IAE-associated states exhibit finite contributions near the Fermi level (E_F) and coexist with Mn-derived states, demonstrating their direct participation in the low-energy electronic structure. The combined electron localization function (ELF), effective charge transfer, and electron population due to IAE at E_F therefore provide consistent evidence for interstitial anionic electrons in elemental Mn. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic identification of spin-selective electride character in elemental Mn at ambient pressure, highlighting the possibility of exploiting its interstitial-electron states for unconventional electronic and magnetic functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过第一性原理计算表明，常压条件下的元素锰在多种晶相中都表现出明显的间隙电子特征，因而可视为一种非范德华电化物。研究进一步揭示了这种间隙阴离子电子具有自旋选择性，并参与费米能级附近的低能电子结构。
authors: Shishir Timilsena, Dinesh Thapa, David James Faller, Prabesh Adhikari, Nicholas Dimakis, Svetlana Kilina
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电化物是一类特殊的离子材料，其中局域在非核间隙区域的电子在晶体中充当阴离子。这里，我们采用第一性原理量子力学计算，研究了常压（0 GPa）下元素锰（Mn）的结构、电子、磁性及电化物特性，重点关注其三种晶相：立方（α）-Mn（Ibar43m，编号 217）、立方（β）-Mn（P4₁₃₂，编号 213）以及六方（hex）-Mn（P6₃/mmc，编号 194）。我们的计算表明，这三种相中都存在显著的间隙电子特征，并伴随自旋选择性的电子局域函数（ELF），从而将元素 Mn 确立为一种非范德华电化物体系。Bader 电荷分析表明，从 Mn 主体骨架向间隙阴离子电子（IAE）区域发生了显著的电子重分布，在 α-Mn、β-Mn 和 hex-Mn 中，每个间隙电子池的有效电荷转移分别约为 -1.645e、-1.477e 和 -1.083e。电子态密度进一步支持了这种电化物特征，因为与 IAE 相关的态在费米能级 E_F 附近具有有限贡献，并与 Mn 来源的态共存，表明它们直接参与了低能电子结构。因此，ELF、有效电荷转移以及费米能级处 IAE 导致的电子占据情况，共同为元素 Mn 中存在间隙阴离子电子提供了一致证据。据我们所知，这项工作首次在常压下系统识别出元素 Mn 的自旋选择性电化物特征，并突出了利用其间隙电子态实现非常规电子与磁性功能的可能性。

articles.title: Gate-tunable electronic properties of epitaxial Bi (111) films using a printable hexagonal boron nitride ionogel
articles.title_zh: 利用可印刷六方氮化硼离子凝胶调控外延 Bi(111) 薄膜的栅控电子性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving effective electrostatic control of carrier transport in semimetals remains challenging due to strong screening and multiband effects. We report efficient low voltage top gated control of electronic transport in epitaxial Bi (111) thin films grown on GaAs (111) substrates using a printable hexagonal boron nitride ionogel. Magnetotransport measurements reveal pronounced nonlinear Hall conductivities arising from multiband electron and hole contributions. Remarkably, the application of a small gate voltage (less than 0.4 V in magnitude) leads to a systematic evolution of the low field Hall conductivity slope and the electron-hole compensation point. The response to gate voltage depends upon thickness and temperature. The observed behavior cannot be explained by a conventional Fermi level shift with rigid bands and instead indicates a non rigid band response associated with multiband effects and a gat tunable Rashba spin orbit coupling. Our results establish printable ionogel gating as a powerful approach to tune multiband transport in topological semimetals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种可印刷的六方氮化硼离子凝胶，用于对外延 Bi(111) 薄膜进行低电压顶部栅控。结果表明，该方法能够有效调节多带电子输运、霍尔电导与电子-空穴补偿点，并暗示存在非刚性能带响应与栅控 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合。
authors: Jagannath Jena, Heather E. Kurtz, Siddhesh Ambhire, Justin S. Wood, Fateme Mahdikhany, Junyi Yang, Eugene Ark, Vinod K. Sangwan, J. Samuel Jiang, Steven S. -L. Zhang, Mark C. Hersam, Anand Bhattacharya
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于强屏蔽和多带效应，在半金属中实现对载流子输运的有效静电控制仍然具有挑战。我们报道了一种高效的低电压顶部栅控方法，利用可印刷的六方氮化硼离子凝胶，对在 GaAs(111) 衬底上生长的外延 Bi(111) 薄膜中的电子输运进行调控。磁输运测量揭示出源于多带电子和空穴贡献的显著非线性霍尔电导。值得注意的是，施加幅值很小的栅压（绝对值小于 0.4 V）会使低场霍尔电导斜率和电子-空穴补偿点系统性演化。对栅压的响应依赖于薄膜厚度和温度。观察到的行为无法用刚性能带框架下的传统费米能级位移来解释，而是表明存在与多带效应及可栅控 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合相关的非刚性能带响应。我们的结果确立了可印刷离子凝胶栅控作为调节拓扑半金属中多带输运的有力方法。

articles.title: All-electrical Coherent Control of a Single Rare-earth Spin Qubit
articles.title_zh: 单个稀土自旋量子比特的全电学相干操控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrical control of single spin qubits is a major frontier for nanoscale, high-speed, and scalable quantum devices. Yet, extending it to highly shielded rare-earth 4f electrons remains an experimental challenge across solid-state platforms. Here we demonstrate all-electrical coherent control of a single Er electron spin, which is exchange-coupled to a nearby Ti atom. Scanning tunneling microscopy-based electron spin resonance with three-dimensional magnetic-field control enables comprehensive mapping of the resonance and Rabi frequencies, revealing pronounced anisotropies in both the Er g-tensor and the Er-Ti exchange interaction. The electrical modulation of the anisotropic Er-Ti coupling results in an efficient drive of the Er spin, allowing us to achieve near-gigahertz Rabi frequencies - a ten-fold improvement over the present record for rare-earth spin qubits. By establishing anisotropic exchange as a general resource for electrically accessing shielded rare-earth spins, our results open a new route to ultrafast and local control of rare-earth spins in solid-state quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了对单个 Er 稀土电子自旋量子比特的全电学相干操控，并利用其与邻近 Ti 原子的交换耦合实现高效驱动。扫描隧道显微镜辅助的电子自旋共振测量揭示了显著的各向异性与近千兆赫兹 Rabi 频率，表明各向异性交换可作为电学访问受屏蔽稀土自旋的关键资源。
authors: Yaowu Liu, Dasom Choi, Stefano Reale, Jeongmin Oh, Seorhin Choi, Lei Fang, We-hyo Soe, Arzhang Ardavan, Andreas J. Heinrich, Soo-hyon Phark, Fabio Donati
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单自旋量子比特的电学控制是纳米尺度、高速和可扩展量子器件的一项重要前沿。然而，将这种控制扩展到受高度屏蔽的稀土 4f 电子上，在各种固态平台中仍然是一个实验挑战。在这里，我们展示了对单个 Er 电子自旋的全电学相干操控，该自旋与邻近的 Ti 原子通过交换作用耦合。基于扫描隧道显微镜的电子自旋共振，并结合三维磁场控制，使我们能够对共振频率和 Rabi 频率进行全面映射，揭示出 Er 的 g 张量以及 Er-Ti 交换相互作用都具有显著各向异性。Er-Ti 各向异性交换的电学调制导致对 Er 自旋的高效驱动，使我们实现了接近千兆赫兹的 Rabi 频率——比当前稀土自旋量子比特的记录提高了十倍。通过证明各向异性交换是电学访问受屏蔽稀土自旋的一种普适资源，我们的结果为在固态量子器件中对稀土自旋实现超快、局域控制开辟了新的途径。

articles.title: Reactive polar mesogenic self-assembly approach enables domain-programmable polymer ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 反应性极性介晶自组装策略实现可域编程的聚合物铁电体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric polymers combine switchable polarization with the processability of soft materials, but their development has been dominated by poly(vinylidene fluoride) and related fluoropolymers, whose crystalline polar phases restrict mechanical compliance and domain design with spatial precision. Here we establish a generic design principle for creating intrinsically flexible ferroelectric liquid-crystal polymers through reactive polar mesogenic self-assembly. The approach creates polyfluoroalkyl-free polymer films in which robust ferroelectric order arises from liquid-crystalline molecular organization rather than crystalline phase formation. By transferring ferroelectric order from fluid mesogenic states into polymer networks, the resulting materials combine mechanical adaptability with programmable polar architectures. Especially, the photoalignment technology enables these polar states to be organized into pixelated domain architectures. This work establishes a design space towards soft ferroelectric polymers that integrate molecularly programmed polar order, mechanical tunability and environmentally conscious chemistry, expanding the design space of adaptive materials for flexible electronics, wearable systems and soft robotics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种通用设计原则，通过反应性极性介晶自组装制备本征柔性的铁电液晶聚合物。该方法构建了不含全氟烷基的聚合物薄膜，其中稳健的铁电有序并非来源于晶相形成，而是来自液晶分子有序。借助光取向技术，这些极性状态还能被组织成像素化的畴结构，为柔性电子、可穿戴系统和软体机器人中的软铁电材料开辟了新的设计空间。
authors: Fan Ye, Minghui Deng, Yuyang Zheng, Xiujuan Liu, Xiuhu Zhao, Haowei Jiang, Yanyun Hou, Bingyu Zou, Neng-Ang Peng, Shuo Zhao, Kutay Sağdiç, Danqing Liu, Yang Shen, Yan-Qing Lu, Satoshi Aya, Mingjun Huang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电聚合物将可切换极化与软材料的可加工性相结合，但其发展长期由聚偏二氟乙烯及相关含氟聚合物主导，而这些材料的晶体极性相限制了机械顺应性以及具有空间精度的畴设计。这里，我们通过反应性极性介晶自组装，建立了一种用于构建本征柔性铁电液晶聚合物的通用设计原则。该方法制备出不含全氟烷基的聚合物薄膜，其中稳健的铁电有序来源于液晶分子组织，而非晶相形成。通过将铁电有序从流动态介晶态转移到聚合物网络中，所得材料兼具机械适应性与可编程极性结构。尤其是，光取向技术使这些极性状态能够被组织成像素化的畴结构。本工作为软铁电聚合物建立了一个设计空间，使其集分子编程的极性有序、机械可调性以及环境友好化学于一体，拓展了柔性电子、可穿戴系统和软体机器人等自适应材料的设计边界。

articles.title: Predicting large-supercell defect formation energies from machine-learning charge density models trained on small supercells
articles.title_zh: 基于训练于小超胞的机器学习电荷密度模型预测大超胞缺陷形成能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07997v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles defect calculations are often limited by the cost of the large supercells required to suppress image interactions. Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) provide another alternative, but training defect MLIPs typically requires thousands of structures and weeks of data generation. Since charge density is the key to density-functional-theory (DFT), we propose a machine-learning charge density (MLCD) route for predicting defect formation energies with higher data efficiency. We optimize the training set by integrating small supercells of varying sizes for better extrapolation, allocating their proportions based on spatial charge-density analysis. With only 96 supercells containing 16--96 atoms as the dataset, MLCD accurately predicts the formation energies of four intrinsic defects in 360-atom supercells, with defect-wise mean absolute error below 0.05 eV. In contrast, MLIPs trained on the same dataset can err by more than 1 eV. These results show that charge-density learning enables more robust cross-size transfer than direct energy-force fitting and that mixed-size data design can substantially reduce the cost of defect prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 第一性原理缺陷计算常受限于抑制镜像相互作用所需的大超胞带来的高成本。本文提出以机器学习电荷密度（MLCD）为核心的路线，用更少数据预测缺陷形成能。仅用96个含16至96个原子的超胞训练后，模型即可准确预测360原子超胞中四种本征缺陷的形成能，平均绝对误差低于0.05 eV，优于同数据集训练的机器学习原子势。
authors: Junjie Zhou, Menglin Huang, Shiyou Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 第一性原理缺陷计算通常受限于抑制镜像相互作用所需的大超胞带来的成本。机器学习原子势（MLIP）提供了另一种替代方案，但训练缺陷MLIP通常需要数千个结构以及数周的数据生成时间。由于电荷密度是密度泛函理论（DFT）的关键，我们提出一种机器学习电荷密度（MLCD）路径，用于以更高的数据效率预测缺陷形成能。我们通过整合不同尺寸的小超胞来优化训练集，以获得更好的外推能力，并根据空间电荷密度分析分配这些超胞的比例。仅使用96个包含16至96个原子的超胞作为数据集，MLCD就能准确预测360原子超胞中四种本征缺陷的形成能，按缺陷分别计算的平均绝对误差低于0.05 eV。相比之下，在同一数据集上训练的MLIP误差可超过1 eV。这些结果表明，电荷密度学习相较于直接的能量-力拟合，能够实现更稳健的跨尺度迁移，而混合尺寸数据设计可以显著降低缺陷预测成本。

articles.title: Local coordination and migration-network topology shape Li-ion transport and delithiation in the low-energy ε-LiMnO₂ polymorph
articles.title_zh: 低能ε-LiMnO₂多晶型中的局域配位与迁移网络拓扑塑造锂离子输运和脱锂行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In rocksalt-derived oxide cathodes, the local Li-migration environment around an O4 tetrahedral intermediate is commonly classified by the number of face-sharing transition-metal (TM) neighbors. In LiMnO2, the TM species is Mn, and 0-TM denotes the absence of face-sharing Mn neighbors. However, migration and delithiation may also depend on higher-shell coordination and tetrahedral connectivity. Using the recently reported low-energy epsilon-LiMnO2 polymorph as a model, we examine these factors through bond-valence site-energy and bond-valence pathway analyses combined with first-principles calculations. The resulting migration maps and tetrahedral statistics reveal distinct topologies and dimensionalities across four LiMnO2 polymorphs. Although the epsilon phase and the lithiated-spinel phase Li2Mn2O4 (hereafter spinel) have identical tetrahedral-type fractions, their 0-TM motifs form quasi-one-dimensional chains and a three-dimensional network, respectively. Climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations further distinguish the two structures: epsilon-phase barriers are 0.35-0.36 eV, compared with 0.41-0.53 eV in spinel, a difference that may be associated with distinct next-nearest corner-sharing shells. Ab initio molecular dynamics yields an apparent activation energy of 0.32 eV, while direction-resolved mean-squared displacements show preferential Li migration along c, supporting low-barrier quasi-one-dimensional diffusion. Delithiation calculations show that differences in 0-TM connectivity and Li-Li separation between the epsilon phase and spinel are associated with Li-site evolution and calculated voltage steps, suggesting that motif connectivity may influence voltage response. These results link the local environments and spatial connectivity of 0-TM motifs to Li migration and delithiation, providing insights into the design of metastable cathode structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者以低能ε-LiMnO₂多晶型为模型，结合键价位点能和键价路径分析以及第一性原理计算，研究了局域配位与迁移网络拓扑对锂扩散和脱锂的影响。结果表明，ε相与尖晶石型Li2Mn2O4虽然具有相同的0-TM四面体类型比例，但其迁移连通性和扩散维度不同，导致能垒与电压响应存在差异。研究揭示了0-TM图案的空间连接方式与锂迁移、脱锂行为之间的关联，为亚稳态正极结构设计提供了启示。
authors: Fukuan Wang, Busheng Wang, Yong Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在岩盐衍生氧化物正极中，围绕O4四面体中间态的局域锂迁移环境通常按与其面共享的过渡金属（TM）邻居数目来分类。在LiMnO2中，TM元素是Mn，而0-TM表示不存在面共享的Mn邻居。然而，迁移和脱锂过程也可能依赖于更高层级的配位和四面体连通性。以最近报道的低能ε-LiMnO2多晶型为模型，我们通过键价位点能和键价路径分析并结合第一性原理计算，对这些因素进行了研究。所得迁移图和四面体统计揭示了四种LiMnO2多晶型之间不同的拓扑和维度特征。尽管ε相和嵌锂尖晶石相Li2Mn2O4（下文简称尖晶石）具有相同的四面体类型比例，但它们的0-TM基元分别形成准一维链和三维网络。爬山式弹性带计算进一步区分了这两种结构：ε相势垒为0.35–0.36 eV，而尖晶石中为0.41–0.53 eV，这一差异可能与不同的次近邻角共享壳层有关。第一性原理分子动力学给出的表观活化能为0.32 eV，而按方向分辨的均方位移显示Li沿c方向的迁移更为优先，支持了低势垒的准一维扩散。脱锂计算表明，ε相与尖晶石之间在0-TM连通性和Li-Li间距上的差异与Li位点演化及计算得到的电压台阶有关，这提示基元连通性可能影响电压响应。上述结果将0-TM基元的局域环境及其空间连通性与Li迁移和脱锂联系起来，为亚稳态正极结构设计提供了新的认识。

articles.title: Multimodal deep learning framework to predict strain localization of Mg/LPSO two-phase alloys
articles.title_zh: 用于预测Mg/LPSO双相合金应变局域化的多模态深度学习框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study proposes a method for predicting three-dimensional (3D) local strain distribution under compressive deformation of as-cast Mg/LPSO two-phase alloys from 3D microstructure images. The 3D local strain distribution was obtained by applying the digital volume correlation method to X-ray CT images before and after compression tests. Three microstructure descriptors were extracted from the 3D microstructure images around each strain measurement point: volume fractions of the phases, persistent diagrams that can express the connectivity of the phases, and two-phase spatial correlation that can express the spatial distribution of the phases. A deep learning model was then constructed to predict local strain from the three microstructure descriptors. Since two types of descriptors were used in this study, numerical data and image data, multimodal deep learning was employed to make predictions. Thus, the use of multiple microstructure descriptors enabled predictions to be made with higher accuracy than when predictions were made from a single descriptor. Feature importance of the descriptors was assessed through correlation analysis and occlusion sensitivity analysis. The results revealed that high strain tended to occur in the region where the hard phase, LPSO phase, had a large elongated phase oriented at a 45deg direction to the loading direction. This result is consistent with other previous studies and indicates that the proposed method is effective in elucidating the relationship between the microstructure and the deformation behavior of the material.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于三维显微组织图像预测铸态Mg/LPSO双相合金压缩变形中三维局部应变分布的方法。研究从相体积分数、持久图以及两相空间相关性三类特征出发，采用多模态深度学习建立预测模型。结果表明，利用多种显微组织描述符比单一描述符具有更高预测精度，并揭示了硬相LPSO相中沿加载方向45度取向的细长结构更易对应高应变区域。
authors: Daiki Kuriki, Fabien Briffod, Takayuki Shiraiwa, Manabu Enoki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究提出一种方法，用于根据三维显微组织图像预测铸态Mg/LPSO双相合金在压缩变形下的三维局部应变分布。三维局部应变分布是通过对压缩试验前后X射线CT图像应用数字体相关方法获得的。围绕每个应变测量点，从三维显微组织图像中提取了三种显微组织描述符：相体积分数、可表征相连通性的持久图，以及可表征相空间分布的两相空间相关性。随后构建了一个深度学习模型，以这三种显微组织描述符预测局部应变。由于本研究使用了两类描述符，即数值数据和图像数据，因此采用了多模态深度学习进行预测。由此，使用多个显微组织描述符所得到的预测精度高于仅使用单一描述符时的结果。通过相关性分析和遮挡敏感性分析评估了这些描述符的特征重要性。结果表明，高应变往往出现在硬相LPSO相中具有较大细长相、且其取向与加载方向成45度的区域。这一结果与此前其他研究一致，表明所提出的方法能够有效阐明显微组织与材料变形行为之间的关系。

articles.title: Effects of high-pressure synthesis on phase formation and superconducting properties of PrFeAsO1-xFx
articles.title_zh: 高压合成对PrFeAsO1-xFx的相形成与超导性能的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent reports of enhanced superconducting performance in several families of iron-based superconductors (IBS) processed by high-pressure (HP) synthesis, we investigate the influence of high gas pressure and high-temperature synthesis (HP-HTS) process on the structural, microstructural, electrical transport, and magnetic properties of Pr-based oxypnictide PrFeAsO1-xFx (Pr1111) using the processing conditions of 0.5 GPa for 1 h previously optimized for other IBS families. Representative underdoped (x = 0.2), optimal doped (x = 0.3), and overdoped (x = 0.5) compositions from the ambient-pressure electronic phase diagram of Pr1111 are selected to evaluate its composition-dependent effects of HP-HTS. The results demonstrate that HP-HTS enhances fluorine incorporation, improves phase formation, and produces a denser microstructure with improved grain connectivity in the underdoped and optimal doped compositions. Magnetic measurements reveal increased in the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) of ~1 K for x = 0.2 and ~6 K for x = 0.3, whereas only a marginal improvement in the critical current density is observed. Electrical resistivity measurements of the underdoped composition show a slight increase in Tc accompanied by a broader resistive transition, indicating residual structural inhomogeneity. In contrast, the overdoped composition exhibits increased impurity phase segregation, accompanied by suppression of superconductivity. These results demonstrate that the effectiveness of HP-HTS in Pr1111 is strongly composition dependent and governed by the interplay among fluorine incorporation, phase stability, and microstructural evolution, highlighting the need for further optimization of the HP-HTS processing conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了0.5 GPa高气压高温合成对Pr基氧砷化物PrFeAsO1-xFx的结构、微结构、电输运和磁学性质的影响。结果表明，高压高温处理可增强氟掺入、改善相形成并提高致密性与晶粒连接性，但其效果显著依赖组分。对于欠掺杂和最优掺杂样品，超导转变温度分别提高约1 K和6 K，而过掺杂样品则因杂相分离加剧而表现出超导被抑制。
authors: Priya Singh, Konrad Kwatek, Tatiana Zajarniuk, Tomasz Cetner, Jan Mizeracki, Shiv J. Singh
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受近期若干采用高压（HP）合成处理的铁基超导体（IBS）家族中超导性能增强报道的启发，我们采用先前针对其他IBS家族优化的0.5 GPa、1 h处理条件，研究了高气压高温合成（HP-HTS）过程对Pr基氧砷化物PrFeAsO1-xFx（Pr1111）的结构、微结构、电输运和磁学性质的影响。我们从Pr1111在常压下的电子相图中选取了具有代表性的欠掺杂（x = 0.2）、最优掺杂（x = 0.3）和过掺杂（x = 0.5）组成，以评估HP-HTS对组成依赖性的影响。结果表明，HP-HTS增强了氟的掺入，改善了相形成，并在欠掺杂和最优掺杂组分中产生了更致密、晶粒连通性更好的微结构。磁性测量显示，x = 0.2时超导转变温度Tc提高约1 K，x = 0.3时提高约6 K，而临界电流密度仅观察到轻微改善。欠掺杂组分的电阻率测量显示Tc略有升高，但电阻转变更宽，表明仍存在残余的结构不均匀性。相比之下，过掺杂组分表现出更明显的杂相分离，并伴随超导性的抑制。这些结果表明，HP-HTS在Pr1111中的有效性强烈依赖于组分，并受氟掺入、相稳定性和微结构演化之间相互作用的支配，凸显了进一步优化HP-HTS工艺条件的必要性。

articles.title: Machine Learning Framework for Magnetic Candidate Discovery in Cerium-Based Compounds
articles.title_zh: 铈基化合物磁性候选体发现的机器学习框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cerium (Ce), the most abundant lanthanide, offers significant potential for addressing shortages in high-performance magnetic materials, particularly through the discovery of compounds suitable for gap magnets. However, predicting Ce-based ferromagnets with uniaxial magnetic anisotropy remains challenging because their magnetic behavior depends strongly on crystal structure, exchange geometry, and electronic interactions. Here, we present a physics-guided computational framework to screen known Ce-based crystal structures and identify promising Ising ferromagnets for future synthesis. A Random Forest classifier uses seven structural and SOAP descriptors, including unit-cell volume, density, atomic sites, space group, atomic density, Ce SOAP overlap, and transition-metal SOAP overlap, to prioritize candidate compounds. Selected crystallographic structures are then analyzed using Ising-model Monte Carlo simulations to characterize phase behavior and critical properties. Critical exponents extracted from simulated phase transitions provide quantitative insight into magnetic regimes and anisotropy-related effects. We further employ autoencoders trained on affinity-based features from simulated spin configurations to identify latent signatures of phase evolution and transition behavior. Together, this framework integrates structural screening, statistical-mechanical simulation, and machine learning to accelerate the identification of promising Ce-based magnetic materials and provide candidates for experimental synthesis and validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个物理引导的计算框架，用于筛选已知铈基晶体结构并识别具有潜在应用前景的伊辛铁磁体。该框架结合随机森林分类、Ising模型蒙特卡洛模拟以及基于自编码器的特征学习，从结构、统计力学与机器学习三个层面加速磁性材料发现。研究表明，这种方法可为实验合成与验证提供有针对性的候选材料。
authors: Joshua A. Torres, Yaser M. Banad, Benjamin O. Tayo, Tej Nath Lamichhane
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铈（Ce）是最丰富的镧系元素，具有缓解高性能磁性材料短缺的巨大潜力，尤其可通过发现适用于间隙磁体的化合物来实现。然而，预测具有单轴磁各向异性的铈基铁磁体仍然具有挑战性，因为其磁行为强烈依赖于晶体结构、交换几何和电子相互作用。在此，我们提出一个由物理引导的计算框架，用于筛选已知的铈基晶体结构并识别未来合成中有前景的伊辛铁磁体。随机森林分类器使用七个结构和SOAP描述符，包括晶胞体积、密度、原子位点、空间群、原子密度、Ce的SOAP重叠以及过渡金属的SOAP重叠，对候选化合物进行优先排序。随后，对选定的晶体结构进行Ising模型蒙特卡洛模拟，以表征其相行为和临界性质。由模拟相变中提取的临界指数为磁性区间和与各向异性相关的效应提供了定量认识。我们进一步采用在基于亲和度特征的自旋构型模拟数据上训练的自编码器，识别相演化和转变行为的潜在特征。总体而言，该框架整合了结构筛选、统计力学模拟和机器学习，可加速识别有前景的铈基磁性材料，并为实验合成与验证提供候选对象。
articles.focus_summary: 本文构建了一个面向铈基化合物的机器学习框架，用于筛选潜在磁性候选材料。作者结合随机森林、结构描述符与 Ising 模型蒙特卡洛模拟，评估了候选体系的磁序和临界行为。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在磁性材料、高通量筛选、机器学习辅助材料发现以及蒙特卡洛模拟方面高度相关。其工作思路可直接借鉴到稀土磁体、二维磁体和其他功能磁材料的候选筛选。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注其特征选择和物理约束如何提升筛选准确率，并考虑与第一性原理交换参数提取结合。后续可扩展到含自旋轨道耦合、反铁磁和多亚晶格磁性体系的预测。

articles.title: Momentum-Selective Electron and Spin Dynamics under Ultrafast Photoexcitation
articles.title_zh: 超快光激发下的动量选择性电子与自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in time-resolved spectroscopies have enabled direct access to the momentum-selective nonequilibrium dynamics of correlated quantum materials, revealing a strongly momentum-dependent response of electrons and collective excitations. Interpreting these observations requires a real-time theoretical framework that consistently captures the interplay between strong local electronic correlations and nonlocal collective fluctuations, a capability that remains beyond state-of-the-art nonequilibrium approaches. Using a recently developed real-time many-body framework, we resolve the momentum-selective ultrafast dynamics of a photoexcited correlated electron system. We predict a transient nodal-antinodal anisotropy in electronic heating, providing a microscopic explanation for the momentum-dependent response debated in time-resolved photoemission and Raman experiments, and identify the nonthermal spectral-weight transfer responsible for the transient antinodal in-gap states observed in ultrafast photoemission. We further uncover a momentum-selective magnetic response, in which antiferromagnetic fluctuations undergo a strongly nonthermal, quench-like excitation far above the electronic temperature while preserving their correlation length, before relaxing through a momentum-space magnon cascade toward lower-momentum modes. Finally, by tracking the real-time local spin susceptibility, we identify a dynamical, experimentally accessible signature of local-moment formation and its photoinduced melting. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of ultrafast electronic and magnetic dynamics, providing a framework for interpreting momentum-resolved pump-probe experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于实时多体理论，研究了光激发关联电子体系中的动量选择性超快动力学。结果预测了电子加热中的节点-反节点各向异性以及反铁磁涨落的非热、准淬火式响应，并给出了瞬态反节点能隙内态和局域自旋磁化率演化的微观图像。该工作为解释动量分辨泵浦-探测实验提供了统一的理论框架。
authors: Gusein Bedirkhanov, Nagamalleswararao Dasari, Alexander I. Lichtenstein, Evgeny A. Stepanov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期时间分辨光谱技术的进展，使人们能够直接接触关联量子材料中动量选择性的非平衡动力学，揭示出电子与集体激发对动量具有强烈依赖性的响应。要解释这些观测，需要一个实时理论框架，能够一致地捕捉强局域电子关联与非局域集体涨落之间的相互作用，而这仍超出现有最先进非平衡方法的能力。我们使用一种最近发展的实时多体框架，解析了一个被光激发的关联电子系统的动量选择性超快动力学。我们预测到电子加热中存在瞬态的节点-反节点各向异性，为时间分辨光电子和拉曼实验中所讨论的动量依赖响应提供了微观解释，并识别出导致超快光电子实验中观测到的瞬态反节点能隙内态的非热谱权重转移。我们还发现一种动量选择性的磁响应，其中反铁磁涨落经历了强烈的非热、类淬火激发，其能量远高于电子温度，同时保持其关联长度不变，之后通过动量空间中的磁振子级联向更低动量模式弛豫。最后，通过跟踪实时局域自旋磁化率，我们识别出局域磁矩形成及其光致消融的一个动态且可实验探测的特征信号。我们的结果建立了超快电子与磁动力学的统一微观图像，为解释动量分辨泵浦-探测实验提供了理论框架。

articles.title: Composite-State Localization Beyond the External Landscape in Non-Hermitian Quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 非厄米准晶中超越外部势景观的复合态局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A composite excitation need not inherit the localization behavior of its constituents. We show that an interacting non-Hermitian quasiperiodic ladder realizes a controllable and reversible localization inversion between composite and unbound excitations, where internal configuration, rather than only the external potential, becomes a control parameter for localization. Opposite complex potentials on the two legs cancel at first order for a same-rung pair but act directly on separated particles, allowing extended composite states to persist while the unpaired sector becomes localized. A strong-coupling theory identifies the composite state as an emergent weakly modulated non-Hermitian quasicrystal generated by virtual unpaired configurations. Breaking the potential antisymmetry restores a direct modulation of the composite band and reverses the localization hierarchy. Engineering configuration-space pathways further stabilizes an extended composite band embedded within a localized continuum, the inverse of the conventional bound-state-in-the-continuum scenario. Our results establish internal configuration as a reversible control parameter for localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在相互作用的非厄米准周期梯子系统中，复合激发与非束缚激发之间可以发生可控且可逆的局域化反转。局域化不再仅由外部势决定，而是受内部构型调控：同一横档上的成对粒子可使一阶势作用相互抵消，而分离粒子则直接受势调制。通过调控构型空间路径，还可稳定一个嵌入局域连续谱中的延展复合带，形成与传统束缚态嵌入连续谱相反的情形。
authors: Tian Zhou, Xue-Bin Wang, Zhongmin Yang, Tao Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复合激发并不一定继承其组分的局域化行为。我们表明，一个相互作用的非厄米准周期梯子可以实现复合激发与非束缚激发之间可控且可逆的局域化反转，在这里，内部构型而不仅仅是外部势，成为局域化的控制参数。两条腿上相反的复势在一对位于同一横档上的粒子上于一阶相互抵消，但会直接作用于分离的粒子，从而允许延展的复合态保持存在，而未成对粒子部门则变得局域化。强耦合理论将该复合态描述为一个由虚拟未成对构型生成的、弱调制的非厄米准晶新兴体。打破势的反对称性会恢复对复合带的直接调制，并使局域化层级反转。通过构型空间通道工程，还可稳定一个嵌入局域连续谱中的延展复合带，这与传统的连续谱中束缚态情形相反。我们的结果确立了内部构型作为局域化可逆控制参数的作用。

articles.title: Cubic-Equivariant Neural Density Functional Theory for Three-Dimensional Lattice Fluids
articles.title_zh: 三维晶格流体的立方群等变神经密度泛函理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a neural classical density functional that acts directly on unrestricted three-dimensional density profiles. As a computationally tractable test bed, we consider parallel hard cubes of side length three on a simple cubic lattice. A fully convolutional network learns the one-body direct-correlation functional c⁽¹⁾[ρ] from data obtained with grand-canonical Monte Carlo simulations in randomized external potentials. Complete profiles are used during both training and inference; a stochastic Bernoulli mask on the output sites makes full-profile training effective without explicitly extracting and storing overlapping local density windows. Averaging the first-layer kernels over all 48 rotations and reflections of the cubic point group additionally imposes exact cubic equivariance without data augmentation. We compare the learned functional with independent simulation data and with the lattice fundamental-measure functional of Lafuente and Cuesta. The neural functional markedly improves the homogeneous equation of state and the density profile at a planar hard wall. For the anisotropic pair distribution around a fixed particle, both functionals reproduce the principal packing shells, with their relative accuracy depending on crystallographic direction. These results demonstrate neural density-functional calculations on complete three-dimensional profiles while also identifying accurate full-dimensional training data, thermodynamic consistency, and structural correlations as the central challenges for extensions to continuum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个直接作用于无约束三维密度分布的神经经典密度泛函，并以简单立方晶格上的平行硬立方体作为测试体系。通过在随机外势下的巨正则蒙特卡洛数据训练，并结合立方点群48种旋转与反射的精确等变约束，模型在整体密度分布、平板硬壁附近密度剖面以及固定粒子周围的各向异性配分布上均表现出良好性能。研究表明，完整三维密度数据、热力学一致性和结构相关性的准确刻画是将神经密度泛函推广到连续流体的关键挑战。
authors: Jens Weimar, Martin Oettel, Alessandro Simon
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一个神经经典密度泛函，它可直接作用于不受限制的三维密度分布。作为一个在计算上可处理的测试平台，我们考虑了简单立方晶格上的边长为3的平行硬立方体。一个全卷积网络从在随机外势中进行的巨正则蒙特卡洛模拟数据中学习一体直接关联泛函 c⁽¹⁾[ρ]。训练和推断阶段都使用完整的密度分布；输出站点上的随机伯努利掩膜使得无需显式提取和存储重叠的局域密度窗口，也能有效进行全剖面训练。对第一层卷积核在立方点群的全部48种旋转与反射操作上取平均，还额外施加了精确的立方等变性，而无需数据增强。我们将所学泛函与独立模拟数据以及Lafuente和Cuesta的晶格基本测度泛函进行了比较。神经泛函显著改善了均匀态状态方程以及平面硬壁附近的密度剖面。对于固定粒子周围的各向异性配对分布，两种泛函都能再现主要的堆积壳层，但其相对精度取决于晶体学方向。这些结果展示了基于完整三维剖面的神经密度泛函计算，同时也指出：高质量的全维训练数据、热力学一致性和结构相关性，是将其扩展到连续流体时面临的核心挑战。

articles.title: Denoising Diffusion Monte Carlo Electron Densities with Physically Informed Variance Stabilization: From Fourier Filters to 3D UNETs
articles.title_zh: 采用物理启发的方差稳定化对扩散蒙特卡洛电子密度进行去噪：从傅里叶滤波到三维UNET
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Obtaining accurate electron densities is important for the fundamental description of molecular and condensed matter systems, as well as for the development of next-generation density functionals. Diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC), in particular, is known to produce benchmark-quality data; however, the predicted real-space electron densities contain substantial amounts of statistical noise. In this work, we study denoising approaches for DMC densities, judged on the basis of the information-theoretic Jensen-Shannon divergence. The denoising is facilitated by an approximate heteroscedastic to homoscedastic transformation leveraging the density functional theory density as a physical prior. We systematically compare a range of denoising techniques-including Fourier transform, regression, and 3D UNETs-on materials showing a wide range of density variations: carbon diamond, blue phosphorus, and rutile VO2. Our results indicate that simple flattened machine learning models and 2D image-based models introduce line artifacts and struggle to capture the full spatial correlation. In contrast, when using variance stabilization, regression methods outperform all others in both the high and low- noise limits across all materials considered. The best denoisers reduce the required cost of density-generating DMC simulations by 10-100x, providing a promising route forward for application in noise-sensitive tasks such as DFT functional inversion.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确的电子密度对分子和凝聚态体系的基础描述以及新一代密度泛函的发展都十分重要。本文针对扩散蒙特卡洛电子密度的统计噪声，比较了傅里叶变换、回归和三维UNET等多种去噪方法，并以Jensen-Shannon散度为评价标准。结果显示，在引入基于密度泛函理论密度的方差稳定化后，回归方法在高噪声与低噪声条件下均优于其他方法，可将生成高质量密度所需的DMC成本降低10到100倍。
authors: Kenneth O. Berard, Brenda Rubenstein, Jaron T. Krogel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 获得准确的电子密度对于分子和凝聚态体系的基础描述以及下一代密度泛函的发展都十分重要。尤其是扩散蒙特卡洛（DMC）已知能够产生基准质量的数据；然而，其预测的实空间电子密度含有大量统计噪声。本文研究了针对DMC密度的去噪方法，并以信息论中的Jensen-Shannon散度作为判据。去噪过程通过利用密度泛函理论（DFT）密度作为物理先验、实现近似的异方差到同方差变换而得到促进。我们系统比较了多种去噪技术——包括傅里叶变换、回归和三维UNET——在具有广泛密度变化范围的材料上的表现：金刚石碳、蓝磷和金红石相VO2。结果表明，简单的扁平化机器学习模型和基于二维图像的模型会引入线状伪影，并且难以捕捉完整的空间相关性。相比之下，在使用方差稳定化之后，回归方法在所考察的所有材料中，无论在高噪声极限还是低噪声极限下，均优于其他方法。表现最好的去噪器可将生成密度所需的DMC模拟成本降低10至100倍，这为诸如DFT泛函反演等对噪声敏感的任务提供了一条很有前景的路径。

articles.title: Out-of-equilibrium inhomogeneous XX chains: Exact results and the hydrodynamic limit
articles.title_zh: 非平衡非均匀XX链：精确结果与流体力学极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08205v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the out-of-equilibrium dynamics in the XX chain with step-like magnetic field, which maps to an inhomogeneous tight-binding chain after Jordan-Wigner transformation. We obtain exact analytic expressions for the fermionic two-point correlation function after a quantum quench from several initial product states, both homogeneous and inhomogeneous ones. This is achieved by using a combination of Fourier and Laplace transforms, which al low us to map the problem to a standard Riemann-Hilbert problem on the unit circle. For arbitrary positions and times the correlators are not expressed in terms of elementary functions. However, in the hydrodynamic limit x,y,t→infty with fixed ratios, we provide explicit formulas that depend only on the effective transmission coefficient across the origin. We benchmark our analytic predictions against exact numerical simulations and find excellent agreement in the hydrodynamic limit, apart from finite-time corrections.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有阶跃式磁场的XX链在量子猝灭后的非平衡动力学，该模型经Jordan-Wigner变换后可映射为非均匀紧束缚链。作者给出了从多种均匀和非均匀初态出发的费米二点关联函数的精确解析表达，并在流体力学极限下得到仅依赖于原点有效透射系数的显式公式。数值结果验证了这些解析预测在长时长尺度极限下的准确性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有阶跃式磁场的XX链中的非平衡动力学，该模型经过Jordan-Wigner变换后可映射为一条非均匀紧束缚链。我们对从若干初始乘积态（包括均匀和非均匀态）出发，在量子猝灭后费米子二点关联函数给出了精确的解析表达式。这是通过傅里叶变换与拉普拉斯变换相结合实现的，这使我们能够将问题映射为单位圆上的标准Riemann-Hilbert问题。对于任意位置和时间，关联函数无法用初等函数表示。然而，在流体力学极限 x,y,t→∞ 且保持比值固定时，我们给出了仅依赖于穿过原点的有效透射系数的显式公式。我们将解析预测与精确数值模拟进行了对比，发现除有限时间修正外，在流体力学极限下二者符合得非常好。

articles.title: Quantum Formulation of Chiral Vortical Effect in Weyl Semi-metals
articles.title_zh: 手性涡旋效应在外尔半金属中的量子表述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The chiral vortical effect (CVE) is the generation of an axial current in a rotating Weyl fermion; its description is presently based on semiclassical frameworks. In this work, we develop a fully quantum formulation for CVE, solving the exact evolution of microscopic spinful wavefunctions, which enables a bottom-up quantitative test of semi-classical theories and postulated distributions fCVE in different reference frames. Notably, it shows that fCVE is over a ground-state-free Floquet spectrum, qualitatively distinct from a thermal equilibrium distribution (i.e., fermi form f_F), underscoring CVE as a non-equilibrium phenomenon, distinguished from other chiral transports. The f_F only approximately holds when three conditions are simultaneously fulfilled: (1) slow rotation ω R/v_Fłl 1, (2) high chemical potential μ/(hbar v_F R)gg 1, (3) isotropic symmetry, where R is the size, v_F is fermi velocity. In these conditions, the theory recovers established semiclassical results, including the current-response coefficients and the magnetization contribution; otherwise, it uncovers quantum phenomena such as ``void states", deviation from the semiclassical formula jCVE sim μ², a v_F-independent charge pumping. The theory is based on semimetals, providing more experimentally accessible detection than fundamental Weyl particles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对外尔半金属中的手性涡旋效应建立了完全量子的理论描述，直接求解含自旋微观波函数的精确演化。研究表明，该效应本质上是非平衡现象，只有在慢旋转、高化学势和各向同性等条件同时满足时，才可近似恢复半经典分布与已知结果。否则会出现诸如“空态”、与半经典公式不同的电流标度以及与费米速度无关的电荷泵浦等量子效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性涡旋效应（CVE）是旋转的外尔费米子中产生轴向电流的现象；目前对其描述主要基于半经典框架。在本工作中，我们为CVE建立了一个完全量子的表述，求解了含自旋微观波函数的精确演化，这使得能够自下而上地定量检验不同参考系下的半经典理论以及所假设的CVE分布 fCVE。值得注意的是，这表明 fCVE 是建立在无基态的Floquet谱之上的，这与热平衡分布（即费米形式 f_F）在性质上不同，强调了CVE作为一种非平衡现象，其区别于其他手性输运过程。只有当以下三个条件同时满足时，f_F 近似成立：（1）慢旋转 ω R/v_Fłl 1，（2）高化学势 μ/(hbar v_F R)gg 1，（3）各向同性对称性，其中 R 为尺寸，v_F 为费米速度。在这些条件下，该理论恢复了既有的半经典结果，包括电流响应系数和磁化贡献；否则，它会揭示诸如“空态”、偏离半经典公式 jCVE sim μ²、以及与 v_F 无关的电荷泵浦等量子现象。该理论建立在半金属体系之上，因此比基础外尔粒子更易于实验探测。

articles.title: Universality of PVDF-Li⁺ Ion Interface Chemistry in Lead-free Perovskite Energy Storage Devices
articles.title_zh: PVDF–Li⁺离子界面化学在无铅钙钛矿储能器件中的普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrode binders are conventionally regarded as inert structural components. Here, we show that in lead-free perovskite supercapacitors, the binder defines the optimal electrolyte composition. Across a factorial matrix of poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) loadings and LiTFSI concentrations in CsSnCl₃ electrodes, the capacitance optimum shifts systematically with binder content along a single linear relationship, described by the Interfacial Balance Rule (λ+θ=1), where λ and θ are the normalized lithium-supply and polymer contributions at the optimized interfacial state. The same relationship holds for hybrid MASnCl₃, showing that the optimum is governed by the polymer-electrolyte interface rather than the perovskite lattice chemistry. Simulations using a pre-trained MACE machine-learned interatomic potential show that PVDF adopts a planar configuration on CsSnCl₃ and simultaneously interacts with cationic and anionic sites. This configuration homogenizes lithium adsorption energetics, introduces fluorine-mediated coordination, and confines lithium to a two-dimensional interfacial region while preserving lateral mobility. Tuning polymer coverage through surface density and chain length reveals a finite interfacial lithium accommodation capacity that marks the onset of out-of-plane aggregation. The Interfacial Balance Rule provides a macroscopic descriptor of this finite interfacial resource, balancing polymer-mediated lithium stabilization against limited accommodation space. Binder loading is therefore an active design parameter for polymer-regulated energy-storage interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统上，电极粘结剂被视为惰性结构组分，但本工作表明，在无铅钙钛矿超级电容器中，粘结剂会决定最优电解质组成。作者发现，在CsSnCl₃电极中，PVDF含量与LiTFSI浓度共同决定电容最优点，并呈现单一线性关系，可由“界面平衡定则”描述。模拟结果显示，PVDF在CsSnCl₃表面采取平面构型并调控锂吸附，从而揭示聚合物-电解质界面是主导因素，而非钙钛矿晶格化学。
authors: Arun Kumar (Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India), Ayush Kumar Pandey (Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India), Ankur Yadav (Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India), Vishnu Saraswat (Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, SR University, Warangal, India), Shiladitya Sengupta (Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India), Abhishek Tewari (Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India, Mehta Family School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India), Monojit Bag (Department of Physics, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India, Centre for Nanotechnology, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee, India)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电极粘结剂通常被认为是惰性的结构组分。这里，我们表明，在无铅钙钛矿超级电容器中，粘结剂决定了最优电解质组成。通过对CsSnCl₃电极中聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF）负载量与LiTFSI浓度进行因子矩阵研究，我们发现电容最优点随粘结剂含量系统性移动，并沿着单一线性关系变化，该关系可由“界面平衡定则”（λ+θ=1）描述，其中λ和θ是在优化后的界面状态下归一化的锂供给贡献和聚合物贡献。相同关系也适用于杂化MASnCl₃，表明该最优点受聚合物-电解质界面支配，而非钙钛矿晶格化学。使用预训练的MACE机器学习原子间势进行的模拟显示，PVDF在CsSnCl₃上采取平面构型，并同时与阳离子位点和阴离子位点发生相互作用。该构型使锂吸附能更加均一，引入氟介导的配位作用，并将锂限制在二维界面区域内，同时保持侧向迁移能力。通过调节表面密度和链长来改变聚合物覆盖度，可以揭示有限的界面锂容纳容量，而这标志着面外聚集的开始。“界面平衡定则”为这一有限界面资源提供了宏观描述，在聚合物介导的锂稳定化与有限容纳空间之间取得平衡。因此，粘结剂负载量是聚合物调控储能界面的一个主动设计参数。
articles.focus_summary: 该文研究了无铅钙钛矿储能器件中 PVDF 绑定剂与 Li⁺ 界面化学的普适规律，指出最佳电容性能取决于聚合物-电解质界面而非钙钛矿晶格本身。作者还用预训练 MACE 势函数模拟了 PVDF 在表面的吸附构型和锂离子二维界面行为。
articles.focus_relation: 这与我们关注的能源材料、钙钛矿体系、界面电荷转移以及机器学习势的应用有一定关联，但核心问题更偏向电极粘结剂与器件化学。作为界面离子输运和 ML 势在储能中的应用案例具有参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可关注其如何用机器学习势描述聚合物-无机界面，以及锂离子在局域环境中的吸附与迁移机制。若继续深化，可将类似分析用于固态电解质、钙钛矿电池或二维电极界面的离子输运研究。

articles.title: Magnetoelastic coupling in stripe-domain states of yttrium iron garnet
articles.title_zh: 钇铁石榴石条纹畴态中的磁弹耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study magnetoelastic coupling in stripe-domain magnetic states of 3,μ m-thick YIG thin films grown on a GGG substrate. Broadband ferromagnetic resonance reveals low-frequency stripe-domain magnon branches modulated by a field-independent phonon comb with a frequency spacing of 3.5,MHz, matching the value predicted for confined thickness-shear modes of the GGG substrate. Analytical fitting yields coupling rates that vary between 0.33--0.54,MHz and cooperativities of order 10⁻¹, indicating that the system is in the weak-coupling regime without resolvable avoided-crossing gaps. Magnon-phonon mode-overlap calculations using finite-element simulations show that the weak coupling arises from phase and domain-sign cancellation: the local magnetoelastic coupling is sizable, but more than 99% of the coherent overlap cancels across the stripe texture. Fully coupled simulations further demonstrate phonon-mediated excitation of a remote YIG layer and show that efficient propagating-phonon generation requires spatially asymmetric magnon modes, establishing magnetic texture as a control parameter for magnon--phonon coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了生长在GGG衬底上的3 μm厚YIG薄膜条纹畴磁态中的磁弹耦合。宽带铁磁共振表明，低频条纹畴磁振子支与一个与磁场无关、频率间隔为3.5 MHz的声子梳相互调制，对应于受限基底厚度剪切模。结果显示该体系处于弱耦合区，避免交叉不明显，其原因是条纹纹理中的相位与畴符号抵消。进一步分析表明，磁纹理可作为调控磁振子-声子耦合的参数。
authors: Nimisha Arora, Daniel Prestwood, Takashi Kikkawa, Eiji Saitoh, Jack Gartside, Will Branford, Hidekazu Kurebayashi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了生长在GGG衬底上的3 μm厚YIG薄膜条纹畴磁态中的磁弹耦合。宽带铁磁共振揭示了低频条纹畴磁振子支，这些支被一个与磁场无关、频率间隔为3.5 MHz的声子梳所调制，该间隔与GGG衬底受限厚度剪切模的预测值一致。解析拟合得到的耦合速率在0.33--0.54 MHz之间，协同效应量级为10⁻¹，表明该系统处于弱耦合区，没有可分辨的反交叉间隙。利用有限元模拟进行的磁振子-声子模重叠计算表明，弱耦合源于相位和畴符号的抵消：局域磁弹耦合虽然相当可观，但条纹纹理中的相干重叠有超过99%被抵消。进一步的全耦合模拟还表明，声子可介导对远端YIG层的激发，并显示要高效产生传播声子，需要空间上不对称的磁振子模式，从而确立了磁纹理作为磁振子—声子耦合控制参数的作用。

articles.title: Thermo-mechanical Characterization of 2D hexagonal Boron Phosphide (h-BP)
articles.title_zh: 二维六方氮化硼磷（h-BP）的热-力学表征
